title: Move, don't think: sample-efficient collision avoidance with lossy proximity sensors
summary: Data-driven robots must learn to avoid collisions with as few demonstrations as possible to avoid collecting large datasets of destructive collision examples. We explore whole-body proximity sensors as inductive biases for learning reflexive collision-dodging behavior and find that lossy sensors with low resolution were stronger biases than high-resolution coverage. We also found that, perhaps unintuitively, anticipating when and where contact happens on the body of a robot reduced its learning sample efficiency. We investigated eight candidate representations in a reinforcement learning environment, which included latent compression, future contact anticipation, lossy corruption, and privileged state estimation. The candidate representations were tested by training over 200 humanoid robots to play a simplified version of dodgeball end-to-end under an intentionally constrained sample and compute budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文将全身近距离传感器作为归纳偏置，用于学习反射式避碰行为；发现低分辨率有损传感器比高分辨率全覆盖更有效，且在八个候选表征中意外发现"预测接触时刻与位置"反而降低样本效率。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动机器人若靠收集碰撞样本来学避碰，代价高且具破坏性，因此希望在极少示范、受限样本与算力预算下获得高效学习，并探索何种传感器表征能作为有效归纳偏置。
AI.method: 在强化学习环境中端到端训练200余个仿真人形机器人玩简化躲避球任务，在刻意受限的样本与计算预算下对比八种表征：潜空间压缩、未来接触预测、有损随机损坏（lossy corruption）、特权状态估计等，并以全身近距离感知作为偏置。
AI.result: 低分辨率、有损的近距离传感表现出比高分辨率全覆盖更强的归纳偏置；对接触发生的时间与部位进行预测（未来接触预测表征）反而降低了学习样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 传感器表征的"信息量"并非越大越好；有损、低分辨率的近距感知更利于学习反射式避碰，而显式接触预测会带来负面效果，提示表征设计应以任务相关性与简洁性为导向。

title: Entity-Aware Evaluation of OCR Systems for Historical Document Transcription
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is essential for digitizing historical archives, yet standard evaluation metrics such as Character Error Rate (CER) do not necessarily reflect whether meaningful information, such as names, dates, and identifiers, is preserved. In this work, we investigate entitylevel analysis of OCR errors as a complementary perspective for evaluating OCR quality in historical documents. Using a publicly available benchmark of 175 documents from the Berrutti Archive, augmented with 5,209 manually annotated entity mentions that will be released upon acceptance, we compare sequence-recognition OCR systems, OCR-specialized vision-language models, and general-purpose vision-language models. Beyond global transcription accuracy, we analyze entity preservation and recoverability under varying character-level edit tolerances. Our experiments show that OCR rankings depend on the evaluation criterion: while Qwen 3.6 achieves the highest entity coverage across all tested tolerances, several systems with lower exact-match coverage recover substantially when small errors are tolerated, suggesting that many of their errors correspond to localized character-level deviations rather than fundamentally incorrect entity transcriptions. Conversely, some systems remain unable to recover many entities even under relaxed matching. These findings show that OCR quality cannot be fully characterized by aggregate transcription metrics alone and highlight the importance of evaluating how OCR errors affect the preservation and recoverability of meaningful information.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"实体级"分析作为OCR质量评估的补充视角：在Berrutti档案175份文档、5209个人工标注实体提及的基准上，对比序列识别OCR、OCR专用VLM与通用VLM，并考察不同字符级编辑容差下实体的保留与可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 标准指标CER只衡量字符级转录误差，无法反映名称、日期、标识符等关键实体的信息是否被保留，因此需要实体级评估来判断OCR错误对语义信息的影响。
AI.method: 构建历史文献基准：Berrutti档案175篇文档，人工标注5,209个实体提及；将标注实体与各系统输出对齐，在精确匹配及多种字符级编辑容差下统计实体覆盖率/可恢复率，并据此比较三类OCR系统（序列识别模型、OCR专用VLM、通用VLM）。
AI.result: OCR系统排名随评价准则而变：Qwen 3.6在所有测试容差下实体覆盖率最高；部分精确匹配覆盖率较低的系统在允许小误差时覆盖率显著回升，说明其错误多为局部字符偏差；另有系统即使放宽匹配仍无法恢复大量实体。
AI.conclusion: 聚合转录指标不足以完整刻画OCR质量，需评估错误对有意义信息保留与可恢复性的影响，实体级分析应作为CER的补充评价维度。

title: Intuition with Evidence: Adaptive Dual Memory for Multimodal Agents
summary: As multimodal agents engage in sustained interactions, long-term memory serves two distinct but complementary functions: fine-grained evidence recall and internalized interpretation for global understanding. Although episodic and latent memory address these demands through explicit historical records and internalized experience, neither paradigm alone can accommodate the diverse memory affinities across tasks, owing to limitations in episodic evidence coverage and integration, and in latent factual grounding. To bridge this divide, we propose a dual-memory framework, unifying a model-native latent memory as an intuitive prior with a multi-indexed episodic memory for exact evidence reconstruction via retrieval-conditioned joint alignment. At inference, the framework adaptively composes these memories through a training-free routing mechanism driven by Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) sensitivity and confidence proxies for query-dependent memory affinity. Extensive evaluations across multimodal benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, outperforming single-paradigm baselines overall (+4.67\% over vanilla Episodic), with further analysis highlighting episodic strengths in evidence-localized tasks and latent contributions to integrating dispersed information and compensating for imperfect retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出双记忆框架：将模型原生隐式记忆（直觉先验）与多索引情景记忆（精确证据重建）通过检索条件联合对齐统一，推理时用基于JSD敏感度与置信度代理的无训练路由机制自适应组合两者。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体长期交互中，记忆需同时满足细粒度证据回溯与全局理解的内化解读，但情景记忆证据覆盖/整合不足、隐式记忆缺乏事实依据，单一范式难以适配跨任务的多样记忆亲和性。
AI.method: 双记忆架构：模型原生隐式记忆 + 多索引情景记忆；通过检索条件联合对齐（retrieval-conditioned joint alignment）实现融合；推理阶段采用无需训练的路由机制，依据Jensen-Shannon散度敏感度和置信度代理，按查询自适应调配两类记忆。
AI.result: 在多模态基准上取得SOTA，整体较纯情景记忆基线提升+4.67%；分析表明情景记忆在证据定位型任务占优，隐式记忆擅于整合分散信息并弥补检索不完美。
AI.conclusion: 双记忆互补范式优于单一范式，JSD驱动的自适应路由有效匹配查询相关的记忆亲和性，为多模态智能体长期记忆提供了可扩展的统一方案。

title: EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM-Generated Chest CT Reports
summary: Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

AI.tldr: 提出 EviGround-CT，在报告生成后用确定性句子抽取 + 3D grounding 模型为每条阳性发现语句预测证据 mask，以验证 CT 报告中的阳性发现是否有影像证据，从而降低无证据阳性发现率。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的胸部 CT 报告可能包含扫描中并无局部影像证据的阳性发现，存在幻觉式误报风险；需要一种生成后的证据核验机制。
AI.method: 确定性抽取器识别阳性发现句子；3D grounding 模型以完整句子为查询预测证据 mask（保留解剖位置、侧别与描述修饰词）；在 CT-RATE 上评估报告生成，在 100 例 ReXGroundingCT 子集上评估 grounding 与验证；与按类别条件化的 baseline 对比，采用配对病例级 bootstrap。
AI.result: 在 137 条抽取的在范围内阳性发现上，证据支持的精度 ESP 由 0.263 提升至 0.365（相对类别条件化），无支持阳性发现率由 0.737 降至 0.635；配对病例级 bootstrap ESP 差值为 +0.102（95% CI [0.028, 0.181]）。预测 mask 可将报告语句与可核查的空间证据对应。
AI.conclusion: 句子级 3D grounding 验证可在生成后有效筛除缺乏影像证据的阳性陈述，提升报告证据可核查性；但绝对 ESP 仍偏低（约 0.37），实际部署价值有限。

title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB: A Hybrid Vision-Language Model for Local AI
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer vision-language model that optimizes speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for local agentic workloads. Derived from the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B model family, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB combines Star Elastic compression with 2-bit Quantization-Aware Distillation for memory-constrained deployment. The model is optimized for reasoning, agentic tool use, and web & terminal interactions. We also trained a LiLiCorr speculative drafter that is released alongside the model to reach our target inference speed. The resulting model achieves a higher accuracy than leading models with similar memory footprints and speed across many benchmarks for general agentic capabilities (e.g., GDPVal v2), web browsing (e.g., BrowseComp), and terminal use (e.g., Terminal-Bench 2.1), with a relatively high TPS of 84 on RTX Spark that is comparable to models with much lower active parameter counts and more than sufficient for long-horizon agentic applications.

AI.tldr: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B: 由 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B 经 Star Elastic 压缩 + 2-bit 量化感知蒸馏得到的混合 Mamba-Transformer 视觉语言模型，74B 总参/9B 激活/24GB 显存，配套 LiLiCorr 投机解码草案模型，RTX Spark 上 84 TPS，面向本地 agentic 长程任务。
AI.motivation: 本地（消费级显卡/边缘设备）部署的 agentic 工作负载对"每 GB 内存的智能与速度"要求极高，现有开源 VLM 在 24GB 显存预算下难以兼顾推理能力、工具调用与推理吞吐。
AI.method: 混合 Mamba-Transformer 架构；从 120B-A12B 母模型通过 Star Elastic 结构化压缩降维，再以 2-bit 量化感知蒸馏（QAD）恢复精度；额外训练 LiLiCorr 投机解码草案头以提升解码速度；针对性优化推理、agentic 工具使用、Web 与终端交互能力。
AI.result: 在 GDPVal v2（通用 agentic）、BrowseComp（网页浏览）、Terminal-Bench 2.1（终端操作）等基准上超越同等内存占用/速度的领先模型；RTX Spark 上 84 TPS，可与激活参数量显著更小的模型速度相当，足以支撑长程 agentic 应用。
AI.conclusion: 压缩+QAD+投机解码的组合可在 24GB 显存内实现接近母模型水平的 agentic VLM，为端侧 agent 系统提供可用基座；但论文为模型/系统报告，缺少与具身/物理 AI 任务的直接证据，作为通用 agent 底座具备参考价值。

title: EKT-Router: Expert-Evidence Alignment for Embodied Vision-Language Models
summary: Embodied vision-language models must answer questions from partial, evolving observations. Their success depends on both the reasoning capability selected and the evidence available to it. Expert routers adapt internal computation, while tool-augmented systems acquire external evidence; choosing these independently can leave a suitable expert without the evidence it needs. We introduce EKT-Router, a bounded framework that jointly selects a capability expert, optional knowledge, and perceptual tools. Outcome-derived signatures represent the overlapping strengths of General, Spatial Reasoning, and Spatiotemporal experts. A joint utility scores complete expert-evidence routes under a call budget. After acquisition, a packet verifier admits valid evidence with positive predicted expert-conditioned gain. The selected expert then answers once, reverting to the unchanged observation if all packets are rejected. Across 6 embodied QA benchmarks, EKT-Router achieves a mean score of 61.4, the highest among the compared systems, and averages 74.7 on 10 general vision-language benchmarks. With all external evidence disabled, question-conditioned expert selection alone improves over the best fixed expert by 1.75 points. Ablations show that learned routing is the dominant component and that knowledge and perception are complementary.

AI.tldr: EKT-Router 是一个有调用预算约束的联合路由框架，同时选择能力专家（通用/空间/时空推理）、可选外部知识与感知工具，并用结果导出的能力签名与"专家条件增益"校验器过滤证据，在 6 个具身 QA 基准和 10 个通用 VLM 基准上取得最优均值。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉语言模型需在部分可观测、不断演化的观察下作答，成功同时取决于所选推理能力与可获取的证据。现有工作要么用专家路由调整内部计算，要么用工具增强获取外部证据，两者独立决策会导致"选对了专家却缺证据"或"取了证据却不匹配专家"的错配问题。
AI.method: 提出 EKT-Router 有界路由框架：(1) 用结果导出的签名刻画 General、Spatial Reasoning、Spatiotemporal 三类专家的重叠能力分布；(2) 在调用预算约束下，用联合效用函数对完整的"专家-证据"路径打分，同时选专家、知识与感知工具；(3) 证据采集后由 packet verifier 只接纳预测专家条件增益为正的包；(4) 被选专家仅作答一次，若所有证据包被拒则回退到原始观察。
AI.result: 6 个具身 QA 基准平均分 61.4，为对比系统最高；10 个通用视觉语言基准平均 74.7。完全关闭外部证据时，仅问题条件化的专家选择即比最佳固定专家高 1.75 分。消融显示学习式路由为主导组件，知识与感知两条证据通道互补。
AI.conclusion: 将专家选择与证据获取耦合建模，比分别独立优化更有效；联合路由是主要收益来源，且外部知识与感知工具具有互补性，预算约束与验证式回退机制可保证稳健性。

title: Detection of false positives by human reviewers depends on the face recognition algorithm and its security configuration
summary: Integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technology into identity workflows, such as automated face recognition (FR), has enhanced operational capabilities, with FR algorithms achieving super-human scale and accuracy. However, these gains can make human oversight of FR more difficult, raising questions about the effectiveness of these human-AI teams. We measured human reviewers' ability to detect false positive errors made by commercial FR algorithms across varying security configurations. Using a novel dataset, the Difficult Facial Image Comparison Test (DFICT), derived from false positives made by four comparable commercial face recognition algorithms, we measured the ability of 801human reviewers to detect algorithmic false positives across three security configurations, representing operationally relevant biometric thresholds. Our findings show that human reviewers can reduce algorithmic false positives, but performance declines at stricter security thresholds. Further, reviewer performance varied by algorithm indicating that some algorithms are more compatible with human oversight. We suggest that biometric systems should be designed to account for human reviewers' variable effectiveness, particularly in high-security applications. Our findings should be considered during algorithm selection and inform human oversight strategies to minimize AI-related risks in operational FR deployments.

AI.tldr: 研究801名人类审核员在不同安全阈值下检出面识别算法误报（false positive）的能力，发现人工复核可降低误报，但阈值越严性能越差，且与具体算法相关。
AI.motivation: 商业人脸识别已达超人级精度，但这反而使人类监督更难有效开展，人机团队的实际效能存疑。
AI.method: 构建 Difficult Facial Image Comparison Test（DFICT）数据集，取自四种可比商业FR算法的误报样本；801名审核员在三种运营相关生物特征阈值配置下进行复核实验。
AI.result: 人工复核能减少算法误报，但在更严格安全阈值下检出性能下降；审核员表现随算法不同而异，说明部分算法更适配人工监督。
AI.conclusion: 生物识别系统设计需考虑人类审核员效能的差异性，尤其在高安全场景；结果应指导算法选型与人工监督策略，以降低AI相关部署风险。

title: Saga: an in silico ontology for a multimodal patient world model
summary: Simulating an individual's disease course requires connecting patient history to future events, clinical timing and disease morphology. Longitudinal prediction and multimodal representations exploit this information, but organizing future readouts around a common patient state and advancing trajectories without real intermediate observations remain central challenges. Here we introduce Saga, a multimodal patient world model that learns a shared state from patient histories to predict clinical events and generate multimodal images. Generated events and times are appended to the history and re-encoded to advance prediction. We studied 461,370 patients with 12 cancer types across 112 centres. Modality-specific paired evaluations linked future images to observed follow-up. With historical images held fixed, removing patient conditioning reduced event F1 from 0.716 to 0.591 and increased lesion-burden error from 11.8% to 21.3%. In free rollouts, eight-step event F1 was 0.672, compared with 0.553 for a longitudinal Transformer evaluated from the same origins, and timing error was lower by 8.7 days. In the internal test set, one-year progression AUROC was 0.882, with values of 0.871 and 0.856 in temporal and geographical external evaluations. These results show that shared patient states connect future phenotypes across observational scales with event-driven trajectory progression, sustaining comparative predictive advantages during rollout and discrimination in external clinical evaluation. Saga makes patient-level disease simulation a multimodal prediction task that can be tested against observed follow-up.

AI.tldr: Saga：多模态"患者世界模型"，从病史学习共享患者状态，预测临床事件并生成多模态图像；生成的事件与时间被回填到病史并重新编码以推进轨迹，实现事件驱动的自回归rollout。
AI.motivation: 纵向预测与多模态表征虽利用了病史、时序与疾病形态，但缺乏统一患者状态来组织未来读出，且在没有真实中间观测时难以推进疾病轨迹。
AI.method: 以患者历史编码共享隐状态，联合预测事件类型/时间并生成图像；将预测事件与时间追加到历史并重编码，形成逐步rollout。112个中心、12种癌症、461,370名患者的回顾性数据；以模态特异性配对评估将生成图像与真实随访对齐；与纵向Transformer对比。
AI.result: 固定历史影像后去掉患者条件，事件F1由0.716降至0.591，病灶负荷误差由11.8%升至21.3%；自由rollout八步事件F1为0.672（对照0.553），时序误差低8.7天；内部测试一年进展AUROC 0.882，时间与地理外部验证为0.871和0.856。
AI.conclusion: 共享患者状态把不同观测尺度的未来表型联系起来，事件驱动推进使轨迹可延续且保持比较优势；将患者级疾病模拟表述为可对照随访检验的多模态预测任务。

title: GMoE-FTI: A Universal Facial Template Inversion Method Adopting Genuine Mixture-of-Experts Mechanism
summary: Face recognition systems have been ubiquitously deployed across daily scenarios. To protect user privacy, mainstream systems store facial templates rather than raw face images for identity verification. However, facial template inversion (FTI) technologies can reconstruct faces from templates, which endangers biometric privacy. Existing FTI methods only fit single type of templates, failing to reconstruct identity-consistent faces from unseen types. To tackle this limitation, we survey mainstream template extractors which can be classified into five categories according the template distribution: unit-sphere, angle-linear, strict unit-sphere, cone-shaped, anuniform hypersphere. Inspired by this observation, this paper proposes GMoE-FTI, a universal FTI framework powered by a genuine MoE mechanism that differs from load-balanced multi-branch alternatives. It follows a three-stage training strategy: (1) independently train five mapping experts (MEs) and a matching module (MM); (2) conduct collaborative inference by weighting each ME's output with MM's output, so as to generate unified latent codes compatible with pre-trained StyleGAN3; (3) perform end-to-end joint fine-tuning over all modules to identity consistency and boost cross-expert coordination. Extensive evaluations on the LFW benchmark validate the superiority of GMoE-FTI against SOTA methods. Evaluated on seven prevailing unseen template types including AdaFace, CosFace, CurricularFace, ElasticFace, SphereFace2, SphereFace-R, and TransFace, GMoE-FTI achieves an average 40% TAR improvement, with average FAPD and FAPC each reduced by 2%, verifying its universal generalization across heterogeneous templates.

AI.tldr: 提出GMoE-FTI通用人脸模板反演框架，按模板分布将主流提取器分为五类，用五个映射专家加匹配模块的MoE结构与StyleGAN3结合重建人脸，在七种未见模板类型上平均TAR提升约40%。
AI.motivation: 现有面部模板反演（FTI）方法只针对单一类型模板拟合，无法从不可见类型的模板重建身份一致的人脸，威胁生物特征隐私审计与安全评估的普适性。
AI.method: 调研主流模板提取器并按模板分布归为五类（unit-sphere、angle-linear、strict unit-sphere、cone-shaped、anuniform hypersphere）；提出GMoE-FTI：五个映射专家（ME）加匹配模块（MM）的真MoE机制，三阶段训练——(1) 独立训练各ME与MM，(2) 用MM权重加权ME输出协同推理生成与预训练StyleGAN3兼容的统一隐码，(3) 全模块端到端联合微调以保障身份一致性并增强专家间协同。
AI.result: 在LFW上优于SOTA；在AdaFace、CosFace、CurricularFace、ElasticFace、SphereFace2、SphereFace-R、TransFace七种未见模板类型上平均TAR提升约40%，FAPD与FAPC各降低约2%。
AI.conclusion: 基于模板分布分类构建的MoE式反演框架可跨异质模板泛化，说明模板隐空间的结构先验是实现通用FTI的关键。

title: Aerial-R1: Reinforcing Aerial Reasoning and Segmentation in MLLMs
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have revolutionized general visual perception, existing methods suffer from severe hallucination in the aerial domain, where extreme scale variations and visual ambiguity abound. Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) paradigms force models to mimic ground truth without modeling uncertainty, often resulting in blind guessing on tiny or unrecognizable objects in aerial scenes. In this paper, we present Aerial-R1, the first aerial MLLM framework to reinforce visual reasoning capabilities for aerial reasoning and segmentation. Drawing inspiration from the reasoning-incentivizing mechanisms of DeepSeek-R1, we find that trustworthy perception stems from consistency across views, establishing a visual parallel to the Chain-of-Thought in logic. To effectively adapt policy optimization for non-autoregressive mask generation, we introduce Hybrid-View Group Advantage-Weighted Regression (H-GAWR). This strategy constructs dynamic groups of high-resolution and low-resolution views, seamlessly bridging group-relative advantage estimation with advantage-weighted policy extraction. By enforcing consensus on clear inputs and strictly penalizing hallucinations on ambiguous ones, Aerial-R1 develops an explicitly incentivized refusal mechanism. Extensive experiments on VSAI-Ref, the first aerial MLLM benchmark dedicated to jointly evaluating dense reasoning and hallucination robustness, demonstrate that Aerial-R1 significantly outperforms SFT baselines in segmentation precision while substantially mitigating fatal hallucinations in low-information scenarios, paving the way for more reliable and trustworthy aerial agents. Codes are available on this https URL .

AI.tldr: Aerial-R1：首个面向航空场景的多模态大模型强化推理框架，用混合视角组优势加权回归（H-GAWR）把"跨视角一致性"当作视觉版思维链，实现对掩码生成的非自回归策略优化，并形成显式"拒绝回答"机制以抑制航空小目标幻觉。
AI.motivation: 航空视觉存在极端尺度变化与视觉模糊，现有SFT范式强迫模型模仿真值、不建模不确定性，导致对极小或不可辨识目标"盲猜"，幻觉严重；需要把逻辑推理中的CoT思想迁移为"跨视角一致性"来激励可信感知。
AI.method: 以DeepSeek-R1式推理激励为灵感，提出H-GAWR：动态构造高/低分辨率视角组，将组相对优势估计与优势加权策略提取桥接，用于非自回归掩码生成的策略优化；对清晰输入强制一致性、对模糊输入严格惩罚幻觉，从而内生出显式拒答机制。同时构建VSAI-Ref基准（首个联合评测稠密推理与幻觉鲁棒性的航空MLLM基准）。
AI.result: 在VSAI-Ref上，Aerial-R1在分割精度上显著优于SFT基线，并在低信息场景下大幅缓解致命幻觉；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将RL式推理激励与跨视角一致性结合可有效提升航空MLLM的可靠性与可信度，为可拒答、抗幻觉的航空智能体奠定基础；核心贡献是方法与基准，属遥感领域专用工作。

title: DRA-SAM: Disagreement-Driven Referential Active SAM for Low-Altitude Drone Referring Segmentation
summary: Referring segmentation in low-altitude drone imagery requires distinguishing small, visually similar instances under complex linguistic and spatial constraints. Global inference may yield multiple plausible masks or leave the intended referent insufficiently represented, motivating selective local re-inference. We propose DRA-SAM, a disagreement-driven framework that allocates an additional inference pass according to competing referential hypotheses and an unresolved state. A lightweight EvidenceScorer estimates beliefs over existing candidates and the unresolved state. A training-free Referential Disagreement LOOK policy balances belief-weighted candidate competition and unresolved-region coverage to select a crop for local re-inference. The same benchmark-adapted SAM3-I backbone processes the selected region, and the resulting evidence updates existing hypotheses and introduces new candidates. Among the compared methods, DRA-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on six of seven test metrics on both RIS-LAD and UAVid-RIS, including mIoU and P@0.5-P@0.9, and on all seven RIS-LAD validation metrics. On RIS-LAD, DRA-SAM improves the matched global SAM3-I baseline from 49.55 to 52.34 mIoU and from 46.80 to 58.05 P@0.5. On UAVid-RIS, the independently adapted DRA-SAM achieves 73.26 mIoU and 86.86 P@0.5. Controlled crop-policy comparisons demonstrate the effectiveness of disagreement-guided crop selection, while target-size analysis reveals particularly pronounced gains for aerial targets occupying less than 1% of an image. These results establish referential disagreement as an effective criterion for allocating local inference. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DRA-SAM：基于指代分歧驱动的局部再推理框架，用于低空无人机图像的指代分割，在RIS-LAD和UAVid-RIS上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机指代分割中小目标多、视觉相似度高且语言/空间约束复杂，全局推理易产生多个可行掩码或目标表征不足，因此需要选择性地进行局部再推理。
AI.method: 提出DRA-SAM框架：轻量EvidenceScorer在已有候选与"未解决"状态上估计信念分布；无训练的Referential Disagreement LOOK策略权衡信念加权的候选竞争与未解决区域覆盖来选择裁剪区域；由同一适配的SAM3-I骨干处理裁剪区，证据更新已有假设并新增候选。
AI.result: 在RIS-LAD与UAVid-RIS的七个测试指标中六个达SOTA（含mIoU、P@0.5-P@0.9），RIS-LAD验证集七项指标全部最佳；RIS-LAD mIoU 49.55→52.34、P@0.5 46.80→58.05；UAVid-RIS达73.26 mIoU与86.86 P@0.5；消融验证分歧引导裁剪策略，目标小于图像1%时增益显著。
AI.conclusion: 指代分歧可作为分配局部推理的有效判据，为小目标、歧义场景下的指代分割提供可插拔的自适应重推理机制，代码开源。

title: KDHNet: A Knowledge-Driven Hybrid Network for Limited-Calibration SSVEP Decoding
summary: Steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) achieve high information transfer rates but often require sufficient subject-specific calibration data for reliable decoding. Analytical spatial filters are effective with limited data, but their linear formulations constrain representation capacity. Deep models learn more flexible representations but are prone to overfitting when calibration data are scarce. We propose KDHNet, which combines knowledge-driven analytical processing with data-driven representation learning. After filter-bank preprocessing, cascaded task-discriminant component analysis (TDCA) and task-related component analysis (TRCA) extract discriminative and trial-reproducible components. Learnable sub-band weighting then fuses spectral information, and an SSVEPformer decoder learns temporal and spectral representations for classification. For inter-subject decoding, a target-guided least-squares transformation aligns source trials using one labeled target trial per class. Extensive experiments were performed on three public datasets, covering intra- and inter-subject protocols, five analysis windows, and multiple calibration ratios. In intra-subject evaluation, KDHNet achieved the highest mean accuracy and information transfer rate in 14 of 15 window settings and all ten calibration-ratio settings. In inter-subject evaluation, KDHNet obtained the best or second-best performance, and the gains were generally larger with less calibration data. Ablation studies indicated that the estimated TDCA projection performed better when fixed than when optimized from analytical or random initialization. Combining fixed knowledge priors with trainable neural modules is effective for low-calibration SSVEP decoding. This framework supports more practical, robust, and plug-and-play BCIs. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: KDHNet将知识驱动的TDCA/TRCA解析空间滤波与SSVEPformer数据驱动解码结合，配合子带加权和跨被试目标引导最小二乘变换，在少校准条件下实现高准确率SSVEP脑机接口解码。
AI.motivation: SSVEP-BCI需要高信息传输率但依赖充足被试特定校准数据：解析空间滤波在少样本下有效但线性表达受限，深度模型灵活但少校准易过拟合。目标是兼顾两者。
AI.method: 滤波器组预处理后，级联TDCA与TRCA提取判别性与试次可复现成分；可学习子带权重融合频谱信息；SSVEPformer解码器学习时频表征用于分类；跨被试场景用目标引导最小二乘变换，每类仅需一个带标签目标试次对齐源域试次。
AI.result: 三个公开数据集，覆盖被试内/跨被试、5种分析窗口、多种校准比例。被试内15个窗口设置中14个、全部10个校准比例设置中获得最高平均准确率与ITR；跨被试取得最佳或次佳，且校准数据越少增益越大。消融显示固定的TDCA投影优于从解析或随机初始化优化的版本。
AI.conclusion: 固定知识先验与可训练神经模块结合对低校准SSVEP解码有效，支持实用、鲁棒、即插即用的BCI；代码开源。

title: MOSAIC: Towards a Universal Latent Space for Computational Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) differ substantially in architecture, pretraining objective, training data and representation dimensionality, yet it remains unclear whether they learn fundamentally different feature spaces or alternative coordinate systems of a shared underlying representation. We present MOSAIC, a systematic study of latent-space similarity, alignment and interoperability across $12$ patch-level and $6$ slide-level PFMs. We first quantify representational agreement using complementary similarity measures and analyze how architecture, pretraining objective, network depth and magnification influence latent geometry. We then evaluate multiple alignment strategies for mapping independently learned representations into a common latent space. The resulting representations are evaluated through cross-model agreement, retrieval, geometry preservation, and downstream multiple-instance learning across molecular and morphological prediction tasks. MOSAIC provides a unified framework for studying whether heterogeneous PFMs can move beyond representational similarity toward a shared and functionally transferable pathology representation space. Our code, benchmarks and additional results are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MOSAIC系统研究12个patch级与6个slide级病理基础模型的潜空间相似性、对齐与互操作性，判断异构PFM是否只是同一表征的不同坐标系。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型在架构、预训练目标、训练数据与表征维度上差异巨大，尚不清楚它们学到的是本质不同的特征空间，还是同一底层表征的不同坐标表示。
AI.method: 用互补相似度度量量化表征一致性，分析架构、预训练目标、网络深度和放大倍率对潜几何的影响；评估多种对齐策略将独立学到的表征映射到公共潜空间，并通过跨模型一致性、检索、几何保持及下游多示例学习（分子与形态学预测）进行验证。
AI.result: 构建了跨18个病理基础模型（12 patch级、6 slide级）的统一表征相似性、对齐与互操作性评测框架，并公开代码与基准。
AI.conclusion: 异构病理基础模型有望超越单纯表征相似性，走向共享且可功能迁移的病理表征空间；MOSAIC为这一研究提供了统一框架。

title: MARC: Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction for Articulated Object Code Generation
summary: Generating an articulated object from images and text requires more than plausible parts and movable joints: the assembled mechanism must execute the intended motion. This is particularly challenging for closed-chain and coupled mechanisms, where an error in one connection can block motion or separate connected parts. We introduce MARC, Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction, which shares an executable kinematic graph across program construction, motion solving, and correction. The graph binds physical connections to local attachment frames and represents loop closures and joint-coordinate couplings. Given prescribed driver inputs, a numerical solver computes follower motion and associates errors with specific connections and configurations. The agent uses these diagnostics to probe possible causes, revise connections or geometry, and retest the mechanism along the original motion paths. On a 20-object test set, MARC with Kimi-K3 achieves 67.8% valid motion coverage and 60.0% overall success, outperforming six baselines. Starting from the same initial candidates, correction improves these scores by 13.7 and 20.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablations further show the benefits of graph-based mechanism support and graph-guided repair. Project homepage: this https URL .

AI.tldr: MARC（Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction）用共享的可执行运动学图统一程序构建、运动求解与纠错，使图像+文本生成的articulated object能真正执行预期运动，尤其针对闭链与耦合机构。
AI.motivation: 从图像与文本生成articulated object不仅要部件合理、关节可动，更要求装配后的机构能实现预期运动；闭链/耦合机构中单处连接错误即可导致运动卡死或部件分离，现有生成方法缺乏机构层面的可执行性校验与修复。
AI.method: 构建跨"程序构建—运动求解—纠错"共享的可执行运动学图，将物理连接绑定到局部附着坐标系，并显式表示闭环约束与关节坐标耦合；给定驱动输入，数值求解器计算从动件运动，并将误差定位到具体连接与构型；智能体据此探测可能成因，修订连接或几何，并沿原始运动路径重测。
AI.result: 在20个对象的测试集上，MARC+Kimi-K3取得67.8%的有效运动覆盖率与60.0%整体成功率，优于6个基线；从相同初始候选出发，纠错环节分别提升13.7与20.0个百分点；消融实验验证了图结构机构支持与图引导修复的作用。
AI.conclusion: 将运动学图作为可执行中间表示并配合求解器诊断驱动的智能体反思修复，能显著提升articulated object生成的功能可行性，为agent驱动的3D/机构生成与迭代精修提供了可复用的范式。

title: Oddin: Latent Visual Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models via Self-Distillation from Image Generation
summary: Unified large multimodal models (ULMMs) are able to perform visual reasoning through interleaved text-image generation, but generating explicit intermediate images incurs significant computational overhead. While visual latent reasoning addresses this, most existing methods rely on vision-language models (VLMs) incapable of visual generation. We propose Oddin, a novel framework enabling latent visual reasoning in ULMMs. Oddin replaces intermediate images with compact latent tokens processed entirely by the understanding branch, reserving the generation branch for the final output image. We train the model via offline self-distillation with three objectives, final image generation losses, text distillation losses, and cross-entropy losses for special tokens. Oddin surpasses interleaved generation baselines and closed-source VLMs on average across seven VBVR-Pro visual reasoning tasks. Qualitative analysis reveals that latent tokens attend to relevant regions in an input image, demonstrating that ULMMs can perform complex visual reasoning without generating intermediate images.

AI.tldr: Oddin框架在统一多模态大模型中将中间推理图像替换为紧凑视觉潜变量token，仅由理解分支处理，生成分支只负责最终输出，并以离线自蒸馏训练，在七个视觉推理任务上超越交错图文生成基线与闭源VLM。
AI.motivation: 统一大模型通过交错文本-图像生成进行视觉推理，但显式生成中间图像带来显著计算开销；已有的视觉潜空间推理方法多基于不具备生成能力的VLM，无法在ULMM中实现。
AI.method: 提出Oddin：用紧凑潜变量token替代中间图像，全部由理解分支处理，生成分支仅用于最终图像输出；采用离线自蒸馏训练，包含三项目标——最终图像生成损失、文本蒸馏损失、特殊token交叉熵损失。
AI.result: 在VBVR-Pro的七个视觉推理任务上平均性能超过交错生成基线与闭源VLM；定性分析显示潜变量token能关注输入图像中的相关区域。
AI.conclusion: ULMM无需生成中间图像即可完成复杂视觉推理，潜空间推理是高效且有效的替代路径。

title: A Canary in the Neural Mine: Catching an Image Classifier's Silent, Confident Failures
summary: Deployed vision models auto-accept confident predictions, so high-confidence errors propagate silently. Maximum Softmax Probability (MSP), the standard failure predictor, has a structural blind spot: as a scalar read from the classifier head, it is first-order blind to feature variation orthogonal to its confidence gradient. Through a factorial analysis of feature-space detectors, we identify a conditional-redundancy principle explaining why they fail to complement MSP: the class-separability geometry they measure is already encoded in MSP and collapses under fusion. The signal that survives is class-conditional typicality on the off-manifold residual---and because this residual's distribution varies by backbone, from near-Gaussian to heavy-tailed, it must be estimated non-parametrically. We instantiate these findings as CANARY, a training-free detector that computes a per-class kNN distance on the PCA residual of the penultimate feature, percentile-calibrates it on validation data, and fuses it with MSP through a single validation-tuned weight. CANARY's benefit follows a headroom law: gains grow as baseline MSP quality falls, so a single clean-validation number forecasts the improvement. With every parameter selected on in-distribution data alone, CANARY matches or improves 382 of 385 shift cells (e-AURC; 379 on AUROC) across five backbones, with worst-case regression within seed noise ($-0.0002$ AUROC) and the largest gains on natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-A/R, ObjectNet)---where deployed models are most exposed.

AI.tldr: 分析MSP的"一阶盲区"，提出条件冗余原则解释特征空间检测器为何无法互补MSP；用"类条件典型性 + 离流形残差的非参数kNN估计"构造免训练检测器CANARY，在385个shift单元中382个匹配或超越MSP。
AI.motivation: 部署的视觉模型自动接受高置信预测，高置信错误会静默传播。作为标准失败预测器的MSP存在结构性盲点：它是从分类头读出的标量，对与置信度梯度正交的特征变化一阶不敏感；而现有特征空间检测器也未能有效补充MSP，其失效原因尚缺乏解释。
AI.method: 因子式分析特征空间检测器，提出“条件冗余原则”：它们度量的类可分性几何已被MSP编码，融合时信号坍塌。存活信号是离流形残差上的类条件典型性；该残差分布在近高斯到重尾之间随backbone变化，故须非参数估计。实例化CANARY：免训练，在倒数第二层特征的PCA残差上计算每类kNN距离，在验证集上做百分位校准，并以单一验证集调优权重与MSP融合；全部参数仅用ID数据选择。
AI.result: 五个backbone上385个shift单元中e-AURC 382个、AUROC 379个匹配或提升；最差回归在种子噪声内（-0.0002 AUROC）；自然分布偏移（ImageNet-A/R、ObjectNet）增益最大。增益服从"headroom law"：基线MSP越差增益越大，可用单一干净验证集指标预判改进幅度。
AI.conclusion: 置信度标量存在结构性盲区，但补足它的不是类可分性几何而是离流形残差的类条件典型性（需非参数估计）；据此的免训练CANARY以零ID数据之外依赖稳定提升失败检测，并在部署最易暴露的自然偏移上收益最大。

title: ProtoEEG: Structured Prototype Alignment for EEG Visual Decoding
summary: EEG visual decoding remains difficult because scalp recordings are noisy, spatially coarse, and variable across trials and subjects. Most systems align each trial with a dense image embedding, although that embedding mixes semantic content with instance-specific texture, pose, and background. This target can demand details absent from EEG and provides no explicit account of the visual factors supporting a prediction. We propose \textbf{ProtoEEG}, a prototype-mediated framework that reformulates EEG--image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook. A trainable EEG encoder and a frozen visual teacher produce assignment distributions over the same $K=64$ prototypes. Their weighted reconstructions form a structured representation for retrieval and image generation. Prototype contrast supplies the main cross-modal training signal, distribution alignment coordinates codebook use across modalities, an instance anchor preserves fine-grained discrimination, and diversity regularization prevents redundant prototypes. The shared assignment profile also makes the learned bottleneck directly testable through prototype retention, random selection, and identity shuffling. Across five seeds, ProtoEEG reaches 64.0\% Top-1 and 91.5\% Top-5 on THINGS-EEG2 200-way retrieval. After retraining on EEG-ImageNet, it obtains 44.8\% Top-1 and 73.8\% Top-5 in 80-way retrieval. ProtoEEG also ranks first on all seven reconstruction metrics. Removing prototype contrast lowers Top-1 by 56.9 percentage points, while shuffling prototype identities reduces it to 0.5\%. Prototype analyses further show distributed assignments and broad codebook use rather than one-prototype routing. These results support structured alignment targets as a practical alternative to increasing encoder or teacher capacity alone.

AI.tldr: ProtoEEG将EEG-图像对齐重构为在共享可学习视觉码本(K=64原型)上的软组合,用原型对比作为主跨模态信号。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG视觉解码多用稠密图像嵌入作对齐目标,该嵌入混杂语义与实例纹理、姿态、背景,要求EEG无法提供的细节,且无法显式解释支撑预测的视觉因素。
AI.method: 可训练EEG编码器与冻结视觉教师对同一码本K=64产生分配分布,加权重建形成结构化表示;损失含原型对比、跨模态分布对齐、实例锚定与多样性正则;通过原型保留/随机选择/身份打乱做瓶颈可测性检验。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG2 200类检索五seed平均Top-1 64.0%、Top-5 91.5%;EEG-ImageNet 80类44.8%/73.8%;七项重建指标均第一;去掉原型对比Top-1降56.9点,打乱原型身份降至0.5%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化(原型中介)对齐目标可作为单纯增大编码器或教师容量的实用替代方案,并揭示分布式而非单原型路由的码本使用模式。

title: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
summary: We introduce OvisOCR3, a 0.8B model for a broad range of OCR-related tasks. OvisOCR3 unifies document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction (KIE), document figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction in a single model. We train the model on real and synthetic data through continued pretraining and use domain-balanced mid-training to balance supervision across tasks with different data volumes and response lengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation transfers expertise from five domain-specific 4B teachers into the shared model, followed by mixed-task reinforcement learning with domain-specific rewards. We compare OvisOCR3 with general-purpose vision-language models and specialized OCR models on public and in-house benchmarks covering all five task families. In these comparisons, it achieves an overall score of 96.74 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and the highest overall scores on PureDocBench, Real5-OmniDocBench, and MDPBench. On OCRBench v2, it ranks first, scoring 65.9 and 61.3 on the English and Chinese splits, respectively. It also outperforms the baselines on OCRBench and all four KIE benchmarks. On DocFigCapBench, it achieves the highest localization F1 and a caption score close to that of Qwen3.8-Max. For cross-page tables, it leads in Relation F1 on CrossTabBench and truncated-table TEDS on MPDocBench-Parse. These results demonstrate that a compact 0.8B model can achieve strong performance across diverse OCR-related tasks. OvisOCR3 is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OvisOCR3: a unified 0.8B OCR model covering document parsing, general OCR, KIE, document figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction, trained via continued pretraining, domain-balanced mid-training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation from five 4B teachers, and mixed-task RL; tops multiple OCR benchmarks.
AI.motivation: OCR-related tasks are fragmented across specialized models and large general VLMs; the authors aim to show a single compact model can handle diverse document/OCR tasks well.
AI.method: Unified 0.8B model trained on real + synthetic data via continued pretraining; domain-balanced mid-training to equalize supervision across tasks with differing data volume/response length; multi-teacher on-policy distillation from five domain-specific 4B teachers; mixed-task RL with domain-specific rewards; evaluated on public and in-house benchmarks across five task families.
AI.result: 96.74 overall on OmniDocBench v1.6; best overall on PureDocBench, Real5-OmniDocBench, MDPBench; OCRBench v2 first place (65.9 EN / 61.3 ZH); beats baselines on OCRBench and all four KIE benchmarks; DocFigCapBench best localization F1 with caption score near Qwen3.8-Max; best Relation F1 on CrossTabBench and truncated-table TEDS on MPDocBench-Parse.
AI.conclusion: A 0.8B compact model can match or beat both general VLMs and specialized OCR systems across diverse OCR-related tasks; strong evidence for unified distillation + RL training recipes.

title: Decentralized Multi-View, Multi-Zone Tracking for Scalable Camera Networks
summary: We present a decentralized multi-view tracking system for scalable camera networks. Single-view detections are projected to bird's-eye-view (BEV) coordinates and fused by independent multi-view trackers, each managing a dynamic spatial zone. To support scalability across spatially partitioned camera networks, we introduce a decentralized layer for trajectory unification, utilizing a locking protocol and periodic track-merging operations termed global collate. This process is supported by a delayed-output buffering mechanism that retroactively applies history corrections. The configurable delay window absorbs asynchronous coordination latency and helps stabilize cross-zone identity consistency. We detail the design of dynamic zone polygons, consensus-based coordination, and the validation framework, which together maintain global ID consistency with minimal accuracy loss compared to a single-instance baseline in the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出去中心化多视角跟踪系统：单视角检测投影到BEV后由各自负责动态空间区域的独立多视角跟踪器融合，并通过带锁协议与周期性"全局汇总"轨迹合并的去中心化轨迹统一层，配合延迟输出缓冲实现历史回修正，从而在空间分区相机网络上保持全局ID一致性。
AI.motivation: 大规模相机网络下的多视角跟踪难以集中式扩展：跨区域身份一致性依赖全局信息，而集中式融合在大规模下通信与计算瓶颈明显。
AI.method: 检测投影至BEV坐标；多个独立多视角跟踪器各管理一个动态空间区域（动态区域多边形设计）；引入去中心化协调层，采用锁定协议与共识式协调执行周期性全局汇总（track merging）；以延迟输出缓冲缓冲异步协调时延并回溯修正历史轨迹，维持跨区域ID一致；并给出验证框架。
AI.result: 在评估配置下实现可扩展的空间分区跟踪，相比单实例基线仅有极小的精度损失，同时保持全局ID一致性；延迟窗口可吸收异步协调时延并稳定跨区域身份。
AI.conclusion: 为分布式多相机跟踪提供了一套可工程化的去中心化轨迹统一方案，通过动态区域划分、锁定/共识协调与延迟缓冲处理分布式一致性代价，适用于可扩展的相机网络部署。

title: PhaseBreak: Proactive Temporal Protection against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Animation
summary: Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single portrait or photograph, enabling shared images to be repurposed for motion synthesis without the subject's authorization. We study proactive visual protection against such use: before an image is released, its owner applies a bounded perturbation that preserves the sharing workflow but disrupts downstream motion generation. Existing spectral disruption objectives globally attenuate temporal representations and therefore provide limited control over subtle or spatially localized motion. Our key idea is that generated dynamics depend not only on temporal feature strength, but also on the order in which feature events occur. We propose PhaseBreak, a white-box spectral retiming protection method that matches intermediate denoiser features to a constrained temporal rearrangement of their clean counterparts. PhaseBreak operates along the true temporal axis and uses a subject-aware mask to confine the protective perturbation to the depicted subject. Evaluations on Stable Video Diffusion and DynamiCrafter show that protected images induce greater short-term motion variation and lower temporal regularity, impeding stable motion customization from the released image.

AI.tldr: PhaseBreak：白盒频谱"重定时"保护，通过将I2V去噪器中间特征匹配到其干净特征的受限时间重排，破坏肖像图像的下游动作生成。
AI.motivation: I2V扩散模型可将单张肖像照片动画化，带来未经授权的运动合成滥用风险；现有频谱扰动方法仅全局削弱时间表征强度，对细微或空间局部化运动的控制能力有限。
AI.method: 提出PhaseBreak白盒保护：在真实时间轴上，将去噪器中间特征与干净特征的受限时间重排（temporal rearrangement）对齐，结合主体感知掩码把有界扰动限制在主体区域，只在分享工作流中加扰动。
AI.result: 在Stable Video Diffusion与DynamiCrafter上，受保护图像产生更大的短期运动变化和更低的时间规律性，妨碍从发布图像进行稳定的运动定制。
AI.conclusion: 控制特征事件的时间顺序而非仅削弱强度，可更精细地破坏I2V运动合成，提供了一种主体局部的主动视觉保护范式。

title: DuoPIC: Uncertainty-Aware Voxel-Level Digital Twins of Cerebral Perfusion with Transport PDEs in Acute Stroke
summary: Digital twins of cerebral perfusion relate tracer dynamics to cerebral blood flow (CBF), blood volume (CBV) and mean transit time (MTT), but must be data-driven, physically consistent and uncertainty-aware. We introduce DuoPIC, a digital twin that needs no reference maps, in which a Windkessel flow model drives a tracer transport partial differential equation (PDE). A population-level neural closure divides each region into fast and slow pathways with tracer mass and MTT conserved by construction, and a tempered posterior quantifies the uncertainty of every estimate. Its voxel maps set the state of the art for lesion detection on ISLES'17 MR (AUC 0.745) and ISLES'24 CT (0.743). On held-out patients, the neural PDE reduced the compartment's reconstruction error by 19% and lifted 95% MTT interval coverage from 88% to 94%. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: DuoPIC：无需参考图的脑灌注数字孪生，Windkessel血流模型驱动示踪剂输运PDE，群体级神经闭包将区域分为快/慢通路并保持质量与MTT守恒，经tempered后验量化不确定性；在ISLES'17 MR与ISLES'24 CT上病灶检测SOTA（AUC 0.745/0.743），神经PDE使重建误差降19%、95% MTT区间覆盖率由88%升至94%。
AI.motivation: 脑灌注数字孪生需将示踪剂动力学与CBF/CBV/MTT关联，但现有方法依赖参考图、物理一致性差且缺乏不确定性量化。
AI.method: Windkessel血流模型耦合示踪剂输运偏微分方程；群体级神经闭包（neural closure）按快/慢通路分流并结构性守恒示踪剂质量与MTT；采用tempered（温度调节）后验进行贝叶斯不确定性量化；无需参考图，体素级参数图端到端生成。
AI.result: ISLES'17 MR病灶检测AUC 0.745、ISLES'24 CT AUC 0.743，均达SOTA；留出患者上重建误差降低19%，95% MTT置信区间覆盖率88%→94%。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束+神经闭包+不确定性感知的数字孪生范式可提升灌注参数估计的准确性与可信度，代码开源，可迁移至其他示踪剂动力学建模问题。

title: VLMProbe: An Open-source Library for VLM Probing and Interpretation
summary: Understanding how vision-language models use visual information requires connecting internal representations to model behavior. We present vlmprobe, an open-source library that integrates lens readouts, attention attribution, causal interventions, and sparse autoencoder (SAE) analysis within a common model interface. Shared adapters, calibration and checkpoint utilities, evaluation pipelines, and visualizations support systematic analysis across architectures. Using this framework, we compare methods across vision-language, language, and vision models through matched case studies and controlled evaluations of pretrained sparse dictionaries. The comparisons show that representation readouts and spatial explanations depend on the analysis objective and observation site, and that local attribution estimates can disagree with measured intervention effects. SAE evaluations further expose distinct trade-offs in reconstruction fidelity, concept readout, and spatial localization. Together, these results support combining multiple forms of evidence to evaluate an interpretation. vlmprobe provides a reusable basis for selecting methods, comparing their conclusions, and testing hypotheses about model behavior. The code is available on this http URL

AI.tldr: 开源库 vlmprobe 统一集成 lens 读出、注意力归因、因果干预与 SAE 分析，用于跨视觉-语言、语言、视觉模型的可解释性比较研究。
AI.motivation: 要理解 VLM 如何使用视觉信息，需把内部表征与模型行为连起来；但现有可解释性工具分散、接口不一，难以在同一框架下系统比较不同方法及其结论。
AI.method: 构建统一模型接口的开源工具库，整合 lens 读出（logit/tuned lens 类）、注意力归因、因果干预（激活替换/消融等）与稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析；提供共享适配器、校准与检查点工具、评估流水线及可视化；并以此做匹配案例研究与预训练稀疏字典的受控评估，横向比较 VLM、LM 与视觉模型。
AI.result: 表征读出与空间解释结果依赖于分析目标与观测位点；局部归因估计可能与实测干预效应不一致；SAE 在重建保真度、概念读出与空间定位之间存在明显权衡。
AI.conclusion: 单一证据不足以评估解释质量，应结合多种证据形式做交叉验证；vlmprobe 为方法选择、结论比较与行为假设检验提供可复用基础设施（代码开源）。

title: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and experimental results: this https URL
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform tasks specified through natural-language instructions, but their large weight footprint challenges deployment on memory-constrained onboard platforms. Ultra-low-bit quantization reduces this footprint, yet preserving task performance and controlling weight recovery costs remain challenging. We propose Action-Guided Quantization, which combines action sensitivity with a measured proxy for weight recovery cost to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets. Per-channel calibration compensates for quantization error, while a uniform bitwidth within each matrix preserves regular layouts. Bit-dependent grouped lossless coding reduces resident weight storage, and block-wise recovery limits temporary buffers. On LIBERO, AGQ achieves 92.7% task success at W3, exceeding AWQ and GPTQ by 1.2 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively, and retains 70.5% success at W2.5. An asymmetric configuration, denoted W1.5$^{*}$, uses W4 vision weights and a parameter-weighted average of 1.5 bits for language weights. With lossless coding, it achieves $6.10\times$ complete-model compression relative to BF16 while retaining 25.5% task success. Code and experimental results are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Action-Guided Quantization (AGQ)：用动作敏感度加权重恢复代价代理，在存储预算下为 VLA 各权重矩阵分配比特宽度，配合逐通道校准、矩阵内统一位宽、按位分组的无损编码与分块恢复，实现超低位宽部署。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型权重规模大，难以部署在显存受限的机载平台；超低位宽量化虽能压缩，但往往损害任务成功率，且权值恢复（反量化/解压）的临时开销难以控制。
AI.method: (1) 以动作敏感度叠加实测的权重恢复代价代理作为重要性度量，在存储预算约束下求解各矩阵的位宽分配；(2) 逐通道校准补偿量化误差，同时保持每个矩阵内位宽统一以维持规整内存布局；(3) 按位宽分组做无损编码以降低常驻权重存储；(4) 分块反量化限制临时缓冲区峰值。
AI.result: LIBERO 上 W3 达 92.7% 成功率，分别超过 AWQ 与 GPTQ 1.2、3.7 个百分点；W2.5 仍保持 70.5%。非对称配置 W1.5*（视觉 W4、语言加权平均 1.5 bit）结合无损编码实现相对 BF16 的 6.10× 整模压缩，并保留 25.5% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: AGQ 表明动作敏感度是 VLA 量化的有效分配信号，可在保持规整布局与低反量化开销的前提下显著压缩整模；但极低位宽（≤1.5 bit 平均）下成功率仍大幅下降，适用性集中在 W3 附近的部署区间。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Evidence Misgrounding in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
summary: Multimodal knowledge editing aims to update visually grounded facts in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) while preserving unrelated text and visual behaviors. However, standard answer-level metrics can hide evidence misgrounding: an edit may produce the target answer on the original image yet remain sensitive to incidental context rather than the intended visual evidence. To examine this issue in a controlled setting, we construct WaterBird-Edit, an analysis set that decouples bird habitat labels from background context and measures whether edited predictions remain stable when the target evidence is preserved but the background changes. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose VICE (Visual In-Context Editing), a retrieval-based framework that stores edits in external memory and applies them through visual in-context demonstrations designed to expose task-relevant evidence. Experiments on three standard benchmarks show that VICE achieves strong lifelong editing performance, while results on WaterBird-Edit show that it substantially reduces sensitivity to the controlled background shifts. Code and dataset are available in this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文诊断多模态知识编辑中的"证据错位"问题（答案正确但依赖偶然背景而非目标视觉证据），构建 WaterBird-Edit 解耦数据集，并提出检索式外部记忆 + 视觉上下文演示的 VICE 框架。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 多模态知识编辑普遍以答案级指标评估，会掩盖证据错位：模型在原图上输出正确目标答案，但实际依赖背景等偶然上下文。作者的动机是把这种"看似编辑成功"的隐患在受控条件下显式暴露并加以解决。
AI.method: 1) 构建 WaterBird-Edit 分析集，将鸟类栖息地标签与背景上下文解耦，测试在保留目标证据、替换背景时编辑后预测是否稳定；2) 提出 VICE（Visual In-Context Editing），将编辑存入外部记忆，通过检索式视觉上下文演示显式呈现任务相关证据，而非改动参数。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准上取得较强的终身编辑性能（lifelong editing）；在 WaterBird-Edit 上显著降低对受控背景偏移的敏感性，从而缓解证据错位。
AI.conclusion: 答案级指标不足以衡量多模态知识编辑的可靠性，需引入证据稳定性评估；检索式视觉上下文编辑是兼顾编辑效果与去偏鲁棒的可行路径。

title: Evaluating Visual Language Models on Visual Grounding for Visually Impaired People
summary: Visual grounding (VG) in visual question answering (VQA) is a fundamental capability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), enabling the detection of the most relevant region in an image to answer the question. This reflects the model's capability of multimodal comprehension, which is crucial when interacting with visually impaired people (VIP). Indeed, visual grounding, when applied to assistive scenarios, is not merely a technical feature, but rather a trust and safety requirement. In this work, we study visual grounding in VLMs for visually impaired people. To this end, we assess open-source VLMs on visual grounding using the VizWiz-VQA-Grounding dataset and challenge, which contains real-life images taken by VIP. We propose VG-SHAP, which extends an existing explainability framework to provide visual grounding explanations, allowing the evaluation of black-box VLMs. Our results on the VizWiz-VQA-Grounding challenge show that despite generating correct answers, VLMs struggle to ground in the proper region in the image. However, these results are constrained by the quality of the segmentation model of our explainability framework and further research is necessary.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究面向视障人士（VIP）场景下视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉 grounding 能力，提出 VG-SHAP 可解释性框架，在 VizWiz-VQA-Grounding 数据集上评测开源 VLM，发现模型虽能答对问题却难以定位正确区域。
AI.motivation: 视觉 grounding 在辅助视障人士的 VQA 场景中不仅是技术特性，更是信任与安全需求，但现有 VLM 在此真实生活图像上的 grounding 表现缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 基于 VizWiz-VQA-Grounding 数据集与挑战赛评测开源 VLM；提出 VG-SHAP，将现有可解释性框架（SHAP）扩展为可给出视觉 grounding 解释，从而对黑盒 VLM 进行 grounding 评估。
AI.result: 实验显示，VLM 虽常能生成正确答案，但在图像中定位到正确区域的能力明显不足；结果受所依赖分割模型质量限制。
AI.conclusion: VLM 在辅助场景下的视觉 grounding 存在显著可靠性缺口，可解释性驱动的评估是可对黑盒模型进行 grounding 分析的有效途径，但需进一步研究以克服分割质量瓶颈。

title: Rethinking Video Storage for AI Training: Breaking Cross-Frame Dependencies for Efficient Random Access
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Large-scale AI training increasingly relies on massive video datasets with random temporal sampling patterns. However, existing video storage paradigms are optimized for sequential playback and employ sophisticated inter-frame reference structures to maximize compression efficiency. When applied to the random-sampling workloads of AI training, these paradigms face substantial decoding-efficiency bottlenecks. Workarounds such as independent JPEG frames and short groups of pictures (GOPs) reduce decoding work at the cost of larger storage and transfer volumes. In this paper, we identify two sources of decode amplification: sequential reconstruction of unrelated frames and reconstruction of the reference chains required by sampled targets. We address both sources by co-designing the decoding schedule and video reference structure. Dependency-aware sparse decoding reconstructs only requested frames and their required references, skipping unrelated reconstruction without transcoding the source videos. Optional offline Dependency-Decoupled Random Access (DDRA) encoding further reduces reference reconstruction by restricting each interior frame to two bounding intra-coded anchors. Together, sparse decoding and DDRA retain inter-frame prediction while bounding reconstruction to at most three frames per requested target, independent of the intra period. Experiments on a large-scale robotics corpus show that, at comparable reconstruction quality, our method achieves $1.45\times$ the loading throughput of LeRobot v3 with 58.7% less media payload.

AI.tldr: 针对AI训练随机时序采样导致的"解码放大"问题，提出依赖感知稀疏解码与DDRA编码协同设计，在不转码的前提下将每个请求帧的重建上界限制为3帧。
AI.motivation: 大规模视频AI训练采用随机抽帧，而现有视频编码（顺序预测、长参考链）在此负载下产生两类解码放大：重建无关帧与逐级重建参考链。既有折中（独立JPEG帧、短GOP）以存储与传输体积为代价。
AI.method: 协同设计解码调度与视频参考结构：(1) Dependency-aware sparse decoding，仅重建被请求帧及其必需参考帧，跳过无关重建，无需转码源视频；(2) 可选离线DDRA（Dependency-Decoupled Random Access）编码，将每个内部帧的参考限制为两个界定的帧内锚点，从而在保留帧间预测的同时将参考重建规模收敛。
AI.result: 在等重建质量下，相比LeRobot v3，加载吞吐提升1.45倍，媒体负载（存储/传输体积）减少58.7%；每个请求目标的重建帧数上界为3帧，且不依赖于GOP内周期长度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示并量化了视频数据存储在AI训练随机访问场景下的解码放大瓶颈，通过编码结构与解码调度联合优化实现系统性效率提升，对具身智能数据集的高效存储与加载具有直接工程价值，但属于数据基础设施层贡献，不涉及策略方法创新。

title: SWIFT-Cell: Segmentation Without Iterative Flow Tracking
summary: Generalist segmenters such as Cellpose-SAM (CPSAM) outline cells accurately across stains but slowly; watershed detectors such as QuPath's are fast but less accurate. In time-critical use, such as interactive retrieval of cells from a user-drawn region, CPSAM at the reference settings takes 58-303 s per measured 8192 x 8192 region on an RTX 4500 Ada GPU, beyond a seconds-scale interactive target. We distil CPSAM into SWIFT-Cell (SWIFT), a 0.63M-parameter U-Net trained only on CPSAM masks of 1,202 H&E and IHC tiles. On three 8192 x 8192 development regions SWIFT takes 2.0-5.2 s on 4 CPU cores in int8, 2.5-5.1x faster than QuPath's detector on the same cores, and 0.36-0.49 s on a GPU. Against human annotations on eight H&E, IHC and ISH sets it keeps 95% of CPSAM's panoptic quality (PQ) on PanNuke (0.593 vs. 0.627) and is level on NuCLS (0.546 vs. 0.540). On Ki-67 IHC masks scored to the outline centre it is 0.205 PQ above QuPath's better mode, 0.079 below CPSAM and 0.027 below InstanSeg (CI includes 0; at the outer edge 0.008 below CPSAM); on 212 pathologist-outlined nuclei in Ki-67 fields of 12 untouched patients its recall is 0.925 (CPSAM 0.920, InstanSeg 0.901; paired difference CIs include 0); one method-blinded pathologist accepted its outlines in 96% of 100 fields (60 from two development tissue patients, 40 hematology; CPSAM 83%, QuPath 53%; tissue 100% for SWIFT and CPSAM); on ER/PR points from 12 patients its detection F1 is 0.882 (CPSAM 0.896, InstanSeg 0.857), and on 4-reader PD-L1 points 0.83 (CPSAM 0.85, readers 0.87). SWIFT is close to CPSAM in accuracy and faster than watershed detection.

AI.tldr: 将 Cellpose-SAM 蒸馏为 0.63M 参数的 U-Net（SWIFT-Cell），在 CPU int8 上 2–5 秒处理 8192² 区域，精度接近教师模型，显著优于 QuPath 分水岭检测。
AI.motivation: 通用分割器（CPSAM）精度高但推理慢，分水岭检测（QuPath）快但精度低；交互式细胞提取等场景需要秒级响应，而 CPSAM 需 58–303 秒/区域，无法满足。
AI.method: 以 CPSAM 在 1,202 张 H&E 与 IHC 图块上生成的掩码为唯一监督，蒸馏出 0.63M 参数的轻量 U-Net；支持 int8 CPU 与 GPU 推理，并与 QuPath、InstanSeg、人工标注在 PanNuke、NuCLS、Ki-67、ER/PR、PD-L1 等多套数据上对比。
AI.result: 8192² 区域 CPU 4 核 int8 下 2.0–5.2 秒（比 QuPath 快 2.5–5.1 倍），GPU 0.36–0.49 秒；PanNuke PQ 0.593（CPSAM 0.627），NuCLS 0.546（0.540）；Ki-67 上优于 QuPath、略低于 InstanSeg/CPSAM，差异置信区间含 0；212 个细胞核召回 0.925；单盲病理学家对 96% 视野接受；ER/PR F1 0.882、PD-L1 0.83。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏式轻量分割器在保持接近教师模型精度的同时实现秒级推理，速度超越分水岭检测；该方法为数字病理交互式分析提供了可行折中方案。

title: The Paired Thermal Channel Is Two Orthogonal Axes: A Controlled Attribution Study of Calibration Cost and Detection Gain in Infrared Person Detection
summary: The calibrated thermal channel in infrared person detection comprises two structurally orthogonal axes. True calibrated $\Delta T$ outperforms scale-matched grayscale pseudo-$\Delta T$ by $+0.0221$ mAP (paired Wilcoxon $p=0.0098$, Cohen's $d=+1.08$), confirming that the calibrated channel carries information the grayscale channel lacks. The calibration axis is driven by the joint pairing-scale condition. Preserving both paired correspondence and absolute calibrated scale raises expected calibration error (ECE) from $\approx 0.05$ to $0.142$. The $2\times 2$ interaction ($p=0.0059$) localizes the rise to this condition. Breaking either factor alone returns ECE to the broken-factor level (true-vs-const $p=0.002$; true-vs-shuffled $p=0.002$). Under post-hoc temperature scaling, the pairing cost survives recalibration ($p=0.002$), while the scale cost is largely absorbed ($p=0.16$). As regards the detection axis, the gain stems from structural de-structuring. Phase randomization, which destroys spatial structure while preserving per-sample variance, yields $+0.0185$ mAP over true $\Delta T$ on FLIR ADAS ($p=0.014$, $d=+0.96$). The FLAME~3 gain is $+0.0064$ mAP ($p=0.078$, n=8). On the calibration axis, the same intervention is insignificant on FLIR ADAS ($p=0.47$) but significant on FLAME~3 ($p=0.0078$). These findings rest on a five-arm controlled attribution with temperature-evidential learning (TEL) as the testbed. TEL obtains a single evidence-derived routing scalar together with a complementary diagnostic entropy, and establishes a finite-evidence degeneracy theorem proving that the acquisition product degenerates to this scalar with a closed-form bound. A physical $0.5^\circ$C threshold admits cross-dataset physical readings, whereas a gray threshold of $20$ inverts without physical interpretation.

AI.tldr: 该文以温度证据学习(TEL)为测试床，用五臂受控归因实验解耦红外行人检测中"校准热通道"的配对(paired correspondence)轴与绝对校准尺度(scale)轴，并讨论其对检测mAP与校准误差(ECE)的分离影响。
AI.motivation: 红外行人检测中经校准的热通道(ΔT)相比灰度伪热通道是否携带独有信息、其增益与校准代价来源不明；需区分"配对对应"与"绝对热尺度"两个正交因素，并给出可检验的归因证据。
AI.method: 五臂受控消融/归因实验：真ΔT vs 尺度匹配灰度伪ΔT、真vs常量、真vs打乱；阶段随机构造(structural de-structuring)保留逐样本方差但破坏空间结构；2×2配对×尺度交互检验；post-hoc温度缩放重校准；以TEL为测试床，提出有限证据退化定理并给出闭式界，采用0.5°C物理阈值与灰度阈值20作对照。
AI.result: 真ΔT较尺度匹配伪ΔT高+0.0221 mAP(p=0.0098,d=+1.08)；保持配对与绝对尺度同时成立使ECE由≈0.05升至0.142，2×2交互显著(p=0.0059)，单独破坏任一因素ECE回落(p=0.002)；温度缩放后配对代价仍存(p=0.002)，尺度代价被吸收(p=0.16)；相位随机化在FLIR ADAS上较真ΔT +0.0185 mAP(p=0.014,d=+0.96)，FLAME 3为+0.0064 mAP(p=0.078,n=8)，且对ECE影响数据集相关(FLIR p=0.47；FLAME 3 p=0.0078)。
AI.conclusion: 校准热通道的检测增益来自"去结构化"，而校准代价源于配对与绝对尺度的联合约束且二者可分离；0.5°C物理阈值支持跨数据集物理可解释读数，灰度阈值20不可解释。结论依赖受控小样本统计，泛化性需更大规模验证。

title: Spectrally optimized implicit neural representations mitigate acquisition-related image quality trade-offs in intracranial 4D Flow MRI
comment: 36 pages, 7 main figures, 2 supplementary figures. Under review at Medical Image Analysis
summary: 4D Flow MRI promises opportunities for non-invasive mapping of neurovascular hemodynamics, but its clinical utility faces trade-offs between resolution, acquisition time, and noise. Deep learning-based super-resolution offers a post-scan solution, but supervised approaches require paired or domain-specific data, while patient-specific physics-informed models can be computationally demanding. This creates a need for unsupervised reconstruction models that can adapt to individual acquisitions without paired high-resolution training data, while remaining robust across anatomy, disease severity, and acquisition quality. To address this, we introduce a spectrally tuned implicit neural representation (INR) framework for intracranial 4D Flow MRI, representing the velocity field as a continuous coordinate-based neural field using WIRE activation functions with tunable spectral bias. Data-driven and physics-informed variants were evaluated in nine cerebrovascular cases spanning healthy controls and moderate-to-severe intracranial atherosclerotic disease, using CFD-derived high-resolution reference fields, MR-realistic synthetic low-resolution inputs, and direct fitting to acquired in-vivo data. Cohort-optimal spectral-bias settings generalized across subjects with only small increases in relative error compared with subject-specific optima, reducing the need for case-specific hyperparameter tuning. Physics-informed regularization provided modest additional accuracy but required substantially longer optimization, whereas the data-driven INR achieved near-comparable reconstruction performance within minutes. The framework also remained robust to acquisition-realistic noise and moderate VENC-dependent aliasing. These findings establish spectrally optimized INRs as a flexible unsupervised approach for mitigating acquisition-related trade-offs in intracranial 4D Flow MRI.

AI.tldr: 用可调谐频谱偏置的WIRE隐式神经表示(INR)做颅内4D Flow MRI的无监督超分辨重建，数据驱动版数分钟即可接近物理约束版精度，且对噪声与VENC混叠稳健。
AI.motivation: 4D Flow MRI的临床可用性受限于分辨率、采集时间与噪声的三角权衡；现有深度学习超分需配对/域内数据，患者特异物理模型计算代价高。因此需要无需配对高分辨训练、能适配单次采集且跨解剖部位、疾病严重度与采集质量稳健的无监督重建模型。
AI.method: 将速度场建模为坐标驱动的连续神经场（INR），采用WIRE激活函数实现可调频谱偏置，并给出数据驱动与物理信息（含流体方程正则）两种变体。在9例脑血管病例（健康对照+中重度颅内动脉粥样硬化）上评估：以CFD高分辨场为参考、MR真实感合成低分辨输入，并直接在在体采集数据上拟合。
AI.result: 队列级最优频谱偏置设置可跨被试泛化，相对误差仅略高于逐被试最优，减少逐例调参；物理正则带来小幅精度增益但优化时间显著更长，数据驱动INR在数分钟内达到近似精度；框架对采集噪声与中等程度VENC相关混叠保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 频谱优化的INR是一种灵活的无监督途径，可缓解颅内4D Flow MRI采集相关的分辨率-时间-噪声权衡。

title: Investigating the trackability of landmarks in NBI and WLI
summary: Reliable visual tracking of anatomical landmarks in endoscopic video is a key prerequisite for computer-assisted interventions in laryngeal surgery. While Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) is clinically established for enhancing vascular contrast, its effect on automated tracking relative to conventional White Light Imaging (WLI) remains unexplored. We present a quantitative comparison of landmark trackability in NBI and WLI using a forward-backward error framework applied to 61 endoscopic videos from 39 patients. Two regions of interest are evaluated: the vocal folds (VF) and mucosa with a prominent vascular pattern (MPVP). We compare a classical feature-based tracker (CSRT) against learning-based point trackers (CoTracker3-Online and TrackOnR) across both modalities. NBI consistently reduced the forward-backward error in both regions, reaching statistical significance for the vocal folds, while failure rates stayed low. These findings indicate that NBI can improve tracking robustness in laryngeal endoscopy, with implications for motion analysis, navigation, and robotic assistance.

AI.tldr: 比较喉镜手术中NBI与WLI两种成像模态对解剖关键点跟踪可靠性的影响，用前向-后向误差框架评测61段视频（39例患者），涉及声带与显著血管化黏膜两区域，对比CSRT经典特征跟踪器与CoTracker3-Online、TrackOnR学习型点跟踪器。
AI.motivation: 计算机辅助喉部手术需要在内窥镜视频中可靠跟踪解剖关键点。NBI在临床已确立用于增强血管对比度，但其相对于常规白光成像对自动跟踪效果的影响尚不清楚，缺乏定量评估。
AI.method: 在内窥镜视频上采用前向-后向误差（forward-backward error）评估框架，对NBI与WLI两模态做定量对比；选取声带（VF）与显著血管化黏膜（MPVP）两个ROI；对比基线为经典特征跟踪器CSRT与两种学习型点跟踪器CoTracker3-Online、TrackOnR；数据规模61段视频、39例患者。
AI.result: NBI在两个ROI中均一致降低了前向-后向误差，其中声带区域的降低达到统计显著；两种模态下的跟踪失败率均保持较低水平。
AI.conclusion: NBI可提升喉部内窥镜视频中的跟踪鲁棒性，对运动分析、导航与机器人辅助具有潜在意义。研究属于成像模态对跟踪性能影响的实证评估，方法层面主要为现成跟踪器的评测应用。

title: Beyond Visible Speakers: Context-Aware Active Speaker Detection with Speaker Registration
summary: Active speaker detection (ASD) relies on audiovisual correspondence between speech and visible faces, yet this correspondence becomes unreliable in crowded scenes, or when visual evidence is unavailable. We introduce ROAM-ASD-C and ROAM-ASD-CR to extend ROAM-ASD with contextual and identity-aware reasoning. ROAM-ASD-C jointly reasons across simultaneously visible candidates, allowing other faces to provide complementary evidence when the target observation is ambiguous or incomplete. ROAM-ASD-CR incorporates registered-speaker representations derived from enrollment speech, allowing detection of whether a speaker is active even when that speaker is not visually observed. ROAM-ASD-C achieves state-of-the-art performance across five ASD benchmarks: 96.8% mAP on AVA, 98.9% on WASD, 88.8% on UniTalk, 98.7% on Talkies, and 99.5% on ASW. It also improves ROAM-ASD by up to 13.3 mAP under 75% target-track visual removal.

AI.tldr: ROAM-ASD-C/CR 扩展 ROAM-ASD：前者做多候选人脸联合上下文推理，解决拥挤/目标不可靠时的视听对应问题；后者引入注册说话人表征，实现说话人未被看到时的活跃检测。AVA 96.8 mAP 等五项基准 SOTA，目标轨迹 75% 遮挡下提升 13.3 mAP。
AI.motivation: ASD 依赖语音与可见人脸之间的视听对应，但在拥挤场景或视觉证据缺失（目标未被拍到/被遮挡）时该对应不可靠。已有方法多基于单目标独立推理，无法利用同场景其他候选的信息，也无法处理"说话人不可见"的情形。
AI.method: 在 ROAM-ASD 基础上提出两个变体：ROAM-ASD-C 对同一时刻可见的多个候选做跨候选联合推理，用其他人脸提供互补证据；ROAM-ASD-CR 进一步引入由注册语音（enrollment speech）得到的说话人嵌入表征，将说话人身份线索与视觉观测解耦，从而在目标不可见时仍判断其是否活跃。
AI.result: AVA 96.8% mAP、WASD 98.9%、UniTalk 88.8%、Talkies 98.7%、ASW 99.5%，五个 ASD 基准均达 SOTA；在 75% 目标轨迹视觉移除设置下较 ROAM-ASD 提升最多 13.3 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 上下文联合推理与身份感知表征能有效缓解拥挤与视觉缺失下的视听对应失效问题，是 ASD 在非理想观测条件下的可行改进方向。

title: Ampe-DB: A Dataset for Human Activity and Interaction Analysis Using the Ghanaian Game Ampe
comment: 74 pages, 9 figures, 7 numbered tables. Ampe-DB V1 dataset (637 interaction clips) available at this https URL
summary: Human activity recognition benchmarks underrepresent culturally situated forms of movement and interaction. We introduce Ampe-DB, a multimodal dataset based on Ampe, a traditional Ghanaian game involving coordinated jumping, leg movements, and two-person interaction. It contains 637 canonical clips from 15 participants, with RGB video, two-person pose representations, participant and pair metadata, four-class movement labels, and derived binary movement-relation labels. We evaluate four-class movement recognition and binary movement-relation classification using three protocols: a duplicate-safe fixed benchmark, four-fold pair-held-out evaluation, and participant-held-out diagnostics for participants with complete class coverage. Baselines comprise a frozen Kinetics-400-pretrained R(2+1)D-18 RGB encoder, a two-layer bidirectional GRU for pose sequences, and validation-selected RGB-pose late fusion. For four-class recognition, RGB macro-F1 falls from 0.955 on the fixed benchmark to 0.418 under pair-held-out evaluation and 0.384 under participant-held-out evaluation. Pose is more robust, achieving 0.957, 0.811, and 0.839 across the same protocols. Fusion reaches 0.976 on the fixed benchmark and 0.824 under pair-held-out evaluation, but does not consistently improve on pose under participant shift. Binary movement-relation recognition also becomes substantially harder under held-out evaluation, especially for different-leg configurations. These findings show that strong fixed-benchmark scores can mask failures to generalize across people and pairings. Ampe-DB supports research on fine-grained movement recognition, human-human interaction, multimodal learning, and identity-aware generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ampe-DB：基于加纳传统游戏 Ampe 的多模态人体动作数据集（637 片段/15 人，RGB + 双人姿态 + 元数据 + 四类动作标签 + 二元交互关系标签），并提供固定基准、配对留出、参与者留出三种评测协议，揭示固定基准高分掩盖跨人泛化失败的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有人体活动识别基准缺乏文化情境化的双人协调运动，且固定划分基准上的高分往往掩盖模型对"未见个体/配对"的泛化失败。
AI.method: 构建 Ampe-DB 多模态数据集；评测三任务协议：重复安全的固定基准、四折 pair-held-out、participant-held-out 诊断；基线为冻结 Kinetics-400 预训练 R(2+1)D-18 RGB 编码器、双层双向 GRU 姿态序列模型、验证集选择权重的 RGB-Pose 晚期融合。
AI.result: 四类识别中 RGB macro-F1 从固定基准 0.955 降至 pair-held-out 0.418、participant-held-out 0.384；姿态更稳健（0.957/0.811/0.839）；融合在固定基准 0.976、pair-held-out 0.824，但在参与者漂移下不总优于姿态；二元动作关系识别在留出设置下显著变难，异侧腿配置尤甚。
AI.conclusion: 固定基准分数不能代表跨人与跨配对泛化能力；Ampe-DB 可用于细粒度动作识别、人-人交互、多模态学习与身份感知泛化研究，但作者未提出改进泛化性的方法。

title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT, a large-scale Character-centric dataset and benchmark covering diverse Large-Angle Camera Trajectories, with accurate camera geometry and multi-view character observations for training and evaluation. We further propose WorldCast, a framework for world-consistent character video generation under diverse large-angle camera motions. Specifically, we back-project the initial frame into a 3D point cloud using estimated depth, align the point-cloud scale with the target camera trajectory, and render it along the trajectory to obtain explicit geometric guidance and coverage masks. To complement the incomplete character information, we introduce Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA). Using relative camera poses estimated jointly from the initial frame and multi-view character anchors, we express anchor and target-view geometry in a common coordinate frame. GAMA uses this geometric alignment to guide the retrieval and injection of view-relevant character features during generation. Evaluations across diverse large-angle camera trajectories demonstrate accurate trajectory following while preserving character geometry, appearance, and identity.

AI.tldr: CLACT大规模角色中心数据集与基准，覆盖大角度相机轨迹与多视角角色观测；WorldCast通过深度反投影点云+轨迹渲染提供几何引导与覆盖掩码，并用几何对齐记忆注意力注入多视角锚点特征，实现世界一致的角色视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以在任意初始方位下跟随包含旋转、平移与半径变化的大角度轨迹；视角变化暴露初始帧未见区域，导致几何畸变、外观退化与身份漂移。需要系统性研究这些耦合挑战。
AI.method: 构建CLACT数据集（精确相机几何+多视角角色观测）；WorldCast框架：用估计深度将初始帧反投影为3D点云，对齐点云尺度与目标轨迹并沿轨迹渲染，得到显式几何引导与覆盖掩码；Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention（GAMA）以联合估计的相对位姿将锚点与目标视角几何表达在统一坐标系，引导视角相关角色特征的检索与注入。
AI.result: 在多样大角度相机轨迹上评测，方法能准确跟随轨迹，同时保持角色几何、外观与身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将显式几何引导（点云渲染+覆盖掩码）与几何对齐的多视角记忆注意力结合，可有效缓解大角度视角变化带来的未观测区域补全问题，推动可控角色视频生成。

title: Matching Particle-Arrival Rates for Low-Count Image Denoising
summary: Low-count imaging arises when limited illumination or dose yields only a few detected particles in microscopy, such as photons or electrons, causing measurements to be dominated by signal-dependent Poisson shot noise. Supervised denoisers typically require paired clean and noisy observations, whereas many self-supervised approaches exploit spatial or temporal redundancy without directly estimating the underlying particle-arrival process. We introduce PARM, a self-supervised denoising framework based on particle-arrival-rate matching. By modeling particle accumulation over exposure as a Poisson counting process, PARM identifies the conditional particle-arrival-rate field with the posterior mean of the latent clean rate. Poisson thinning then splits each observation into complementary lower-exposure views that provide self-supervised rate targets for one another. In implementation, the network estimates the normalized spatial allocation of the conditional rate, while the observed total count determines its global particle mass. Experiments on synthetic data, natural-video sequences corrupted with Poisson noise, and real low-dose electron microscopy demonstrate leading or competitive performance while effectively preserving fine structures. PARM therefore provides a statistically grounded approach to low-count image denoising when clean references are unavailable.

AI.tldr: PARM：基于泊松到达率匹配的自监督低计数图像去噪框架，用泊松稀疏化构造互补低曝光视图互为目标，网络只预测归一化空间分配、由观测总计数确定全局粒子质量。
AI.motivation: 低计数成像（少光子/少电子）受信号相关泊松散粒噪声主导；监督去噪需成对干净数据，现有自监督方法靠空间/时间冗余，未直接建模粒子到达过程。
AI.method: 将曝光内粒子累积建模为泊松计数过程，用隐干净率的后验均值作为条件到达率场；通过泊松稀疏化把单次观测拆分为互补的低曝光视图互为监督目标；网络输出归一化空间分配，全局粒子质量由观测总计数给定。
AI.result: 在合成数据、加泊松噪声的自然视频序列及真实低剂量电子显微镜数据上取得领先或具竞争力性能，并有效保留精细结构。
AI.conclusion: PARM 为无干净参考的低计数去噪提供统计上自洽的方案，适用于显微成像等低剂量场景。

title: Learning Pathology-Sensitive Representations for Unsupervised Retinal OCT Anomaly Detection
summary: Deep learning approaches for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) predominantly rely on predefined disease categories, limiting their ability to detect rare or previously unseen abnormalities. While visual foundation models provide transferable representations, their effectiveness in identifying pathological deviations from normal retinal anatomy remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce an unsupervised framework for retinal OCT anomaly detection and localization that adapts pretrained visual representations to normal retinal anatomy through anatomy-aware reconstruction and contrastive triplet learning guided by synthetic structural perturbations, without requiring disease-specific annotations. We systematically investigate the influence of pretraining strategies, anatomy-aware representation adaptation, and anomaly scoring mechanisms on the detection and localization of unseen retinal abnormalities. Our findings demonstrate that adapting pretrained representations to normal retinal structure improves anomaly sensitivity, while pixel-space reconstruction errors and feature-space deviations provide complementary signals for identifying pathological changes. These findings underscore the importance of anatomy-aware representation learning and offer insights into developing generalizable retinal anomaly detection frameworks beyond predefined disease categories.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督视网膜OCT异常检测与定位框架，通过解剖感知重建与由合成结构扰动引导的对比三元组学习，将预训练视觉表征适配到正常视网膜解剖结构，无需疾病标注即可发现未见异常。
AI.motivation: 现有OCT深度学习依赖预定义疾病类别，难以检出罕见或未见异常；视觉基础模型虽有可迁移表征，但其在偏离正常解剖时的异常识别能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 无监督框架：利用解剖感知重建与合成结构扰动引导的对比三元组学习，将预训练视觉表示适配至正常视网膜解剖；系统分析预训练策略、解剖感知适配与异常评分机制的影响。
AI.result: 解剖感知表征适配提升异常敏感性；像素空间重建误差与特征空间偏差对病灶识别提供互补信号。
AI.conclusion: 强调解剖感知表示学习的重要性，为超越预定义疾病类别的可泛化视网膜异常检测框架提供思路。

title: WebUniverse: Scaling Verified Training Data for Agentic Web Development
summary: Training agents for front-end web development requires demonstrations of code editing, execution, browser inspection and revision, yet public trajectories and reusable task environments remain limited. We introduce WebUniverse, a pipeline that constructs verifiable tasks with verified development trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages. The tasks cover text-grounded application development in standalone and iterative settings and vision-grounded reproduction across pages and viewports. We collect agent trajectories for these tasks and verify the resulting applications against task-specific functional or visual requirements. We release WebUniverse-Env, containing 15K executable task environments, and WebUniverse-Mix, containing the corresponding 15K development trajectories with verification records and scores. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on WebUniverse-Mix raises the Vision2Web average score from 51.7 to 68.3, WebGen-Bench accuracy from 34.5% to 63.9%, and Web-Bench pass@2 from 12.2% to 23.1%. The resulting model also outperforms a public-data baseline trained with the same configuration and sample budget across all reported metrics. Ablations show complementary benefits from text and visual trajectories and continued gains as training data scales from 5K to 15K trajectories.

AI.tldr: WebUniverse：从开源仓库与真实网页构建可验证前端开发任务与经验证轨迹，发布15K可执行环境与15K轨迹数据集，微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B显著提升多个Web智能体基准。
AI.motivation: 前端Web开发智能体需要代码编辑、执行、浏览器检查与迭代修正的演示数据，但公开轨迹与可复用任务环境稀缺。
AI.method: 自动化流水线：基于开源仓库与真实网页构造任务（文本驱动的独立/迭代式应用开发、跨页面与多视口的视觉复现），采集智能体轨迹，并按任务特定的功能或视觉需求进行验证与打分；产出WebUniverse-Env（15K可执行环境）与WebUniverse-Mix（15K带验证记录与分数的轨迹）。
AI.result: 在WebUniverse-Mix上微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B：Vision2Web均分51.7→68.3，WebGen-Bench准确率34.5%→63.9%，Web-Bench pass@2 12.2%→23.1%；全面优于同配置同预算的公开数据基线；消融显示文本与视觉轨迹互补，5K→15K规模扩展持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 可验证任务+经验证轨迹的数据流水线能有效训练通用Web/前端开发智能体，且数据规模与模态具互补收益。

title: Gaussian Episodic Memory for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Reasoning
comment: Code and data: this https URL
summary: Real-world environments undergo continual semi-static changes, requiring a memory representation that captures both the spatial and temporal evolution of a scene. Existing spatio-temporal memories for robots typically rely either on structured representations, which are limited to the entities and attributes captured during construction, or on image-based memories, which are constrained to previously observed viewpoints. We introduce GEMS, a framework that combines a persistent spatio-temporal 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) map with an agentic reasoning pipeline. The 3DGS map is reconstructed once and subsequently updated only in regions where the scene changes, storing only these modifications while preserving visual detail across time. The agentic pipeline leverages this map to render novel views on demand, iteratively accumulating evidence to answer spatio-temporal questions and ground objects from natural-language queries. To advance future research, we introduce GEMS-Bench, a spatiotemporal question-answering benchmark focused on semi-static environments. It comprises 3 real-world and 12 synthetic environments, spanning 473 question-answer pairs. We evaluate GEMS on novel-view synthesis quality across scene updates, 3D object grounding, spatiotemporal question answering, and storage efficiency. GEMS outperforms recent baselines in 3D object grounding and spatiotemporal question answering, while achieving rendering quality on par with dedicated scene-update methods. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: GEMS结合持久化�空3D高斯泼溅地图与智能体推理管线，实现半静态场景的增量更新、新视角渲染、3D物体定位与时空问答，并发布GEMS-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 真实环境持续半静态变化，机器人记忆需同时建模空间与时间演化；现有结构化表示受限于构建时的实体/属性，图像记忆受限于已观测视角。
AI.method: 一次性重建3DGS地图，仅在场景变化区域增量更新并存储差异，保留全时序视觉细节；智能体管线按需渲染新视角、迭代累积证据以回答时空问题并依据自然语言查询进行物体定位。
AI.result: 在3D物体定位与时空问答上优于近期基线，渲染质量与专用场景更新方法相当，并具备较高存储效率；GEMS-Bench含3个真实+12个合成环境、473个问答对。
AI.conclusion: 持久增量3DGS地图加智能体推理可作为机器人在动态半静态环境中的可扩展时空记忆表示，兼具精度与存储效率。

title: World-in-Context: Interactive Video World Modeling with In-Context Conditioning
summary: Interactive video world models require coordinated control over viewing perspectives, character actions, and camera motion. Existing methods typically leave view modes implicit in text captions, conflate action with camera motion, and inject controls through fragmented architectural pathways that capture interdependencies only indirectly. In this work, we present World-in-Context, an interactive world modeling framework powered by In-Context Conditioning (ICC). Rather than relying on specialized conditioning pathways, World-in-Context unifies view, action, and camera controls into explicit tokens contextualized directly within a shared self-attention space. Our formulation reveals that (i) explicit view tokens disentangle conflicting dynamics and unlock emergent view switching from single-view data, while (ii) action and camera inputs play complementary roles in governing local responsiveness and global stability. To preserve temporal continuity across execution intervals, we further introduce Interaction-Transport RoPE (IT-RoPE), parameterizing temporal attention with accumulated control transitions. On WBench, World-in-Context-5B achieves navigation performance on par with 22B EchoWM ($81.5$ vs. $81.6$) and attains a $93.8\%$ perspective-switching success rate, substantially outperforming existing 5B baselines ($18.8\%$). Controlled analyses further demonstrate compounding advantages of World-in-Context under richer conditioning mixtures, favorable data efficiency, and natural applicability to causal rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出 World-in-Context 交互式世界模型框架，用 In-Context Conditioning 将视角、动作、相机控制统一为共享自注意力空间中的显式 token，并提出 IT-RoPE 保持跨执行间隔的时间连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有交互视频世界模型把视角模式隐含在文本描述中、混淆动作与相机运动，并通过割裂的条件注入通路间接建模三者依赖关系，导致视角切换与全局稳定性难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将 view/action/camera 控制均编码为显式 token 放入统一 self-attention 上下文，替代专用条件分支；引入 Interaction-Transport RoPE，用累积控制转移参数化时间注意力以维持执行间隔间的时序连续。
AI.result: 在 WBench 上，5B 模型导航性能与 22B EchoWM 持平（81.5 vs 81.6）；视角切换成功率 93.8%，远超现有 5B 基线（18.8%）；消融显示显式 view token 可从单视角数据涌现视角切换能力，动作与相机输入分别主导局部响应与全局稳定；更丰富条件混合下具复合收益、数据效率高且适用于因果 rollout。
AI.conclusion: 显式统一 in-context 控制在交互式视频世界模型中优于碎片化条件通路，小模型可达到大模型性能，具备良好的条件扩展性与因果推理适配性。

title: RAIWAY: A Large-Wheeled Bipedal Robot with Contact-Informed Blind Locomotion
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
