summary: We present RAIWAY, an in-house wheeled bipedal robot with 20-inch wheels, together with a contact-informed control approach for rolling locomotion across irregular and discontinuous terrain. Such locomotion is fundamentally contact-dominated, governed by local wheel--terrain interaction that is impractical to instrument directly and depends on more than terrain geometry alone. The proposed framework exploits the contact information available in simulation, distilling multi-contact events into a latent representation. At deployment, the controller infers this representation online from proprioception, requiring no contact sensing. In real-world experiments, the proposed system traverses diverse environments including steep slopes, gravel beds, studded surfaces, and rocky terrain, and demonstrates continuous ascent on the tested outdoor staircases with riser heights up to 15~cm. On our platform, the proposed controller further outperforms baselines without the contact-informed mechanism across challenging indoor and outdoor settings. The video can be found at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RAIWAY: 20英寸轮径轮腿机器人 + 接触信息蒸馏的隐式接触表示控制，无需接触传感器即可在陡坡、碎石、凸起路面、岩石及最高15cm台阶的户外楼梯上连续爬升。
AI.motivation: 轮式双足在非规则/断续地形上的滚动运动本质由局部轮-地接触主导，而该接触难以直接测量且不仅取决于地形几何，故需要一种可在线推断接触状态的控制器。
AI.method: 利用仿真中可获得的多接触事件，蒸馏为紧凑隐式表示（contact latent），训练策略；部署时仅用本体感知（proprioception）在线推断该表示，无需接触传感，形成contact-informed控制框架。
AI.result: 真实机器人穿越陡坡、砾石床、钉突表面与岩石地形；户外楼梯（台阶高至15 cm）连续上行；在室内外挑战场景中优于无接触信息机制的基线。
AI.conclusion: 仿真接触特权信息蒸馏 + 本体感知在线推断是可行的sim-to-real路线，但缺少与前沿方法的系统对比、消融细节与定量指标。

title: Bracketing Shows the Way: Adaptive Multi-Exposure Policy as Input for Robust Visual SLAM
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, submitted to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
summary: Rapid illumination transitions can disturb Visual SLAM (VSLAM) by saturating images before the Automatic Exposure (AE) policy adapts, removing the visual correspondences needed to maintain tracking. Our proposed methods mitigate this disturbance at two levels: B-Adapt acquires adaptive exposure brackets to cover the scene dynamic range while promoting photometric overlap, and BVSLAM directly uses the multi-exposure sequence as constraints in a factor graph state estimator without relying on High Dynamic Range (HDR) merging. We evaluate both methods against state-of-the-art approaches in nominal environments and during a repeated tunnel-exit transition at an emulated vehicle speed of 32 m s-1. In the tunnel, combining our B-Adapt with BVSLAM reduces the state estimation error by 78 % compared with AE images. These results suggest that bracketing efficiently improves visual pose estimation robustness to rapid illumination disturbances while retaining low error under nominal conditions. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出自适应曝光包围(B-Adapt)与直接使用多曝光序列作因子图约束的视觉SLAM(BVSLAM)，缓解快速光照突变导致的跟踪失败，隧道出口场景下状态估计误差降低78%。
AI.motivation: 快速光照过渡（如隧道出口）会使自动曝光(AE)尚未收敛时图像饱和，丢失视觉对应，导致VSLAM跟踪失效；HDR融合方案计算开销大且引入伪影。
AI.method: B-Adapt：在线自适应选取曝光包围序列，覆盖场景动态范围并保证相邻曝光间光度重叠；BVSLAM：将多曝光图像直接作为约束注入因子图状态估计器，避免显式HDR合成。
AI.result: 在标称环境与32 m/s模拟车速下重复隧道出口过渡场景中评测，B-Adapt+BVSLAM相比AE图像将状态估计误差降低78%，标称条件下误差仍保持低位。
AI.conclusion: 曝光包围是提升视觉位姿估计对快速光照扰动鲁棒性的高效手段，且不牺牲常规场景精度；代码已开源。

title: Interpretable Collision Avoidance and Feasibility Guarantees through an Uncertainty Aware Pipeline
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) operating in dynamic, challenging conditions such as intersections and roundabouts must guarantee collision avoidance under uncertainty while maintaining real-time feasibility. Most existing planners struggle to simultaneously guarantee both requirements. Chance-constrained formulations embed safety constraints directly in the optimization but become infeasible as uncertainty compounds; deterministic planners provide feasible solutions but fail to address the uncertainty that causes collisions; end-to-end learned policies provide neither guarantee in an interpretable form. We present a modular perception-prediction-planning pipeline that closes this gap by propagating uncertainty as structured, interpretable quantities across module boundaries. Rather than embedding probabilistic risk directly in the optimization, our pipeline resolves collision probabilities upstream and constructs convex safe sets within which the planner provides a guaranteed feasible solution at every cycle -- decoupling the safety guarantee from solver feasibility. Across Monte Carlo trials in a four-way unsignalized intersection, our pipeline achieves 0% collisions and 0% solver infeasibility at 12.7ms per cycle, compared to 36% and 10% collision rates for deterministic and chance-constrained baselines respectively. The ablation study confirms the necessity of each uncertainty source and the hardware deployment on Clearpath Jackal UGVs validates the pipeline's real-time viability on physical platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化感知-预测-规划流水线，将不确定性以结构化可解释量跨模块传播，在上游消解碰撞概率并构建凸安全集，从而在保证每周期可行解的同时实现碰撞避免。
AI.motivation: 交叉路口/环岛等动态不确定场景下，现有规划器难以同时满足碰撞规避保证与实时可行性：机会约束优化在不确定度累积时易不可行；确定性规划器可行但忽略不确定性导致碰撞；端到端学习策略缺乏可解释保证。
AI.method: 模块化感知-预测-规划流水线；不确定性以结构化、可解释量在模块边界传播；不在优化中直接嵌入概率风险，而在上游解析碰撞概率，构造凸安全集，使规划器在每周期提供有保证的可行解，解耦安全保证与求解器可行性。含消融实验及Clearpath Jackal UGV硬件部署。
AI.result: 四向无信号交叉口蒙特卡洛试验：0%碰撞、0%求解不可行，单周期12.7ms；确定性基线与机会约束基线碰撞率分别为36%和10%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化不确定性传播与凸安全集构造，可在实时预算内同时获得碰撞规避与可行解保证，并在真实UGV上验证了实时性与可部署性。

title: Support-guided OOD Removal with Diffusion
summary: Many real-world signals are corrupted by localized, structured perturbations whose distribution is unknown: an intermittent background noise in a music recording, a watermark stamped on a photograph, a cast shadow. We study the task of recovering a clean signal $x$ from an observation $y$ containing such a localized out-of-distribution (OOD) corruption. We propose Support-guided OOD Removal with Diffusion, SORD, an iterative algorithm to recover $x$ using only two ingredients: a binary map of the corruption support and a single diffusion model pretrained on clean signals. SORD does not require any paired data or any statistical model of the corruption. We evaluate SORD on natural images and human faces with spatially localized corruptions including handwritten digits, other images, watermarks, and shadows, as well as audio recordings of different musical instruments with temporally localized corruptions including other instruments and human speech. SORD is competitive with, and often outperforms, posterior-sampling inpainting given the same diffusion prior and the same mask, source-separation baselines that require a separate diffusion model for each source, and, on several benchmarks, supervised networks trained on paired clean and corrupted signals. The code is released here: \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: SORD 利用“损坏支撑集二值掩码 + 单一干净信号预训练扩散模型”做迭代式局部 OOD 损坏去除，无需成对数据或损坏统计模型。
AI.motivation: 真实信号常被分布未知的局部结构化扰动污染（间歇背景噪声、水印、阴影），现有修复/源分离方法依赖成对数据、损坏统计模型或每源一个模型。
AI.method: 提出 SORD（Support-guided OOD Removal with Diffusion）：给定损坏支撑集二值图和单个在干净数据上预训练的扩散模型，迭代地结合支撑集引导的扩散采样恢复干净信号；不依赖成对监督，也不需要损坏的概率模型。
AI.result: 在自然图像与人脸（手写数字、其他图像、水印、阴影等空间局部损坏）及多种乐器音频（其他乐器、人声等时间局部损坏）上，性能与同先验同掩码的 posterior-sampling inpainting 相当或更优，并优于需逐源独立扩散模型的源分离基线，在若干基准上超过成对监督网络。
AI.conclusion: 支撑集掩码与单一干净先验扩散模型的组合即可实现通用、无监督的局部 OOD 损坏去除，跨图像与音频模态有效，代码已开源。

title: Of Chains and Gains: What Reinforcement Learning changes on Reasoning-based Image Quality Assessment
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the performance of large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches often attribute these gains to improved reasoning before scoring, supported by increasingly plausible Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, whether these gains exceed sampling effects and how they depend on explicit reasoning remain unclear. We rigorously investigate these questions through sampling-aware evaluation, controlled reasoning interventions, and shortcut experiments. We find that RL-trained models outperform base models under large-budget $\operatorname{max}_g@k$ evaluation, while improvements beyond averaging are concentrated in-distribution. RLVR produces chains that raise base-model performance when transplanted and improves scoring with the chain held fixed. Yet scoring becomes less dependent on the chain during inference, more clearly at 7B than at 32B. Steering the probed quality direction in thinking tokens also has little effect on scoring. Finally, RL can improve scoring accuracy by exploiting textual cues correlated with mean opinion scores (MOSs), which could inflate benchmark performance. Together, these findings show that RLVR raises quality scoring and produces more useful chains, but that better scoring does not imply a stronger reliance on explicit reasoning, while score-based rewards can also encourage reliance on quality-irrelevant shortcuts. We hope this preliminary study can enlighten more and more concrete reasoning schemes in IQA.

AI.tldr: RLVR 提升 VLM 图像质量评分，但增益部分来自采样与文本捷径，而非显式推理依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将 RLVR 在 IQA 上的改进归因于评分前推理增强（更合理的 CoT），但缺少证据表明增益超出采样效应，也未厘清对显式推理的依赖程度。
AI.method: 采用采样感知评估（大预算 max_g@k）、受控推理干预（思维链迁移、固定CoT评分、推理时移除CoT）、对思考token中探测到的"质量方向"做导向干预，以及考察文本线索与MOS相关性的捷径实验。
AI.result: RL模型在大预算max_g@k下优于基座模型，但超出平均的增益主要集中在分布内；RLVR产生的思维链迁移到基座模型可提升性能，固定思维链下评分也提升；然而推理阶段评分对思维链的依赖下降（7B比32B更明显），导向质量方向影响微弱；RL还可利用与MOS相关的文本线索提升评分准确率，可能虚高基准分数。
AI.conclusion: RLVR 确实提升评分准确率并产生更有用的思维链，但更好的评分不等价于更强的显式推理依赖；基于分数的奖励会诱发对质量无关捷径的依赖。该初步研究为IQA中更具体的推理方案设计提供启示。

title: Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition
comment: 10 pages for the main paper, 8 figures including supplementary material, accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query-vision interactions. We address this gap by observing that the query-vision interaction matrix, naturally induced by the query and key projections already present in transformer attention, is effectively low-rank, with a small number of dominant latent interaction modes capturing query-relevant semantics. Motivated by this observation, we propose Query-Vision Decomposition (QViD), a novel training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits this structure. Extensive experiments on both image and video understanding benchmarks show that QViD consistently improves performance under matched token budgets, with the largest gains appearing under aggressive compression regimes.

AI.tldr: QViD：无需训练、查询感知的视觉token剪枝方法，基于“查询-视觉交互矩阵本质低秩、少数主导潜在交互模式即可捕获与查询相关的语义”这一观察，直接在Transformer已有Q/K投影上诱导的交互矩阵做低秩分解来指导视觉token选择，在图文与视频理解基准上同等token预算下稳定提升性能，激进压缩下增益最大。
AI.motivation: 大型VLM因视觉token数量庞大导致推理成本高，视觉token剪枝是自然的效率方案。已有工作用查询信息引导token选择，但多依赖attention模式或token动态的启发式规则，未显式利用查询-视觉交互的内在结构。
AI.method: 作者观察到注意力中由query/key投影自然诱导的query-vision交互矩阵近似低秩，少数主导潜在交互模态即可刻画查询相关语义。据此提出QViD：训练免费的查询感知视觉token剪枝，利用该低秩结构（对交互矩阵做分解/子空间提取）来衡量并保留与查询最相关的视觉token。
AI.result: 在图像与视频理解基准上与匹配token预算的基线相比持续提升性能；在较激进的压缩率下增益最明显，说明低秩结构在token高度受限时更为关键。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模query-vision交互的低秩结构是一种有效且无需额外训练的token剪枝信号，为VLM高效推理提供了新视角；但属于通用VLM推理加速范畴，与物理AI/VLA/世界模型/具身导航无直接关联，仅作为效率工具具备间接参考价值。

title: The Locality Trade-off in Masked Patch Self-Distillation
summary: Masked patch self-distillation is a key component of modern vision foundation models, including DINOv2 and DINOv3, yet its implications for local visual information remain unclear. We show that its semantic benefits can coexist with a scale-dependent locality cost. Using two annotation-free diagnostics, we distinguish recoverable local appearance from spatial correspondence. In smaller models, adding iBOT substantially weakens patch correspondence while largely preserving appearance decodability. In larger models, correspondence improves, but pixel and texture evidence becomes less linearly accessible in deep features. Thus, scaling changes the form of the locality cost rather than uniformly eliminating it. Our analysis of Gram anchoring further shows that preserving patch relations does not guarantee simultaneous improvements in both properties. These findings motivate evaluating and designing visual representations around the complementary demands of semantic abstraction, appearance preservation, and spatial correspondence. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 分析DINOv2/v3中掩码patch自蒸馏(iBOT)与Gram锚定对局部视觉信息的影响，提出无标注诊断区分"外观可解码性"与"空间对应性"，发现语义收益伴随尺度相关的局部性代价。
AI.motivation: 掩码patch自蒸馏是当代视觉基础模型的关键组件，但其对局部视觉信息（外观保真与空间对应）的影响尚不明确，需厘清规模化能否消除该代价。
AI.method: 采用两个无需标注的诊断任务：局部外观可解码性（像素/纹理的线性可及性）与patch空间对应性；对比小/大模型在加入iBOT前后的表现，并分析Gram锚定对patch关系的保持效果。
AI.result: 小模型中加入iBOT显著削弱patch对应性而基本保持外观可解码性；大模型中对应性改善但像素与纹理证据在深层特征中线性可及性下降，即规模化改变了局部性代价的形式而非消除之；Gram锚定保持patch关系并不保证两项性质同时提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉表征的设计与评估应围绕语义抽象、外观保持与空间对应三者的互补需求展开，而非单一追求其中一项。

title: Causal-based approaches to explain and learn from self-extension - A review
summary: The last decades have seen a revolution in autonomous robotics. Deep learning approaches and their hardware implementations have made it possible to endow robots with extraordinary perceptual capabilities. In addition, they can also benefit from advances in Automated Planning, allowing them to autonomously solve complex tasks. However, on many occasions, the robot still acts without internalising and understanding the reasons behind a perception or an action, beyond an immediate response to a current state of the context. This gap results in limitations that affect its performance, reliability and trustworthiness. Deep learning alone cannot bridge this gap, because the reasons behind behaviour, when it emanates from a model in which the world is a black-box, are not accessible. What is really needed is an underlying architecture based on deeper reasoning. Among other issues, this architecture should enable the robot to generate explanations, allowing people to know why the robot is performing, or has performed, a certain action, or the reasons that may have caused a certain plan failure or perceptual anomaly. Furthermore, when these explanations arise from a cognitive process and are shared, and thus validated, with people, the robot should be able to incorporate these explanations into its knowledge base, and thus use this understanding to improve future behaviour. Our article looks at recent advances in the development of self-aware, self-evolving robots. These robots are designed to provide the necessary explanations to their human counterparts, thereby enhancing their functional capabilities, in the quest to gain their trust.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇综述/立场文章，提出自主机器人需要超越"黑箱"深度学习的深层推理架构，使机器人具备自我意识、自我演化能力，并能生成解释、与人类共享验证后纳入知识库以改进行为。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人虽具备强感知与自动规划能力，但缺乏对行为原因的internalise与理解，仅是"对当前上下文的即时响应"，导致性能、可靠性与可信度受限；深度学习无法弥合该缺口，因为黑箱模型的行为理由不可访问，因此需要基于深层推理的底层架构。
AI.method: 综述性论述：梳理近期在self-aware、self-evolving robots方向的进展，强调架构应支持生成解释（动作选择理由、计划失败原因、感知异常成因），并在解释经人类共享与验证后回灌至机器人知识库，形成理解—改进的闭环。文中未提出具体算法、实验或系统实现。
AI.result: 无实证结果；仅以文献回顾形式阐述解释生成与知识回灌对能力提升和人类信任建立的作用。
AI.conclusion: 具备可解释推理与自我演化的机器人架构是提升可靠性与人机信任的关键方向；但本文为概念性综述，无具体方法或真实机器人证据。

title: ORBIT: A Modular Multi-finger Robotic Hand Platform with Rotational Finger Reconfiguration
summary: Despite the popularity of multi-fingered robotic hands for dexterous manipulation, there is no systematic platform to compare different hand morphologies against one another. We present ORBIT (Orbital Reconfigurable Base-actuated Integrated Theta-motion Hand), a modular platform designed to enable principled exploration of multi-fingered hand morphology. The core contribution of ORBIT is a rotating knuckle mechanism, where independent fingers travel around a cylindrical palm via a belt drive. This enables ORBIT to perform quick recon- figuration (< 1 s) of finger layout without hand disassembly. ORBITs a robust system, with finger average angular velocity of 1.57 rad / s1 and a root finger force resistance of 50 N. Using a three fingers instantiation of ORBIT, we demonstrate an initial pilot grasping study, comparing anthropomorphic, isometric, and Barrett-style finger layouts across eleven objects of varied size, shape, and texture. We further demonstrate how ORBITs nonanthropomorphic orbital DOF enables the achievement of tasks that would be difficult to perform with fixed-knuckle designs, such as cube face reorientation, lid threading, and precision pinching of sub-centimeter objects. These results establish ORBIT as a viable platform for direct apples to apples comparison of multi-fingered hand morphologies for specific manipulation tasks

AI.tldr: ORBIT：带旋转指节（皮带驱动环绕圆柱手心的）可重构多指手硬件平台，可在 <1 s 内重排手指布局，用于系统化对比不同手部形态。
AI.motivation: 多指灵巧手形态多样（拟人、等比、Barrett 式等），但缺乏可在同一硬件上直接"苹果对苹果"比较手部形态的实验平台，导致形态设计与任务性能之间的关系难以系统研究。
AI.method: 提出 ORBIT 模块化平台，核心是旋转指节机构：各独立手指经同步带驱动沿圆柱手心周向移动，无需拆装即可快速重构（<1 s）；用三指实例化进行 11 种不同尺寸/形状/纹理物体的初步抓取实验，对比拟人、等距、Barrett 式三种布局，并展示轨道自由度带来的非常规操作（立方体翻面、拧盖、亚厘米级精密捏取）。
AI.result: 手指平均角速度 1.57 rad/s，指根抗外力 50 N，重构时间 <1 s；三指原型完成跨 11 物体的抓取对比实验，并成功演示立方体面重定向、螺纹拧紧与亚厘米物体精密捏取等固定指节设计难以完成的任务。
AI.conclusion: ORBIT 可作为多指手形态直接对比的可行平台，为特定操作任务下的手部形态选择与设计提供实验基础；但当前证据限于小规模初步（pilot）抓取研究，任务指标与规模有限。

title: Automated identification of ivory carvings using machine learning: A proof-of-concept approach to detecting the illegal wildlife trade
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures and 2 tables. Submitted for publication in PLOS One
summary: Despite a ban on the international trading of recently poached ivory, elephants are still killed for their tusks. Ivory and its products are mainly sold in online marketplaces. However, due to the huge volume and variety of adverts and the similarity of ivory with other materials that can be legally sold, it is hard for enforcement officials to identify illicit trading and prosecute sellers. Existing techniques for identifying elephant ivory, such as Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy and microscopy, can reliably distinguish ivory from other materials, but require physical access to the item and cannot be applied to photographs alone. As a result, these methods are unsuitable for screening the large volume of images posted in online marketplaces, leaving a gap for automated, image-based identification tools. In this proof of concept work, we investigate the potential of machine learning techniques for image analysis to automatically distinguish ivory objects from bone. We employ a semantic segmentation framework using a U-Net architecture with a ResNet34 backbone, leveraging transfer learning on an augmented dataset of 541 original images. Using a dataset of images of ivory and items resembling carved ivory, several models were trialled. On a distinct test set, the classifier achieved an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.81 and an overall classification accuracy of 81% on confident samples. The paper presents the best-performing model as a proof of concept for developing a system that can effectively identify ivory and its products when indicative features of elephant ivory are present in an image. This work provides initial steps towards a machine learning-based framework designed to advise law-enforcement in detecting illegal elephant ivory trade.

AI.tldr: 该概念验证工作用 U-Net(ResNet34 骨干，迁移学习)语义分割/分类模型，仅凭照片区分象牙与骨骼，在独立测试集上 AUC 0.81、置信样本准确率 81%。
AI.motivation: 大象象牙被非法猎取并在网络市场交易；现有 FTIR 光谱与显微镜方法虽可靠但需实物接触，无法用于海量在线图片筛查，因此缺乏自动化、基于图像的识别工具。
AI.method: 采用语义分割框架 U-Net + ResNet34 backbone，结合迁移学习；对 541 张原始图像做数据增强，构建象牙与仿象牙（主要是骨）图像数据集，比较多个模型，在独立测试集上评估。
AI.result: 最佳分类器 AUC 0.81，置信样本整体分类准确率 81%；作者呈现其为可识别图像中含象牙指示特征物品的概念验证系统。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为面向执法部门的机器学习框架提供了初步步骤，用于辅助发现非法象牙交易；但仅为小规模概念验证，尚未达到部署级可靠性。

title: Explaining Basketball Shot Classifications with Grad-CAM: An Investigation of Shortcut Reliance with Spatiotemporal Correlations
comment: 2 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Basketball action recognition is used in high-stakes scenarios to inform such tasks as specialized coaching, yet the evidence used by its deep-learning models is poorly understood. This paper investigates whether there is evidence that an R(2+1)D-18 model trained on the Basketball-51 dataset relies on spurious spatiotemporal correlations when classifying basketball shot outcomes. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) was used to generate spatiotemporal saliency maps, whose faithfulness was evaluated by progressively blurring the most salient pixels. Twenty saliency maps were then visually reviewed for recurring salient regions. Grad-CAM highlighted spatially central regions of clips including the shooter, net, and occasionally the courtside crowd. Blurring interventions were conducted to support these patterns. Blurring the central region resulted in an accuracy of 43.7%, compared to the original test accuracy of 69.3% and random-blurred accuracy of 50.9%. The additional 7.2 percentage-point reduction from central blurring compared to random blurring suggests that the model relies on task-relevant visual regions; this highlights the need for continual audits to ensure trustworthy, equitable sports analytics.

AI.tldr: 用 Grad-CAM 加模糊干预检验 Basketball-51 上 R(2+1)D-18 是否依赖虚假时空关联：显著性集中在中部（投篮者/篮网/场边观众），中心模糊使准确率从 69.3% 降至 43.7%（随机模糊为 50.9%）。
AI.motivation: 篮球动作识别模型被用于高风险场景（如专项训练指导），但其依赖的证据缺乏可解释性核查；作者希望检验模型是否倚赖虚假的时空相关特征。
AI.method: 在 Basketball-51 数据集上训练 R(2+1)D-18；用 Grad-CAM 生成时空显著性图，并通过逐步模糊最显著像素评估其忠实性；人工复核 20 张显著性图以归纳反复出现的显著区域；补充中心区域模糊与随机模糊的对照实验。
AI.result: Grad-CAM 高亮时空中心区域，包含投篮者、篮网，偶尔出现场边观众。中心模糊后准确率 43.7%，原始测试准确率 69.3%，随机模糊 50.9%；中心模糊相对随机模糊额外下降 7.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型确实依赖任务相关的视觉区域，至少部分证据合理；但显著性图中出现观众等背景区域提示仍存在虚假关联风险，体育数据分析需持续审计以保证可信与公平。

title: Image Clustering with Vision-Language Model Embeddings
summary: Pretrained vision-language models provide image representations whose suitability for clustering may vary with feature extraction, image domain, and partitioning algorithm. We compare nine representation pipelines across seven image benchmarks and four clustering configurations, yielding 252 baseline combinations. Eight pipelines extract visual features, including two vision-only references; the ninth generates descriptions and embeds the resulting text. With agglomerative clustering (Ward linkage) fixed, Qwen3-VL achieves the highest adjusted Rand index (ARI) on five datasets, including 0.925 on MNIST, while BLIP-2 leads on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ARIs of 0.925 and 0.591, respectively. A separate sensitivity analysis compares raw and L2-normalized embeddings at their original dimensionality across all 63 dataset-representation pairs. Normalization preserves the highest-ARI representation in every dataset, increases ARI in 35 pairs, decreases it in 26, and leaves two numerically unchanged. On the SVHN dataset, the highest ARI remains low, rising from 0.097 to 0.098 after normalization. The evaluated caption-mediated pipeline obtains relatively high ARI on isolated digits but does not consistently exceed direct visual features. These findings support selecting and evaluating complete representation-clustering pipelines for the intended domain, with explicit attention to extraction and normalization choices.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较9种视觉-语言表征流程、7个图像数据集与4种聚类配置共252种组合，并做L2归一化敏感性分析，结论是表征-聚类流程需按目标域整体评估。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型的特征表示是否适合聚类，会随特征提取方式、图像域和划分算法而变化，缺乏系统性的横向对比证据。
AI.method: 构建九条表征流程（八条视觉特征提取，含两条纯视觉参考模型；一条先生成描述再嵌入文本），在七个图像基准上与四种聚类配置交叉，共252个基线组合；固定Ward层次聚类，比较ARI；另做全维度原始嵌入与L2归一化嵌入的敏感性分析，覆盖63个数据集-表征对。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL在五个数据集上ARI最高（MNIST 0.925），BLIP-2在CIFAR-10/100上领先（0.925/0.591）；归一化在每个数据集都保留了最优表征，35对提升、26对下降、2对不变；SVHN最优ARI仍很低（0.097→0.098）；caption中介流程在孤立数字上较好但未稳定超过直接视觉特征。
AI.conclusion: 应按目标域选择并整体评估完整的“表征-聚类”流程，并显式考量特征提取与归一化策略；该结论属方法论经验性指导，非新模型或算法贡献。

title: Neuromorphic Decision Dynamics for Deadlock-free Safe Navigation in Congested Environments
summary: Safe navigation in congested environments requires both collision avoidance and coordinated passage. We introduce neuromorphic decision dynamics (NDD), a decentralized, event-based controller, that provides navigation in congested spaces with guarantees on safety, liveness, robustness, and scalability. NDD makes safe-and-live deconfliction a controllable, locally tunable emergent property of local agent interactions, without requiring communication, preassigned priorities, models of neighbors' objectives or future actions, or estimates of group size or global network properties. By design, NDD couples the dynamics of internal decision and attention states with changing physical states and locally observed relative motion. Each agent continuously modulates its speed along its prescribed path, responding as soon and as much as conflict resolution requires. Agents self-organize into disjoint, locally engaged groups that resolve conflicts concurrently. When any group's conflict becomes safety-critical, decision-action feedback destabilizes collective indecision, and coordinated conflict-resolution emerges that stabilizes a safe traversal order within the group. Order persists as conflicts clear, but groups may split or merge as agents autonomously adapt to new conflicts and those with resolved conflicts resume their nominal motion. We derive explicit conditions on sensing range, feedback gains, response time scales, and actuation limits that guarantee collision avoidance and traversal-order formation in finite time with no deadlock or livelock for finite, heterogeneous agent populations of arbitrary, changing size. Computational cost scales with the number of local interactions sensed by each agent. Large-scale simulations, comparisons with existing approaches, and hardware experiments demonstrate NDD in complex congested scenarios and validate its scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出神经形态决策动力学（NDD）：一种去中心化、事件驱动的局部控制器，通过将内部决策/注意状态与物理状态和局部相对运动耦合，使多智能体在拥挤环境中无须通信与预先优先级即可安全、无死锁地协调通行。
AI.motivation: 拥挤环境中的导航同时需要避碰与协调通行，而现有去中心化方法通常依赖通信、预分配优先级或邻居意图/群体规模估计，难以扩展且缺乏安全与活性保证。
AI.method: 每个智能体沿给定路径按局部冲突紧迫度连续调制速度；内部决策与注意状态动力学与可观测的相对运动耦合，形成决策—动作反馈。冲突达安全临界时反馈使集体犹豫失稳，群体内自发涌现协调的通过顺序并保持，群体可分裂/合并。作者推导了感知范围、反馈增益、响应时间尺度与执行器限制的显式条件。
AI.result: 在有限、异构且规模任意的群体中保证有限时间内的避碰与通过顺序形成，无死锁/活锁；计算代价随每智能体感知到的局部交互数线性增长。大规模仿真、与现有方法对比及硬件实验验证了复杂拥挤场景中的有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: NDD 将安全且活性的解冲突转化为可由局部交互调控的涌现属性，为无通信多机器人拥挤导航提供了有理论保证、可局部调参的去中心化方案。

title: Tiny Recursive Policy: Recursive Latent Refinement for Visuomotor Control
summary: Behaviour cloning has become a powerful approach for robotic manipulation, but many modern policies reconstruct their internal representation from a fixed observation window at each prediction and do not maintain persistent latent context throughout execution. We introduce Tiny Recursive Policy (TRP), a parameter-efficient behaviour-cloning policy that combines persistent temporal state with recursive latent refinement. At each control step, TRP repeatedly updates high- and low-level latent states using a shared computation module before decoding an action sequence, and propagates the resulting state to subsequent predictions. We evaluate TRP across LIBERO-100, MetaWorld ML45, and the LIBERO-Mem benchmarks. TRP performs competitively across multi-task and few-shot settings and shows substantial gains on long-horizon and context-dependent tasks, while using significantly fewer parameters than large generative baselines. Execution-time perturbations show that reliance on the persistent carry increases with temporal-context demand, while training with carry perturbations substantially improves robustness to both carry and visual corruptions. Ablations reveal a strong interaction between persistent state and recursive refinement: the benefit of carry depends strongly on the amount of within-step computation, and the resulting performance cannot be explained by parameter count alone.

AI.tldr: TRP是一种参数高效的行为克隆策略，将持久时序隐状态与递归隐空间精炼相结合：每步用共享模块反复更新高低层隐状态后再解码动作序列，并把状态传递给后续预测。
AI.motivation: 现有行为克隆策略在每次预测时仅从固定观测窗口重建内部表示，缺乏贯穿执行过程的持久隐上下文，难以应对长时程和上下文相关任务。
AI.method: 提出Tiny Recursive Policy：在每步控制中，共享计算模块迭代精炼高层与低层隐状态，随后解码动作序列，并将结果状态"携带"到下一步；同时研究带carry扰动的训练以提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-100、MetaWorld ML45和LIBERO-Mem上多任务与少样本表现有竞争力，长时程及上下文依赖任务收益显著，参数量远少于大型生成式基线；执行期扰动实验显示对持久状态的依赖随上下文需求上升；消融显示持久状态与递归精炼存在强交互。
AI.conclusion: 持久时序状态与步内递归计算互补，且增益不能仅由参数规模解释，为轻量机器人操作策略设计提供了方向。

title: KINESYS: Test-Time Adaptation for Reference-Based Effect Editing in Images
summary: Visual effects are often easier to demonstrate via reference than to describe in words. We study effect-reference editing, where a reference image shows a desired visual effect and language identifies which properties should guide the edit. Existing single-pass editing techniques often fail to make fine-grained edits, resulting in unintended changes to source content or deviations from the reference effect. We introduce KINESYS, a test-time adaptation framework for effect-reference editing that combines reference-aware and source-aware feedback to transfer the desired effect while preserving the composition and content of the original shot. To ensure KINESYS can produce a diverse set of edits that preserve the source, we develop a robust optimization strategy in which the generative model is fine-tuned across multiple noise samples and optimization runs. Evaluation with VLM judges, source preservation metrics (LPIPS, TPIPS), and a user study shows that KINESYS outperforms state-of-the-art image editors in source preservation; on effect transfer, it remains competitive with Nano Banana 2 and outperforms open-weight editors.

AI.tldr: KINESYS：面向"效果参考编辑"的测试时自适应框架，结合参考感知与源感知反馈微调生成模型，在保持源图像构图与内容的同时迁移参考视觉特效。
AI.motivation: 视觉特效难以用语言精确描述，用参考图更直观；但现有单次前向编辑方法难以做到细粒度编辑，常导致源内容被意外改动或偏离参考效果。
AI.method: 提出测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）框架：以参考感知与源感知的反馈信号驱动生成模型优化；并设计鲁棒优化策略——在多个噪声样本与多次优化运行上联合微调，以提升编辑多样性并保持源保真。
AI.result: 在VLM评判、源保真指标（LPIPS、TPIPS）及用户研究中，源保真优于SOTA图像编辑器；效果迁移上与Nano Banana 2相当，并优于开源权重编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 以测试时自适应的多轮反馈优化替代单次编辑，可有效解耦"效果迁移"与"内容保持"，是效果参考式图像编辑的一条可行路径。

title: Active Reachability Learning for Humanoid Recoverability Monitoring
summary: Deploying humanoid task policies requires reliable runtime monitors that anticipate unrecoverable falls in time to trigger a fallback. We formulate this task as learning the stochastic, finite-horizon recoverability envelope of a given fallback policy. Synthesizing this monitor is challenging: existing methods assume training data naturally covers the recoverability envelope, yet acquiring such data remains a major bottleneck for contact-rich systems. Consequently, they recover only a fraction of the true envelope, leaving them prone to optimistic hallucinations for out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We resolve this via a unified framework that iterates between value learning and active exploration. Data exploration is reframed as a reach-avoid problem, where an uncertainty-guided explorer systematically uncovers unseen states while avoiding confidently unrecoverable regions. This loop is further supported by a combined Temporal Difference and Monte Carlo objective for accurate in-distribution value prediction and reliable uncertainty estimation. By explicitly treating the remaining high-uncertainty regions as unrecoverable, the monitor mitigates optimistic OOD hallucinations. Evaluated on stochastic benchmarks and a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid, our approach drastically improves monitor coverage and accuracy and successfully transfers zero-shot to real-world hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架迭代"价值学习+主动探索"，将数据探索建模为reach-avoid问题，结合TD与MC目标估计不确定性与分布内价值，学习随机有限时域可恢复性包络（recoverability envelope），显式将高不确定区域视为不可恢复以抑制OOD乐观幻觉；在随机基准与29-DoF Unitree G1上显著提升监测覆盖与精度，并零样本迁移到真实硬件。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人部署需要运行时监测器，提前预判不可恢复跌倒以触发后备策略。现有方法假设训练数据自然覆盖可恢复性包络（recoverability envelope），而接触丰富系统获取此类数据是主要瓶颈，导致只能恢复部分包络并对OOD输入产生乐观幻觉（误判为可恢复）。
AI.method: 1) 将问题形式化为学习给定fallback策略的随机、有限时域可恢复性包络；2) 统一框架交替进行价值学习与主动探索；3) 数据探索重构为reach-avoid问题，不确定性引导的探索器系统挖掘未见状态，同时回避高置信不可恢复区域；4) 价值学习采用TD + Monte Carlo 组合目标，兼顾分布内价值预测精度与不确定度估计；5) 推理时将剩余高不确定区域判为不可恢复，抑制OOD乐观幻觉。
AI.result: 在随机基准测试与29-DoF Unitree G1人形机器人上评测：监测器覆盖率与准确率大幅提升，并成功零样本迁移至真实硬件部署。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索+不确定性感知价值学习可有效合成安全关键的运行时监测器，解决数据覆盖瓶颈与OOD幻觉问题；具备真实人形硬件零样本迁移能力，适合作为人形部署的安全层组件。

title: TinyFlow: Breaking the Warping Bottleneck for Edge Optical Flow
summary: High-performance optical flow networks are difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge accelerators because their iterative refinement warps features by the current flow, which relies on flow-dependent resampling and data-dependent memory access. We present TinyFlow, a 1.26M-parameter warp-free optical flow network that preserves iterative coarse-to-fine refinement by replacing the warp with a fixed-window correlation over constant offsets, so the whole network compiles as a single static INT8 graph. Quantization-aware fine-tuning, warp-teacher distillation, and model souping reduce the Float32-to-INT8 penalty to below 0.2 end-point error (EPE) on MPI-Sintel. TinyFlow outperforms EdgeFlowNet and NanoFlowNet on Sintel Clean, Sintel Final, and FlyingChairs in both Float32 and INT8, while using 54% fewer parameters than EdgeFlowNet, and our INT8 model achieves 6.29/7.13 EPE on Sintel Clean/Final. In flow-only monocular visual odometry on TartanAir and UZH-FPV, the same INT8 model yields the lowest trajectory error on seven of eleven sequences.

AI.tldr: TinyFlow：1.26M 参数、无 warp 的迭代式光流网络，整网编译为单一静态 INT8 图，可在边缘加速器部署。
AI.motivation: 高性能光流网络的迭代细化依赖按当前光流做特征 warp，导致依赖光流的重采样与数据相关访存，难以在资源受限的边缘加速器上部署。
AI.method: 用恒定偏移上的固定窗口相关（fixed-window correlation over constant offsets）替换 warp 操作，保留由粗到细的迭代细化结构；配合量化感知微调、warp-teacher 蒸馏与 model soup，降低 Float32→INT8 精度损失。
AI.result: MPI-Sintel 上量化损失小于 0.2 EPE；Sintel Clean/Final 与 FlyingChairs 上 Float32 与 INT8 均优于 EdgeFlowNet 与 NanoFlowNet，参数比 EdgeFlowNet 少 54%；INT8 为 Sintel Clean 6.29 / Final 7.13 EPE；在 TartanAir、UZH-FPV 纯光流单目视觉里程计中，11 条序列里 7 条轨迹误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 通过去除 warp 使光流网络可静态量化并落地边缘设备，在保持精度的同时显著压缩参数量，并可驱动下游视觉里程计。

title: Compression of Vision Foundation Models for Retinal OCT via Growing-Neural-Gas Codebooks and Graph-Guided Masked Image Modeling
comment: 31 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables; supplementary material provided as an ancillary file
summary: Vision foundation models for retinal imaging are large and computationally demanding, limiting point-of-care deployment. We ask how much of such a model's downstream utility survives compression into a smaller network. We propose a topology-aware discretization framework that distills a continuous foundation model into a discrete codebook, then uses it as the reconstruction target for masked image modeling (MIM). It combines gradient-free codebook learning via Growing Neural Gas, which yields an adjacency graph over the codes, with a graph-distance soft cross-entropy loss that replaces one-hot MIM targets with topologically graded supervision. With student pretraining on 383 public Duke iAMD optical coherence tomography (OCT) volumes, the pipeline distills an 86M-parameter teacher into a 22M-parameter student with at least 3.6x fewer FLOPs. The student performs close to, and in some settings above, its teacher across three classification and two segmentation benchmarks, with the magnitude and direction of the difference depending on the teacher, task, metric, and student capacity. On the external OLIVES benchmark, it surpasses its MIRAGE teacher on every metric (98.06% vs. 95.22% balanced accuracy). It works with two Vision Transformer (ViT-Base) teachers, retinal (MIRAGE) and natural-image (DINOv3); with the out-of-domain teacher, the student outperforms it on retinal-layer segmentation, indicating that the added value of retina-specific pretraining is task-dependent: largest for segmentation, while a general-domain teacher is competitive for classification. These results yield compact retinal models potentially suitable for deployment, transferring across OCT datasets, devices, and clinical tasks, including three datasets not used in the student's pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出拓扑感知离散化框架：用Growing Neural Gas学习离散码本并构建码间邻接图，将连续视网膜基础模型蒸馏为离散码本作为MIM重建目标，配合图距离软交叉熵损失，使86M教师压缩为22M学生（FLOPs减少≥3.6倍），在多任务基准上接近或超过教师。
AI.motivation: 视网膜影像视觉基础模型参数量大、算力需求高，难以在床旁/边缘设备部署；需研究基础模型压缩为小网络后能保留多少下游效用，并希望压缩过程本身不损失（甚至提升）表征质量。
AI.method: 两阶段拓扑感知离散化：(1) 无梯度码本学习，用Growing Neural Gas把教师连续特征离散化为码本，并得到码字上的邻接图；(2) 以该离散码本作为掩码图像建模(MIM)的重建目标，用基于图距离的软交叉熵替代one-hot目标，实现拓扑梯度化监督；学生在383例Duke iAMD OCT体数据上预训练。
AI.result: 22M学生对比86M教师，FLOPs至少少3.6倍；在3个分类与2个分割基准上接近教师、部分设定下超过教师；外部OLIVES基准上所有指标超过MIRAGE教师（平衡准确率98.06% vs 95.22%）；对MIRAGE(视网膜)与DINOv3(自然图像)两类ViT-Base教师均有效，域外教师学生在视网膜层分割上反而胜出，说明视网膜专用预训练的增益是任务相关的（分割最大，分类上通用域教师具竞争力）；跨OCT数据集、设备与临床任务迁移，含3个未参与预训练的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑感知离散蒸馏能在显著降低算力下保留乃至部分超越视网膜基础模型的下游效用，产出可部署的紧凑视网膜模型；结果提示"领域专用预训练"的价值随任务而异，通用域教师对分类任务已具竞争力。

title: Contract-Based Agentic Systems Engineering: Delegation as Quotient for Assured System Design
summary: A component an agent builds from a prompt can satisfy it and still break the system it joins, because the prompt omits what its neighbours assume of it. The artifact to hand over is computed, not written. A SysML v2 requirement with assumed and required constraints is an assume/guarantee contract, so when a system requirement is decomposed over fixed neighbours, the open component's requirement is the contract quotient, the weakest sound one, and again a SysML v2 requirement. Its required constraints carry the neighbours' assumptions, which a requirement for the mission alone drops and unit tests with mocked neighbours cannot reach. Signal Temporal Logic is closed under the quotient. We build the requirements, with derivation, allocation, satisfaction and verification, as a SysML~v2 model and compute the quotient from it. A case study delegates the local controller of a simulated warehouse robot, whose route crosses a worker's path and ends at a dock, to one language model under the quotient requirement, a mission-only requirement and a natural-language task, and scores the deliveries on live episodes against the system requirement from ground truth.

AI.tldr: 用SysML v2的assume/guarantee契约对系统需求做分解，把开放构件需求定义为"契约商"（最弱可靠需求），用STL承载约束，构建SysML v2需求模型并自动计算商；在仓储机器人案例中用LLM按商需求、任务需求和自然语言三种方式各实现一次局部控制器，并在真值系统需求下评测。
AI.motivation: 基于提示词构建的构件即使满足提示，仍可能破坏其所属系统，因为提示省略了邻居构件对它的假设。作者希望以形式化方式自动推导出可交接的构件需求，使其在固定邻居环境下既可靠又不含多余限制。
AI.method: 将带assumed/required约束的SysML v2需求视作assume/guarantee契约；系统需求在固定邻域上分解时，开放构件的需求即契约商（weakest sound requirement），且其required约束携带邻居假设。证明STL在商运算下封闭。以SysML v2模型形式构建需求并实现推导、分配、满足与验证，自动从模型计算商。案例：将模拟仓储机器人的局部控制器（路径横穿工人并抵达码头）在三种提示下交由同一语言模型实现，并以真值系统需求对实际运行回合打分。
AI.result: 给出了契约商的形式定义与STL封闭性结论，并产出可计算的SysML v2需求模型工具链。案例显示，仅按任务提示或自然语言提示的控制器无法触及邻居假设，而基于商的提示所交付控制器按系统需求评分表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 构件的可交接需求应被计算而非手写：契约商为LLM等生成主体提供了系统级正确性的最佳规格，弥补了单任务提示与mock单元测试的覆盖盲区。该方法为形式化需求工程与生成式智能体之间建立了可验证的接口。

title: Real Time Motion Detection in Video Inspired by Photonic Time Stretch
summary: Motion perception is fundamental to computer vision and physical AI, and plays a central role in robotics, autonomous vehicles, human-computer interaction, and video compression. Traditional approaches such as background subtraction, frame-differencing and optical flow algorithms often struggle in complex or dynamic scenes, typically sacrificing spatial resolution for computational tractability. Here we introduce MoViD (Motion estimation via Virtual dispersion and phase Detection), a physics-inspired algorithm grounded in the principles that govern photonic time stretch - a highly successful ultrafast realtime data acquisition platform. Drawing inspiration from the optical physics therein, MoViD treats video as a collection of optical time series waveforms associated with pixels. Motion of an object through a pixel broadens the time series spectrum and, after group delay dispersion, induces a temporal phase that exists only if there is motion. Spatiotemporal group delay dispersion templates, corresponding to dielectric functions, classify specific motion trajectories. Unlike conventional empirical phase-based motion-analysis pipelines that require narrow-band spatial channelization and pyramid reconstruction, the physics-based MoViD operates directly on the broadband video signal, vastly increasing its computational speed. The resulting algorithm achieves unprecedented performance in both motion characterization and motion magnification, providing full-resolution motion mapping in real time at nearly 200 frames per second at 4K resolution and 70 frames per second for 8K video - orders of magnitude faster than classical optical flow approaches or learning-based methods. Notably, such extreme performance enables real time motion analysis at ultrahigh resolution for motion detection and compensation in robotics and other autonomous devices.

AI.tldr: MoViD is a physics-inspired motion estimation algorithm that models video pixels as optical time series, using photonic time-stretch principles (spectral broadening + group delay dispersion) to detect and characterize motion directly on broadband video, achieving real-time full-resolution motion mapping and magnification.
AI.motivation: Traditional motion estimation (background subtraction, frame differencing, optical flow) degrades in complex/dynamic scenes and typically trades spatial resolution for speed. Existing phase-based motion analysis relies on empirical, narrow-band spatial channelization and pyramid reconstruction, which is computationally heavy.
AI.method: Treat video as per-pixel optical time series waveforms. Object motion through a pixel broadens the time series spectrum; after group delay dispersion it induces a temporal phase that exists only under motion. Spatiotemporal group delay dispersion templates (analogous to dielectric functions) classify specific motion trajectories. Operates directly on the broadband video signal without spatial narrow-band channelization or pyramid reconstruction.
AI.result: Full-resolution motion mapping and magnification in real time: ~200 fps at 4K and ~70 fps at 8K, orders of magnitude faster than optical flow or learning-based methods, with strong motion characterization and magnification performance.
AI.conclusion: Physics-grounded motion estimation enables extreme-speed, full-resolution real-time motion analysis, with implications for robotics, autonomous vehicles, HCI, and video compression.

title: Detecting Temporal Concepts in Video Transformers via a No-False-Positives Test
summary: Video models have the architecture to support encoding temporal aspects of the input, i.e. concepts that require more than one frame to define, like object movement. However, because motion and appearance change are entangled, a feature that appears to encode temporal concepts like object movement may instead encode non-temporal concepts like spatial presence at different positions whose activations merely correlate with motion. To resolve this, we introduce the No-False-Positives (NFP) test, a statistical test with a formal guarantee of statistical specificity for identifying features encoding temporal concepts. Using specially designed stimuli, we apply this test to representations produced by VideoMAE, V-JEPA2, and TimeSformer, and observe that temporal features exist in each model. We validate the test first by showing it yields no temporal features for the DINOv2 image-encoder. Then, using a synthetic representation space, we show that detection rate increases with a direction's projection onto the temporal subspace, and that Sparse Autoencoder features test-flagged as temporal project much more of their norm onto the temporal subspace than unflagged features. Interventions on temporal SAE features yield mixed results across models, suggesting that intervening on temporal features may not outperform a non-temporal feature baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 No-False-Positives (NFP) 统计检验，为"特征是否真正编码时间概念"提供统计特异性保证，用于区分时间特征与仅与运动相关的空间特征；在 VideoMAE、V-JEPA2、TimeSformer 中发现时间特征，DINOv2 图像编码器则无；合成空间验证检测率随投影到时间子空间比例上升，但干预时间 SAE 特征效果参差。
AI.motivation: 视频模型具备编码时间信息（如物体运动）的架构能力，但运动与外观变化纠缠，看似编码时间概念的特征可能只是编码不同位置的空间存在并与运动伪相关，缺乏可验证的判别方法。
AI.method: 设计专门刺激（stimuli），构建 NFP 统计检验，对特征的激活提供统计特异性保证；应用于 VideoMAE、V-JEPA2、TimeSformer 的表征；以 DINOv2 图像编码器作阴性对照，用合成表征空间检验检测率与方向在时间子空间上投影的关系，并对比 SAE 特征的时间子空间投影范数，最后对时间 SAE 特征做干预实验。
AI.result: 三个视频模型均存在时间特征；DINOv2 未检出（验证有效性）；合成空间中检测率随投影到时间子空间的比例单调上升；被判为时间的 SAE 特征其范数投影到时间子空间的比例显著高于未标记特征；但干预效果跨模型不一，未稳定优于非时间特征基线。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种可信的时间特征识别工具，但"时间特征可被干预并因果影响模型行为"尚未得到证据支持，需进一步验证其可操控性。

title: Tight Learned Event-Inertial Odometry (TLEIO): a Transformer-Based Architecture for End-to-End Motion from Event Streams
summary: Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and sparse asynchronous measurements, making them compelling for odometry under fast motion and challenging illumination. Yet, accurate event-based state estimation remains difficult: existing systems often use events as a complement to frames or rely on feature tracking, correspondence search, and optimization-heavy backends, limiting the efficiency promised by event sensing. We introduce Tight Learned Event-Inertial Odometry (TLEIO), a compact filter-based pipeline that learns short-window relative motion directly from voxelized event streams and tightly fuses the resulting constraints with IMU propagation. Its learned front-end, EventsFormer, predicts local displacements and per-axis uncertainty from event voxels in a single forward pass, while a stochastic-cloning EKF fuses these overlapping predictions with IMU propagation, producing metric trajectories without explicit feature tracks and pose optimization at inference time. The network is trained directly from pose displacements, without requiring event-flow labels. We evaluate TLEIO on the TartanAir/TartanEvent benchmark and on real DAVIS240c sequences. On TartanAir, TLEIO reduces average ATE from 2.26 m to 1.10 m over the IMU-only TLIO baseline, while achieving up to 48.9% lower runtime than optimization-based event odometry methods.

AI.tldr: TLEIO 提出一种紧凑的滤波器式事件-惯性里程计：用 EventsFormer 从体素化事件流单次前向预测短窗口相对运动及逐轴不确定性，再以随机克隆 EKF 与 IMU 紧耦合，无需特征跟踪与位姿优化即可输出米制轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有事件相机里程计多以事件作为帧图像的补充，或依赖特征跟踪、对应搜索与重优化后端，未兑现事件感知在效率上的潜力；同时缺少端到端、无需事件光流标签的紧耦合方案。
AI.method: 前端 EventsFormer 对体素化事件体一次前向回归局部位移与各轴不确定性，直接以位姿位移监督训练（不需事件光流标签）；后端采用随机克隆 EKF，将重叠短窗口的相对运动约束与 IMU 预积分紧耦合，推理阶段无显式特征轨迹与位姿优化。
AI.result: 在 TartanAir/TartanEvent 上，平均 ATE 由 IMU-only TLIO 基线的 2.26 m 降至 1.10 m；相较基于优化的事件里程计方法运行时间最多降低 48.9%。并在真实 DAVIS240c 序列上完成验证。
AI.conclusion: 学习式短窗口运动前端与克隆滤波后端的组合可在不带特征跟踪、不做推理期优化的前提下显著提升事件-惯性里程计精度并降低计算开销，为高效事件状态估计提供了可行范式。

title: AdShot: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Advertisement Clipping
summary: Advertisers routinely create multiple duration variants of ads to meet marketing budgets and viewer preferences, a labor-intensive and costly process. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at general video understanding, their ability to perform specialized editorial tasks remains unexplored. We introduce AdShot, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on shot selection for ad clipping. It contains 823 professionally edited ad pairs (30-sec sources and 15-sec edits) across 194 brands and 17 industries, annotated with shot-level boundaries and content features (action, emotion, information, imagery). We evaluate 13 state-of-the-art video-only MLLMs and 2 audio-visual MLLMs (7B-72B parameters) on shot selection accuracy (Precision, Recall, F1), duration constraints (15s), and content preservation, including an audio ablation. We find: (1) model architecture matters more than scale, with smaller models often matching or exceeding larger ones; performance is strongest for target ads with 6-10 shots; (2) models exhibit a mean absolute duration error of 5.39s, with most tending to overshoot the 15s target, though they can still substantially reduce human editing effort; (3) all models exhibit systematic content biases, favoring information-rich and emotion-focused shots while under-selecting action and imagery. We publicly release our benchmark to facilitate research at the intersection of multimodal AI and computational advertising.

AI.tldr: AdShot 基准：用 823 对专业广告（30s 源片与 15s 剪辑）评测 15 个多模态大模型（MLLM）在广告剪辑镜头选择上的能力，发现架构比参数量更重要、模型普遍超时长（平均绝对误差 5.39s）、并存在偏好信息型/情绪型镜头而轻视动作与意象镜头的系统性内容偏差。
AI.motivation: 广告主需为同一素材制作多种时长版本，人工剪辑成本高；现有 MLLM 虽擅长通用视频理解，但其在专业编辑类任务上的能力尚未被系统评估，缺乏对应基准。
AI.method: 构建 AdShot 基准：194 个品牌、17 个行业、823 对专业剪辑广告（30 秒源片对应 15 秒成片），标注镜头级边界与内容特征（动作、情绪、信息、意象）；在镜头选择准确率（Precision/Recall/F1）、时长约束（15s）和内容保真度上评测 13 个纯视频 MLLM 与 2 个音视频 MLLM（7B–72B），并做音频消融。
AI.result: (1) 架构影响大于规模，小模型常与更大模型持平甚至更优；目标广告含 6–10 个镜头时表现最佳；(2) 平均绝对时长误差 5.39s，多数模型倾向超出 15s，但仍能显著降低人工剪辑工作量；(3) 所有模型呈现系统性内容偏差，偏好信息密集与情绪聚焦镜头，少选动作与意象镜头。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 在广告镜头选择上已具备可用的辅助编辑潜力，但时长控制与内容均衡性仍是明显短板；作者开源基准以推动多模态 AI 与计算广告交叉研究。

title: Fast Instinct, Slow Reason: A Dual-Speed Agentic Framework for Self-Configuring Multi-Object Tracking in Satellite Video
summary: Multi-object tracking in satellite video underpins persistent monitoring, yet offline-tuned trackers lack the onboard intelligence and efficiency to adapt within an observation of tens of seconds. The root is that adaptation still means relabelling and retraining the detector, which cannot run on board in time. Tuning the tracker configuration strongly controls accuracy without touching the network, yet search needs labelled or proxy evaluations, and a language agent costs seconds and tokens per decision. We propose a dual-speed agentic framework pairing a fast instinct compiled offline with a slow reason serving the mission. Its algorithm, Arbitration of Unlabelled Shortlists from Prior Experience, or AUSPEX, learns a covering shortlist and a label-free ranker from labelled source tasks and commits one configuration per sequence. Its system, a Cascaded Onboard Runtime with Verified Uplinked Skills, or CORVUS, cascades reflex, skill, and agent layers, so that a verified skill commits 2.5 s into each observation while a language agent serves natural- language missions. On SatMTB and SatVideoDT with three recent detectors, AUSPEX raises IDF1 by 2.84 to 2.94 points and MOTA by 3.21 to 3.29 points on average without target labels, balances accuracy and labels best among sixteen methods, and loses at most 0.28 IDF1 points at 1.25 tracking passes. CORVUS executes four missions with execution accuracy up to 0.99 and target recall at the perception ceiling, spends no token on the routine decision, runs on Jetson Xavier NX, and hosts fifteen language models from six families without altering any commitment, demonstrating its extensibility and generalization.

AI.tldr: 卫星视频多目标跟踪的星上在线自适应：提出双速智能体框架，离线编译"快直觉"（AUSPEX：学习覆盖式配置短名单+无标签排序器，逐序列提交一套跟踪器配置）与在线"慢推理"（CORVUS：反射/技能/智能体三级级联，经验证技能在观测2.5 s内完成提交，语言智能体仅服务自然语言任务）。
AI.motivation: 星上持续监测需要算法在数十秒观测内自适应，但离线调优的跟踪器缺乏这种能力与算力；重标注重训检测器无法在轨及时运行，而逐决策调用语言智能体（数秒、消耗token）代价过高。因此转而只调跟踪器配置以避开启网络，并把搜索代价前移到离线。
AI.method: AUSPEX（算法层）：从有标注源任务学习"覆盖式短名单"+无标签排序器，实现无目标标签的配置选择，每条序列只承诺一个配置。CORVUS（系统层）：三级级联运行时——反射层、经上行链路验证的技能层、语言智能体层；技能在观测开始2.5 s后即提交配置，语言智能体仅响应自然语言任务指令；支持Jetson Xavier NX部署与多语言模型后端热插拔。
AI.result: 在SatMTB、SatVideoDT与三个近期检测器上，无目标标签条件下平均IDF1 +2.84~2.94、MOTA +3.21~3.29；16种方法中精度-标注成本平衡最优；1.25次跟踪遍历下IDF1损失≤0.28。CORVUS完成四项任务，执行精度最高0.99，目标召回达感知上限，常规决策零token开销，可在Jetson Xavier NX运行，并托管来自6个家族的15个语言模型而不改变既有承诺。
AI.conclusion: 把跟踪器配置搜索离线编译为可低成本部署的"直觉"，可替代在线重训实现星上快速自适应；级联运行时兼顾实时性、零token常规开销与自然语言任务扩展性。局限在于任务域限于卫星视频跟踪配置调优，增益幅度中等，未涉及检测器层面的表征自适应。

title: Rethinking Microscopy Generation: Co-Designed Diffusion for Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Synthesis
summary: Generative models for microscopy can already produce realistic whole-image fields of view, but offer no principled way to control how each individual cell looks. We address this gap by recasting microscopy generation at the single-cell level and designing the input controls and the model's internal representation jointly, so that both are organized along the same biologically meaningful directions. On the input side, we aggregate a long list of standard cell measurements into a small set of semantic axes (size, elongation, brightness, texture, etc.) that are each named, measurable, and traversable. On the model side, we introduce BioVAE, an encoder-decoder whose latent space is explicitly aligned with the same set of measurements. A key finding is that the benefit of biologically structuring the latent emerges only when conditioning is also moved to the semantic axes, showing that the two ends must be designed jointly. Experiments on LIVECell show that semantic-axis conditioning substantially improves generative fidelity over high-dimensional conditioning, a blind study with biologists confirms the realism of generated cells, and per-axis traversals produce stable and interpretable phenotypic changes.

AI.tldr: BioVAE：将细胞生成建模重构到单细胞层级，输入端的语义轴（尺寸、伸长率、亮度、纹理）与隐空间表示联合对齐，实现可控、可解释的细胞图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有显微图像生成模型能生成真实的整幅视野，但无法有原则地控制单个细胞的形态与表型，缺乏单细胞级别的可控性与可解释性。
AI.method: 将大量标准细胞测量指标聚合为少量命名、可测量、可遍历的语义轴用于条件输入；同时设计BioVAE编码器-解码器，使隐空间显式对齐同一组测量。强调条件与隐表示必须联合设计。
AI.result: 在LIVECell上，语义轴条件相比高维条件显著提升生成保真度；生物学家盲评确认生成细胞真实性；逐轴遍历产生稳定且可解释的表型变化。
AI.conclusion: 生物结构化隐空间只有在条件也迁移到语义轴时才获益，验证了两端联合设计的必要性；单细胞级语义可控生成是可行方向。

title: Bidirectional Cross-frequency Domain Interaction Network for UHD Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods typically rely on either spatial- or frequency-domain modeling, or independently process different frequency components for efficient restoration. However, they often fail to jointly exploit complementary spatial--frequency information and the inherent relationship between illumination and structural information across frequencies, leading to inconsistent illumination, residual noise, and detail artifacts. In this paper, we propose a novel Bidirectional Cross-frequency Domain Interaction Network (BiFreqNet) for UHD LLIE. Specifically, BiFreqNet incorporates a Dual-domain Feature Interaction (DFI) module into the multi-scale representations of a pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) to perform reciprocal enhancement between low- and high-frequency features. DFI consists of a Spatial and Spectral-Aware Low-Frequency Enhancement (S$^2$LFE) block and a Cross-Frequency Enhancement (CFE) block. S$^2$LFE exploits high-frequency structural cues to guide low-frequency restoration and jointly models spatial and spectral information to recover global exposure and spatially varying illumination while suppressing sensor noise. CFE further leverages the enhanced low-frequency contextual information to guide adaptive high-frequency refinement, enabling faithful reconstruction of structures and fine details. Extensive experiments on four general and UHD LLIE benchmarks demonstrate that BiFreqNet achieves competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: BiFreqNet：在预训练VAE的多尺度表征中嵌入双域特征交互(DFI)模块，用高频结构线索引导低频照度恢复、再用增强后的低频上下文引导高频细节重建，实现UHD低光照图像增强的双向跨频域交互。
AI.motivation: 现有UHD低光照增强方法多局限于空域或频域单一建模，或独立处理各频段以追求效率，未能联合利用空域-频域互补信息以及光照与结构信息跨频段的内在关联，导致照度不一致、残余噪声与细节伪影。
AI.method: 提出BiFreqNet。将Dual-domain Feature Interaction (DFI)模块嵌入预训练VAE的多尺度表征中，实现低频与高频特征的双向互增强。DFI包含两部分：(1) S²LFE（空间与频谱感知的低频增强）以高频结构线索引导低频恢复，联合建模空间与频谱信息以恢复全局曝光与空间变化光照并抑制传感噪声；(2) CFE（跨频增强）利用增强后的低频上下文自适应精修高频，忠实重建结构与细节。
AI.result: 在4个通用与UHD低光照增强基准上，性能与SOTA方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 双向跨频域交互+VAE多尺度先验是UHD LLIE的有效范式，可为高分辨率视觉增强与下游感知前处理提供参考；摘要未给出量化指标与代码/复现信息。

title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
summary: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual. We introduce AV-FABLE, a dual-timeline benchmark for sparse manipulations in open-scene long-form audio-visual videos. AV-FABLE contains 16,650 pristine--manipulated twin pairs (998 hours) created with 27 editing configurations, with separate audio and visual timelines that enable modality-specific temporal localization and expose errors hidden by joint-timeline evaluation. On AV-FABLE, zero-shot prompting of audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) yields near-chance detection and poor temporal localization. In contrast, supervised readouts of their frozen perception features recover strong forensic signals, suggesting manipulation evidence is encoded in these representations but not effectively exposed through language outputs. Motivated by this observation, we propose NFSR(Native Forensics via Separated Readouts), which reads frozen AV-LLM features with separate audio and visual temporal decoders. NFSR achieves the best audio-visual localization performance in-domain and across all three out-of-distribution settings, including transfer to held-out videos from an external long-video forensic benchmark. AV-FABLE, code, and model weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: AV-FABLE 双时间线基准（16,650 对、998 小时、27 种编辑配置）用于开放场景长视频稀疏音视频篡改的细粒度定位；提出 NFSR，用分离的音/视时序解码器读取冻结 AV-LLM 特征，在域内与三种 OOD 设定下均取得最佳定位性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频中的局部 AI 篡改只影响短暂事件，视频级二分类不足以支撑取证；现有音视频深伪基准多为短视频说话头，长视频时序取证又偏重视觉单模态。
AI.method: 构建带独立音频/视觉时间线的 pristine–manipulated 成对基准，支持模态专属时序定位并暴露联合时间线评测掩盖的错误；先验证 AV-LLM 零样本提示近乎随机，而冻结特征的有监督读出可恢复强取证信号；据此提出 NFSR，将冻结 AV-LLM 感知特征交由分离的音频与视觉时序解码器读出。
AI.result: AV-LLM 零样本检测接近随机且时序定位差；NFSR 在域内及三种分布外设置（含向外部长视频取证基准的迁移）均为最佳音视频定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 操纵证据已编码于冻结 AV-LLM 表征中，但未通过语言输出暴露；分离读出的原生取证范式更有效。基准、代码与权重将开源，但属数据集/取证方向，与机器人、VLA、3D 重建等核心关注区无交集。

title: How Robust Are CNNs and Vision Transformers for Alzheimer's MRI Classification Across Datasets?
comment: 12 pages, 9 tables, 3 figures. Submitted to Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary: Accurate assessment of Alzheimer's disease stages from MRI is important for understanding disease progression and supporting the development of computer-aided analysis tools. Deep learning models have shown promising results for Alzheimer's disease classification from MRI. However, when evaluated on single datasets, it is difficult to determine whether the observed performance reflects consistent architectural behavior or dataset-specific effects. In this work, we present a multi-dataset benchmarking framework with standardized preprocessing and evaluation. We compare five architectures: ResNet-50, ReXNet-150, Swin Transformer, ViT-Base, and ViT-Large. The models are evaluated across three MRI datasets representing severe class imbalance, train-test distribution mismatch, and large-scale augmentation. The results show broadly consistent performance patterns across datasets, with ViT-Large achieving the best performance on all three datasets and reaching up to 99.84% accuracy and 99.86% macro F1. Performance differences between architectures are most pronounced under distribution mismatch and considerably smaller in the augmented-data setting. Across datasets, lower class-level performance is observed primarily among adjacent early-stage categories, particularly Very Mild and Mild impairment. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating deep learning architectures across multiple data conditions rather than relying on single-dataset performance.

AI.tldr: 提出多数据集标准化基准框架，比较ResNet-50、ReXNet-150、Swin、ViT-Base、ViT-Large在三个阿尔茨海默病MRI数据集上的分期分类表现。
AI.motivation: 单数据集评估难以区分模型架构的真实行为与数据集特异效应，需跨多数据条件对比以验证结论一致性。
AI.method: 统一预处理与评估流程的多数据集基准；五个架构（CNN与ViT/Swin）在三种条件（严重类别不平衡、训练-测试分布错配、大规模数据增强）下对比。
AI.result: 性能模式跨数据集大体一致；ViT-Large在三个数据集上均最优，最高99.84%准确率、99.86% macro F1；架构差异在分布错配时最明显、增强设置下最弱；错误集中于相邻早期阶段（Very Mild与Mild）。
AI.conclusion: 应基于多数据条件评估架构而非依赖单数据集结果；早期相邻阶段的细粒度区分仍是瓶颈。

title: Dynamic Query as Budgeting for Tiny Object Detection
summary: Recent DETR-based tiny object detectors adopt dynamic query mechanisms to handle severe density imbalance. However, existing designs entangle two effects: how many and which queries are decoded. This entanglement obscures what drives the gains and complicates dynamic-query design; additional learned predictors and heuristic filtering also introduce overhead and potential selection errors. We disentangle these effects and show that dynamic query primarily acts as \emph{budgeting}---allocating decoder query capacity according to object density---rather than intricate query this http URL by this view, we formulate a monotonic and conservative budgeting principle and propose a budgeting-based DETR (BUTR), a streamlined framework that uses a lightweight, non-learned budgeter to estimate an input-dependent query budget $K(x)$ from encoder confidences. BUTR retains standard Top-$K(x)$ query initialization without additional learned modules or heuristic filtering in the this http URL $800\times800$ resolution, BUTR-L achieves 35.7 AP at 47.8 FPS on AI-TOD-v2 and 29.8 AP at 42.1 FPS on VisDrone on an NVIDIA T4 GPU. Inference-time integration on COCO further demonstrates its applicability to general scenario detection. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 将动态查询机制解耦为"数量"与"选择"两个效应，指出其本质是按目标密度分配解码器查询预算（budgeting）；据此提出单调、保守的预算化原则与BUTR框架：用轻量、非学习的budgeter从编码器置信度估计输入相关预算K(x)，保留标准Top-K(x)初始化，无需额外可学习模块或启发式过滤。
AI.motivation: DETR类小目标检测器用动态查询机制应对严重密度不平衡，但现有设计将"解码多少查询"与"解码哪些查询"两种效应纠缠，导致增益来源不清、动态查询设计复杂化，且额外可学习预测器与启发式过滤带来开销与选择误差。
AI.method: 解耦上述两种效应并论证动态查询主要起"预算分配"作用；据此提出单调且保守的budgeting原则，设计BUTR：轻量、非学习budgeter基于编码器置信度估计输入相关的查询预算K(x)，配合标准Top-K(x)查询初始化，去除额外学习模块与启发式筛选。
AI.result: 800×800分辨率下，NVIDIA T4 GPU上BUTR-L在AI-TOD-v2达35.7 AP @ 47.8 FPS，在VisDrone达29.8 AP @ 42.1 FPS；在COCO上以推理期集成方式验证了对通用场景检测的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 动态查询的核心价值在于查询预算分配而非复杂查询选择，简化的非学习budgeting即可在保持高帧率的同时获得优异性小目标检测性能，并具备向通用目标检测迁移的潜力。

title: MOTIO: Agentic Skill Engineering for Reality-Grounded Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
comment: 24 pages, including 11 pages of supplementary material
summary: We present MOTIO, an agentic skill-engineering system that turns ordinary human-action videos, reality-grounded 3D assets, motion references, and reusable robot skills into executable humanoid loco-manipulation programs. Through in-context task and contact reasoning, an agent constructs staged robot-native interactions and improves them using physics execution, multi-frame feedback, and human validation---without task-specific teleoperation or robot demonstration collection. Agentic 3D supplies metric product and environment assets, while existing whole-body, inverse-kinematics, and dexterous-hand interfaces realize the programs. Across 33 timestamped first approvals, the median recorded agent-turn time is 97.0 minutes and request-to-approval duration is 2.80 hours. Simulation-side layout and object variation prepare a long-horizon bottle-disposal skill for a continuous 101.75-second physical G1 execution in a scanned office; physical refinement reduces screw-tightening thread residual by 76.0%. Agent-generated skills additionally supervise BC/DAgger distillation into one shared reference policy, completing 18 simulated tasks under the same checkpoint without inference-time expert intervention. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: MOTIO：用智能体将人类动作视频、3D资产、运动参考与可复用技能组合成可执行的人形loco-manipulation程序，免遥操作、免真机演示，并获得真实G1机器人长程任务执行与技能蒸馏结果。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身loco-manipulation缺乏通用编程范式：逐任务遥操作/真机演示采集成本高、难以扩展到长程复合任务；现有方法也缺少把人类视频与3D资产转化为机器人原生可执行程序的中介层。
AI.method: 提出agentic skill-engineering系统MOTIO：智能体做in-context的任务与接触推理，构建分阶段的robot-native交互程序，通过物理执行、多帧视觉反馈与人类确认迭代修正；Agentic 3D生成度量级产品/环境资产；复用现有全身控制、IK与灵巧手接口执行程序；仿真侧做布局与物体变化增强长程技能鲁棒性；用智能体生成的技能对BC/DAgger做蒸馏，合成单一共享参考策略。
AI.result: 33次带时间戳的首次批准，智能体回合中位时长97.0分钟，请求到批准中位2.80小时；仿真布局/物体变化支持下，在扫描办公室里完成连续101.75秒物理G1长程倒瓶任务；真机精修使拧螺丝螺纹残差降低76.0%；蒸馏得到的单一共享策略在无推理期专家介入下完成18个仿真任务。
AI.conclusion: 智能体驱动的技能工程可把人类视频与3D资产作为监督来源，替代任务级遥操作，形成可复用、可迭代的人形loco-manipulation技能生产线，并可作为策略蒸馏的数据/监督放大器。

title: Semantic-First MixGRPO: Reliable Emotional Image Generation via Temporal Decoupling
summary: Controllable image synthesis should modify visual affect without replacing the objects, layout, or relations specified by a prompt. Existing methods address this tension through conditioning architectures or auxiliary losses, while mixed ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling has mainly been used to accelerate group relative policy optimization (GRPO). We instead study stochastic-window position as an attribute-control variable for flow-based image generation. Using FLUX.1-dev with EmotiCrafter-style valence-arousal conditioning, we compare fixed early, middle, and late four-transition SDE windows, progressive MixGRPO, and full-path Flow-GRPO under matched settings. Because step 0 has the highest noise, our semantic-first schedule uses deterministic ODE sampling at steps 0-19 to establish content, then confines stochastic exploration and policy updates to steps 20-23. Across three seeds, it achieves a CLIPScore of $29.662\pm0.276$, cross-affect DINO consistency of $80.1\pm0.9$, and semantic drift of 2.9%, while reducing training cost by 33.5% relative to full-path Flow-GRPO. Full-path stochastic training remains more accurate on valence-arousal targets, revealing a genuine trade-off. Semantic-first nevertheless improves both affect and semantic metrics over progressive scheduling, preserves the principal subject in 95.98% of images at five extreme or neutral targets, and receives the highest semantic-preservation and overall-preference ratings in a 30-participant study. These results identify probability-flow time as a practical graphics control dimension for reliable affective appearance manipulation.

AI.tldr: 将随机窗口位置（混合ODE/SDE采样中的步数区间）作为流式图像生成的情感属性控制变量，提出"语义优先"调度：前20步确定性ODE建立内容，后4步SDE+策略更新仅做情感探索。
AI.motivation: 可控图像合成需在修改视觉情感的同时保持提示词指定的物体、布局与关系不变；现有方法依赖条件架构或辅助损失，而混合ODE/SDE采样主要被用于加速GRPO。作者转而研究"随机窗口位置"本身作为属性控制维度。
AI.method: 基于FLUX.1-dev + EmotiCrafter式效价-唤醒条件，对比固定早/中/晚四步SDE窗口、渐进式MixGRPO、全路径Flow-GRPO。提出语义优先调度：步0–19用ODE确定性采样确立内容，步20–23限制随机探索与策略更新；三随机种子实验，并进行30人用户研究。
AI.result: CLIPScore 29.662±0.276，跨情感DINO一致性80.1±0.9，语义漂移2.9%，训练成本较Flow-GRPO降低33.5%；全路径随机训练在效价-唤醒目标上更准确（存在真实权衡）；五个极端/中性目标下95.98%图像保留主体，用户研究语义保持与整体偏好得分最高。
AI.conclusion: 概率流时间（随机窗口位置）可作为实用的图形学控制维度，用于可靠的情感外观操控，并在情感与语义指标上均优于渐进式调度。

title: SCET-CBF: Speed-Calibrated Soft Guidance for One-Step Dynamic Navigation
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) support collision avoidance, yet dense dynamic encounters can leave a vehicle with no feasible command. Geometric refinements and soft constraints help preserve motion choices. Using these choices also requires accounting for the vehicle's changing turning response. For a steering-limited bicycle, braking can lower closing speed while slowing the lateral motion needed before an obstacle arrives. We propose SCET-CBF, a speed-calibrated soft guidance law for one-step dynamic navigation. A short lateral escape maneuver gives an allowable approach speed. Its speed derivative allows a quadratic program to weigh both effects of braking when choosing acceleration and steering. Soft penalties accommodate competing obstacle preferences within the input set permitted by segment and braking constraints. We derive the guidance and establish protection over each accepted motion segment, together with conditional braking invariance for a single obstacle. On 2500 paired tasks with a 60 s deadline, SCET achieves 72.8% completion, compared with 49.8% for CBF/velocity-obstacle control and 69.8% for an enhanced 1 s CBF-MPC. At 100 obstacles, SCET and the enhanced MPC complete 52.4% and 33.6% of tasks. Paired studies identify the contributions of speed feedback and early activation. Further evaluations examine the operating range under lateral acceleration limits and bounded motion and execution errors.

AI.tldr: SCET-CBF：面向一步式动态导航的速度校准软约束引导律，用短时横向逃逸动作推得允许接近速度及其导数，使QP在选加速度与转向时同时权衡制动的两个效应。
AI.motivation: 稠密动态障碍下CBF易出现无可行指令；几何放宽与软约束虽保留可选动作，但未考虑转向受限自行车模型下制动对横移能力的削弱——制动既降接近速度，也降低到达障碍前所需的横移速度，需显式建模这一耦合。
AI.method: 建模为转向受限自行车模型；构造短时横向逃逸机动得到允许接近速度v_allow，并给出其速度导数，使二次规划（QP）在加速度与转向决策中同时计入制动的双向效应；以软惩罚在段约束与制动约束允许的输入集内协调冲突障碍偏好；推导引导律并证明每个被接受运动段的保护性及单障碍下的条件制动不变性。
AI.result: 2500组配对任务（60 s时限）完成率72.8%，对比CBF/速度障碍控制49.8%、增强型1 s CBF-MPC 69.8%；100障碍时SCET与增强MPC分别为52.4%和33.6%；配对消融确认速度反馈与提前激活的贡献；并评估了横向加速度限制及有界运动/执行误差下的工作范围。
AI.conclusion: 通过把制动对转向响应的削弱纳入QP权衡，软引导CBF在密集动态场景显著提升任务完成率与可扩展性，并具备可证明的段级安全性；属导航控制层方法，尚缺实车验证。

title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
summary: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation. Existing methods preserve user intent and improve overall visual appeal, with less explicit emphasis on fine-grained design dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce Qwen-Image-PE, which learns visual design through two-stage training. Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) uses dense captions of well-designed images as design supervision. Reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) jointly compares all candidate images for the same request to refine lighting, composition, layout, and detail. On Qwen-Image-Bench with Qwen-Image-2.1, Qwen-Image-PE-397B improves over original requests by 7.81 points, while Qwen-Image-PE-9B outperforms all evaluated PE baselines. Further evaluations show gains in visual design, aesthetics, image quality, and human preference. We find that PE scales along three axes: training data, model size, and information density, with sufficient information density as a prerequisite for effective enhancement. Moreover, we demonstrate that Qwen-Image-PE generalizes to four additional T2I backbones, even surpassing native prompt enhancers on HunyuanImage-2.1 and FLUX 3 Image Klein. We release Qwen-Image-PE-9B at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Qwen-Image-PE 通过两阶段训练（基于标题反向蒸馏的监督微调 + 组内设计奖励的强化学习）让提示增强模型学习细粒度视觉设计，并在多个 T2I 骨干上取得一致的视觉质量与人类偏好提升。
AI.motivation: 现有提示增强（PE）方法虽能保留用户意图并提升整体观感，但缺乏对光照、构图、布局、细节等细粒度设计维度的显式建模，导致增强后的视觉规格不够专业。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：(1) 监督微调阶段采用 Caption-Based Reverse Distillation（CRD），用高质量设计图像的稠密描述作为设计监督信号；(2) 强化学习阶段采用 Groupwise Design Reward（GDR），对同一请求下的所有候选图像做组内横向比较，以相对优劣为奖励信号精修光照、构图、布局与细节。模型规模覆盖 9B 与 397B。
AI.result: 在 Qwen-Image-Bench + Qwen-Image-2.1 上，397B 版本较原始请求提升 7.81 分；9B 版本优于所有对比的 PE 基线。视觉设计、美学、图像质量与人类偏好均有提升。消融分析表明 PE 沿训练数据、模型规模、信息密度三个方向扩展，且足够的信息密度是有效增强的前提。方法可迁移至另外 4 个 T2I 骨干，在 HunyuanImage-2.1 与 FLUX 3 Image Klein 上甚至超过其原生提示增强器。开源 Qwen-Image-PE-9B。
AI.conclusion: 提示增强的核心瓶颈在于设计维度的显式监督与信息密度；CRD + GDR 的两阶段范式提供了可扩展、可跨骨干迁移的设计感知 PE 方案。

title: A Differentiable Chassis Safety Layer for Intelligent Vehicle Motion Control
summary: Learning-based vehicle motion control requires coordination between diverse task objectives and state-dependent chassis safety constraints. Conventional cascaded architectures may compromise task performance when safety filters modify nominal commands independently of policy learning. This article proposes a differentiable chassis safety layer that modularly integrates task-oriented control with explicit physical constraints. Actuator limits, individual-tire force constraints, and vehicle handling envelopes are incorporated into sequential quadratic programs. Each projected command propagates the predicted vehicle dynamics and updates subsequent constraints, enabling temporal gradient coupling through implicit differentiation. A two-stage learning strategy combines expert imitation with risk-guided supervision and conditional intervention guidance to coordinate nominal control decisions with chassis safety constraints. Closed-loop evaluations under unseen scenarios, emergency maneuvers, and ablation studies demonstrate that the proposed method improves safety-performance coordination and exploits vehicle dynamic potential while maintaining handling stability.

AI.tldr: 提出可微分底盘安全层，将执行器极限、单轮胎力约束与操纵包络嵌入序列二次规划，通过隐式微分实现时域梯度耦合，并用两阶段学习协调任务性能与安全约束。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的车辆运动控制需同时满足多任务目标与状态相关的底盘安全约束；传统级联架构中安全滤波器独立于策略学习修改标称指令，易损失任务性能。
AI.method: 构建可微分安全层：执行器限制、单胎力约束、操纵包络构成序列二次规划；每个投影指令前推预测车辆动力学并更新后续约束，借助隐式微分获得时间维度的梯度耦合；采用专家模仿+风险引导监督+条件干预引导的两阶段学习策略。
AI.result: 在未见场景、紧急机动与消融实验中，闭环评测显示该方法改善了安全—性能协调，在保持操纵稳定性的同时更充分挖掘车辆动力学潜力。
AI.conclusion: 将安全约束以可微分方式内嵌进策略学习，优于独立级联安全滤波，为约束感知的学习型底盘控制提供可行方案；但证据主要为仿真闭环，缺少实车验证与开源细节。

title: MarineLife-16K: An Attribute-Rich Video-Text Dataset for Motion-Aware Marine Video Understanding
summary: Marine video understanding is crucial for a wide range of real-world applications. However, existing marine video datasets suffer from limitations, including the limited number of data samples, fine-grained text descriptions, and detailed visual attributes. To address these limitations, we introduce a large-scale, video-text dataset featuring rich, in-the-wild visual attributes tailored for complex marine environments. Our dataset comprises 2,000 video-text pairs annotated with 13 attributes covering up to four objects per scene, object visual/geometric properties, behaviors, environmental context, and camera motion, spanning diverse lighting conditions, times of day, and 7 countries. From these annotations, we generate 16,080 video-question pairs (12,080 multiple-choice, 4,000 open-ended). Furthermore, we benchmark both proprietary and open-source video-LLM models on video question answering and video captioning tasks. We find that (i) proprietary models often achieves superior performances; (ii) VLMs handle object motion well but struggle with complex camera motion; (iii) closed-source models struggle to perceive camera motion; and (iv) VLMs struggle to reason in static cameras.

AI.tldr: 提出面向海洋场景的大规模视频-文本数据集：2,000条视频-文本对、每场景至多4个对象、13类属性标注，派生16,080个视频问答对，并基准评测闭源/开源视频LLM在VQA与视频描述任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有海洋视频数据集存在样本量小、缺乏细粒度文本描述与详细视觉属性等问题，难以支撑复杂海洋环境下的视频理解研究。
AI.method: 构建含丰富野外视觉属性的视频-文本数据集，标注涵盖对象视觉/几何属性、行为、环境上下文与相机运动共13类属性，覆盖多光照、多时段与7个国家；由标注生成12,080道多选题与4,000道开放式问答，对专有及开源视频LLM进行VQA与captioning基准测试。
AI.result: 专有模型整体表现更优但难以感知相机运动；VLMs对物体运动理解较好而对复杂相机运动处理不足；在静态相机场景下推理能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与评测揭示了当前视频LLM在海洋场景属性级理解（尤其相机运动与静态相机推理）上的系统性短板，为后续模型改进提供基准。

title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
summary: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.

AI.tldr: 轻量级 ENet + UNet 跳连 + CBAM 的肺肿瘤分割模型，43万参数、0.549 GMAC，跨数据集 DSC 0.908，用 Grad-CAM 做可解释分析。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习肺肿瘤分割模型虽 DSC 高，但单次前向浮点运算量大、依赖 GPU、推理慢，难以在临床资源受限环境部署。
AI.method: 以实时推理、低算力的 ENet 为主干，编码器-解码器间引入 UNet 式跳连以复用特征，并加入轻量 CBAM 注意力模块提升特征表达；在 TCIA（MSD 挑战赛）公开数据上训练，在 LIDC-IDRI 上外部验证；用 Grad-CAM 可视化预测并定位分割薄弱区域。
AI.result: DSC 0.90812（阈值0.5），参数量 430,052、计算量 0.549 GMAC；相比 UNet 最高快 10 倍、GMAC 少 79 倍，参数量为 SegNet 的 1/22。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑模型在保持高分割精度的同时显著降低算力与参数成本，适合资源受限临床场景部署，并具备可视化可解释性；但方法本身为既有模块组合，缺少与主流轻量分割基线的系统对比与临床实用性验证。

title: MDPO: Multi-constraint Dexterous Policy Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires high-dimensional control policies to accomplish complex contact-rich tasks while simultaneously satisfying multiple safety requirements, such as joint limits, unsafe finger configurations, arm collisions, and unstable object interactions. Constrained reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for incorporating these requirements into dexterous manipulation policy learning. However, existing constrained RL methods for dexterous manipulation primarily focus on cumulative cost constraints and struggle to simultaneously handle multiple heterogeneous constraints during dexterous policy learning. In this work, we propose Multi-constraint Dexterous Policy Optimization (MDPO) for safe dexterous manipulation. We first formulate dexterous manipulation as a multi-constraint policy optimization problem involving both cumulative cost constraints and state-wise cost constraints. Based on this formulation, we integrate multi-constraint projection into the dexterous manipulation policy optimization process. Specifically, we employ constraint-specific policy projections to map the intermediate policy that maximizes task performance onto the feasible regions defined by the cumulative cost constraint and the state-wise cost constraint. Extensive experiments on ReDMan, including safe joint control, finger safety, and grasping tasks, demonstrate that MDPO achieves superior constraint satisfaction while maintaining competitive task performance compared with the baselines. Our code is available at this link.

AI.tldr: MDPO：将灵巧操作建模为同时含累积代价约束与逐状态代价约束的多约束策略优化问题，通过约束特定的策略投影将中间策略映射到可行域，在ReDMan的关节限制、手指安全与抓取任务上实现更好的约束满足与有竞争力的任务性能。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作需满足关节限位、不安全手指构型、机械臂碰撞、物体交互不稳定等多元异构安全约束；现有约束RL方法主要处理累积代价约束，难以同时处理多类异构约束。
AI.method: 将灵巧操作形式化为多约束策略优化问题（累积代价约束+逐状态代价约束）；在策略优化过程中引入多约束投影：分别用针对累积代价约束与逐状态约束的约束专用投影，把最大化任务性能的中间策略投影至各自定义的可行域。
AI.result: 在ReDMan平台的安全关节控制、手指安全、抓取三类任务上，MDPO相对基线在约束满足上更优，且任务性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 多约束投影可有效统一处理异构安全约束，为灵巧操作的安全策略学习提供可行方案；代码开源。

title: Can One Hear Geometry? Gauge-Invariant Spectral Descriptors for Text-to-B-rep Retrieval
summary: Text-to-3D solid retrieval requires aligning natural language with precise geometry despite variations in pose, scale, and recording conventions. Existing methods discretize Boundary Representation (B-rep) models into point clouds or meshes, or learn features from faces, edges, and topology, risking information loss or lacking explicit invariance guarantees. We propose a text-to-B-rep retrieval framework based on group actions and spectral geometric invariants, making invariance an explicit constraint on descriptor construction. Specifically, we use group actions to characterize equivalence transformations induced by translation, rotation, reflection, uniform scaling, and contour recording conventions. For sketch-extrusion solids, we construct a fixed 280-dimensional spectral geometric descriptor by integrating geometric information from three complementary levels, including cross-sectional regions, contour boundaries, and extrusion structures. Furthermore, we use descriptor-consistent multi-positive sets and geometric attribute supervision to promote structural alignment between text and solids. On Text-to-3D solid retrieval, our method achieves 88.6% Recall@5, exceeding the previous state of the art by 13.6 percentage points and demonstrating the effectiveness of explicit geometric invariants for precise 3D solid retrieval.
