AI.tldr: 提出基于群作用与谱几何不变量的文本到B-rep实体检索框架，构造对平移、旋转、反射、均匀缩放及轮廓记录约定不变的280维谱几何描述子，在Text-to-3D实体检索上达到88.6% Recall@5，超先前最优13.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有文本-3D检索将B-rep离散化为点云/网格，或从面-边-拓扑学习特征，存在信息损失或缺乏显式不变性保证；位姿、尺度与记录约定差异使语言与精确几何对齐困难。作者希望将不变性从"学习而来"转为对描述子构造的显式约束。
AI.method: 用群作用形式化平移、旋转、反射、均匀缩放与轮廓记录约定引起的等价变换。针对草图-拉伸(sketch-extrusion)实体，融合截面区域、轮廓边界与拉伸结构三个互补层次的几何信息，构造固定280维谱几何不变描述子；再用描述子一致的多正样本集合与几何属性监督促进文本-实体结构对齐。
AI.result: 在文本到3D实体检索任务上取得88.6% Recall@5，比此前最先进方法提升13.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何不变量（群作用+谱描述子）对精确3D实体检索有效，不变性作为构造约束优于隐式学习，为CAD/B-rep与语言对齐提供可解释的几何先验路径。

title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation: Hands, Simulators, Training, and Evaluation
comment: 36 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables. Survey of 113 learning-based dexterous manipulation methods, with a comparison of each paper's stated reward against its released code
summary: A dexterous hand can change an object's pose without setting it down. This survey covers 113 learning-based methods that attempt it, the hands they run on, the simulators they train in, and how they report results. The field has largely converged on one recipe: reinforcement learning on privileged state in a GPU simulator, distilled into a vision-only student for transfer to hardware. Almost half the corpus trains that way, nearly all of it in one simulator, whose own successors are barely used. A second and faster-growing branch learns from teleoperated demonstration instead, through vision-language-action models, diffusion policies, and systems whose contribution is the collection rig itself. Published work has tripled since 2022. Grasping remains the largest task family and bimanual coordination the fastest-rising, and almost every experiment runs on one of four hands. What the survey adds comes from reading released code and vendor specifications beside the papers. Eight hands that can be bought or built from published designs appear in no method paper here. Where the depth a hand sinks into the object it holds is reported at all, it is not measured in the physics that produced the motion. Section VII proposes a protocol for the unreported quantities; the body gives the counts behind every claim above.

AI.tldr: 综述113篇基于学习的灵巧手手内操作（in-hand reorientation）方法，统计其硬件平台、仿真器与评估范式；指出领域高度集中于"特权状态RL+GPU仿真+视觉蒸馏"与遥操作/ VLA/diffusion策略两大路线，并揭示8款可购/可造的手未被任何方法论文使用、接触深度等量未被报告，Section VII提出报告协议。
AI.motivation: 手内操作研究文献量自2022年增长约三倍，但方法、硬件、仿真器与评估口径高度碎片化且缺乏统一报告标准，需要一次以代码与厂商规格为依据的系统梳理，暴露"未报告量"与硬件覆盖缺口。
AI.method: 文献综述（meta-analysis式统计）：覆盖113篇学习型方法，按学习范式（特权状态RL+GPU仿真→视觉学生蒸馏 vs. 遥操作示教/VLA/diffusion策略）、使用的手（四种为主）、仿真器、任务族（抓取最大、双臂协调增长最快）与结果报告方式进行定量归类；并对照公开代码与商业/开源手规格进行交叉核查。
AI.result: 近半数语料采用特权状态RL+单一GPU仿真器蒸馏范式，后继仿真器几乎未被采用；新兴分支基于遥操作示教更快增长；2022年以来论文数增至三倍；几乎全部实验集中于四种手；八款可购或可复现的手未被任何方法论文使用；接触深度等关键量普遍未报告或未与物理仿真一致地测量。
AI.conclusion: 领域收敛于单一技术配方，存在硬件多样性不足与评估口径缺失两大系统性问题；提出面向未报告量的报告协议，为后续手内操作研究的可复现与可比较性提供规范。

title: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents
summary: Robots can use historical observations to answer spatiotemporal queries in familiar environments, but the presence of relevant evidence does not imply that existing tools support the operations a task requires. We introduce ReSight, a task-driven self-improving memory system for embodied agents that expands the capabilities for processing and accessing historical observations as task demands arise. ReSight retains keyframes and their spatiotemporal associations, separating observation evidence from extensible derived fields so that stored observations can be reprocessed for new needs. An execution agent and a coding agent share this memory through different interfaces: the former calls registered tools within a bounded online budget, while the latter uses a programmable workspace and a larger exploration budget to inspect evidence, write programs, and acquire models as needed. To realize capability expansion in ReSight, we develop Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM), which identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers and converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, extending memory representations and access capabilities as needed. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate effective base memory access and capability expansion. With the execution model and online budget held fixed within each benchmark, EDM reduces mean position error on OC-NaVQA from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and improves high-level success on FindingDory from 38.3% to 63.8%. With the tools and skill frozen, success still improves by 28.3 percentage points on FindingDory episodes excluded from exploration and distillation. Experiments on real robot patrol memories further demonstrate reuse of these capabilities for subsequent queries and new memories, with fewer online tool calls on average.

AI.tldr: ReSight：面向具身智能体的任务驱动自改进记忆系统，通过把观测证据与可扩展派生字段分离，并借助编码智能体在更大预算下探索、写程序、装载模型，将"探索→蒸馏→挂载(EDM)"得到的方案固化为可复用的记忆构建器、查询工具与技能，从而按需扩展历史观测的表示与访问能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人在熟悉环境中可用历史观测回答时空查询，但"存在相关证据"不等于"现有工具支持任务所需操作"。即基座记忆的表示与访问能力是固定的，一旦任务需求超出既有工具集，证据再多也无法被利用。
AI.method: ReSight 记忆保存关键帧及其时空关联，将观测证据与可扩展派生字段解耦，使已存观测可被重新处理。两类智能体共享记忆：执行智能体在有界在线预算内调用已注册工具；编码智能体在可编程工作区中以更大探索预算检查证据、编写程序、按需获取模型。核心机制 EDM(Explore-Distill-Mount)在无参考答案条件下，从执行与探索记录中识别能力缺口，将探索所得解法蒸馏为可复用的记忆构建器、查询工具与技能并挂载。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上验证了基座记忆访问与能力扩展：固定执行模型与在线预算下，OC-NaVQA 平均位置误差由 33.10 m 降至 24.72 m，FindingDory 高层成功率由 38.3% 提升至 63.8%；工具与技能冻结时，对未参与探索/蒸馏的 FindingDory 回合成功率仍提升 28.3 个百分点。真实机器人巡逻记忆上复用了这些能力用于后续查询与新记忆，平均在线工具调用更少。
AI.conclusion: 能力可扩展性应作为记忆系统的一等设计目标：通过定义与分离"当前已有能力"和"可再生能力"，系统能在无监督信号下自动扩展记忆表示与访问接口，且新获得的能力具备跨回合、跨记忆的泛化性与效率收益。

title: Explicit Frictional Contact Modeling in Neural Garment Simulation
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) simulate garments efficiently through physics-based self-supervision, but leave body-garment friction implicit or inside training energies, with no friction coefficient $\mu$ to set at inference; retraining the tested GNNs with a coefficient-specific friction term barely responds to $\mu$. Optimization-based solvers decide each contact's stick-slip state from the reaction that governs it, but only by re-optimizing the garment state at every step; a friction term in a one-pass training objective acts as a fixed-weight penalty on sliding, and the trained weights apply no per-contact Coulomb condition at inference. We therefore resolve friction explicitly after prediction: a Modular Contact Operator, attached to a frozen predictor without retraining or an iterative solve, estimates the normal load, applies a closed-form Coulomb correction along a path across body triangles, and propagates the induced motion through the cloth as a linearized membrane wave. On HOOD and ContourCraft, it raises sticking and lowers slip monotonically in $\mu$, tracking a reference solver's response while coefficient-specific retraining stays flat, with low penetration and reference-consistent stretching at an eighth of the solver's runtime.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的GNN服装预测器之后附加一个"模块化接触算子"，无需重训或迭代求解即可显式施加库仑摩擦并对齐参考求解器响应，并以1/8运行时达到低穿透与一致拉伸。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN服装模拟把布料-身体摩擦隐式编码在训练能量中，缺少可在推理时设定的摩擦系数μ；用μ专用摩擦项重训也几乎不响应。优化型求解器虽能逐接触判定粘-滑，但每步都要重优化服装状态，代价高；单次前向训练目标中的摩擦项只是对滑动的固定权重惩罚，推理时没有逐接触库仑条件。
AI.method: 提出在预测后显式解算摩擦的模块化接触算子（Modular Contact Operator）：挂接冻结预测器，无需重训或迭代求解；估计法向载荷，沿跨身体三角面片的路径施加闭式库仑修正，并将诱发的运动以线性化膜波形式在布料中传播。
AI.result: 在HOOD与ContourCraft上，粘着随μ单调上升、滑移单调下降，能追踪参考求解器的μ响应，而系数专用重训版本响应平坦；同时保持低穿透、拉伸与参考一致，运行时约为求解器的1/8。
AI.conclusion: 将摩擦从隐式训练能量中分离为推理时可调的显式后处理算子，可在不牺牲精度的前提下让一次性前馈服装预测器获得可控、物理一致的摩擦行为与大幅加速。

title: FreqPKC: Frequency-Aware PeakConv for Radar Semantic Segmentation
summary: Automotive millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has attracted increasing attention for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving, owing to its robustness under adverse weather and lighting conditions. Recent works have introduced radar-specific neural operators such as PeakConv (PKC), inspired by constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, to better model the peak-dominated characteristics of radar images. However, existing methods typically treat the guard bandwidth as learnable parameters, without explicitly characterizing the frequency response of the PKC operator. In this work, we revisit PKC from a frequency-domain perspective and propose Frequency-Aware PeakConv (FreqPKC), which explicitly models and exploits its underlying spectral characteristics. By analyzing the frequency response of PKC, FreqPKC enables the network to capture a broader range of frequency components and adaptively adjust its effective bandwidth. With the proposed Frequency-Aware (FA) module, the network can infer appropriate guard bandwidths to balance high- and low-frequency information: it enhances high-frequency components in target regions for more precise segmentation while suppressing noise through low-frequency filtering in background areas. Building on FreqPKC, we further develop FreqPKC-Net, a radar semantic segmentation (RSS) framework that integrates frequency-guided adaptive modulation with cross-view fusion for multi-view inputs, and can also be adapted to single-view data. Experiments on the public datasets CARRADA, CARRADA-RAC, and a self-built dataset named RS-SAR demonstrate that FreqPKC-Net consistently outperforms existing SoTA methods on both range-Doppler and range-angle views.

AI.tldr: 从频域视角重新审视雷达语义分割中的PeakConv算子，提出FreqPKC与FreqPKC-Net，通过频率感知模块自适应推断guard带宽以平衡高低频信息，在多视角/单视角雷达分割上超越SoTA。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达语义分割方法将PKC中的guard带宽视为可学习参数，未显式刻画PKC算子的频率响应，导致高低频信息利用不充分、难以兼顾目标细节与背景噪声抑制。
AI.method: 对PKC进行频域分析，显式建模其频率响应并据此设计Frequency-Aware PeakConv（FreqPKC），使网络覆盖更宽频段并自适应调节有效带宽；FA模块推断合适guard带宽，在目标区域增强高频以提升分割精度、在背景区域以低频滤波抑制噪声。进一步构建FreqPKC-Net框架，融合频率引导的自适应调制与多视角跨视角融合，并支持单视角适配。
AI.result: 在CARRADA、CARRADA-RAC及自建RS-SAR数据集上，FreqPKC-Net在距离-多普勒与距离-角度视图上均稳定优于现有SoTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 频域显式建模为雷达特定算子设计提供了有效且可解释的切入角度，频率感知自适应调制可兼顾细节增强与噪声抑制，具备单/多视角通用性。

title: MimicAll: Structured Embodiment Conditioning for Cross-Humanoid Whole-Body Motion Tracking
summary: Humanoid motion trackers reproduce diverse behaviors, but sharing a policy across bodies requires accounting for differences in structure, morphology and dynamics. We present MimicAll, a reinforcement-learning framework for shared whole-body motion tracking across heterogeneous humanoids. A structured embodiment descriptor is encoded into global and joint-aligned conditions, which are combined with observation history and body-matched motion references to predict joint-target offsets. Physics-consistent embodiment randomization, body-calibrated retargeting and heterogeneous simulation support training across 4,096 variants from 16 humanoid families. We introduce a benchmark of 464 bodies across five distribution strata to evaluate motion generalization, within-family embodiment shifts and unseen-family transfer. Controlled ablations show that embodiment information improves motion completion with simple concatenation, while self-attention yields the lowest global position errors. With equal training transitions, shared training achieves 99.4% 30-second success on randomized G1 bodies in 100STYLE, versus 42.9% for a single-body specialist. With Flat-MLP encoding and concatenation, continued training on a motion subset excluding obstacle categories achieves 98.3% and 93.5% 30-second success on 100STYLE for sampled training bodies and out-of-distribution variants within seen families, respectively. On an eight-motion LAFAN1 subset excluding ground and get-up sequences across 464 bodies, mismatched body conditions reduce self-attention's 30-second success from 61.7% to 47.0%, demonstrating a closed-loop benefit from embodiment information.

AI.tldr: MimicAll：用结构化具身描述符实现跨异构人形机器人的共享全身运动跟踪策略，在4096个身体变体上训练并被验证可泛化到未见机体系。
AI.motivation: 全身运动跟踪策略难以跨不同结构的机器人本体共享，需显式建模结构、形态与动力学的差异；同时缺乏评测跨本体运动泛化的系统性基准。
AI.method: 将结构化具身描述符编码为全局条件与关节对齐条件，与观测历史和身体匹配的运动参考融合预测关节目标偏移；采用物理一致的具身随机化、身体标定的重定向和异构仿真，覆盖16个家族4096个变体训练；构建464个身体、5个分布层的基准；消融比较拼接与self-attention编码。
AI.result: 相同训练转移量下，G1随机化身体100STYLE 30秒成功率99.4%，单本体专家仅42.9%；继续训练于剔除障碍类别的子集，采样训练身体98.3%、同家族OOD变体93.5%；在LAFAN1 464身体上，错配身体条件使self-attention成功率从61.7%降至47.0%，证明闭环利用具身信息的收益。
AI.conclusion: 显式具身条件能显著提升跨本体运动跟踪的样本效率与泛化能力，为异构人形机器人共享控制策略提供可复用的框架与评测基准。

title: Component Pooling Trained Across Orientations for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
summary: Few-shot remote sensing scene classification (FSRSSC) aims to recognize novel scene categories from only a few labeled images. Most FSRSSC methods summarize the feature map of an image by global average pooling, which treats the few objects that define an aerial scene and the large background around them alike, and they rarely consider that aerial images have no canonical orientation. To address these issues, we propose RoCoP, a parameter-free component pooling network trained across orientations. RoCoP consists of a feature extractor, a non-negative decomposition module (NDM) and a component scoring module (CSM). NDM factorizes the local descriptors of each image into a few additive components with a deterministic initialization and a single multiplicative update, so that the positions of one object are grouped together. CSM weights each component by its activation magnitude and converts the weights into a soft mask for pooling. Because both modules are invariant to permutations of feature positions, the only rotation-sensitive part of the pipeline is the backbone, which we train to classify randomly rotated views of every image. Experiments on NWPU-RESISC45, AID and UC Merced show that component pooling and rotated-view training are complementary: together they improve a strong transfer-learning baseline by about 2.5 points in 5-way 1-shot accuracy on NWPU-RESISC45 and AID, without adding parameters at inference. Under an identical protocol, RoCoP outperforms re-implemented metric-based and task-adaptive methods, and NDM and CSM also improve existing methods when plugged into them. We further identify the regime in which the method does not apply, namely very small base sets.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoCoP——一个无额外参数的“组件池化”网络，用非负分解(NDM)把局部描述子聚成若干加性组件、再用激活强度加权的软掩码(CSM)替代全局平均池化，并对每张图随机旋转视图训练主干以消除航向敏感性，在 NWPU-RESISC45、AID、UC Merced 少样本遥感场景分类上超过强迁移基线约 2.5 个点。
AI.motivation: 少样本遥感场景分类中，主流方法用全局平均池化汇总特征图，把界定航拍场景的少数目标与其周围大背景一视同仁；同时几乎没有考虑航拍图像无规范朝向(旋转等变)的特性。
AI.method: RoCoP 由特征提取器、非负分解模块(NDM)与组件评分模块(CSM)组成。NDM 用确定性初始化加单步乘性更新，将每张图的局部描述子分解为少量加性组件，使同一目标的不同位置归入同一组；CSM 按组件激活幅度加权，并把权重转成软掩码用于池化。两个模块都对特征位置的置换不变，因此整条流程中唯一对旋转敏感的是主干网络，故对每张图像随机旋转视图进行分类训练。
AI.result: 在 NWPU-RESISC45、AID、UC Merced 上，组件池化与旋转视图训练互补，相较强迁移学习基线在 5-way 1-shot 精度上提升约 2.5 个点，且推理阶段不增加参数；同一协议下优于复现的度量学习与任务自适应方法；NDM/CSM 可作为插件提升已有方法；并指出在基类集合极小时方法失效的适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 用置换不变的组件分解+软掩码池化取代 GAP，并配合旋转视图训练，是提升少样本遥感场景分类的简洁有效方案；但适用性受基类规模限制。

title: Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)
comment: 6 pages, including references. Accepted at the International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Secure Communication Systems (ICICSCS 2026)
summary: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.

AI.tldr: LiteMed-ViT：用卷积主干+双token蒸馏训练0.234M参数的轻量ViT，在MedMNIST上与紧凑CNN比较精度与鲁棒性，并刻画性能 plateau 条件。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上CNN过重、ViT缺少归纳偏置且需大数据；探索CNN教师→轻量ViT学生的跨架构双token蒸馏在医学影像上的极限。
AI.method: 双token ViT（含卷积stem）+ 类别平衡蒸馏目标；ResNet18为教师；在BloodMNIST/PathMNIST/DermaMNIST上用三个紧凑CNN基线与MedMNIST-C腐蚀鲁棒性对比，并分析输入分辨率、教师强度与置信度校准的影响。
AI.result: 0.234M参数（0.89MB），比ResNet18少47.8倍；BloodMNIST 95.05%、PathMNIST 89.15%超基线；腐蚀鲁棒性不劣于紧凑CNN；DermaMNIST平衡精度落后最强CNN至多1.9点，提高分辨率至224无增益（ResNet18提升12.6点），更强教师不带来更准学生，过自信教师需校准。
AI.conclusion: 跨架构双token蒸馏可在极小模型上逼近甚至超越紧凑CNN，但受限于数据模态与类别不平衡的特定情形，教师质量与校准是不可忽视的瓶颈。

title: Optimizing Physical Neural Networks through Device Variable Selection
summary: Physical neural networks (PNNs) leverage device physics in electronics, optics, and related domains to enable energy-efficient neural networks. Broken-isomorphism PNNs replace linear operations with multivariate physical transformations, modifying how input signals are mapped to device variables. We exploit network architectures emerging from these mappings by treating the routing between signals and input variables of physical devices as trainable parameters. This approach expands device-level tunability of the physical transformations while, at the system level, demonstrating improved expressivity of PNNs with negligible additional inference overhead. This discrete routing is optimized by training a categorical distribution using Gumbel-Softmax reparametrization. We evaluate this approach using experimentally calibrated differentiable models of multivariate electronic RNPUs for MNIST and CIFAR-10 classification. Using variable selection, we improve the MNIST classification accuracy for a small CNN model from 94.5% to 96.9% and the accuracy of CIFAR-10 from 62.8% to 68.0%. Our method uniquely leverages the induced biases of broken-isomorphism PNN architectures, paving the way towards more efficient physics-based neural network inference.

AI.tldr: 将物理神经网络中信号与器件输入变量之间的离散路由作为可训练参数，用Gumbel-Softmax训练类别分布，提升破坏同构PNN的表达力。
AI.motivation: 破坏同构（broken-isomorphism）PNN用多变量物理变换替代线性运算，改变了输入信号到器件变量的映射方式，但器件层面可调性未被充分利用。
AI.method: 把信号到多变量电子RNPU输入变量的路由视为可训练离散参数，通过Gumbel-Softmax重参数化训练类别分布来优化变量选择，在系统层面仅引入极少的推理开销。
AI.result: 基于经实验标定的多变量电子RNPU可微模型，在MNIST上小CNN准确率由94.5%提升至96.9%，CIFAR-10由62.8%提升至68.0%。
AI.conclusion: 方法利用破坏同构PNN架构的归纳偏置，为更高效的物理基神经网络推理提供路径；但仅限分类仿真验证，缺乏硬件实测与更广泛任务。

title: Patch-Derived or Register Tokens? Comparing Variable-Length Image Tokenizers
summary: Image tokenizers convert pixels into compact latent sequences for efficient generative modeling. Most approaches arrange latents on a downsampled two-dimensional grid, tying sequence length to image resolution. We compare two variable-length strategies: computationally efficient patch-derived tokens, which inherit explicit spatial organization, and more demanding register tokens, which have no predefined spatial layout. Our reconstruction results reveal that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, whereas register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction quality at intermediate budgets. At high token budgets, both approaches achieve similar reconstruction quality. For downstream generative tasks, register tokens outperform patch-derived tokens. Adding representation alignment with external pretrained visual encoders substantially improves the generative performance of patch-derived tokens, allowing them to match or outperform register tokens depending on the token budget. We further find that both approaches learn spatially localized representations. Patch-derived tokens largely retain their explicitly imposed spatial organization, while register tokens develop an implicit two-dimensional spatial structure despite having no predefined layout. Representation alignment reduces this spatial organizational constraint, enabling individual tokens to exert a stronger non-local influence.

AI.tldr: 比较两种变长图像tokenizer（patch派生token vs register token）在重建与生成上的表现，并发现表征对齐可弥补patch token的生成劣势。
AI.motivation: 多数tokenizer在降采样2D网格上排布latent，使序列长度与图像分辨率耦合。需要变长策略实现高效生成建模，但patch派生token（有显式空间结构）与register token（无预设空间布局）孰优孰劣尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对比实验：patch派生token（计算高效、继承显式空间组织）与register token（计算开销更大、无空间布局）两种变长策略；在不同token预算下评估重建质量与下游生成性能；并引入与外部预训练视觉编码器的表征对齐（REPA式）作为改进手段；分析两者的空间局部化特性及token的非局部影响。
AI.result: 极端压缩下patch派生token重建显著更好；中等预算下register token重建略优；高预算下两者相近。下游生成任务中register token优于patch派生token。加入表征对齐后patch派生token生成性能大幅提升，可追平甚至超越register token。两者均学到空间局部化表征：patch token基本保留显式空间组织，register token自发形成隐式2D空间结构；表征对齐削弱这种空间组织约束，使单个token产生更强的非局部影响。
AI.conclusion: patch派生与register token各有所长，表征对齐是关键调节手段，可在保持空间结构优势的同时获得强生成性能；tokenizer设计应在显式空间归纳偏置与表征灵活性之间权衡。

title: MOON: Learning When to Forget and How to Move On in Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) policies act on their visual history, and an incorrect action can take them off the instructed route. Paired interventions on four VLN policies show that clearing the history doubles pooled success at the onset of a deviation but lowers it on route, while later in a deviation, removing only the off-route frames helps much less. After a deviation, the retained history keeps the policy from turning where a turn is needed, which we call behavioral inertia. We propose MOON, a framework that equips a frozen VLN policy with two lightweight modules, adding less than 1% of its parameters. A deviation judge decides when to forget, raising an alarm that clears the history when it predicts that the agent is off route. A recovery policy, trained with GRPO from alarm states, learns how to move on, turning more of the successes found only by sampling into a single greedy rollout. Experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE show that MOON reaches the highest R2R-CE success rate among the compared methods and raises the success rate of its frozen base by 5.2 and 6.0 points, and an ablation with a random trigger indicates that this gain depends on when the history is cleared. Without retraining, MOON also improves zero-shot object-goal navigation on HM3D-OVON. Together, these results suggest that deviation recovery depends on knowing when to forget, not only how to act. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MOON为冻结的VLN策略外挂两个轻量模块（<1%参数）：偏离判别器在预测离开路线时清空视觉历史，GRPO训练的恢复策略在告警状态下学会继续前进，从而把"采样才能得到的成功"转为单次贪心rollout成功。
AI.motivation: VLN策略基于视觉历史行动，一次错误动作会让智能体偏离指令路线；作者发现一个关键现象：偏离初期清空历史能显著提升成功，而在路线上清空反而有害；偏离后期仅删除离路帧收效甚微——说明"何时遗忘"比"如何遗忘/如何行动"更关键，故提出"行为惯性"概念。
AI.method: 对四个VLN策略做配对干预实验以定位历史的影响；提出MOON框架：冻结基座策略，增加(1)偏离判别器（deviation judge），判定离线时触发告警并清空历史；(2)恢复策略，以告警状态为起点用GRPO训练，学习脱离偏离后的转向与推进行为。另做随机触发消融验证依赖"何时清空"。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE与RxR-CE上，MOON取得对比方法中最高的R2R-CE成功率，并把冻结基座的成功率分别提升5.2与6.0个点；随机触发消融表明增益依赖清空历史的时机；无需重训练即在HM3D-OVON零样本目标导航上亦有提升；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 偏离恢复的关键在于"知道何时遗忘"，而不仅是"如何行动"。轻量外挂模块即可显著改善冻结VLN策略，并具备跨任务（对象目标导航）的泛化性。

title: Cross-View and Cross-Time Tracking of Crack Evolution in Concrete
summary: Crack propagation provides richer information than static crack observations for evaluating structural conditions of concrete infrastructure and planning maintenance strategies. Unlike static crack detection, which can now be largely automated using computer vision, vision-based crack tracking is a coupled cross-view and cross-time problem: the same physical crack must retain its identity as camera viewpoints change, while newly developed growth must be distinguished from existing crack segments in a unified reference view. Existing segmentation and 3D reconstruction methods can recover crack masks or scene geometry, but they do not preserve crack identity across views or quantify temporal extension. To address this gap, this study formulates crack growth monitoring as a cross-view and cross-time crack-instance tracking task and proposes a geometry-assisted, morphology-aware framework. The framework first uses image-based geometric registration to align observations from different viewpoints into a shared structural reference, then applies morphology-aware instantiation to assign physically interpretable crack identities, and finally performs temporal mapping in the unified view to distinguish newly developed growth from existing crack segments. To enable evaluation, a temporally annotated dataset was established and used, covering three representative cracking scenarios: single dominant crack propagation, mixed-mode branching, and multiple-crack interaction, with pixel-level masks and cross-time instance labels. Experimental results show that the proposed framework can establish loose cross-view identity correspondence under changing viewpoints, while strict spatial overlap and growth localization remain limited by early micro-crack segmentability and projection drift, highlighting directions for future crack-monitoring research.

AI.tldr: 提出几何辅助、形态感知的跨视角跨时序裂缝实例跟踪框架，用图像几何配准统一参考视角、基于形态学的实例化赋予裂缝身份、在统一视图中时序映射区分新生扩展与既有裂缝，并构建含三类开裂场景的像素级+跨时实例标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 裂缝扩展比静态裂缝观测提供更丰富的结构状况信息，但现有分割与三维重建方法只能恢复裂缝掩码或场景几何，无法在不同视角间保持同一裂缝的身份，也无法量化时序扩展量；视-based裂缝跟踪本质上是跨视角与跨时间的耦合问题。
AI.method: 框架分三步：1）基于图像的几何配准，将不同视角观测对齐到共享的结构参考系；2）形态感知实例化，为裂缝分配具有物理可解释性的身份；3）统一视图中的时序映射，区分新生成的扩展段与既有裂缝段。评估使用自建时序标注数据集，覆盖单一主裂缝扩展、混合模式分叉、多裂缝相互作用三类场景，含像素级掩码与跨时实例标签。
AI.result: 实验表明框架可在视角变化下建立宽松的跨视角身份对应关系；但严格空间重叠与扩展定位精度受限于早期微裂缝的可分割性与投影漂移，效果仍然有限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将裂缝扩展监测形式化为跨视角跨时序实例跟踪任务，验证了该任务设定的可行性与主要瓶颈（微裂缝可分割性、投影漂移），为后续裂缝监测研究指出方向；属土木结构健康监测领域的专用视觉方法，尚缺少高精度定量突破。

title: Cross-Scale Sparse Attention for Referring Segmentation in Remote Sensing
summary: High-resolution remote sensing (RS) imagery provides fine spatial detail over large areas, making it essential for fine-grained scene understanding. Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) aims to segment regions described by natural language, yet many existing methods rely on sequential alignment--fusion pipelines with limited joint modeling of cross-scale visual hierarchies and linguistic dependencies. Moreover, dense attention mechanisms struggle with the sparsity and wide spatial dispersion of RS targets, while current datasets offer limited structured evaluation of multi-target references, multi-hop relational reasoning, and multi-granularity descriptions, limiting both model development and evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a Cross-Scale Sparse Attention Model (CSSAM), which aligns multiscale visual features with complex referring expressions through two key modules. The Cross-scale Modality-aligned Fusion Module (CMFM) performs unified cross-scale cross-modal fusion, while the Dynamic Multimodal Sparse Hybrid Attention (DMSHA) selectively attends to informative visual--textual tokens, reducing dense visual interactions. Furthermore, we introduce M$^{3}$RRSIS-D, a RRSIS dataset explicitly designed around three core reasoning dimensions: multi-target (M$^{1}$), reference-dependent multi-hop (M$^{2}$), and multi-granularity (M$^{3}$) expressions. Extensive experiments on M$^{3}$RRSIS-D and two public RRSIS benchmarks demonstrate that CSSAM achieves competitive performance across accuracy, fine-grained reasoning, and high-IoU localization metrics, validating its effectiveness for complex semantic reasoning in realistic RS scenarios. Code, dataset, and model weights will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出跨尺度稀疏注意模型CSSAM，用跨尺度模态对齐融合模块(CMFM)与动态多模态稀疏混合注意(DMSHA)对齐多尺度视觉特征与指代表达，并发布M3RRSIS-D数据集（多目标/多跳推理/多粒度三维度评测）。
AI.motivation: 现有RRSIS方法多为串行对齐-融合管线，跨尺度视觉层级与语言依赖的联合建模不足；稠密注意力难以应对遥感目标稀疏、空间分散的特点；现有数据集缺乏对多目标指代、多跳关系推理与多粒度描述的结构化评测。
AI.method: CSSAM：CMFM执行统一的跨尺度跨模态融合；DMSHA对信息量高的视觉-文本token做选择性稀疏注意，减少稠密视觉交互。配套构建M3RRSIS-D数据集，围绕多目标(M1)、指代依赖多跳(M2)、多粒度(M3)三类表达设计。
AI.result: 在M3RRSIS-D及两个公开RRSIS基准上，CSSAM在准确率、细粒度推理与高IoU定位指标上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度稀疏注意与结构化多维度数据集可提升遥感指代分割的复杂语义推理能力，适用于真实遥感场景。

title: End-to-end prostate lesion segmentation and detection from undersampled diffusion-weighted MRI
summary: Automated prostate lesion detection from diffusion-weighted MR imaging (DWI) conventionally relies on reconstructed images and does not fully use all acquisition information. We present an end-to-end network that uses complex multicoil DWI data and coil sensitivity information for prostate lesion segmentation. We included 269 fastMRI prostate examinations with additional voxel-level lesion annotations. Of these, 64 examinations contained PIRADS 4 or 5 lesions. The proposed network, VarNet-Seg, consists of a k-space variational network (VarNet) with six variational cascades and an image-space 3D segmentation U-Net. Comparator models used the same segmentation architecture with fully coil-combined images (CC-Seg), fixed root-sum-of-squares reconstruction (RSS-Seg), or fixed SENSE reconstruction (SENSE-Seg). We performed ablations with end-to-end training and data consistency (DC) enabled or disabled. We evaluated lesion segmentation using Dice and patient-level detection using AUROC in five-fold cross-validation with full sampling, simulated undersampling, added noise, or both. VarNet-Seg achieved the highest Dice at every undersampling level. At eight-fold acceleration, Dice was 0.22 for VarNet-Seg, 0.14 for SENSE-Seg and 0.16 for VarNet-Seg (no DC). The paired difference from SENSE-Seg was 0.08 (95% CI, 0.04-0.11). With full sampling, VarNet-Seg and RSS-Seg performed similarly (0.40 vs 0.39). Patient-level AUROC decreased from 0.75 with full sampling to 0.63 at eight-fold acceleration; corresponding RSS-Seg AUROCs were 0.76 and 0.64. The proposed multicoil network improved prostate lesion segmentation under simulated undersampling compared to conventional models. Matched ablations supported contributions from both end-to-end training and data consistency. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether this approach can be used clinically in accelerated prostate DWI.

AI.tldr: 提出VarNet-Seg：端到端联合k空间变分网络（6级cascade）与3D分割U-Net，直接用多线圈复数DWI数据与线圈敏感度做前列腺病灶分割，在模拟加速下优于CC/RSS/SENSE等传统重建后分割方案。
AI.motivation: 常规DWI前列腺病灶自动检测依赖已重建图像，丢弃了多线圈采集的原始复数信息，且在加速采样下性能明显下降；作者希望把重建与分割联合优化以充分复用采集信息。
AI.method: 使用269例fastMRI前列腺检查（含体素级病灶标注，64例含PIRADS 4/5病灶），构建VarNet-Seg：k空间变分网络（6个variational cascade）+图像域3D分割U-Net，端到端训练并引入数据一致性（DC）。对照为相同分割骨干但输入全线圈合并图（CC-Seg）、固定RSS重建（RSS-Seg）、固定SENSE重建（SENSE-Seg），并做端到端训练/DC的开/关消融；五折交叉验证，在全采样、模拟欠采样、加噪及二者叠加条件下用Dice和患者级AUROC评估。
AI.result: VarNet-Seg在所有欠采样倍率下Dice最高；8倍加速时Dice为0.22，SENSE-Seg为0.14，无DC的VarNet-Seg为0.16，与SENSE-Seg配对差0.08（95% CI 0.04–0.11）。全采样时VarNet-Seg与RSS-Seg接近（0.40 vs 0.39）。患者级AUROC从全采样0.75降至8倍加速0.63，RSS-Seg相应为0.76与0.64。
AI.conclusion: 多线圈端到端网络在模拟欠采样条件下改善前列腺病灶分割，消融表明端到端训练与数据一致性各有贡献；但绝对Dice仍低（≤0.40），且仅为回顾性模拟实验，需前瞻性验证才能确定临床可用性。

title: GeoLift: Grounding Video Spatial Reasoning in Explicit 3D Maps
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Xinglin Li and TingTing Long contributed equally. Jin Xie is the corresponding author
summary: Video spatial reasoning requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to understand how objects are arranged and related across viewpoints. While these models can recognize objects in individual frames, integrating these observations to solve complex spatial tasks remains challenging. We examine route planning as a representative task and observe that existing models become substantially less accurate as the number of required turns increases, with several models achieving accuracy close to random guessing on routes requiring three or more turns. This finding suggests that recognizing landmarks alone is insufficient: models must also connect observations across viewpoints and track how landmarks are arranged in a shared space. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GeoLift, a training-free framework that uses feed-forward 3D reconstruction to map objects detected in individual frames into a shared metric 3D scene. GeoLift combines a frozen MLLM for 2D grounding with pretrained geometry models for scene reconstruction. It then uses shared geometric regions, called superpoints, to associate observations of the same object across views without a learned matcher. The reconstructed 3D map enables explicit computation of spatial relations and multistep routes, and provides geometric evidence for estimating distances and sizes. With all model weights frozen, GeoLift improves Qwen3-VL-4B's average score on VSI-Bench from 55.4% to 64.1%, including an increase in route-planning accuracy from 30.9% to 53.6%, and achieves 59.8% accuracy on MindCube. These results show that connecting frame-level object grounding through a shared 3D map can improve complex spatial reasoning without task-specific training.

AI.tldr: GeoLift：免训练框架，用前馈3D重建把逐帧检测到的物体映射到统一度量3D场景，借助superpoints跨视角关联同一物体，从而显式计算空间关系与多步路线，显著提升MLLM的路线规划能力。
AI.motivation: MLLM能识别单帧物体，但随转弯数增加，路线规划精度急剧下降（≥3个转弯接近随机猜测），说明仅靠地标识别不足，必须跨视角关联并追踪地标在共享空间中的布局。
AI.method: 以路线规划为代表任务：冻结MLLM做2D grounding，联合预训练几何模型做前馈3D重建，将逐帧观测映射进共享度量3D场景；用共享几何区域（superpoints）在无需学习匹配器的情况下关联跨视角同一物体；在重建3D图上显式计算空间关系、多步路线及距离/尺度估计。
AI.result: 全权重冻结下，Qwen3-VL-4B在VSI-Bench平均分从55.4%升至64.1%，路线规划从30.9%升至53.6%；MindCube上达59.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享3D地图串联帧级物体grounding，可在无任务特定训练的情况下提升复杂空间推理，验证了几何显式表征对MLLM空间推理的价值。

title: What Remains OOD? OODConceptBench for Open-World Concept Recognition in Vision-Language Models
summary: In the era of large-scale pretrained models, zero-shot generalization has increasingly blurred the boundary between known and unknown concepts. However, current evaluations do not directly reveal which open-world concepts different vision-language models can recognize. To study this problem, we introduce OODConceptBench, a hierarchical benchmark for open-world concept recognition on image-concept pairs. The full benchmark set (L1) contains 30,752 images, and the harder subset (L2) contains 14,285 images. The benchmark covers 560 concept phrases across seven open-world categories. We evaluate 37 vision-language models across release year, model family, and variant. We obtain three main findings. First, target-concept recognition is lower on L2 than on L1 across all 37 evaluated models. Second, later-released models do not necessarily achieve stronger open-world concept recognition. Third, an increase in overall recognition does not imply consistent improvement across all benchmark categories. Together, these results show that OOD remains a challenge even in the era of large-scale vision-language pretraining.

AI.tldr: OODConceptBench：面向开放世界概念识别的层次化图像-概念对基准，L1含30,752张图，L2（更难子集）含14,285张图，覆盖7类开放世界类别共560个概念短语，评测37个视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练时代零样本泛化模糊了已知/未知概念边界，现有评测无法直接揭示不同视觉语言模型究竟能识别哪些开放世界概念，缺乏对OOD概念识别能力的直接、层次化度量。
AI.method: 构建层次化开放世界概念识别基准（图像-概念对匹配任务）：全量集L1（30,752图）与更难子集L2（14,285图），7类开放世界类别、560个概念短语；按发布年份、模型家族、变体三个维度系统评测37个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：(1) 全部37个模型在L2上的目标概念识别率均低于L1；(2) 更晚发布的模型未必具备更强的开放世界概念识别能力；(3) 整体识别率提升并不意味着各基准类别上的一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 即便在大规模视觉-语言预训练时代，开放世界OOD概念识别仍是未解决的挑战，模型能力提升呈现不均衡、非单调的特性。

title: WorldFailBench: Do World Models Understand Policy Failures?
summary: Robot policy evaluation informs deployment decisions and policy improvement, but physical testing and simulator preparation require substantial effort. World models offer a complementary route through closed-loop interaction in generated environments. Recent benchmarks have demonstrated their potential as policy evaluators through outcome-based evaluation (i.e., assessing task success or failure). However, such evaluation does not establish whether world models faithfully simulate how policies fail. Misrepresenting failures can lead to incorrect diagnoses of policy weaknesses and make policies appear ready for deployment even when small scene changes cause them to fail. We therefore ask: do world models faithfully simulate how and at which stages policies fail, and under what conditions they transition from success to failure? To answer this question, we introduce WorldFailBench with three evaluation tasks. Failure reason tests whether models reproduce the observable errors policies make. Failure stage assesses whether failures concentrate at the same stages of full-task execution. Failure boundary examines whether models reproduce the conditions under which policies transition from success to failure under controlled scene changes in simulation. The benchmark covers manipulation tasks in the LIBERO and RoboTwin simulation environments and real-world manipulation tasks performed by the G1 humanoid robot. Experiments across seven world models reveal substantial gaps in their understanding of policy failures, providing guidance for developing more reliable world models for policy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldFailBench，从"失败原因""失败阶段""失败边界"三方面检验世界模型是否忠实模拟策略失败，覆盖 LIBERO、RoboTwin 与 G1 人形真机任务，评估七个世界模型。
AI.motivation: 世界模型可作策略评估器，但现有基准只做结果式（成功/失败）判断，无法验证其是否忠实再现策略"如何失败、何时失败、在何种条件下由成功转为失败"。失真会掩盖策略弱点，导致误判可部署性。
AI.method: 构建三项诊断任务：(1) failure reason—是否复现策略可观测的错误行为；(2) failure stage—失败是否集中在全任务执行的相同阶段；(3) failure boundary—在仿真受控场景扰动下，是否复现成功→失败的转变条件。场景含 LIBERO、RoboTwin 操作任务及 G1 人形真机操作任务；对七个世界模型统一评估。
AI.result: 七个世界模型在理解策略失败方面普遍存在显著差距，缺乏对失败机理、阶段定位与失败边界的可靠刻画。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型作为策略评估器仍不可靠，结果式评估不足；该基准为诊断失败提供细粒度工具，并为开发更可信的世界模型指明方向。

title: Distilling Dense Trajectory Teachers For Large-Motion Video World Models
summary: Video world models are expected to generate videos that accurately follow specified camera trajectories while maintaining consistent 3D structures. However, existing models are predominantly trained on densely sampled videos with small inter-frame camera motions. When applied to sparse, large step trajectories, they often produce frozen frames, inaccurate camera motion, and severe geometric drift. We attribute this degradation to a mismatch between the gradual viewpoint transitions seen during training and the large viewpoint changes required at inference time. To address this problem, we propose Dense Trajectory Teacher Distillation (DTTD), a post-training framework that transfers a model's generation capability from dense trajectories to large camera motions. Given a sparse trajectory, DTTD interpolates additional camera poses to construct a dense trajectory covering the same path. The frozen base model then generates reliable teacher videos along this familiar dense trajectory, and pose aligned teacher observations are used to evaluate candidate videos generated under the original sparse trajectory. In this way, the model serves as its own generation teacher, requiring neither additional video data nor a stronger external video generator. We further combine dense teacher supervision with geometry aware rewards that assess cross frame consistency and camera trajectory following, and use the resulting preferences for offline preference optimization. To stably expand the model's motion range, we introduce a cumulative curriculum that progressively incorporates larger motion steps while retaining simpler trajectories to reduce capability forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出DTTD后训练框架：用插值得到的稠密相机轨迹让冻结基座模型充当"自身教师"，配合几何感知奖励做离线偏好优化，并用累积课程逐步扩展相机运动范围。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型训练时仅见帧间小位移的稠密轨迹，推理时面对稀疏大跨度轨迹会出现帧冻结、相机运动不准和严重几何漂移；根源是训练（渐变视角）与推理（大视角变化）的分布不匹配。
AI.method: 给定稀疏轨迹，插值出覆盖同一路径的稠密位姿序列，冻结基座模型沿稠密轨迹生成"教师视频"；再用位姿对齐的教师观测评估原始稀疏轨迹下的候选视频，构成自蒸馏偏好数据。结合跨帧一致性与轨迹跟随的几何感知奖励构建偏好对，做离线偏好优化；并采用累积课程，逐步纳入更大运动步长同时保留简单轨迹以抑制能力遗忘。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；声称可缓解稀疏大跨度轨迹下的冻结帧、相机运动失真与几何漂移，且无需额外视频数据或更强外部生成器。
AI.conclusion: "模型自任教师"的轨迹插值蒸馏+偏好优化为扩展世界模型的相机运动范围提供了数据免费、依赖极少的后训练方案；实际效果需依赖实验部分的定量与定性证据。

title: Memory-Aware Keyframe Management for Dense Maps on Memory-Constrained Robots
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Running a language model and a dense 3D map on one device means the two share one memory, and exceeding its limit is an out-of-memory failure. Map systems that keep a bounded working set bound it by a count of keyframes, but the memory one keyframe occupies varies widely with what it carries, so a count does not control what the working set occupies. The unit of admission is as poorly matched, since a radius around the pose, a fixed cell, or the graph neighbors of the last matched keyframe all move parts of the map that are not needed. We therefore propose two decisions. First, the memory the resident map uses is bounded directly, and the cost of every admission is known before any data is read, from per-keyframe resident sizes computed offline and carried with the map. Second, keyframes are admitted and released at a semantic spatial unit, the rooms and corridors of the building, so that the robot holds the zone it occupies together with the zone it is about to enter while the zones it has passed are released. Every admission measures the resident total, makes room, and only then reads, so the budget is never overshot. On two NVIDIA Jetson boards the budget holds in every run and the model gives up at most 0.8 percent of its throughput, whereas without it the operating system kills the model or the map. Under that budget, and over the environments evaluated, admission by semantic zone localizes 6-9 points more of the query frames than a geometric partition of matched zone count and about twice as much as the retrieval of RTAB-Map, at a lower ATE. Bounding memory lets the map and the model coexist, and moving the map in semantic zones makes the bounded map usable.

AI.tldr: 提出按内存预算而非关键帧数量管理地图工作集，并以语义空间单元（房间、走廊）为粒度进行关键帧准入/释放，使大语言模型与稠密3D地图在同一设备上共存。
AI.motivation: 在单设备上同时运行语言模型与稠密3D地图时，共享内存超限即OOM。现有系统按关键帧数量限制工作集，但单帧占用内存差异大，数量无法控制实际占用；且以位姿半径、固定栅格或图邻居为准入单位，会引入大量无用数据。
AI.method: 1) 直接对常驻地图内存设定硬预算，每个关键帧的常驻大小离线计算并随地图携带，使准入代价在读取数据前已知；2) 以语义空间单元（房间/走廊）为粒度准入与释放关键帧，机器人保留当前区域与即将进入区域，释放已通过区域；3) 每次准入先测量常驻总量、腾出空间再读取，保证不超预算。
AI.result: 在两块NVIDIA Jetson上，预算在所有运行中均未超限，模型吞吐损失最多0.8%；无预算时系统会杀死模型或地图。在该预算下，语义分区准入的查询帧定位成功率比相同匹配区域数的几何分区高6–9个百分点，约为RTAB-Map检索的两倍，且ATE更低。
AI.conclusion: 内存上界约束使地图与大模型得以共存，而按语义区域搬移地图则使这一有界地图真正可用；二者结合构成了端侧具身系统可行的资源管理方案。

title: CADonatello: Towards Real-World Multi-Part 3D CAD Reconstruction
summary: Existing methods for CAD reconstruction from 3D scans achieve strong performance on standard benchmarks, yet their effectiveness often degrades in real-world scenarios where objects consist of multiple parts and scan artifacts such as noise. A key reason is that current CAD reconstruction datasets predominantly contain single-part models and clean geometric inputs, limiting the ability of learned models to generalize to realistic settings. In this work, we introduce CADonatello, a part-aware framework for reconstructing parametric CAD models from real-world 3D scans. Our approach first decomposes the input geometry into structurally meaningful components using a foundation-scale 3D part segmentation model, and then reconstructs each component independently through a cross-section-driven pipeline that performs sketch parameterization followed by an extrusion. To improve the robustness of sketch parameterization to scan-derived cross-sections, we further introduce CC3D Cross-Sections, a dataset of paired rasterized cross-section images from realistic scans and their corresponding parametric sketches derived from aligned CAD models. This dataset enables effective domain adaptation from clean CAD sketch images to scan-derived cross-section images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach improves generalization to noisy scans and enables reliable reconstruction of complex multi-part objects across multiple real-world CAD reverse engineering benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CADonatello：先用法线/部件分割基础模型将真实扫描分解为结构部件，再逐部件通过"截面驱动"流程做草图参数化+拉伸重建参数化CAD；并发布CC3D Cross-Sections成对数据集（扫描截面图↔对齐CAD参数草图）用于域适应。
AI.motivation: 现有3D扫描逆向CAD重建方法在标准benchmark上表现好，但真实场景中多部件、含噪声的扫描使性能退化；根因是现有CAD重建数据集以单部件、干净几何为主，模型难以泛化到真实设置。
AI.method: 1) 用foundation-scale 3D部件分割模型将输入几何分解为结构上有意义的部件；2) 对每个部件独立重建：截面驱动流水线依次做草图参数化与拉伸(extrusion)；3) 构建CC3D Cross-Sections数据集，包含真实扫描的栅格化截面图像与来自对齐CAD模型的参数化草图配对，实现从干净CAD草图图像到扫描截面图像的域适应以提升参数化鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界CAD逆向工程benchmark上，方法对含噪扫描的泛化性提升，并能可靠重建复杂多部件物体（摘要为定性表述，未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 将部件级分解与截面驱动的草图-拉伸参数化结合，并通过配对域适应数据缓解扫描域与CAD域之间的差距，为真实扫描下的多部件参数化CAD重建提供了可行框架。

title: ZoomSEM: accelerating large-scale brain connectomics with intelligent SEM super-resolution
summary: Serial electron microscopy (EM) is essential for large-volume biological imaging and connectomics, yet its throughput remains a major bottleneck, with cubic-millimeter-scale brain imaging requiring months or years. Existing deep learning-based EM super-resolution methods are limited to small upscaling factors or rely on synthetic data, offering modest acceleration and limited practical impact. We introduce ZoomSEM, a deep learning-based super-resolution method to dramatically accelerate SEM imaging. Trained on real low- and high-resolution scanning electron microscopy (SEM) pairs, ZoomSEM enables reliable recovery of 4$\times$, 8$\times$, and up to 16$\times$ higher-resolution images from fast low-resolution scans while preserving fine neuronal structures critical for connectomic analysis, achieving up to 30-fold effective acceleration. Extensive experiments across datasets of diverse biological samples demonstrate robust generalization under realistic low-resolution acquisition. This advance enables high-resolution, large-volume serial EM imaging at unprecedented speed, poised to transform connectomics and related fields.

AI.tldr: ZoomSEM 用真实低/高分辨率 SEM 配对数据训练，实现 4×/8×/16× 的 EM 图像超分，最高约 30 倍有效加速，并保持连接组学所需的精细神经元结构。
AI.motivation: 串行电子显微镜是大体积生物成像与连接组学的核心手段，但吞吐量极低，立方毫米级脑成像需数月到数年。现有深度学习超分受限于小放大倍数或依赖合成数据，实际加速有限。
AI.method: 基于真实采集的低分辨率与高分辨率 SEM 配对数据训练超分辨网络 ZoomSEM，支持 4×、8×、16× 上采样，在快速低分辨率扫描输入下重建高分辨率图像。
AI.result: 在多种生物样本数据集上验证，可在真实低分辨采集条件下稳健泛化，最高实现约 30 倍有效成像加速，同时保留连接组分析关键的精细结构。
AI.conclusion: 为高通量、大体积串行 EM 成像提供可行路径，有望推动连接组学及相关领域效率提升。

title: UltraFlash: Accelerating Megapixel Visual Synthesis
summary: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.

AI.tldr: UltraFlash 针对级联扩散超高清合成中的 VAE 像素空间转换瓶颈，提出 Latent Hyperloop（学习潜空间捷径替代 decode-resize-encode）与 Sparse Patch-based Decoding（复用 GroupNorm 统计量、减小重叠），将 4K 生成延迟降低约 2 倍并提升画质。
AI.motivation: 百万像素级视觉合成的级联流程中，每个细化阶段都要做像素空间分辨率转换（潜变量解码→RGB 缩放→再编码），最终重建还需带密集重叠的逐块解码。以往加速工作主要压缩去噪开销，而这一反复穿过 VAE 的像素空间转换开销被忽视，却相当可观。
AI.method: 1) Latent Hyperloop：用学习到的潜空间映射近似 decode-resize-encode 变换，跳过中间 RGB 往返，避免重复 VAE 编解码；2) Sparse Patch-based Decoding：分析块间接缝源于 GroupNorm 统计不一致，通过跨块缓存并复用统计量，使稀疏解码仅需很小重叠即可消缝。
AI.result: 集成到 SOTA 级联基线后，4K 生成延迟约降低 2 倍，同时图像质量指标改善（无接缝伪影）。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间转换是级联高分辨率扩散中可独立优化的效率瓶颈，优化它不仅提速还能保真，为快速高质量百万像素视觉合成提供了一条有效路径。属于生成效率工程优化，与具身/3D 重建等核心方向关联较弱。

title: Replicate What Varies: Resource Sharing for Domain-Randomized Embodied Simulation
summary: Simulation provides a low-cost sandbox where embodied agents can attempt tasks, observe outcomes, and learn from experience. Running many diverse simulation environments concurrently can consume substantial CPU and GPU memory because independently constructed scenes duplicate resources that remain unchanged across instances. We present Patchwork, a resource-sharing system for domain-randomized simulation, built around the representation $E=T+\Delta$: a shared template contains common resources, and a patch records the mutations needed to construct a target environment. Patchwork separates randomization sampling from replay and selects reusable templates together with patches that preserve each target environment's intended configuration. Its layered runtime shares compiled model structure and immutable assets while keeping mutable parameters and simulation state private to each instance. We implement Patchwork on robosuite and MuJoCo and evaluate it on LIBERO-plus and RoboCasa365 workloads. At 32 replicas, shared-template execution reduces CPU RSS by 88-92% relative to process-per-environment execution. Controlled experiments show how sharing shifts memory growth toward template diversity and unique asset content rather than instance count, within the supported sharing boundaries.

AI.tldr: Patchwork：用 $E=T+\Delta$ 模板-补丁表示实现域随机化仿真的资源（内存）共享系统，在 robosuite/MuJoCo 上把 32 副本的 CPU RSS 降低 88-92%。
AI.motivation: 多环境并发仿真时，独立构建的场景重复复制了大量不变资源（编译模型结构、不可变资产），导致 CPU/GPU 内存开销高，限制了大规模域随机化与并行 rollout 的规模。
AI.method: 提出 $E=T+\Delta$ 表示：共享模板 T 存放公共资源，补丁 Δ 记录构造目标环境所需的变更；将随机化采样与重放解耦，选择可复用模板及保持目标配置语义的补丁；分层运行时共享编译模型结构与不可变资产，可变参数与仿真状态按实例私有；在 robosuite 与 MuJoCo 上实现。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-plus 与 RoboCasa365 负载上，32 副本时共享模板执行相比每环境一进程将 CPU RSS 降低 88-92%；受控实验显示内存增长主要随模板多样性与唯一资产内容上升，而非实例数量，且受支持共享边界约束。
AI.conclusion: 资源分层的模板-补丁共享可在保持域随机化配置语义的前提下大幅降低并行仿真内存，是提升仿真数据生成/Rollout 吞吐的实用基础设施。

title: HA-DiPO: Diffusion Policy Optimization for Heterogeneous Cooperative Transport
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project website: this https URL
summary: Cooperative transport with heterogeneous legged robots requires coordinating different motion capabilities while supporting an unfixed shared payload. We present HA-DiPO (Heterogeneous-Agent Diffusion Policy Optimization), a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework under centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE). The framework decouples team-level coordination from embodiment-specific motion control: at the high level, a centralized critic uses team-value estimates to jointly train independent coordination policies, aligning robot-specific action responses with a shared transport objective; at the low level, embodiment-specific robust motion policies track the coordination commands. The high-level diffusion policies offer more flexible action distributions than single-Gaussian parameterizations, allowing potentially multimodal coordination responses to be represented. The coordination policies learn from scratch through reward-driven simulator interaction without demonstrations. At execution, each robot generates coordination commands using only local robot and payload observations, without partner-state inputs or inter-robot messages. Simulation comparisons show that HA-DiPO achieves higher final mean returns and velocity-tracking success rates, as well as lower velocity errors, than the evaluated baselines. Real-world experiments further demonstrate quadrupedal-wheeled-legged and human-robot cooperative transport.

AI.tldr: HA-DiPO：CTDE 分层多智能体强化学习框架，高层用集中式 critic 与扩散策略学习异构机器人协同搬运（仅用局部观测、无通信），低层用本体特定鲁棒运动策略跟踪指令，仿真与真机验证四足-轮足、人-机器人协同搬运。
AI.motivation: 异构腿足机器人协同搬运需兼顾各机器人不同运动能力与未固定共享负载，同时要求去中心化执行（无伙伴状态与通信）下仍能形成多模态协同响应。
AI.method: CTDE 分层结构：高层集中式 critic 用 team-value 联合训练各机器人独立协同策略，采用扩散策略替代单高斯参数化以表达多模态动作分布，纯奖励驱动从零训练、无示范；低层为本体特定的鲁棒运动控制策略跟踪高层指令；执行时仅用机器人自身与负载的局部观测。
AI.result: 仿真中相较基线取得更高最终平均回报、更高速度跟踪成功率与更低速度误差；真机演示四足-轮足腿机器人与人形机器人的协同搬运。
AI.conclusion: 解耦团队级协调与本体级运动控制，配合扩散策略与去中心化局部观测执行，可有效实现异构机器人无通信协同搬运，并具备真机可行性。

title: Mix Forcing: Causal Pre-Training via Mixture Attention for Interactive World Models
summary: While interactive video world models require autoregressive generation, directly adapting pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into autoregressive ones with teacher forcing can disrupt their visual priors and degrade autoregressive generation quality. In this paper, we introduce Mix Forcing, a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models, implemented with the Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive (MoBA) attention. Mix Forcing jointly trains a video diffusion model with both teacher forcing and bidirectional training, yielding a strong causal initialization for few-step post-training. In self-attention, Mix Forcing leverages teacher forcing to learn causal next-chunk prediction for autoregressive rollout, while using bidirectional attention to preserve pretrained visual priors. To support online text interaction, Mix Forcing further adopts a chunk-wise cross-attention design that conditions each video chunk on a shared environment prompt and its own local prompt, without exposing future instructions to the current chunk. Following causal pre-training on a 14B image-to-video model, we apply consistency and distribution matching distillation to obtain a four-step autoregressive generator. Experiments on our internal benchmark and public benchmarks, including WBench and SANA-WM-Bench, show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control. Notably, our model supports high-fidelity long-horizon generation without quality degradation even over one-hour rollouts. Project page is here: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出混合因果预训练范式 Mix Forcing，配合 MoBA 注意力，将双向视频扩散模型转为交互式自回归视频世界模型，并蒸馏为四步生成器，支持一小时级长程高保真生成。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需要自回归生成，而直接把双向预训练视频扩散模型改造为 teacher forcing 自回归会破坏其视觉先验，导致生成质量下降。
AI.method: Mix Forcing 在 14B 图生视频模型上联合使用 teacher forcing 与双向训练进行因果预训练：自注意力中 teacher forcing 学习 chunk 级因果下一段预测，双向注意力保留预训练视觉先验；交叉注意力采用 chunk-wise 设计，每段以共享环境提示加自身局部提示为条件，不泄露未来指令；随后用一致性蒸馏与分布匹配蒸馏得到四步自回归生成器。
AI.result: 在内部基准及 WBench、SANA-WM-Bench 上取得最优视觉质量、及时的事件跟随与精确相机控制；在一小时以上 rollout 中保持高保真长程生成且无明显质量退化。
AI.conclusion: 混合双向与自回归注意力的因果预训练是保留视觉先验、提升交互式视频世界模型自回归生成质量的有效方案，并可蒸馏为高效的少步长程生成器。

title: Satellite-derived bathymetry of Arabian Gulf ports under leakage-free validation: a multi-site benchmark of empirical, machine-learning and deep-learning models against 285,000 multibeam soundings, with an outlook for UAE waters
summary: Satellite-derived bathymetry (SDB) is often proposed as a low-cost complement to multibeam surveys of ports, but its accuracy is seldom measured on an area the model has never seen. We test SDB in the turbid, shallow and tidal waters of the Abu Dhabi coast against 285,619 multibeam soundings from twelve surveys at six port areas, reduced to Lowest Astronomical Tide. The Stumpf ratio, the Lyzenga transform, a monotonic gradient-boosted tree model (LightGBM) and a U-Net ensemble were trained on 72 Sentinel-2 images and tested in transfer to an unseen site and with local control (about 20% of a site's soundings, spatial blocks beyond a 225 m buffer). The validation design changed the result more than the model: the same LightGBM model gave 0.57 m RMSE under a random pixel split, 1.30 m under spatial blocks and 1.66 m at an unseen site. In transfer the Stumpf ratio (1.45 m) was not beaten by LightGBM, the U-Net or Lyzenga. With local control a hybrid of the tree output and the band ratio reached 1.11 m over 0-11 m, 67% of pixels within the IHO S-44 Order 2 tolerance and a conformal 95% interval with 95% observed coverage; in clear water it reached 0.29-0.53 m. The seabed could not be read beyond 11 m, and summer images were five to six times more turbid than winter ones. ICESat-2 ATL24 agreed with the surveys to 0.25 m after a depth-dependent offset was removed. A 60 m reconnaissance mosaic of 17,200 km2 of the UAE coast, calibrated cell by cell on ICESat-2 without any vessel survey, reached 1.42 m RMSE on held-out blocks over half of the product. Sentinel-2 SDB with about a hundred control depths per image is a usable reconnaissance and change-monitoring tool in these waters to about 10 m; it does not meet S-44 Order 1 without local control, and accuracies from random splits should not be taken as operational accuracy.

AI.tldr: 用285,619个多波束测深点检验Sentinel-2卫星测深(SDB)在阿布扎比浑浊潮汐浅水区的真实泛化精度，发现验证设计比模型本身更决定结果。
AI.motivation: SDB常被宣传为港口多波束测量的低成本补充手段，但精度多在模型见过的区域评估，缺乏对未见过站点的真实迁移精度度量，也缺乏与IHO S-44规范的对照。
AI.method: 在阿布扎比6个港区12次测量、归算至最低天文潮位的285,619个多波束点作为真值；对比Stumpf波段比、Lyzenga变换、LightGBM单调梯度提升树与U-Net集成；72景Sentinel-2影像训练，分别采用随机像素划分、225 m缓冲空间块划分、未见站点迁移三种验证协议；另用ICESat-2 ATL24校正后生成17,200 km²沿岸60 m侦察镶嵌图。
AI.result: 同一LightGBM在随机划分下RMSE 0.57 m，空间块下1.30 m，未见站点下1.66 m；迁移场景中Stumpf比(1.45 m)未被LightGBM/U-Net/Lyzenga超越；有本地控制(约每景百个深度)时树模型与波段比混合达1.11 m(0–11 m)，67%像元满足S-44 Order 2，共形95%区间实测覆盖率为95%；清水区0.29–0.53 m；深于11 m不可读；夏季影像浑浊度为冬季5–6倍；仅用ICESat-2标定的镶嵌图在半数产品上held-out块RMSE 1.42 m。
AI.conclusion: Sentinel-2 SDB在约10 m以浅可作为侦察与变化监测工具，但有本地控制才可用；无本地控制时达不到S-44 Order 1；随机划分得出的精度不能当作作业精度，验证设计的影响大于模型选择。

title: Semantic-Guided Frequency Modulation for Learned Image Compression
summary: High-frequency attenuation can reduce the rate of learned image codecs but also remove object boundaries and fine detail. We propose Semantic-Guided Adaptive Latent-Frequency Modulation (SG-AFM), which uses a semantic structural prior to guide attenuation of encoder latents. SG-AFM applies a Haar wavelet transform and combines a fixed semantic-frequency multiplier with a bounded learned correction to modulate high-frequency subbands. The semantic prior is computed only at the encoder. No semantic map is transmitted, and no decoder modules are added. Across six datasets, SG-AFM reduces PSNR-based BD-rate relative to TCM by an average of 13.17%. It achieves the best BD-rate among the compared methods on ExDark, NightCity, and OnePlus, with a mean reduction of 16.80%. An ablation on OnePlus demonstrates the benefit of spatially aligned semantic guidance, and visual comparisons illustrate improved reconstruction of local structures.

AI.tldr: 提出SG-AFM：用语义结构先验引导编码器隐变量的高频衰减，通过Haar小波+固定语义频率乘子+有界学习修正调制高频子带，语义图不传输、解码器不加模块，相对TCM平均降低BD-rate 13.17%。
AI.motivation: 高频衰减能降低学习式图像编解码的计算率，但会抹除物体边界与细节。作者希望在不增加解码端负担、不传输语义图的前提下，保留结构关键的高频成分。
AI.method: 仅编码端计算语义结构先验；对编码器隐变量做Haar小波变换，对高频子带施加"固定语义-频率乘子+有界学习修正"的自适应调制（SG-AFM）。语义先验不进码流，解码器结构不变。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上相对TCM平均降低PSNR-based BD-rate 13.17%；在ExDark、NightCity、OnePlus上取得对比方法中最佳BD-rate，平均降低16.80%。OnePlus消融显示空间对齐的语义引导有效，可视化显示局部结构重建改善。
AI.conclusion: 以零码率开销、零解码器改动的语义引导高频调制实现更优的率失真权衡，尤其利于暗光/低质场景的局部结构保真。

title: Allocation Before the Clock: Graph, Set and Game Theory of Professional League of Legends Objective Setups
summary: Before every neutral objective in professional League of Legends, each team decides which of its five players walk to the pit, which hold a lane, and when to commit. The leading analysis of such setups, TAGNet for Counter-Strike 2, clusters graph-network embeddings of player positions and reads cluster win rates as tactical quality. We treat a setup as an allocation on a walled map: formations are set partitions on the lattice $\Pi_5$, control is a geodesic Voronoi split of a navigation graph, and commitment is an allocation game solved as a quantal response equilibrium priced in win probability. On all 164 games of MSI and Worlds 2025 (2,994 team-setups, minimap tracks validated against Riot positions), trailing teams leave the pit empty far more often than leading teams, by +34.8 percentage points at the first baron and +30.4 percentage points at Atakhan. Our model, HASSE-QRE, finds six setup patterns that whole-model series-bootstrap refits reproduce (ARI 0.819, comparable to 0.813 for TAGNet's $K$-Means step alone) and indicates that teams price fights, travel and committed players, not the objective itself (weight 0.018; fixing it to one costs 59.9 log-likelihood points). The equilibrium reproduces a quarter of the commitment gap, almost all of it through state variables rather than its strategic channels. Weighting a team-level contrast by exposure moves it across $p=0.05$ (0.046 against 0.052). We release the tracks, setups and code.

AI.tldr: 论文将《英雄联盟》职业比赛中争夺中立目标前的团队站位判读建模为"有墙地图上的资源分配"：队形=Π5上的集合划分，控制权=导航图上的测地Voronoi划分，投入决策=以胜率为代价的量子响应均衡博弈；提出HASSE-QRE模型并在MSI/Worlds 2025共164场比赛、2994个团队布阵上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有主流布阵分析（TAGNet，源自CS2）仅对选手位置图网络嵌入做聚类、再以簇胜率读作战术质量，缺乏对"谁去、谁守线、何时投入"这一分配决策的结构化建模；作者希望对职业LoL的中立目标前布阵给出可解释的均衡式分析框架。
AI.method: 形式化为三层结构：队形用五人间集合划分（Π5格）表示；控制用导航图上的测地Voronoi分割刻画；投入决策建模为以胜利概率为支付的分配博弈，并用分位数响应均衡（QRE）求解，得到HASSE-QRE。数据为MSI与Worlds 2025全部164场比赛、2994个团队布阵，小地图轨迹经Riot官方坐标校验；采用整模型序列bootstrap重拟合检验模式稳定性（ARI 0.819），并与TAGNet的K-Means步骤（0.813）对比。
AI.result: 落后方空pit比例显著高于领先方：第一个男爵+34.8个百分点，Atakhan+30.4个百分点；识别出6种可复现布阵模式；模型显示队伍定价的是战斗、移动与投入人数，而非目标本身（目标权重0.018，固定为1损失59.9个对数似然点）；均衡只能复现约四分之一的"投入差距"，且几乎全部经由状态变量而非策略通道；对团队级对比按暴露度加权会使显著性跨过p=0.05（0.046 vs 0.052）。作者公开轨迹、布阵与代码。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出将电竞布阵作为结构化分配博弈分析的可复现框架，实证上给出落后/领先队伍行为差异的量化描述，但也表明均衡解释力有限且结论对加权方式敏感，提示结论稳健性需谨慎对待。

title: ONOT/TONO-Print: A Paired Benchmark for Identity-Document Portrait Quality under Document Production Shift
summary: Identity-document portraits are modified during document production by printing, engraving, and integration into the document template. These transformations may change image texture, contrast, colour, and other visual properties without necessarily changing the underlying biometric or presentation information. In this work, we introduce ONOT/TONO-Print, a small paired benchmark for evaluating face-image quality models under identity-document production shift. The benchmark is based on ONOT and TONO portraits and contains synthetic variants representing five common production techniques: toner, inkjet, dye sublimation, laser engraving, and thermal transfer. A smaller physical subset contains portraits printed and scanned using inkjet and toner devices. The benchmark is used to compare the behaviour of biometric and ICAO-related face-quality components before and after production. Results show that production can introduce substantial domain shift for some quality estimators, while other models remain comparatively stable.

AI.tldr: 提出 ONOT/TONO-Print 成对基准，用五种证件生产印制工艺的合成变体（另加喷墨/激光实物子集）评估人脸图像质量模型在生产域偏移下的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 证件照在生产中被打印、刻蚀并嵌入模板，会改变纹理、对比度与颜色，但不改变生物特征信息；现有生物特征/ICAO 人脸质量评估器在真实生产位移下的行为缺乏系统评估手段。
AI.method: 基于 ONOT 与 TONO 人像构建小幅成对基准：合成模拟碳粉、喷墨、热升华、激光雕刻、热转印五种工艺；并用喷墨与碳粉设备实物打印—扫描构建更小规模物理子集，形成"生产前/生产后"成对比较。
AI.result: 对比结果显示部分质量评估器在生产位移下出现显著域偏移，另一些模型相对稳定，说明不同质量组件的鲁棒性差异明显。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为证件照生产扰动下的人脸质量模型鲁棒性提供了受控评测手段，可指导质量评估器在证件文档流水线中的选用与再校准。

title: DROA-CLIPSeg: Prompt-Guided Thin Crack Segmentation in Low-Light Conditions
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Pavement crack segmentation under low light is degraded by reduced contrast, shadows, headlight glare, joints, stains, and wet seams. Existing crack segmentation methods mostly assume good illumination. Low-light enhancement methods improve visual quality, but they do not explicitly preserve crack topology. To address these limitations, we formulate low-light crack segmentation as a degradation-aware, prompt-grounded structural defect segmentation problem and propose DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision language backbone using two lightweight modules. QKV Low-Rank Adaptation is injected into the Q/K/V projections of the vision and text encoders to improve crack-specific image text alignment without backbone fine-tuning. The proposed Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) decomposes intermediate features into a dominant crack-domain branch, which captures recurring low-light crack patterns, and an orthogonal residual branch, which preserves faint, thin, and fragmented evidence usually suppressed by noise, shadow, or over-smoothing. We also introduce CrackLingo-9K and CrackLingo-12K, text augmented versions of Crack9k and Crack12k with crack-aware prompts. Training only approximately 1.93 M parameters, corresponding to 1.3% of the full model, DROA-CLIPSeg outperforms 9 zero-shot and 4 fine-tuned vision language baselines on both splits, generalises zero-shot to MVTec AD across textures and defect morphologies, and is supported by extensive ablations. Our source code is publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DROA-CLIPSeg：冻结CLIPSeg主干，注入QKV低秩适配与域残差正交适配器，仅训练1.93M参数实现低光照路面裂缝分割，并发布带裂缝提示的CrackLingo-9K/12K文本增强数据集。
AI.motivation: 低光照路面裂缝分割受低对比度、阴影、车灯眩光、接缝与污渍影响；现有裂缝分割方法假设光照良好，低光增强方法虽提升视觉质量但不显式保持裂缝拓扑。故将问题重构为"退化感知、提示锚定"的结构性缺陷分割。
AI.method: 在冻结CLIPSeg视觉-语言主干上插入两个轻量模块：(1) QKV Low-Rank Adaptation 注入视觉与文本编码器的Q/K/V投影，提升裂缝专属图文对齐而不微调主干；(2) Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) 将中间特征分解为主导裂缝域分支（捕捉重复性低光裂缝模式）与正交残差分支（保留被噪声/阴影/过度平滑压制的细微、细薄、断裂证据）。另构建CrackLingo-9K/12K文本增强提示数据集。
AI.result: 仅训练约1.93M参数（全模型1.3%），在两个数据划分上均优于9个零样本与4个微调视觉语言基线；可零样本泛化至MVTec AD的不同纹理与缺陷形态；大量消融实验支持；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效的低光裂缝分割框架，通过低秩图文适配与正交域残差分解兼顾裂缝拓扑保持与微弱证据保留，并具备跨域零样本迁移能力。

title: UniQuery: Unifying Vision Models with a Joint Query Head for Cross-Domain Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027
summary: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR) predicts semantic attributes of individuals, such as gender, age, clothing and accessories, and its descriptions support attribute-based person retrieval and person re-identification. However, accurately recognizing fine-grained attributes across domains remains challenging due to occlusion, appearance variations, and shifts in image distributions. Ensembles of independently trained foundation encoders combine their logits with fixed fusion weights, so every attribute uses the same mix and the encoders are never trained together. We propose UniQuery, which instead jointly fine-tunes DINOv3 and CLIP for attribute-specific fusion. It combines two query heads, one for each encoder, with a joint query head whose attribute queries attend to tokens from both encoders, and the prediction is the average of the logits of the three query heads. We evaluate UniQuery on the benchmark of the UPAR Challenge 2027 at the WACV 2027 Real-World Surveillance workshop, where models are trained on PA100k, PETA and Market-1501 with a shared set of attributes. In leave-one-dataset-out experiments, UniQuery outperforms the independent ensemble in Challenge_Avg on both held-out datasets. Ablations show that learning fusion over independently trained encoders does not improve upon logit averaging in the mean over the two held-out datasets, while freezing the encoders lowers the Challenge_Avg of UniQuery. On the hidden test set of the benchmark, UniQuery achieves a Challenge_Avg of 0.8001.

AI.tldr: UniQuery jointly fine-tunes DINOv3 and CLIP with a joint query head that attends to tokens from both encoders, yielding attribute-specific fusion for cross-domain pedestrian attribute recognition; it reaches Challenge_Avg 0.8001 on the hidden UPAR Challenge test set.
AI.motivation: Pedestrian attribute recognition (PAR) underpins attribute-based retrieval and re-ID, but fine-grained attributes degrade across domains due to occlusion, appearance variation and image-distribution shift. Existing ensembles of independently trained foundation encoders apply fixed fusion weights, so all attributes share one mix and encoders are never co-trained.
AI.method: Joint fine-tuning of DINOv3 and CLIP with three query heads: one per encoder plus a joint query head whose attribute queries attend to tokens from both encoders; final logits are the average of the three heads' logits. Evaluated on the UPAR Challenge benchmark, trained on PA100k, PETA and Market-1501 with a shared attribute set under a leave-one-dataset-out protocol.
AI.result: UniQuery outperforms the independent-encoder ensemble in Challenge_Avg on both held-out datasets; joint training is necessary since learned fusion over frozen encoders does not beat logit averaging on average, and freezing encoders lowers Challenge_Avg. Hidden test Challenge_Avg = 0.8001.
AI.conclusion: Attribute-adaptive, cross-encoder query fusion with joint training is more effective than fixed-weight logit ensembling of foundation models, though gains over simple averaging are modest and validated mainly on one benchmark.

title: HARP: Handoff-Aware Recovery Planning for Active Target Acquisition in Multi-UAV Handoff
summary: Continuous aerial tracking often requires multiple drones to maintain target coverage over long periods. During handoff, the receiving UAV may lack prior target observations and must actively acquire a usable view without disrupting the sender's ongoing coverage. This work introduces HARP, a handoff-aware recovery planner that registers bounded sender predictions in the receiver's local map, distinguishes field-of-view failure from physical occlusion, and generates failure-specific yaw, translation, and parallax viewpoints. Candidate motions are checked for receiver clearance, sender-fiducial observability, protected sender--target visibility, temporal validity, and deadline compliance. When a complete trajectory cannot be admitted, HARP may execute a sampled admissible nonzero prefix and replan from updated evidence. In simulation, HARP acquired the target in all 49 standard trials and in 15 of 16 stress trials. Field trials validated HARP's recovery geometry under field-of-view limitation and environmental occlusions.

AI.tldr: HARP：面向多无人机连续空中跟踪交接的"交接感知恢复规划器"，在接收机局部地图中配准发送机有界预测，区分视场失效与物理遮挡并生成差异化视角，候选运动需通过多重安全/时效校验，无法准入完整轨迹时可执行采样得到的非零前缀并重规划。
AI.motivation: 连续空中跟踪需多机接力维持目标覆盖；交接时接收机缺乏先验目标观测，须主动获取可用视角，同时不能破坏发送机正在进行的覆盖。
AI.method: 将发送机预测以有界不确定度配准到接收机局部地图；判别失效类型为视场受限或物理遮挡；按失效类型生成偏航、平移、视差三类候选视点；对候选运动逐一校验接收机净空、发送机基准点可观测性、受保护的"发送机—目标"视线可见性、时间一致性与截止期；若无完整可行轨迹，则执行可采样的非零可行前缀并从更新证据重规划。
AI.result: 仿真中 49 次标准试验全部成功获取目标，16 次压力试验中 15 次成功；外场试验验证了在视场受限与环境遮挡下的恢复几何有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模失效模式并引入多约束采样式规划与安全前缀执行，HARP 在多机交接场景中显著提升目标重新获取的鲁棒性，并在真实环境中初步验证其恢复几何。

title: LENS: Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing for Attribute-Based Person Retrieval on Unseen Cameras
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027
summary: Attribute-based person retrieval ranks surveillance images from a binary query of semantic attributes, but mean Average Attribute Degree of Match (mADM) drops on unseen cameras as predicted probabilities shift. Common pipelines rank gallery images by their L1 distance to the query, which penalizes a confident single-attribute mismatch no more than small uncertainties across many attributes, while post-hoc recalibration fitted on source validation data fails to transfer because the per-attribute maps fitted on source data do not match those of new cameras. We propose LENS (Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing), combining fine-tuned DINOv3 and CLIP models with a distilled student. LENS regularizes mutually exclusive attribute groups with group cross-entropy in training, scores gallery images by the log-likelihood of the exact query, and smooths gallery logits over nearest neighbors using DINOv3 appearance features from the same forward pass. On held-out datasets, all three changes raise mADM: the likelihood score improves all six retrieval metrics for the main ensemble and mADM for all 48 development models, and training-free kNN smoothing improves all 46 tested development models. On the hidden test set of the UPAR 2027 benchmark, LENS reaches 68.17 mADM.

AI.tldr: LENS：用微调 DINOv3+CLIP 蒸馏学生模型做基于属性的行人检索，训练中加入互斥属性组交叉熵，检索时按查询精确对数似然打分并用同一次前向的 DINOv3 外观特征做 kNN 平滑 logits。
AI.motivation: 属性行人检索在未见相机上 mADM 下降，原因是预测概率漂移；常见 L1 距离排序无法区分"单属性高置信错配"与"多属性小幅不确定"，而基于源域验证数据的后处理重校准无法迁移到新相机。
AI.method: LENS（Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing）：集成微调 DINOv3 与 CLIP 并蒸馏为学生模型；训练时对互斥属性组施加组交叉熵正则；检索时按精确查询的对数似然对图库图像打分；利用同一次前向中的 DINOv3 外观特征在最近邻上平滑图库 logits（免训练 kNN 平滑）。
AI.result: 在留出数据集上三项改动均提升 mADM：似然打分使主集成模型全部 6 项检索指标提升、并使全部 48 个开发模型 mADM 提升；免训练 kNN 平滑使全部 46 个测试开发模型提升。UPAR 2027 隐藏测试集上达到 68.17 mADM。
AI.conclusion: 将概率合并规则（似然而非 L1）与特征邻居平滑引入属性检索，可缓解跨相机概率漂移且无需事后重校准；属基准竞赛型工作，对具身/3D 方向参考价值有限。

title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
summary: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.

AI.tldr: PreView 是一种免训练的辅助预处理器，通过裁剪放大局部视图并提供视觉/文本候选线索，提升冻结 GUI grounding 模型的点击定位精度。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding 需要在杂乱截图中定位小控件并判断指令所指目标；裁剪放大虽能暴露局部细节，但目标仍可能歧义，且直接微调 grounding 模型成本高。
AI.method: 提出 PreView，为现有 grounding 模型改进输入而不训练该模型。训练轻量辅助模型预测并精修中心点，裁剪出局部视图并放大；同时生成红色圆圈标记（含位置提示）作为视觉线索，以及描述候选控件身份或功能的文本线索。冻结的 grounding 模型基于这些输入预测最终点击。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，无需进一步训练即可提升 Qwen3-VL-2B、OS-Atlas-4B、Qwen3-VL-4B 的平均 grounding 准确率；并分析了视图/线索贡献、中心精修与视觉输入预算的影响。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的输入侧预处理是提升 GUI grounding 的有效且通用途径，可即插即用于多种 grounding 模型。

title: FreeView: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Uncurated Views
summary: Reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from uncurated image collections remains challenging due to the presence of irrelevant or non-overlapping views. Recent work has shown that feed-forward reconstruction models contain internal view-consistency signals that support distractor rejection. However, reference-conditioned filtering relies on a curated clean reference, which is not guaranteed in practical image collections. To address this limitation, we introduce FreeView, a training-free framework that jointly selects a filtering reference and rejects distractor views from an uncurated collection. FreeView leverages collection-level consensus to identify a representative view that serves as a reliable reference for filtering. It then adapts view rejection to each input collection by combining complementary visual and geometric evidence. This approach preserves useful views under substantial appearance and viewpoint variations while rejecting distractors. FreeView integrates with both VGGT and pi^3, removing the need for a manually curated reference or manual calibration of view rejection. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate high clean-view retention and distractor rejection rates, leading to reliable 3D reconstruction from uncurated views.

AI.tldr: FreeView：无需训练的框架，在无标注图像集合中联合选择过滤基准视图并剔除干扰视图，即插即用于 VGGT 与 pi^3。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈重建模型内部存在视图一致性信号可用于剔除干扰视图，但参考条件过滤依赖人工挑选的干净参考视图，实际无标注图像集合中无法保证存在这样的参考。
AI.method: 利用集合级共识（collection-level consensus）自动挑选代表性视图作为过滤参考；随后结合视觉与几何互补证据，对每个输入集合自适应地设定视图剔除阈值，无需人工校准；整体为training-free，可接入 VGGT 与 pi^3。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上取得较高的干净视图保留率与干扰视图剔除率，显著提升无标注视图下三维重建的可靠性；在较大外观与视角变化下仍保留有效视图。
AI.conclusion: 解决"参考视图不可得"这一实际瓶颈，使前馈重建流水线可在in-the-wild、未经整理的图像集合中直接使用，且有较好的通用性（跨两个骨干模型）。

title: Tracking Is Not Sensing: Artifact-Aware Thermal Video Respiration Estimation in Head-Free Marmosets
summary: Continuous physiological monitoring is essential for linking behavior, internal state, and neural activity in neuroscience and translational research. In common marmosets, a key nonhuman primate model for social neuroscience, respiratory rate provides a basic readout of arousal, stress, and physiological regulation. Contact sensors can provide accurate measurements, but they add preparation burden and may interfere with head-free behavioral protocols. Thermal video offers a noncontact alternative by capturing breathing-related temperature changes around the nose and mouth. However, in head-free marmosets, these cues are weak, localized, and easily corrupted by head motion, pose changes, and fur. Here we show that this setting exposes a broader challenge in video-based physiological sensing: visually reliable tracking does not necessarily imply physiologically valid measurement. Using synchronized thermal video and contact respiration recordings, we show that marmoset respiration is recoverable from thermal video but strongly ROI-sensitive. Under head-free motion, visually plausible nasal tracking can still produce traces inconsistent with contact respiration, demonstrating that tracking is not sensing. We therefore estimate respiratory rate from learned temporal signals extracted from thermal clips and introduce Selective Temporal Attenuation Regularization (STAR). STAR selectively attenuates high-motion thermal discontinuities through local temporal imputation during training, regularizing models toward respiration-consistent dynamics while leaving inference unchanged on raw video. Across multiple deep-learning backbones, STAR improves head-free estimation, reaching 2.23 bpm MAE compared with 20.76 bpm for tracked ROI analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出STAR正则化方法，从热成像视频中无接触估计头部自由运动狨猴的呼吸频率，解决"视觉跟踪可靠≠生理测量有效"的问题。
AI.motivation: 狨猴是社会神经科学关键的非人灵长类模型，呼吸频率反映唤醒、压力与生理调节。接触式传感器增加准备负担并干扰无头固定行为范式；热视频可无接触捕捉口鼻温度变化，但在无头固定场景下信号弱、局部化，且易被头部运动、姿态变化和毛发干扰。核心观察：视觉上可靠的跟踪并不等价于生理上有效的测量。
AI.method: 使用同步热视频与接触式呼吸记录进行对比分析，证明呼吸信号可从热视频恢复但高度依赖ROI；针对无头固定运动下轨迹与接触信号不一致的问题，改用从热视频片段中学习的时间信号估计呼吸率，并提出选择性时间衰减正则化（STAR）：训练时通过局部时间插补选择性衰减高运动热不连续性，将模型正则化到呼吸一致的动力学，推理阶段不改变对原始视频的处理。
AI.result: 在多种深度学习骨干网络上，STAR一致提升无头固定条件下的估计精度，MAE达2.23 bpm，而基于跟踪ROI的分析为20.76 bpm。
AI.conclusion: 区分了"跟踪"与"感知"，指出视频生理传感中视觉可行性与生理有效性间的鸿沟；STAR作为一种无需推理期改动的训练正则化手段，显著提升非接触呼吸监测鲁棒性，可推广至其他视频生理传感场景。

title: Energy-Based Fault Detection and Isolation Framework for Flat Port-Hamiltonian Mechanical Systems
summary: Fault diagnosis during regulated motion requires informative signals even when feedback attenuates tracking deviations. This paper develops an energy-based diagnostic framework that constructs mechanical port-power residuals without a dedicated dynamic observer. Spectral Hamiltonian Algebraic Power Evaluation (SHAPE) combines port-Hamiltonian variables and differential flatness to generate nominal power references from planned motion for fully actuated mechanical systems with collocated actuation. Subtracting these references from commanded effort multiplied by measured flow yields residuals whose final evaluation requires neither recursive observer updates nor measured-state dynamics calculations.
