Continuous wavelet transform (CWT) scalograms and a shared-encoder convolutional neural network are used to distinguish nominal operation, actuator loss of effectiveness, anomalous friction, and vibration from complete trajectories. Evaluation uses a simulated six degree of freedom Kinova manipulator under model predictive control and fixed plant-model mismatch, with single faults at a specified joint. Across five training seeds and 3000 held-out test runs, SHAPE-CWT achieves a mean accuracy of 84.69 percent, versus 81.67 percent for torque residuals and 97.17 percent for the generalized momentum observer under common CWT processing. The respective sample standard deviations are 0.70, 0.70, and 0.37 percentage points. These results demonstrate useful fault-type discrimination from algebraic power residuals, while severity-excitation profiles and offline velocity perturbations reveal limits to their diagnostic capability.

AI.tldr: Port-Hamiltonian power residuals via differential flatness, classified by CWT+CNN, reach 84.69% fault-type accuracy on a simulated 6-DoF Kinova manipulator — below a generalized momentum observer baseline.
AI.motivation: Abstract presents energy-based fault diagnosis for regulated motion where feedback masks tracking deviations.
AI.method: SHAPE framework + CWT + shared-encoder CNN.
AI.result: 84.69% mean accuracy vs 81.67% torque residuals, 97.17% GMO.
AI.conclusion: Algebraic power residuals enable fault-type discrimination but underperform observer-based baselines.

title: EXE: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Pretraining via Factorized Latent Actions for VLA Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are bottlenecked by the scarcity of robot data. Egocentric human manipulation videos offer an abundant, diverse, and semantically-rich alternative that inherently captures manipulation intent. However, the embodiment gap makes it difficult to extract action-relevant representations from these videos. From the perspective of action execution, human hands and robots share analogous manipulation primitives---reaching, grasping, placing---yet exhibit distinct kinematics tied to their embodiments. This might motivate our key approach: egocentric video pretraining can yield shared action representations capturing transferable manipulation skills, while human-specific motion patterns should be disentangled to avoid interfering with robot policy learning. To this end, we propose EXE, an Egocentric Cross(X)-Embodiment pretraining framework that learns a factorized latent action representation from egocentric human videos, separating shared manipulation priors from embodiment-specific signals. By leveraging the shared action space, the robot policy acquires generalizable manipulation semantics from diverse human demonstrations without being biased by human-specific kinematics. This shared knowledge transfers across embodiments with different kinematic structures, enabling the same pretraining to benefit both parallel grippers and dexterous hands. EXE yields consistent gains over baseline without pretraining on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa GR1, and real-world manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: EXE: an egocentric cross-embodiment pretraining framework that learns a factorized latent action space from human manipulation videos, disentangling shared manipulation priors from embodiment-specific kinematics to pretrain robot policies for both parallel grippers and dexterous hands.
AI.motivation: VLA models are bottlenecked by scarce robot data; egocentric human videos are abundant and semantically rich but suffer from the embodiment gap. The framing that hands and robots share manipulation primitives (reach/grasp/place) yet differ in kinematics motivates separating transferable action knowledge from human-specific motion patterns.
AI.method: Learn a factorized latent action representation from egocentric human video pretraining, splitting a shared action space (transferable manipulation semantics) from embodiment-specific signal encodings; the robot policy is pretrained in the shared space so it is not biased by human kinematics and transfers across kinematic structures (parallel gripper, dexterous hand).
AI.result: Consistent gains over no-pretraining baselines on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa GR1, and real-world manipulation tasks, with the same pretraining benefiting both gripper and dexterous-hand embodiments.
AI.conclusion: Factorized cross-embodiment latent action pretraining from egocentric human video is an effective and embodiment-agnostic route to mitigate robot data scarcity for VLA policies.

title: Rescuing Your Pruning: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning and Post-Training Recovery in MLLMs
summary: Visual token pruning substantially reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods are mostly training-free and plug-and-play. They treat the resulting performance drop as an inevitable cost of compression and pursue increasingly complex pruning rules. We rethink this view through two questions: how much of the loss can post-training rescue, and, building on this recovery, how can joint compression push pruning to its limit? We curate a 282K-sample post-training mixture covering general VQA, reasoning, OCR, and grounding, and post-train 36 configurations that drop or merge tokens under a unified protocol. Post-training rescues most of the loss, even for OCR and grounding, and its adaptation gain in closing the gap between the pruned and the dense model grows as the budget tightens. For joint compression, we find that the vision encoder, not the LLM, dominates prefill time in native-resolution MLLMs, so where tokens are removed matters more than how many: keeping 40% of tokens at the encoder runs faster than keeping 10% at the projector. Our best configuration prunes the encoder lightly and the projector aggressively, leaves the LLM intact, and keeps general understanding and reasoning at the dense level. It accelerates the LLM stage by 3.49x but the end-to-end time-to-first-token by only 1.54x, showing that LLM-stage speedups overstate end-to-end gains. We hope these findings offer insights for future research on joint visual token compression. Our data, protocol, and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了多模态大模型视觉token剪枝后的"训练后补救"效应，并提出编码器与投影器联合压缩策略，指出编码器主导预填充耗时，故token删减位置比数量更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法多为免训练即插即用，将性能损失视为压缩的必然代价，转而设计越来越复杂的剪枝规则。作者质疑这一视角，试图回答两个问题：(1) 训练后微调能挽回多少损失；(2) 在补救基础上，联合压缩如何将剪枝推到极限。
AI.method: 构建282K样本的后训练混合数据集（覆盖通用VQA、推理、OCR、grounding），在统一协议下对36种token删除/合并配置进行后训练；同时剖析原生分辨率MLLM预填充耗时来源，比较在编码器与投影器不同位置剪枝的效率。
AI.result: 后训练可挽回大部分损失（含OCR与grounding），且预算越紧，缩小剪枝模型与稠密模型差距的适应增益越大。原生分辨率MLLM中预填充时间由视觉编码器而非LLM主导，故编码器保留40% token比投影器保留10%更快。最优配置为编码器轻度剪枝、投影器激进剪枝、LLM不变，通用理解与推理保持稠密水平；LLM阶段加速3.49x，但端到端首token时间仅加速1.54x。
AI.conclusion: 性能损失并非不可挽回的压缩代价，后训练是剪枝恢复的关键手段；联合压缩中"在哪剪"比"剪多少"更重要，LLM阶段加速会高估端到端收益。作者将公开数据、协议与代码，为后续联合视觉token压缩研究提供参考。

title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at this https URL
summary: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

AI.tldr: PathKGen用病理专用知识图谱为多模态大模型注入可解释的结构化知识，双分支（视觉token+知识token）实现WSI病理报告生成，并优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: MLLM仅依赖参数内隐分布进行推理，受模型规模限制知识容量不足，且黑箱推理难以人工解读；知识图谱可将医学知识部分外化，但该方向在病理报告生成中尚未充分探索。
AI.method: PathKGen包含两条分支：(1) 视觉路径，基于病理基础模型学习视觉token输入MLLM；(2) 知识路径，通过查询病理专用知识图谱提取WSI关键形态学特征，学习知识token输入MLLM，使推理过程可视化。
AI.result: 在WSI-Bench数据集上的综合评估显示，PathKGen超越此前SOTA方法，并能以直观图形式呈现诊断推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 知识路径模块化设计可与视觉对齐MLLM互补，通过构建领域专用知识图谱生成知识token，可扩展至其他应用。

title: Scalable Unrolled Chains for MRI Reconstruction
comment: 23 pages (including supplementary material), 14 figures. Accepted at WACV 2027
summary: Unrolled variational networks achieve state-of-the-art performance for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but standard end-to-end training becomes prohibitively memory intensive as the number and width of cascades increase. We propose a memory-efficient training framework that updates a randomly sampled cascade while retaining supervision from the final reconstruction loss. The error signal is propagated from the end of the chain to the sampled cascade using an activation-light backward pass that avoids storing full chain activations, thereby decoupling training memory from chain length. A time-conditioned network shared across cascades further keeps the parameter count independent of chain length. The backward pass is approximate only through frozen normalization statistics, and a trained exact gradient control shows the approximation leaves reconstruction quality unchanged. The framework remains trainable at chain lengths and cascade widths where standard end-to-end backpropagation exhausts GPU memory. On fastMRI single-coil knee and multi-coil brain reconstruction, our method consistently outperforms other local training approaches. On high-SNR knee slices, our method surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and matches it at $4\times$, while on the complete brain validation set it surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and achieves comparable performance at $4\times$, with fewer parameters, lower peak memory, and faster per-iteration training. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出一种内存高效的单级联随机采样训练框架（冻结归一化统计的近似反向传播 + 时间条件共享网络），使展开式变分网络训练内存与链长解耦，在 fastMRI 膝/脑重建上优于 E2E-VarNet。
AI.motivation: 展开式变分网络（如 E2E-VarNet）在加速 MRI 重建中性能领先，但端到端训练的内存随级联数量与宽度线性增长，限制了可训练模型规模。
AI.method: 随机采样单个级联进行参数更新，但监督信号仍来自最终重建损失；采用 activation-light 反向传播（仅冻结归一化统计导致近似）把末端梯度传至被采样级联，避免存储全链激活，使训练内存与链长解耦；并用时间条件网络在各时间步/级联间共享参数，使参数量与链长无关；另训练精确梯度对照以验证近似影响。
AI.result: 近似反向与精确梯度重建质量无差异；在标准端到端反向传播显存溢出的链长与宽度下仍可训练；fastMRI 单线圈膝与多线圈脑重建上稳定优于其他局部训练方法；高 SNR 膝切片 8× 超过、4× 持平 E2E-VarNet，完整脑验证集 8× 超过、4× 相当，且参数量更少、峰值显存更低、每迭代更快。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持最终损失监督的同时大幅降低训练显存开销，可作为深展开重建网络的可扩展训练方案，但验证局限于医学 MRI 重建任务。

title: Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory
summary: Typed decision-making tasks in agents, such as UI element selection, product recommendation, and chart matching, require models to choose from a set of discrete candidates. While prior work demonstrates that text-only System One models achieve four key properties including candidate-order invariance, scalability, and cache reuse via separate request-candidate encoding, extending them to multimodal settings where candidates are visual remains underexplored. We introduce Iris, a framework that accommodates image, text, or hybrid candidates while preserving the core decision module. We prove that order invariance and exact cache reuse hold for any per-candidate encoder under Iris, and derive the closed-form latency reduction. We construct a visual-candidate benchmark from Multimodal-Mind2Web (K=16, deduplicated, order-shuffled, three generalization splits). Independent encoding (Iris) achieves 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 percent accuracy with zero-flip rate under candidate reordering. Joint encoding reaches 90.6 / 89.5 / 91.6 percent but suffers an 8 to 10 percent answer-flip rate when shuffled. To bridge this gap, we propose a design that encodes each candidate conditioned on the request state without inter-candidate cross-attention; it preserves strict order invariance, enables forked cache sharing, and attains 91.7 / 86.5 / 90.0 percent accuracy at one-third of OneJev latency with calibrated null probabilities (AUROC 0.93 to 0.97). Reusing image candidates across requests cuts latency by 37x at K=256 and 191x at K=2048. On MetaEncoder benchmarks, Iris-4B achieves 100 percent on JevBench original and easy, outperforming 30B MetaEncoder and 27B OpenJev. Finally, we resolve a systems bottleneck on Ampere GPUs: reformulating Qwen3.5 patch-embedding Conv3d into its exact matrix-product form accelerates processing by 350x. Code, data, and checkpoints: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Iris：面向视觉候选的多模态决策框架，用逐候选独立编码保留顺序不变性与缓存复用，并以"请求状态条件化"设计逼近联合编码精度，同时把 Qwen3.5 Conv3d patch-embedding 改写为矩阵乘形式实现 350x 加速。
AI.motivation: 文本型 System One 决策模型已具备候选顺序不变、可扩展、请求-候选分离编码带来缓存复用等性质，但候选为图像/混合模态时如何保留这些性质尚不清楚；联合编码虽精度高却对候选顺序敏感且无法精确复用缓存。
AI.method: 提出 Iris 框架，保持核心决策模块不变而支持图像、文本及混合候选；理论证明任意 per-candidate 编码器下顺序不变性与精确缓存复用成立，并给出闭式延迟削减；进一步提出"以请求状态为条件、无候选间 cross-attention"的编码设计，实现严格顺序不变与 forked cache sharing；基于 Multimodal-Mind2Web 构建视觉候选 benchmark（K=16，去重、顺序打乱、三种泛化划分）；并将 Qwen3.5 patch-embedding 的 Conv3d 等价改写为矩阵乘以解决 Ampere GPU 系统瓶颈。
AI.result: 独立编码（Iris）在三划分上达 78.4/72.1/74.8%，重排下零翻转；联合编码达 90.6/89.5/91.6% 但重排翻转率 8–10%；新设计达 91.7/86.5/90.0%，延迟约为 OneJev 的 1/3，零概率校准 AUROC 0.93–0.97；图像候选跨请求复用使 K=256 延迟降 37x、K=2048 降 191x；MetaEncoder 基准上 Iris-4B 在 JevBench original/easy 均达 100%，超过 30B MetaEncoder 与 27B OpenJev；Conv3d 矩阵化带来 350x 加速。
AI.conclusion: Iris 表明多模态候选决策可在保持顺序不变性与缓存复用的同时接近联合编码精度，并具备显著工程加速与跨规模性能优势；核心贡献在架构与系统层面，而非具身/3D 领域的感知或重建方法。

title: E3tereo: Improving Stereo Matching at Depth Boundaries with Learned Geometric Edges
summary: Depth boundaries remain a major source of error in stereo matching. For IGEV on Scene Flow, geometric edge pixels account for only 6% of evaluated pixels but about half of the total absolute disparity error. Photometric edges can respond to texture changes without corresponding depth discontinuities, making them unreliable cues for boundary refinement. We propose E3Stereo, which learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines these boundary cues with the backbone disparity and image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections. The same edge map also emphasizes boundary errors during training, while joint optimization allows the edge predictor to adapt to disparity refinement. On the Scene Flow dataset, E3Stereo reduces end-point error (EPE) at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across RAFT-Stereo, IGEV, and MonSter, while also reducing overall EPE. After fine-tuning, our IGEV-based model improves upon IGEV on all eleven reported metrics across ETH3D, KITTI 2012, and KITTI 2015. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: E3Stereo 用视差监督学习几何边缘，并将几何边缘、主干视差与图像细节融合，预测全分辨率视差修正；同一边缘图还用于训练时强调边界误差，联合优化使边缘预测器适配视差细化。
AI.motivation: 立体匹配中深度边界是主要误差来源：IGEV 在 Scene Flow 上几何边缘像素仅占 6%，却贡献约一半绝对视差误差；光度边缘会响应纹理变化但不对应深度不连续，作为边界细化线索不可靠。
AI.method: 学习式几何边缘检测（由视差监督得到边界线索）+ 与主干视差和图像细节联合的全分辨率视差残差预测；边缘图同时用作边界加权损失；边缘预测器与视差细化端到端联合优化，可嵌入 RAFT-Stereo、IGEV、MonSter 等主干。
AI.result: Scene Flow 上边界 EPE 相对 RAFT-Stereo、IGEV、MonSter 下降 9.5%–14.3%，整体 EPE 亦下降；基于 IGEV 微调后在 ETH3D、KITTI 2012、KITTI 2015 共 11 项指标全部优于 IGEV。
AI.conclusion: 几何边缘是比光度边缘更可靠的边界线索，作为显式中间表征可同时服务于细化与损失加权，插件式提升多个立体主干。

title: Open-World Law-to-Action: Vision-Language Priors and Touch for Parts with Hidden Physics
summary: A robot in a home it has never seen must open doors, drawers, lids and taps whose physics a picture does not show. Instructions such as "open the drawer halfway, gently" depend on that physics: how far a part travels, how it resists, and what locks it. We present Open-World Law-to-Action (L2A). A vision-language model (VLM) proposes, for each movable part, its motions, the terms of its law of motion, and what may lock it. Each proposal becomes a prior with a floor, so that touch can always overturn it. The robot identifies each part's law online by Bayesian linear regression with closed-form evidence, for parts that move in one way or in two, and keeps a hypothesis that an unseen part or motion locks the target. We prove that touch alone cannot rule this hypothesis out, derive when another look is worth its cost, and show that a constant load and friction cannot be told apart while a part moves one way. All experiments are in simulation, developed on some scenes and run once on held-out ones. In new kitchens the robot completes 80% of tasks from the VLM's proposals, against 98% when every part is known. Proposed physics raises success on objects that need new terms from 353 to 378-383 of 400 episodes, and a second look raises success in mixed scenes from 284 to 329 of 366 tasks. A mobile robot that takes nothing from the simulator completes 70 of 100 requests in new scenes, against 62 when the simulator says which part each box is (after one change made between two held-out tests).

AI.tldr: 在未见过的家庭环境中，用VLM提出各可动部件的"运动定律"先验，结合触觉的贝叶斯线性回归在线辨识部件物理规律（含锁定假设），并推导"再看一眼"的收益条件，仿真中显著提升开门/抽屉/水龙头等任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 单张图片无法揭示可动部件的物理属性（行程、阻力、锁定方式），而"轻轻开一半"这类指令恰恰依赖这些物理量；需要一种在开放世界中快速在线辨识物体运动规律的方法，且不能盲信视觉先验（视觉先验可能错误，触觉信息才是最可靠的证据）。
AI.method: 提出Open-World Law-to-Action (L2A)框架：(1) VLM为每个可动部件生成运动模式、运动定律项与潜在锁定因素的提案，每个提案作为带下限的先验，允许触觉随时推翻；(2) 机器人通过带闭式证据的贝叶斯线性回归在线辨识部件的运动定律，支持单自由度与双自由度情形，并保留"未观测部件/运动导致锁定"的假设；(3) 理论分析：证明仅靠触觉无法排除锁定假设，推导额外视觉观察的代价-收益条件，并证明单向运动时恒定负载与摩擦不可区分；(4) 实验全在仿真中进行，在部分场景开发、在留出场景单次评测。
AI.result: 新厨房场景中，基于VLM提案完成80%任务，而所有部件已知时为98%；对需要新运动项的对象，加入物理提案使成功从353提升到378–383/400；混合场景中"再看一眼"使成功从284提升到329/366。移动机器人在全新场景中完成70/100请求，而以模拟器直接告知部件归属时为62（两次留出测试之间做过一次改动）。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM语义先验与触觉在线贝叶斯辨识、可推翻的锁定假设及主动观察决策相结合，可在开放世界以较少交互可靠地辨识可动部件物理规律；同时揭示了触觉与单向运动的根本可辨识性局限。

title: Traffic-Context-Aware Driver Emotion Recognition with Expectation-Deviation-Driven Inference
summary: Driver emotion provides an important indication of how drivers perceive and evaluate ongoing traffic situations, making reliable emotion recognition an important capability for effective human-vehicle interaction. Yet, most existing driver emotion recognition approaches rely primarily on in-cabin images and overlook how surrounding traffic interactions shape driver emotional responses. To address this limitation, we propose a traffic-context-aware driver emotion recognition (TADER) framework that integrates in-cabin signals with out-of-cabin traffic scenarios, modeling driver emotions as arising from expectation deviation represented by the discrepancy between predicted and observed vehicle trajectories. The proposed framework comprises two key components: (1) a vision-based base recognizer that extracts spatiotemporal representations from in-cabin facial images to infer driver emotions, and (2) a traffic-context-aware fusion module that quantifies expectation deviation from external traffic scenarios and integrates it into the base recognizer via attention-based embedding fusion. To overcome the scarcity of paired in-cabin and out-of-cabin data, we introduce a transfer learning strategy that transfers a trajectory prediction model trained on large-scale naturalistic datasets to smaller paired datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TADER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both naturalistic and simulated driving environments by incorporating traffic context information into emotion recognition, resulting in improvements of 5% in accuracy on the AIDE and manD datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出TADER框架，将车内驾驶员面部图像与车外交通场景联合建模，用"预期偏差"（预测轨迹与观测轨迹之差）表征情绪诱因，通过注意力嵌入融合实现驾驶情绪识别，AIDE与manD数据集准确率提升约5%。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶员情绪识别主要依赖车内图像，忽略了周边交通交互对情绪的影响；同时缺少配对的舱内-舱外数据。
AI.method: (1) 基于视觉的基础识别器，从面部图像提取时空表征推断情绪；(2) 交通上下文感知融合模块，由外部场景量化预期偏差并做注意力嵌入融合；(3) 迁移学习策略，将大规模自然驾驶数据训练的轨迹预测模型迁移到小规模配对数据集。
AI.result: 在自然驾驶（AIDE）与仿真驾驶环境中一致优于SOTA，准确率提升约5%。
AI.conclusion: 引入交通上下文与预期偏差建模可有效提升驾驶员情绪识别性能，为自然人机共驾交互提供支持。

title: Quantum Closed Loop Inverse Kinematics Through Hilbert-Space Encoding of Robot Kinematics
summary: The integration of quantum computing into robotics requires mathematical representations that preserve the geometric structure and configuration dependence of robot motion. This paper introduces a structure-preserving quantum representation of rigid-body transformations and serial-manipulator kinematics, establishing a correspondence between classical kinematic models and parameterized quantum circuits. Building on the Bloch-sphere representation, spatial directions are encoded into single-qubit states, while quantum rotations reproduce the ordered composition of reference-frame transformations. Translational contributions are combined through quantum-state aggregation, with their metric scales retained classically, enabling the reconstruction of end-effector position and orientation from Pauli expectation values. The formulation preserves the original joint variables and accommodates different kinematic conventions and joint types. Beyond forward kinematics, we establish that the manipulator geometric Jacobian can be reconstructed from quantum-observable derivatives using the parameter-shift rule, with analytical equivalence to its classical counterpart under ideal readout. To demonstrate the applicability of this representation to robot-level algorithms, we introduce Quantum Closed Loop Inverse Kinematics, a hybrid closed-loop method that exploits quantum-derived pose and Jacobian information. The proposed framework provides a geometrically interpretable foundation for developing and investigating quantum and hybrid computational methods for robotic kinematics and motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种保结构（structure-preserving）的量子表示方法，将刚体变换与串联机械臂运动学映射为参数化量子线路，并给出量子闭式逆运动学。
AI.motivation: 将量子计算引入机器人学需要既能保持几何结构、又能体现构型依赖的数学表示；作者希望建立经典运动学模型与量子线路之间的严格对应关系。
AI.method: 基于 Bloch 球表示，把空间方向编码为单量子比特态，用量子旋转复现参考系变换的有序复合；平移分量通过量子态聚合合并，其度量尺度保留在经典侧；由 Pauli 期望值重建末端位姿。进一步用 parameter-shift rule 从量子可观测量导数重建几何雅可比。并据此提出混合闭环方法 Quantum CLIK。
AI.result: 在理想读出下，量子重建的位姿与几何雅可比与经典对应量解析等价；表述保留原始关节变量，兼容不同运动学约定与关节类型；Quantum CLIK 可完成闭环逆运动学求解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为机器人运动学的量子/混合计算方法提供了几何可解释的基础，但其应用价值依赖量子硬件的实际可行性，论文仅给出解析等价性而非真实量子硬件或真机实验验证。

title: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection
summary: Many robot manipulation videos do not indicate whether the task was successfully completed. RoboJev-27B is an open-weight vision-language model that takes a task instruction, 10 frames of a manipulation attempt, and (if available) final frames from auxiliary cameras and predicts whether the robot accomplished the task. RoboJev-27B is a variant of JEV-27B-VL, trained with a rank-32 LoRA adapter on the language model only (keeping the vision encoder frozen) using 52,598 episode records. It also uses a source-specific KL penalty that applies only to research data, anchoring predictions closer to the original model on those sources. It uses a calibrated two-token readout that outputs success/failure probabilities in a single forward pass. On 268 held-out episodes of the same robot model (SO-101), RoboJev-27B attains 95.2% balanced accuracy and 0.993 AUROC. It also generalises to episodes collected by unseen labs/robots (AUROC = 0.890 over 459 episodes) as well as to clearly labelled community-collected episodes (accuracy = 93.3% over 135 episodes), where the base model attains an AUROC = 0.900 on the unseen-lab/robot subset with the same inputs. It takes 0.26 seconds per episode (median, serial) to infer on a single H100, which is about \$0.19 per 1,000 success predictions at \$2.69 per GPU-hour (not including media processing and serving costs). RoboJev-27B is released together with its inference code, along with a transparent evaluation: 20,628 predictions organized into 29 model/protocol entries are made available to facilitate browsing and to enable reproducible benchmarking of success detection. We also compare against strong API-based frontier VLMs, which take in fewer input frames (4 images from the primary camera only); note that this comparison is not strictly like-for-like because RoboJev-27B is given more frames at inference.

AI.tldr: RoboJev-27B：基于JEV-27B-VL、仅对语言模型加rank-32 LoRA（视觉编码器冻结），用52,598条episode训练的机器人操作成功检测VLM；采用源特定KL惩罚与校准双token读出，单次前向输出成功/失败概率。
AI.motivation: 大量机器人操作视频缺少任务成功与否的标注，需要自动的成功检测（success detection）来筛数据、评估策略与监控部署。现有前沿VLM为闭源API，输入帧数受限、成本高、不可复现。
AI.method: 在开源VLM JEV-27B-VL上仅对语言模型施加rank-32 LoRA适配，视觉编码器冻结；输入任务指令+主相机10帧（可选辅助相机末帧）。训练用52,598个episode记录，并引入仅作用于研究数据源的source-specific KL惩罚以锚定原始模型；推理端用校准的两token读出，单次前向给出成功/失败概率。
AI.result: 同机器人（SO-101）268条留出episode上平衡准确率95.2%、AUROC 0.993；未见实验室/机器人459条episode上AUROC 0.890（基座模型0.900）；社区数据135条准确率93.3%。H100单卡串行中位0.26秒/episode，约$0.19每千次预测（不含媒体处理与serving）。随代码发布20,628条预测、29个模型/协议条目的透明评测。
AI.conclusion: 提供一个开源、低成本、可复现的机器人成功检测基线，具备跨机器人与社区数据的泛化能力，并公开推理代码与评测集；与闭源前沿VLM的比较非严格同条件（本模型输入帧更多）。

title: Floor Friction Assessment from Robot Tire-Surface Interaction
comment: 11 pages and 14 figures; Extended abstract submitted to IEEE/ION PLANS 2027, under review
summary: Floor traction influences wheel-slip behavior, dead-reckoning accuracy, and the navigation performance of wheeled mobile robots that rely on wheel odometry. As these robots become increasingly common in GNSS-denied indoor environments, including automated manufacturing and retail facilities, their onboard measurements could also be used to characterize floor conditions and improve localization. In this study, a skid-steer robot was driven over five floor surfaces with distinct traction characteristics using commanded velocity profiles designed to induce wheel slip through repeated acceleration and direction reversal. Differences between the body velocity estimated from inertial sensing and the velocity obtained from wheel odometry were evaluated using the integrated relative-velocity error, phase-derived wheel-to-body response delay, and velocity-reversal response delay. Welch power spectral density analysis was additionally applied to characterize the frequency distribution of the velocity mismatch during positive and negative acceleration. Band-integrated spectral power, spectral centroid, and spectral decay rate were extracted from each recording and evaluated using linear discriminant analysis and multiclass classification. The response-delay measurements produced consistent surface-dependent trends, with the longest delays observed on soap and the shortest delays observed on carpet. The spectral features also provided clear separation among the tested surfaces, achieving a balanced classification accuracy of 97.1% under recording-level cross-validation. These results demonstrate that both the magnitude and frequency domain characteristics of wheel-to-body velocity mismatch contain useful information about tire-surface interactions. Such information could support surface recognition and the development of slip-aware wheel-odometry weighting within robot state-estimation frameworks.

AI.tldr: 将skid-steer机器人驱动于五种不同摩擦特性的地面，利用惯性速度与轮式里程计速度之差（时域响应延迟+Welch谱特征）实现地面材质识别，交叉验证平衡准确率97.1%。
AI.motivation: 轮式里程计依赖地面牵引力，在GNSS拒止的室内环境中滑移会导致定位漂移；希望复用机器人已有传感器在线表征地面状况，从而用于地面识别与滑移感知的里程计加权。
AI.method: 设计含反复加速与方向反转的指令速度曲线以诱发轮滑；在5种地面上采集数据，计算体速度（惯性估计）与轮速里程计速度的差；提取三类指标：积分相对速度误差、相位法轮-机响应延迟、速度反转响应延迟；对正/负加速度段做Welch功率谱密度分析，提取频带积分功率、谱质心、谱衰减率；用LDA与多类分类器区分地面。
AI.result: 响应延迟呈一致的材质相关趋势（肥皂上最长、地毯上最短）；谱特征对五种地面区分清晰，录制级交叉验证平衡准确率97.1%。
AI.conclusion: 轮-体速度失配的幅值与频域特征均携带轮胎-地面交互信息，可支撑地面识别并在状态估计框架中实现滑移感知的轮式里程计加权。属小型受控实验，未涉及学习式方法、真实场景数据或开源，应用范围限于轮式室内机器人导航。

title: A SegFormer-based model for spatial Daylight Factor prediction with comprehensive obstruction encoding and regulatory validation
comment: Conference: BuildSim Nordic 2026 15 pages, Appendices A, B, C 9 figures, 8 tables
summary: Daylight compliance assessment in residential buildings requires time-consuming raytracing simulations and specialist model preparation, limiting its integration into iterative architectural design. We present a machine learning-based methodology for predicting the spatial distribution of the Daylight Factor (DF) directly within Building Information Modelling (BIM) environments, delivering results in seconds without model export or manual curation. The approach addresses five gaps not jointly covered by any existing model: external obstruction encoding including balconies, own building height, variable material reflectances, non-orthogonal room geometries, and regulatory validation. Two models are developed: a default-materials model with fixed reflectances for preliminary design checks, and a custom-materials model with variable project-specific reflectances. Both are trained on about 20,000 synthetic Radiance-simulated rooms and validated on a held-out synthetic dataset and 102 rooms from 18 real building models. The default-materials model achieves $\delta_1$ = 83.4% and MAE = 0.11% DF on synthetic data, and on real buildings predicts BBR (Swedish) compliance area within 4.85 pp MAE (bias +2.31 pp) and TEK17 (Norwegian) mean room DF within 0.304% DF MAE (bias +0.287% DF). The custom-materials variant shows 1.7-2.4$\times$ higher error across all metrics. Both models concentrate accuracy in the BBR compliance-critical zone (DF < 1%), achieving a sub-1% DF MAE of 0.105% DF and Compliance IoU of 0.883 on real buildings. All cases where compliance is overestimated are borderline, within 10.7 pp of the BBR threshold (median 3.2 pp) and 0.36% DF of the TEK17 threshold (median 0.10% DF). The default-materials model is recommended as a replacement for preliminary daylight simulations; the custom-materials variant requires further development before use in final compliance verification.

AI.tldr: 提出在BIM环境内直接预测采光系数(DF)空间分布的机器学习方法，秒级输出、无需模型导出，含默认材料与自定义材料两个模型，在1万+合成房间与18个真实建筑102个房间上验证。
AI.motivation: 住宅采光合规评估依赖耗时的Radiance光线追踪与专家级模型准备，难以嵌入迭代式建筑设计流程。已有模型未同时覆盖外部遮挡（含阳台）、自身建筑高度、可变材料反射率、非正交房间几何与法规验证这五项需求。
AI.method: 构建两个代理模型：默认材料模型（固定反射率，用于方案阶段初检）与自定义材料模型（项目特定可变反射率）。两者均以约2万个合成Radiance仿真房间训练，并在留出合成集与18个真实建筑模型的102个房间上验证，直接集成于BIM内部推理。
AI.result: 默认材料模型在合成数据上δ1=83.4%、MAE=0.11% DF；真实建筑上BBR合规面积MAE 4.85pp（偏差+2.31pp）、TEK17平均房间DF MAE 0.304% DF（偏差+0.287% DF）。精度集中在DF<1%的合规关键区（MAE 0.105% DF，Compliance IoU 0.883）。所有高估合规的案例均处边界（距BBR阈值≤10.7pp，中位3.2pp）。自定义材料变体误差高1.7–2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 默认材料模型可替代初设阶段采光仿真；自定义材料变体需进一步改进后方可用于最终合规核验。

title: POD-RoPE: Rotary Position Encoding over Physical Observation Distributions for Embodied AI
summary: Embodied perception requires positional representations that capture both physical geometry and the spatial and temporal extent of observations. We introduce POD-RoPE (Physical Observation Distribution RoPE), which represents token observation footprints as distributions over camera centers, viewing directions, and sampling times. Under independent sampling, expected rotations encode relative relationships between distributions; when each distribution collapses to a single address, the construction recovers pointwise RoPE. The same rotation statistics support Q/K matching and coherence-dependent V/O transformations, allowing observation geometry to guide both information selection and content aggregation. Per-token pre-aggregation avoids increasing sequence length or processing pairs of observation nodes. We evaluate POD-RoPE across four robot policy architectures, simulation and real-world manipulation, and complementary reconstruction, depth-estimation, and novel-view-synthesis tasks. Integrating POD-RoPE into Fast-WAM improves mean success from 91.83% to 92.88% across all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and from 32.5% to 52.5% on two real-robot tasks on Sharpa North. Controlled reconstruction ablations support the contributions of distribution encoding and V/O transformations. In H20 model-block benchmarks, POD-RoPE achieves median forward-plus-backward speedups of $1.91\times$ over P-RoPE and $5.34\times$ over RayRoPE, with a median latency overhead of 17.4% over Standard RoPE. These results support physical observation distributions as an effective and computationally efficient basis for geometry-aware attention.

AI.tldr: POD-RoPE 将 token 的观测足迹建模为相机中心、视线方向与采样时间上的分布，用期望旋转编码分布间相对关系，并统一驱动 Q/K 匹配与 V/O 聚合。
AI.motivation: 具身感知需要同时刻画物理几何与观测的空间/时间范围，而现有位置编码（RoPE 类）只用单点地址表示 token，无法表达多视角、多时刻观测的分布特性。
AI.method: 以观测分布替代点地址构造旋转位置编码：独立采样假设下期望旋转给出分布间相对关系，分布退化为单点时回退到逐点 RoPE；同一旋转统计量同时用于 Q/K 匹配与相干性相关的 V/O 变换；采用 per-token 预聚合避免序列变长或观测节点两两配对。
AI.result: 在 4 种机器人策略架构、仿真与真机操作、以及重建/深度估计/新视角合成任务上验证：Fast-WAM 在 RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个任务上平均成功率由 91.83% 提升至 92.88%，Sharpa North 两个真机任务由 32.5% 升至 52.5%；H20 上前反向中位加速 1.91×（对比 P-RoPE）、5.34×（对比 RayRoPE），相对 Standard RoPE 仅增加 17.4% 延迟。
AI.conclusion: 物理观测分布可作为几何感知注意力的一种有效且计算高效的基础表示，消融支持分布编码与 V/O 变换各自的贡献。

title: Computer Vision Navigation for an Autonomous Vehicle Model Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: This work aims to assess the capabilities of the reinforcement learning algorithm, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), in developing a policy capable of controlling the speed and steering angle of a vehicle model to navigate within simulated road lines. The control system's input is a camera, and its outputs are the rotational speed of the rear wheels and the steering angle of the front wheels, controlling the vehicle's speed and direction, respectively. The algorithm is trained and tested in a simulated environment, where it receives image frames from the vehicle's camera, processes them through a feature extraction algorithm, and feeds them into the policy. For each frame, the policy outputs speed and direction commands for the vehicle. The policy is iteratively updated to enhance its performance. The reinforcement learning algorithm successfully generates a policy capable of navigating the vehicle in a simplified environment. Potential improvements are suggested to enhance the system's robustness in more complex scenarios. Creating a simulation environment suitable for testing an advanced reinforcement learning algorithm is a complex task. This project offers a framework for other developers to test different approaches and algorithms. The tested algorithm, PPO, uses proximity intervals - an innovative approach in reinforcement learning. In some scenarios, the algorithm achieved better performance than predecessor algorithms, which are typically harder to implement and require tuning more hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 用PPO在仿真中训练基于摄像头的车辆横向/纵向控制策略（后轮转速+前轮转角），验证其能在简化车道线环境中完成循迹。
AI.motivation: 验证强化学习算法（PPO）能否仅凭相机输入学出车辆速度与转向控制策略，并搭建可供他人复用的仿真测试框架。
AI.method: 仿真环境中的车辆模型，相机图像经特征提取后输入PPO策略，逐帧输出后轮转速与转向角；策略迭代更新。
AI.result: 在简化场景中成功学得可行车道保持/循迹策略；在部分场景下表现优于实现更复杂、超参更多的前人算法；但未涉及复杂场景鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架可作为开发者的通用测试基线，后续需提升复杂场景鲁棒性。

title: Road Infrastructure Perception for Autonomous Driving: Taxonomy, Representations, Tasks, and Challenges
summary: Road infrastructure perception is a fundamental component of autonomous driving, as it recovers the structured road elements that define roadway geometry, delimit operational space, and encode traffic regulations. Although individual tasks such as lane detection, drivable-space estimation, traffic-sign recognition, and online map construction have been extensively studied, the field remains fragmented across task definitions, sensing assumptions, output representations, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This survey provides a function-oriented synthesis of road infrastructure perception. We first clarify its scope and organize existing studies into three complementary categories: geometric-structural, functional-spatial, and regulatory-semantic infrastructure. Based on this taxonomy, we review sensing modalities, scene representations, representative methods, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols, emphasizing the field's evolution from image-space recognition toward metric, vectorized, topology-aware, occupancy-based, and rule-grounded scene modeling. We further examine how representation choices affect evaluation and downstream usability, revealing limitations of current benchmarks in relation reasoning, temporal consistency, robustness, and planning-oriented assessment. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions toward unified infrastructure representation, open-environment generalization, relation- and rule-aware reasoning, and downstream-oriented evaluation. By connecting tasks, representations, and evaluation under a common functional framework, this survey aims to establish road infrastructure perception as a coherent foundation for map-compatible and behavior-relevant autonomous-driving scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇面向自动驾驶的“道路基础设施感知”综述，按几何-结构、功能-空间、法规-语义三类建立功能导向分类体系，并围绕传感模态、场景表征、方法、基准与评测协议进行归纳，指出领域正从图像空间识别走向度量、矢量化、拓扑感知、占据与规则落地式建模。
AI.motivation: 车道线检测、可行驶区域估计、交通标志识别、在线地图构建等子任务各自成熟，但任务定义、传感假设、输出表征、数据集与评测协议高度碎片化，缺乏统一的功能框架把任务—表征—评测联系起来。
AI.method: 综述性质：先界定范围，提出几何-结构、功能-空间、法规-语义的三类分类法；在此基础上按分类梳理传感模态（相机/激光/雷达等）、场景表征（栅格、矢量化、拓扑、占据、规则约束）、代表性方法、基准与评测协议；并分析表征选择对评测与下游可用性的影响。
AI.result: 系统揭示现有基准在关系推理、时序一致性、鲁棒性和面向规划评测方面的不足，指出统一基础设施表征、开放环境泛化、关系与规则感知推理、下游导向评测是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 以共同的功能框架串联任务、表征与评测，将道路基础设施感知确立为与地图兼容、与行为相关的自动驾驶场景理解的连贯基础，并给出未来方向。

title: C-DFF: Concept-Level Diagnostics for Mechanism Parity in Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous Driving Perception
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Simulation is widely used in autonomous-driving validation, but matching task outputs between real and synthetic images does not guarantee that a system relies on the same visual evidence. This creates a validation gap for transfer, especially in safety-critical perception functions. We present Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity (C-DFF), a concept-level mechanism-parity diagnostic for paired real-synthetic evaluation. Starting from decisive evidence extracted from a frozen system-under-test (SUT), C-DFF projects that evidence into a shared semantic concept space using off-the-shelf segmentation and compares real and synthetic concept-importance vectors. The result is not only a scalar mechanism-parity score, but also a concept-shift diagnostic that identifies which scene concepts become more or less decisive in simulation. We evaluate C-DFF on KITTI $\leftrightarrow$ Virtual KITTI 2 with 2126 matched pairs across three frozen SUTs (steering regression, YOLOP drivable-area, YOLOP lane-line). Across these tasks, C-DFF is SUT-discriminative and yields interpretable concept-level summaries that support validation triage and simulator debugging. When reported alongside task-specific output-value context metrics, C-DFF shows that output agreement does not by itself establish mechanism parity. These results position C-DFF as a practical semantic diagnostic layer for validation and verification workflows in simulation-based AV testing.

AI.tldr: 提出C-DFF，一种概念级"机制一致性"诊断方法：从冻结被测系统(SUT)提取决定性证据，借助现成分割模型投影到共享语义概念空间，比较真/合成图像的概念重要性向量，输出机制一致性标量与概念漂移诊断。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶仿真验证中，真/合成图像上任务输出一致并不代表系统依赖相同的视觉证据，存在"机制层面"的迁移验证缺口，尤其对安全关键感知功能。
AI.method: 在配对的真实-合成图像上，从冻结SUT中提取决定性证据（特征/梯度类归因），用现成分割模型映射到共享语义概念空间，构建概念重要性向量并对比，得到标量机制一致性分数及概念级漂移摘要（哪些场景概念在仿真中变得更/更不决定性）。
AI.result: 在KITTI↔Virtual KITTI 2的2126对匹配样本、三个冻结SUT（转向回归、YOLOP可行驶区域、YOLOP车道线）上评估，C-DFF具有SUT判别性并给出可解释的概念级摘要；与任务输出一致性指标并列报告时表明输出一致不等于机制一致。
AI.conclusion: C-DFF可作为基于仿真的自动驾驶验证与确认流程中的实用语义诊断层，用于验证分诊与仿真器调试。

title: RoboReason: Boosting Robotics-Relevant VLM Reasoning Through Scalable Data Generation
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance when integrated into robot manipulation pipelines, but real-world evaluation of VLM capabilities on downstream robotics tasks is both difficult and expensive to scale. We propose that spatial and temporal ordering tasks using images from stereo and wrist cameras attached to real-world robots are particularly well-suited for evaluating visual reasoning capabilities, as they assess skills directly applicable to robots. We evaluate VLM reasoning abilities on three questions: ordering shuffled frames conditioned on a language description of the task, ordering objects depthwise based on distance from the camera, and ordering objects from left-to-right in pixel coordinates. The complexity of these tasks can also be modulated by changing the size of the set to sort. Our experiments show that several state-of-the-art vision-language models struggle on ordering tasks. To fix this, we propose a scalable autonomous training data generation pipeline, and show that both supervised finetuning and reinforcement-learning on the generated data can significantly improve VLM reasoning performance both on spatiotemporal ordering tasks as well as downstream robotics and visual reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出用真实机器人立体/腕部相机图像构建时空排序任务来评估VLM视觉推理能力，并给出可扩展的自主数据生成管线，通过SFT与RL训练显著提升VLM在排序及下游机器人任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: VLM在机器人操作管线中表现亮眼，但在真实机器人下游任务上评估VLM能力难以规模化且成本高昂，需要一个与机器人技能直接相关、可自动扩展的评估范式。
AI.method: 设计三类排序任务：(1) 依据语言描述对打乱帧排序；(2) 按相机距离深度排序物体；(3) 按像素坐标从左到右排序物体，并可调整待排序集合大小以调节难度。基于真实机器人立体相机与腕部相机采集图像，构建可扩展的自主训练数据生成管线，对VLM进行监督微调与强化学习。
AI.result: 多个SOTA视觉语言模型在排序任务上表现不佳；在生成数据上做SFT和RL后，VLM在时空排序任务以及下游机器人与视觉推理任务上显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 真实机器人视角下的时空排序是评估VLM空间与时序推理的有效、可扩展代理任务，配合自主数据生成与SFT/RL训练，可作为提升VLM机器人相关推理能力的实用手段。

title: Segmentation of Moving Objects During Camera Motion Using the OWL Function
summary: We present a principled, analytical framework for segmenting multiple independently moving rigid objects during single camera motion, built directly upon the OWL perception function. OWL encodes two fundamental visual motion cues, perceived looming $L$ and perceived rotation $\omega$, into a single closed-form representation of relative 3D structure. A key consequence of this structure is that the unit direction of relative translation $\hat{t}$ is analytically recoverable per image point from $L$ and $\omega$ alone. All points belonging to a non-rotating rigid body share the same $\hat{t}$, whereas points on different rigid bodies generally yield distinct values. This furnishes a natural segmentation criterion: clustering per-point $\hat{t}$ estimates partitions the visible scene into independently moving rigid bodies. Building on the 2D complex form of OWL, we derive the framework in 3D using quaternions, for a single moving camera. The approach is parallel, camera rotation-invariant, and requires no training data, no depth information, and no semantic priors.

AI.tldr: 基于OWL感知函数，用looming L与旋转ω解析地逐点恢复相对平移方向t̂，据此对t̂聚类实现单目相机运动下多刚体运动分割，并给出四元数三维推导。
AI.motivation: 多独立运动刚体的无监督分割通常依赖深度、语义先验或训练数据；作者希望直接从视觉运动线索出发，给出闭式、解析的分割准则。
AI.method: 以OWL（looming L + 旋转ω的闭环表示）为基础，证明相对平移单位方向t̂可由L、ω逐点解析恢复；同一非旋转刚体上各点共享同一t̂，故对逐点t̂估计进行聚类即得分割。将OWL的二维复数形式推广为四元数三维推导，适用于单相机运动；方法并行、对相机旋转不变、无需训练数据/深度/语义先验。
AI.result: 摘要为方法性描述，未给出定量实验结果；核心结论是t̂的可解析恢复与基于t̂一致性的分割准则成立，并提供三维四元数框架。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个原理化、无监督的单目多刚体运动分割解析框架；局限在于假设非旋转刚体、缺乏实验验证与噪声鲁棒性分析，属于概念性贡献。

title: One Scan is Enough: Demonstration-Free Adaptation for Language-Guided Navigation
summary: Deploying a language-guided navigation policy in a new building usually means watching it fail. Public-benchmark VLAs degrade scene by scene as layout, appearance, and language drift, and the standard fix of teleoperating fresh trajectories on site does not scale. We replace human demonstration with a single brief iPhone scan. Scan2Instruction compiles that scan into a complete training environment, automatically synthesizing executable navigation episodes with grounded instructions. PRPT-KS then adapts the policy through a closed-form Pareto utility read directly off the reconstructed scene, with no learned critic and no human labels. Across five real environments, the two designs together drive our RealNav to an 85% real-robot success rate, compared with 49% for a RealNav baseline post-trained on human demonstrations, and still achieve 82% in unscanned regions of the same buildings, compared with 41% for the same baseline. Our work turns demonstration-free scene adaptation for language-guided navigation from an aspiration into a working reality.

AI.tldr: Scan2Instruction 将一次简短的 iPhone 扫描编译成完整训练环境并自动合成带指令的导航 episode；PRPT-KS 用闭式 Pareto 效用在重建场景上直接适配策略，无需人类演示或学习型 critic。五个真实环境下真实机器人成功率 85%（基线 49%），未扫描区域 82%（基线 41%）。
AI.motivation: 公共基准上的 VLA 在新建筑中逐场景退化（布局、外观、语言漂移），而现场遥操作采集新轨迹不可扩展，因此希望用低成本场景扫描替代人类演示实现免演示的现场适配。
AI.method: 两阶段：Scan2Instruction 把单次 iPhone 扫描重建为可交互仿真训练环境，自动生成可执行导航轨迹与接地语言指令；PRPT-KS 在重建场景上构造闭式 Pareto 效用目标，直接对策略做无 critic、无标签的策略正则化/微调。
AI.result: 五个真实环境中 RealNav 达到 85% 真实机器人成功率，对比在人类演示上后训练的基线 49%；同建筑未扫描区域为 82% 对 41%。
AI.conclusion: 把"免演示的场景自适应"从构想到可运行现实；但证据为单一系统的消融式对比，缺独立复现与规模验证。

title: Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval
summary: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image's own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate's supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 在冻结的双编码器检索范式下，利用"同一图像的邻近 caption"作为辅助支持集进行推理时融合，可显著提升文本到图像检索性能；但"残差"技巧的优势实为评测偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有图像-文本检索基准与数据集普遍为每张图附多个 caption，但双编码器仍逐对独立打分，未利用同图 caption 间的邻域信息。作者系统考察：在不训练编码器的前提下，推理时引入邻近 caption 能为冻结编码器带来多少收益，以及这些收益的来源与边界条件。
AI.method: 提出推理时融合打分：将 query 与图像的相似度和 query 与该图像自身 caption 集合的相似度（max 或聚合）线性融合。在九个冻结编码器上评测；对比同源标注者 caption、现成 captioner 生成 caption、异源标注 caption 三种来源，并测试改写训练文本编码器的增益。进一步提出"残差打分"——只对 caption 未解释的图像部分打分，并用留一法评估拆分各因素贡献（支持集大小、query 移除），在固定支持索引下做消融以揭示其本质。同时在组合性基准上检验其作用机理。
AI.result: 文本到图像 R@1 提升：同源标注 caption 下 +3.4~16.8 点；现成 captioner 生成 caption 下 +1.9~7.2 点；异源标注 caption 下 ≤1 点。改写训练的文本编码器进一步增强文本侧。留一法下残差打分看似增益更大，但拆解表明正样本候选的支持集构建方式与负样本不同，集合大小与 query 移除各贡献约一半；固定支持索引后，残差退化为对 caption 已有信息的重加权。组合性基准上，caption 的作用是把候选匹配到人类描述，而非改善图文定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 邻近 caption 是有价值的免费检索信号，但收益高度依赖 caption 与 query 的标注源一致性；表面上的"残差精修"优势主要是评测协议造成的假象而非真实新信息。提示多 caption 基准在留一法评测下需警惕支持集不对称带来的乐观偏差。

title: ProMo3D: Probing Motion Cues in Frozen 3D Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). Poster: this https URL
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models have recently reshaped multi-view reconstruction, yet dynamic 4D understanding still often relies on large-scale motion supervision or hand-crafted, architecture-specific heuristics. We ask whether frozen 3D foundation model tokens already encode motion-relevant information that can be exposed by lightweight readout functions, rather than re-learning motion-specific features with high-capacity decoders. Through probing on three representative backbones, we find that static--dynamic separation is decodable from frozen token representations. Our rank-restricted and spectral analyses on $\pi^3$X reveal that the recovered motion cues are concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this, we propose Probing-based Motion Distillation (PMD), which converts pairwise motion-state compatibility scores against a fixed anchor token into dense motion masks. Trained on only 160 YouTube-VOS videos using a single 16 GB GPU, PMD transfers zero-shot to DAVIS, SegTrackv2, and FBMS-59 without target-benchmark fine-tuning. With multi-view pretrained geometric backbones, PMD outperforms training-free heuristics and approaches substantially heavier supervised and self-supervised methods, suggesting that motion decoding from frozen 3D foundation models can be lightweight and data-efficient.

AI.tldr: 探究冻结的前馈3D基础模型token是否已隐含运动信息，并通过轻量探针读出转换为稠密运动掩码（PMD），仅用160个视频、单卡16GB训练即可零样本迁移到多个视频分割基准。
AI.motivation: 动态4D理解目前依赖大规模运动监督或针对特定架构的手工启发式规则，成本高且不通用；作者希望验证冻结的3D基础模型表征中是否已存在可解码的运动线索，从而以轻量读出替代重训练运动专用特征。
AI.method: 在三种代表性骨干上做探针（probing）实验，证明静态-动态可分性可从冻结token解码；对π³X进行秩受限与谱分析，发现运动线索集中于低维子空间；据此提出PMD：用固定锚点token计算成对运动状态兼容性分数，转换为稠密运动掩码。
AI.result: 仅用160个YouTube-VOS视频、单张16GB GPU训练，零样本迁移到DAVIS、SegTrackv2、FBMS-59无需目标基准微调；在多视角预训练几何骨干下优于免训练启发式方法，并接近更重的有监督/自监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 冻结3D基础模型的运动解码可以是轻量且数据高效的，探针式蒸馏为4D动态理解提供了低成本替代方案。

title: RoboWorM: Evaluating Movement Realism, Consistency and Acceleration Affects in Embodied Video World Models
summary: Video world models (VWMs) are rapidly emerging as scalable neural simulators for robotic manipulation. However, most benchmarks only evaluate them as open-world video generators, using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that lack strict 3D spatial and kinematic reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboWorM, a comprehensive, deployment-aware benchmark that leverages known hardware priors such as robot kinematic trees and fixed camera configurations, to systematically examine structural and spatiotemporal fidelity. RoboWorM curates 1,605 episodes across single-arm, bimanual, and humanoid morphologies, spanning both Markovian and long-horizon non-Markovian tasks under single- and multi-view setups. To explicitly measure physical consistency, we propose two deterministic, VLM-free metrics: KIVA for intra-view kinematic stability, and RIGIS for multi-view geometric consistency. By exploiting intrinsic robotic invariants, KIVA improves hallucination detection alignment with human annotations by 25.8% relative to the strongest frontier VLMs, while RIGIS achieves a 130% higher Spearman correlation with human preferences. Furthermore, since real-world deployment requires low inference latency, we utilize RoboWorM to conduct the first large-scale audit of the quality-efficiency trade-off. Evaluating 9 state-of-the-art acceleration techniques across 3 leading world models (over 29,000 generated rollouts), we demonstrate how these acceleration methods can retain superficial visual quality while silently compromising deployment-critical physical constraints. Using our metrics, we achieve 2.3$\times$ maximum inference speed-up with minimal quality loss.

AI.tldr: RoboWorM：面向视频世界模型（VWM）的部署感知机器人基准，利用运动学树与固定相机先验，提出无VLM的确定性指标KIVA（视图内运动学稳定性）与RIGIS（多视图几何一致性），并首次大规模审计加速技术的质量-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有VWM基准仅按开放世界视频生成器评估，且使用缺乏严格3D空间与运动学推理的VLM评测，无法反映机器人部署所需的物理与几何保真度。
AI.method: 构建1,605条episode数据集，覆盖单臂/双臂/人形、马尔可夫与长程非马尔可夫任务、单/多视图；基于机器人硬件先验设计两个确定性、免VLM指标：KIVA（视图内运动学稳定性）与RIGIS（多视图几何一致性）；并在9种加速技术×3个主流世界模型、超29,000条rollout上做效率-质量审计。
AI.result: KIVA幻觉检测与人类标注对齐度比最强前沿VLM高25.8%；RIGIS与人类偏好的Spearman相关提升130%；加速方法可在保持表面视觉质量的同时悄悄破坏部署关键物理约束；借助所提指标实现2.3×推理加速且质量损失极小。
AI.conclusion: 以机器人内在不变量驱动的确定性指标优于VLM评测，可揭示加速带来的隐性物理退化；但工作偏基准与评测工具，未提出新的世界模型或生成方法。

title: Grounded Exploration for Open-Ended Image Editing
summary: Open-ended image-editing requests, such as ``decorate this room,'' admit multiple valid realizations. Direct sampling may produce ungrounded variation, whereas explicit diversity prompting often produces superficial differences. We study how to ground these requests without prematurely eliminating their legitimate ambiguity. We introduce a two-stage framework that first identifies diverse, feasible edit scopes and then realizes them as executable edit instructions. Across 300 open-ended image-editing tasks, our approach achieves 24.6% higher mean semantic dispersion and 17.1% higher mean groundedness than direct diversity prompting, while producing more valid and distinct realizations. These results show that structuring feasible edit directions before realization supports more useful grounded exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段图像编辑框架：先辨识多样且可行的编辑方向（scope），再将其落实为可执行编辑指令，以在保留合理歧义的前提下提升"有根基"的开放性图像编辑多样性。
AI.motivation: 开放式图像编辑请求（如"装饰这个房间"）存在多种合理解，直接采样会产生无根基的随机变化，而显式多样性提示往往只带来表面差异。目标是既保留合法歧义、又让多样性"有依据"。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段生成多样且可行的编辑范围/方向，第二阶段将其实现为可执行的编辑指令（指令化落地）。在300个开放式图像编辑任务上，与直接多样性提示基线对比。
AI.result: 平均语义离散度提升24.6%，平均groundedness提升17.1%，同时产出更多有效且互异的编辑结果。
AI.conclusion: 在实现之前先结构化"可行编辑方向"，能支撑更有用的、有根基的开放式探索；多样性应来源于对合理编辑空间的分解而非提示扰动。

title: Grounding on Request: Learning Modality Control in Vision-Language Models
summary: When an image and its caption disagree, can a user reliably control which one a vision-language model (VLM) follows? Accuracy alone cannot answer this question, since a model might give the correct answer from parametric knowledge without following the requested evidence. We therefore evaluate modality grounding control through conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions. Specifically, Flip measures whether an initially correct answer follows an edit to the requested modality, while Stay measures whether it remains stable when the competing modality is edited. To learn this control, we build on neologism learning by introducing new words for visual and textual grounding, training only their embeddings while keeping the pretrained model fixed. We also introduce Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM) supervision, which uses paired interventions to teach how answer probabilities should change when the requested evidence changes. Across three VLMs on three existing benchmarks and our multi-attribute Ground-CF benchmark, we find that learned modality words improve control over natural-language instructions. Surprisingly, a single learned embedding per modality provides strong lightweight visual control and shows little average degradation on held-out values. LoRA remains strongest overall, although its visual advantage narrows under held-out evaluation. Moreover, counterfactual supervision improves control in several settings where standard supervision is weaker. Finally, we test our method on real-world news video and find that visual control improves when the relevant evidence is made easier to access. Overall, our results show that reliable modality control requires testing not only whether an answer is correct, but whether it continues to follow edits to the modality of choice.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"冲突保持的反事实干预"来评估VLM对模态指令（图像vs文本）的可控性（Flip/Stay指标），并通过为视觉/文本接地学习新词嵌入+反事实孪生边际(CTM)监督实现轻量级模态控制。
AI.motivation: 仅看准确率无法判断模型是否真正遵循用户指定的模态：模型可能凭参数知识答对而不理会所请求的证据。因此需要在图文冲突场景下检验模态接地控制能力。
AI.method: 构造保留冲突的反事实干预：Flip衡量答案是否随被请求模态的编辑而改变，Stay衡量竞争模态被编辑时答案是否稳定。借鉴新词学习，为"视觉接地"和"文本接地"各引入一个新词，仅训练其嵌入、冻结预训练模型；并提出Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM)监督，用成对干预教模型在被请求证据变化时如何调整答案概率。构建多属性Ground-CF基准。
AI.result: 在3个VLM、3个现有基准及Ground-CF上：学习到的模态词比自然语言指令带来更强控制；每个模态单个嵌入即可提供强轻量视觉控制，且held-out取值上平均退化很小；LoRA整体最强但视觉优势在held-out下收窄；反事实监督在标准监督较弱的多个设置下提升控制；在真实新闻视频上，当相关证据更易获取时视觉控制提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的模态控制不仅要测答案是否正确，还要测答案是否持续跟随所选模态的编辑；冲突保持的反事实评估是必要补充。

title: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
comment: CVPR 2026. 18 pages, 14 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: Language is a natural way to command robots, but converting a single instruction into a long-horizon, contact-rich hand-object interaction remains challenging: synthesized references are noisy, human-to-robot retargeting introduces embodiment bias, and fixed-reference tracking lets small errors snowball. We address this with AdaDexTrack, a modulator-in-the-loop framework for language-conditioned manipulation tracking. A distilled generalist tracker serves as the skill carrier, while a tightly aligned modulator performs three feedback corrections: reference modulation (continual adjustment of what to track), object-latent modulation (online adaptation of the object representation to recruit suitable skills), and positional-target modulation (small state-dependent refinements for execution). The tracker is learned via large-scale specialist to generalist distillation on a corpus of language-conditioned hand-object trajectories; the modulator is trained with RL under the same task objective, ensuring tight coupling. Across large-scale evaluations, AdaDexTrack consistently outperforms prior SOTA on unseen-trajectory and unseen-object sets in both average tracking error and success rate, demonstrating robustness and generalization. We further show zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on real hardware, where adding the modulator yields substantial gains over a tracker-only variant. AdaDexTrack reframes language-conditioned dexterous manipulation as modulated tracking, replacing the open-loop, fixed-reference tracking with in-loop modulation that adjusts the reference, object latent, and positional target, yielding drift-resistant execution from noisy text references.

AI.tldr: AdaDexTrack：将语言条件的灵巧手物操作重构为"调制式跟踪"，用蒸馏的通用跟踪器作技能载体，配合RL训练的在线调制器对参考轨迹、物体latent与位置目标做闭环修正，提升鲁棒性与零样本sim-to-real。
AI.motivation: 单句语言指令转长时序、富接触手物交互困难：合成参考含噪、人到手重定向存在具身偏差、固定参考跟踪使小误差累积雪崩。
AI.method: Modulator-in-the-loop框架：(1) 通用跟踪器经大规模专家→通才蒸馏获得（语言条件手物轨迹语料）；(2) 调制器以RL在同一任务目标下训练，实现三重反馈：参考调制（持续调整跟踪目标）、物体latent调制（在线适配物体表征以调用合适技能）、位置目标调制（状态依赖的小幅执行修正）。
AI.result: 大规模评测中在未见轨迹与未见物体集合上，平均跟踪误差与成功率均优于此前SOTA；真机零样本sim-to-real显示加入调制器后显著优于仅跟踪器版本。
AI.conclusion: 以"调制式跟踪"替代开环固定参考跟踪，通过闭环调制参考、物体latent与位置目标，实现抗漂移执行，验证了框架的鲁棒性与泛化性。

title: TrackTok: Object-Centric Video Tokenization with Semantically Persistent Tokens
summary: We introduce TrackTok, an efficient video tokenization framework that produces object-centric tokens, i.e., tokens that consistently encode the same semantic objects across time, even as it moves, deforms, or undergoes partial occlusion. Conventional patch-based or existing holistic tokenizers produce token identities often tied to fixed image locations. In contrast, our approach learns temporally persistent object-centric representations that bind visual features across frames into stable semantic units. This enables substantially more compact, continuous latent video representations, reducing the number of tokens required for downstream generative modeling with state-of-the-art flow models, while preserving the semantic structure needed for high-quality synthesis. Our tokenizer offers a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. TrackTok achieves comparable class-conditional generative FVD on UCF-101 dataset at 8 times fewer latent tokens and better latency, and outperforms existing 1D tokenization baselines on frame prediction task on Kinetics-600 across low token budgets. These results suggest that object-aligned and temporally persistent tokenization is a promising direction for scalable video generation, where reducing latent token counts is critical for efficient modeling. Our code for this work is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TrackTok learns object-centric, temporally persistent video tokens that bind the same semantic object across frames despite motion, deformation, and occlusion, yielding 8x fewer latent tokens with comparable generation quality.
AI.motivation: Patch-based and holistic video tokenizers tie token identity to fixed image locations, so latent sequences are redundant and long, which is costly for downstream generative modeling.
AI.method: A video tokenization framework that learns temporally persistent object-centric representations binding visual features across frames into stable semantic units, producing compact continuous latent video representations for flow-model-based generation.
AI.result: On UCF-101 class-conditional generation, comparable FVD with 8x fewer latent tokens and better latency; outperforms existing 1D tokenization baselines on Kinetics-600 frame prediction under low token budgets.
AI.conclusion: Object-aligned, temporally persistent tokenization is a promising direction for scalable video generation where reducing latent token counts is critical. Code is released.

title: Securing Edge & Physical AI: Post-Quantum IoT Blockchain for Mission-Critical Cyber-Physical Agents
comment: 47 pages, 39 figures, 10 tables, 5 algorithms, to be published in IEEE IoTJ, Science Directy (Elseiver IoTJ, Embodied Intelligence in Physical Systems)
summary: Distributed Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) and Edge AI networks increasingly depend on public-key authentication and key-establishment mechanisms that are vulnerable to cryptographically relevant Quantum Computers (QC). Shor's algorithm threatens widely deployed asymmetric primitives, while Grover's algorithm reduces the effective security margins of symmetric and hash-based mechanisms. Although Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) provides a migration path, its larger public keys, ciphertexts, and signatures introduce additional computation, memory, communication, storage, and packet-fragmentation costs that can constrain dynamic multi-agent systems. In this article, we introduce rotational secrecy, an architectural objective that limits temporal key exposure through authenticated transitions between cryptographic epochs. We present Private Authentication for Rotational Secrecy (PARS), a reference mechanism that coordinates policy-triggered key establishment, rotation, and reconciliation among authorized Physical AI agents. For deployments that need distributed agreement on security state, we further develop the PARS-Enabled Edge Security Ledger (PARS-ESL), an optional permissioned architecture maintained by authorized validators or capable edge gateways. PARS-ESL does not store high-volume operational transactions. Instead, it records authenticated state for key epochs, group membership, revocation, algorithm-suite policies, challenge validation, and recovery checkpoints. As a result, resource-constrained agents can take part as lightweight clients, and low-latency operational traffic stays outside the ledger consensus path, protected by the currently active symmetric epoch keys. Our results show that ledger-assisted post-quantum key-epoch management is feasible for selected Edge AI and CPS security-control workloads under the stated trust, compromise, connectivity, and resource assumptions.

AI.tldr: 提出"轮转保密性"(rotational secrecy)架构目标与PARS机制，通过认证化的密钥纪元(epoch)切换来限制密钥的时序暴露；并给出可选的许可链PARS-ESL，仅记录密钥纪元/成员/撤销/算法策略/恢复检查点等安全状态，操作流量仍走当前对称密钥而不进入共识路径。
AI.motivation: 分布式CPS与Edge AI依赖的公钥认证/密钥建立机制在量子计算威胁下失效（Shor/Grover），而PQC迁移带来公钥、密文、签名膨胀，导致算力、内存、通信、存储与分片开销，制约动态多智能体系统。
AI.method: 定义rotational secrecy目标；设计PARS参考机制，协调策略触发的密钥建立、轮转与协商，支持授权Physical AI agent之间的认证化纪元迁移；进一步提出PARS-ESL：由授权验证者或边缘网关维护的许可式账本，仅存储密钥纪元、组成员、撤销、算法套件策略、挑战校验与恢复检查点等认证状态，资源受限agent作为轻客户端接入。
AI.result: 在给定的信任、妥协、连通性与资源假设下，账本辅助的后量子密钥纪元管理对选定的Edge AI与CPS安全控制类工作负载可行；方法以架构与机制论述为主，摘要未给出量化实验数据。
AI.conclusion: PQC迁移的可行性可通过"减少密钥暴露窗口"的纪元轮转架构缓解，而非单纯追求更大参数；将分布式共识限制在低频安全状态上、把高频操作流量留在对称加密路径，是资源受限边缘智能体可行的折中方案。

title: RoboLongR: Causally Consistent Rewards Teach Robots to Progressively Master Long-Horizon Manipulation
comment: 11 pages including appendices, 8 figures, 6 tables. Project website: this https URL
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires actions whose validity depends on earlier interactions, yet visual progress can conceal missing task prerequisites. We propose RoboLongR, an offline-to-online framework that learns history-dependent rewards to guide policy adaptation to new tasks. Its central objective is causal consistency: aligning rewarded progress with prerequisites supported by execution history. Stage-shuffle supervision encourages execution-order sensitivity, recurrent memory preserves evidence of earlier interactions, and two-round training refines trajectory segments using predicted progress. The resulting rewards guide stage-conditioned policy refinement from behavior cloning to online reinforcement learning. Sparse terminal feedback connects policy experience to reward learning by triggering correction for repeated high-scoring failures. Pretrained on demonstrations from 88 RLBench tasks and Open-X data, RoboLongR achieves 31.8% average success on 18 long-horizon tasks excluded from reward pretraining, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.2 percentage points. Across four real-robot tasks, it achieves 57.5% success, a 32.5-percentage-point improvement over the comparison method. Reward-level controls probe sensitivity to synthetic order perturbations, while ablations examine the contributions of individual components to policy improvement.

AI.tldr: RoboLongR 是一个 offline-to-online 框架，学习"历史依赖"的进度奖励（强调因果一致性），用 stage-shuffle 监督、循环记忆与两轮训练产生奖励，再以稀疏终局反馈触发纠正，进而把行为克隆策略逐步精炼为在线 RL，在 18 个未见过长时域 RLBench 任务上平均成功率 31.8%（+9.2pp），4 个真机任务 57.5%（+32.5pp）。
AI.motivation: 长时域操作中，动作的有效性依赖此前交互历史；仅靠视觉进度容易"看起来完成"却遗漏必要前置条件（prerequisite），导致奖励被错误地赋给未真正满足因果前提的轨迹段。
AI.method: 提出因果一致性目标：奖励的进度须与执行历史所能支撑的前置条件对齐。技术手段包括（1）stage-shuffle 监督，打乱阶段顺序以迫使模型对执行顺序敏感；（2）循环记忆保留早期交互证据；（3）两轮训练用预测进度对轨迹片段做再精炼；（4）稀疏终局反馈将策略经验回传奖励学习，对反复高分但失败的情形触发纠正；最终奖励用于驱动的阶段条件策略从 BC 到 online RL 的迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在 88 个 RLBench 任务与 Open-X 数据上预训练奖励，在奖励预训练中未出现的 18 个长时域任务上平均成功率 31.8%，超过最强基线 9.2 个百分点；4 个真机任务成功率 57.5%，相对对比方法提升 32.5 个百分点。另有奖励层面的顺序扰动敏感性实验与组件消融。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模"执行历史—前置条件"的因果一致性可显著提升长时域操作的奖励可靠性与策略迁移性；offline 奖励预训练 + 稀疏终局在线纠正是一条实用的长时域操作路径，具备真机有效性验证。

title: Late Breaking Results: Audio-Language-Action Models with Direct Speech Conditioning for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to DAC 2026 Late Breaking Results
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to follow instructions in typed text, limiting broader deployment in natural speech. The traditional solution by prepending a speech recognition before VLA to convert speech into texts would incur additional latency and propagate errors. To address this, we present Speech-$\pi_{0.5}$, which maps raw speech directly to motor commands without explicit textual transcriptions. Specifically, built on $\pi_{0.5}$, we use a cross-modal projection to convert voice frames directly into audio tokens with significant response latency reduction. To further improve the accuracy, we adopt split LoRA adaptation with dedicated audio and task adapters, under a two-stage training. Speech-$\pi_{0.5}$ achieves $3\times$ lower response latency than ASR pipeline while maintaining competitive task success on LIBERO, and generalizes robustly to unseen accents where a single adapter degrades significantly.

AI.tldr: Speech-π0.5 将原始语音通过跨模态投影直接映射为音频 token 输入 π0.5 VLA 模型，省去显式文本转录，并采用音频/任务分离的 split LoRA 与两阶段训练，实现低延迟且高鲁棒性的语音驱动机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅接受文本指令，而"ASR + VLA"级联方案会引入额外响应延迟并造成识别错误传播，因此需要将语音直接映射到动作指令。
AI.method: 基于 π0.5，用跨模态投影将语音帧直接转为音频 token 输入模型；采用分离的音频 LoRA 适配器与任务 LoRA 适配器，并配合两阶段训练流程。
AI.result: 相比 ASR 级联管线响应延迟降低约 3 倍，同时在 LIBERO 上保持有竞争力的任务成功率；在未见口音上泛化稳健，而单一 LoRA 适配器在口音泛化上明显退化。
AI.conclusion: 端到端语音到动作的多模态适配是替代 ASR 级联的可行路径，分离式 LoRA 设计对声学域偏移的鲁棒性至关重要。

title: RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting
summary: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.

AI.tldr: RelateGS：一种结构化语言感知3D高斯表示，通过抑制不可靠观测并进行多视角语义聚合、将物体观测整合为持久3D图，识别欠观测的物体关系并回查已有帧补充证据，从而提升3D视觉定位。
AI.motivation: 现有语言感知3DGS工作注重语义与关系信息的表示，但关系型定位还依赖场景侧证据是否可靠充分：多视角语义聚合会引入弱观测，而沿给定相机轨迹某些物体关系观测不足，导致目标消歧证据模糊。
AI.method: 在语义特征上采样阶段抑制不可靠观测；将多视角物体观测整合为持久3D关系图；由图识别欠观测的物体关系，并引导对已有信息量大的帧进行定向再查询以补全证据；整体嵌入3DGS框架实现选择性精炼语义与关系证据。
AI.result: 在Sr3D+和Nr3D数据集上取得有竞争力的3D grounding性能，Acc@0.25分别比此前最佳提升7.9和1.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 证据可靠性筛选与基于图的关系欠观测再查询是提升语言驱动3D定位的关键，且无需新视角采集即可补全关系证据。

title: Stable Dimensionality Reduction via Isometric Centroid-Encoder
summary: Many supervised dimensionality reduction methods promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation but do not explicitly constrain class geometry, leading to variability in the relative arrangement of classes across independent runs. Such variability limits the reproducibility and interpretability of low-dimensional embeddings. We propose the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework in which class centroids are learned directly in the latent space while preserving a prescribed pairwise class-centroid geometry. Unlike existing centroid- or prototype-based methods that primarily encourage intra-class compactness, ICE explicitly regularizes the relative arrangement of latent class centroids. Unlike multidimensional scaling and many metric-learning approaches that preserve sample-level relationships, ICE operates on class centroids, preserving inter-class geometry without requiring large numbers of sample-pair or triplet constraints. We further show that the intrinsic dimensionality required to represent the centroid-distance configuration of $M$ classes is at most $M-1$, explaining the observed saturation of distance-preservation measures as the latent dimensionality increases. To quantify embedding reproducibility, we introduce the Centroid Neighborhood Stability (CNS) metric, which measures the consistency of class-level neighborhood topology across independent runs and complements existing embedding quality measures. Experiments on image and biological datasets demonstrate that ICE produces stable embeddings with improved preservation of class-centroid geometry while remaining computationally efficient. Additional analyses of optimization dynamics, sensitivity, and preprocessing further provide practical insights into latent dimensionality and explicit geometry modeling for supervised dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出等距质心编码器（ICE），在学习潜在空间类别质心的同时显式约束类间质心距离几何（等距保持），并证明M类质心距离构型的内在维度至多M-1；引入质心邻域稳定性（CNS）指标衡量嵌入可复现性。
AI.motivation: 现有监督降维方法（如质心/原型类方法）只鼓励类内紧致与类间分离，不显式约束类的几何构型，导致不同独立运行间类间相对布局变化大，损害低维嵌入的可复现性与可解释性。
AI.method: 监督降维框架：在潜在空间直接学习类质心，并加入保持预设成对类质心几何（相异度矩阵）的正则项；与MDS/度量学习不同，约束作用在类别质心层面而非样本对/三元组上，约束数量小、计算高效。理论上给出M类质心距离构型所需内在维度上界M-1，并定义CNS指标度量多次独立运行中类别级邻域拓扑的一致性。另附优化动态、敏感性与预处理分析。
AI.result: 在图像与生物数据集上，ICE产生更稳定的嵌入，类质心几何保持更好，同时计算开销低；实验观察到随着潜在维度增加，距离保持度量出现饱和，与M-1理论界一致。
AI.conclusion: 对类别级几何施加显式等距约束可在低计算成本下提升监督降维嵌入的可复现性与可解释性，CNS可作为现有嵌入质量指标的有效补充；并给出潜在维度选择的实用建议。

title: Semantic Concept Steering Breaks the Explanation Drift Loop in Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting in continual learning (CL) manifests not only as accuracy degradation but also as \emph{explanation drift}: models maintain predictive accuracy while silently shifting attention from diagnostic features to spurious correlations. This work identifies and resolves a previously overlooked structural flaw in explanation-aware CL: pixel-level saliency regularization derives supervision targets from the model's own frozen saliency maps, creating a \emph{self-referential drift loop} that actively reinforces spurious attention across tasks. We introduce \textbf{C$^3$L} (Concept-Consistent Continual Learning), which breaks this loop by anchoring regularization to class-consistent semantic concepts (e.g., ``curved beak'', ``striped pattern'') discovered offline, independent of model state, providing (i) target independence from model drift, and (ii) cross-instance semantic consistency across every instance of a class. We identify that our concept-based objective, combined with approximate LRP relevance conservation, induces a \emph{crowding-out effect}: since concept and background regions compete for the relevance of the same prediction, enforcing high relevance within concept regions implicitly suppresses spurious background correlations without explicit penalization. \method does not require human-annotated concept sets, as it employs a fully automated concept discovery and spatial grounding. Extensive evaluation across five benchmarks and over 20 baselines demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in accuracy, forgetting, explanation quality, spurious correlation mitigation, and out-of-distribution robustness.

AI.tldr: C³L identifies a self-referential drift loop in explanation-aware continual learning and replaces pixel-level saliency regularization with offline-discovered class-consistent semantic concepts, achieving SOTA accuracy, forgetting, and explanation quality across five benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Continual learning suffers not only accuracy degradation but "explanation drift": models keep accuracy while shifting attention from diagnostic features to spurious correlations. Existing explanation-aware CL methods regularize on pixel-level saliency maps derived from the model's own frozen maps, creating a self-referential loop that reinforces spurious attention across tasks.
AI.method: C³L (Concept-Consistent Continual Learning) anchors regularization to class-consistent semantic concepts (e.g., "curved beak") discovered offline, independent of model state, giving target independence from model drift and cross-instance semantic consistency. Combined with approximate LRP relevance conservation, this induces a "crowding-out effect": concept and background regions compete for the same prediction relevance, so enforcing high relevance in concept regions implicitly suppresses spurious background attention without explicit penalization. Concept discovery and spatial grounding are fully automated, requiring no human annotation.
AI.result: Across five benchmarks and 20+ baselines, C³L achieves state-of-the-art performance in accuracy, forgetting, explanation quality, spurious correlation mitigation, and out-of-distribution robustness.
AI.conclusion: Self-referential saliency regularization is structurally flawed for explanation-aware CL; anchoring to model-independent, class-consistent concepts plus LRP relevance conservation resolves explanation drift, and the implicit crowding-out mechanism suffices in place of explicit background penalization.

title: WMEval: Evaluating Interactive World Models Grounded on Physical Simulations
summary: Interactive world models hold immense potential for high-stakes applications in robotics, game engines, and immersive digital twins, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual similarity rather than the physical-causal coherence essential for real-world utility. We introduce WMEval, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates interactive world models against Unity-based physical simulations. By leveraging Unity as a high-fidelity ground-truth oracle, we shift evaluation beyond perceptual visual assessment toward the objective state-based verification required for downstream applications. Spanning 9 diverse scenes, WMEval assesses action controllability, scene and character consistency, prompt adherence, kinematics, fluid mechanics, physical causality, and lighting. By executing matched action sequences in both the simulator and the world model, WMEval enables evaluation at both the perceptual level and the physical-causal level, using simulator-derived states as reference. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal significant room for improvement in dimensions that remain hidden by standard perceptual metrics but are vital for real-world deployments. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: WMEval：以Unity物理仿真为高保真真值预言机，对交互式世界模型进行感知层面与物理-因果层面的双层评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型（机器人、游戏引擎、数字孪生）基准主要度量感知相似度，缺乏对下游部署至关重要的物理-因果一致性验证；作者希望把评测从"看起来像"推进到基于仿真状态的客观检验。
AI.method: 构建WMEval基准：在9个多样场景中，用Unity物理仿真作为真值源，在仿真器与世界模型中执行同一动作序列，用仿真器导出的状态作参考，评测动作可控性、场景与角色一致性、提示词遵循、运动学、流体力学、物理因果性和光照等多个维度。
AI.result: 对当前最先进世界模型的实验表明，在标准感知指标下被掩盖、但对真实部署至关重要的物理-因果维度上仍有显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型评测需超越像素级相似度，转向基于状态的物理-因果验证；WMEval提供了可复用的评测框架（代码已开源）。

title: Sybil-Resilient Multi-Drone Exploration of Indoor and Confined Spaces
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, and 8 tables. Code, worlds and mission results: this https URL
summary: When a team of drones explores a building together, each drone tells the others which frontier it is going to and shares the map it has built. This avoids duplicated effort, but it also means that the team trusts every identity from which it receives messages. In a Sybil attack, one compromised drone creates fake identities, and these fake teammates claim frontiers and send fabricated scans, so the real drones leave parts of the building unexplored and end up with walls in their maps that do not exist. We study five such attackers, including one that seals off the openings between floors, and five levels of defence that need no security infrastructure, only the drones' own sensors and maps: an audit of received map data against what a drone sees itself, a check that a body is present where an identity claims to be, trust only for identities whose body has been seen, a quarantine for identities that no drone has observed, and a rule that binds each observed body to one identity. Tests in simulation cover 70 maps of seven kinds, from offices and tunnels to three-storey buildings and caves. Without a defence, one compromised drone leaves on average up to 25% of a map unexplored (45% in offices), and the floor-sealing attacker cuts the explored part of a three-storey building to 82.3%, or 34.6% on the worst map. The quarantine brings exploration back to the level of an unattacked team in every setting, and in most settings it also brings the false data back to that level. The exceptions are two colluding attackers, fakes placed next to real drones, three of the ten caves and a team of 16 drones, and binding bodies to identities fixes the last three. Over 2,350 missions, an honest drone was revoked by a teammate only twice.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多无人机协同探索建筑时的Sybil攻击（单个被入侵无人机伪造身份抢占前沿、下发伪造扫描），提出五种仅依赖自身传感器与地图、无需安全基础设施的防御（地图数据审计、身份处身体存在性核查、仅信任已观测身体的身份、未观测身份隔离、身体-身份唯一绑定），并在70张七类地图上测试五种攻击者。
AI.motivation: 多无人机共享地图与前沿可减少重复探索，但也意味着团队盲目信任任何发信身份；Sybil攻击者可伪造多个“队友”抢占前沿并注入虚假扫描，导致真实无人机漏探区域、地图中出现不存在的墙。现有方法多依赖PKI/区块链等安全基础设施，而实际无人机编队往往缺乏此类设施，因此需要仅基于本体传感器与地图的轻量防御。
AI.method: 提出五种攻击者（含“楼层封堵”型，封住层间开口）与五级递进防御：(1) 将收到的地图数据与自身观测比对审计；(2) 核查某身份声称位置是否有实体存在；(3) 仅信任已被亲眼观测到实体的身份；(4) 对无任何无人机观测到的身份进行隔离；(5) 将每个已观测实体与唯一身份绑定。在70张、七类地图（办公室、隧道、三层建筑、洞穴等）的仿真中进行评估。
AI.result: 无防御时单个被入侵无人机平均使最多25%地图未被探索（办公室达45%）；楼层封堵攻击者使三层建筑探索率降至82.3%，最差地图降至34.6%。隔离机制在所有设置下将探索恢复到未受攻击队伍水平，多数设置下虚假数据亦恢复到该水平。失效情形包括两类合谋攻击者、伪造身份被置于真实无人机近旁、10个洞穴中的3个、以及16机编队；后三者（含）可由身体-身份绑定修复。2350余次任务中，诚实无人机仅2次被队友撤销。
