AI.conclusion: 无需密码学基础设施，仅凭本体传感器一致性校验与实体-身份绑定，即可使多机协同SLAM/探索对Sybil注入与伪造扫描具有强鲁棒性；剩余弱点集中于合谋攻击与近距伪造身份。局限在于仅仿真验证、未涉及真实飞控与通信层实现。

title: Rank-1 Weight-Corrected Trainable Weight Averaging for Out-of-Distribution Detection
comment: Accepted to ACCV2026 Workshop on Subspaces in the Era of Foundation Models
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection identifies inputs outside the training distribution. Rank-based analyses such as RankFeat and RankWeight suggest that OOD overconfidence is closely related to dominant low-rank components in feature and weight spaces. Since weight averaging operates directly in parameter space and improves model generalization, we consider it for OOD detection from a dominant-component perspective. Trainable Weight Averaging (TWA) assigns a single coefficient to each checkpoint, limiting independent control of dominant weight components. We extend TWA with leading rank-one weight components extracted by Singular Value Decomposition as correction directions, whose contributions are learned through the in-distribution classification objective. On ResNet50, our method improves over fine-tuning and standard TWA across the evaluated datasets with MSP and RankWeight, both with and without Outlier Exposure. Mahalanobis-based evaluation yields mixed results, indicating that the benefit depends on the OOD scoring protocol. Target-layer analyses with MSP and Energy favor correction near the classifier.

AI.tldr: 用SVD提取的leading rank-one权重分量作为TWA的可学习修正方向，借ID分类目标学习其系数以改进OOD检测；ResNet50上MSP/RankWeight指标优于微调与TWA，Mahalanobis结果混合。
AI.motivation: RankFeat/RankWeight等秩分析表明OOD过置信与特征/权重空间的主导低秩分量有关；权重平均直接在参数空间操作且能提升泛化，但标准TWA对整个checkpoint只给单一系数，无法独立控制主导权重分量。
AI.method: 在TWA基础上，用SVD分解checkpoint权重并取前若干rank-one分量作为"修正方向"，与原checkpoint系数解耦，通过in-distribution分类目标端到端学习各修正方向的贡献（可配合Outlier Exposure）；并做目标层分析（MSP、Energy）。
AI.result: ResNet50上，在评估数据集上以MSP与RankWeight评测时，无论是否使用Outlier Exposure均优于fine-tuning与标准TWA；Mahalanobis评测结果好坏参半；MSP与Energy的目标层分析显示修正应靠近分类器层。
AI.conclusion: 将权重平均的主导秩一分量作为可控修正方向是可行的OOD检测增强手段，但收益依赖OOD打分协议；方法仅为参数空间微调式改进，缺少跨架构与真实部署验证。

title: Texture-Aware Strategies for Subregion Style Transfer Augmentation
comment: Published at 2026 3rd International Conference on Digital Image Processing and Computer Applications (DIPCA)
summary: A common strategy for data augmentation is to apply style transfer on training images to enrich appearance variations. Recent approaches have combined style augmentation with random erasing by selectively replacing image subregions with style-transferred patches. However, existing methods rely on uniformly random region selection or fixed geometric constraints, which may fail to cover informative texture patterns and limit augmentation diversity. To address these limitations, we propose a texture-aware subregion style augmentation framework that prioritizes regions with strong texture responses for style replacement. Furthermore, we extend this framework with a hybrid region strategy that combines a texture-driven region with an auxiliary random region, implicitly enabling more diverse style perturbations. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves higher classification accuracy and improves robustness compared with existing style-based augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出纹理感知的子区域风格增广：优先选纹理响应强的区域做风格替换，并扩展为纹理区+随机区的混合区域策略，提升分类精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有"风格增广+随机擦除"方法在子区域选择上依赖均匀随机或固定几何约束，容易错过信息量大的纹理模式，限制增广多样性。
AI.method: 以纹理响应强度对图像子区域排序，优先在强纹理区进行风格迁移替换；进一步提出混合区域策略，将纹理驱动区域与一个辅助随机区域组合，隐式引入更多样化的风格扰动。
AI.result: 在分类任务上取得更高准确率，相对现有基于风格的增广方法提升了鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数据集与数值）。
AI.conclusion: 区域选择准则（纹理感知）是风格增广中的关键设计维度，混合区域策略可进一步提升增广多样性。属通用视觉数据增广，与机器人/VLA/3D核心方向无直接关联。

title: Real-Time Human Trajectory Prediction from RGB-D for Mobile Robots Using Bi-Mamba
comment: Accepted at the 14th International Conference on Control, Mechatronics and Automation (ICCMA 2026), Bari, Italy, November 3-5, 2026. 7 pages, 6 figures
summary: Predicting the short-term future trajectory of a person from RGB-D cameras is a key capability for mobile robots navigating in dynamic and human populated environment. The key challenge to deploying learned predictors on real robots is the train-deploy pipeline gap. Training data are often prepared with an idealized, smoothed ground truth, whereas at inference, the model is fed noisy estimates from pose detectors and depth sensors. The model is therefore evaluated on an input distribution it never encountered during training. Most existing models rely on recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or transformers, which either struggle to capture short-term temporal dependencies or suffer from computational cost. We present TrajMamba, a lightweight, bidirectional state space model for short-term human trajectory prediction using an RGB-D camera. The model uses a single shared processing path for both training and deployment, aligning human pose extraction, depth back projection, and smoothing processes. It encodes a short window of persons's hip center velocities with stacked bidirectional Mamba blocks and decodes future velocities with a GRU head. On the ETH/UCY benchmark, TrajMamba reaches an average ADE of 0.29 m FDE of 0.51 m. With 262K parameters, it runs in real time on modest hardware and is deployed on a TIAGo robot with an onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin.

AI.tldr: TrajMamba：面向RGB-D移动机器人部署的轻量双向Mamba短期人体轨迹预测，统一训练/部署处理路径以缓解分布失配，262K参数、实时运行并部署于TIAGo。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人在动态人群环境中导航需预测人类短期轨迹；核心痛点是训练-部署流水线鸿沟：训练用理想化平滑真值，推理却接收姿态检测与深度反投影的噪声估计，模型面对未见分布；同时现有RNN/Transformer难以兼顾短期时序依赖与计算开销。
AI.method: 提出TrajMamba：以单个共享处理路径统一训练与部署阶段的人体姿态提取、深度反投影与平滑流程；将短时间窗内人体髋中心速度编码输入堆叠的双向Mamba块，再用GRU头解码未来速度；模型仅262K参数，可实时运行并可部署于带Jetson Orin的TIAGo机器人。
AI.result: ETH/UCY基准上平均ADE 0.29 m、FDE 0.51 m；262K参数下在普通硬件上实时运行，并在TIAGo + NVIDIA Jetson Orin实机部署。
AI.conclusion: 轻量双向状态空间模型可在保持精度的同时实现实时RGB-D人体轨迹预测，且通过训练-部署一致性设计弥合分布鸿沟，适合移动机器人实际部署。

title: TurboWAM: Learning What Matters for Fast World Action Models
comment: Technical report. Project page: this https URL
summary: World action models have demonstrated promising performance in robot policy learning, yet their high inference latency remains a critical bottleneck for real-world deployment. Recent approaches have sought to improve inference efficiency by reducing test-time future-frame imagination or accelerating action prediction. However, these methods often leverage representations from all video world model layers without explicitly considering their varying relevance to action prediction, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal representation utilization. In this work, we propose TurboWAM, a fast world action model that efficiently aggregates structured world representations conditioned on action predictions. Specifically, TurboWAM introduces a structured world representation aggregation module that adaptively fuses representations from different world model layers according to their relevance to the evolving action denoising state. Furthermore, TurboWAM employs a structured action supervision mechanism that adaptively modulates gradients from action supervision across different world model layers during backward propagation, facilitating world representation learning. During inference, by reducing the number of world model layers executed and caching relevant representations across action denoising steps, TurboWAM substantially reduces computational overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that TurboWAM achieves low inference latency while maintaining competitive task success rates compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: TurboWAM：以动作去噪状态为条件自适应聚合世界模型多层表征，并用结构化动作监督调制反向梯度；推理时减少执行层数并跨去噪步缓存表征，降低世界动作模型推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）推理延迟高，现有加速方法（减少测试时未来帧想象、加速动作预测）无差别使用全部视频世界模型层的表征，忽略其对动作预测的相关性差异，导致冗余计算与表征利用不佳。
AI.method: 提出结构化世界表征聚合模块，依据各层表征与演化中的动作去噪状态的相关性自适应融合多层特征；提出结构化动作监督机制，在反向传播中按层自适应调制动作监督梯度以促进世界表征学习；推理阶段减少执行的世界模型层数，并在动作去噪步之间缓存相关表征以降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在多个机器人操作基准上，TurboWAM 在保持与 SOTA 方法相当的任务成功率的同时实现低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 面向动作预测的层级表征选择性聚合与跨去噪步缓存，是提升世界动作模型推理效率的有效且有前景的路径。

title: Learning Functional Specialisation for Bimanual Robotic Control
summary: Bimanual robotic control requires simultaneous management of distinct functional demands under motor noise, energetic costs, and communication delays. We investigate how learning responsibility should be organised across modular controllers and the two arms in a simulated musculoskeletal system with two communicating recurrent controllers. Using a 2 x 2 design, we compare differential versus shared controller objectives and fixed versus balanced hand-task assignments. Task-aligned functional specialisation was strongest when differential objectives were combined with a fixed assignment aligned with contralateral control routing. This condition achieved the highest canonical-task performance and control efficiency, reaching 81.33% bimanual success. Its advantage over shared objectives increased with motor noise but narrowed under stronger energy penalties. Stronger specialisation also reduced hand-role flexibility: reversing the hand roles decreased bimanual success by 80.46 percentage points under Differential-Fixed training, compared with 1.51 percentage points under Shared-Balanced training. These results show that controller objectives and hand-task experience jointly determine functional organisation. Stronger role-specific specialisation favours performance and efficiency when roles remain stable, whereas more distributed training favours interchangeability when roles change.

AI.tldr: 在双通信循环控制器的仿真肌肉骨骼系统中，用2×2设计比较"差异化 vs 共享"控制器目标与"固定 vs 平衡"手-任务分配，发现差异化目标+与对侧控制通路对齐的固定分配带来最强功能特化，双任务成功率81.33%，但角色反转时性能骤降80.46个百分点。
AI.motivation: 双臂控制需在运动噪声、能量代价与通信延迟下同时满足不同功能需求；作者关心"学习责任"应如何在模块化控制器与两臂之间组织，即控制器目标设计与手-任务经验分配如何共同塑造功能组织（特化 vs 可互换）。
AI.method: 仿真肌肉骨骼双臂系统，两臂各配一个相互通信的循环控制器（recurrent controller）。采用2×2因子设计：控制器目标为差异化（differential）vs 共享（shared），手-任务分配为固定（fixed，与对侧控制路由对齐）vs 平衡（balanced）；并施加运动噪声与能量惩罚，通过角色反转实验测试手部角色灵活性。
AI.result: 差异化目标+固定分配的"任务对齐功能特化"最强，取得最高标准任务性能与控制效率，双臂成功率81.33%；相对共享目标的优势随运动噪声增大而扩大，但在更强能量惩罚下收窄。特化越强，角色灵活性越差：反转手角色使 Differential-Fixed 成功率下降80.46个百分点，而 Shared-Balanced 仅下降1.51个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 控制器目标与手-任务经验共同决定功能组织：角色稳定时，强角色特异化有利于性能与能效；角色需变化时，更分布式的训练更利于互换性。这为模块化双臂控制器的目标设计与训练分配提供了明确权衡依据。

title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
summary: Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs. As such, the dataset can also be used to post-train LLMs to strengthen their continual learning capabilities.

AI.tldr: CLE：50+领域专家构建的持续学习基准，120个任务×5级阶梯=600级，覆盖12领域89职业角色；前沿LLM最佳配置仅通过47.7%级别、全通关任务仅23.3%，反馈+修订中位提升5.3pp。
AI.motivation: 现有评测主要衡量单任务表现，而非"通过积累经验实现提升"这一持续学习核心能力，导致长时程LLM agent的持续学习能力缺乏可信度量。
AI.method: 构建120个人工撰写任务、每任务五级阶梯（共600级）的基准，跨12职业领域89个角色，逐级解锁且后级依赖前级经验；由评估agent按人工rubric自动评分；对比"单次提交"与"失败后给诊断反馈并允许一次修订"两种设置，测试17种harness-模型组合。
AI.result: 反馈+修订带来中位5.3个百分点完成率提升；最强系统仅通过47.7%的级别，仅23.3%任务完成全部五级；数据可用于后训练以强化持续学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 现有前沿LLM在经验驱动的持续学习上仍显著不足；CLE提供了可度量、可解锁式的评测范式并兼作后训练数据来源。

title: I Won't Know Until I Try: Interactive Information Gathering for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation often depends on object properties that cannot be reliably inferred from appearance alone. Physical interaction can reveal these properties, but it can also change the world in ways that invalidate subsequent actions. We present a task and motion planning (TAMP) framework that integrates task-directed interactive information-gathering with interleaved planning and execution. Building on PDDLStream, our framework plans optimistically with these interactive actions, verifies their outcomes during execution, and adapts the remaining plan by retaining still-applicable actions and replanning only the connections needed to continue execution. We evaluate the framework in simulation and on a real robot across tasks that require determining whether an object is movable, a pen has ink, a drawer can be opened, or a container is empty. These experiments demonstrate how interaction-driven state updates and recovery replanning support continued execution under uncertain outcomes and external disturbances.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 PDDLStream 的 TAMP 框架，将"任务导向的交互式信息获取动作"与规划-执行交错结合，用乐观规划+执行期验证+最小重规划恢复机制，应对物体属性不可由外观推断的长期操作任务。
AI.motivation: 长期操作依赖外观无法可靠推断的物体属性（可移动性、笔是否有墨、抽屉能否打开、容器是否为空）；物理交互可揭示这些属性，但交互本身会改变世界状态、使后续动作失效。现有 TAMP 缺少对"有副作用的交互信息获取"的统一建模与执行期恢复。
AI.method: 在 PDDLStream 上构建 TAMP 框架：把交互动作（推/拉/抓取试探等）建模为带信息收益与状态变更的流；先做乐观规划，执行中验证交互结果，若与预期不符则保留仍可用的动作、仅重规划衔接部分（recovery replanning），实现规划-执行交错。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人上验证四类需属性判定的任务（物体可移动性、笔是否有墨、抽屉可否打开、容器是否为空）；实验显示交互驱动的状态更新与恢复重规划可在结果不确定和外部扰动下维持执行。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模交互信息获取并结合执行期验证与最小重规划，是一种切实可行的长时序操作不确定性问题处理范式；但实验规模较小、缺乏与强基线/学习的对比，深度感知与泛化性证据有限。

title: Accuracy Is Not Enough: An Efficiency- and Statistics-Aware Benchmark of ResNet50 and Vision Transformer for Explainable Multi-Class Gastrointestinal Diseases Classification
summary: Automated classification of gastrointestinal (GI) findings in endoscopic images could support early diagnosis, but architectures are often chosen on accuracy alone. We present a controlled, reproducible benchmark of ResNet50 and ViT-B/16 for eight-class GI classification on the public Kvasir dataset (4,000 images), using a stratified split (400 test images) and stratified group 5-fold cross-validation over all images. In cross-validation, ResNet50 and ViT-B/16 reached 92.12% and 91.70% accuracy, and a two one-sided tests (TOST) procedure showed equivalence within a +/-3 percentage-point margin (difference +0.43 points, 90% CI -0.33 to +1.18; p < 0.001). The architectures differed mainly in cost: ResNet50 had 3.6 times fewer parameters and 4.3 times fewer operations, 2.5-fold lower single-image CPU latency (69 vs. 177 ms) and 3.8-fold higher GPU throughput. Cross-validated calibration was similar (expected calibration error 0.021 vs. 0.023). An edge-oriented transformer, MobileViT-S, was most accurate on the test split (95.5%) but lost 9.4 points when an acquisition artefact present in some classes (the ScopeGuide inset) was occluded, whereas ResNet50 was not significantly affected. On 500 unseen polyp images with expert masks, both models' Grad-CAM maps focused on the lesion (3.6 times chance). On a de-duplicated external subset of GastroVision (1,998 images), accuracy fell to 78-80% for all three models and differences between them remained small. Accuracy differences between architectures were thus small relative to the effects of shortcut learning and domain shift, whereas efficiency differences were large. An efficient CNN is a defensible default for resource-constrained screening, but no model is deployment-ready without local validation.

AI.tldr: 在Kvasir内镜数据集上对ResNet50与ViT-B/16做受控可复现基准：交叉验证精度等价（92.12% vs 91.70%，TOST等价），差异主要体现在效率（参数3.6倍、运算4.3倍、CPU延迟2.5倍）；但快捷方式学习与域偏移（GastroVision外部集掉至78–80%）的影响远大于架构差异。
AI.motivation: 内镜图像自动分类有助于消化道疾病早筛，但架构选型通常只看精度，忽视效率与鲁棒性；作者希望给出兼顾精度等价性检验、计算成本、校准、快捷方式依赖与域偏移的规范化基准。
AI.method: 在Kvasir（4,000张、8类）上采用分层划分（400张测试）与分层分组5折交叉验证；对ResNet50与ViT-B/16做TOST等价检验（±3个百分点）、参数量/FLOPs/CPU延迟/GPU吞吐/ECE对比；用Grad-CAM与ScopeGuide内嵌伪影遮挡实验检验快捷方式学习；另引入MobileViT-S对照，并在500张带专家掩膜的未见息肉图像与去重后的GastroVision外部子集（1,998张）评估泛化。
AI.result: 交叉验证中ResNet50/ViT-B/16精度92.12%/91.70%，差值+0.43点（90% CI −0.33~+1.18，p<0.001）落在等价边界内；ResNet50参数少3.6倍、运算少4.3倍、单图CPU延迟69 vs 177 ms、GPU吞吐高3.8倍；ECE 0.021 vs 0.023。MobileViT-S在测试集最高（95.5%），但遮挡ScopeGuide伪影后掉9.4点，ResNet50不受显著影响；Grad-CAM对息肉病灶的聚焦为随机水平的3.6倍；外部GastroVision上三者均降至78–80%且差距变小。
AI.conclusion: 架构间精度差异远小于快捷方式学习与域偏移带来的影响，而效率差异显著；资源受限筛查场景下高效CNN是合理默认选择，但任何模型都需本地验证后方可部署。

title: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
summary: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today's MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.

AI.tldr: 提出 InteractiveWorld——首个面向"人机闭环协作"的可验证仿真环境(助手指令、人类执行、环境反馈),并构建 InteractiveBench 动态基准(6类120个多轮任务,基于状态的奖励),评测12个前沿MLLM,发现最强模型在长程 Guidance/Planning 上仅约20%/25%。
AI.motivation: 第一视角可穿戴 AI 助手需要真实人类参与测试,真实交互数据昂贵稀缺,导致"当前 MLLM 是否真能在物理世界帮助人"这一关键问题悬而未决;现有仿真器以机器人为中心,缺少以"人类作为执行者、AI 作为指导者"的闭环可验证评测环境。
AI.method: 构建 InteractiveWorld:助手发出指令,由观察场景、理解指令并自主行动的人类智能体执行,环境执行动作并更新下一帧观测,从而模拟人机协作闭环;在此之上提出 InteractiveBench,含6大类别、120个多轮任务,采用可验证的基于状态的奖励进行逐指令评分;对12个前沿 MLLM 进行评测。
AI.result: 12个前沿 MLLM 均表现不佳,距离可靠助手仍有明显差距;最强模型 Claude Fable 5.1 在长程 Guidance 与 Planning 任务上分别最高约 20% 与 25%。
AI.conclusion: 提供了人机交互式 MLLM 助手的可验证平台与严格评测集,为"真正能在物理世界帮助人"的交互式助手研究奠定基础;从结果看,当前 MLLM 在长程指导与规划上仍远未达到可用水平。

title: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Network for Single-Shot 3D Reconstruction from Fringe Patterns
summary: Deep learning facilitates rapid single shot three dimensional (3D) reconstruction using fringe projection profilometry (FPP), but recovering accurate surface height from a single high frequency fringe image remains challenging because both long-range spatial consistency and fine geometric details must be preserved. Convolutional networks are limited in modeling long range dependencies, whereas window-based Transformers establish global interactions only progressively with increasing depth. To address these limitations, a hybrid Mamba Transformer network is proposed for fringe to height regression. The network adopts a Swin based U shaped architecture and introduces visual state space modeling at the intermediate resolution encoder stage. An axial and dilated vision state space (ADVSS) block is further developed to enhance prescan feature encoding through local, dilated, and axial depthwise convolutions while retaining four directional selective scanning. This design combines linear complexity long range modeling with direction aware preservation of local fringe structures. Experiments on a publicly available FPP dataset show that the proposed method outperforms hNet, SwinConvUNet, UHRNet, and HiDNet in mean absolute error(MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), absolute relative error, and structural similarity index measure (SSIM). Using only one deformed fringe image, the proposed method achieves an RMSE of 0.548 mm and an SSIM of 0.9985, reducing RMSE by 65.2% and 59.6% relative to UHRNet and HiDNet, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining selective state space modeling with hierarchical window based attention for accurate single-shot FPP reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出混合 Mamba-Transformer 网络实现单幅高频条纹图到三维高度的回归,并用 ADVSS 模块增强局部条纹结构编码。
AI.motivation: 单帧高频条纹投影轮廓术(FPP)三维重建需同时保持长程空间一致性与细粒度几何细节;CNN 长程建模能力弱,窗口 Transformer 需层层堆叠才能获得全局交互。
AI.method: 以 Swin U 型架构为骨架,在中等分辨率编码阶段引入视觉状态空间(Mamba)建模;设计 ADVSS 模块,通过局部、膨胀与轴向深度卷积增强预扫特征编码,并保留四方向选择性扫描,实现线性复杂度长程建模与方向感知的局部条纹结构保持。
AI.result: 在公开 FPP 数据集上,MAE、RMSE、绝对相对误差与 SSIM 均优于 hNet、SwinConvUNet、UHRNet、HiDNet;单张变形条纹图下 RMSE 0.548 mm、SSIM 0.9985,相对 UHRNet 与 HiDNet 分别降低 RMSE 65.2% 与 59.6%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性状态空间建模与层级窗口注意力结合,可有效提升单帧 FPP 重建精度与结构保真度。

title: Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.

AI.tldr: 提出阶段感知归因框架：先在历史与当前观测上构建动作条件的时间化指令-视觉归因，再将其投影到指令空间估计阶段关联，用以聚合相关历史证据并精炼当前解释，辅以指令引导的空间滤波抑制孤立响应；在多策略、多基准上提升归因质量，并用于失败诊断与Unitree G1真机导航验证。
AI.motivation: VLM驱动的视觉语言导航(VLN)决策缺乏可解释性，影响可靠部署；现有可解释方法忽视VLN的核心难点——当前动作的证据分散于历史与当前观测，且对应不同指令阶段，导致"指令阶段不敏感"（不同导航阶段给出相似解释）。
AI.method: 阶段感知归因框架：(1) 构建动作条件的时间化指令-视觉归因，覆盖多帧观测；(2) 将归因投影至指令空间以估计阶段关联，据此加权聚合相关历史证据以精炼当前解释；(3) 指令引导的空间滤波抑制孤立响应，保留紧凑且与指令相关的区域。
AI.result: 在多种VLN策略与多个基准上归因质量优于现有方法；可作为失败案例分析诊断工具；在Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了真实场景导航适用性。
AI.conclusion: 面向VLN的可解释性应采用阶段感知、跨时间聚合的归因范式，而非单帧显著图；该框架兼具解释质量与诊断价值，并具备真机部署可行性。

title: ElevateHead: Decide Once, Then Commit: When the Action Head Matters for Multimodal Imitation
summary: Robots that learn from people often see several valid ways to do the same task: pass an obstacle on the left or on the right, open the microwave or move the kettle first. A policy that re-decides at every step can waver between these ways mid-task. We ask when the action head (the part of a policy that turns the state into actions) matters, and how it should make this choice. On a controlled task, heads that sample one way succeed far more often than a head that averages the ways when the demonstrations contain several ways and the state gives no hint which to take (+0.72 success with two ways); this trend was not reproduced on the other tasks we ran. We then present ElevateHead, a head that decides once at a learned decision point, commits to that choice for the episode, and exposes the choice as an input a user can set. We designed it by diagnosis: each version was frozen and tested on tasks it had not seen, and the next version changed only what a measured failure pointed to; predictions were registered before each run. The first four versions each fell below BeT on at least one held-out task. The fifth completed all four subtasks of the held-out Franka Kitchen task in 45.2% of episodes against 29.3% for BeT, the strongest baseline across our tasks (+0.160, 95% CI [+0.129, +0.188]); when a mode was forced, the first completed subtask matched it in 95% of successful episodes. Diagnosis also located where commitment breaks: varied start positions (repaired on the controlled task: commitment 0.22 to 0.81, success 0.74 to 0.91) and varied object placement (partly repaired: in an exploratory variant, commitment 0.03 to 0.59 on aligning with no detectable change in success). On held-out block stacking, version 4 was comparable to BeT and did not exceed it. A real-robot test with predictions fixed in advance is planned for a follow-up version of this paper.

AI.tldr: 提出 ElevateHead 解码头：在学到的决策点一次性选定多模态策略中的一个模态（如绕障左/右），并在整个 episode 内承诺该选择，同时将其暴露为用户可设定的输入；在 Franka Kitchen 留出任务上成功率 45.2% vs. BeT 29.3%。
AI.motivation: 从人类示范学习得到的多模态策略，若每步重新决策，会在同一任务的多种合法执行方式之间摇摆（左/右绕障、先开微波炉还是先移水壶）。作者追问"动作头（action head）何时重要、应如何做选择"。
AI.method: 受控任务上对比"采样单一模态"与"对多模态取平均"的动作头（两模态时采样头成功率 +0.72）。随后提出 ElevateHead：在学习得到的决策点处一次性采样并承诺到 episode 结束，模态作为用户可控输入。采用"诊断驱动"的迭代设计：每个版本冻结后在未见任务上测试，预注册预测，下一代只修改被实测失败指出的部分。
AI.result: 前四版均至少在一个留出任务上低于 BeT；第五版在留出 Franka Kitchen 四个子任务全完成率 45.2% vs. BeT 29.3%（+0.160，95% CI [+0.129, +0.188]），强制模态时首个完成子任务与之一致率 95%。承诺失效定位：起始位置多样（受控任务承诺率 0.22→0.81，成功率 0.74→0.91）、物体摆放多样（部分修复，探索变体对齐全率 0.03→0.59，成功率无可检测变化）。在留出积木堆叠上 v4 与 BeT 相当但未超越。受控任务上的"采样优于平均"趋势未能复现于其他任务。
AI.conclusion: 动作头的模态决策机制在示范多模态、状态无提示时可以显著改变成败；一次性承诺+可控模态是有效设计，但在分布偏移（起始位姿、物体摆放）下承诺鲁棒性仍是主要瓶颈，真实机器人验证尚待后续版本。

title: Fovea-JEPA: Overcoming Geometric Blind Spots in V-JEPA for Camera Motion Recognition
summary: Camera motion recognition requires separating viewpoint changes caused by camera translation, rotation, or zoom from object motion and scene dynamics. Video-language models often rely on semantic cues and struggle with the geometric evidence needed for this task. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures such as V-JEPA offer strong spatio-temporal representations, but our experiments suggest that they underrepresent geometric cues in some regions. Under temporal-reversal supervision, V-JEPA improves overall but degrades on several motion families, whereas a weaker geometry-oriented VGGT predictor improves across all families. We refer to these geometrically underrepresented regions as geometric blind spots and propose Fovea-JEPA to identify and address them. Using V-JEPA as the base model and VGGT as a geometry expert, we construct intervention pseudo-labels from their prediction errors to weakly supervise a blind-spot predictor. The predictor produces token-wise response maps, which are aggregated into a clip-level intervention score to guide adaptive fusion of visual and geometric features. This selective intervention introduces complementary geometric information while preserving reliable visual predictions. Experiments on CameraMotionDataset, CameraBench, and ShotBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Fovea-JEPA, with gains of 9.67, 8.67, and 24.38 percentage points over previously reported state-of-the-art baselines, respectively. Code and models will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Fovea-JEPA以V-JEPA为基座、VGGT为几何专家，通过干预伪标签识别几何盲区，并用token级响应图自适应融合视觉与几何特征，提升相机运动识别。
AI.motivation: 相机运动识别需将相机平移/旋转/缩放引起的视点变化与物体运动、场景动态分离；视频-语言模型依赖语义线索、缺乏几何证据，而V-JEPA在时间反转监督下虽有整体提升，却在部分运动类别上退化，说明其对几何线索表征不足（几何盲区）。
AI.method: 实验对比显示几何导向的VGGT预测器在各运动类别上均更稳，据此定义"几何盲区"；以V-JEPA与VGGT的预测误差构造干预伪标签，弱监督一个盲区预测器；该预测器输出token级响应图，聚合成片段级干预分数，据以自适应融合视觉特征与几何特征，实现选择性干预。
AI.result: 在CameraMotionDataset、CameraBench、ShotBench上分别较此前报告的最优基线提升9.67、8.67、24.38个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性注入几何信息并保留可靠视觉预测，可有效修补JEPA类时空表征的几何盲区；方法为视频表征的几何补强提供了可迁移的干预式融合范式。

title: Enabling Motion-Induced WiFi-CSI Sensing in Multi-Robot Systems: A Simulation Framework
summary: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) enables fine-grained sensing of spatial relationships between wireless devices. The WiFi Sensor for Robotics (WSR) toolbox demonstrated that WiFi-CSI measurements collected during robot motion, combined with odometry, can be used to synthesize virtual antenna arrays, enabling motion-induced bearing estimation in multi-robot experiments. However, deploying the WSR approach has remained challenging due to its limited integration with standard robotics tools and reliance on deprecated WiFi-CSI acquisition hardware. This work presents an open-source simulation framework that integrates the WSR sensing pipeline within the robotic simulator Gazebo. The framework generates synthetic WiFi-CSI measurements with realistic physical signal properties and leverages realistic robot motion required for motion-induced sensing and downstream localization. It further supports processing both simulated and real WiFi-CSI data for direct comparison and validation. Our aim is to make WSR-style sensing accessible as a modular sensing modality for robotic research. We validate our framework by comparing simulated and real-world experiments using TurtleBot3 robots, and demonstrate its use for bearing estimation and robot localization. This work lowers the barrier to entry for WiFi-CSI-based sensing in multi-robot systems and provides a foundation for integrating WiFi-CSI sensing with multi-modal perception for localization and coordination. All code and experimental details are publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该工作将 WiFi Sensor for Robotics (WSR) 的 CSI 感知管线集成进 Gazebo 机器人仿真器，构建开源仿真框架，生成具真实物理信号特性的合成 WiFi-CSI 数据，支持与真实数据对比，并用于多机器人方位估计与定位验证。
AI.motivation: WSR 方法依赖已停产的 WiFi-CSI 采集硬件、与标准机器人工具链集成度低，导致使用门槛高，难以在机器人社区推广。作者希望将 WiFi-CSI 传感做成模块化的可及传感模态，降低多机器人系统的入门门槛。
AI.method: 在 Gazebo 中复现 WSR 运动诱导虚拟天线阵（synthetic aperture）感知管线：用仿真机器人运动轨迹驱动，生成带真实物理信号特性的合成 WiFi-CSI 测量；同一管线同时可处理真实 CSI 数据以做直接对比与验证；公开代码与实验细节。
AI.result: 用 TurtleBot3 机器人进行仿真-真实对照实验验证框架有效性，并展示其在运动诱导方位估计与机器人定位上的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 框架降低了 WiFi-CSI 多机器人感知的入门门槛，为将 WiFi-CSI 与多模态感知结合用于定位与协同提供了基础，但验证规模有限、属仿真优先的工具型贡献。

title: What Sketches Tell Us about LVLMs: Conventions, Grounding, and Localisation
summary: LVLM benchmarks tell us whether a model answers correctly, but not which visual conventions it has retained, nor where those conventions live. Sketches expose this hidden structure. A sketch removes texture, lighting, and photographic context while preserving the strokes humans judged sufficient for recognition. If an LVLM can operate on that abstraction, the surviving signal is structural rather than merely photometric. We introduce a training-free sketch probe with three readouts: temporal part-construction order, spatial attention-based grounding, and the mechanistic layer/head locus of grounding. We evaluate nine LVLMs on part order and five on the attention readouts, over two part-annotated sketch datasets. Three findings emerge. First, LVLM part order tracks human convention: models reproduce canonical orderings where human drawings converge, and become correspondingly variable where human orderings vary. Controls that blank, withhold, and mismatch the sketch locate this convention in the language model. Second, part-level grounding survives the abstraction: attention heads selected from the frozen model with an existing recipe recover part and object regions on object and scene sketches, with no grounding supervision. Third, the grounding signal concentrates in a narrow mid-network band whose location follows the base language model rather than parameter count in the two families we compare, and remains stable across object and scene sketches. The result is a practical diagnostic for sketch-driven LVLMs: no fine-tuning, no auxiliary segmenter, and a layer band that doubles as a head-selection prior, matching or improving grounding mAcc@0.1 in every model and dataset we tested.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练草图探针，用部件构建顺序、注意力定位、机制层/头定位三个读出，揭示LVLM保留的结构性视觉约定及其所在层。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM基准只评判答案对错，无法说明模型保留了哪些视觉约定、这些约定位于网络何处；草图剥离纹理光照而保留人类判定充分的笔画，是暴露该隐藏结构的理想抽象。
AI.method: 免训练探针：(1)时序部件构建顺序读出；(2)基于注意力的空间定位读出；(3)定位信号的层/头机制层面定位；并用blank/withhold/mismatch对照定位约定来源。9个LVLM做顺序评估、5个做注意力读出，覆盖两个带部件标注的草图数据集。跨两个模型家族比较层带位置与基座语言模型规模的关系。
AI.result: ①部件顺序与人类约定一致，且人类顺序分歧处模型亦变异性上升；对照实验表明该约定源于语言模型；②冻结模型中用既有配方选出的注意力头可无监督恢复部件/物体区域；③定位信号集中于网络中部窄层带，其位置随基座LM而非参数量变化，并在物体与场景草图上稳定；该层带作为头选择先验可匹配或提升所有模型/数据集上的mAcc@0.1。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个实用的草图驱动LVLM诊断工具：无需微调、无需辅助分割器，可直接作为注意力头选择的先验层带。

title: Cut a Wall, See a Wall: Identity Substitution in Occluded Point-Cloud Perception for Construction Robots
summary: Construction robots must label building elements they can only partly see. We show that when occlusion at test time removes whole regions of a scene, rather than parts of an object as in training, point-cloud segmentation networks do not simply miss the hidden elements: they relabel them, and the errors collapse onto a single sink class. With fixed synthetic layouts the column absorbs up to 70% of all test points; with randomized layouts the sink moves to the stair, predicted at 4.5-5.4x its true share across three training seeds. Baseline mIoU falls to 0.15-0.27 (fixed) and 0.36-0.72 (randomized), and up to 269 whole objects vanish in a single test set. Appending 14 hand-computed geometric features per point (GPE) restores mIoU to 0.54-0.92 and removes 64-100% of whole-object losses in every run, for PointNet++ and a PTv3-style transformer in both layout regimes; on real S3DIS scans it removes every whole-wall loss (10 to 0). In an as-built column check computed from the predictions, GPE raises the share of correctly checked views from 17-58% to 71-92%. Feature permutation on fixed, randomized and real scenes explains the pattern: each class relies on whichever cue is stable in its training data, position for height-banded slabs and beams, intrinsic shape for walls and stairs once their position varies. Occlusion augmentation is a strong alternative on mIoU, but in every setting it loses more whole objects than GPE (e.g., 25-35 vs. 0).

AI.tldr: 遮挡导致点云分割网络把整块隐藏区域重标为单一"汇类"（柱子/楼梯），每点追加14个手工几何特征(GPE)可大幅恢复mIoU并消除整物体丢失。
AI.motivation: 建筑机器人需标注仅部分可见的构件；训练时的遮挡是物体局部缺失，而测试时是整区域缺失，网络并非"漏检"隐藏元素而是将其重新错误分类。作者要揭示并缓解这种分布偏移。
AI.method: 构造固定与随机布局的合成场景及真实S3DIS扫描，量化"汇类"坍缩现象；对每个点拼接14个手工计算的几何特征(GPE)；用特征置换实验分析各类别的依赖线索（位置 vs 内在形状）；与遮挡数据增强对比；在PointNet++和PTv3风格Transformer上验证，并做建成柱体检查的下游评估。
AI.result: 无GPE时mIoU降至0.15-0.27(固定)/0.36-0.72(随机)，单个测试集最多269个整物体消失，柱子吸收高达70%测试点，楼梯预测占比为真实4.5-5.4倍；加入GPE后mIoU回升至0.54-0.92，消除64-100%整物体丢失，真实S3DIS整墙丢失从10降到0，柱体检查正确视图比例从17-58%升至71-92%。遮挡增强在mIoU上接近但整物体丢失更多(25-35 vs 0)。
AI.conclusion: 整区域遮挡引发类别坍缩而非简单漏检；每类依赖训练中稳定的线索（高度分层构件靠位置，位置变化后墙/楼梯靠形状），显式几何特征是可推广、比遮挡增强更保守的修复手段。

title: T-ConSG: A LiDAR-Based Real-Time Temporal Construction Scene Graph for Dynamic and Evolving Environments
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Dynamic and continuously evolving environments present significant challenges for robotic mapping and scene understanding, particularly on construction sites where moving agents, temporary obstacles, and persistent structural changes coexist. While dynamic and long-term SLAM methods can detect motion and environmental changes, their outputs are predominantly metric representations that provide limited structure for higher-level spatial and temporal reasoning. This paper presents a LiDAR-based real-time temporal construction scene graph (T-ConSG) that jointly represents free-space regions, static objects, dynamic objects, and environmental events with spatial-relational and event-participation edges. The proposed framework incrementally constructs the graph from LiDAR-derived geometric evidence, maintaining persistent free-space and static-object information while tracking dynamic objects. Changes in accumulated spatial evidence are further represented as explicit installation and removal events, allowing the graph to capture both transient dynamics and persistent environmental evolution. We demonstrate the proposed representation through three complementary application studies: dynamics-aware navigation in a bricklaying testbed, construction progress monitoring on the ConSLAM dataset, and online change detection in a simulated construction environment. The results demonstrate that the proposed T-ConSG provides a unified representation for organizing spatial and temporal information and supports robotic reasoning across environments containing both short-term dynamics and persistent changes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LiDAR的实时时序施工场景图(T-ConSG)，统一表示自由空间、静态物体、动态物体及安装/移除事件，支持导航、进度监测与在线变化检测。
AI.motivation: 施工等动态演化环境中，动态/长期SLAM虽能检测运动与变化，但输出以度量表示为主，缺乏支撑高层时空推理的结构化表示。
AI.method: 从LiDAR几何证据增量构建图结构，包含节点(自由空间区域、静态物体、动态物体、环境事件)与边(空间关系边、事件参与边)；持续维护自由空间与静态物体信息并跟踪动态物体，将累积空间证据的变化显式建模为安装/移除事件，兼顾瞬态动态与持久环境演化。
AI.result: 在砌砖试验台开展动态感知导航、在ConSLAM数据集做施工进度监测、在仿真施工环境做在线变化检测，三项应用研究验证表示可用性。
AI.conclusion: T-ConSG为组织空间与时间信息提供统一表示，可支撑同时含短期动态与持久变化的机器人推理；但以仿真/数据集验证为主，缺少真实机器人闭环长期部署证据。

title: Behavior Spatial Benchmark: Evaluating Spatial Understanding for Robotics
summary: Robot tasks require grounding spatial language in physical scenes, but task success alone cannot establish whether spatial instructions are followed. We present BEHAVIOR-Spatial, a benchmark built on BEHAVIOR-1K that measures spatial question answering, point-based target grounding, and robot action to examine how VLM spatial understanding relates to VLA behavior. It comprises 3,256 spatial questions across 49 activities, 1,240 grounding queries across 14 manipulation tasks, and action evaluations covering those 14 tasks and 10 navigation tasks. Our manipulation protocol evaluates held-out configurations and instruction following when the requested target changes within a fixed training layout. The baseline achieves 41.6% on held-out configurations but only 16.1% under changed instructions. VLM adaptation and robot-data pretraining provide limited improvements, whereas oracle visual target cues raise these rates to 60.3% and 38.0%, respectively. Perception evaluations reveal policy-dependent correlations between VLM question-answering and grounding accuracy and VLA manipulation performance. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial instruction following alongside task completion and examining when spatial perception performance translates into robot behavior. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: BEHAVIOR-Spatial 基准：结合空间问答、点定位与机器人动作，检验 VLM 空间理解能否转化为 VLA 行为，并揭示指令变化下性能骤降。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务中"任务成功"不等于"空间指令被遵循"，现有评测无法判断空间语言是否真正被落地，且 VLM 空间感知与 VLA 行为之间的关系缺乏系统测量。
AI.method: 基于 BEHAVIOR-1K 构建统一基准：3,256 个空间问题（49 类活动）、1,240 个点基目标定位查询（14 个操作任务）、动作评测（14 个操作 + 10 个导航任务）。操作协议设置两种设置：留出布局配置、以及在固定训练布局内更换目标指令；另做 VLM 适配、机器人数据预训练、oracle 视觉目标提示等消融，并分析感知指标与策略表现的策略依赖性相关性。
AI.result: 基线在留出配置下达 41.6% 成功率，但更换指令后仅 16.1%；VLM 适配与机器人数据预训练提升有限；给出 oracle 视觉目标线索后分别升至 60.3% 与 38.0%。空间问答/定位准确率与 VLA 操作性能的相关性依赖于具体策略。
AI.conclusion: 空间指令遵循应作为与任务完成并列的独立评测维度；空间感知分数并非必然转化为机器人行为，需明确其生效条件。

title: Extended LASMP: Language Aided Subset Sampling Based Motion Planner for Drone Navigation
summary: This paper proposes a command-aligned sampling distribution that incorporates navigation commands directly into the exploration process to improve the efficiency of sampling-based motion planning for quadcopters in three-dimensional environments. Inspired by the Language-Aided Subset Sampling Motion Planner, this paper extends command-aware subset sampling to aerial systems. Subset sampling is generalized to command-aligned regions, enabling structured 3D exploration while preserving probabilistic completeness. Natural language instructions are grounded into yaw-conditioned and altitude-aware geometric constraints using a prompt-based large language model for entity extraction and instruction validation. Extensive simulations in complex environments demonstrate that the proposed method generates collision-free, consistent trajectories while significantly reducing sampling effort compared to uniform RRT-based planners.

AI.tldr: 将自然语言导航指令经大语言模型解析为偏航与高度几何约束，并把子集采样推广到"指令对齐区域"，从而在三维四旋翼无人机运动规划中实现结构化探索。
AI.motivation: 采样式运动规划在三维复杂环境中效率低，而语言指令提供了先验结构信息未被利用；作者希望把语言条件先验融入采样分布以加速四旋翼的可行轨迹搜索。
AI.method: 受 Language-Aided Subset Sampling Motion Planner 启发，定义指令对齐（command-aligned）采样分布：基于提示的大语言模型做实体抽取与指令校验，将指令接地为偏航条件与高度感知的几何约束区域，在该区域内进行子集采样并保持概率完备性。
AI.result: 复杂环境仿真显示可生成无碰撞且一致的轨迹，相较均匀采样的 RRT 类规划器显著降低采样次数。
AI.conclusion: 语言接地与子集采样的结合可有效提升空中机器人采样式规划的采样效率，但验证仅限仿真，缺乏实机部署与真实环境泛化证据。

title: Lightweight Change Detection for Adaptive Collective Perception in Dynamic Environments
summary: Swarm robotics enables scalable inspection through collective perception, where robots infer environmental properties from distributed observations. A common benchmark considers robots exploring black-white tiled environments and determining the majority tile type. While most work studies static environments, dynamic environments remain underexplored. We study collective perception in dynamic environments where the tile proportion and the spatial correlation of surface patterns may change over time. To enable implementation on resource-constrained robots, we integrate a lightweight change detection mechanism into a Bayesian collective decision-making framework that resets robot beliefs when distribution shifts are detected. The proposed detector requires constant memory and constant per-sample computation, unlike two recent competitive approaches that store the full sample stream, making it suitable for memory-constrained robots. We further introduce a method that detects spatially correlated sampling and adapts sampling intervals online to mitigate correlation effects. Our simulation results in Webots show competitive change detection delays, more consistent precision across communication settings, and improved decision accuracy under changing spatial correlations.

AI.tldr: 在动态黑白地块环境的群体感知任务中，将恒定内存/恒定单样本计算量的轻量变化检测器嵌入贝叶斯群体决策框架，检测到分布漂移时重置机器人信念，并在线自适应采样间隔以抑制空间相关采样影响。
AI.motivation: 现有群体感知（collective perception）研究多限于静态环境；真实场景中地块比例与表面图案的空间相关性会随时间变化，且资源受限机器人无法承担存储完整样本流的变化检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 在贝叶斯集体决策框架中集成轻量变化检测机制，检测到分布偏移时重置信念；检测器保持恒定内存与恒定每样本计算量（对比两种需存全样本流的近期方法）。2) 提出检测空间相关采样的方法，并在线调整采样间隔以缓解相关性带来的偏差。3) 在 Webots 仿真中评估。
AI.result: 仿真显示：变化检测延迟与竞争方法相当；在不同通信设置下精度更稳定；在空间相关性变化时决策准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 面向资源受限群体的动态环境集体感知可行，恒定复杂度变化检测加自适应采样是有效且低开销的方案；但验证限于 Webots 仿真，缺乏真机实验与开源代码说明。

title: Learning Interaction-Aware Path Corrections from Unlabeled Trajectories: A LiDAR-Based Sim-to-Real GNN Framework for Construction Robots
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, submitted to Automation in Construction
summary: Construction robots operating near workers require navigation that can anticipate human motion while remaining robust to dynamic and unstructured site conditions. However, existing social navigation methods depend on hand-crafted interaction rules, labeled demonstrations, or robot-specific control policies, limiting their scalability and transferability in construction environments. We propose a real-time, LiDAR-only framework that learns interaction-aware path corrections from unlabeled demonstrations. Constant-velocity extrapolation generates residual learning targets, while a GNN models relationships among the robot, pedestrians, and goal context. During deployment, an extended Kalman filter tracks LiDAR detections to construct dynamic graphs, and the GNN offsets planner-generated waypoints through a planner-agnostic interface. Within the bricklaying trial, the GNN reduced path irregularity by 39.2\% and increased minimum TTC. Across Dynablox sequences, it increased minimum TTC by 38.3\% while producing shorter, smoother paths than the baselines. Ablation studies supported a 1.0-s prediction interval and confirmed the benefits of target context, reflection augmentation, and feature normalization.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用LiDAR的实时social navigation框架，从无标注演示中学习交互感知的路径修正；用恒速外推生成残差学习目标，GNN建模机器人-行人-目标关系，部署时以EKF跟踪LiDAR检测构建动态图，并通过与规划器无关的接口偏移航点。
AI.motivation: 施工机器人在工人附近作业，需预判人体运动并对非结构化动态环境保持鲁棒；现有social navigation依赖手工交互规则、带标注演示或机器人专属控制策略，可扩展性与迁移性差。
AI.method: LiDAR-only端到端框架：以恒速外推残差作为标签，实现无标注学习；GNN编码机器人、行人及目标上下文关系；部署阶段用EKF跟踪LiDAR检测构建动态图，GNN在planner-agnostic接口上偏移规划器航点；配合反射增强与特征归一化；消融支持1.0 s预测区间。
AI.result: 砌砖场景试验中路径不规整度降低39.2%并提升最小TTC；Dynablox序列上最小TTC提升38.3%，且路径比基线更短更平滑。
AI.conclusion: 无需标注与机器人专属策略的即插即用交互修正模块可有效提升施工场景人机共融导航的安全性与平滑性，具备较好迁移性；但验证限于单一施工任务与公开数据集，仍需更多真实部署与多机器人验证。

title: DSGN: A Dual-Stream Gated Network for Scalable Simultaneous Surveillance and Containment
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Full version of the paper accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), October 2026
summary: The simultaneous surveillance and containment (SSC) problem arises in multi-robot applications such as perimeter security and environmental monitoring, where robots must survey a region of interest and coordinate to enclose targets once they are detected. Surveillance favors spatial dispersion for coverage, whereas containment requires target-centric cohesion for enclosure. This conflict makes heuristic switching unstable, and the instability becomes more pronounced as larger robotic networks introduce more inter-agent and agent-target relations. End-to-end DRL reduces reliance on hand-crafted switching, but conventional single-stream policies often mix surveillance and containment cues in one shared feature space that could entangle dispersion-oriented and target-centric signals and weaken task transitions. In this paper, we propose the Dual-Stream Gated Network (DSGN), an architecture designed to address scale-amplified task-transition difficulties by separating surveillance and containment into specialized representation streams and coordinating them through a context-aware gating mechanism. A probabilistic prior further regularizes the gating process, reducing ambiguous intermediate decisions and supporting clearer behavioral transitions under large-scale interaction complexity. Evaluations show that DSGN maintains strong task efficacy and scalability under constant-density cross-scale settings. Additional ablation and phase-specific evaluations show that the proposed dynamic gating mechanism and probabilistic prior support effective task arbitration and reliable mode switching in both pure surveillance and task-switching scenarios. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出双流门控网络（DSGN），将多机器人"同时监视与围捕"任务中的监视/围捕表征解耦为两条专用流，并用上下文感知门控与概率先验正则化实现行为切换，在常密度跨尺度设定下验证了有效性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人同时监视与围捕（SSC）中，监视偏好空间分散、围捕要求目标中心聚合，二者目标冲突导致启发式切换不稳定；且机器人规模扩大时交互关系剧增使问题更严重。端到端DRL虽减少手工切换，但单流策略将两类线索混在同一特征空间，易纠缠信号、削弱任务过渡。
AI.method: DSGN架构：为监视与围捕分别构建专门的表征流以隔离分散导向与目标中心信号；引入上下文感知门控机制协调两流输出；再用概率先验对门控过程进行正则化，抑制模糊中间决策，使大规模交互复杂度下的行为过渡更清晰。基于DRL端到端训练。
AI.result: 在常密度跨尺度设置下，DSGN保持较强任务效能与可扩展性；消融与分阶段评估表明，动态门控与概率先验能有效完成任务仲裁，并在纯监视场景与任务切换场景中实现可靠模式切换。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将冲突任务目标通过多流表征解耦+门控仲裁，是缓解大规模多机器人任务切换不稳的有效路径；概率先验对门控的约束提升了模式切换可靠性。属多机器人协同控制方向，与感知/3D/操作核心议题相关性有限。

title: Doppler-aided Position-Velocity Tracking of Hidden Objects using mmWave Radar
summary: Safe indoor operation requires autonomous tracking of objects that are not directly visible to the robot. Optical non-line-of-sight (NLoS) methods depend on ambient lighting and scene geometry or on weak multi-bounce returns that need long acquisitions. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers an attractive alternative: walls act as reflectors for mmWave signals, and frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radars enable fast, practical measurement of range, angle, and velocity. However, the low resolution of these radars leads to spatially ambiguous observations. The Doppler information, although particularly sensitive to target motion, remains underexplored in indoor NLoS localization: existing methods emphasize spatial representations and either collapse or discard the Doppler dimension before learning. To leverage the complete Range-Azimuth-Doppler (RAD) information, we acquire the first indoor NLoS radar dataset that pairs sequential RAD measurements with synchronized position and velocity ground truth under controlled variations in motion: 576 sequences totaling 720,856 frames across 12 trajectories of a mobile robot moving along varying speeds, starting positions, and material configurations. We then formulate NLoS tracking as sequential position-velocity estimation rather than frame-wise localization: a shared 3-D encoder processes the full RAD representation of consecutive frames, separate recurrent branches estimate position and velocity, and post-inference refinement combines the two into a motion-consistent trajectory. Our method achieves 8.95cm position and 1.75cm/s velocity errors on held-out trajectories and generalizes to unseen scenarios involving a moving human target. Together, our dataset and tracker establish a benchmark for tracking hidden moving targets with a low-cost radar.

AI.tldr: 利用FMCW毫米波雷达与墙体反射实现室内非视域(NLoS)移动目标跟踪，发布首个RAD序列数据集并训练位置-速度联合估计的循环网络。
AI.motivation: 室内机器人需要跟踪不可见目标；光学NLoS方法依赖环境光与场景几何或需长曝光多跳回波，而现有mmWave NLoS方法在学习前压缩或丢弃对运动高度敏感的多普勒维度，且雷达低分辨率导致空间歧义。
AI.method: 采集首个室内NLoS雷达数据集（576段序列、720,856帧、12条轨迹，配同步位置与速度真值，含速度/起点/材质变化）；将NLoS跟踪建模为序列位置-速度估计：共享3D编码器处理连续帧的完整Range-Azimuth-Doppler表示，两个独立循环分支分别回归位置与速度，推理后融合为运动一致轨迹。
AI.result: 在留出轨迹上达到8.95cm位置误差与1.75cm/s速度误差，并可泛化到未见场景（含移动人体目标）。
AI.conclusion: 数据集与跟踪器共同为低成本雷达跟踪被遮挡运动目标建立了基准；保留完整RAD与多普勒信息是有效的设计选择。

title: Learning the Autoregressive: Direct Score-Difference Estimation with Amortized Future Credit for Video Distillation
summary: Few-step distillation for autoregressive (AR) video generation commonly first initializes an AR student and then refines it with distribution matching distillation (DMD). This refinement process faces two challenges. First, although initialization already yields a reasonably capable student, DMD obtains the refinement direction indirectly by estimating the full student score before forming the teacher-student correction. Second, detached-history training prevents the generator from assigning credit to a current chunk for its influence on subsequent chunks. We introduce Leta, a few-step distillation framework that addresses these challenges with ScoreDelta and FutureCredit. ScoreDelta directly estimates the teacher-student correction from denoising residuals, while FutureCredit learns an auxiliary cross-chunk update signal from vector-Jacobian products (VJPs) of next-chunk teacher residuals. Leta combines these signals into a joint teacher-guided update field in a single forward pass during generator updates. Teacher evaluations and credit VJPs are used only for estimator training. For ScoreDelta, we establish population equivalence to score-difference estimation and a conditional approximation advantage under limited capacity in a fixed-feature linear model. In our controlled experiments, Leta improves over DMD by 0.9 points on VBench and 0.66 on VideoAlign. This advantage persists at a higher generator update frequency (a generator-to-estimator update ratio of G:E=1:1), where Leta improves over DMD by 1.6 on VBench and 0.35 on VideoAlign. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Leta少步蒸馏框架，用ScoreDelta从去噪残差直接估计师生修正量、用FutureCredit通过下一chunk教师残差的VJP学习跨chunk信用信号，单次前向即得联合教师引导更新场。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成少步蒸馏中，DMD需先估计完整学生score再构造师生修正，路径间接；且detached-history训练使生成器无法把后续chunk的表现归因于当前chunk。
AI.method: ScoreDelta直接由去噪残差估计teacher-student correction；FutureCredit从下一chunk教师残差的vector-Jacobian乘积学习辅助跨chunk更新信号；二者合成joint teacher-guided update field，生成器更新仅需单次前向；教师评估与credit VJP只用于训练估计器。附带在固定特征线性模型下证明ScoreDelta与score-difference估计的总体等价性及有限容量下的条件近似优势。
AI.result: 受控实验较DMD在VBench提升0.9分、VideoAlign提升0.66；在G:E=1:1的高生成器更新频率下，分别提升1.6与0.35。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接估计师生score修正并引入跨chunk信用分配，Leta在少步AR视频蒸馏中稳定优于DMD，且在高更新频率设定下优势更明显。

title: LegoOcc++: Towards Consistent Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction is important for embodied agents operating in complex environments whose semantic categories extend beyond fixed taxonomies. While recent studies have explored open-vocabulary occupancy in outdoor driving scenarios, indoor environments remain challenging due to dense occlusions, complex geometry, and fine-grained long-tailed semantics. To reduce the need for expensive voxel-level semantic annotations, we study a geometry-only supervision setting requiring only binary occupancy labels. We build upon Language-Embedded Gaussians as a unified representation coupling 3D geometry with language-aligned semantics. For geometry learning, we introduce an opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy formulation that enables stable volumetric aggregation under binary occupancy supervision. For semantic learning, we render Gaussian features into images and align them with a frozen open-vocabulary model, together with Progressive Temperature Decay to reduce feature mixing during Gaussian splatting. Building on this framework, we further introduce Instance-Level Semantic Consistency to alleviate fragmented object predictions, and Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection to provide informative and less redundant multi-view semantic supervision. We also extend our framework to outdoor driving scenarios to evaluate its generality across substantially different environments. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 在仅用二值占据标签的几何监督下，将Language-Embedded Gaussians与冻结的开放词汇2D模型对齐，实现室内/室外的开放词汇3D占据预测。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇3D占据预测对未知类别场景中的具身智能体很关键；室外驾驶已有探索，但室内存在稠密遮挡、复杂几何和长尾细粒度语义的挑战。同时体素级语义标注代价高昂，因此希望仅依赖二值占据标签完成语义开放化。
AI.method: 以Language-Embedded Gaussians为统一表示：几何端提出opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy公式，在二值监督下稳定体素聚合；语义端将高斯特征渲染成图像，与冻结的开放词汇2D模型对齐，并加入Progressive Temperature Decay抑制splatting中的特征混合；进一步引入Instance-Level Semantic Consistency缓解实例碎片化，以及Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection提高多视图监督信息量、降低冗余；框架扩展到室外驾驶场景验证泛化性。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准上的大量实验显示，该方法取得了较强的开放词汇占据性能，验证了框架的有效性与跨场景通用性。
AI.conclusion: 仅用二值占据监督即可构建统一高斯表示的开放词汇3D占据预测器，可同时覆盖室内与室外，并可作为具身智能体开放词汇感知的轻标注方案。

title: X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Variable-View Robot Control
summary: Video diffusion models provide a source of interaction representations for robot control, but transferring these representations requires reconciling variable camera inputs with heterogeneous action interfaces and closed-loop execution. We present X-World, a framework that transfers a video prior through a fixed-length token sequence to a shared action expert. A residual cross-view attention branch extends a pretrained video backbone to one, two, or three views while retaining its original self-attention path. A layer-aligned Q-Former aggregates backbone features, and dataset-specific modules map between native state and action interfaces and the shared action expert. Training separates video adaptation from action-only pretraining by freezing the video backbone in the latter stage, followed by joint target-domain post-training. The policy extracts video features with a single backbone pass and uses asynchronous action chunking for execution. On LIBERO, X-World reaches 98.5\% mean success; its LIBERO-trained checkpoint obtains 76.5\% on LIBERO-Plus without further adaptation. The seven-shift breakdown reveals gains in robot, language, lighting, and layout perturbations, alongside weaknesses under camera, background, and noise shifts relative to OpenVLA-OFT. On six dual-arm real-world tasks, it achieves 81.7\% mean success over 20 trials per task. Removing video adaptation or cross-view fusion produces the largest observed success drops among the tested removals.

AI.tldr: X-World：通过固定长度token序列把视频扩散先验迁移到共享动作专家，跨视图残差注意力支持1-3路相机输入，LIBERO 98.5%，零适配迁移LIBERO-Plus 76.5%，真机双臂6任务81.7%。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型蕴含可用于机器人控制的交互表征，但迁移面临三重障碍：相机视角数量可变、动作接口异构（不同数据集/机器人的状态-动作空间不一致）、以及闭环执行需求。
AI.method: 以预训练视频骨干为基础，增加残差跨视图注意力分支（保留原自注意力路径）以扩展至1-3视角；层对齐Q-Former聚合骨干特征；数据集专属模块将原生状态/动作接口映射到共享动作专家。训练分三阶段：视频适配、冻结视频骨干的动作预训练、目标域联合后训练。推理时单次骨干前向提取特征，采用异步动作分块执行。
AI.result: LIBERO平均成功率98.5%；免适配在LIBERO-Plus上76.5%，七类扰动分解显示在机器人、语言、光照、布局扰动上优于OpenVLA-OFT，但在相机、背景、噪声扰动上较弱。六个双臂真机任务每任务20次试验平均成功率81.7%。消融中移除视频适配或跨视图融合导致最大性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多视角视频先验+共享动作专家范式可有效跨异构动作接口迁移，视频适配与跨视角融合是性能关键；但视觉外观层面的鲁棒性（相机/背景/噪声）仍是短板。

title: RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map a language instruction and the current observation directly to actions, without checking whether the instruction has been completed. For long-horizon tasks, a single failed step therefore goes unnoticed and leaves the whole task unfinished. Such failed episodes, however, often end with the task partially complete. Moreover, the unfinished steps are reusable atomic skills that recur across demonstrations. A failed attempt can thus be recovered by composing with atomic skills. We propose RoboDuo, a closed-loop dual-system framework that uses code as the interface between a coding agent and two VLAs. The agent writes a program that lets a full-task VLA attempt the whole task and checks whether it is complete; on failure, an atomic VLA finishes the remaining steps. Since the agent emits no actions and only decides which VLA for execution, RoboDuo wraps an existing full-task VLA without updating its weights. To train the atomic VLA and the coding agent with the completion-checking ability, we build LIBERO-Atomic, LIBERO-Code, and LIBERO-Judge from a single set of LIBERO demonstrations. RoboDuo consistently improves X-VLA and $\pi_{0.5}$ on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks, and recovers failed rollouts of a frozen full-task VLA on a real robot.

AI.tldr: RoboDuo 用"代码"作为接口，让编码 agent 编排一个全任务 VLA 与一个原子技能 VLA 构成闭环双系统：先由全任务 VLA 尝试，再由程序检查完成度，失败则由原子 VLA 补齐剩余步骤；不改动既有 VLA 权重即可即插即用。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型把指令+观测直接映射为动作，缺乏"指令是否完成"的显式检查，长程任务中单步失败不会被察觉，导致整段轨迹失败；但失败轨迹往往已部分完成，且未完成步骤是可跨演示复用的原子技能，因此可用原子技能组合"补救"失败轨迹。
AI.method: 双系统闭环框架：编码 agent 生成程序作为控制层，调用 full-task VLA 执行整任务并判断是否完成（completion checking），失败时调用 atomic VLA 完成剩余原子步骤；agent 不输出动作、只做 VLA 调度，因此可包裹冻结权重的全任务 VLA。配套从同一套 LIBERO 演示构建 LIBERO-Atomic、LIBERO-Code、LIBERO-Judge，用于训练原子 VLA 与具备完成度判断能力的编码 agent。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-PRO 上稳定提升 X-VLA 与 π0.5，长程任务增益最大；并在真实机器人上成功恢复冻结全任务 VLA 的失败 rollout。
AI.conclusion: 以代码为接口的 agent+VLA 闭环、结合可复用的原子技能与显式完成度校验，是提升长程具身任务可靠性、且无需重训基础 VLA 的有效范式。

title: HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
summary: Humanoid robots have recently achieved remarkable success in motion tracking. However, during real-world deployment, robots inevitably encounter dynamics gaps arising from either extra physical disturbances or inaccurate simulation modeling, resulting in a significant training-deployment gap. Therefore, effectively leveraging real-world data to fine-tune policies represents the crucial last mile for robust deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HumanoidNDM, an online fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking driven by a real-world-trained neural dynamics model. First, in the data collection stage, we introduce a low-frequency reference perturbation method with an adaptive intensity mechanism, balancing deployment feasibility and exploration efficiency. Second, for the model training stage, we train a robust history-based, proprioceptive neural dynamics model in Euclidean space by incorporating differentiable forward kinematics, eliminating the reliance on costly motion capture systems. Finally, in the policy fine-tuning stage, we directly fine-tune the policy via backpropagated model gradients, achieving high data efficiency. Through physical validation on the Unitree G1 robot, we demonstrate that HumanoidNDM enables rapid real-world adaptation to various perturbations, representing the first online, MoCap-free fine-tuning framework for humanoid tracking policies.

AI.tldr: HumanoidNDM: 一种基于真实世界训练的神经动力学模型的在线微调框架，用于人形机器人运动跟踪，在Unitree G1上实现无动捕的快速真实环境适应。
AI.motivation: 仿真训练的人形运动跟踪策略在真实部署中面临动力学差距（外部扰动与建模不精确），导致显著训练-部署差距；如何高效利用真实数据完成微调是鲁棒部署的"最后一公里"。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 数据采集：低频参考扰动 + 自适应强度机制，兼顾部署可行性与探索效率；(2) 模型训练：在欧氏空间训练基于历史的本体感知神经动力学模型，引入可微前向运动学，摆脱对昂贵动捕系统的依赖；(3) 策略微调：通过模型反向传播梯度直接微调策略，实现高数据效率。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1实体机器人上验证，可快速适应多种真实扰动；作者称为首个面向人形跟踪策略的在线、无需动捕的微调框架。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界神经动力学模型可作为在线微调的高效代理，显著缩小人形运动跟踪的sim-to-real差距；无需动捕的范式降低了实际部署门槛。

title: Semantic-Coupled Perception Framework for Autonomous Laparoscope Control
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) for possible publication
summary: In minimally invasive surgery (MIS), maintaining an appropriate field of view (FoV) is essential for surgical safety and efficiency. However, conventional autonomous laparoscope control methods often treat visual tracking and surgical phase recognition independently, limiting robustness under occlusion, entity overlap, and camera motion. This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous laparoscope control framework that couples real-time surgical phase recognition with camera-motion-compensated visual perception. By exploiting phase-dependent relationships among surgical entities, the framework improves target state estimation under challenging visual conditions, supporting task-aware autonomous FoV control. Experiments on benchmark datasets evaluate the proposed framework in surgical phase recognition and target tracking, including scenarios involving occlusion and entity overlap. Phantom experiments further demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous FoV control, showing improved target visibility and task execution performance compared with fixed-FoV control. These results highlight the potential of incorporating task-level semantics into visual state estimation for autonomous laparoscope guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环自主腹腔镜控制框架，将实时手术阶段识别与相机运动补偿的视觉感知耦合，利用阶段相关的实体关系提升遮挡/重叠下的目标状态估计，实现任务感知的视场(FoV)控制。
AI.motivation: 微创手术中维持合适视场对安全与效率至关重要，但现有自主腹腔镜控制方法将视觉跟踪与手术阶段识别割裂处理，在遮挡、器械实体重叠与相机运动下鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 闭环框架：实时手术阶段识别 + 相机运动补偿的视觉感知；通过建模阶段依赖的手术实体关系，在困难视觉条件下改进目标状态估计，并据此驱动任务感知的自主FoV调节。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上评估阶段识别与目标跟踪（含遮挡、实体重叠场景）；体模(phantom)实验验证自主FoV控制可行性，相比固定FoV控制，目标可见性与任务执行表现提升。
AI.conclusion: 将任务级语义引入视觉状态估计对自主腹腔镜引导具有潜力；仅在体模上验证，缺乏活体/真实手术部署与量化精度细节。

title: StickFigure: Enabling Pose-Only IoT Cameras for Privacy-Preserving Edge Vision
summary: Indoor IoT cameras can support assisted living and activity-aware spaces, but exporting raw RGB frames raises privacy concerns by exposing facial, clothing, and household details that body-motion tasks often do not require. We present StickFigure, a pose-only IoT camera system that, during real-time monitoring, keeps raw frames local and ephemeral while exporting only compact skeleton streams sufficient for downstream human activity recognition (HAR). While pose estimation has matured on GPUs, extracting accurate pose streams on resource-constrained IoT cameras remains difficult. To overcome these challenges and enable on-device pose streams on (almost) any IoT camera, we present two core designs in StickFigure: an activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling and a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner that selectively corrects elbow and wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. We fully implement StickFigure and evaluate it on public benchmarks and real-world deployment. Compared with state-of-the-art MCU pose models, StickFigure achieves the highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility on both NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, while using 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines, achieving 0.107 s p95 latency on a representative STM32H753 MCU. We believe StickFigure establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras.

AI.tldr: StickFigure: an on-device, pose-only IoT camera system that keeps raw RGB frames local and streams only compact skeleton data for downstream activity recognition, using an activation-aware pose backbone plus a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner for elbow/wrist correction.
AI.motivation: Exporting raw RGB from indoor IoT cameras leaks facial, clothing and household details that body-motion tasks don't need; yet accurate pose estimation on resource-constrained MCUs is hard, limiting privacy-preserving edge deployment at scale.
AI.method: Two designs: (1) activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling; (2) lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner selectively correcting elbow/wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. Fully implemented on STM32-class MCU hardware.
AI.result: On NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility vs. SOTA MCU pose models, with 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines; 0.107 s p95 latency on STM32H753 MCU.
AI.conclusion: Establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras, showing compact on-device skeleton streams suffice for HAR.

title: Reversion, Retention, and Semantic Intervention: Measuring Functional Content in CLIP Fine-Tuning Deltas
comment: 20 pages. Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Fine-tuning adapts pretrained models to new tasks, but identifying which weight changes support the resulting behavior remains difficult. Weight-space interpretability assigns semantic descriptions to these changes, called fine-tuning deltas. Such descriptions leave open how much task performance depends on the identified updates, particularly when other updates can support the same predictions. We address this gap by pairing reversion, which restores selected parameters to their pretrained values, with retention, which keeps only selected fine-tuning updates. We evaluate Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) models on synthetic financial charts, Flowers102, EuroSAT, and FGVCAircraft with ViT-L/14, and on Flowers102 with ViT-B/16, using a shared recipe that tunes the final six visual blocks. Our contributions are threefold. First, attention value-output (VO) updates alone recover 43-87% of the accuracy improvement, although reverting them leaves chart accuracy unchanged. Cross-entropy loss preserves this contrast on Charts and EuroSAT, while correct-class score margins reveal additional contributions. Second, VO weights recover more loss improvement than all ten equally sized, layer-matched random subsets in each setting. VO and multilayer perceptron (MLP) retentions jointly correct 25-81% of pretrained errors, demonstrating overlapping recovered behavior, which we call operational redundancy. Third, removing semantically selected directions reduces VO-retained recovery more than matched-random removal in all five settings. Together, these results distinguish semantic alignment, removal cost, and retained recovery as complementary evidence about the functional role of fine-tuning updates within the evaluated CLIP recipe.

AI.tldr: 该论文用"逆转(reversion)"与"保留(retention)"配对实验，量化CLIP微调增量(尤其是attention VO权重)对任务性能的因果贡献，并提出 operational redundancy 与语义对齐、移除代价、保留恢复三类互补证据。
AI.motivation: 权重空间可解释性给微调增量赋予语义描述，但无法说明任务性能在多大程度上真正依赖这些被识别的更新——尤其当其他更新也能支撑同样预测时。
AI.method: 在合成金融图表、Flowers102、EuroSAT、FGVCAircraft 上微调 CLIP(ViT-L/14，Flowers102 另加 ViT-B/16)，统一调最后六个视觉block；配对使用 reversion(把选定参数还原为预训练值)与 retention(只保留选定微调更新)，对比 VO 与随机等量子集、VO+MLP 联合保留，并做语义方向移除实验。
AI.result: 仅 VO 更新即恢复43-87%的精度提升，但逆转 VO 后图表任务精度不变；VO 权重恢复的 loss 改善超过全部十个等大小层匹配随机子集；VO+MLP 保留共同纠正25-81%的预训练错误；移除语义选定方向对 VO 保留恢复的削弱在所有五个设置中均大于匹配随机移除。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐、移除代价与保留恢复构成互补证据；微调增量存在显著操作冗余，单一可解释性信号不足，需多证据交叉验证其功能角色（限于所评估的CLIP配方）。

title: PS-DLO: Property- and Spatially Aware Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Policy
summary: Deformable linear objects (DLO) pose a coupled perception and control challenge: their slender geometry makes precise localization difficult, while their deformations depend on object-specific physical properties. To address this challenge, we propose PS-DLO, a property- and spatially aware DLO manipulation policy. First, contrastive image-text learning maps the initial observation to categorical descriptions of DLO properties, providing explicit physical and structural priors for action generation. Second, SAM3 extracts mask-guided features from future observations, which are distilled into the policy's action expert to encode task-relevant DLO regions and their subsequent configurations. We evaluate PS-DLO on nine real-world tasks across single-arm and bimanual platforms, training a shared multi-task policy for each embodiment. PS-DLO achieves an average success rate of 68.9%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.0 percentage points. In generalization experiments, PS-DLO achieves higher success rates than the baseline in six of seven visual-shift conditions on butterfly-knot untying. These results demonstrate that combining object-property priors with future spatial supervision improves multi-task DLO manipulation and robustness to visual variation.

AI.tldr: 提出PS-DLO策略：用对比图文学习将初始观测映射为线状可变形物体（DLO）属性的类别化描述作为物理/结构先验，并用SAM3从未来观测提取掩码引导特征、蒸馏进动作专家，实现属性感知与空间感知的DLO操作。真实双臂/单臂9任务平均成功率68.9%，超最强基线20个百分点。
AI.motivation: DLO细长几何导致精确定位困难，且形变依赖物体特定的物理属性，构成感知与控制的耦合挑战；现有策略缺少显式的物体属性先验与对任务相关区域后续构型的空间监督。
AI.method: PS-DLO包含两部分：(1) 对比式图文学习，把初始观测映射到DLO属性的类别化文本描述，为动作生成提供显式物理与结构先验；(2) 用SAM3从未来观测中提取掩码引导特征，蒸馏到策略的动作专家中，编码任务相关的DLO区域及其后续构型。每个具身形态训练一个共享多任务策略。
AI.result: 在单臂与双臂平台的9个真实任务上，平均成功率68.9%，比最强基线高20.0个百分点；在蝴蝶结解结的7种视觉偏移条件下，有6种成功率高于基线。
AI.conclusion: 将物体属性先验与未来空间监督相结合，可提升多任务DLO操作成功率及对视觉变化的鲁棒性。

title: MuSTEL: A Large-Scale Multilingual Synthetic Text-Line Image Dataset for OCR
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) systems depend strongly on the scale and diversity of their training data. One approach to document OCR first analyzes the page layout and extracts text-line images, which are then transcribed by a recognition model. Multilingual line-level recognition involving Persian, Arabic, and English presents additional challenges because different writing directions, fonts, and styles may coexist within a single line. This paper introduces MuSTEL, a large-scale synthetic multilingual OCR dataset containing more than 14.5 million annotated text-line images, organized into a training partition and predefined small and large test sets. Samples are generated from natural-language corpora, including multilingual content already present in the source texts. The generation framework incorporates capability-aware font selection, within-line font and style changes, mixed-direction text rendering, highlighting, and underlining. A validated repository of 2,009 font files from 711 families supports broad typographic coverage, while varied backgrounds, blur, geometric distortion, skew, stroke width, and image save quality provide diverse document-like appearances. Statistical analysis characterizes the dataset's language composition, transcription lengths, lexical and character-sequence diversity, image dimensions, typography, and rendering conditions. MuSTEL provides a resource for training and evaluating multilingual line-level OCR systems and investigating recognition robustness across languages, writing directions, and visual conditions.

AI.tldr: MuSTEL：>1450万张多语言（波斯/阿拉伯/英文）合成文本行图像OCR数据集，含混合书写方向、字体/样式变换与图像退化。
AI.motivation: 行级OCR依赖数据规模与多样性；波斯语、阿拉伯语与英语混合场景存在行内多书写方向、多字体样式共存问题，缺乏大规模行级多语言训练数据。
AI.method: 用自然语言语料合成文本行图像：能力感知的字体选择、行内字体与样式切换、混合方向渲染、高亮与下划线；711个字体家族共2009个字体文件；叠加背景、模糊、几何畸变、倾斜、笔画宽度与保存质量等退化；提供训练集与预设大小两档测试集，并做语料/长度/字符多样性/尺寸/排版/渲染条件的统计分析。
AI.result: 构建超1450万标注文本行图像的大规模合成多语言OCR数据集，具备覆盖广泛的排版与视觉条件多样性；摘要未给出模型训练与精度数值结果。
AI.conclusion: MuSTEL为多语言行级OCR的训练与评测提供数据资源，可用于研究跨语言、跨书写方向与视觉条件的识别鲁棒性。

title: Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?
comment: Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 33 pages, 14 figures, and 23 tables
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 SATE-Bench，一个含 316 个真实场景、2,525 条多轮 QA 的交互式基准，用于评测 MLLM 的视觉自我感知与主动外视角探索（从严重遮挡视角出发迭代查询相邻视角直至证据“饱和”），并给出步数惩罚的效率奖励；实验表明 SOTA 模型过早终止探索却高置信，且 GRPO 微调奖励"找视角"会提升探索率但降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 空间能力评测多为静态、被动观测，在遮挡严重的人类中心场景中关键几何证据被掩盖；被动评测迫使模型"猜"而非识别自身视觉不确定性，缺少对主动视角探索的评测。
AI.method: 构建 SATE-Bench：316 个真实场景 + 2,525 多轮问答，含被动多视角对照设置与主动探索设置；主动设置下模型从严重遮挡视角出发，逐轮查询相邻视角，直至证据充分，并以步数惩罚的效率奖励计分。同时用 GRPO 对模型进行视图寻求奖励的微调，并做匹配视角对照实验分离主动—被动差距来源。
AI.result: SOTA MLLM 倾向过早终止探索且报告高置信度，细粒度 3D 几何任务表现差；匹配视角对照表明主动—被动差距主要源于证据获取不足；GRPO 奖励视图寻求虽提升探索频率，但整体准确率下降，模型过度探索且无法跨轮融合扩张的多视角上下文。
AI.conclusion: 被动多视角感知的规模扩展并不能自发产生主动空间推理能力；需具备"知道看哪里、如何整合所见、何时停止"三项能力的模型，为主动空间推理研究提供了评测与诊断工具。

title: Execution Logs Sway VLM Judges of Robot Progress
summary: Vision-language models now grade robot videos, and text placed beside the frames can change their verdicts. On clips where the robot is losing progress, we add one log line saying the robot is making progress. Across Gemini, Qwen and GPT judges, this flips correct verdicts to progress 10 to 35 percentage points more often than a neutral line does. A one-line warning that the log may be wrong removes most of this effect. Selected fake "task complete" claims flip half of Qwen's correct verdicts, against a tenth for unrelated log lines. They have no detectable effect on Gemini.

AI.tldr: Suggests that text logs placed beside robot video frames can bias vision-language model judges of robot progress; an inserted "making progress" log line inflates incorrect progress verdicts by 10–35 pts, and a one-line warning largely neutralizes the effect.
AI.motivation: VLM-based grading of robot videos is increasingly used for automated evaluation, yet judges are sensitive to co-present text (prompt/log injection), which undermines the reliability of these verdicts.
AI.method: Controlled adversarial probing: on clips where the robot is losing progress, inject a single fake log line ("robot is making progress") plus contrastive conditions (neutral line, unrelated log lines, explicit fake "task complete" claims) and a one-line warning that the log may be wrong; evaluate across Gemini, Qwen and GPT judges.
AI.result: Fake progress log flips correct verdicts to "progress" 10–35 percentage points more often than neutral text across all three judge families; a single-line warning removes most of the effect. Crafted "task complete" claims flip ~50% of Qwen's correct verdicts versus ~10% for unrelated lines, with no detectable effect on Gemini.
AI.conclusion: VLM video judges are vulnerable to text-side injection that is not visible-prone in the video, and judge robustness varies strongly by model; lightweight warnings help but the evaluation interface needs to be hardened before automated robot-video grading is trusted.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Crowd Flow Control Using Dynamic Barriers
comment: An earlier version was presented at the 26th Scientific Forum for Hajj, Umrah and Visit Research, Umm Al-Qura University (2026)
summary: Crowd barriers are widely used to regulate pedestrian movement during large public events such as pilgrimages. However, fixed barrier layouts often create unnecessary stopping and local congestion even when they successfully control the overall crowd flow. Finding better barrier configurations is difficult because there is no dataset that provides the best barrier placement for a given crowd scene. We address this challenge by introducing a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework that learns barrier configurations without requiring labelled training data. Starting from a segmented crowd scene, we construct a realistic simulation environment that reproduces the observed pedestrian distribution. This environment is then used to train a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent that continuously adjusts barrier positions to improve pedestrian movement. Unlike supervised approaches the proposed framework allows the agent to explore barrier configurations that have never been observed in real data. We evaluate the learned policy under unseen numbers of pedestrians. The learned policy consistently outperforms the existing manually designed barrier configuration by reducing pedestrian stops while maintaining effective flow regulation. These results demonstrate that combining computer vision crowd simulation and reinforcement learning provides an effective framework for optimizing crowd control infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 用仿真驱动的强化学习（SAC）框架从分割后的人群场景中学习隔离栏布局，无需标注数据，在未见人数下减少行人停顿并维持流量调控效果。
AI.motivation: 大型公共活动（如朝圣）中固定隔离栏布局虽能控制整体人流，但会造成不必要的停顿与局部拥堵；由于不存在"给定人群场景的最优隔离栏摆放"数据集，难以用监督方法优化布局。
AI.method: 从分割后的人群场景出发，构建复现观测行人分布的真实仿真环境；在该环境中训练 Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）智能体，连续调整隔离栏位置以改善行人流动，允许智能体探索真实数据中从未观测到的布局。
AI.result: 在未见行人数量条件下评估学习到的策略，其相比现有手工设计布局持续减少行人停顿，同时保持有效的流量调控能力。摘要中未给出定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 将计算机视觉人群仿真与强化学习结合，可为人群控制基础设施的优化提供有效框架；但仅在仿真中验证，缺少真实场景部署与其他基线对比。

title: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
summary: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them.
