On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.

AI.tldr: FreezePlan：在 Qwen-Image-2.1 指令图像编辑中，用逐步成本模型把加速预算在"步缓存"（TaylorSeer）与"区域冻结"之间分配，5 步全量+其余交给 TaylorSeer，端到端 5.05× 加速、与原输出 29.8 dB PSNR，VLM 评分无显著下降。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 图像编辑器需数十步去噪，训练无关加速有两条路线（跨步特征复用 / 未编辑区域冻结），二者已被组合，但"高目标加速比应如何在两者间分配"这一问题缺乏研究；且冻结能降低每步成本，会改变缓存可用的保守阈值。
AI.method: 建立拟合于开发集的每步成本模型（预测留出延迟中位误差 4.0%）；分析冻结与步缓存的相互作用，并比较冻结 token 的两种回填方式（模型单步 x0 估计 vs. 参考图）；据此设计 FreezePlan：保留 5 个全量步，其余步预算交给 TaylorSeer，并在其调度下替换不同区域选择器做消融。
AI.result: 成本模型复现所重实现区域方法的速度上限（RegionE 预测 2.73× vs 实测 2.70×）；单步 x0 回填在所有开发样本上优于参考图回填，90% 情形下复合误差小于两误差之和；预注册测试集上 5.05× 加速、29.8 dB（TaylorSeer 同速为 23.5 dB），曲线可延伸至 5.99×/28.0 dB；换用先前方法的区域选择器中位 PSNR 仅降 0.5–0.6 dB。
AI.conclusion: 主要增益来自调度与预算分配而非区域选择器；提供可预测的速度—质量 Pareto 曲线与可解释成本模型，为训练无关扩散加速的预算拆分给出实用配方。

title: Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory
summary: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

AI.tldr: 提出 Factorized Write Routing (FWR)，将"是否写入记忆"与"写入多少槽位"解耦，在多槽循环记忆中先门控 tokens 再自适应分配槽位，发现长上下文精度呈密度依赖的反转：信息密集任务应全写入，稀疏事实任务应选择性写入。
AI.motivation: 长序列模型需保留早期信息。全注意力保留所有 token 但代价高；循环记忆模型将历史压缩到固定槽位以实现线性时间，但容量有限使"写入决策"变得关键：干扰项会污染有用内容，被跳过的证据则无法召回。现有多种子记忆对每个 token 都写入相同数量的槽位，把"是否存储"与"更新几个槽位"这两件事混在一起。
AI.method: Factorized Write Routing：对每个 token 先做 keep/skip 门控，再决定写入固定数量或 token 自适应的槽位数；读取阶段查询仍访问全部槽位。在两个合成任务（长上下文后查询事实）上以十组随机种子评估，并设置使用事实标签的诊断性 oracle 上界分析。
AI.result: 观察到密度依赖的反转：每写 4 槽时，密集的 Feature Recall 上"总是写入"更优（0.472 vs 0.337）；稀疏事实的 Passkey 上学习式选择性写入更优（0.222 vs 0.048）。在学到的门控下，所测自适应槽位分配规则在两个任务上均不如固定分配。使用部署时不可得标签的 oracle 在 Passkey 上达 0.372，说明过滤干扰项仍有较大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 记忆写入策略应与信息密度匹配：信息密集上下文应避免漏写，干扰项占主导时应加强过滤；写入门控与槽位分配的解耦是有价值的设计方向，但当前自适应分配规则未带来增益，留待进一步研究。

title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
summary: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.

AI.tldr: HuGe：基于2000+小时第一人称人类与机器人数据预训练的人形通用VLA系列，通过潜动作token+全身控制器接口、三阶段训练（第一人称预训练/人形适配/下游微调）、伪本体感觉构造与第一人称观测手臂重渲染实现跨具身迁移，在HumanoidArena达SOTA，并在Unitree G1上验证人类示范增强真实机器人示范可显著提升pick-and-drop成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身协调控制的VLA需要大量真实示范，采集成本高；第一人称人类示范是补充数据源，但存在视觉具身差异（人手/人臂外观）与缺失机器人本体感觉两大障碍，阻碍向人形策略迁移。
AI.method: 在三种代表性VLA架构上统一输出预训练全身控制器的潜动作token与手部控制信号；构建三阶段流水线：第一人称人类数据预训练→人形适配→下游任务微调；预训练阶段用仿真回放生成伪本体感觉状态以补全缺失proprioception；下游微调阶段对第一人称观测中的手臂外观进行重渲染以缩小视觉具身差距。
AI.result: 在仿真基准HumanoidArena上取得SOTA；在Unitree G1真机上，用视觉适配后的第一人称人类示范增强机器人示范，显著提升pick-and-drop任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 潜动作token作为VLA与全身控制器之间的抽象接口，配合伪本体感觉与视觉重渲染两类具身对齐手段，可有效利用大规模第一人称人类视频数据训练人形通用策略；人类示范增强对真实机器人性能有实质增益。

title: GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

AI.tldr: GeoPrompt：面向水下开放词汇实例分割的几何条件化提示学习框架，用深度派生结构先验替代不稳定的视觉外观对齐，生成几何感知文本分类器，在 MARIS-OpenIS 上达 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 OVIS 依赖视觉-语言对齐，但水下色衰减、散射、浑浊与低对比度使区域视觉特征偏离语义概念，视觉-文本相似度不可靠，且未见类无法靠类别监督校正。作者观察到几何结构在水下退化场景中比视觉外观更稳定。
AI.method: GeoPrompt 含两模块：(1) GVAM 几何引导视觉适配，提取深度派生结构先验并注入多尺度视觉特征；(2) GCPL 几何条件化提示学习，从结构表征生成几何感知文本分类器，并与固定文本分类器、图像条件文本分类器融合以增强开放词汇语义对齐。
AI.result: 在 MARIS-OpenIS 基准上取得 SOTA，并在水下开放词汇实例分割任务上带来一致性提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 验证了几何结构先验在水下退化场景下作为视觉-语言对齐替代/补充信号的有效性，为域退化条件下的开放词汇感知提供思路。

title: Timing Matters Twice: When to Query and When to Skip in Flow-Matching On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables flow-matching models to acquire complementary capabilities from specialized teachers through supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, different evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics and OCR accuracy, and different tasks, such as image generation and editing, emphasize different aspects of the denoising process, suggesting that their effective supervision may occur at different stages. Existing methods typically select supervision states from predefined timestep distributions, which may overlook these phase-dependent differences and incur unnecessary computational overhead. This motivates two critical timing decisions: when to adaptively query teachers for effective supervision based on the evolving generative process, and when to skip the remaining rollout to avoid redundant computation. In this paper, we introduce PhaseOPD, a phase-aware query-and-skip framework that identifies generative phases online from revisions of predicted-clean latents, using existing student velocity predictions without additional model evaluations. For each task-assigned teacher, PhaseOPD selects a supervision state based on its phase preference and skips the unused rollout suffix once all query decisions are finalized, preserving the single-query velocity-distillation objective. On SD3.5-M, PhaseOPD executes only 5.56 of 16 rollout positions per local batch, reducing training time by 41.3% relative to DanceOPD while improving Aesthetic, GenEval, and OCR scores.

AI.tldr: PhaseOPD: a phase-aware query-and-skip framework for on-policy distillation of flow-matching models that selects teacher supervision states based on online-identified generative phases and skips the unused rollout suffix, cutting training time by 41.3% vs. DanceOPD on SD3.5-M while improving Aesthetic, GenEval and OCR scores.
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation lets flow-matching models learn from specialized teachers on student-generated trajectories, but different evaluation dimensions (aesthetics vs. OCR accuracy) and different tasks (generation vs. editing) emphasize different stages of denoising. Existing methods draw supervision states from predefined timestep distributions, ignoring such phase-dependent differences and wasting computation.
AI.method: Identifies generative phases online from the revision magnitude of predicted-clean latents, reusing existing student velocity predictions without extra model evaluations. Per task-assigned teacher, selects a supervision state according to that teacher's phase preference; once all query decisions are settled, truncates the remaining rollout suffix, retaining the single-query velocity-distillation objective.
AI.result: On SD3.5-M, only 5.56 of 16 rollout positions per local batch are executed; training time drops 41.3% versus DanceOPD while Aesthetic, GenEval and OCR scores all improve.
AI.conclusion: Phase-dependent, adaptive teacher querying makes on-policy distillation of flow-matching/generative models both cheaper and more effective; the phase signal is essentially free, and the framework is compatible with the existing single-query distillation objective, suggesting plug-and-play applicability to other multi-teacher distillation settings.

title: MIS-VQA: An Annotation-Driven Surgical Vision-Language Dataset for Complex Surgical Understanding
summary: Modern surgical AI increasingly requires multimodal understanding rather than isolated perception, yet existing datasets remain largely limited to single-task supervision such as recognition or templated question answering. Current medical VQA resources often rely on synthetic templates, lack natural descriptive supervision, or provide sparse annotations that hinder reasoning about spatial relations and procedural context. We introduce MIS-VQA, a surgical vision-language dataset generated through an annotation-driven pipeline that converts heterogeneous surgical annotations into structured textual scene representations. Using EndoVis18 and CholecT50, we transform phase, instrument, interaction, triplet, and segmentation labels into unified contexts that guide large language models to generate clinically coherent question-answer pairs. MIS-VQA supports four response types-concise and detailed descriptions, perception-level grounding, and multi-step reasoning-enabling hierarchical evaluation from atomic visual grounding to compositional reasoning. To address annotation sparsity, we incorporate confidence-filtered segmentation and cross-annotation consistency checks, enabling spatially grounded supervision at scale. MIS-VQA establishes a unified benchmark for surgical vision-language understanding with spatial supervision and multi-tier reasoning evaluation. To demonstrate its utility, we introduce LLaVA-SurgXpert, a family of surgical vision-language models with visual encoders to analyze how visual representations influence multimodal reasoning. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing surgical VQA baselines while revealing capability gaps between perceptual grounding and higher-level reasoning hidden in prior benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MIS-VQA：由手术标注驱动生成的多模态手术视觉-语言数据集，含四种回答类型与分层评测；配套给出 LLaVA-SurgXpert 模型族。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视觉-语言数据集多为单任务监督或模板化 VQA，缺乏自然描述性监督与空间关系、流程上下文推理所需标注。
AI.method: 将 EndoVis18 与 CholecT50 的阶段、器械、交互、三元组、分割标签转成结构化文本场景表示，引导 LLM 生成临床连贯 QA 对；引入置信度过滤分割与跨标注一致性检查以缓解标注稀疏；四种回答类型（简/详描述、感知级 grounding、多步推理）支撑分层评测；另提出 LLaVA-SurgXpert 模型族考察视觉编码器对多模态推理的影响。
AI.result: 相较现有手术 VQA 基线稳定提升，并揭示感知 grounding 与高层推理之间的能力差距（此前基准中未显现）。
AI.conclusion: MIS-VQA 提供带空间监督与多层级推理评测的统一手术视觉-语言基准，属医疗领域数据集工作。

title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
summary: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

AI.tldr: 提出 StaX-Net：Stackelberg 交错非对称网络，用于跨模态医学图像翻译，通过部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构与 2D FAST 层注入目标域先验，并用非对称优化稳定训练。
AI.motivation: 跨模态医学图像翻译常出现解剖结构不一致的合成结果，可能影响临床诊断，需要约束生成过程以保持解剖一致性。
AI.method: Stackelberg 启发的非对称生成式框架：(1) 生成器与判别器共享部分编码块以增强特征对齐（部分耦合编码器-判别器）；(2) 2D 特征聚合与空间变换（FAST）层，在学习使用特权信息（LUPI）范式下蒸馏目标监督先验，推理时仅用源域变换；(3) 显式共享参数冻结与非对称学习率实现 leader-follower 非对称优化。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；声称 FAST 层机制上通过目标域先验约束合成，相对标准生成架构可提升解剖一致性，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 为医学跨模态翻译提供了参数共享 + 特权信息蒸馏 + 非对称优化的组合方案；但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，应用领域限于医学影像。

title: From Presence Labels to Bounding Boxes: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Scale Surgical Instrument Localization?
summary: Spatial localization of surgical instruments through bounding-box annotations is a foundational component of surgical scene understanding, supporting detection, tracking, interaction analysis, and grounded vision-language applications. Yet existing annotations often cover selected frames, video subsets, or dataset variants rather than complete procedures. Manual extension is time-consuming and expert-dependent. Additionally, weakly supervised and detector-based pseudo-labels require task-specific training and may be imprecise. In this study, we design a scalable MLLM-based annotation framework that converts surgical frames and existing instrument-presence labels into accurate bounding boxes, and systematically analyze its reliability, cost, and design sensitivity. We instantiate the framework using six MLLMs and a multi-call configuration on laparoscopic cholecystectomy in Cholec80. Using a carefully designed stratification scheme, two annotators independently label 1,000 frames, and an expert surgeon reviews one annotation set to establish the reference. Results show that instrument-set F1 ranges from 88.2 to 92.7,whereas mIoU ranges from 0.180 to 0.735, showing that comparable recognition can conceal large localization differences. A structured multi-stage annotation pipeline achieves 0.784 mIoU, compared with 0.735 for the best single-call baseline and 0.814 human-human agreement. Using the best accuracy pipeline, we create and publicly release a spatial extension of Cholec80 comprising 285,977 bounding boxes across all 184,498 annotated frames from the 80 videos. The annotations and human references are made available on GitHub

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于MLLM的可扩展手术器械包围框标注框架，将图像帧与已有的器械存在性标签转化为精确bbox，并在Cholec80上系统分析其可靠性、成本与设计敏感性，最终公开发布285,977个框的全数据集空间扩展。
AI.motivation: 手术场景理解依赖器械空间定位的bbox标注，但现有标注仅覆盖部分帧、视频子集或数据集变体，无法覆盖完整手术流程；人工扩展耗时且依赖专家；弱监督与检测器伪标签需任务特定训练且精度不足。因此需要一个可扩展、低成本、可系统的评估的自动标注方案。
AI.method: 设计MLLM-based标注框架，把手术帧+已有instrument-presence标签转成bbox；用6个MLLM及多次调用(multi-call)配置实例化；在Cholec80腹腔镜胆囊切除上，通过分层抽样选1000帧，两名标注者独立标注、专家外科医生复核一套作为参考基准，比较instrument-set F1、mIoU及人-人一致性。
AI.result: instrument-set F1为88.2–92.7，但mIoU跨度0.180–0.735，说明识别指标相近可掩盖巨大定位差异；结构化多阶段流水线mIoU达0.784，优于最佳单次调用基线0.735，接近人-人一致性0.814；据此发布覆盖80个视频全部184,498个标注帧、285,977个bbox的Cholec80空间扩展数据集。
AI.conclusion: MLLM可作为可扩展的手术器械bbox标注器，但必须用mIoU等定位指标而非仅分类F1来评估；多阶段结构化提示显著提升定位质量并逼近人工一致性；强调"F1高≠定位准"的评估陷阱，并公开数据与人工参考。

title: CropReward: A Human-Preference Benchmark and Reward Model for Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Aesthetic image cropping (AIC) aims to improve image composition and aesthetic quality by removing extraneous or distracting content. Over the past decade, AIC methods have evolved from specialized vision models to multimodal large language models(MLLMs). Reliable evaluation that reflects human preferences is essential for benchmarking AIC methods and guiding model optimization. However, the current AIC evaluation relies largely on geometry-based metrics such as intersection over union (IoU), as well as image aesthetic assessment(IAA) models. Although inconsistencies with human preferences have long been observed, the robustness and reliability of these evaluation criteria remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we first construct CropBench, a large-scale benchmark comprising 106,995 human preference pairs for 1,019 images, with each candidate set containing the original image and candidate crops produced by 14 AIC methods. A systematic study on CropBench reveals that the existing criteria, ranging from IoU to off-the-shelf IAA assessment models, only exhibit limited alignment with human preferences. Building upon CropBench, we further propose CropReward, an MLLM-based reward model that evaluates a candidate crop by comparing with the original uncropped image and outputs a score indicating explicit aesthetic improvement or degradation relative to the original. In addition, we employ CropReward to construct CropReward-300k, the largest AIC dataset to date, and further develop CropAlign, a preference-aligned AIC model trained solely with CropReward supervision, without human-annotated crop boxes. Experimental results demonstrate that CropReward aligns with human preferences significantly better than existing criteria. CropAlign also surpasses the state-of-the-art AIC methods, demonstrating the advantage of CropReward in guiding AIC model optimization.

AI.tldr: 构建CropBench（1019张图、14种裁剪方法、106,995个人类偏好对）系统揭示现有AIC评测指标（IoU、IAA模型）与人偏好对齐有限，并提出MLLM奖励模型CropReward与仅用其监督训练的偏好对齐裁剪模型CropAlign。
AI.motivation: 美学图像裁剪（AIC）评测长期依赖IoU等几何指标与图像美学评估（IAA）模型，虽已知与人偏好不一致，但其鲁棒性与可靠性缺乏系统检验，缺少可反映人类偏好的可信评测基准。
AI.method: 1）构建CropBench大规模人类偏好基准，每张图的候选集含原图及14种AIC方法的裁剪结果，共106,995偏好对；2）在CropBench上系统比较IoU类几何指标与现成IAA模型与人偏好的对齐度；3）提出CropReward——基于MLLM的奖励模型，将候选裁剪与原图比较，输出相对原图的显式美学提升/退化分数；4）用CropReward标注构建CropReward-300k数据集，并在无人工标注裁剪框条件下仅以CropReward监督训练CropAlign。
AI.result: 现有IoU与IAA类指标仅与人偏好有有限对齐；CropReward与人偏好的一致性显著优于现有准则；CropAlign超越当前SOTA的AIC方法，验证CropReward在指导AIC模型优化方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 偏好对齐的奖励模型是比几何/IAA指标更可靠的AIC评测与优化信号，可用于大规模数据构建与模型训练，形成“基准—奖励模型—数据—模型”的闭环。

title: BoundedGS: Memory-Efficient High-Resolution Training for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-resolution 3D Gaussian Splatting training increases pixel and Gaussian-tile intersection counts, expanding rasterization caches that coexist with projection and gradient state at peak memory. A complete-view update aggregates gradients across the view; each region's forward and backward caches can be released after its contribution is collected. BoundedGS separates rasterization and projection backward passes and bounds the active local rasterization working set according to its measured load. Candidate-indexed projection and compact gradient storage address the view-level peaks exposed by this change, while CPU-assisted structure rebuilding and bounded image supply manage resources outside rendering. In a resolution sweep at a fixed count of about 6M Gaussians, the measured rendering working set stays within 1.073-1.077 GiB from 1K to 16K; at 11K, a warm pass takes 19.79 seconds versus 21.76 for full-frame execution. Across five native 5K outdoor scenes, full training reduces the mean rendering working set from 9.97 to 1.76 GiB (82.3%), retains similar reconstruction quality, and shortens training time from 36.7 to 33.9 minutes. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: BoundedGS通过分离光栅化与投影反向传播、按实测负载限制活跃光栅化工作集、候选索引投影与紧凑梯度存储、CPU辅助结构重建，将高分辨率3DGS训练显存峰值降低约82%，且重建质量基本持平、训练略快。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D Gaussian Splatting训练中，像素与Gaussian-tile交叠数随分辨率增长，光栅化缓存与投影、梯度状态在峰值内存处并存，导致显存占用急剧膨胀，限制高分辨率/高Gaussian数量场景的训练可行性。
AI.method: 1）按完整视角更新，各区域贡献收集完毕后即可释放其前向与反向缓存；2）将光栅化反向与投影反向拆分为两个阶段，依据实测负载上界化活跃局部光栅化工作集；3）对视图级峰值采用候选索引投影（candidate-indexed projection）与紧凑梯度存储；4）渲染之外用CPU辅助的结构重建与有界图像供给管理资源。
AI.result: 固定约6M Gaussian、1K–16K分辨率扫描中渲染工作集稳定在1.073–1.077 GiB；11K分辨率下warm pass 19.79s，全帧执行为21.76s。五个原生5K室外场景全量训练：平均渲染工作集从9.97 GiB降至1.76 GiB（-82.3%），重建质量相近，训练时间由36.7min缩短至33.9min。
AI.conclusion: 通过反向传播分阶段与工作集上界化，可在几乎不损失质量的前提下显著压缩3DGS高分辨率训练的显存峰值并略降训练时长，为高分辨率、大规模场景重建与后续实时/端侧部署提供了实用工程路径。

title: ParetoGS: High-Quality Continuous-Budget 3D Gaussian Splatting with Sparse Adapted Anchors
summary: Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting allows one scene representation to serve different Gaussian-count budgets, yet its quality-budget curve may lag behind models optimized separately for each budget. Reducing the number of Gaussians changes both the selected members and the reconstruction tasks carried by the survivors; parameters inherited from a high-budget model may fit a low-budget representation poorly. We propose ParetoGS, which describes member changes and parameter evolution with a small set of adapted budget anchors and decodes intermediate budgets without separate optimization at every requested count. ParetoGS alternates pruning and fixed-member adaptation to build nested anchors with persistent identities, and encodes their parameter changes relative to the full model in a compact residual atlas. At decoding, it interpolates the states of shared members and gradually introduces the rendering contributions of new members, connecting sparse anchors into a continuous-budget representation. Across 13 scenes, ParetoGS attains better average PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS with fewer Gaussians than the compared prefix methods at 10% of each method's own full model. From a shared full model, it also outperforms FlexGS-imp at its trained 1%, 5%, and 10% budgets and NanoGS-imp at the 1% and 0.1% budgets. On Garden, its non-anchor quality approaches an empirical reference from independently optimized GNS models at higher retention ratios and exceeds it at some lower-budget points. Across 13 scenes, encoding reduces mean additional state from 390.0 to 85.7 MB with an average PSNR change of 0.01 dB. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ParetoGS 用少量经过自适应训练的预算锚点（nested anchors）加一个紧凑的残差图谱（residual atlas），把高预算 3DGS 模型的参数变化编码为相对全模型的残差，从而在不逐预算单独优化的情况下解码出任意中间高斯数量预算的场景表示，得到连续的质量-预算曲线。
AI.motivation: 可扩展 3DGS 希望用一份表示服务多个高斯数量预算，但单一模型的质量-预算曲线常落后于各预算单独优化的模型：减少高斯既改变成员集合，也改变幸存者承担的渲染任务，直接从高预算模型继承的参数在低预算下拟合不佳。
AI.method: 交替执行剪枝与固定成员适配（fixed-member adaptation），构造具有持久成员身份（persistent identities）的嵌套锚点；将各锚点相对全模型的参数变化编码为紧凑残差图谱。解码时对共享成员状态插值，并渐进引入新成员的渲染贡献，把稀疏锚点连成连续预算表示。
AI.result: 13 个场景上，在各自全模型 10% 高斯量时平均 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 优于前缀（prefix）方法且高斯更少；共享全模型下在 1%/5%/10% 预算超过 FlexGS-imp，在 1%/0.1% 超过 NanoGS-imp；Garden 上非锚点质量逼近独立优化 GNS 的经验参考线，低预算部分点超过它；编码将平均额外状态从 390.0 MB 降至 85.7 MB，平均 PSNR 变化仅 0.01 dB。
AI.conclusion: 以少量锚点加残差编码实现多预算 3DGS 表示是有效且存储经济的方案，接近甚至超过逐预算独立优化的质量，为可部署的按需计算-质量权衡提供路径。但实验限于少场景、以渲染指标为主，缺实时性与真实场景泛化/下游任务验证。

title: $Δτ$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
summary: In this paper, we introduce $\Delta\tau$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $\Delta\tau$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $\Delta\tau$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出 Δτ-Bench：一个可执行智能体基准，用 42 个域、1,588 个多轮任务、6 个经"能力保持变换"生成的连续生态状态，模拟工具生态的结构性演化；评测显示最强模型/框架仅 42.3% 成功率，已有技能学习方法收益难以持续迁移；随后提出 Steward，通过增量技能维护与执行期动态供给联合管理工具与程序性知识。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准未同时考察两项能力：(1) 在移动的能力前沿上主动发现高效工具使用路径；(2) 及时修正已积累的程序性知识。真实工具生态中服务独立演化，熟悉工具会消失或被替换，更优替代在功能重叠与噪声文档中出现，需要专门基准刻画这种结构性演化。
AI.method: 构建可执行基准 Δτ-Bench，覆盖 42 个领域、1,588 个经校验的多轮任务，通过保持能力的变换生成 6 个连续生态状态（工具增删替换、功能重叠、文档噪声）。在此基础上提出 Steward 生态管理器：在任务执行过程中进行增量式技能维护与动态工具供给，联合管理工具集合与程序性知识。
AI.result: 最强被测模型或框架在 Δτ-Bench 上仅达 42.3% 任务成功率；现有技能学习方法的初期收益在生态演化后无法稳定转化为更强适应能力。Steward 在生态变化中维持更高成功率、技能维护开销更低，并同时改善中断工作流的恢复与新更高效替代工具的采纳。
AI.conclusion: 工具生态的结构性演化是当前智能体系统的关键短板，静态基准与现有技能学习范式无法充分衡量与解决；将工具与程序性知识作为可共同维护的状态进行增量管理，是提升长期适应性的有效方向，并给出可执行、可复现的评测基线与指标。

title: RacerGS: Residual-Autoregressive Context for 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising approach for fast, high-quality novel-view rendering. However, its large parameter size remains a bottleneck for storage and transmission. We propose RacerGS, a compact 3DGS compression framework that achieves scene reconstruction at significantly reduced storage sizes with preserved fidelity. To obtain compact and spatially coherent features, we design a hash projection model that projects the anchor hash encodings into compact context features. Additionally, we introduce a FiLM-modulated autoregressive GRU context model that utilizes causal dependencies among anchor feature groups and uses recurrent hidden states to refine entropy-model parameters, improving bitrate efficiency. Furthermore, we adaptively entropy-code quantized anchor-attribute residuals relative to their context-predicted means, leveraging spatial consistency to reduce symbol entropy. Overall, RacerGS achieves more than 150x compression over vanilla 3DGS and 28x over Scaffold-GS, while providing comparable rendering quality. Extensive experiments across five datasets demonstrate that RacerGS outperforms prior 3DGS compression methods in both storage reduction and rate-distortion performance.

AI.tldr: RacerGS：基于哈希投影锚点编码、FiLM调制自回归GRU上下文模型与残差熵编码的紧凑3DGS压缩框架，压缩率超原版150倍、超Scaffold-GS 28倍且渲染质量相当。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽能快速高质量新视角渲染，但参数量庞大，存储与传输成为瓶颈，亟需在保真前提下大幅压缩。
AI.method: 1) 哈希投影模型将锚点哈希编码投影为紧凑、空间连贯的上下文特征；2) FiLM调制的自回归GRU上下文模型利用锚点特征组之间的因果依赖，以循环隐状态细化熵模型参数；3) 对量化后的锚点-属性残差（相对上下文预测均值）做自适应熵编码，利用空间一致性降低符号熵。
AI.result: 相对vanilla 3DGS压缩超过150倍、相对Scaffold-GS 28倍，渲染质量相当；在五个数据集上存储缩减与率失真性能均优于已有3DGS压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合锚点级哈希上下文建模与自回归熵模型可有效去除3DGS表示冗余，为3DGS的实用化存储与传输提供高效方案。

title: Robust Single-Parameter Point Cloud Registration using Truncated Lp Functions
summary: We propose a novel method for robust point cloud registration with only one tunable parameter. Our method, dubbed TLP, uses truncated $L_p$ functions with different values of $p$ to assign priority scores to correspondences, select the hypothesis, and refine the final model. By leveraging the robustness of truncated functions, TLP effectively handles the high outlier rates commonly encountered in real-world 3D feature matching. We also exploit GPU parallelization to evaluate hypotheses efficiently, enabling registration from thousands of correspondences in under a second on average. With only one tunable parameter, our method offers greater practicality than multi-parameter methods that require dataset-specific tuning of several parameters. Evaluations on public benchmark datasets demonstrate that TLP achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art single-parameter methods. Furthermore, it outperforms two widely used multi-parameter methods on three of the four evaluated datasets while maintaining competitive runtime.

AI.tldr: TLP: 使用不同 p 值的截断 Lp 函数对对应关系赋优先级、选择假设并精化模型，实现仅含单个超参数的高鲁棒点云配准，GPU 并行下千级对应关系秒级以内完成。
AI.motivation: 现有点云配准方法多依赖多个需按数据集调参的超参数，实用性差；同时真实 3D 特征匹配常含高比例离群点，需要兼具鲁棒性与易用性的单参数方案。
AI.method: 采用截断 Lp 函数（不同 p 值）构建对应关系的优先级评分，据此进行假设选择与最终模型精化；利用截断函数的鲁棒性应对高离群率，并通过 GPU 并行化对所有假设做高效评估。
AI.result: 公开基准上精度优于最先进的单参数方法；在四个评测数据集中的三个上超过两种常用多参数方法，且运行时间具竞争力，千级对应关系平均 1 秒内完成配准。
AI.conclusion: TLP 以单一可调参数在精度与效率上同时取得优势，是比多参数方法更实用的点云配准方案；但其评测集中于特征匹配类配准基准，未涉及机器人实机或具身场景验证。

title: AdaPolicy: Action-Driven Anticipatory Robot Policies via Next-Chunk Prediction
summary: Endowing robot policies with anticipatory capabilities has proven effective in improving control performance. However, existing methods predominantly rely on explicit supervision derived from future observations, in either pixel or latent space, at the cost of additional architectural and computational complexity. Departing from explicit future supervision, we ask whether such foresight can be elicited directly from the action signal. To this end, we propose \textbf{AdaPolicy}, an \textbf{A}ction-\textbf{d}riven \textbf{a}nticipatory policy framework that shapes future-aware representations via cascaded next-chunk prediction. Specifically, an Online Action Head jointly produces the current action chunk and an evolved latent state. Building on this state, a cascaded Unrolled Action Head forecasts the next chunk, and the resulting loss flows back through the evolved state to instill implicit foresight into the online policy. Importantly, this training-only unroll requires no future-observation encoding, keeping AdaPolicy lightweight to train with zero inference-time overhead. Experiments on MetaWorld, RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world deployments demonstrate consistent gains across diverse settings, including up to $14$ percentage points on millimeter-precision tasks such as earphone assembly and shoelace threading. More details and visualizations are available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: AdaPolicy：用"预测下一段动作块"(next-chunk)的自监督替代基于未来观测的显式监督，通过级联展开的Action Head将潜未来信息回灌到在线策略，训练期零推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有"预见性"策略依赖未来观测(pixel或latent)的显式监督，带来额外架构与计算负担；作者质疑远见是否可直接从动作信号中激发，从而避免未来观测编码。
AI.method: 在线Action Head同时输出当前动作块与一个演化的隐状态；级联的Unrolled Action Head基于该隐状态预测下一动作块，其损失经演化状态反向传播，隐式注入前瞻表征。该展开仅在训练时存在，无需未来观测编码，推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在MetaWorld、RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及真实机器人部署上均取得一致提升，在耳机装配、穿鞋带等毫米级精度任务上最高提升约14个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作驱动的隐式未来监督是一种轻量、可插拔的替代方案，无需未来观测与推理开销即可获得跨仿真与真机的稳健增益，为预见性VLA/机器人策略提供新范式。

title: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
summary: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in. ChronoReplay addresses it by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision as chronologically ordered episodes, retaining source-native targets, and balancing supervision across families. Under the same observation access, a single ChronoReplay checkpoint improves OVO-S-Bench, OST-Bench, and UCS-Bench together, including a 13.41-point gain on OST-Bench, and achieves the highest three-benchmark mean among the supervision settings compared here. Same-data controls further separate the ingredients of this transfer: answer serialization redistributes gains across OST and UCS, family-balanced learning improves over ordinary joint SFT and natural turn weighting, and chronological replay exceeds a shifted-order control by about 2.41 OST points across two paired seeds. Adaptive frame selection then changes evidence access while keeping the trained model fixed, providing an additional inference-time gain at lower visual cost. Streaming spatial performance depends on what distinctions supervision preserves, how heterogeneous histories are organized during learning, and what causal evidence inference makes available at test time.

AI.tldr: ChronoReplay通过按时间顺序重放异构空间监督信号来解决空间VLM的"接口锁定"问题，单检查点在OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench、UCS-Bench上同时提升。
AI.motivation: 空间VLM训练存在"接口锁定"(interface lock-in)：训练"物体在哪一侧"并不要求模型保留决定答案的度量位移，监督距离估计又可能让类别关系不受约束。当后训练侧重某一读出接口时，提升集中在该接口，向其他接口的迁移弱甚至退化。
AI.method: 将异构空间监督组织为按时间排序的episode进行重放(replay)，保留源数据原生目标格式(source-native targets)，并在不同监督家族(family)间做平衡。消融对照包括：答案序列化、家族平衡学习、自然轮次加权、移位顺序控制组；推理阶段固定模型，加入自适应帧选择以改变证据获取并降低视觉成本。
AI.result: 在相同的观测访问条件下，单一检查点同时在OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench、UCS-Bench上提升，其中OST-Bench提升13.41点，取得三基准平均最高。同数据对照表明：答案序列化在OST与UCS间重新分配增益；家族平衡优于普通联合SFT与自然轮次加权；时间顺序重放比移位顺序控制组高约2.41个OST点(两个配对种子)。自适应帧选择在推理期带来额外增益且视觉成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 流式/在线空间能力取决于三点：监督保留了哪些区分性信息、学习时如何组织异构历史、推理时能获取何种因果证据。方法论上给出可复用的多任务空间监督编排范式，但主要证据为基准评测，缺少真实机器人部署验证。

title: ScheNav: Schematic-Guided Object Goal Navigation
summary: Object goal navigation requires an embodied agent to locate and reach target objects in complex environments. Humans often rely on low-cost yet informative schematic maps, such as rough sketches or directional annotations. We develop a workflow for schematic-guided embodied navigation with two components: a training-data generation pipeline and ScheNav, a closed-loop navigation framework. Our lightweight data-generation pipeline turns 2D floorplans into navigation training environments, yielding Furnished-RPLAN, a dataset of over 33k furnished layouts with paired navigation episodes and noise-controllable schematic maps. ScheNav turns rough schematic guidance into exploration and stopping decisions by using SchemaField, a learned spatial module that fuses the guidance with accumulated observations and predicts spatial value fields. The framework updates these fields as exploration proceeds, with trajectory-based training and a cross-frame consistency objective supporting coherent guidance across changing viewpoints. ScheNav learns to use schematic guidance entirely from simulated floorplans and transfers this ability to unseen embodied environments. Experiments show improved navigation success and path efficiency across schematic maps, goal ellipses, and pointed directions, together with tolerance to the tested schematic perturbations and omissions. Together, these results demonstrate that rough schematic guidance offers a practical way to improve embodied navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出示意图引导的具身导航工作流：轻量流水线将2D平面图转为导航训练环境（Furnished-RPLAN，33k+布局及配对episode与可控噪声示意图），并提出SchNav闭环框架，用可学习的SchemaField空间模块融合粗糙示意图与累积观测并预测空间价值场，实现探索与停止决策。
AI.motivation: Object goal navigation依赖昂贵精确的感知/地图，而人类常借助低成本但信息量大的草图、方向标注等示意图；现有方法缺乏大规模带示意图标注的导航训练数据，也缺乏将粗粒度示意引导转化为探索/停止决策的机制。
AI.method: 两组件：(1) 数据生成流水线，将2D floorplan转为带家具的导航仿真环境，生成33k+布局、配对导航episode与噪声可控示意图，构成Furnished-RPLAN；(2) ScheNav闭环框架，核心为SchemaField—学习式空间模块，将示意引导与累积观测融合并预测空间价值场，随探索在线更新；训练采用轨迹基目标与跨帧一致性约束以保持视点变化下的引导连贯性。
AI.result: 在示意图、目标椭圆、指向箭头三类引导下均提升导航成功率与路径效率；对测试的示意图扰动与缺失具有容忍度；仅从仿真平面图学习示意引导能力，可迁移至未见具身环境。
AI.conclusion: 粗糙示意图引导是提升具身导航实用且有效的手段，数据生成+价值场学习是其可行实现路径。

title: EditDistill: Is It Possible to Guide Video Editing with Image Editing?
summary: Recent advances in image editing have enabled fine-grained and highly controllable visual modifications. However, achieving similar levels of controllability in video editing remains an open challenge, particularly for precise local edits, dynamic temporal effects, and consistent lighting across this http URL this paper, we propose EditDistill, a framework that distills image-level visual transformations from edits to guide video this http URL , given a source video and an edit prompt, we first generate an edited version of the initial video frame using an off-the-shelf image editing model. We then distill the visual transformation of this original-edited image pair into a compact representation termed an edit this http URL descriptor is injected into a video diffusion model through our lightweight fusion module, which steers the denoising process toward the desired edit. To align the video trajectory with the demonstrated image edit while preserving motion and layout, we train with edit-descriptor alignment and DINO structural consistency losses, and derive an equivalent inference-time guidance formulation under flow this http URL experiments demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance on standard benchmarks and produces high-quality video editing results across diverse scenarios. For more details and videos, please refer to the anonymous webpage: this https URL .

AI.tldr: EditDistill 将图像编辑模型产生的视觉变换蒸馏为一个紧凑的"编辑描述符"，注入视频扩散模型，实现可控局部、时序动态的指令式视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑已具备细粒度、高可控性，而视频编辑在精确局部编辑、动态时序效果和跨帧光照一致性方面仍不可控；直接把图像编辑模型逐帧套用会导致闪烁与不一致。
AI.method: 给定源视频与编辑提示，先用现成图像编辑模型编辑首帧，将"原图—编辑图"对的视觉变换蒸馏为紧凑的 edit descriptor；通过轻量融合模块把描述符注入视频扩散模型的去噪过程以引导编辑方向；训练使用编辑描述符对齐损失与 DINO 结构一致性损失，以保持运动与布局；并在 flow matching 框架下推导出等价的推理期引导公式。
AI.result: 在标准基准上取得较强性能，在多种场景下生成高质量视频编辑结果（摘要未给出具体定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 以图像编辑变换为"教科书信号"蒸馏进视频扩散模型，是获得高可控视频编辑的一种有效、轻量的范式；推理期引导公式使训练与测试目标一致。

title: Real-Time Conveyor Belt Defect Detection via Edge TPU-Accelerated YOLOv11 on Raspberry Pi 5
summary: Conveyor belts are vital arteries in continuous bulk material handling, particularly in heavy process industries such as cement manufacturing. Undetected structural anomalies (longitudinal tears, holes, degraded patch repairs, and impact punctures) cause catastrophic belt snapping, costly downtime, and severe safety hazards. While deep learning offers high accuracy, existing models rely on power-hungry workstation GPUs, hindering practical deployment at remote industrial edge points. In this paper, we propose, implement, and validate an end-to-end, low-power edge AI vision system for real-time conveyor belt defect detection deployed on a Raspberry Pi 5 accelerated by a Google Coral Edge TPU coprocessor. The system leverages an optimized YOLOv11 nano (YOLOv11n) architecture trained on a multi-source industrial corpus exceeding 3,000 augmented samples from an operational cement plant in West Java, open-source datasets, and automated captures. The model undergoes post-training full integer quantization (INT8) compiled for systolic tensor execution. Experimental results demonstrate robust detection capability, achieving precision of 0.742, recall of 0.730, and mAP@0.5 of 0.764 across four defect classes. Deployed on-site in an IP-rated enclosure interfaced with an RTSP PoE industrial camera, the system achieves stable throughput of 30-40 FPS at 320x320 resolution with an end-to-end latency of 70-90 ms. Operational profiling under harsh clinker dust confirms thermal equilibrium at 55 +/- 5 deg C on the host CPU and ~65 deg C on the Edge TPU with zero frame loss. This demonstrates that edge AI bridges the gap between high-accuracy computer vision and cost-effective predictive maintenance in continuous manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 在Raspberry Pi 5 + Google Coral Edge TPU上部署INT8全量化YOLOv11n，实现水泥厂输送带缺陷实时检测，达30-40 FPS、70-90 ms端到端延迟，mAP@0.5=0.764。
AI.motivation: 输送带纵向撕裂、孔洞、补丁退化、冲击穿刺等结构异常若未检出会导致断带、停机与安全事故；现有深度学习模型依赖高功耗工作站GPU，难以在偏远工业边缘点部署。
AI.method: 构建多源工业语料（西爪哇某运营水泥厂数据+开源数据集+自动采集，3000+增强样本）；采用YOLOv11n架构训练；进行训练后全整型INT8量化并编译为Edge TPU的 systolic tensor 可执行格式；部署于IP防护外壳内，接入RTSP PoE工业相机，在Pi 5 + Coral Edge TPU上完成端到端推理。
AI.result: 四类缺陷检测 precision 0.742、recall 0.730、mAP@0.5 0.764；320x320分辨率下稳定30-40 FPS，端到端延迟70-90 ms；熟料粉尘环境下热稳态为主机CPU 55±5°C、Edge TPU约65°C，零丢帧。
AI.conclusion: 边缘AI可在低成本、低功耗硬件上实现高精度工业视觉与预测性维护，弥合精度与实际部署成本之间的鸿沟，具备工业现场实用价值。

title: Learning Discriminative Prototypes via Boundary Repulsion MixUp for Object Re-Identification
summary: Object re-identification requires embeddings that are robust to intra-class variation in viewpoint, illumination, and occlusion, yet preserve sharp separation between visually similar identities. The hardest errors arise precisely where confusable identities meet, a region that pairwise losses shape only implicitly. We present PBR-ReID, a prototype-based framework that makes this inter-class geometry an explicit learning target. Each identity is represented by a learnable prototype jointly optimized with a DiNOv3 backbone and the resulting prototype similarity matrix reveals, at every training step, which identities are most confusable. On this signal we build Boundary Repulsion MixUp (BRM), a geometry-aware regularizer that converts standard MixUp's weakness into a discriminative signal. Rather than interpolating samples across confusable identities, which blurs the boundaries that matter most, BRM constructs an explicit boundary proxy between each confusable pair and repels their features away from it, converting boundary ambiguity into a discriminative signal. We adopt a two-stage training protocol consisting of a prototype warmup phase followed by EMA-stabilized joint fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on person and vehicle ReID benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, with thorough ablations confirming each component's contribution. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PBR-ReID: prototype-based ReID framework making inter-class boundary geometry an explicit learning target via Boundary Repulsion MixUp (BRM), which builds boundary proxies between confusable identity pairs and repels features away from them, with prototype warmup + EMA-stabilized joint fine-tuning.
AI.motivation: Object re-identification needs embeddings robust to intra-class variation yet sharply separated between visually similar identities. The hardest errors occur where confusable identities meet, but pairwise losses only shape this region implicitly (and standard MixUp blurs the most critical boundaries).
AI.method: Learnable per-identity prototypes jointly optimized with a DiNOv3 backbone; prototype similarity matrix identifies most confusable pairs each step. Boundary Repulsion MixUp constructs explicit boundary proxy samples between confusable pairs and repels their features from the proxy instead of interpolating across them. Two-stage protocol: prototype warmup, then EMA-stabilized joint fine-tuning.
AI.result: Extensive experiments on person and vehicle ReID benchmarks show strong performance; ablations confirm contributions of each component. Code released.
AI.conclusion: Explicitly modeling inter-class boundary geometry with prototype-guided repulsion is an effective, generalizable way to sharpen identity separation in ReID, and can be plugged into modern ViT backbones.

title: TopX: Text-to-Motion for Unseen Skeletons from the Skeleton File Alone
summary: Text-to-motion models generate for the skeletons they were trained on, while a new character arrives as a skeleton file and nothing else. We study text-to-motion for skeletons that no training clip has used, with no clips of the character, no template, no retargeting and no fine-tuning. We present TopX, a 73M-parameter flow-matching transformer that generates joint rotations and a root trajectory for any kinematic tree from its tree, rest pose and joint names. Motion is normalised by the rest pose and the size of the skeleton, and the rest pose enters as a world-frame descriptor that does not depend on how the rig's author oriented each joint, with rest conventions randomised in training. Attention is factorised over the joints and the frames of a motion and carries a spatial--temporal encoding designed for skeleton graphs of any topology: queries and keys are rotated across joints by a heat-kernel coordinate of the skeleton graph, which is defined for every tree and does not change with the order of its joints or the eigenbasis of its Laplacian, and across frames by a rotary encoding of frame order. To measure what this buys, we build SkelShift: four motion corpora under one codec, 143,334 captioned clips on skeletons of 4 to 142 joints, from which 4,232 clips on 2,043 skeletons are held out by clip, rig, tree class or species and organised along topology, joint count, body plan, species and rig source, and scored by motion quality: Fréchet distances on public kinetic features and on kinematic descriptors, foot skating and ground contact. Against UniMate trained on the same clips, on test rigs without a training clip, TopX lowers the descriptor FID from 5.73 to 4.58 when UniMate's guidance is tuned for the kinetic FID, and the kinetic FID from 1.48 to 0.55 when it is tuned for the descriptor FID, also on motions no training skeleton performs; fewer of its frames sink below the ground.

AI.tldr: TopX：73M 参数流匹配 Transformer，仅凭骨架文件（树结构、rest pose、关节名）即可为任意未见骨架生成文本驱动动作，并配套 SkelShift 跨骨架评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有文生动作模型只能为训练时见过的骨架生成；新角色到来时只有骨架文件，既无动作片段、无模板，也不便重定向或微调，需要真正"零骨架先验"的跨骨架文生动作能力。
AI.method: 1) 用 rest pose 与骨架尺寸归一化动作，rest pose 以与作者关节朝向无关的世界坐标描述子输入，并随机化 rest 约定；2) 在关节维与帧维分解注意力，关节间以骨架图上热核坐标旋转 Q/K（对任意树定义、与关节顺序和拉普拉斯特征基无关），帧间用旋转位置编码；3) 输出关节旋转与根轨迹；4) 构建 SkelShift：统一编解码下 143,334 条带字幕片段，4–142 关节，按片段/骨架/树类/物种划分留出 4,232 条片段、2,043 个骨架。
AI.result: 与同数据训练的 UniMate 相比，在无训练片段的测试骨架上：按动力学 FID 调优引导时，描述子 FID 由 5.73 降至 4.58；按描述子 FID 调优时，动力学 FID 由 1.48 降至 0.55；在训练骨架从未执行过的动作上亦然，且穿地帧更少。
AI.conclusion: 以骨架图谱感知的时空编码与 rest-pose 归一化实现真正的跨拓扑骨架文生动作泛化，无需重定向或微调，并给出可量化该能力的基准 SkelShift。

title: CrossPair: Unlocking Generalist Visual Transformation Learning in Image Editors
summary: Language models switch tasks from demonstrations, but vision still often relies on separate systems for restoration, editing, and stylization. A before--after example offers a shared instruction only if the transferable change can be separated from the scene that demonstrates it. We introduce CrossPair, which adapts a pretrained multimodal image editor to transfer diverse transformations from one exemplar pair. Exemplar-before, exemplar-after, and query images take fixed roles in its native VLM and VAE pathways: the VLM extracts operation semantics, while the VAE retains fine appearance and structure. A training-only, change-aware DINOv3 objective aligns feature-change directions across content-distinct scenes, guiding the output to follow the demonstrated relation without an inference-time encoder. We construct Transform-360K by grouping filtered pairs from conditional representations, restoration, editing, virtual try-on, and stylization under shared transformations. On Relation252K-derived seen and held-out transformations, \method improves target agreement and edit-direction similarity over released systems. Ablations show that the semantic and visual exemplar routes are complementary and that DINO relation alignment further strengthens transfer; Transform-360K training also improves aggregate held-out-operation scores.

AI.tldr: CrossPair 将预训练多模态图像编辑器改造成"单示例对迁移"系统，通过对齐 VLM 语义路径与 VAE 外观路径，从一对 before–after 示例中学到可迁移的图像变换并作用到新场景。
AI.motivation: 语言模型已能从示例切换任务，而视觉的图像修复、编辑、风格化仍依赖彼此独立的系统；单对 before–after 示例只有在"可迁移变换"与"示例场景"可分离时才能充当共享指令，因此需要一个统一的多任务图像变换迁移框架。
AI.method: 在预训练多模态图像编辑器的原生路径上赋予固定角色：示例前图、示例后图、查询图分别入 VLM 与 VAE，VLM 抽取操作语义，VAE 保留细粒度外观与结构；引入仅在训练时使用的、变化感知的 DINOv3 对齐目标，在内容不同的场景间对齐特征变化方向，使生成遵循示例关系且推理时无需额外编码器；并构建 Transform-360K 数据集，将条件表示、修复、编辑、虚拟试穿、风格化等过滤配对按共享变换分组。
AI.result: 在 Relation252K 衍生的已见与留出变换上，CrossPair 相比已发布系统提升了目标一致性与编辑方向相似度；消融表明语义与视觉示例路径互补，DINO 关系对齐进一步增强迁移；使用 Transform-360K 训练还提升了留出操作的总体得分。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦"操作语义"与"场景外观"，并以关系级特征变化对齐作为正则，通用图像编辑器可被低成本改造为单对示例驱动的通用变换迁移器，跨修复、编辑、试穿、风格化等任务统一。

title: Birth-Death Structural Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Code is available at: this https URL
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a standard representation for real-time novel-view synthesis. Yet, its quality-efficiency trade-off still relies heavily on adaptive density control. Existing cloning, splitting, and pruning rules use proxy signals, such as position gradients, opacity, and image-space error. Although effective in practice, these signals do not directly answer the structural question behind density control: where should new Gaussians be allocated to reduce the multi-view reconstruction loss, and which existing primitives can be pruned with minimal penalty. To address this, we propose first-variation birth-death control for 3DGS, a principled approach that replaces heuristic structural decisions with a variational score derived from the reconstruction loss. At each structural update, we freeze the current Gaussian population, attach auxiliary mass coordinates to each primitive, and differentiate the multiview loss with respect to these coordinates. We demonstrate that this score is a coordinate of the first variation of the Splat Regression Model, giving a rigorous local descent surrogate for birth-death moves: high-score Gaussians are selected as birth sites, while low-score, low-opacity Gaussians are selected for removal. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, integrating this score into 3DGS-MCMC yields state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and outperforms existing methods, delivering the most significant gains under tight Gaussian budgets. Ultimately, our work provides compelling evidence that gradient-based variational metrics offer a principled alternative to proxy heuristics in 3DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出3DGS的"一阶变分生灭控制"：用多视角重建损失对辅助质量坐标的导数作为结构更新的变分分数，指导高斯新增与剪枝。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS自适应密度控制依赖位置梯度、不透明度、图像空间误差等代理信号，无法直接回答"应在何处新增高斯以降低多视角重建损失、哪些基元可低代价剪枝"这一结构性核心问题。
AI.method: 在每次结构更新时冻结当前高斯集合，为每个基元附加辅助质量坐标，对多视角损失关于该坐标求导得到变分分数；证明该分数是Splat Regression Model一阶变分的坐标，构成生灭移动的严格局部下降代理。高分高斯作为新增位置，低分且低不透明度高斯被移除；将该分数集成进3DGS-MCMC框架。
AI.result: 在标准3DGS基准上集成该分数后达到SOTA重建质量并优于现有方法，在高斯预算紧张时增益最显著。
AI.conclusion: 基于梯度的变分度量可为3DGS的密度控制提供替代启发式代理信号的有原则方案。

title: Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoders via Localized Hebbian Learning
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the UBMK conference (not presented)
summary: Traditional autoencoders rely on static network architectures to learn latent representations. Recently we suggested a dynamic architecture inspired by Hebbian plasticity, enabling topological self-organization among convolutional feature maps (R. Koç et al., Proceedings of the SIU, 2026). Early implementations of this paradigm infer relationships among feature maps using global average pooling and model their interactions through scalar-valued connections. This approach falls short to fully exploit the underlying spatial information, embedded in input images. Furthermore, abrupt transitions between different loss functions and training dynamics can introduce representation shocks, leading to unstable feature learning. In this paper, we introduce a Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoder (S-LooM) to address these structural bottlenecks. By using spatial cross-correlation, and spatial kernels, S-LooM establishes dynamic connections among feature maps. We replace static scalar message passing of autoencoders with learnable spatial kernels and eliminate high-frequency deconvolutional artifacts observed in decoders using nearest-neighbor upsampling. Via a soft-blending training curriculum, the latent topology aligns smoothly during training. Our experiments show that S-LooM yields a more stable topology, compared to the state of the art dynamic architectures. Meaning, the graph structure that emerge has more resistance to feature entanglement and noise. It forms functional communities responsible for visual attributes, such as illumination, shape and texture even under high connection densities.

AI.tldr: 提出S-LooM——空间感知自组织图自编码器，用空间互相关与可学习空间核替代标量连接，并以最近邻上采样与软混合训练课程稳定潜空间拓扑。
AI.motivation: 已有Hebbian式动态架构（LooM）用全局平均池化推断特征图关系、以标量连接建模交互，丢失空间信息；且损失函数切换与训练动力学突变会引发表征冲击，导致特征学习不稳定。
AI.method: 以空间互相关与空间卷积核建立特征图间动态连接，将自编码器的静态标量消息传递替换为可学习空间核；解码器用最近邻上采样消除反卷积高频伪影；采用软混合（soft-blending）训练课程使潜空间拓扑平滑对齐。
AI.result: 相比SOTA动态架构，S-LooM得到更稳定的拓扑，图结构对特征纠缠与噪声更具鲁棒性；即使在高连接密度下仍形成对应光照、形状、纹理等视觉属性的功能社区。
AI.conclusion: 空间化消息传递与平滑训练课程可有效缓解动态自组织自编码器的结构瓶颈，获得语义可解释的功能模块化拓扑。

title: A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis
summary: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免插值的虚拟网格（NVHT）算子，在保持方形网格的同时用滤波核模拟六边形像素表示，以降低卷积与梯度分析的计算与存储开销，并用于医学图像（乳腺癌）分类的特征提取。
AI.motivation: 传统医学图像特征分析在斜对角方向模式捕获、计算效率与特征缓存存储方面存在不足；经典算子（卷积、梯度分析）对硬件要求高，难以高效支撑复杂机器学习模型的训练与推理。
AI.method: 设计非插值虚拟六边形网格算子：不将图像实际变换为六边形网格，而是在同一方形图像上以滤波器核实现六边形像素等效采样，从而获得多方向高灵敏度特征，同时减少插值与变换带来的额外计算和存储。
AI.result: 摘要仅定性声称该方法降低了计算与存储成本、提升了特征提取效率与分类精度，并在性能上优于传统方法，未给出数据集、定量指标或对比基线数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种轻量化的图像特征算子思路，对六边形采样优势的应用有一定参考价值，但缺乏可验证的定量证据，属于特定应用域（医学图像分类）的工程性改进。

title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
comment: Project page: this https URL , GitHub: this https URL
summary: Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.

AI.tldr: RynnVLA-Latent 用 RynnLAM 从异构人类/机器人/仿真视频中学习连续的 3D 接地潜在动作（残差未来特征预测 + 相机补偿 3D 光流监督 + 相机运动解耦），在 30.1K 小时视频上产出 745.52M 潜在动作描述符，再用 flow matching 预训练 4B VLA 策略并适配到具体本体动作。
AI.motivation: VLA 扩展受限于稀缺的动作标注演示与不同机器人本体间不可兼容的控制空间；希望把大量无动作标签的异构交互视频转化为可扩展的策略预训练监督信号。
AI.method: RynnLAM 从视觉状态转移中学习连续、3D 接地的潜在动作表示，无需原生机器人控制信号；通过残差未来特征预测、相机补偿的 3D 光流监督与相机运动解耦，使表征聚焦控制相关运动而非外观变化。随后 RynnVLA-Latent 以 flow matching 从视觉观测和语言预测潜在动作 chunk，再将预训练主干与 action expert 适配到各本体原生动作空间。
AI.result: 4B 策略在 LIBERO 达 98.8%，LIBERO-Plus 无基准特定适配下达 84.7%，VLABench 五个赛道平均 51.9%，RoboTwin 2.0 双臂基准平均 88.6%；在灵巧手与移动夹爪平台的六个真实操作任务上取得对比方法中最高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 表征消融与数据规模实验表明，潜在动作监督可突破原生动作标注数据的限制，为机器人策略学习扩展提供可行路径。

title: EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins
summary: Task success is not a sufficient measure of safety for embodied artificial intelligence (AI), because robots may complete objectives while violating safety requirements. Existing evaluations often emphasize performance and robustness, but lack a systematic route from documented safety hazards to executable, verifiable tests. We present EAST (Embodied AI Safety Testing), a digital-twin framework that converts literature-grounded safety evidence into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing. EAST combines an expert-reviewed safety-fault taxonomy and eight executable operators with applicability and validity constraints. Its three-stage workflow generates test specifications, verifies fault realization during simulated execution, and independently assesses safety challenges, violations, task outcomes, and behavioral signatures using simulator-state evidence. The framework preserves execution traces and replayable records, supporting attribution and reproducibility across experiments. We evaluate EAST on six RoboTwin manipulation tasks and two policy architectures, ACT and RDT, against alternative testing strategies under matched budgets. Across five comparative campaigns, EAST targets all 74 admissible task-policy-operator combinations and obtains valid evidence for 63, while achieving safety-challenge exposure rates close to Random-Legal and Rule-Based. Moreover, 82 valid EAST executions complete their tasks despite safety violations, revealing risks concealed by success-oriented evaluation. These findings support systematic, validity-aware, reproducible safety testing beyond task-completion metrics.

AI.tldr: EAST是一个数字孪生框架，将文献安全证据转化为覆盖感知、指令、环境、动作、时序五维度的故障注入测试，并验证故障真实发生、独立判定安全违规与行为特征。
AI.motivation: 任务成功率不足以衡量具身AI安全性：机器人可能完成目标的同时违反安全约束。现有评测偏重性能与鲁棒性，缺乏从"已记录安全危害"到"可执行可验证测试"的系统化路径。
AI.method: 构建专家审阅的安全故障分类体系与8个可执行算子（带适用性与有效性约束）；三阶段流程：生成测试规格→仿真执行中验证故障已实现→基于仿真器状态证据独立评估安全挑战、违规、任务结果与行为特征；保留可重放执行轨迹以支持归因与可复现。
AI.result: 在6个RoboTwin操作任务与ACT、RDT两种策略上，5组对比实验中EAST覆盖全部74个可行任务-策略-算子组合并取得63条有效证据，安全挑战暴露率接近Random-Legal与Rule-Based；82条有效EAST执行虽完成任务但存在安全违规，揭示成功率导向评测掩盖的风险。
AI.conclusion: 提出了有效性感知、可复现的系统化安全测试范式，超越任务完成度指标，为具身AI安全评测提供可执行、可归因的路线。

title: ThinkLocoManip: A Whole-Body Control Agentic Harness for Legged Loco-Manipulation
summary: In this paper, we propose ThinkLocoManip, an agentic harness for legged loco-manipulation designed to tackle complex, long-horizon tasks in large-scale environments. Existing approaches typically follow either direct action generation or a plan-then-act paradigm, both of which can struggle with the generalization and error-recovery capabilities required for extended task execution. In contrast, ThinkLocoManip adopts an interleaved reasoning-and-acting paradigm, allowing the agent to continuously reason about its current state, execute actions, observe their outcomes, and adapt its strategy accordingly. Building on this paradigm, our agentic harness orchestrates a suite of specialized tools for perception, navigation, manipulation, and locomotion, enabling flexible composition of heterogeneous capabilities. Unlike existing robotic agentic harnesses, ThinkLocoManip explicitly incorporates locomotion as a tool domain for agent reasoning and execution. We further design a set of skills that explicitly account for both tool usage within each functional domain and coordination across domains, supporting effective execution of complex behaviors over long horizons. To tackle task failure during long-horizon interactions, we develop keyframe thinking mechanism to preserve critical execution context and support efficient error recovery. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that ThinkLocoManip substantially outperforms representative methods based on both direct action generation and plan-then-act paradigms across challenging long-horizon legged loco-manipulation tasks. Notably, ThinkLocoManip achieves a success rate of 77%, more than twice that of the strongest plan-then-act baseline (37.1%). Our experiments further validate the effectiveness of interleaved reasoning and acting, tool orchestration, and coordinated skill execution.

AI.tldr: ThinkLocoManip：面向足式移动操作长程任务的智能体框架，采用"交错推理-执行"范式，将感知、导航、操作、运动统一为工具域，配合跨域协调技能与关键帧思维机制实现错误恢复，真机成功率77%（plan-then-act最强基线37.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有足式移动操作方法多采用直接动作生成或"先规划后执行"两段式范式，在大规模环境中的长程任务上泛化性与错误恢复能力不足，且已有机器人智能体框架普遍未将运动（locomotion）纳入智能体可推理与调度的工具域。
AI.method: 提出交错推理与执行（interleaved reasoning-and-acting）范式：智能体持续推理当前状态、执行动作、观察结果并调整策略。构建智能体harness编排感知、导航、操作、运动等多类专用工具，实现异构能力灵活组合；设计显式考虑单域工具使用与跨域协调的技能集合；引入关键帧思维（keyframe thinking）机制保留关键执行上下文以支撑高效错误恢复。
AI.result: 多类挑战性长程足式移动操作任务真机实验中显著优于直接动作生成与plan-then-act代表方法，成功率77%，超过最强plan-then-act基线（37.1%）两倍以上；消融验证了交错推理-执行、工具编排与协调技能执行的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将locomotion显式纳入工具域的智能体化交错推理-执行框架，可有效解决长程足式移动操作中的组合泛化与故障恢复问题，为具身智能体系统设计提供了可复用的范式。

title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
summary: Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

AI.tldr: AndroidFlux：基于AndroidWorld构建的移动GUI智能体失败恢复基准，将已记录轨迹回放到首个可恢复错误前/中/后的受控检查点，并配套恢复动作偏好奖励建模基准与离线RL数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有移动端多模态智能体仅以干净初始状态下的任务成功率评估，无法隔离"从中间错误中恢复"的能力；移动环境动态变化，智能体需在意外状态与未见环境下稳健完成任务，因此需要可控地定位错误并衡量恢复能力。
AI.method: 1) 在AndroidWorld上构建失败恢复基准AndroidFlux，利用轨迹回放将设备恢复到首个可恢复错误之前、之时、之后三个受控检查点，使不同智能体从相同设备状态与历史继续；2) 在这些检查点上构建互补的奖励建模基准，用下游rollout结果评估恢复动作偏好；3) 发布离线RL数据集以提升错误恢复与整体任务成功率。
AI.result: 恢复性能与干净初始状态成功率仅部分相关；显式推理仅对经GUI领域特定RL训练的模型有增益。
AI.conclusion: 移动智能体的鲁棒性评估需与干净起点评估解耦；AndroidFlux提供了可复现的错误恢复与奖励建模评测框架，并表明恢复能力不能由任务成功率代理，离线RL数据可提升恢复表现。

title: On Distributed Sensing and Adversarial Localization of Narrowband Acoustic Sources for Offshore Data Center Monitoring
summary: This report investigates an acoustic surveillance framework for localizing and tracking narrowband adversarial acoustic sources that threaten offshore data centers. Unlike conventional sound source localization (SSL) methods that rely on broadband signals and compact receiver arrays, the considered scenario involves narrowband emissions and sparse sensors. In such scenarios, the observed time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) measurements are aliased and produce an ambiguous solution space, rendering conventional localization methods ineffective. To address this challenge, we integrate a mobile receiver that temporarily forms anchor pairs with selected fixed receivers, constraining the feasible solution space. The proposed two-stage pipeline first estimates the initial source position using anchor constraints, then initializes a particle filter that jointly tracks source position and velocity using one live anchor measurement and quality-adaptive fixed-pair measurements. We evaluate the proposed method through Monte Carlo acoustic simulations, ROS-Gazebo robotic demonstrations, and open-water field experiments. Our framework achieves a localization success rate of 91% in simulation, while 9 of 10 field trials show tracking error below 2m under receiver-position uncertainty and noisy sensing conditions. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of passive acoustic surveillance for protecting large-scale infrastructure against acoustic threats.

AI.tldr: 提出面向海上数据中心防护的窄带对抗声源被动声学监测框架：用移动接收器与固定接收器临时构成锚点对以消解TDOA混叠模糊，两阶段流程先锚点约束定位、再以粒子滤波联合跟踪位置与速度，仿真成功率91%，10次海上试验中9次误差<2m。
AI.motivation: 传统声源定位（SSL）依赖宽带信号与紧凑阵列；实际威胁场景为窄带发射且传感器稀疏，导致TDOA测量混叠、解空间多峰模糊，常规定位方法失效，需在稀疏+窄带条件下仍能定位与跟踪的被动方案。
AI.method: 引入移动接收器与选定固定接收器临时组成锚点对，压缩可行解空间。两阶段流水线：第一阶段利用锚点约束估计初始源位置；第二阶段以该初值初始化粒子滤波器，融合一个实时锚点测量与质量自适应的固定对测量，联合跟踪声源位置与速度。
AI.result: Monte Carlo声学仿真定位成功率91%；ROS-Gazebo机器人演示验证系统集成；开阔水域现场试验10次中9次跟踪误差低于2m，且在接收器位置不确定与测量噪声条件下仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 验证了利用移动接收器解TDOA混叠的可行性，表明被动声学监测可作为一种保护大型基础设施免受声学威胁的实用手段；方法在仿真、机器人平台与真实水域三个层级得到交叉支撑。

title: No Cones, No Duals: A Fast and Scalable Solver for NRSfM
comment: 21 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables, Accepted for publication at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027
summary: Non-rigid structure from motion (NRSfM) aims to recover camera motion and time-varying 3D shape from tracked 2D image measurements. Recent high-performing methods show that shape-space factorization remains highly effective for this task. These methods often use costly solvers for two key steps. First, a semidefinite programming (SDP) cone solver to perform Euclidean correction. Next, an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver to recover the low-rank shape. These steps often scale poorly to long sequences and dense point tracks. We propose a fast, scalable NRSfM solver that avoids these costly steps. For rotation estimation, we introduce a differentiable Euclidean correction that directly optimizes small factors for each sequence. A row-polar projection then maps each estimated camera block to the closest row-orthonormal matrix. For shape estimation, we introduce an unrolled spectral-proximal solver. It combines reprojection-gradient steps with weighted singular-value shrinkage in the reshuffled shape domain. This solver further uses FISTA-style restart and continuation. The spectral shrinkage operator itself is classical, but we embed it in a fixed differentiable solver, while preserving NRSfM's geometric constraints. The proposed approach is category-agnostic, requires no external training data, and maps naturally to modern accelerator-friendly linear algebra primitives. Across sparse, dense, noisy, missing-data, and long-sequence benchmarks, our solver achieves substantial speedups with competitive reconstruction accuracy, including 7x-1000x runtime improvements on dense sequences with 28,887 tracked points.

AI.tldr: 提出一种快速可扩展的非刚性结构从运动（NRSfM）求解器：用可微欧氏矫正+行极投影替代SDP锥规划求解旋转，用展开的谱近端求解器（重投影梯度+加权奇异值收缩、FISTA重启与continuation）替代ADMM求低秩形状，在稀疏/稠密/含噪/缺失/长序列基准上取得7x-1000x加速且精度有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有高精度的形状空间分解类NRSfM方法依赖两步昂贵求解器：SDP锥规划做欧氏矫正、ADMM恢复低秩形状，二者对长序列和稠密点轨迹的扩展性差、运行时间过长。
AI.method: (1) 旋转估计：提出可微欧氏矫正，直接对每条序列优化小的因子（因子分解式欧氏矫正），再用行极投影把每个相机块映射到最近的行正交归一矩阵；(2) 形状估计：引入展开的谱近端求解器，在重排（reshuffled）形状域中将重投影梯度步与加权奇异值收缩结合，并采用FISTA式重启与continuation策略；(3) 将经典谱收缩算子嵌入固定的可微求解器中，同时保持NRSfM的几何约束；方法类别无关、无需外部训练数据，可映射到加速器友好的线性代数原语。
AI.result: 在稀疏、稠密、含噪、缺失数据及长序列基准上，实现显著加速同时保持有竞争力的重建精度；在含28,887个跟踪点的稠密序列上获得7x–1000x的运行时提升。
AI.conclusion: 避开SDP与ADMM两步昂贵求解、改用可微矫正与展开谱近端求解，可在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅提升NRSfM的可扩展性；该框架无需训练数据、类别无关，且对现代加速器友好。

title: On Detection Reliability for Small Object Segmentation
summary: This study investigates whether predicted bounding boxes are reliable for determining where small-object segmentation should be performed without risking false negatives outside those boxes. The investigation leverages adenovirus particles as small objects, YOLO26x for detection, YO-LO26x-Sem for segmentation, and Mask R-CNN for both detection and segmentation. Segmenta-tion-model predictions were matched to ground-truth adenovirus masks or reference objects using their centroids, with ground-truth mask centroids preferred over ground-truth bounding-box centroids as references for matching. Matched predicted-mask centroids were considered as inside at least one detector-predicted bounding box or outside all such boxes, while ground-truth masks without matched predictions were recorded as having no matched segmentation. For the YOLO26 models, 34 reference objects (47.89%) had matched segmentation centroids inside at least one pre-dicted box, 8 (11.27%) had centroids outside all predicted boxes, and 29 (40.85%) had no matched predicted segmentation. For the Mask R-CNN model, the corresponding counts were 69 (97.18%), 0 (0.00%), and 2 (2.82%). These preliminary experiments demonstrated that restricting segmentation to detector-predicted bounding boxes risks excluding matched segmentation predictions outside those boxes, potentially introducing false negatives.

AI.tldr: 以腺病毒颗粒为小目标，比较YOLO26x检测+分割与Mask R-CNN，检验"先把分割限制在检测框内"是否会漏掉框外的分割预测（假阴性）。
AI.motivation: 已有的级联"检测框→框内分割"范式在小目标上可能产生假阴性，但缺少直接证据。作者想知道检测器预测框能否可靠地界定分割应执行的位置。
AI.method: 使用腺病毒颗粒作为小目标数据集；检测器为YOLO26x（配合YOLO26x-Sem分割模型），对照为Mask R-CNN（检测+分割一体）。分割预测与真值掩码或参考目标按质心匹配（优先使用真值掩码质心而非真值框质心）。记录每个匹配预测掩码质心落在至少一个检测框内、落在所有检测框外，以及无匹配分割的真值掩码数量。
AI.result: YOLO26系列：34个参考目标（47.89%）的分割质心落在某预测框内，8个（11.27%）落在所有预测框外，29个（40.85%）无匹配分割预测。Mask R-CNN：分别为69（97.18%）、0（0.00%）、2（2.82%）。
AI.conclusion: 初步实验表明，把分割限制在检测器预测框内会排除框外的有效分割预测，可能引入假阴性；检测框并非可靠的分割范围先验。

title: AuRA: From Atoms to Bits through Autonomous Robot Interaction
summary: Simulation enables robot-learning experiments at scale, but acquiring physics-informed digital twins often requires human manipulation and manual annotation of recorded interactions. To reduce this reliance on human effort, we present AuRA, a system that automates robot interaction and data preparation for digital-twin reconstruction. AuRA combines execution-aware grasp selection, gripper-motion measurements derived from robot states, and registered pre-interaction geometry and appearance priors. These choices enable autonomous collection, avoid reliance on visual gripper tracking, and recover object information obscured by the robot. Across 13 deformable objects, AuRA reduces active human labor and wall-clock collection time per successfully reconstructed asset by 88.5% and 55.4%, respectively. Relative to the human-collected PhysTwin baseline, AuRA improves seven of nine metrics for future prediction under known gripper motion, including a 28.1% reduction in one-way $L_1$ Chamfer distance. It also achieves similar mean silhouette IoU and Chamfer distance under the evaluated unseen interactions. These results highlight the potential of autonomous robot interaction to support more efficient digital-twin acquisition with comparable reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: AuRA自动化机器人交互与数据采集，实现无需人工的物理数字孪生重建，13种可变形物体上人力降88.5%、耗时降55.4%。
AI.motivation: 仿真规模化依赖物理一致的数字孪生，但现有获取流程需人工操作机器人并手动标注交互数据，成本高、效率低。
AI.method: 提出AuRA系统：结合执行可行的抓取选择、由机器人状态推导的夹爪运动测量，以及配准的交互前几何与外观先验，实现自主采集与数据准备；不依赖视觉夹爪跟踪，并可恢复被机器人遮挡的物体信息。
AI.result: 13种可变形物体上，每个成功重建资产的人力降低88.5%、实际耗时降低55.4%；已知夹爪运动下的未来预测在9项指标中7项优于PhysTwin基线，单向L1 Chamfer距离降低28.1%；未见交互下轮廓IoU与Chamfer距离相当。
AI.conclusion: 自主机器人交互可显著提升数字孪生采集效率，并保持可比的重建质量，减少对人工标注的依赖。

title: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation via Action Representation Pretraining
comment: 23 pages. Project page: this https URL
summary: Large-scale vision, language, and video pretraining has substantially improved the perception and generalization capabilities of robotic manipulation models, but action generation for complex dexterous manipulation remains constrained by the scarcity of robot demonstrations. Limited robot demonstrations must be used to learn both action representations and task-conditioned action distributions, making it difficult to adequately learn action representations and, in turn, limiting the ability of downstream generative models to generate complex dexterous actions. To address this limitation, we propose ARPG (Action Representation Pretraining and Generation), which explicitly separates action representation learning from action generation: we first pretrain an action representation encoder on large-scale human manipulation data. We then freeze the encoder and train a compact generative backbone (130M parameters) to learn task-conditioned action distributions in the encoder's representation space. Experimental results show that ARPG achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DexJoCo benchmark and improves the average success rate on bimanual dexterous manipulation from 10.1% for $\pi_{0.5}$ to 44.7%. Scaling experiments further show that broader coverage of human manipulation behaviors effectively improves downstream performance. These results indicate that action representation pretraining provides an independent scaling dimension for improving complex dexterous manipulation capabilities.

AI.tldr: ARPG 将动作表示学习与动作生成解耦：先在大规模人类操作数据上预训练动作表示编码器，冻结后在其隐空间中训练轻量生成骨干（130M）学习任务条件动作分布，在 DexJoCo 达到 SOTA，双臂灵巧操作成功率从 10.1%(π0.5) 提升至 44.7%。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示数据稀缺，却需同时承担"学动作表示"和"学任务条件动作分布"两项任务，导致复杂灵巧操作的表示学习不充分，进而限制下游生成模型生成复杂动作的能力。视觉/语言/视频预训练已大幅提升感知与泛化，但动作生成侧仍被数据瓶颈卡住。
AI.method: 显式分离两阶段范式：(1) 在大规模人类操作数据上预训练动作表示编码器；(2) 冻结编码器，在冻结表示空间中用紧凑生成骨干（130M 参数）学习任务条件动作分布，从而让机器演示只用于学分布而非学表示。并开展人类行为覆盖广度对下游性能影响的缩放实验。
AI.result: 在 DexJoCo benchmark 上取得 SOTA；双臂灵巧操作平均成功率由 π0.5 的 10.1% 提升到 44.7%（约 4.4 倍）。缩放实验显示更广的人类操作行为覆盖能有效提升下游性能，表明动作表示预训练是提升复杂灵巧操作能力的独立缩放维度。
AI.conclusion: 动作表示预训练可作为与模型规模、数据量并列的独立缩放维度，用以缓解机器人演示稀缺对灵巧操作生成的限制；解耦式"表示预训练+冻结空间生成"是可行且高效的路线。

title: Nonlinear Control of Aerial Manipulator
summary: This paper presents two controllers for a quadrotor equipped with a two-DOF robot manipulator that physically interacts with the environment. Cartesian impedance and adaptive sliding mode controllers are implemented and compared for a simple hovering task in the presence of some bounded disturbance. A full dynamic model is developed, and the two above controllers are implemented with the same initial conditions and desired position.

AI.tldr: 针对搭载二自由度机械臂的四旋翼飞行机械臂，建立完整动力学模型，并对比笛卡尔阻抗控制与自适应滑模控制在有界扰动悬停任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂在物理接触环境时，系统动力学耦合强且存在未知有界扰动，单一控制策略难以兼顾柔顺性与鲁棒跟踪精度，因此需要对比不同控制范式在相同初始与期望条件下的性能差异。
AI.method: 建立含机械臂-四旋翼耦合的完整动力学模型；分别设计笛卡尔阻抗控制器与自适应滑模控制器；在相同初始条件与期望位置下执行简单悬停任务，施加有界扰动并对比两者响应。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标，仅描述为对两种控制器在有界扰动悬停任务中的对比实验结果，缺少误差、收敛时间等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 阻抗控制在接触/交互场景下提供柔顺性，自适应滑模在抗扰鲁棒性上占优，二者构成空中物理交互任务的互补设计选项；但验证任务简单、缺少实物对比与环境接触实验。

title: Trajectory Generation and Control for Quadrotors
summary: In this project, I explored controller design and trajectory generation for a quadrotor. Differential flatness was used for trajectory generation based on one of the references. A minimum snap trajectory is generated from the given algorithm based on waypoint navigation, and a simple proportional plus derivative (PD) controller is used to track the trajectories. Simulation results are presented which generate smooth trajectories for position and velocity of the quadrotor.

AI.tldr: 基于微分平坦性的四旋翼最小snap轨迹生成，配合简单PD控制器跟踪，仿真验证位置/速度轨迹平滑。
AI.motivation: 探索四旋翼的控制器设计与轨迹生成，验证基于航点导航的平滑轨迹方案。
AI.method: 利用微分平坦性从参考算法生成最小snap轨迹（航点导航），采用PD控制器进行轨迹跟踪，仅做仿真实验。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示四旋翼位置与速度轨迹平滑，PD控制器可完成跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 课程项目级别的原理验证：微分平坦+最小snap轨迹与PD跟踪在仿真中可行，缺少实机验证与先进控制（如几何/MPC）对比。

title: Task Relevance-Driven Prompt Expansion for Federated Continual Learning
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Federated continual learning (FCL) has attracted considerable interest by enabling local clients to continually acquire knowledge from new tasks. However, most FCL methods assume that the global server has prior knowledge of the arrival times and number of categories for new tasks, which is unrealistic in the real world. Furthermore, they neglect the importance of positive inter-task semantic relationships when learning new tasks and are significantly affected by irrelevant relationships from old tasks, thereby exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To resolve the above challenges, we develop a novel Task Relevance-driven Prompt Expansion (TRPE) model. Specifically, to eliminate the reliance on prior knowledge of new tasks, we propose an out-of-distribution detector to identify the arrival of new tasks within local clients, along with a radius-adaptive DBSCAN to infer the quantity of categories in new tasks on the proxy server. Moreover, to explore positive inter-task relationships, we calculate the affinity between the original gradient for learning new task and its gradient orthogonal to the feature space of old tasks to evaluate semantic relevance between old and new tasks from a global perspective. Then, we use this global task relevance to determine the key-prompt pair for new tasks and identify highly related old tasks. After concatenating their prompts for training, we can leverage such positive inter-task relations to improve the continual learning of newly arriving tasks. To balance the learning of new tasks and the forgetting of old ones, a soft orthogonality constraint is applied to the local key and prompt gradients. Experiments spanning diverse datasets and backbones confirm the efficacy of our TRPE model.
