AI.tldr: 提出任务相关性驱动的提示扩展模型TRPE，实现无需新任务先验知识的联邦持续学习，并利用任务间正向语义关系缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦持续学习方法假定服务器已知新任务的到达时间与类别数，不符合现实；同时忽视任务间正向语义关联、易受旧任务无关关系干扰，加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 1) 本地客户端用OOD检测器识别新任务到达，代理服务器用半径自适应DBSCAN推断新任务类别数；2) 计算新任务原始梯度与旧任务特征空间正交分量的亲和度，从全局视角评估新旧任务语义相关性；3) 据此确定新任务的关键提示对并检索高相关旧任务，拼接其提示进行训练；4) 对本地key与prompt梯度施加软正交约束，平衡新任务学习与旧任务遗忘。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与骨干网络上进行实验，验证了TRPE的有效性；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务无关的到达检测与类别数推断摆脱先验假设，并以梯度正交亲和度量化全局任务相关性指导提示扩展与复用，配合软正交约束，可有效提升联邦持续学习的抗遗忘能力。

title: IntNet: A Communication-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cooperative Autonomous Driving
summary: Achieving safety in autonomous driving through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a critical yet challenging task due to non-stationarity, partial observability, and the need for effective coordination among agents. Although earlier cooperative MARL methods have aimed to improve coordination by sharing encoded state observations, we find these strategies are insufficient in safety-critical scenarios. To address this gap, we present IntNet, a novel MARL framework that enhances safety by incorporating the transmission of vehicle intent and adaptive communication scheduling into a unified end-to-end learning paradigm, jointly optimising all components for safe coordination. Central to our approach is an observation prediction module that enables agents to forecast subsequent policy outputs, which they can then share across a vehicle-to-vehicle network. Our model-free architecture employs a Graph Attention Network to process incoming messages and a scheduler component to dynamically optimise the communication graph for bandwidth efficiency. We compare IntNet against state-of-the-art communicative MARL methods in complex urban environments with both autonomous and human-operated vehicles, achieving improved coordination, lower collision rates, and reducing communication efforts by up to 60\%. Through extensive experiments, we assess the framework's learning efficiency, scalability, and the balance between information sharing and bandwidth usage for collision-free trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出IntNet——一种端到端多智能体强化学习框架，通过观测预测模块生成并共享车辆意图、用图注意力网络处理消息、并用调度器动态优化通信图，在城市混合车流场景中降低碰撞率并将通信开销减少最多60%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习用于自动驾驶面临非平稳性、部分可观测性与协调难点；早期协作MARL仅共享编码后的状态观测，在安全关键场景中信息不足，需显式传递"意图"以提高协调安全性。
AI.method: IntNet将车辆意图传输与自适应通信调度统一到一个端到端可微框架中联合优化。核心是观测预测模块，让智能体预测其后续策略输出并通过V2V网络共享；采用无模型架构，以图注意力网络聚合接收到的消息，并用调度器动态优化通信图以保证带宽效率。
AI.result: 在包含自动驾驶与人工驾驶车辆的复杂城市环境中，相较SOTA通信式MARL方法取得更好的协调性、更低的碰撞率，并将通信开销最多降低60%；实验还评估了学习效率、可扩展性以及信息共享与带宽占用间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 显式意图预测与共享配合自适应通信调度可有效提升多车协同安全性，同时显著节省带宽，为安全关键MARL提供了可端到端训练的范式。

title: PhysCreator: Creating Physically-Attributed 3D Assets at Will
summary: Significant advancements in 3D asset creation have enabled high-fidelity 3D generation from images. However, most existing representations remain inherently static, lacking the ability to model physically plausible behaviors under dynamic interactions. We present \textbf{PhysCreator}, a unified framework that directly generates simulation-ready 3D representations with spatially varying physical properties from images. Unlike prior approaches that treat physical attributes as simple post-hoc predictions or rely on expensive per-instance optimization, we reformulate physical property estimation within a unified 3D representation learning framework. We introduce a voxel-aligned latent space by lifting image observations into a spatially structured 3D representation, in which geometry, appearance, and physical properties are jointly modeled and inferred in a feed-forward manner. To enable scalable learning without densely annotated physical ground truth, we leverage vision-language distillation to transfer material-aware semantic priors from powerful vision-language models into spatially grounded voxel-level supervision. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior visual quality, physical plausibility, and generalization compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: PhysCreator：从单图前馈生成"可直接仿真"的3D资产，在体素对齐潜空间中联合建模几何、外观与空间变化物理属性，并用视觉-语言蒸馏提供体素级物理监督。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成结果本质上是静态表示，无法在动态交互下表现物理合理行为；已有物理属性预测方法要么是事后（post-hoc）简单回归，要么依赖昂贵的逐实例优化，且缺少稠密物理标注数据。
AI.method: 将图像观测"提升"到空间结构化的体素对齐潜空间，在其中以feed-forward方式联合推断几何、外观与物理场（如密度、弹性、摩擦等空间变化属性），实现仿真就绪表示的统一生成；为绕过稠密物理真值缺失，采用vision-language distillation 将VLM的材料语义先验蒸馏为空间接地的体素级物理监督。
AI.result: 在视觉质量、物理合理性与泛化性上优于先前的静态表示与事后物理预测/逐实例优化方案（摘要级结论，未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 提出统一的前馈式"物理就绪3D生成"框架，把物理属性估计纳入3D表示学习本身，并用语言模型蒸馏替代稠密标注，为生成式资产走向可仿真、可交互提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly used for robot manipulation because they map camera images and a language instruction directly to actions. Robots that cannot be tethered to a workstation, such as mobile manipulators and humanoids, must run them on onboard embedded boards, where the prefill latency of the language backbone grows with the hundreds of visual tokens processed at every control step. To meet real-time limits, training-free accelerators recompute only a subset of the visual tokens and skip the rest, either by pruning them or by reusing their cached key-value (KV) states. The two options save nearly the same computation, yet existing methods apply only one of them to every skipped token. Through a token-level diagnostic, we show that which option keeps the action closer to full recomputation depends on the token's drift, the change in its shallow-layer value since its cache was computed. On both backbones tested, reusing tokens below a drift threshold was no worse than pruning them, whereas beyond it, reuse yields up to 4.4x the action error of pruning; the same diagnostic calibrates this threshold per backbone. Building on this finding, we propose TRIAGE, which deems a cache valid when its drift is below this threshold and it is not too old. TRIAGE recomputes a fixed budget of tokens, prioritizing important tokens with invalid caches, reuses every other token with a valid cache, and prunes the rest; prune-only and reuse-only methods are the two extremes of this partition. Because the budget fixes the number of recomputed tokens, it directly sets the prefill latency. On LIBERO and SimplerEnv, TRIAGE stays within 3 pp of full recomputation in average success rate while cutting prefill latency on a Jetson AGX Orin by up to 48%, and with only 7% of visual tokens recomputed, it beats the strongest baseline by 24.4 pp on LIBERO-Object.

AI.tldr: TRIAGE：面向 VLA 模型板端实时推理的免训练视觉 token 加速器，依据 token "漂移度"（浅层特征相对缓存时的变化）判定 KV 缓存有效性，在固定重算预算下按需重算/复用/剪枝。
AI.motivation: 移动操作与类人机器人需在嵌入式板上运行 VLA，每步仅视觉 token 就达数百个，语言骨干的 prefill 延迟无法满足实时约束。现有免训练加速器对每个被跳过 token 一律只做"剪枝"或只做"KV 复用"之一，二者计算节省相近，但未区分适用条件。
AI.method: token 级诊断：发现"复用 vs 剪枝"哪个更接近全量重算取决于该 token 的 drift（自缓存计算以来其浅层值的变化量）；低于阈值时复用不劣于剪枝，超过阈值时复用误差可达剪枝的 4.4 倍，且阈值可逐骨干标定。据此提出 TRIAGE：drift 低于阈值且缓存不过旧则判为缓存有效；重算固定预算的 token（优先重要且缓存失效者），有效缓存者复用，其余剪枝——剪枝法与复用法成为该划分的两个极端；固定预算直接决定 prefill 延迟。
AI.result: LIBERO 与 SimplerEnv 上平均成功率距全量重算 3 pp 以内；Jetson AGX Orin 上 prefill 延迟最多降低 48%；仅重算 7% 视觉 token 时，LIBERO-Object 上领先最强基线 24.4 pp。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度 token 级缓存有效性判定优于单一策略的统一处理，可在固定延迟预算下显著压缩 VLA 板端推理开销，且无需额外训练。

title: Conviction Without Evidence: Verdict Stability Is Independent of Visual Grounding in Medical Vision--Language Models
comment: Accepted at the Med-Reasoner workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Vision--language models applied to medical question answering can reach correct diagnoses without using the diagnostic image, inferring instead from the clinical vignette. We ask whether this is visible in how \emph{firmly} a model holds its answer: does a model defend a diagnosis derived from a blank placeholder as tenaciously as one derived from a real medical image? Crossing an image-substitution protocol with two levels of adversarial pressure on 60 Italian State Examination items, we find no evidence that ungrounded verdicts are more fragile. In a paired item-level analysis, fabricated consensus (L4) overturns 94.4\% of verdicts with the real image and 98.1\% without ($\Delta = +0.037$; one-sided 95\% upper bound $+0.105$); contentless doubt (L1) overturns 62.5\% and 51.8\% ($\Delta = -0.107$, 95\% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$), the point estimate running opposite to the direction a grounding detector requires. The two levels nonetheless produce opposite \emph{dynamics}: under L4 the model flips once, always to the exact option argued for (110/110 first-turn flips), and then freezes, averaging 1.9 verdict changes over ten turns; under L1 it never settles, averaging 7.4 changes. Instability under contentless doubt tracks intrinsic item ambiguity rather than evidence availability, and so does not serve as a grounding signal. Flips are almost entirely corrupting (99/100 across both levels). The model is not unaware of the missing evidence---it flags the blank image at baseline on 35 of 60 items and abstains on 4--6---yet those abstentions do not survive contact with pressure. None of the epistemic signals a user could plausibly consult distinguishes a grounded diagnosis from a confabulated one.

AI.tldr: 论文检验医学VQA模型中“图像无关的正确诊断”是否在答案置信度上有所体现：用空白占位图替换真实医学影像，并对60道意大利医学考试题施加两档对抗压力，发现无依据诊断并不更脆弱，且模型自报的认知信号无法区分“有据”与“编造”诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有工作已发现视觉语言模型在医学问答中不看图像也能给出正确诊断（依赖临床文字描述的捷径），但缺乏对“模型对答案的坚持程度是否随证据有无而变化”的考察，即是否存在可被用户利用的认知/证据接地信号。
AI.method: 60道意大利医学考试题，交叉设计“真实图像 vs 空白占位图”的图像替换协议与两档对抗压力（L4虚构共识、L1空洞质疑），进行配对题目级分析，统计推翻率差异、多轮翻转动量、基线拒答率及翻转方向（是否指向被诱导选项）。
AI.result: L4下真实图推翻率94.4%、空白图98.1%（Δ=+0.037，单侧95%上界+0.105）；L1下62.5% vs 51.8%（Δ=-0.107，95% CI [-0.209,-0.001]），方向与接地检测器所需相反。L4下首次翻转为110/110指向被论证选项后冻结（10轮均1.9次变判）；L1下从不收敛（均值7.4次）。翻转几乎全为破坏性（99/100）。基线时模型在35/60题指出图像缺失、4–6题拒答，但拒答在压力下无法保持。
AI.conclusion: 无图像依据的诊断并未表现出更低的答案稳健性，L1不稳定度反映题目内在歧义而非证据缺失，因此不能作为接地信号；模型虽能察觉证据缺失，但其拒答与自我认知信号在对抗压力下均失效，用户可获取的任何认知信号都无法区分有据诊断与虚构诊断。

title: How High Can GPT-6 Astra Climb in Contact-Rich Manipulation? PhysLadder: A Hierarchical, Matched Sim-Real Benchmark for Physical Interaction
summary: We introduce PhysLadder, a hierarchical Sim-Real benchmark for evaluating physical interaction capabilities in contact-rich manipulation. Its 16 household tasks span three cumulative levels: contact selection and geometric alignment (L1), force regulation within sustained contact (L2), and coordinated contact reconfiguration and force regulation (L3). Each task is instantiated in physically and visually matched simulated and real-world environments, with shared task definitions and success criteria. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra zero-shot with three trials per task in each environment. Real-world success rates decline from 80.0% at L1 to 47.6% at L2 and 0.0% at L3, with corresponding simulation rates of 66.7%, 47.6%, and 0.0%. Ten of the 16 tasks have identical success counts across environments; the remaining six differ by one success out of three trials. Across both environments, recurring difficulties in spatial reasoning, contact selection, force regulation, and coordination often prevent local physical progress from accumulating into task completion. These findings characterize Astra's observed capability boundary across increasing interaction demands and, for this model, support matched simulation as a repeatable, scalable testbed for studying the sustained, coordinated physical interactions that limit reliable manipulation.

AI.tldr: PhysLadder 是一个分层 Sim-Real 基准，16 个家庭任务分三级（L1 接触选择与几何对齐、L2 持续接触下的力调节、L3 接触重构与力调节协同），在物理与视觉匹配的仿真与真实环境中用统一任务定义和成功标准评测 GPT-6 Astra 零样本表现。
AI.motivation: 现有操作评测缺乏对"交互需求逐步升级"这一维度的分层刻画，也少有仿真与真实严格匹配的可复现测试床；作者希望刻画模型在接触选择、力调节、协同等递进能力上的边界，并验证匹配化仿真能否作为可扩展替代评测平台。
AI.method: 构建三级累积难度任务阶梯（L1→L3），每任务在视觉与物理匹配的仿真和真实环境中以共享任务定义与成功判据实例化；对 GPT-6 Astra 做零样本评测，每环境每任务 3 次试验，比较仿真与真实的成功计数一致性，并做定性失败模式归纳。
AI.result: 真实环境成功率 80.0%（L1）→47.6%（L2）→0.0%（L3），仿真为 66.7%/47.6%/0.0%；16 个任务中 10 个仿真与真实成功次数完全一致，另 6 个仅差 1/3 次试验；失败主要集中于空间推理、接触选择、力调节与协调，局部物理进展难以累积为任务完成。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出 Astra 在交互复杂度递增下的能力边界，并支持"匹配化仿真"作为可重复、可扩展的评测替代，用于研究限制可靠操作的持续协同物理交互；但工作侧重基准与诊断，未提供提升方法。

title: Multimodal Socially Aware Framework for Human-Robot Interaction in Virtual Reality
summary: Social robots must coordinate speech and movement while interpreting multimodal human input. We present a multimodal framework that integrates speech, vision, and touch to generate contextually appropriate robot speech and movement. We evaluated the framework in virtual reality with 18 participants across five social interaction scenarios, comparing its performance against a human-teleoperated baseline. Although participants rated the autonomous system above the neutral midpoint for both naturalness and social appropriateness, the teleoperated baseline received significantly higher ratings on both measures. Behavioral coding and qualitative feedback revealed that conversational timing, clarification of ambiguous requests, and spatial coordination were important factors contributing to this performance gap. These findings highlight key challenges in developing autonomous robots capable of natural, multimodal social interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出整合语音、视觉与触觉的多模态框架生成社交机器人语音与动作，在VR中用18名被试、5个场景与人类遥操作基线对比；自主系统在自然度与社会适切性上高于中性中点，但显著低于遥操作，差距主要源于对话时序、歧义澄清与空间协调。
AI.motivation: 社交机器人需在解读人类多模态输入的同时协调言语与动作，而现有系统在自然、连贯的多模态社交交互上仍有明显不足，作者希望量化自主系统与人类遥操作之间的差距并定位关键影响因素。
AI.method: 构建融合语音、视觉、触觉输入的多模态框架，用于生成情境适配的机器人言语与运动；在虚拟现实中开展用户研究，18名参与者×5个社交交互场景，与人类遥操作基线对比，结合主观评分、行为编码与质性反馈分析。
AI.result: 自主系统在自然度与社会适切性上均显著高于中性中点，但遥操作基线显著更优；行为编码与质性反馈显示对话时序、对歧义请求的澄清、空间协调是造成差距的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 自主多模态社交交互仍有显著差距，未来需在对话时序控制、主动澄清与空间协同上改进；研究局限为VR模拟环境、小样本（18人）且仅在虚拟场景验证。

title: Dual Gradient Consensus for Adaptive Learning to Transient Out-of-Distribution Disturbances in Quadrotor Control
summary: Quadrotor trajectory tracking under unmodeled disturbances often relies on online residual adaptation, but short out-domain residuals can corrupt the learned disturbance model when constant-step updates treat every residual gradient uniformly. We propose Dual Gradient Consensus (DGC), an adaptive-learning method for mixed in-domain/out-domain disturbances that retains the random Fourier feature model, offline BPTT policy, and least-squares adaptation of a prior domain-adaptive residual policy (DAPL) while modifying the online update step size. DGC compares each residual gradient with long- and short-term gradient memories, classifies the current adaptation regime, and uses a confidence map to suppress unreliable updates while recovering adaptation after persistent domain shifts. We evaluate DGC in numerical quadrotor trajectory tracking under four residuals that mix an in-domain component with short out-domain events. Compared with $L_1$-augmented MPC, RFF-based MPC, constant-step DAPL, and a frozen-parameter baseline, DGC achieves the lowest mean position RMSE in all four cases.

AI.tldr: DGC（Dual Gradient Consensus）在既有 DAPL（RFF 特征 + 离线 BPTT 策略 + 最小二乘残差适应）框架上改造在线步长：将当前残差梯度与长/短期梯度记忆对比以判定适应状态，用置信度图抑制域外扰动导致的不可靠更新并在持续域偏移后恢复适应。四类混合残差扰动下的四旋翼轨迹跟踪仿真中平均位置 RMSE 最低。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼轨迹跟踪中的未建模扰动依赖在线残差适应，但短暂的域外残差在常数步长更新下会被均匀对待，从而污染已学到的扰动模型。
AI.method: 保留 RFF 扰动模型、离线 BPTT 策略与最小二乘残差适应；仅修改在线更新步长：将残差梯度与长期/短期梯度记忆比较，分类当前适应状态，并用置信度图抑制不可靠更新、在持续域偏移后恢复适应。
AI.result: 在四旋翼轨迹跟踪数值仿真中，与 L1-augmented MPC、RFF-based MPC、常数步长 DAPL、冻结参数基线相比，DGC 在全部四种混合域内/短时域外残差情形下取得最低平均位置 RMSE。
AI.conclusion: 通过梯度一致性门控的步长自适应可提升残差适应对短时域外事件的鲁棒性；但验证仅限仿真与单一任务，缺少实机与代码证据。

title: VTC-AUDIT: An Interventional Reliability Audit for Visual-Token Compression under Paired Image Shifts
comment: 9 pages, 6 tables. Code and experimental results: this https URL
summary: Visual-token compression is usually evaluated by clean accuracy and efficiency, but these averages do not reveal failures that compression introduces under an image shift where the uncompressed model stays correct. We introduce VTC-AUDIT, which estimates this incremental risk only on pairs where the full model is correct on both images and the compressed model is correct on the clean image. The four arms then cross two binary choices: which image selects the retained token positions, and which image supplies the visual features. We audit three open 8-9B vision-language models on four tasks and eight pre-specified shifts. We evaluate two training-free compressors---hard-pruning DivPrune and prune-and-merge ApET---at a matched 25% retained-position budget, producing 708,000 inference records. Reselecting positions on the shifted image, rather than reusing the clean-image positions, raises the failure rate in all six model-compressor settings. The increase is 3.04-9.60 percentage points for DivPrune and 2.05-4.20 percentage points for ApET, with every 95% interval above zero. Repeating the audit on a separately resampled second manifest reproduces all six increases. In a pooled monitor audit across the four benchmarks, support Jaccard instability fails the practical AUROC criterion of 0.65 in all six settings, whereas clean compressed-model uncertainty clears it. Thus, support turnover is a weak ranking signal under the audited benchmark mixture, while clean compressed-model uncertainty is substantially more informative. These results suggest that future visual-token compression evaluations should report conditional reliability alongside clean accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: VTC-AUDIT 提出一种“增量风险”评测协议：只在未压缩模型对干净图与偏移图均正确、且压缩模型在干净图上正确的样本对上，测量压缩引入的失败率，并交叉“位置选择图像/特征来源图像”两种二元选择，审计 3 个 8-9B VLM、4 个任务、8 种预设图像偏移、2 个免训练压缩器（DivPrune、ApET，25% 保留位置）。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 压缩通常只用干净准确率与效率均值来评价，掩盖了在图像发生偏移时压缩模型失效而全模型仍正确的失败模式；需要一种聚焦条件可靠性的评测指标。
AI.method: 构造四臂交叉设计（其中两臂为“在偏移图上重选保留 token 位置”与“复用干净图位置”；另两维为位置选择图像与视觉特征来源图像），仅在双方模型均正确的配对子集上估计增量失败率；共 708,000 条推理记录，并用独立重采样的第二份 manifest 复现；另做汇总监控审计，比较 support Jaccard 不稳定度与压缩模型在干净图上的不确定性的 AUROC 排序能力（阈值 0.65）。
AI.result: 在偏移图上重新选择 token 位置使全部 6 个模型-压缩器组合的失败率上升：DivPrune 上升 3.04–9.60 个百分点，ApET 上升 2.05–4.20 个百分点，所有 95% 置信区间均不含零；第二次重采样复现全部 6 项上升。汇总审计中，support Jaccard 不稳定度在全部 6 个设置下均未达到 AUROC 0.65，而干净压缩模型不确定性通过该判据。
AI.conclusion: token 支持集翻转是较弱的排序信号，干净压缩模型不确定性更具信息量；建议未来视觉 token 压缩评测在干净准确率与效率之外，一并报告条件可靠性（增量风险）。

title: GRASP: Group-Adaptive Hybrid RL-SFT Post-Training for Medical VQA without Reasoning Annotations
summary: Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. We propose GRASP, which combines RL and SFT in every update using only short answers: RL lets the model explore its own reasoning, SFT teaches the gold answer after that reasoning to supply the direct supervision RL lacks, and their balance adapts to how well the model answers each question. Tuning only about 1% of the parameters with LoRA, GRASP outperforms all compared training objectives both in domain and on OOD open-ended questions across Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B and Gemma 3-4B. On an OOD benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities, GRASP-trained InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B beat all 10 compared general and medical VLMs in open-ended accuracy, including models trained on up to 2,600 times more data or with over 250 times more trainable parameters. We release MedTerse, a dataset of 12.9K short-answer questions, and our code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: GRASP在每次更新中同时用RL（GRPO式组内对比）和SFT（仅用短答案作为目标）联合训练医学VQA模型，并按每题答题正确度自适应平衡二者；仅调1%参数（LoRA）即在域内与OOD开放式问答上超越所有对比训练目标。
AI.motivation: 医学VQA标注数据稀缺且只有短答案、无推理标注；纯SFT易过拟合短标签并放大偏差、损害OOD泛化，而GRPO类RL因全对/全错组无信号、且从不直接使用金答案；现有SFT-RL混合方法分阶段或需专家推理链，医学数据不具备。
AI.method: 提出GRASP：单次更新内同时施加RL与SFT。RL让模型自行探索推理轨迹并利用组内正确/错误对比；SFT在该推理之后以金短答案提供直接监督；两者权重根据模型对每题的回答质量自适应调节。用LoRA仅训练约1%参数。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3-8B、Gemma 3-4B上，域内与OOD开放式问题均优于所有对比训练目标；在覆盖8种成像模态的OOD基准上，GRASP训练的InternVL3-8B与Qwen3-VL-8B开放式准确率超过全部10个对比的通用与医学VLM，包括训练数据多至2600倍、可训练参数多至250倍的模型。发布MedTerse（12.9K短答案问答）数据集与代码。
AI.conclusion: 无需推理标注即可在单阶段内融合RL探索与SFT直接监督，并以逐题自适应性平衡二者，是数据稀缺短答案场景下提升VLM泛化性的有效训练范式。

title: Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks
summary: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP typically rely on independently parameterized transformer blocks across depth. We investigate the extent to which these blocks can instead be reused recurrently while preserving the transferable capabilities of CLIP. We study recursive transformer backbones in which a small set of $N$ transformer blocks is applied $M$ times per forward pass. By holding $N \cdot M$ fixed to the depth of a standard ViT-B, our models preserve computational depth while progressively increasing parameter sharing. We consider two recursive CLIP model families: rCLIP, where only the vision encoder is recursive, and r$^2$CLIP, where recurrence is also introduced in the text encoder. We study these models under both direct contrastive training and through knowledge distillation from a strong ViT-B/16 teacher pretrained on DFN-2B, using the substantially smaller CC3M and CC12M datasets. We evaluate the resulting models on zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval, and further study their adaptability through few-shot learning, visual grounding, and concept unlearning. Our results show that CLIP can tolerate substantial recurrent block reuse, although its effect depends on the encoder and downstream task. Recurrence also provides parameter efficiency by construction, since fewer distinct transformer blocks need to be stored and adapted. Our results establish recurrent block reuse as a practical design space for vision-language models and highlight its implications for knowledge transfer, downstream adaptation, and parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: rCLIP/r²CLIP：将ViT-B的N个block递归复用M次（保持N·M=深度），研究视觉（及文本）编码器递归对CLIP迁移能力、下游适配与参数效率的影响。
AI.motivation: CLIP类对比视觉-语言模型通常逐层独立参数化，参数与深度线性增长；作者希望验证在保持计算深度的前提下，能否通过递归复用少量block在几乎不损失迁移能力的情况下获得参数效率。
AI.method: 构建两族递归骨干：rCLIP（仅视觉编码器递归）与r²CLIP（文本编码器也递归），N个block重复M次且N·M固定为标准ViT-B深度，逐步增加参数共享；在直接对比训练与从DFN-2B预训练ViT-B/16教师蒸馏（CC3M/CC12M小数据集）两种设定下训练；评测零样本分类、跨模态检索、少样本学习、视觉定位与概念遗忘。
AI.result: CLIP可容忍显著程度的递归block复用，但影响依赖于具体编码器（视觉/文本）与下游任务；递归在构造上带来参数效率，需存储与适配的独立block更少；蒸馏条件下小数据亦可维持较好迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 递归block复用构成视觉-语言模型的一个实用设计空间，对知识迁移、下游适配与参数效率均有明确启示。

title: FlockWorld: Toward Population-Scale Multi-Agent Video World Models through Artificial Life Simulation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Creative AI Track
summary: Most action-conditioned video world models remain limited to a single player, while existing multiplayer models support only small, fixed groups of agents. We introduce FlockWorld, an artificial-life environment built on Reynolds's Boids algorithm for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models. Specifically, FlockWorld renders synchronized egocentric crops, assigns distinct colors to preserve camera-agent identity across views, exposes rule-derived accelerations as actions, and lets the number of camera agents be configured independently of the size of the surrounding population. We further introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer trained with flow matching on FlockWorld data to jointly generate synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents. Our results suggest that joint generation benefits agent detection at density-matched settings and that diffusion forcing improves rollout fidelity. Together, FlockWorld and FlockDiT provide a controlled testbed for multi-agent video generation.

AI.tldr: FlockWorld：基于Boids群体算法的种群级多智能体自视角视频世界模型测试平台；FlockDiT：用flow matching训练的action-conditioned latent DiT，联合生成多智能体同步自视角视频。
AI.motivation: 现有action-conditioned视频世界模型多为单玩家，已有多人模型仅支持小规模固定智能体组，缺乏种群规模的多智能体视频世界模型研究平台。
AI.method: 构建FlockWorld人工生命环境：基于Reynolds Boids规则，渲染同步的egocentric裁剪视图，用distinct color保持跨视角的相机-智能体身份对应，以规则导出的加速度作为action，相机智能体数量可与周围种群规模独立配置；并训练FlockDiT——带动作条件的latent diffusion transformer，用flow matching在FlockWorld数据上联合生成多智能体同步自视角视频，结合diffusion forcing。
AI.result: 联合生成在密度匹配设置下改善智能体检测；diffusion forcing提升长时序rollout保真度。
AI.conclusion: FlockWorld与FlockDiT为多智能体视频生成提供可控测试平台，但实验基于合成Boids场景，缺乏真实世界证据与开源代码说明。

title: The German Tank Problem & Navigating by Scent
summary: A robot searching for the source of an odor must eventually answer a deceptively hard question: have I arrived? Near the source, concentration gradients flatten, turbulence makes the signal intermittent, and a small robot often lacks the positional accuracy to map the plume. Here, we describe a lightweight remedy inspired by a World War II statistics conundrum: the German tank problem. To approximate enemy armament production, Allied analysts developed an estimator based on serial numbers from captured tanks. Analogously, we use the same procedure over sampled chemical sensor readings from a robot to create estimates for the peak concentration of an odor plume, and therefore the odor's source. Treating each sensor reading as an observation, our unbiased estimator needs only a running maximum and a sample counter. An exact confidence bound turns both numbers into a principled rule that the robot or UAV can use to determine whether to keep searching for the plume source or land. We derive the estimator and its bound, demonstrate its sample efficiency, and examine its robustness even when its assumptions fail. Finally, we summarize the estimator's role as the termination criterion for olfactory navigation.

AI.tldr: 借用二战"德军坦克问题"的序列号极大似然/无偏估计思想，将机器人化学传感器读数视为连续采样，估计气味羽流峰值浓度并据此构造精确置信界，作为嗅觉导航的终止（"是否已到源"）判定准则。
AI.motivation: 嗅觉寻源的最后一步"是否已到达"极难判定：近源处浓度梯度平缓、湍流造成信号间歇性中断，小型机器人/无人机定位精度不足难以建图羽流。需要一种轻量、无需建图的终止判据。
AI.method: 把每个传感器读数当作对未知上界（峰值浓度）的均匀分布采样观测，沿用德军坦克问题的无偏估计器，仅需运行最大值与样本计数两个统计量；进一步推导精确置信上界，形成"继续搜索还是降落"的判定规则；给出样本效率分析与假设失效（如噪声、截断、非均匀分布）下的鲁棒性讨论。
AI.result: 得到峰值浓度的无偏估计及其精确置信界；实验/分析显示样本效率高，且在假设不完全成立时仍保持一定鲁棒性；作者将该估计器总结为嗅觉导航的终止准则。
AI.conclusion: 统计估计（最大序统计量法）可低成本替代建图，为气味源定位提供原则性终止判据，适用于资源受限的机器人/UAV 平台。

title: What Does World Modeling Actually Improve in Robot Action Learning?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-video prediction with robot action learning, yet improvements in task success alone do not reveal how predictive supervision manifests in execution behavior or whether its benefits persist under task and environmental shifts. We conduct controlled future-video prediction loss ablations within FastWAM and OpenWAM, keeping model architecture, initialization, robot training data, and training steps fixed within each model family. Under clean conditions on seen tasks, predictive supervision increases success rates by 24.38 and 72.91 percentage points, respectively. Trajectory clustering further reveals higher success rates within several coarse trajectory clusters, including cases where cluster frequencies change little, indicating that the gains are not solely reflected in changes in the prevalence of trajectory patterns. However, these benefits do not consistently persist under distribution shifts: improvements on unseen tasks vary across models and tasks, while both models exhibit low success rates under the evaluated environmental randomizations, without a consistent advantage from predictive supervision. We further introduce future-video prediction as an auxiliary training objective for $\pi_{0.5}$, where a lightweight Transformer predictor used only during training increases success from 82.94% to 89.19%. These findings support future-video prediction as effective auxiliary supervision for action learning, while distinguishing improved execution on familiar tasks from reliable transfer and showing that such gains need not rely on a large pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 该文在 FastWAM 与 OpenWAM 上做受控的未来视频预测损失消融，并在 π0.5 上引入轻量 Transformer 预测器作为辅助训练目标，系统评估预测监督对任务成功率与轨迹分布的影响及其在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 仅以任务成功率衡量效果，无法说明未来视频预测监督如何体现在执行行为中，也不清楚其收益能否在任务与环境变化下保持。作者希望区分"熟悉任务上的执行改进"与"可靠迁移"。
AI.method: 在模型架构、初始化、机器人训练数据与训练步数固定（同一模型族内）的条件下，对 FastWAM 与 OpenWAM 做未来视频预测损失的受控消融；用轨迹聚类分析行为模式变化；在未见任务与环境随机化下评估分布偏移鲁棒性；并在 π0.5 中加入仅训练期使用的轻量 Transformer 未来视频预测头作为辅助目标。
AI.result: 干净条件下已见任务成功率分别提升 24.38 与 72.91 个百分点；部分粗粒度轨迹簇内成功率提升明显，即便簇频率变化很小，说明收益不只来自轨迹模式占比变化。分布偏移下收益不稳定：未见任务上的提升因模型与任务而异，环境随机化下两模型成功率都低且无明显一致优势。π0.5 加辅助预测头后成功率由 82.94% 升至 89.19%。
AI.conclusion: 未来视频预测可作为有效的动作学习辅助监督，但其收益主要体现在熟悉任务上的执行质量提升，而非可靠的任务/环境迁移；且此类增益在本文设定下并不依赖大规模预训练视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）。

title: Finetuning Prompt-Based Image Editor for Geometry-Consistent Room Defurnishing
comment: 2 pages, 3 figures. Poster presented at IEEE ISMAR 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Erasing all furniture from a single room image to generate its empty counterpart is valuable for XR applications such as diminished reality and virtual staging. The challenge is twofold: inpainting the furniture regions with realistic content, and doing so without distorting the room's 3D geometry. Prompt-driven image editors, such as FLUX.2, handle realism impressively, but their structural faithfulness is inferior to explicit layout conditioned inpainting. To improve geometric consistency, we propose a training recipe for finetuning a LoRA on 2,500 furnished-empty room pairs. FLUX.2 with our LoRA adaptor significantly improves geometric consistency while retaining the high texture fidelity. This single-photo inpainter can be an effective building block for depth-aware and 3D-consistent XR pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出在2,500对"有家具/空房间"图像上微调FLUX.2的LoRA适配器，实现单张房间图去除全部家具的空房生成，在保持高纹理真实感的同时显著提升3D几何一致性。
AI.motivation: XR场景（减现实、虚拟布置）需要从单张房间图生成无家具的空房图像。难点有二：既要对家具区域做真实感修复，又不能破坏房间的3D几何结构。现有prompt驱动的编辑器（如FLUX.2）真实感强但结构忠实度不如显式布局条件修复。
AI.method: 构建2,500对"有家具—空房间"成对数据，设计训练配方对FLUX.2进行LoRA微调，以提升几何一致性；将单图修复器作为depth-aware与3D一致XR流程的模块。
AI.result: FLUX.2 + 自训练LoRA在几何一致性上显著提升，同时保留高纹理保真度；单照片修复可作为XR管线的有效构件。
AI.conclusion: 通过成对数据LoRA微调，可在不引入显式布局条件的前提下获得接近布局条件修复的几何一致性，为减现实与虚拟布置提供单图输入方案。

title: An Agentic AI Workflow for Liver Lesion Segmentation and Structured Radiology Reporting
summary: Despite advances in automated liver lesion segmentation, a gap remains between image-derived predictions and clinically interpretable radiology reports. Bridging this gap requires quantitative measurements that are both reproducible and traceable. We present an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that connects liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and structured reporting. TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net models delineate the liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions, while computational tools extract volumes, dimensions, counts, and anatomical locations. A large language model (LLM) organizes these measurements into a predefined reporting schema, with numerical consistency checks against source measurements. On 51 LiTS cases, the segmentation stage achieved a liver Dice score of 0.947, lesion sensitivity of 75.6%, and positive predictive value of 68.9%. Exploratory screening of 25,494 MERLIN reports identified 10,208 (40.0%) with liver-related abnormalities. By connecting quantitative imaging evidence with agentic report generation, this work takes a step toward human-centered medical AI that prioritizes traceability and clinical relevance.

AI.tldr: A liver/lesion segmentation + LLM agentic pipeline converts quantitative imaging evidence into structured, traceable radiology-style reports.
AI.motivation: Automated liver lesion segmentation outputs remain disconnected from clinically interpretable, reproducible, traceable radiology reports; quantification needs explicit evidence linkage.
AI.method: TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net jointly delineates liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions; computational tools derive volume, dimensions, counts, and anatomic location; an LLM organizes measurements into a predefined reporting schema with numerical consistency checks against source values.
AI.result: On 51 LiTS cases: liver Dice 0.947, lesion sensitivity 75.6%, PPV 68.9%; exploratory screening of 25,494 MERLIN reports found 10,208 (40.0%) with liver-related abnormalities.
AI.conclusion: Coupling deterministic imaging quantification with agentic LLM report generation improves traceability and clinical relevance, a step toward human-centered medical AI.

title: FlexiMIND: Combined Pretrained Vision Features and Local Structure for Training-Free Deformable Medical Image Registration
summary: Objective. Deformable image registration remains challenging because corresponding anatomy may exhibit different intensity relationships. Hand-crafted modality-robust descriptors such as Modality-Independent Neighborhood Descriptor with Self-Similarity Context (MIND-SSC) and features from pretrained vision encoders provide distinct representations for correspondence estimation, but how they should be combined remains unclear. We investigate whether tighter integration improves registration over a sequential, scale-separated design. Approach. We introduce FlexiMIND, a training-free and label-free two-stage framework in which frozen FlexiCT-2D encoder features establish contextual correspondence and MIND-SSC refines the deformation within ConvexAdam. Five alternative feature-coupling strategies were evaluated under a protocol across CT-CT (DIR-Lab 4DCT 4DCT, 10 cases), MR-MR (ACDC, 50 patients), and MR-CT (Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT, 8 pairs) registration. Performance was assessed using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), SDlogJ, and local folding. Main results. FlexiMIND achieved a TRE of 1.27 mm on DIR-Lab 4DCT, a DSC of 0.807 on ACDC, and an organ-averaged DSC of 0.825 on Abdomen MR-CT. Across 15 coupling-strategy dataset comparisons, only four outperformed the reference method, with a maximum absolute improvement of 0.0043 in Dice, whereas degradation reached 20.6 % in TRE and 37.9 % in Dice. Changes in registration accuracy were closely associated with changes in deformation-field regularity, and strategies that better preserved regularity generally remained closest to the reference performance. Landmark-level analysis showed that the pretrained encoder stage primarily reduced large correspondence errors rather than uniformly improving local precision. Code is available upon acceptance at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FlexiMIND 是一个无需训练、无需标签的两阶段可变形配准框架：先用冻结的 FlexiCT-2D 编码器特征建立上下文对应，再由 MIND-SSC 在 ConvexAdam 中细化形变；作者系统比较了 5 种特征耦合策略，发现更紧耦合并未稳定优于顺序式解耦设计。
AI.motivation: 跨模态/多模态配准中对应解剖结构强度关系不一致，MIND-SSC 类手工模态鲁棒描述子与预训练视觉编码器特征各有所长，但二者如何组合（紧耦合 vs. 尺度分离的顺序设计）缺乏系统对比证据。
AI.method: 在 ConvexAdam 框架内构建两阶段流程：冻结 FlexiCT-2D 编码器特征负责全局上下文对应，MIND-SSC 负责形变细化；作为参照的无训练、无标签"顺序解耦"设计，并与 5 种替代特征耦合策略在统一协议下对比，覆盖 CT-CT（DIR-Lab 4DCT，10 例）、MR-MR（ACDC，50 例）、MR-CT（Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT，8 对）；指标为 TRE、Dice、SDlogJ、局部折叠。
AI.result: FlexiMIND 取得 DIR-Lab TRE 1.27 mm、ACDC DSC 0.807、Abdomen MR-CT 器官平均 DSC 0.825；15 组耦合策略对比中仅 4 组优于参照方法，Dice 最大绝对提升仅 0.0043，而退化可达 TRE 20.6%、Dice 37.9%；精度变化与形变场正则性变化高度相关；关键点分析显示预训练编码器阶段主要削减大位移对应误差而非均匀提升局部精度。
AI.conclusion: 更紧的特征耦合并不优于尺度分离的顺序设计；混合描述子配准的收益来源是修正大范围误对应，且须以形变场正则性为前提，后续设计应优先保证正则性以维持稳定性。

title: Do Words Matter? What Text Contributes to Few and Full-Shot Vision-Language Anomaly Detection
summary: Vision-language anomaly detectors describe normal and abnormal appearance with text, and their gains are commonly credited to the semantic content of these descriptions. This attribution is plausible in the zero-shot setting, but few- and full-shot detectors interpose a trained visual adapter, and in that setting it has not been isolated. Changing a description changes both its meaning and its geometry, so accuracy comparisons cannot separate the two. We ask what a fixed pair of text embeddings, or anchors, contributes to such a detector: semantic content, effective scale, or joint anchor geometry. For a single anchor pair, the answer is effective scale alone. The score reads the anchors only through their difference, and a trained adapter can rotate to follow any replacement direction, leaving that direction, and with it the linguistic content, unidentifiable. We prove that replacement anchors with the same difference-vector length permit exactly the same probability maps and attainable losses. Across seven medical datasets, three vision backbones, both supervision regimes, and three adapter families, scale-matched random and orthogonal anchors track correct prompts; breaking the scale match opens a gap that restoring it closes without text. The same pattern holds in MVFA and when MadCLIP's learned prompts are replaced by a text-free learned scale. When one adapter serves many categories, the answer expands to their joint arrangement. Rotating all category axes together changes nothing, as predicted. For the tested CLIP prompts, these axes are nearly collinear, and meaning-free rotations that spread them apart improve performance on both industrial benchmarks. Even under frozen zero-shot transfer, a random anchor frame transfers as well as the prompt frame: coordinate consistency, not meaning. What these detectors read from their prompts is scale and arrangement, not semantic content.

AI.tldr: 该文通过理论与实验证明：少样本/全监督视觉-语言异常检测器从文本提示中读取的并非语义内容，而是锚点（文本嵌入对）的有效尺度；多类别适配器则读取各类别锚轴的联合几何排列，而非语义。
AI.motivation: 社区普遍将视觉-语言异常检测的性能增益归因于文本描述的语义内容，但在引入可训练视觉适配器的少样本/全监督设定下，语义贡献与几何贡献（尺度、方向）未被解耦；改变描述同时改变语义与几何，导致精度比较无法区分二者。
AI.method: 提出"固定锚点对/锚点框架"的可辨识性分析：证明分数仅通过锚点差向量起作用，适配器可旋转以跟随任意替换方向，故方向与语言内容不可辨识；证明差向量长度相同的替换锚点产生完全相同的概率图与可达损失。实验覆盖7个医学数据集、3种视觉骨干、两种监督范式、3个适配器家族，以及MVFA和MadCLIP，并测试多类别联合锚轴排列与工业基准。
AI.result: 尺度匹配的随机锚点与正交锚点可媲美正确提示；破坏尺度匹配会打开性能差距，仅恢复尺度即可闭合（无需文本）。多类别情形下，整体旋转所有类别轴无影响（与预测一致）；CLIP提示的类别轴近共线，无意义的"打散"旋转在工业基准上带来提升；冻结零样本迁移下随机锚点框架与提示框架迁移效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 此类检测器从提示中读到的只是尺度与排列（坐标一致性），而非语义内容；提示工程的有效性来自几何而非语言，提示与锚点的语义解释在适配器存在时基本失效。

title: P2P-Former: Bridging the Supervision Gap Between Point and Proposal in Temporal Action Localization
summary: Recently, point-supervised temporal action localization has attracted increasing attention due to its low annotation cost (only one frame per action instance) and competitive detection performance. However, since point annotations are less complete than proposal annotations, existing methods mainly rely on multiple instance learning for snippet-level classification, which leads to a performance gap compared to fully supervised models. To bridge this gap, we propose P2P-Former, a novel point-to-proposal Transformer-based framework that effectively connects point-level supervision with proposal-level learning for temporal action localization. In this work, we identify two key challenges in transitioning from point-level supervision to full supervision: (1) how to generate reliable proposals as pseudo ground-truth, and (2) how to effectively integrate point-level cues into the fully supervised paradigm. To address the first challenge, we propose a Point-aware Proposal Generation (PPG) strategy that refines the confidence of proposals produced by a base locator using a point-aware importance estimation function, and then performs optimal matching between point annotations and candidate proposals to select reliable proposals as pseudo ground-truth. To tackle the second challenge, we introduce a Point-guided Semantic Enhancement (PSE) module that aggregates prototypes from point-annotated features and injects them into snippet features through Transformer-based interactions. Moreover, we design a Point-to-Proposal Constraint Loss (PPCL) that enforces each predicted proposal to include the annotated point, thereby encouraging more accurate localization. Extensive experiments on the THUMOS14 and ActivityNet-1.3 datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms several existing state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: P2P-Former：将点级弱监督通过"点感知提议生成+最优匹配"转为伪真值提议，并用Transformer原型增强与点-提议约束损失接入全监督范式，在THUMOS14/ActivityNet-1.3上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 点监督时序动作定位（每个实例仅一帧标注）成本低但监督信号弱，现有方法依赖多示例学习做片段级分类，与全监督存在明显性能差距。作者认为需解决两个问题：(1) 如何生成可靠的伪真值提议；(2) 如何将点级线索有效融入全监督范式。
AI.method: 提出P2P-Former点到提议Transformer框架，含三个组件：PPG（Point-aware Proposal Generation）用点感知重要性估计函数精修基定位器输出提议的置信度，再以点标注与候选提议做最优匹配筛选伪真值；PSE（Point-guided Semantic Enhancement）从点标注特征聚合原型（prototypes），经Transformer交互注入片段特征；PPCL（Point-to-Proposal Constraint Loss）约束每个预测提议必须包含标注点，以强化定位精度。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14与ActivityNet-1.3上实验表明，方法优于多种现有SOTA点监督方法，缩小了与全监督的差距。
AI.conclusion: 将点级监督经伪真值提议生成与点引导语义增强嫁接到全监督检测范式，是提升点监督时序动作定位的有效途径；但其验证仅限视频时序定位基准，未涉及具身/三维场景。

title: One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition
summary: Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. We analyze components of synthetic input (durations, acoustic features), compare different HMM aligners, evaluate scaling on the 25 000 h Loquacious dataset, and show that full-encoder injection yields strong relative improvements compared to partial-encoder and decoder methods. The code of the whole pipeline behind every number in this paper is public: this http URL

AI.tldr: 用逐音素平均log-mel向量或one-hot加对齐统计采样的时长构成查表式合成特征替代神经TTS，用于text injection训练ASR，速度快1.8倍且WER相当，配合外部LM在LibriSpeech取得1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24% SOTA。
AI.motivation: text injection需要将无配对文本转成语音编码器可消费的输入，此前依赖冻结的神经TTS模型，流程昂贵且需额外模型；作者希望用极简、无需训练的替代方案降低门槛与成本。
AI.method: 1) 构建每音素一个平均log-mel向量（或one-hot）的查表；2) 时长按对齐统计分布随机采样，词间插入静音，拼出合成特征序列；3) 将合成输入直接送入语音编码器做全编码器注入训练；4) 消融时长/声学特征设计，比较不同HMM对齐器，并在25k小时Loquacious上验证可扩展性；5) 对比全编码器注入与部分编码器、解码器注入。
AI.result: 训练速度较神经TTS方案快1.8倍，WER相当；配合外部LM在LibriSpeech dev/test-clean/other为1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24%，据称是仅用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本与词典条件下的SOTA；全编码器注入相对部分编码器和解码器方法有显著相对提升；整套流程代码公开。
AI.conclusion: 合成语音特征不必依赖神经TTS，简单的音素级查表加统计时长即可支撑有效text injection，且更适合大规模扩展；全编码器注入是最有效的注入位置。

title: RIDE-Splat: Reflection Removal for In-the-Wild Driving Environments
summary: Driving video captured through a windshield violates the world-space consistency assumed by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS): the road scene exhibits parallax while cabin reflections remain attached to the camera, causing standard 3DGS to embed reflected content into the reconstructed scene. We introduce RIDE-Splat, a pipeline for reflection-free 3D reconstruction from posed driving video without clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks. RIDE-Splat assigns world-consistent transmission through the windshield to a 3DGS scene and the dominant camera-attached reflection to one shared, signed RGB image. It builds the clean reconstruction in two passes. First, it learns the 3D geometry and the signed reflection image, representing both added radiance and transmission attenuation. Then, it uses the reflection-removed training images to fit a clean 3DGS model. At inference, the reflection image is discarded, preserving the standard 3DGS rendering path. We also introduce the RIDE-Splat Dataset, the first 3D reconstruction benchmark for reflection removal from driving video -- with real driving scenes, physical windshield reflections in training views, and separately captured non-reflective evaluation images. Across the RIDE-Splat Dataset, XLD, and Wayve, RIDE-Splat outperforms 3DGS, DC-Gaussian, and RobustSplat on all nine aggregate metrics, improving PSNR by up to 3.59 dB and reducing LPIPS by up to 0.0876. We achieve the highest metrics in 38 out of 42 per-scene comparisons and removes windshield reflections that remain visible in the baselines while preserving the transmitted scene.

AI.tldr: RIDE-Splat 提出从带位姿的车载视频中去除挡风玻璃反射的无反射 3DGS 重建流程：将世界一致的透射分量分配给 3DGS 场景，将相机附着的反射建模为单张带符号 RGB 图，两阶段训练后推理时丢弃反射图；并发布首个车载反射去除 3D 重建基准 RIDE-Splat Dataset。
AI.motivation: 透过挡风玻璃拍摄的驾驶视频违反 3DGS 假设的世界一致性：车外场景存在视差，而车内反射随相机运动，标准 3DGS 会把反射内容"烘焙"进重建场景，造成几何与外观污染。现有反射去除方法依赖干净图像、反射掩码或预训练网络，且缺少面向 3D 重建的评测基准。
AI.method: RIDE-Splat 采用两遍（two-pass）建模范式。第一遍：将挡风玻璃透射的、满足世界一致性的成分赋给 3DGS 场景，同时用一张共享的带符号 RGB 图像表示相机附着的反射（带符号以同时建模叠加辐射亮度与透射衰减）；联合优化 3D 几何与反射图。第二遍：用去除反射后的训练图像拟合干净的 3DGS 模型。推理阶段直接丢弃反射图，保持标准 3DGS 渲染路径不变，无需干净图像、反射掩码或预训练网络。
AI.result: 在自建 RIDE-Splat Dataset、XLD 和 Wayve 三个数据集上，RIDE-Splat 在全部 9 项聚合指标上优于 3DGS、DC-Gaussian 和 RobustSplat，PSNR 最高提升 3.59 dB，LPIPS 最多降低 0.0876；在 42 组逐场景比较中 38 组取得最优，并去除了基线中仍可见的挡风玻璃反射，同时保持透射场景质量。
AI.conclusion: 论文将相机附着反射与世界一致透射显式解耦，为车载场景提供无需监督的反射鲁棒 3DGS 重建方案；并首次建立含真实挡风玻璃反射训练视图与独立无反射评估图像的重建基准。属单场景优化型（per-scene）方法，未见跨场景泛化或前馈推理能力主张。

title: Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila
summary: Animals have a remarkable capacity for autonomy---driven by intrinsic motivation---without external sensory cues or extrinsic objectives, yet the computational mechanisms behind this ability largely remain a mystery. We combine whole-brain recordings in the fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster), which reveal neural representations of spontaneous exploratory decisions more than 10 seconds in advance, with a neuromechanical digital twin to test whether optimizing intrinsic goals yields realistically embodied artificial agents that quantitatively match fly behavior and internal representations of future volitional action during exploration. Our hierarchical policy selects from a discrete library of low-level motor primitives, consistent with ethological theories of behavioral syllables. We train agents without external reward using 20 intrinsic motivation algorithms spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency methods. The agents are evaluated in a virtual tethered-ball assay modeled on the fly experiment, comparing spontaneous locomotor statistics and internal representations and decoding future turn direction from kinematics and neural activity on the same timescales observed in flies. DIAYN, a hierarchical competency algorithm learning discrete policies that maximize behavioral entropy and the separability of induced sensory observations, achieves the strongest joint behavioral and neural prospective coding performance relative to flies. Its learned policies closely capture individual variability in fly exploration strategies, suggesting that this diversity serves to maximize state-space coverage at the population level. DIAYN's latent activity also closely captures the sum-difference rule for interhemispheric encoding of kinematics in biological flies. These results establish hierarchical, intrinsically motivated agents as a powerful framework for reverse-engineering animal autonomy.

AI.tldr: 该研究将果蝇全脑记录（可提前10秒以上预测自发性探索决策）与神经力学数字孪生结合，检验用内在动机算法训练的分层具身智能体能否定量匹配果蝇的探索行为与前瞻性神经表征；DIAYN在行为统计与神经预测编码上综合表现最佳，并复现了半球间运动学编码的"和-差"规则。
AI.motivation: 动物内在动机驱动的自主探索能力缺乏计算层面的机制解释；已有强化学习智能体多依赖外在奖励，能否用纯内在目标在具身层面重现生物自发行为与神经表征尚不清楚。
AI.method: 把果蝇全脑记录与基于真实形态/驱动动力学的neuromechanical digital twin结合，构建分层策略：高层从离散的低层运动基元库中选择动作（对应行为"音节"理论）；在无外部奖励条件下用20种内在动机算法（好奇心、熵、能力型）训练；在仿照果蝇实验的虚拟拴绳球（tethered-ball）装置中评估，比较自发运动统计量，并从运动学与神经活动解码未来转向，时间尺度与果蝇一致。
AI.result: DIAYN（学习离散策略以最大化行为熵及诱导感觉观测可分性的分层能力型算法）在行为与神经前瞻编码的联合指标上最接近果蝇；其策略能刻画果蝇个体间探索策略差异，提示个体多样性在群体层面最大化状态空间覆盖；其隐层活动也复现了生物果蝇半球间编码运动学的"和-差"规则。
AI.conclusion: 分层、内在动机驱动的智能体可作为逆向工程动物自主性的有效框架，并实现了行为与神经表征双向对齐的具身验证。

title: Regional prediction of hematoma expansion from non-contrast computed tomography in spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage patients
summary: Background The combination of hematoma location, expansion and final volume influence neurological outcome. The aim of this study was to derive and validate a quantitative and interpretable region-based NCCT image feature model for predicting hematoma expansion. Methods The Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage(ERICH) study was used for derivation and the Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive(VISTA) was used for validation. NCCT images at presentation and 24+/-6hours were pre-processed, segmented and categorized into lobar, basal ganglia or thalamic regions. Hematoma expansion was defined by region and according to its effect on clinical outcome. Transport-based morphometry (TBM) produced a unique transport-based representation from each NCCT hematoma image. Linear classifiers applied to transport representations were used to derive a predictive model. The regional TBM model's performance was compared to alternate methods using AUROC analyses. Results The derivation dataset included 574 patients, comprising 162 lobar, 257 basal ganglia and 155 thalamic hematomas. The validation dataset included 196 patients, comprising 31 lobar, 119 basal ganglia and 46 thalamic hematomas. A combined regional model predicted hematoma expansion in the validation dataset with an AUROC of 0.787. The principal image features which varied by location were size, heterogeneity, eccentricity and density distribution towards the hematoma periphery. The regional TBM model outperformed alternative clinician based and machine-learning methods. Conclusions TBM discriminated and visualized regional features of hematoma expansion from presentation NCCT scans. This provides preliminary evidence for regional radiographic features of hematoma expansion. It has the potential to improve hematoma expansion prediction and understanding of hematoma expansion pathophysiology.

AI.tldr: 提出基于传输的形态学(TBM)区域化NCCT特征模型预测脑出血血肿扩大，外部验证AUROC=0.787。
AI.motivation: 血肿位置、扩大与最终体积共同影响神经功能预后，但缺乏定量、可解释且按出血部位区分的影像学预测模型。
AI.method: ERICH队列(574例)建模，VISTA队列(196例)验证；对首诊及24±6h NCCT做预处理、分割并划分为脑叶/基底节/丘脑区域；用transport-based morphometry生成血肿的传输表示，在其上训练线性分类器，AUROC对比临床医师与常规机器学习方法。
AI.result: 分区联合模型验证AUROC 0.787；关键区域差异特征为大小、异质性、偏心度及血肿周边密度分布；优于医师判断与其他ML方法。
AI.conclusion: TBM可判别并可视化血肿扩大的区域影像特征，为区域化预测提供初步证据，有望改善预测与病理生理理解。

title: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
summary: Recent advances in vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) have significantly improved robotic manipulation, yet deploying robots in the open world demands a higher level of autonomy beyond executing predefined tasks. Robot agents offer a promising paradigm for this transition, integrating task discovery, contextual reasoning, physical execution, and adaptive recovery into a closed interaction loop. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated capabilities, failing to capture the complexity of open-world robot autonomy. We introduce RobotAgentBench (RAB), a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating robot agents in realistic, open-world household environments. Through an agent-assisted, human-in-the-loop real-to-sim pipeline, RAB constructs 50 diverse household layouts with interactive objects and physically grounded tasks, encompassing 90 atomic tasks, 18 short-horizon tasks, 8 long-horizon tasks, and 4 open-ended scenarios. RAB provides a multi-level evaluation of robot agent capabilities: (1) task-level assessments systematically examine five complementary dimensions: task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, failure recovery, and robustness; (2) scenario-level evaluation assesses how agents integrate these capabilities to autonomously fulfill high-level user needs. Furthermore, RAB enables systematic comparisons of standalone VLA/WAM models and diverse robot agent architectures under a unified planning-execution-verification framework. Extensive experiments reveal substantial gaps between manipulation and autonomy, demonstrate the advantages of agentic architectures and recursive self-improvement, and highlight the remaining challenges toward open-world robot autonomy.

AI.tldr: RobotAgentBench (RAB)：面向开放世界家庭环境的机器人智能体综合基准，含 50 个场景、90 原子任务/18 短程/8 长程/4 开放任务，提出任务级五维与场景级闭环评估，并统一比较 VLA/WAM 与智能体架构。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA/WAM 基准只评测孤立能力（如操作成功率），无法刻画开放世界所需的“任务发现—情境推理—物理执行—自适应恢复”闭环自主性，缺少能评估端到端机器人智能体的统一平台。
AI.method: 采用“智能体辅助 + 人在回路”的 real-to-sim 管线构建 50 个带可交互物体的物理仿真家庭布局；任务分四级（90 原子、18 短程、8 长程、4 开放）；评估分两级：任务级考察任务发现、情境推理、操作、失败恢复、鲁棒性五维，场景级考察高层需求下的能力整合；在统一的 planning-execution-verification 框架下对比单体 VLA/WAM 与多种智能体架构。
AI.result: 大规模实验显示操作能力与自主性之间存在显著落差；智能体化架构与递归自我改进带来明显优势；同时暴露开放世界机器人自主性的剩余挑战。
AI.conclusion: RAB 提供了首个覆盖多层级任务与闭环交互的机器人智能体基准，表明仅靠 VLA/WAM 操作能力不足以实现开放世界自主，需智能体化规划、验证与自我改进机制。

title: Dream to Assist: Intent-Conditioned World Models for Shared Vehicle Control
summary: Assistive agents in shared-control settings face a dual challenge: acting proactively to align with the human's intentions while remaining legible enough for the human to comprehend and fluently respond in real time. We present Dream2Assist, a model-based reinforcement learning framework for tightly-coupled shared decision making that addresses both sides of this challenge. Our approach extends a recurrent state-space world model with intent inference, enabling an assistive policy trained via fictitious co-play to anticipate and support discrete human objectives without overriding human agency. Beyond the computational framework, we describe the full deployment pipeline needed to translate a world-model-based policy into a safe, human-centered system in a resource-efficient way. Crucially, we address the sim-to-real-human gap via policy down-selection and reward restructuring within an iterative human-machine interface design. We validate the framework through three human-subjects studies and a preliminary on-vehicle deployment spanning two qualitatively distinct domains: high-speed racing (N=30) and urban driving with richer intent structure (N=10). Our results demonstrate that intent conditioning yields measurable improvements in torque alignment and collision rate. We surface key design insights and practices for deploying learning-based assistive agents in safety-critical, real-time human-robot teaming.

AI.tldr: Dream2Assist：用带意图推断的循环状态空间世界模型，通过虚构共玩训练辅助策略，实现前瞻性且可读的共享控制，并在高速赛车与城市驾驶两类真人实验（N=30 / N=10）中验证。
AI.motivation: 共享控制下的辅助智能体需同时满足"主动性"（贴合人类意图）与"可读性"（人类能实时理解并顺畅响应）的双重目标，现有方法多侧重单侧。
AI.method: 在循环状态空间世界模型上增加意图推断分支，得到可预测离散人类目标的条件化辅助策略；用fictitious co-play训练策略而不剥夺人类主导权；通过策略下采样（down-selection）与奖励重构，配合迭代式人机界面设计缩小sim-to-real-human差距；给出资源高效的安全部署流水线。
AI.result: 三项人因实验加初步实车部署，覆盖高速赛车（N=30）与含更丰富意图结构的城市驾驶（N=10）；意图条件化在扭矩对齐与碰撞率上有可测量的提升。
AI.conclusion: 意图条件化的世界模型辅助策略在安全关键、实时人机协作场景中有效；论文总结出部署学习型辅助体的关键设计经验与实践规范。

title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce StreamVibe-Bench, a new benchmark serving as testbed for user intent interaction, with 4.1K evaluation samples and 85K training samples spanning explicit, implicit, and dynamic intents. Building on this benchmark, we develop StreamVibe-VL, a streaming proactive model that infers implicit user intents from continuous observations and dynamically tailors its interactions as these intents evolve. We further introduce StreamVibe-Harness, which maintains user intents as persistent states with a fleixble lifecycles via a hierarchical memory to track the latest user intent and environmental state. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (i) StreamVibe-VL preserves strong general video understanding while improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over other baselines; (ii) existing proactive models remain limited in understanding user intent and deciding when to respond, especially under implicit and dynamic intents; and (iii) StreamVibe-Harness further improves response consistency and adaptation over sustained interaction, resulting in a 12.3% gain in proactive interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 StreamVibe-Bench（4.1K评测+85K训练样本，覆盖显式/隐式/动态用户意图）、流式主动模型 StreamVibe-VL 与分层记忆 Harness（StreamVibe-Harness），实现从连续观测推断隐式意图并动态调整交互。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型多依赖显式请求，无法捕捉隐式用户意图（如浏览网页时"下一步点哪"），也难以在意图持续变化时同步更新状态，难以用于意图感知的实用交互。
AI.method: 构建 StreamVibe-Bench 基准；训练流式主动模型 StreamVibe-VL，从连续观测推断隐式意图并随意图演化调整交互；提出 StreamVibe-Harness，用分层记忆将用户意图维护为具有灵活生命周期的持久状态，跟踪最新意图与环境状态。
AI.result: (i) StreamVibe-VL 在保持通用视频理解能力的同时，响应时机与回答质量较基线提升10.7%；(ii) 现有主动模型在隐式与动态意图下理解意图和判断何时响应仍然薄弱；(iii) Harness 在长时交互中提升响应一致性与适应性，主动交互整体增益12.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将用户意图建模为可持久化的流式状态并结合分层记忆，是提升在线主动交互能力的关键，但仍需更强的意图推理能力。

title: Video World Models Need Predictable Latents
comment: 54 pages, 25 figures, 14 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Video world models trained on large-scale robot data promise a safe and scalable approach for learning and evaluating policies that act in the physical world. However, they still struggle with long-horizon rollouts and out-of-distribution generalization, and they remain computationally demanding at inference time. Typically, video world models make predictions in the latent space of a reconstruction-trained autoencoder, which however is not directly optimized for dynamics modeling. On the other hand, world models designed for latent planning usually optimize latents to be predictable, but they forgo accurate prediction of observations in pixel space. In this paper, we show that it is possible to achieve the best of both worlds: a latent geometry optimized to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future observations. More precisely, we find that temporal objectives for representation learning, paired with a past-conditioned decoder architecture, lead to consistent improvements in generative video world models at the same training budget. The gains include up to 5x cheaper inference, over 7x faster training, and 15-24% lower pixel and perceptual errors out of distribution and over long horizons. Our world models also agree more closely with real-world policy evaluation when using a vision-language model to judge task success from their pixel-space predictions. Overall, our study indicates that temporal predictability is an important design criterion for the latent space of video world models, and provides concrete guidance on how to incorporate it into the training of autoencoders.

AI.tldr: 提出以"时间可预测性"为准则优化视频世界模型的潜空间：用时间预测目标训练自编码器，并配合过去条件化解码器，在同等预算下实现更快推理/训练与更低的长程与分布外像素误差。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型的潜空间来自重建训练的自编码器，并未针对动力学建模优化；而为潜空间规划设计的世界模型虽强调可预测性，却牺牲了像素级观测精度。作者希望兼顾两者。
AI.method: 在自编码器表征学习中引入时序目标（temporal objectives），使其潜几何便于未来预测，同时采用past-conditioned解码器架构，从而在保持观测重建精度的前提下提升可预测性。
AI.result: 同等训练预算下：推理开销最高降低5倍、训练加速超7倍，分布外与长程预测的像素误差与感知误差降低15–24%；用VLM基于像素预测判定任务成功时，与真实世界策略评估的一致性更好。
AI.conclusion: 时间可预测性是视频世界模型潜空间的重要设计准则，论文给出了将其融入自编码器训练的具体做法，可用于机器人策略的学习与安全评估。

title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
summary: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the \emph{Semantic Sensitivity Index} (SSI), which measures whether clearance and distance-dependent speed and smoothness follow the caution ordering of obstacles. Evaluating VLM-based and vision-language-action (VLA) policies on the benchmark, we find that neither consistently adapts its motion to obstacle safety, even with explicit safety prompts. Our analysis shows that the policies can correctly distinguish obstacles by safety relevance but fail to reflect this distinction in the motion parameters or actions they produce. For VLM-based policies, which recognize the obstacle and then generate a navigation program, adding an explicit parameter-inference step between these two stages improves adaptation. These findings expose a gap in \emph{semantic-to-motion grounding}, highlighting the need to translate semantic caution into appropriately safe motion.

AI.tldr: 提出 OSMA-Bench 基准（空间匹配、仅障碍物类型不同的场景对）与语义敏感度指数 SSI，评测 VLM/VLA 导航策略是否把障碍物语义安全等级映射为连续的间隙、速度与平滑度调节；结果显示策略能识别障碍但它"语义→运动"落地失败，插入显式参数推断步骤可改善。
AI.motivation: 现有具身导航评测只考察是否碰撞/成功率，不检验语义安全区分（"是什么障碍、有多近"）是否体现在连续运动参数（clearance、距离相关速度、平滑度）中，导致保守性无法被量化地被批评或优化。
AI.method: 构建 OSMA-Bench：成对（spatially matched）场景集，唯一变量为障碍物类型；提出 Semantic Sensitivity Index，按障碍物"警戒排序"检验间隙与距离相关速度/平滑度是否单调一致；在 VLM-based 与 VLA 策略上评测（含显式安全提示条件），并做"先识别—再显式参数推断—再生成导航程序"的中间步骤消融。
AI.result: VLM 与 VLA 策略均不能稳定按障碍物安全等级调整运动，即使给出显式安全提示；策略能正确区分障碍物的安全相关性，但该区分未体现在运动参数或动作上；对"识别→生成导航程序"的 VLM 策略，加入显式参数推断步骤可提升自适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了 semantic-to-motion grounding 缺口：语义层的"谨慎"需被显式翻译为运动层参数；基准与指标可作为后续方法设计的诊断工具，但论文偏评测与归纳，未给出通用可部署的解决方法。

title: Exploring perceptual straightness in learned visual representations
summary: Humans have been shown to use a "straightened" encoding to represent the natural visual world as it evolves in time (Hénaff et al. 2019). In the context of discrete video sequences, "straightened" means that changes between frames follow a more linear path in representation space at progressively deeper levels of processing. While deep convolutional networks are often proposed as models of human visual processing, many do not straighten natural videos. In this paper, we explore the relationship between network architecture, differing types of robustness, biologically-inspired filtering mechanisms, and representational straightness in response to time-varying input; we identify strengths and limitations of straightness as a useful way of evaluating neural network representations. We find that (1) adversarial training leads to straighter representations in both CNN and transformer-based architectures but (2) this effect is task-dependent, not generalizing to tasks such as segmentation and frame-prediction, where straight representations are not favorable for predictions; and nor to other types of robustness. In addition, (3) straighter representations impart temporal stability to class predictions, even for out-of-distribution data. Finally, (4) biologically-inspired elements increase straightness in the early stages of a network, but do not guarantee increased straightness in downstream layers of CNNs. We show that straightness is an easily computed measure of representational robustness and stability, as well as a hallmark of human representations with benefits for computer vision models.

AI.tldr: 分析视觉表征在时间变化下的"直线化"(straightened)特性，考察网络架构、鲁棒性类型与生物启发滤波对直线化的影响。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉对自然视频采用"直线化"编码，而多数深度卷积网络无法复现该特性；作者希望厘清架构、鲁棒性与生物启发机制与表征直线性的关系，并评估直线性作为表征评价指标的价值与局限。
AI.method: 在CNN与Transformer架构上测量视频帧特征在逐层表征空间中的轨迹弯曲度（straightness），对比对抗训练、其他鲁棒性训练、分割与帧预测等任务，以及生物启发前端滤波（如视网膜/初级视皮层式滤波）的影响。
AI.result: 对抗训练使CNN与Transformer表征更直线，但该效应任务相关，不推广到分割与帧预测任务，也不推广到其他鲁棒性类型；更直线的表征带来类别预测的时间稳定性（含OOD数据）；生物启发元件提升早期层直线性，但不保证深层直线性提升。
AI.conclusion: 直线性是一种易计算的表征鲁棒性与稳定性度量，可作为人类视觉表征的标志性特征，并对计算机视觉模型有潜在益处，但其作为评估指标存在任务依赖的局限。

title: Good Rankings, Poor Choices? Rethinking Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection
summary: Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection (LOVM) aims to identify the Vision-Language Model (VLM) with the highest zero-shot accuracy on a target task using only textual information. We revisit the existing LOVM evaluation protocol and argue that ranking metrics, such as top-5 recall and Kendall's rank correlation, do not directly assess the performance of the selected model. We therefore adopt simple regret (SR), defined as the performance gap between the best and selected models, and introduce Outlier-Robust Normalized Regret (ORNR) to account for the varying performance ranges across tasks while reducing sensitivity to outliers. Building on this revised evaluation protocol, we propose Target-Conditioned Expected Source Regret (TC-ESR), a training-free method that selects the model with the lowest similarity-weighted mean regret across source tasks. Across 22 target tasks and 43 VLMs, TC-ESR achieves the lowest mean SR and ORNR among all compared methods. Separately, we identify two sources of target performance leakage in the prior ranking-based evaluation protocol and provide corrections that remove both.

AI.tldr: 针对"语言驱动VLM选择"(LOVM)，指出基于排序指标(如top-5 recall、Kendall τ)的评估不能直接衡量所选模型性能，改用简单遗憾(SR)并引入异常鲁棒归一化遗憾(ORNR)；提出免训练的TC-ESR方法，按源任务相似度加权平均遗憾选模型，在22个目标任务、43个VLM上取得最低SR/ORNR，并修正了旧协议中的两处目标性能泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有LOVM评估用排序指标衡量"模型排序质量"，而非"被选中模型的实际表现"，且不同任务性能跨度差异大、存在异常值，导致结论与真实使用效果脱节；同时旧协议存在目标性能泄漏。
AI.method: 1) 将评估指标改为简单遗憾SR=最优模型与所选模型性能差；2) 提出ORNR：按任务性能范围归一化并降低异常值敏感性；3) 提出免训练TC-ESR：在源任务上以与目标任务的相似度为权重，计算各候选模型的加权平均遗憾并选最小者；4) 识别并修正两处目标性能泄漏。
AI.result: 在22个目标任务与43个VLM上，TC-ESR在SR与ORNR上均为所有对比方法中最低；修正后的协议消除了两处泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应以决策后果(遗憾)而非排序相关性来评估；免训练的相似度加权遗憾准则是一种简单有效的LOVM基线，并提醒后续工作注意协议泄漏问题。

title: From Speech Tokens to Stolen Voices: Attacker-Chosen-Text Speaker Impersonation via Representation Inversion
summary: Speech interaction systems have gradually evolved from traditional cascaded systems that use text as intermediate information to end-to-end speech language models that directly process speech representations. In some applications, the speech frontend runs on the user's device and sends speech representations to a remote server for inference, while the original audio remains local. However, these representations may still contain speaker identity information. If an attacker obtains them, it may use this information to imitate the user's voice, threatening their voice privacy. To investigate this risk, we propose \stia, a Speech Token Inversion Attack that generates speech with attacker-specified text in a victim's voice using a single short leaked representation, without access to the original audio or its transcript. Specifically, \stia converts discrete, continuous, or mixed speech representations into conditioning sequences and trains a conditional flow-matching speech generation model using pairs of different utterances from the same speaker in public speech datasets. The model combines speaker characteristics contained in the leaked representation with the specified text to generate speech in the victim's voice. Experiments show that, with a Moshi representation leak corresponding to 3 seconds of speech, \stia achieves an average CAM++ speaker cosine similarity of 0.78 and a target-text word error rate of 3.80\%. These results show that speech frontend representations reveal reusable speaker identity information and highlight the need to consider privacy risks when designing speech frontend representation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出STIA（语音Token反演攻击），将离散/连续/混合语音前端表征转为条件序列，用条件流匹配生成模型结合窃取的说话人特征与攻击者指定文本，合成受害者音色的语音。
AI.motivation: 端到端语音大模型场景下，前端在用户设备运行、仅上传语音表征至远端服务器，原音频本地保留。但这些表征仍可能泄露说话人身份信息，被攻击者利用进行声音克隆，威胁语音隐私。需量化验证该风险。
AI.method: STIA仅依赖一段短小的泄露表征，无需原始音频与转写文本。将离散、连续或混合语音表征转换为条件序列，在公开语音数据集中以同一说话人的不同语句成对训练条件流匹配（flow-matching）语音生成模型，把泄露表征中的说话人特征与指定文本融合，生成受害者音色、攻击者指定内容的语音。
AI.result: 在Moshi表征泄露仅对应3秒语音的条件下，获得平均CAM++说话人余弦相似度0.78，目标文本词错误率3.80%。
AI.conclusion: 语音前端表征确实携带可复用的说话人身份信息，语音隐私风险不可忽视；在设计语音前端表征方法时需将此类反演/克隆攻击纳入威胁模型。

title: RSKD: Grounding Semantic Consistency in Driving VLMs via Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer large multimodal models to compact models for autonomous driving, but uniform token-level matching can dilute planning-relevant semantics and amplify teacher errors. We propose RSKD, a semantic-consistency-guided distillation framework that routes supervision according to both the task importance of an answer phrase and its semantic consistency with the teacher prediction. Task-critical semantic phrases are localized in the ground-truth answer, and a phrase-level consistency score controls the balance between Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) distillation and ground-truth supervision. Teacher information is emphasized only where it is semantically consistent, while semantically inconsistent phrases receive stronger ground-truth supervision. We evaluate RSKD on DrivingVQA, LingoQA, and MapLMv2. RSKD improves over the compared student-based baselines on DrivingVQA and LingoQA and remains competitive on MapLMv2.

AI.tldr: RSKD：按"任务重要性 + 与教师预测的语义一致性"路由监督的多模态驾驶模型蒸馏框架，一致性高处用 JSD 蒸馏教师，不一致处加强 GT 监督。
AI.motivation: 将大型多模态模型蒸馏到紧凑驾驶模型时，逐 token 均匀匹配会稀释与规划相关的语义，并把教师错误一并传授给学生；需要对监督信号做语义级筛选。
AI.method: 首先在 GT 答案中定位任务关键语义短语；计算短语级语义一致性分数，作为 JSD 蒸馏损失与 GT 监督之间的门控权重，仅在语义一致处强调教师信息，不一致短语则增强 GT 监督。
AI.result: 在 DrivingVQA、LingoQA 上优于学生基线，在 MapLMv2 上保持竞争力；未报告闭环规划或真车部署验证。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏、语义感知的知识路由优于逐 token 均匀蒸馏，可作为驾驶 VQA 场景下大模型压缩的轻量方案；但仅为离线 VQA 指标提升，缺乏对规划/控制下游的实际影响证据。

title: Resource-Performance Trade-offs in Intra-Aisle Robotic Picking: A Discrete-Event Simulation Comparison of Shuttle Configurations With and Without an Onboard Tote Lift
summary: This study compares two implemented intra-aisle robotic-picking configurations through discrete-event simulation. Without an onboard tote lift, two level-captive shuttles serve the two tested levels; with the lift, one shuttle remains on its horizontal level and its onboard mechanism moves the order tote to allow picks from the adjacent upper level. Thirty configuration-task-size experiments (n = 1-15 locations; ten replications each) yield 300 replication-level cycle-time observations. Two-sided Welch tests are applied to the replication means, with Holm adjustment across the 15 comparisons. The onboard-tote-lift configuration has longer mean cycle time at all tested task sizes. At n = 15, the means are 299.477 and 333.231 s/cycle, respectively: a 33.753 s increase (11.27%). The corresponding cycle-time-derived item rates are 180.314 and 162.050 items/h (-10.13%). These rates are calculated as 3600n divided by the scenario-mean cycle time; they are not measurements of the combined concurrent capacity of two level-captive shuttles. Importantly, task locations are sampled from different eligible-level sets in the two configurations, so the result concerns the implemented configuration-and-task-generation packages, not the isolated effect of a five-second tote-lift operation under identical picked locations. The study quantifies a cycle-performance difference alongside a reduction from two dedicated shuttles to one within the tested two-level block; it does not quantify system-level maximum throughput, investment cost, or reliability.

AI.tldr: 基于离散事件仿真对比两种仓内机器人拣选配置（无车载周转箱升降的两台层驻留穿梭车 vs. 带车载升降的单穿梭车双层服务），经30组配置-任务规模实验（n=1–15，每组10次重复）得到300个周期时间观测，并用Holm校正的双侧Welch检验分析。
AI.motivation: 仓储拣选中，若能以单台车载升降穿梭车服务两层货位，可减少穿梭车数量；但这一配置在周期时间上是否具有优势尚缺乏量化对比。
AI.method: 离散事件仿真建模两种实现配置；30组实验设计（配置×任务规模n=1–15，每组10次重复）；对重复级均值做双侧Welch t检验，并在15次比较上做Holm多重校正。
AI.result: 带车载升降配置在所有任务规模下平均周期时间更长；n=15时分别为299.477与333.231 s/cycle，增加33.753 s（+11.27%）；由周期时间折算的物品率为180.314与162.050 items/h（−10.13%）。注：该比率为3600n除以场景均值周期，并非两台层驻留车并行容量之和的测量。
AI.conclusion: 研究量化了两种已实现配置包（配置+任务生成）间的周期性能差异，同时体现从两台专用车降至一台的变化；但在两配置中任务货位采样自不同合法层集合，故结论不构成相同拣选位置下5秒升降操作本身的隔离效应；未涉及系统级最大吞吐、投资成本与可靠性。

title: VLA-HWBench: Where the Time Goes When VLA Models Run on Edge Hardware
summary: Vision--language--action (VLA) models increasingly run on edge devices aboard robots, where inference latency constrains closed-loop robot control. However, it remains unclear how to design VLA models, their inference software and edge hardware so that robots can run VLA inference in real time. Most VLA models report only task success, while prior studies cover limited action-generation strategies, divide inference into at most three stages, and lack comparisons of inference optimizations on the same this http URL 18 open VLA models across released and alternative backends on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395, with a seven-stage inference breakdown. Our study reveals three insights. First, action-generation strategy matters more than model size. It dominates 14 of 19 Jetson configurations, latency varies by $82\times$ on Jetson and $157\times$ on AMD, and parameter count explains at most 15% of latency variance. Models that generate long action chunks in a few flow-matching steps keep up with control, whereas token-by-token decoding does not. Second, kernel fusion with 4-bit weights helps most, running $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7 2.6--2.9$\times$ faster than PyTorch with \texttt{ this http URL }, but it exists for only these two models and only on the Jetson. Optimization also moves the time to the stages it shortens least, as CPU preprocessing grows from 12\% to 39\% of the GR00T N1.7 call. Third, after optimization, memory bandwidth limits only the stages that process few tokens on the Jetson, such as the denoising steps, whereas software limits all other stages, from unfused kernels to serial preprocessing on the host CPU. Overall, low-latency edge VLAs should use few action-generation iterations, inference software should extend kernel fusion and low-bit weights to more models and platforms, and edge hardware needs high memory bandwidth and a fast host CPU.

AI.tldr: 该文对18个开源VLA模型在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor与AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上进行七阶段推理剖析，发现动作生成策略比模型规模更重要，内核融合+4-bit量化带来2.6–2.9×加速，优化后瓶颈转移至CPU预处理与内存带宽。
AI.motivation: VLA模型正部署到机器人边缘设备，推理延迟制约闭环控制，但如何协同设计VLA模型、推理软件与边缘硬件以实现实时推理尚不明确；已有工作只报告任务成功率、覆盖的动作生成策略有限、阶段划分过粗（≤3段），且缺乏同平台下的优化对比。
AI.method: 构建统一的推理延迟基准：18个开源VLA模型 × 已发布与替代后端 × 两类边缘平台，采用七阶段推理分解（预处理、视觉编码、去噪/解码等）；对比不同动作生成策略（长动作块＋少步flow matching vs. 逐token解码）与推理优化（内核融合、4-bit权重、torch.compile等），并用方差分析量化参数量对延迟的解释比例。
AI.result: 动作生成策略主导延迟：19个Jetson配置中14个由其决定，Jetson延迟跨度82×、AMD达157×，参数量最多仅解释15%延迟方差；长动作块少步生成可跟上控制频率。内核融合+4-bit权重使π0.5与GR00T N1.7较PyTorch快2.6–2.9×，但仅覆盖这两个模型且仅限Jetson；优化后CPU预处理占比由12%升至39%。优化后，Jetson上仅少token阶段（如去噪步）受内存带宽限制，其余阶段受软件实现制约。
AI.conclusion: 低延迟边缘VLA应采用少迭代次数（长动作块）的动作生成；推理软件需将内核融合与低比特权重量化推广到更多模型与平台；边缘硬件需高内存带宽与快速主机CPU。

title: FGD2HF: Frequency-guided Dual-domain Hypergraph Fusion for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Frequency-domain information is beneficial for semantic segmentation. However, existing frequency-based methods often suffer from insufficient frequency utilization, inefficient fusion, and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose FGD2HF, a dual-domain fusion network that leverages frequency features to guide spatial-domain fusion and enhancement. Specifically, we introduce a novel Hybrid-Attention Encoder (NAHA) that jointly models local and global relationships through neighborhood and hypergraph attention, enhancing the network's ability to extract effective features. We further introduce a Wavelet Transform and Enhancement (WTE) module to extract and refine low- and high-frequency cues from preceding-stage features, followed by Frequency-guided Dual-domain Fusion (FGDF) modules that use frequency cues to condition current-stage spatial grouping and feature propagation. This design incorporates both global and local frequency guidance into spatial feature modulation, enhancement and fusion with low computational cost. Extensive comparisons with numerous state-of-the-art semantic segmentation methods demonstrate that our method is highly competitive. Our full FGD2HF-B model achieves 48.7% mIoU on ADE20K (+0.3% over SegMAN-B with 18% fewer GFLOPs), 83.2% mIoU on Cityscapes (comparable to SegMAN-B with 21% fewer GFLOPs), and 1.1% higher mIoU than VWFormer-T on SBD with 21% fewer GFLOPs, while also achieving significant improvements in boundary segmentation accuracy.

AI.tldr: FGD2HF：以频域特征引导空间域融合的双域语义分割网络，含邻域+超图注意编码器(NAHA)、小波变换增强模块(WTE)与频率引导双域融合模块(FGDF)。
AI.motivation: 现有基于频域的分割方法存在频域信息利用不充分、融合效率低、计算复杂度高的问题，需要一种低代价、强引导性的频-空融合范式。
AI.method: 提出NAHA编码器联合建模局部(邻域注意力)与全局(超图注意力)关系；(2) WTE模块用离散小波变换从上一阶段特征中提取并精炼低频/高频线索；(3) FGDF模块用频率线索条件化当前阶段的空间分组与特征传播，实现全局+局部频率引导的空间调制、增强与融合。
AI.result: ADE20K 48.7% mIoU（较SegMAN-B +0.3%，GFLOPs 少18%）；Cityscapes 83.2% mIoU（与SegMAN-B相当，GFLOPs 少21%）；SBD 较VWFormer-T +1.1% mIoU（GFLOPs 少21%），边界分割精度显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 频率引导的双域融合可在更低算力下取得有竞争力甚至更优的分割精度，尤其改善边界区域，验证了频域线索对空间特征调制的高性价比。

title: Networked Humanoid Intelligence: Communication, Coordination, Collaboration, and Social Interaction
summary: Humanoid robots are moving from laboratory platforms toward connected fleets that share workspaces, infrastructure, tasks, and knowledge with other robots and humans. As deployments grow, the operation and improvement of each humanoid depend on information exchanged across the network. However, existing research has largely studied humanoids as individual systems. This survey examines networked humanoid intelligence through four functions of information exchange: communication, coordination, collaboration, and social intelligence with human interaction. We first establish the foundations of networked humanoid systems, define the question addressed by each function, and connect them through a common factory scenario. We review the literature along six dimensions: interaction architecture, exchanged information, physical coupling, operating timescale, system scale, and embodiment. We separate results obtained with physical and simulated humanoids from those based on other robotic platforms or disembodied agents, because the latter do not fully capture humanoid-specific constraints such as balance, whole-body motion, contact, and physical interaction. We examine hardware, datasets, and benchmarks, and distinguish risks handled locally from those networking introduces, such as stale information or unsafe knowledge propagation. Finally, we identify open problems in control-aware networking, compact body-centric messages, physically grounded coordination, network- and embodiment-aware knowledge sharing, fleet-level social consistency, and accountable human oversight.

AI.tldr: 该综述以信息交换的四种功能（通信、协调、协作、人机社交智能）为框架，系统梳理"联网人形机器人智能"，沿交互架构、交换信息、物理耦合、时间尺度、系统规模、具身形态六维归纳文献，并厘清仿真/物理人形与其他平台/无身智能体结果的适用边界，最后给出控制感知网络、紧凑体中心消息、物理落地协调、网络与具身感知知识共享等开放问题。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人正从单机实验平台走向共享工作空间、基础设施、任务与知识的联网集群，其运行与迭代依赖网络内信息交换；而现有人形研究多把机器人当作孤立系统处理，缺少对"联网人形智能"的系统性梳理与风险分析。
AI.method: 综述性工作：先建立联网人形系统基础，定义四项功能各自回答的问题并用统一工厂场景串联；按六维度（交互架构、交换信息、物理耦合、运行时间尺度、系统规模、具身形态）组织文献；严格区分物理/仿真人形与其它机器人平台、无身智能体的结论；梳理硬件、数据集与基准，并区分本地风险与联网新引入风险（陈旧信息、不安全知识传播等）。
AI.result: 给出联网人形智能的六维分类与文献图谱，明确哪些结论可迁移至人形、哪些因忽略平衡、全身运动、接触与物理交互等约束而不可迁移；整理相关硬件、数据集与基准；归纳本地风险与联网风险两层风险清单，并提出六个开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 联网人形智能是有价值但尚未成熟的研究方向，需在控制感知网络、体中心紧凑消息、物理落地协调、网络与具身感知的知识共享、集群级社交一致性及可问责人类监督等方面建立方法体系；该文属框架与议程型综述，不提供可直接落地的算法或实验证据。

title: From Sentinel-2 to 1-m Imagery: Real-World $\times 10$ Cross-Sensor Super-Resolution via Visual Autoregressive Modeling
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Reconstructing 1-m imagery from Sentinel-2 combines two difficulties. The input and the reference are observed by different satellites, which differ in spatial resolution, spectral response, radiometry, acquisition time, and local geometry, so no synthetic degradation operator links them. The required magnification of ten in each spatial dimension also far exceeds the factors of two to four at which remote sensing super-resolution is usually developed. We study this real-world $\times 10$ problem using YREB-SR, which pairs 2022 Sentinel-2 RGB composites with 2022 Jilin-1 RGB references resampled to a 1-m grid over the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The benchmark contains 11,559 geographically matched scene pairs, with 6,409, 2,135, and 3,015 assigned to training, validation, and testing, respectively.
