We develop CrossVAR, a visual autoregressive model that predicts the 1-m latent as a nine-scale hierarchy conditioned on the Sentinel-2 input and estimates the remaining quantization residual with a diffusion refiner run without injected noise. Complete 1600 $\times$ 1600 scenes are reconstructed in overlapping windows that start on the Sentinel-2 pixel grid, as every training patch does, and every window is decoded at the size on which the decoder was trained before the windows are blended with Gaussian weights. On all 3,015 test scenes, CrossVAR achieves 27.60 dB PSNR, 0.7725 SSIM, 0.1451 LPIPS, and 7.15 FID, the best value of each metric among the compared methods. These results establish a strong autoregressive baseline for large-scale cross-sensor reconstruction. To facilitate reproducibility, the source code and implementation are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 YREB-SR 基准（2022 年 Sentinel-2 RGB 与吉林一号 1 m RGB 配对，11,559 个地理配准场景对）研究真实跨传感器 ×10 超分问题，并给出 CrossVAR：以 Sentinel-2 为条件、按九尺度层级预测 1 m 潜变量的视觉自回归模型，配合无噪声注入的扩散精修器估计量化残差；在 3,015 个测试场景上取得 PSNR 27.60 dB、SSIM 0.7725、LPIPS 0.1451、FID 7.15，各项指标均最优。
AI.motivation: 已有遥感超分多在合成退化算子、×2–×4 倍率下开展；而真实场景中输入与参考来自不同卫星，分辨率、光谱响应、辐射定标、成像时间与局部几何均不一致，不存在可解析的退化算子，且 ×10 倍率远超常规设定，因此需要真实数据下的基准与更强方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建 YREB-SR：跨卫星、跨传感器、真实 ×10 配准数据集（6409/2135/3015 划分）；2) CrossVAR：视觉自回归模型在 Sentinel-2 条件先验下逐尺度预测 1 m 潜表示，构成九层金字塔；3) 扩散精修器以无注入噪声方式估计量化残差；4) 全幅 1600×1600 推理采用以 Sentinel-2 像素网格为起点（与训练 patch 对齐）的重叠窗口，每窗在解码器训练尺寸下解码后以高斯权重融合。
AI.result: 在全部 3,015 个测试场景上，CrossVAR 达到 PSNR 27.60 dB、SSIM 0.7725、LPIPS 0.1451、FID 7.15，四项指标均为对比方法中最优；证实无需显式退化算子的跨传感器自回归重建路线可行，代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将遥感超分从实验室合成退化设定推进到真实跨卫星 ×10 重建，提供了公开基准、可复现的窗口化推理协议与强自回归基线，但本质属遥感图像生成/复原任务，未涉及实体智能体的感知-决策闭环。

title: SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments
summary: Visual captures provide detailed scene appearance, but converting them into interactive simulation environments requires object reconstruction, physical modeling, and correction of intermediate errors. We present SceneAgent, an agentic pipeline that coordinates these steps through simulator-based visual inspection and repair. The pipeline processes 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), photogrammetry, LiDAR captures, AI-generated 3DGS scenes, and 4D videos of dynamic scenes, and combines object segmentation, physical parameter estimation, part decomposition, articulation, and deformable simulation. To support policy learning, SceneAgent generates diverse object variants ("digital sisters") and scripted demonstrations. On a cluttered bin scene from GraspClutter6D, SceneAgent raises F1 at 1 cm for every coding agent with scorable outputs both with and without its skills, and its reconstructions are better than SimFoundry: all agent configurations exceed SimFoundry's F1 score, with a best of 60.75% versus 6.9%. On three dynamic scenes from 4DCodeBench, SceneAgent raises the mean dynamic IoU of Gemini 4 Argon from 0.86% to 99.09%. We further demonstrate diverse simulated interactions and preliminary policy transfer to a real robot.

AI.tldr: SceneAgent：基于仿真器视觉检查与修复的智能体流水线，将3DGS/摄影测量/LiDAR/AI生成3DGS/4D视频转化为可交互仿真场景（分割、物理参数估计、部件分解、关节化、可变形仿真），并生成"数字姐妹"变体与脚本演示用于策略学习。
AI.motivation: 视觉捕捉只提供外观，转为可交互仿真器需对象重建、物理建模与中间误差修正，人工流程繁琐且易出错；希望用智能体自动组织这些步骤并闭环纠错，以支撑策略学习。
AI.method: Agent 驱动的多步流水线：以仿真器渲染结果做视觉检查，迭代发现并修复重建/物理/分部件错误；统一处理3DGS、摄影测量、LiDAR、AI生成3DGS与动态4D视频输入；含分割、物理参数估计、部件分解、关节建模、可变形仿真；并生成物体变体与脚本化演示数据。
AI.result: GraspClutter6D 杂乱箱场景：对每个有可评分输出的编码智能体，加入技能前后 F1@1cm 均提升；所有配置均超过 SimFoundry，最好 60.75% vs 6.9%。4DCodeBench 三个动态场景：Gemini 4 Argon 平均动态 IoU 由 0.86% 提升至 99.09%。另展示多种模拟交互与初步真机策略迁移。
AI.conclusion: 仿真器在环的智能体式视觉检查—修复可显著提升物体/动态场景重建与物理可用性，并产出可用的策略学习数据；作者称其为通用式智能体重建框架（属本文主张，非第三方验证）。

title: Efficient Multi-modal Video Fusion Network with Dynamic Region-Guided Temporal Interaction
summary: Multi-modal video fusion aims to generate temporally coherent videos with salient targets and rich structural details by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous sensors. However, existing video fusion methods commonly rely on optical flow estimation and feature warping for inter-frame alignment and cross-frame information aggregation to maintain temporal consistency, thereby introducing considerable computational overhead and making the fusion performance vulnerable to flow estimation errors. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an efficient multi-modal video fusion network with dynamic region-guided temporal interaction. Specifically, the proposed spatio-temporal interaction module leverages the Test-Time Training paradigm to model temporal dependencies with linear complexity. Building on this design, the module restricts temporal modeling to key dynamic regions in the video sequence, as static background regions provide limited temporal cues. By excluding low-variation tokens from unnecessary temporal interaction, this selective strategy contributes to improved fusion quality and temporal consistency. In addition, leveraging the strong ability of pretrained MAE features to capture global structural dependencies, we introduce a feature-level temporal consistency constraint to suppress local flickering by aligning the inter-frame variation directions of the fused and source videos. We further propose a new MAE-based temporal metric that quantifies directional distance between their temporal variations within dynamic regions. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with existing state-of-the-art methods, our method achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency on multiple benchmark datasets, while exhibiting high computational efficiency under edge-device deployment settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效多模态视频融合网络，用测试时训练（TTT）实现线性复杂度的时序交互，并仅在动态区域做时序建模；引入MAE特征级时序一致性约束与新的时序评价指标。
AI.motivation: 现有红外-可见光等多模态视频融合依赖光流估计与特征warping做帧间对齐与跨帧聚合，计算开销大且对光流误差敏感。
AI.method: 1) 时空交互模块基于Test-Time Training范式，以线性复杂度建模时序依赖；2) 动态区域引导：仅对关键动态区域做时序交互，剔除低变化token；3) 利用预训练MAE特征的全局结构建模能力，提出特征级时序一致性约束，对齐融合视频与源视频的帧间变化方向以抑制局部闪烁；4) 提出基于MAE的时序指标，量化动态区域内的方向距离。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，融合质量与时序一致性均优于现有SOTA，且在边缘设备部署下具有较高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 无需光流与warping的动态区域引导TTT时序交互可高效实现高质量多模态视频融合，为时序一致性提供了新约束与新指标。

title: Factorized Gradients for Scalable Highly-expressive Parametric Diffeomorphisms
summary: Diffeomorphisms provide a flexible, topology-preserving mathematical tool for modeling complex spatial or temporal deformations and are used in various scientific fields. However, making these deformations simultaneously highly expressive and computationally efficient remains challenging. Continuous Piecewise-Affine Based (CPAB) transformations (Freifeld et al., ICCV 2015; IEEE TPAMI 2017) offer an attractive solution by parameterizing a family of diffeomorphisms via continuous velocity fields that are piecewise affine with respect to a chosen tessellation of the domain. Importantly, $d=\dim(\theta)$, the dimension of the parameter vector $\theta$, depends on the fineness of the tessellation rather than on the data resolution. Despite this compact parameterization, CPAB optimization has long been hindered by the tight coupling between trajectory integration and gradient computation with respect to $\theta$. We introduce FG-CPAB, a factorized-gradient formulation for scalable CPAB transformations. By separating integration from parameter-space projection, our method reduces gradient computation complexity from $\mathcal{O}(dTN)$ to $\mathcal{O}(TN+dC)$, where $T$ is the number of integration steps, $N$ is the number of transformed points, and $C$ is the number of tessellation cells. This reformulation yields speedups of up to four orders of magnitude (e.g., $\approx 10^4\times$ in 2D), substantial memory savings (e.g., $\approx 500\times$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage in 2D), and dramatically higher expressiveness. This makes fine-tessellation CPAB practical in 2D and 3D for the first time, enabling highly expressive parametric diffeomorphisms.

AI.tldr: 提出FG-CPAB，将CPAB微分同胚变换的轨迹积分与参数空间投影解耦，把梯度计算复杂度从O(dTN)降到O(TN+dC)，实现最高约10^4倍加速、约500倍显存下降，使细网格CPAB在2D/3D首次实用化。
AI.motivation: CPAB以分片仿射连续速度场参数化微分同胚族，参数维度d仅取决于网格细度而非数据分辨率，具备紧凑参数化优势；但长期以来轨迹积分与对θ的梯度计算紧耦合，导致计算与内存开销随网格细化爆炸，限制了表达力与可扩展性。
AI.method: 因子化梯度（factorized-gradient）重构：将轨迹积分（与θ无关的数值积分过程）与参数空间投影分离，先计算与积分步数T、点数N相关的中间量，再通过网格单元（C个）上的稀疏投影映射回d维参数空间，从而避免对每个点-每步-每参数的三重求和。
AI.result: 梯度复杂度由O(dTN)降至O(TN+dC)；2D中约10^4倍加速、峰值GPU显存约500倍降低，整体可达四个数量级加速，并显著提升模型表达力。
AI.conclusion: FG-CPAB使细网格CPAB在2D与3D中首次变得实用，为高表达力、低开销的可微参数化微分同胚提供了可扩展方案，可用于形变建模、配准与可微几何等下游任务。

title: ToDoPro: Faster and Better Reference-Based Generation: Early Token Reduction via Downsampled Self-Probing
summary: Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro). By executing a few denoising steps on spatially $2\times$ downsampled reference images, this cheap probing stage utilizes the DiT model itself to effectively and efficiently extract reference token importance. Using the probed importance, we apply a hierarchical reduction before the main denoising stage: we completely discard low-importance tokens, substitute mid-importance tokens with their downsampled counterparts to cheaply preserve global context, and keep high-importance tokens. Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks demonstrate that our early reduction accelerates inference significantly and mitigates peak GPU memory. Furthermore, we can improve generation quality by safely filtering out noisy, uninformative reference tokens, enabling the model to concentrate its limited attention capacity on genuinely useful tokens. The code will be released at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 ToDoPro：对参考图做 2× 下采样后跑少量去噪步，用 DiT 自身探测参考 token 重要性，在主去噪前做分层 token 裁剪（丢弃低重要性、下采样替换中等重要性、保留高重要性），无需额外参数即可加速并降低峰值显存。
AI.motivation: 多条件参考图生成模型把所有参考图与文本 token 拼成联合序列送入单一 DiT，多参考导致 token 爆炸，复杂度达 O(N²)；现有 DiT 内部加速方法难减空间冗余与峰值显存，而模型外的 token 削减方案又需引入外部模型、破坏与内部技术的兼容性。
AI.method: Early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro)：用模型自身在 2× 下采样参考图上执行少量去噪步，低成本探测参考 token 重要性；依据重要性在主去噪前做三级分层归约——低重要性 token 直接丢弃、中重要性 token 用其下采样版本替换以保留全局上下文、高重要性 token 保留。
AI.result: 在三个基础模型、两个基准上验证：推理显著加速并降低峰值 GPU 显存；此外通过过滤噪声性、无信息参考 token，使模型注意力集中于有效 token，从而在部分情况下提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外参数、与 DiT 内部加速技术互补的参考 token 早期归约方案可行，同时兼顾效率、显存与生成质量。

title: Natural Jammers: When Non-Robust Features Become Antagonistic
summary: Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remains approximately stable and is redistributed rather than eliminated under such transformations. Our results reframe natural non-robustness as a failure field over the empirical model-data geometry: one that redistributes rather than disappears under small transformations.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示标准DNN依赖的"非鲁棒特征"不仅是被动捷径，还可能作为"自然干扰器"主动误导干净图像上的预测；提出"频谱-空间锁定"机制与"替代悖论"。
AI.motivation: 既有工作把非鲁棒特征视为在干净数据上帮助标准模型的投机性捷径，忽略其可能主动误导模型的对抗性一面。
AI.method: 以标准模型与鲁棒模型的分歧为分析透镜，构建Jammer Set；通过频谱滤波与几何平移做因果干预实验，验证高频成分与特定空间结构的精确对齐（Spectral-spatial Locking）。
AI.result: 发现鲁棒模型在Jammed Set上优于标准模型；破坏锁定可恢复正确预测；单点干扰对几何平移脆弱，但整体干扰普遍度近似稳定并在变换下重新分布（Substitution Paradox）。
AI.conclusion: 自然非鲁棒性应被重新理解为经验模型-数据几何上的"失效场"，在小变换下重新分布而非消失。

title: ISB-NMPC: Interception-Oriented Spherical-Bearing Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Quadrotors
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, and 1 table. Submitted to IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Quadrotor interceptors equipped with strapdown cameras offer a low-cost solution for physically countering unauthorized UAVs. However, this configuration inherently couples vehicle maneuvering and camera pointing, creating a conflict between rapid closing and maintaining target visibility. We present interception-oriented spherical-bearing nonlinear model predictive control (ISB-NMPC), which couples spherical-bearing prediction with nonlinear quadrotor dynamics to jointly optimize target-directed closing motion and visibility. An attitude-compensated extended Kalman filter on S^2 estimates target bearing motion, compensates for perception delay, and predicts target bearings to guide scale-adaptive detection. Across 30 paired simulation trials, ISB-NMPC achieves an interception success rate of 86.7%, the highest among the evaluated controllers, with a mean per-trial target-visible time of 99.11%. Outdoor flights demonstrate acquisition of a 30 cm target at approximately 150 m, with interceptor speed reaching 17 m/s in the long-range flight and approximately 14 m/s while pursuing a quadrotor-towed maneuvering target. The software and hardware are open source at this https URL and this https URL , respectively.

AI.tldr: ISB-NMPC：将S²球面方位预测与四旋翼非线性动力学耦合的模型预测控制，联合优化撞击式接近运动与目标可见性，配以姿态补偿EKF与尺度自适应检测。
AI.motivation: strapdown相机四旋翼拦截器的机体机动与相机指向强耦合，快速接近与保持目标可见存在本质冲突，缺乏同时兼顾二者的控制方法。
AI.method: 以球面方位（S²）为状态表示：姿态补偿扩展卡尔曼滤波在S²流形上估计目标方位运动、补偿感知延迟并预测方位以驱动尺度自适应检测；将方位预测与非线性四旋翼动力学联合嵌入NMPC，同时优化撞击接近与可见性约束。
AI.result: 30组配对仿真中拦截成功率86.7%（对比控制器最高），单次试验平均目标可见时间占比99.11%；户外实飞在约150 m处捕获30 cm目标，远程飞行速度达17 m/s，追踪四旋翼拖曳机动目标时约14 m/s；软硬件开源。
AI.conclusion: 球面方位预测+非线性MPC的可控框架有效缓解敏捷拦截中的视场-机动冲突，具备感知延迟鲁棒性与实飞可行性，适用于低成本strapdown视觉拦截系统。

title: Towards Spatio-Temporal Intelligence Systems in Urban Space: A Twin-Agent Perspective
comment: A review of urban digital twins and urban agent systems
summary: Cities must coordinate domains like infrastructure, mobility, environmental management, emergency response, and public services as conditions evolve. An urban Spatio-Temporal Intelligence (STI) system helps the city monitor citywide states, analyze problems, plan and execute interventions, and adapt through feedback, making urban governance more timely, effective, and transparent. Recent urban twinning and agentic AI techniques provide foundations for such systems. From a twin-agent perspective, this survey takes a system-level view of how these disparate techniques can be coherently integrated into an urban STI system. Specifically, we review how the twin reconstructs and represents a persistent, information-enriched urban environment, and how the agent understands the twin via interfaces, reasons over it, acts reliably, and continuously evolves with the city. Built upon this synthesis, we summarize a two-loop blueprint, where an inner agent loop for grounding, reasoning, and verification, and an outer system loop linking data, twin, agentic action, feedback, and update. We then use this to structure an STI research agenda and show how a shared prototype supports diverse urban domains.

AI.tldr: 该综述从"孪生体—智能体"视角系统梳理城市时空智能（STI）系统的集成方法，提出内层智能体环路（感知落地、推理、验证）与外层系统环路（数据、孪生、智能体行动、反馈、更新）的双环蓝图，并据此构建研究议程与跨领域共享原型。
AI.motivation: 城市需协调基础设施、出行、环境、应急与公共服务等多领域，条件动态变化，亟需更及时、有效、透明的治理手段。数字孪生与智能体AI虽有进展，但缺乏系统级视角说明二者如何连贯整合为可闭环运行的城市时空智能系统。
AI.method: 面向系统级综述：一是剖析孪生体如何重构并表征持续存在、信息富集的城市环境；二是剖析智能体如何通过接口理解孪生、在孪生上推理、可靠行动并随城市持续演化；在此基础上归纳双层闭环蓝图，并用于组织STI研究议程与共享原型验证多城市域支撑。
AI.result: 提出"内环智能体闭环（grounding–reasoning–verification）+外环系统闭环（数据–孪生–智能体行动–反馈–更新）"的双环集成蓝图，并给出可支撑多类城市领域的统一STI研究议程框架与原型构想。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生与智能体AI的耦合应以双闭环架构来组织，内环保障智能体行动的落地性与可验证性，外环保障系统随城市演化持续更新，为城市时空智能提供统一的系统级集成范式与研究方向。

title: Selective Monocular Precession Estimation under Geometric and Evaluation Ambiguity: An Auditable Synthetic Study with ORBIT-SCOUT
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures and 7 tables; extended narrative review and ancillary code/data for descriptive arithmetic and physical-metric reproduction
summary: Monocular observations of a tumbling object can support a precise fitted trajectory without establishing that the recovered physical axis is correct. We study this distinction for elongated, approximately cylindrical targets observed by a calibrated stationary camera. ORBIT-SCOUT couples image-derived line and rim geometry to constant-cone and torque-free triaxial trajectory families, then returns a linked momentum-axis and mean-precession-rate estimate only when numerical, geometric, temporal and competing-hypothesis checks pass. We describe the measurement objective, selection policy and limitations, and situate them within spacecraft pose estimation, unknown-target reconstruction, rigid-body identification and selective prediction. An internally preregistered population of 96 new synthetic scenes was processed in two cold passes, retaining all 192 attempts. In the primary pass, 38 scenes produced jointly correct estimates, none produced an incorrect estimate, 57 were withheld and one execution was incomplete. Correct coverage on the 64 supported scenes was 25/64. Ninety-five repeated pairs were scientifically equivalent under a frozen comparison policy; the remaining pair was incomplete. The registered coverage, failure-free execution and all-case repeatability targets were not met. Historical audits also exposed an overly permissive axis metric and motion-dependent acquisition cadence. The contribution is a documented measurement-to-decision implementation and a failure-preserving evaluation case study, not a new rigid-body theory or evidence of state-of-the-art accuracy. Zero observed errors does not establish calibrated risk, and conditional temporal checks do not remove shared image-feature bias. Real-image transfer and external reproduction remain open.

AI.tldr: ORBIT-SCOUT 将单目相机图像中的线与轮廓几何约束耦合到常锥/无力矩三轴轨迹族，仅在数值、几何、时间与竞争假设检验全部通过时才输出动量轴与平均进动率；在96个合成场景（两次冷启动共192次尝试）上，38例联合正确、0例错误、57例主动弃权（覆盖25/64受支持场景），未达到预设覆盖/零失败/可重复性目标，定位为"测量到决策"的实现与保失败评测案例。
AI.motivation: 单目翻滚（tumbling）目标的轨迹拟合可以在几何上贴合图像，却不一定恢复出正确的物理转轴——"拟合精度"与"物理轴正确性"存在关键区分。作者希望明确测量目标、构建可弃权的选择性预测流程，并揭示历史评测（过于宽松的轴误差度量、依赖运动的采集节奏）的缺陷。
AI.method: 针对标定静止相机观测细长近圆柱目标的场景：从图像提取线与轮廓（rim）几何，耦合到常锥（constant-cone）与无力矩三轴（torque-free triaxial）轨迹族；设置数值、几何、时间一致性与竞争假设四类检查，全部通过才联动输出动量轴与进动率；采用内部预注册的96个新合成场景，两次独立冷启动处理，保留全部192次尝试并按冻结比较策略做配对重复性判定。
AI.result: 主运行中38个场景给出联合正确估计，无错误估计，57个被弃权，1次执行不完整；受支持场景的覆盖率仅25/64；95对重复实验结果科学等价、1对不完整；预注册的覆盖率、无失败执行与全场景可重复性目标均未达成。作者同时指出零观测错误不等于已校准风险，条件式时间检查无法消除共享图像特征偏差。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是可记录的"测量→决策"实现与保失败（failure-preserving）评测案例，而非新的刚体理论或SOTA精度证据；真实图像迁移与外部复现仍待完成，轴误差度量与采集节奏需修订。方法学与弃权式验证的思路对物理感知有价值，但证据强度有限。

title: Interpretable Brain Age Prediction Using White Matter Fiber Orientation Distributions with Rotation-Equivariant Deep Learning
summary: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) provides information about white matter microstructure that can support brain age prediction. However, many existing prediction models use diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) scalar metrics that omit orientation information. Deep learning is increasingly used for brain age prediction, but conventional CNNs do not explicitly respect the geometric structure of orientation-dependent features. We present an interpretable brain age prediction framework that combines white matter fiber orientation distributions (WM-FODs) with an SE(3) (Special Euclidean group in 3 dimensions) equivariant CNN. The network operates directly on spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients of the FOD, preserving their transformation properties under rotation. Evaluation in 692 participants aged 36-90 years from the Human Connectome Project Aging dataset showed that the combined framework outperformed the evaluated DTI-based models and conventional CNNs. Averaging predictions from five cross-validation models yielded a mean absolute error of 3.54 years and Pearson's correlation of 0.958. Our results indicated that the performance advantage depended on combining WM-FODs with equivariant processing. Prediction accuracy was highest at a maximum SH order of Lmax = 2 and declined at higher orders. Tract-level occlusion, where each segmented tract was masked in turn, revealed age-dependent patterns of model sensitivity, with importance peaks in frontal projection pathways at 36-44 years, the fornix at 45-54 years, the callosal isthmus at 55-64 years, the middle cerebellar peduncle at 65-74 years, and the callosal genu at 75-90 years. These findings support rotation-equivariant processing of WM-FODs for accurate brain age prediction with anatomically interpretable model sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将白质纤维取向分布（WM-FOD）球谐系数与SE(3)等变CNN结合的可解释脑龄预测框架，在HCP-Aging 692人数据上MAE 3.54岁、r=0.958，并通过束级遮挡揭示随年龄变化的敏感通路。
AI.motivation: 现有dMRI脑龄预测多使用DTI标量指标，丢弃了取向信息；常规CNN也未显式尊重取向相关特征的几何结构，导致表征不充分且缺乏解剖可解释性。
AI.method: 直接在FOD球谐系数上运算的SE(3)等变CNN，网络在旋转下保持系数的变换性质；与WM-FOD输入联合构成框架。Lmax扫描（重点Lmax=2最优），五折交叉验证模型预测平均，并对分割束逐一遮挡做束级敏感性分析。
AI.result: MAE 3.54年、Pearson r=0.958，优于所评估的DTI模型与常规CNN；性能优势依赖WM-FOD与等变处理的组合；Lmax=2最佳，更高阶下降；遮挡分析显示敏感峰随年龄迁移（36-44岁额叶投射通路、45-54岁穹窿、55-64岁胼胝体峡部、65-74岁小脑中脚、75-90岁胼胝体膝部）。
AI.conclusion: 旋转等变的WM-FOD处理可实现高精度且解剖可解释的脑龄预测，等变几何归纳偏置与高阶取向特征缺一不可。

title: Behavioural Quality Is Not Learning Utility: Objective Mismatch in Human Behaviour Models for Robot Learning
summary: Human behaviour models are increasingly used to provide simulated human interactions for training robots via reinforcement learning (RL). Existing approaches primarily evaluate these models according to how closely their generated behaviours resemble real human data, while their usefulness as training partners is less commonly assessed. This creates a potential objective mismatch: a model that performs well according to behavioural evaluation metrics may not necessarily provide useful training experiences for downstream robot policy learning. Across two human-robot interaction (HRI) domains, highway driving and object handover, we evaluate different types of human behaviour models using common generative-model evaluation metrics. We consider multiple human trajectory representations and compare the resulting evaluations with the downstream performance of RL policies trained using the corresponding models. We find that existing behavioural evaluation metrics do not consistently predict downstream policy performance across domains and trajectory representations, while their evaluations are sensitive to the choice of trajectory representation. We also show that even when the true testing behaviour distribution is known, training against a different distribution may yield better downstream performance than training directly against the true distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文指出用行为相似度指标评估人类行为模型与"作为RL训练伙伴是否有用"存在目标错配，并在高速驾驶与物体交接两个HRI任务上比较多种轨迹表示下生成模型指标与下游策略性能的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要按生成行为与真实人类数据的相似度评价人类行为模型，很少评估其作为训练伙伴对下游机器人策略学习的价值，可能导致选型偏差。
AI.method: 在两个HRI域（高速驾驶、物体交接）中，采用多种人类轨迹表示与不同类型人类行为模型的生成评估指标，并与使用这些模型训练得到的RL策略下游性能做相关性对比分析。
AI.result: 现有行为评估指标无法一致地预测下游策略性能，且对轨迹表示的选择敏感；同时发现即使已知真实测试行为分布，用不同分布训练反而可能获得更好的下游表现。
AI.conclusion: 人类行为模型的评估应以训练有用性为准，而非仅以行为相似度衡量；需重新审视生成指标作为机器人训练数据筛选标准的可靠性。

title: PosePlaner: Denoising Any Feed-Forward Pose Predictor from Pairwise Planar Geometry
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recent multi-view Transformers (e.g., DUSt3R and VGGT) have advanced 3D reconstruction by scaling training data and model capacity from two views to many views and long sequences, subsuming the classical SfM/SLAM pipeline of feature extraction, matching, and pose estimation in a single feed-forward pass. Yet this subsumption hides the interfaces between pipeline stages---correspondences, geometry, and pose are entangled in a single forward pass, leaving supervised fine-tuning as the major path to improvement and offering no mechanism to correct predictions from geometric evidence at test time. We propose PosePlaner to close this gap by reviving the classical coupling between correspondences and pose via flow matching, treating pose refinement as a conditional generation problem that takes coarse geometric matches and initial pose as input condition and fuses the resulting pose hypotheses into a single refined estimate, providing a continuous, data-driven analog of RANSAC voting. Our method is trained efficiently on two-view data, yet serves as a periodic refiner for streaming n-view pose estimators with no retraining. Empirically, it corrects failures of feed-forward predictors, substantially improves correspondence-based solvers, and reduces accumulated drift in long streaming sequences.

AI.tldr: PosePlaner 用 flow matching 把位姿细化建模为条件生成问题，以粗几何匹配与初始位姿为条件生成位姿假设并融合为单一精化估计，作为两视图数据训练的周期精化器，可在不重训的情况下提升流式多视图位姿估计器。
AI.motivation: DUSt3R/VGGT 等多视图 Transformer 将 SfM/SLAM 流水线端到端前馈化，但对应关系、几何与位姿被纠缠在单次前向中，测试时无法用几何证据纠正预测，只能依赖有监督微调改进。
AI.method: 将位姿细化视为条件生成问题：输入粗几何匹配与初始位姿作为条件，用 flow matching 生成位姿假设，并融合多个假设为单一精化位姿，形成类似 RANSAC 投票的连续、数据驱动对应物；仅用两视图数据高效训练，作为周期精化模块接入流式 n 视图位姿估计器而无需重训。
AI.result: 实验显示可纠正前馈预测器的失败案例，显著提升基于对应关系的求解器，并降低长流式序列中的累积漂移。
AI.conclusion: 通过以生成式方式重新耦合对应关系与位姿，PosePlaner 为前馈 3D 重建提供了可插拔、免重训的测试时几何纠错机制，恢复了经典几何流水线的可解释接口。

title: Seeing Before Naming: Context-Grounded Learning of Novel Visual Concepts
summary: Learning an unfamiliar visual category requires more than adapting a classifier: the model must connect its visual evidence to a useful semantic name. A pre-trained vision-language model can retain discriminative image features while providing a weak textual anchor for the target concept. We address this imbalance through context-grounded semantic anchoring. Our framework, SynerNet, learns concept-specific name embeddings, exposes them to compatible linguistic contexts, and conditions their representations on visual evidence. Difficulty-aware processing and adaptive objective weighting coordinate this adaptation while retaining the pre-trained backbone. On four VISTA-Beyond domains, SynerNet reaches a mean 16-shot accuracy of 74.35%, compared with 72.45% for few-shot name learning. Across 14 domains in the name-masked transfer setting, it improves mean accuracy from 45.17% to 46.74%. Ablations identify concept-specific name embeddings and cross-modal context integration as important components. These results support treating concept acquisition as the construction of visually grounded semantic anchors.

AI.tldr: SynerNet通过上下文锚定语义学习新视觉类别：学习概念特定名称嵌入、置于兼容语言上下文中、并用视觉证据条件化，配合难度感知处理与自适应目标加权，仅微调轻量部分保留预训练骨干。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉语言模型在适应新类别时存在“不平衡”：图像特征判别性强，但目标概念的名称嵌入锚定弱，导致视觉证据与语义名之间连接不良。
AI.method: 提出context-grounded semantic anchoring框架SynerNet：(1) 学习概念特定名称嵌入；(2) 将其暴露于兼容文本上下文以获取语言学先验；(3) 以视觉证据条件化名称表示；(4) 采用难度感知处理与自适应损失加权，协调各目标；同时冻结预训练骨干以保留判别特征。
AI.result: 四个VISTA-Beyond域16-shot平均准确率74.35%（对照72.45%）；名称掩码迁移设定下14域平均准确率由45.17%提升至46.74%；消融表明概念特定名称嵌入与跨模态上下文整合为关键部件。
AI.conclusion: 概念获取可被视为“视觉接地语义锚”的构建过程，弱文本锚配合上下文与视觉条件化即可稳定提升少样本新类别识别与迁移。

title: Physics-Informed and Data-Driven Composite Disturbance Separation and Predictive Control for Airborne Electro-Optical Gimbals with Multiple Constraints
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures. Includes supplementary derivations and proofs. Demonstration video included as an ancillary file
summary: This paper studies the constrained pointing control problem of airborne electro-optical gimbals subjected to composite periodic and aperiodic disturbances. Under carrier vibration, input delay, and actuator constraints, achieving line-of-sight stabilization and tracking is challenging. A disturbance-separated model predictive control (MPC) scheme is proposed to compensate these heterogeneous disturbances according to their physical characteristics. An adaptive periodic observer predicts multi-harmonic vibrations over the MPC horizon using linear-regression frequency estimation. A linear observer estimates the aperiodic disturbance, and a bounded long short-term memory (LSTM) network predicts its change over the input delay. Embedding periodic predictions into the MPC model while applying aperiodic compensation outside the optimizer limits amplification of aperiodic estimation errors and improves pointing accuracy under frequency changes and parameter mismatch. On the stated headroom envelope, input-set tightening provides feasible commands within the prescribed limits, and a regional practical tracking bound is established under explicit input-sequence and predicted-state margin conditions. A UAV-mounted two-axis gimbal platform is assembled for comparative indoor hovering experiments, complemented by simulations under frequency changes and parameter mismatch. In the reported trials, the proposed method achieves yaw and pitch relative-angle root-mean-square errors (RMSEs) of 0.770 degrees and 0.350 degrees, reducing tracking errors by 25.1% and 45.9% compared with linear active disturbance rejection control.

AI.tldr: 面向机载光电吊舱的复合周期/非周期扰动约束指向控制：扰动分离式MPC，周期扰动用自适应多谐波观测器嵌入预测模型，非周期扰动用线性观测器+LSTM预测时延内变化并在优化器外补偿；实测RMSE 0.770°/0.350°，较LADRC降25.1%/45.9%。
AI.motivation: 载体振动、输入时延与执行器饱和下，机载两轴光电吊舱的视轴稳定与跟踪困难；现有方法多将异质扰动视为统一总扰动处理，难以兼顾周期振动预测精度与非周期扰动补偿的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出“扰动分离”框架：1）自适应周期观测器用线性回归频率估计实现多谐波振动预测，并将预测值嵌入MPC模型；2）线性观测器估计非周期扰动，有界LSTM网络预测其在输入时延内的变化，在优化器外前馈补偿以抑制估计误差放大；3）输入集紧缩保证指令在执行器约束内可行，并在给定输入序列与预测状态裕度条件下建立区域实用跟踪界。
AI.result: 搭建无人机载两轴吊舱平台开展室内悬停对比实验，辅以频率变化与参数失配仿真；偏航/俯仰相对角RMSE分别为0.770°和0.350°，相对线性自抗扰控制（LADRC）分别降低25.1%和45.9%。
AI.conclusion: 扰动按物理特性分离处理可有效缓解周期预测污染非周期补偿的问题，在频变与参数失配下提升指向精度；方法具备理论可行域保证，但验证限于室内悬停场景与单一基线。

title: Recovering Black-Box Point Cloud Models from Pose Shifts via Derivative-Free Optimization
summary: Point cloud models are increasingly deployed through score-only black-box interfaces. Under this access model, test-time rotations outside the training distribution can substantially degrade performance. Although existing mitigations such as equivariant retraining and gradient-based adaptation are effective, they are infeasible without access to model weights or gradients. To address this limitation, we propose CanDO, a test-time canonicalization method that recovers lost performance using only forward queries. Specifically, CanDO searches for an input transformation that maximizes model confidence and uses derivative-free optimization to perform this search without gradients. We further identify three conditions for successful recovery: a training augmentation gap, an accuracy-aligned confidence surrogate, and global search over a multi-modal objective. Across multiple architectures and benchmarks, CanDO recovers 76% of the oracle gap under azimuthal misorientation and 51% under arbitrary SO(3) rotations for object part segmentation. These results show that frozen score-only point cloud models can recover from rotation-induced distribution shifts through post-deployment canonicalization alone.

AI.tldr: CanDO：仅用前向查询的无梯度测试时规范化方法，通过搜索最大化模型置信度的输入旋转，使冻结的score-only点云黑盒模型从旋转分布偏移中恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 点云模型越来越多以仅返回score的黑盒接口部署，训练分布外的测试时旋转会显著降低性能；等变重训练与基于梯度的自适应虽然有效，但需要权重或梯度，在此访问模式下不可行。
AI.method: 提出CanDO，仅用前向查询进行测试时规范化：以模型置信度为目标，用无导数优化（derivative-free optimization）在输入变换空间搜索使置信度最大的旋转；并指出成功恢复的三个条件——训练增强缺口、与准确率对齐的置信度代理、以及对多模态目标的全局搜索。
AI.result: 在多种架构和基准上，目标部件分割任务中，方位角错位下恢复76%的oracle差距，任意SO(3)旋转下恢复51%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的score-only点云模型仅通过部署后的规范化即可从旋转导致的分布偏移中恢复性能，无需权重或梯度访问。

title: Learning Dual-Camera Smooth Zoom via Decoupled Geometric-Photometric Data Synthesis
comment: Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL . 13 pages, 13 figures
summary: When zooming between dual cameras on smartphones, prominent discontinuities in both geometric perspective and color rendition inevitably degrade the visual experience of users. To address this issue, we introduce the dual-camera smooth zoom (DCSZ) task, aiming to synthesize continuous intermediate frames for fluid zooming. However, directly applying existing video frame interpolation (VFI) models to this task is severely hindered by substantial domain gaps and the practical intractability of capturing real-world continuous ground-truth. To this end, we propose a novel data synthesis framework to generate high-fidelity DCSZ training sequences, named ZoomGS v2. It explicitly decouples geometric and color transformations from 3D scene representation modeling, thereby enabling extensive data generation from easily accessible single-camera 3D scenes. Furthermore, we develop ZoomFI, a specialized VFI network tailored to the DCSZ task, which leverages complementary bidirectional warping for comprehensive dual-camera information fusion. Extensive experiments on test datasets captured using two mobile phones demonstrate that training with the constructed DCSZ data significantly improves the performance of various VFI models. Moreover, ZoomFI achieves state-of-the-art results in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The datasets, code, and pretrained models are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出双摄平滑变焦(DCSZ)任务与ZoomGS v2数据合成框架(解耦几何与色彩变换)及专用插帧网络ZoomFI,实现手机双摄变焦的连续中间帧合成。
AI.motivation: 手机双摄切换时视角几何与色彩渲染存在明显跳变,直接套用现有视频插帧模型受域差距与真实连续GT难以采集的限制。
AI.method: ZoomGS v2:从单相机3D场景(3D高斯表示)中显式解耦几何变换与色彩变换,合成高保真DCSZ训练序列;ZoomFI:专用VFI网络,采用互补双向warp进行双摄信息融合。
AI.result: 在两部手机实拍测试集上,所构造数据可显著提升多种VFI模型性能;ZoomFI在定量指标与视觉质量上均达SOTA。数据集、代码与预训练模型开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据合成与专用网络设计有效解决双摄变焦的几何与色彩不连续问题,开源数据与模型可推动该任务研究。

title: DecoyCount: Evaluating Visual-Reasoning Misalignment in Counting
summary: Visual counting benchmarks report whether vision-language models produce the correct number, but not whether errors arise from perception or reasoning. We introduce DecoyCount, a benchmark built from 1,660 real-world images with designed decoys across seven mechanisms, along with paired prompts: a neutral question, a matched alignment cue, and a novel multi-hop, multi-image question that situates the same counting problem in a realistic scenario. Using this design, we find that counting failures are induced partly by visual misalignment: models can execute the intended counting process when cue-guided but fail to select it unaided, and we term this difference in accuracy the reasoning-alignment gap. Despite being highly capable on general reasoning, frontier models remain below 50\% accuracy on our benchmark, while alignment gaps range from 11.8-22.1 percentage points; strikingly, we observe that more capable models, greater thinking budgets, and agentic processes often induce larger gaps. Because humans may bring context that models lack, we test whether textual underspecification contributes to misalignment using a scenario-based multi-hop condition without explicit hinting, but this added context does not improve aggregate performance. Our analysis concludes that stronger general reasoning does not by itself generalize to aligned visual reasoning, leaving misalignment with human visual expectations as a substantial component of the remaining deficit.

AI.tldr: DecoyCount基准用1,660张真实图像+七类诱饵机制与三种配对提示（中性问题/对齐线索/多跳多图场景）区分视觉计数错误源于感知还是推理，提出"推理-对齐差距"指标，发现前沿模型准确率不足50%，差距达11.8–22.1个百分点，且越强模型/更长思考预算/agent流程差距越大。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数基准只报告最终数字是否正确，无法判断错误来自感知还是推理；作者希望量化"模型能否在没有提示时自主选择正确的计数行为"，即视觉对齐问题。
AI.method: 构建DecoyCount基准：1,660张真实图像，设计七种诱饵机制，并配套三种提示——中性问句、匹配的对齐提示（cue）、新颖的多跳多图问句将同一计数问题嵌入真实场景；以中性提示与线索提示的准确率差定义"推理-对齐差距"；另设无显式提示的场景化多跳条件检验文本欠指定是否导致错位。
AI.result: 前沿模型整体准确率低于50%；对齐差距范围11.8–22.1个百分点；能力更强模型、更大thinking预算与agentic流程往往带来更大差距；增加场景上下文的文本条件未提升总体性能。
AI.conclusion: 更强的通用推理并不能自动泛化到对齐的视觉推理，与人类视觉期望的错位是剩余性能缺口的重要来源。

title: DocTalk: Enhancing Medical Knowledge Retrieval via Fine-tuned Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Robust Clinical Decision Support
summary: Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The framework integrates prompt engineering, in-context learning, and medically aligned evaluation to support factual and interpretable responses. Results: On DocTalk-QA, instruction tuning produced consistent improvements across lexical, semantic, and clinical fidelity metrics. The best-performing tuned model, Llama-3-Med42-8B, achieved ROUGE-L = 0.40, BERTScore-F1 = 0.76, and UMLS-F1 = 0.49. To examine external generalization beyond the DocTalk-QA dataset, the two best-performing models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Med42-8B, were evaluated on PubMedQA before and after instruction tuning. Accuracy improved from 0.931 to 0.977 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 0.935 to 0.943 for Llama-3-Med42-8B. Conclusion: DocTalk was deployed as a secure web-based platform for interactive EHR querying. These findings suggest that clinically grounded instruction tuning can improve medical QA performance and support practical clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: DocTalk：基于去标识出院小结构建500条图表依据QA数据，用LoRA指令微调6个开源LLM，并部署为安全Web问诊平台。
AI.motivation: LLM在临床决策支持中受幻觉与领域错配制约，需生成简洁、贴合病历图表（chart-grounded）的可信回答。
AI.method: 句子级分解+思维链引导提问+专家审核的数据生成流水线；6个开源LLM（3通用、3生物医学）在LoRA指令微调前后对比；结合提示工程、上下文学习与医学对齐的评测（ROUGE-L/BERTScore/UMLS-F1），并在PubMedQA上做外部泛化测试。
AI.result: 微调带来词法、语义、临床忠实度一致提升；最佳模型Llama-3-Med42-8B达ROUGE-L 0.40、BERTScore-F1 0.76、UMLS-F1 0.49；PubMedQA准确率Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 0.931→0.977，Llama-3-Med42-8B 0.935→0.943。
AI.conclusion: 临床依据型指令微调可提升医疗QA表现，已形成安全Web端EHR交互查询平台，支撑临床决策支持，但缺乏真实临床部署效果与医生盲评证据。

title: Localization-Uncertainty-Aware UAV Swarm Search for GNSS-Denied Maritime Surveillance
summary: This paper studies UAV swarm search in GNSS-denied maritime environments, where inter-UAV ranging drives cooperative localization and uncertainty propagates along the multi-hop reference chain, affecting connectivity, collision avoidance, and search effectiveness. We propose an uncertainty-aware control barrier function (CBF) framework approximating cascading localization covariance through Fisher information matrices. First, the cascading covariance model captures how ranging noise and neighbor uncertainty accumulate along the localization chain. Second, uncertainty-tightened CBFs incorporate the covariance model and its rate into margins for connectivity maintenance and collision avoidance, with conditional invariance and graceful-degradation bounds. Third, a hierarchical Voronoi-target strategy with formation keeping supports efficient forward-looking coverage. The distributed controller is validated with a standard unbiased extended Kalman filter in the loop. The framework is demonstrated on several polygon shapes and swarm sizes from 6 to 30 sUAVs. An estimator-in-the-loop run completes the search in 302.5 s, 20 Monte Carlo deployments confirm repeatable completion with all local QPs feasible and containment in at least 98.97% of UAV-frames, and six MBZIRC runs provide estimator-in-the-loop evidence. The source code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 针对GNSS拒止海上环境下的无人机集群搜索，提出不确定性感知控制障碍函数（CBF）框架，用Fisher信息矩阵近似级联定位协方差，并将协方差及其变化率纳入连通性保持与避障的约束余量，结合分层Voronoi-目标与编队保持策略实现前瞻覆盖。
AI.motivation: GNSS拒止海上环境中，集群仅靠机间测距进行协同定位，不确定性沿多跳参考链传播，直接威胁连通性、避障与搜索效率；现有CBF方法通常忽略定位不确定性的级联放大效应。
AI.method: 1) 级联协方差模型：刻画测距噪声与邻居不确定性沿定位链的累积；2) 不确定性收紧CBF：将协方差模型及其变化率写入连通性与避障的安全余量，并给出条件不变性与优雅退化界；3) 分层Voronoi-目标策略配合编队保持，实现分布式前瞻覆盖控制；闭环中接入标准无偏EKF。
AI.result: 在6–30架小型无人机、多种多边形搜索区域上验证；估计器在环单次搜索用时302.5 s；20次蒙特卡洛部署均重复完成搜索，所有局部QP可行，至少98.97%的UAV帧满足包含约束；6次MBZIRC实飞提供估计器在环证据；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 将定位协方差显式嵌入CBF约束余量，可在GNSS拒止多跳测距条件下保障集群连通与安全并维持搜索效能；该方法具备分布式可解性与可重复性，但主要证据来自估计器在环仿真与MBZIRC赛项数据，非全自主海上实飞。

title: CoDeRNet: Selective Cross-Task Routing under Heterogeneous Supervision for Change Detection and Captioning
summary: Change Detection & Captioning (CDC) aims to jointly localize changed regions and describe their semantic content from bi-temporal remote sensing images. While recent approaches have demonstrated the effectiveness of unified modeling, they primarily rely on shared representations or jointly optimized architectures, leaving task-specific communication under heterogeneous supervision less explored. However, detection and captioning differ fundamentally in their supervision granularity, leading to heterogeneous representations with uneven reliability across tasks and spatial locations. In this paper, we reformulate CDC as a selective information routing problem between heterogeneous task branches, where the key challenge is to determine when and where information should be transferred. To this end, we propose CoDeRNet, a unified framework that preserves task-specific representations while enabling bidirectional exchange of complementary information. CoDeRNet introduces a Confidence-Decomposed Routing (CoDeR) mechanism, which decomposes the routing condition into receiver-side need for support and sender-side reliability cues to guide selective transfer. Experiments on LEVIR-MCI and WHU-CDC show that CoDeRNet achieves strong overall CDC performance, particularly improving caption generation while preserving competitive change localization. Extensive analyses further show that the benefits arise not merely from joint learning or generic cross-task communication, but from explicitly modeling selective cross-task information routing. These results highlight the importance of conditional information transfer for unified CDC under heterogeneous supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出CoDeRNet，将变化检测与描述(CDC)重构为异质任务分支间的选择性信息路由问题，通过置信度分解路由机制实现双向互补信息交换。
AI.motivation: 现有统一建模方法多依赖共享表示或联合优化架构，忽视了在异质监督下（检测为稠密像素级、描述为序列级）任务间异质表示可靠性不均衡的问题，任务特定通信尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 保留任务特定表示，将CDC建模为选择性信息路由：引入Confidence-Decomposed Routing (CoDeR)机制，把路由条件分解为接收端"支持需求"与发送端"可靠性线索"，据此决定何时、何地进行跨任务信息传递，实现双向互补信息交换。
AI.result: 在LEVIR-MCI与WHU-CDC上取得较强整体CDC性能，尤其显著提升变化描述生成，同时保持有竞争力的变化定位精度；消融分析表明收益来自显式建模选择性跨任务路由，而非单纯联合学习或通用跨任务通信。
AI.conclusion: 在异质监督下，条件化的选择性信息传递对统一CDC建模至关重要，任务特定表示 + 置信度引导路由优于共享表示方案。

title: LayoutMamba: Efficient Document Layout Analysis with Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Networks
summary: Document layout analysis (DLA) faces a long-standing dilemma: existing methods either capture rich local details at prohibitive computational cost (e.g., Transformer-based approaches with quadratic complexity) or achieve efficient global modeling but sacrifice fine-grained structural awareness (e.g., state-space models). This trade-off hinders deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. We present LayoutMamba, a hybrid framework that synergistically combines sparse-attention Transformers for localized feature extraction (O(n) complexity) and the recurrent state-space mechanism of Mamba for dilution-free long-range dependency modeling across the 2D document canvas. Our two-stage paradigm first uses a lightweight Transformer encoder to hierarchically distill salient local semantics; second, Mamba propagates global contextual dependencies without attention dilution, enabling precise, efficient, and scalable layout understanding. We further identify a critical yet overlooked issue in existing DLA benchmarks: the inherent low-overlap distribution bias of layout objects, which we mitigate through a novel Geometric Overlap Penalty Loss (GOPLoss), a dual-optimization objective that minimizes redundant bounding box overlaps and encourages geometrically consistent predictions. Extensive experiments on PubLayNet and D4LA show that LayoutMamba surpasses state-of-the-art AP on PubLayNet with 8x fewer parameters and maintains leading performance on D4LA, ranking top-3 among published methods, achieving an unprecedented balance between accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. Our work pioneers a cognition-inspired paradigm for document analysis, advancing practical deployment in edge computing and resource-limited environments.

AI.tldr: LayoutMamba 将稀疏注意力 Transformer 与 Mamba 状态空间模型结合，兼顾局部细节与长程全局建模，并提出几何重叠惩罚损失缓解 DLA 基准中的低重叠分布偏置，实现精度-效率-可扩展性的平衡。
AI.motivation: 文档版面分析存在两难：Transformer 捕捉丰富局部细节但复杂度为二次方、计算代价高；状态空间模型全局建模高效但细粒度结构感知弱。这种权衡阻碍了资源受限场景的部署。
AI.method: 两阶段混合框架：第一阶段用轻量 Transformer 编码器（稀疏注意力，O(n) 复杂度）分层提取显著局部语义；第二阶段用 Mamba 循环状态空间机制在二维文档画布上传播无稀释的长程上下文依赖。另提出 Geometric Overlap Penalty Loss（GOPLoss），双目标优化：抑制冗余边界框重叠、鼓励几何一致的预测，以缓解基准中版面对象固有低重叠分布偏置。
AI.result: 在 PubLayNet 上以 8 倍更少参数超过 SOTA AP；D4LA 上保持领先性能，在已发表方法中排名前三。
AI.conclusion: LayoutMamba 在准确率、效率与可扩展性间取得前所未有的平衡，提出受认知启发的文档分析范式，利于边缘计算与资源受限环境的实际部署。

title: MedAdaptAgent: An Automatic Harness for Adapting Medical Imaging Models to New Sites
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Reusing pretrained medical-imaging models offers an alternative to training from scratch. A model trained for the same task may perform poorly at a new hospital because imaging protocols and preprocessing differ. Effective adaptation depends on the model architecture, domain shift, and available labels and compute. Adaptation can improve scores on a small labeled set yet reduce performance on unseen data. We present MedAdaptAgent, an automatic harness that turns a supplied model, target data, and a free-text request into a new-site adaptation workflow. Its LLM-driven Adaptation Planner uses model-site evidence to choose compatible experiments and revise subsequent adjustments. The harness requires evidence of improvement over the pretrained model, then delivers the selected model as a complete, runnable package. Evaluation spans 26 segmentation and classification transfers across architectures and compute settings, with segmentation annotation budgets ranging from zero-shot transfer to few-shot adaptation. With 20 local annotations, mean segmentation Dice rises from 0.483 to 0.774 across 10 transfers, a 60.1% relative gain, with no harmful replacements. Mean classification AUROC rises from 0.810 to 0.837 across 13 transfers, a 3.4% relative gain. Comparing adapted models with the pretrained model reduces harmful classification replacements by 30.8% versus selecting the highest-scoring model on the available labels, using identical candidates. Seven public-model deployments demonstrate adaptation and reproducible package delivery across contrast and modality shifts. A CT-to-MRI study extends the evaluation to four LLM planners, including two open-weight models. We release the code on GitHub.

AI.tldr: MedAdaptAgent：一个LLM驱动的自动化适配流程框架，把预训练医学影像模型、目标站点数据和自然语言需求转化为可运行的跨院适配包，并强制以"优于预训练模型"为验收证据。
AI.motivation: 复用预训练医学影像模型可省去从头训练，但同一任务的模型在新医院常因成像协议与预处理差异而失效；适配效果取决于架构、域偏移、标签与算力，且在小标注集上提分可能在未见数据上掉分，目前缺乏系统化的自动适配与验证机制。
AI.method: 构建自动harness：LLM驱动的Adaptation Planner依据模型-站点证据选择兼容实验并迭代修订后续调整；适配流程需先证明相对预训练模型有改进，再把选中模型封装为完整可运行交付包。评估覆盖26个分割/分类迁移任务，跨多种架构与算力设置，分割标注预算从零样本到少样本。
AI.result: 20个本地标注下，10个分割迁移任务平均Dice由0.483升至0.774（相对提升60.1%），无有害替换；13个分类迁移平均AUROC由0.810升至0.837（+3.4%）。与"按可用标签最高分选模"相比，采用与预训练模型的对照使有害分类替换减少30.8%。7个公开模型部署验证了对比度与模态偏移下的适配与可复现交付；CT→MRI研究扩展至4个LLM规划器（含2个开源权重模型）。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM规划器与"必须有相对基线收益证据"的验收门槛结合，可实现跨站点的可靠、可复现模型适配，并以防退化的选模机制显著降低有害替换率；但整体仍属医学影像域应用，方法洞察对其他领域的可迁移性有限。

title: MMGNet: Multi-Modal 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis for Cluttered Scenes
summary: Grasping is a foundational capability in robotic manipulation. Scene-level 6-DoF grasp synthesis relies on point clouds for metric geometry, yet real-world point observations are often noisy, incomplete, and over-smoothed. RGB images provide object-region, boundary, and appearance cues, yet two bottlenecks limit their effective use in scene representation and local grasp reasoning. We present MMGNet, a Multi-Modal Grasp Synthesis Network that addresses these bottlenecks through hierarchical image-to-3D feature injection and rotational graspness modeling. Hierarchical injection integrates multi-scale image features throughout 3D representation formation, while the rotational graspness jointly predicts the grasp approach direction and in-plane rotation before organizing local image-informed features through grasp-shaded grouping. Ablation studies show that these two modules provide complementary gains. MMGNet achieves a mean AP of 60.34 on GraspNet-1Billion with RealSense, surpassing all compared methods. In real-world experiments with adversarial grasp objects, MMGNet improves the grasp success rate over AnyGrasp by 8.46 percentage points. \emph{Code, models, and data will be released upon publication.}

AI.tldr: MMGNet通过层级化图像到3D特征注入与旋转抓取度建模，融合RGB与点云进行场景级6-DoF抓取合成。
AI.motivation: 真实点云噪声大、不完整且过度平滑，而RGB图像虽提供物体区域、边界与外观线索，却存在场景表示与局部抓取推理两个瓶颈。
AI.method: 多模态抓取合成网络：在多尺度上把图像特征分层注入3D表示形成过程；旋转抓取度模块联合预测接近方向与平面内旋转，并通过抓取着色分组组织局部图像引导特征。
AI.result: GraspNet-1Billion RealSense上平均AP达60.34，超过所有对比方法；真实场景对抗性物体抓取成功率较AnyGrasp提升8.46个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 两模块互补增益显著，RGB-点云融合能有效提升6-DoF抓取检测精度与实机鲁棒性。

title: SGDB: Semantic-Geometric Decoupling and Evidence Binding for Logical Anomaly Detection
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, includes supplementary material. Code: this https URL
summary: Logical anomaly detection requires recognizing scene components and measuring whether their configuration satisfies task constraints. Correct identities can coexist with inaccurate geometry; clean mask fragments can yield misleading lengths. We propose Semantic-Geometric Decoupling and Evidence Binding (SGDB). A semantic decoder learns object identities from component-annotated normal sources and factual edits; a separate reader supplies final measurements. Partial one-to-one association binds geometric witnesses to identities while retaining unmatched objects in the count. A support-certified reader selects mask-derived axes using line quality and complete component ownership. Explicit task requirements and normal-data references define executable checks, with decision thresholds fixed by independent normal calibration. Execution-grounded explanation traces rule contributions to source objects and measurements, extracting compact sufficient alarm certificates. A frozen language model expresses selected outcomes as cited claims, with numeric evidence retained by the executor. Reports preserve observed deviations and unavailable evidence. SGDB achieves 98.19% AUROC and 94.52% fixed-threshold F1 on five MVTec LOCO logical categories, and 93.56% AUROC and 92.76% F1 across all 50 VID-AD tasks. Frozen-output controls evaluate geometric readout and explanatory sufficiency and compactness.

AI.tldr: SGDB：将逻辑异常检测拆分为语义解码与几何测量两支，用部分一一关联把几何证据绑定到对象身份，再由支持认证读取器选取掩码轴，并以任务规则+正常校准阈值做可执行检查，输出可引用、含充分报警证书的解释。
AI.motivation: 逻辑异常检测需判断场景组件配置是否违反任务约束；但身份正确≠几何准确，掩码碎片会给出误导性长度。因此需解耦语义身份与几何测量，避免二者误差互相污染。
AI.method: 语义解码器从组件标注的正常源与事实编辑中学习身份；独立读取器做最终测量。部分一一关联将几何见证绑定到身份，未匹配对象仍计入计数。支持认证读取器依据线质量与组件完整归属选择掩码派生轴。显式任务要求与正常参考定义可执行检查，阈值由独立正常校准固定。执行落地解释追踪规则贡献至源对象与测量，提取紧凑充分报警证书；冻结语言模型仅表达选中结果并附引用，数值证据保留在执行器。
AI.result: MVTec LOCO 五个逻辑类别上 98.19% AUROC、94.52% 固定阈值 F1；VID-AD 全部 50 个任务 93.56% AUROC、92.76% F1。通过冻结输出对照组评估几何读出与解释的充分性、紧凑性。
AI.conclusion: 语义-几何解耦加证据绑定可在工业逻辑异常检测上同时获得高精度与可验证解释，且解释受执行器数值证据约束、不依赖语言模型自由生成。

title: LE-GDA: Layer Ensemble Gaussian Discriminant Analysis for Training-Free Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 23 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Training-free few-shot adaptation of vision-language models typically constructs a classifier from CLIP's final projected image representation, leaving intermediate representations unused. Combining them is not straightforward. Class scores from different representations differ in spread by orders of magnitude for the same query. Direct averaging allocates influence by numerical scale rather than predictive information. We propose Layer-Ensemble Gaussian Discriminant Analysis (LE-GDA), a method that fits regularized shared-covariance discriminants independently to intermediate and final representations extracted in one frozen encoder pass. LE-GDA standardizes each discriminant's class scores per query, selects a small representation multiset on labeled validation data, and combines it with the zero-shot classifier without gradient-based optimization. Across 11 datasets, four CLIP backbones, five shot counts, and three independently sampled K-shot training sets, LE-GDA achieves the highest mean accuracy of all evaluated methods on every backbone, raising the 16-shot mean from 78.01% to 79.54% over a matched GDA-CLIP (final-feature) baseline and improving that baseline for every backbone-shot combination. At one shot, LE-GDA retains a 1.20-point mean gain over the baseline even though covariance estimation is unavailable and per-query standardization is neutral. A control with richer per-class structure inside a single representation does not reproduce the gain, indicating that the benefit comes from combining representations. These results show that intermediate CLIP representations carry information beyond the final embedding and can improve training-free few-shot adaptation. Code and evaluation resources are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 LE-GDA：在冻结 CLIP 一次前向中提取中间层与最终层表征，各自独立拟合共享协方差正则化 GDA 判别器，按查询做类分数标准化，并在验证集上挑选小型表征子集，与零样本分类器无梯度组合。
AI.motivation: 免训练少样本适配普遍只用 CLIP 最终投影表征构建分类器，中间层表征被浪费；而直接融合不可行，因为不同层表征的类分数在数值尺度（spread）上相差数量级，简单平均会按数值尺度而非预测信息量分配权重。
AI.method: 1) 一次冻结编码器前向提取中间与最终表征；2) 对每个表征独立拟合带正则的共享协方差高斯判别分析（GDA）；3) 对每个判别器的类分数按查询逐条标准化（per-query standardization），消除尺度差异；4) 在带标签验证集上选择小型表征多重集（multiset）；5) 与零样本 CLIP 分类器无梯度组合。
AI.result: 在 11 个数据集、4 个 CLIP 骨干、5 种 shot 设置、3 组独立采样 K-shot 训练集上，LE-GDA 在每个骨干上均取得最高平均准确率；16-shot 均值由匹配的 GDA-CLIP（仅最终特征）基线的 78.01% 提升至 79.54%，且在全部骨干-shot 组合上均优于基线；1-shot 下即使无法估计协方差、逐查询标准化失效，仍保持 1.20 点平均增益。对照实验：在单一表征内部使用更丰富的类内结构无法复现该增益，说明收益源自表征间组合。
AI.conclusion: 中间层 CLIP 表征携带超出最终嵌入的信息，且通过逐查询标准化 + 验证集表征选择可被有效、免梯度地利用，从而改进免训练少样本适配。方法本质是分类器集成/表征集成的少样本视觉-语言适配，属通用 CV 方法，未涉及机器人、3D 重建或世界模型，对具身方向为间接背景。

title: Accuracy and efficiency of compact foundation models for surface-water mapping during floods
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code: this https URL Data: this https URL
summary: Pretrained Earth observation models may reduce the effort needed to map surface water, but their value depends on the alternative against which they are compared. We evaluated Prithvi-EO-2.0-Tiny using the 446 hand-labeled Sentinel-2 chips from 11 flood events in Sen1Floods11. A fine-tuned model, a frozen-encoder model, and an identical randomly initialized architecture were compared with a similarly sized U-Net, a larger Prithvi model, and spectral-index thresholds. Experiments varied the number of training chips, excluded events from model fitting, and measured computational cost and prediction reliability. With 252 training chips, U-Net achieved a water intersection-over-union (IoU) of 0.856 on the official test set, compared with 0.833 for fine-tuned Prithvi-Tiny. Pretraining improved the tiny transformer over random initialization by a reported 0.046 IoU with 25 training chips and 0.023 with 252 chips, but did not reverse the U-Net ranking. Across 11 event-exclusion evaluations, mean IoU was 0.768 for fine-tuned Prithvi-Tiny and 0.777 for U-Net; the paired interval included zero. Fine-tuned Prithvi-Tiny processed a 512x512-pixel chip in 16.1 ms on a GPU and 258 ms on a laptop CPU, compared with 30.6 and 665 ms for U-Net. Errors were concentrated near water boundaries, and high predictive entropy identified many, but not all, erroneous pixels. These results support a specific role for compact pretrained models: lower measured computational demand with competitive accuracy, rather than consistent superiority. Event-dependent performance, shared hyperparameter selection, and the distinction between observed water and newly inundated land delimit the conclusions.

AI.tldr: 在Sen1Floods11上对Prithvi-EO-2.0-Tiny与同规模U-Net、随机初始化Transformer及光谱指数阈值做受控对比：预训练带来小幅增益但不改变U-Net更优的排序，紧凑预训练模型的价值在于计算开销显著更低而非精度优势。
AI.motivation: 预训练地球观测模型（如Prithvi-EO）被宣称可降低地表水制图成本，但其收益高度依赖比较基线，缺少同规模、同超参、同数据的公平对照，因此需要明确其相对价值边界。
AI.method: 使用Sen1Floods11中11次洪水事件的446张手工标注Sentinel-2 512×512图像块；比较微调Prithvi-Tiny、冻结编码器、随机初始化同架构、同规模U-Net、更大Prithvi模型与光谱指数阈值；实验涵盖训练样本数变化（25/252张）、逐事件排除（11次留一事件评估）、GPU与笔记本CPU推理耗时以及预测熵与误差的对应关系。
AI.result: 252张训练样本下U-Net测试集水体IoU 0.856，微调Prithvi-Tiny 0.833；预训练相对随机初始化在25张样本时提升约0.046 IoU、252张时约0.023，但未逆转U-Net的排序；11次事件排除评估平均IoU为0.768（Prithvi-Tiny）对0.777（U-Net），配对区间包含零；单块推理耗时16.1 ms（GPU）/258 ms（CPU）对30.6 ms/665 ms；误差集中于水体边界，高预测熵可识别多数但非全部错误像素。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑预训练地球观测模型的定位应是"低计算需求下具备竞争力精度"，而非稳定超越任务定制基线；结论受事件依赖性、共享超参选择以及"已观测水体与新淹没陆地"区分问题所限制。

title: Quantile-Based Command-Reserve MPC for Current-Command Gimbal Pointing
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary hardware trial data and recomputation scripts included as ancillary files. Submitted to Journal of the Franklin Institute
summary: This paper studies the constrained line-of-sight pointing control problem of a two-axis current-command gimbal subjected to mismatched mechanical disturbances. Friction, torque ripple, current-response lag, model mismatch, and limited drive commands make accurate pointing more challenging yet interesting. A quantile disturbance predictor is proposed to compensate predictable acceleration residuals and describe their remaining uncertainty, with the aid of learning median and outer quantiles from state, command, and reference histories. A tube-inspired model predictive controller is proposed to reserve command headroom according to prediction uncertainty, with the aid of calibrated radii and stage-dependent input margins. The median improves the nominal prediction, while the radius adapts the command reserve without adding optimization variables. A finite-horizon tube inclusion result is established for a specified linear error model and fixed ancillary policy; its conditions are distinguished from the approximations used in hardware. Native command bounds and a final command limiter keep the sent commands within their prescribed range. On a two-axis embedded platform, four controller configurations are compared in seven repeated trials each. The proposed configuration achieves a two-dimensional pointing root-mean-square error of $3.94 \pm 0.10$ mrad with no command-limit samples in the evaluation windows. Its performance supports the combined use of residual prediction and adaptive command margins in the tested operating condition. Solver times and logged loop overruns are reported separately for the nominal 100 Hz implementation.

AI.tldr: 针对双轴电流指令伺服转台的失配机械扰动视线指向问题，提出分位数扰动预测器与管式MPC，在嵌入式平台实现3.94±0.10 mrad指向精度。
AI.motivation: 摩擦、转矩脉动、电流响应滞后、模型失配与驱动指令受限相互耦合，使双轴电流指令伺服转台的高精度视线指向控制困难；且扰动的可预测分量与残余不确定性未被分离开建模利用。
AI.method: 用状态、指令与参考历史学习扰动中位数与外分位数构成分位数扰动预测器；中位数改善名义预测，外分位半径经标定后用于管式MPC的阶段相关输入裕度，从而在不增加优化变量前提下自适应预留指令余量；针对给定线性误差模型与固定辅助策略给出有限时域管包含结论，并指出与硬件实现所用近似的差别；保留原生指令界并用末端限幅器约束下发指令。
AI.result: 双轴嵌入式平台上对四种控制器配置各重复七次试验，所提配置取得二维指向RMSE 3.94±0.10 mrad，评估窗口内无指令饱和样本；100 Hz标称实现下单独报告了求解时间与循环超时次数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在测试工况下，残余预测与自适应指令裕度的联合使用是有效的；理论保证仅覆盖理想化误差模型，硬件近似需另行评估。

title: DiffAuction: An Auction-Driven Framework for Generative Image Advertising
summary: Diffusion models enable multiple advertisers to compete for exposure within a shared generated image. Yet existing approaches are computationally costly when generating images under varying target-share configurations, and it remains unclear how the resulting outcomes should be evaluated and priced. To address these gaps, we propose DiffAuction, a framework integrating controllable generation, click-intent evaluation, and auction design. First, our training-free Residual Share Calibration (RSC) decomposes joint-attention updates into product-specific residuals and rescales them according to target shares. We further introduce Share-Conditioned Prompting (SCP) to adapt the viewpoint to each desired allocation. Second, we develop an evaluator that uses a VLM to extract visual evidence and an LLM to assess Click-Through Intent (CTI), a proxy for click propensity, along four dimensions: Product Prominence, Brand Recognizability, Scene Integration, and Contextual Value Communication. We validate its assessments against judgments from 10 trained annotators on 1000 images. Third, we formulate this advertising setting as an auction over jointly feasible generation configurations. Each configuration has a public expected CTI vector, while advertisers hold configuration-specific private values per unit of CTI that map click intent into commercial value. We adopt a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA), which jointly selects a shared generation configuration and determines advertiser-specific payments to maximize expected platform revenue. The resulting allocation and payment rules guarantee dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and individual rationality (IR). Experiments show that our generation method strengthens the monotonic relationship between target shares and CTI relative to baselines, while the learned AMA achieves higher platform revenue in the resulting auction setting.

AI.tldr: DiffAuction：面向生成图像内多广告主曝光份额竞争的拍卖框架，含免训练的可控生成（RSC+SCP）、VLM/LLM 驱动的点击意向（CTI）评估器，以及保证DSIC与IR的可学习仿射最大化拍卖（AMA）。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型内多广告主共享生成图像的方法，在不同目标份额配置下生成成本高，且缺乏对产出结果的评估与定价机制。
AI.method: (1) Residual Share Calibration（RSC）：将联合注意力更新分解为产品特定残差并按目标份额重缩放，免训练；(2) Share-Conditioned Prompting（SCP）按目标分配调整视角；(3) 评估器：VLM提视觉证据 + LLM按四维（产品显著性、品牌可识别性、场景融合、语境价值传达）打分CTI，并用1000图、10名标注员验证；(4) 拍卖：在联合可行生成配置上定义拍卖，配置有公开期望CTI向量，广告主对每单位CTI持配置相关私有价值，采用可学习AMA联合选择配置并确定支付，最大化平台期望收益。
AI.result: 生成方法相对基线增强了目标份额与CTI间的单调关系；在所得拍卖设定下，学习到的AMA取得更高平台收益；标注对比验证了CTI评估器的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把可控生成、可解释评估与机制设计统一为端到端广告拍卖管线，为生成式广告资源分配提供可定价、具策略鲁棒性的方案。

title: Rethinking Data Imbalance in Class Incremental Surgical Instrument Segmentation
summary: In surgical instrument segmentation, the increasing variety of instruments over time poses a significant challenge for existing neural networks, as they are unable to effectively learn such incremental tasks and suffer from catastrophic forgetting. When learning new data, the model experiences a sharp performance drop on previously learned data. Although several continual learning methods have been proposed for incremental understanding tasks in surgical scenarios, the issue of data imbalance often leads to a strong bias in the segmentation head, resulting in poor performance. Data imbalance can occur in two forms: (i) class imbalance between new and old data, and (ii) class imbalance within the same time point of data. Such imbalances often cause the dominant classes to take over the training process of continual semantic segmentation (CSS). To address this issue, we propose SurgCSS, a novel plug-and-play CSS framework for surgical instrument segmentation under data imbalance. Specifically, we generate realistic surgical backgrounds through inpainting and blend instrument foregrounds with the generated backgrounds in a class-aware manner to balance the data distribution in various scenarios. We further propose the Class Desensitization Loss by employing contrastive learning to correct edge biases caused by data imbalance. Moreover, we dynamically fuse the weight parameters of the old and new models to achieve a better trade-off between the biased and unbiased model weights. To investigate the data imbalance problem in surgical scenarios, we construct a new benchmark for surgical instrument CSS by integrating datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving significant performance improvement against existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 SurgCSS，一个用于数据不平衡条件下手术器械持续语义分割（CSS）的即插即用框架：用修复生成真实背景并按类别感知混合前景以平衡分布，提出类去敏化损失（对比学习纠偏边缘偏置），并动态融合新旧模型权重。
AI.motivation: 手术器械种类不断增加，现有网络难以持续学习新任务且出现灾难性遗忘；已有持续学习方法受两类数据不平衡（新旧类间、同一时刻类内）影响，导致分割头偏置、主类主导训练、性能下降。
AI.method: 1）通过图像修复（inpainting）生成逼真手术背景，将器械前景按类别感知方式与新背景合成以平衡各场景的数据分布；2）提出 Class Desensitization Loss，利用对比学习纠正数据不平衡导致的边缘偏置；3）动态融合新旧模型权重参数，在偏置与无偏权重之间取得更好权衡；4）整合数据集构建手术器械 CSS 新基准。
AI.result: 在新建的手术器械 CSS 基准上，大量实验证明框架有效，相较现有基线取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SurgCSS 以即插即用方式缓解持续语义分割中的数据不平衡问题，结合背景合成、对比学习损失与权重动态融合，可有效抑制灾难性遗忘与分割头偏置，适用于手术器械增量分割场景。

title: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
summary: An action seen once and the same action seen three times receive the same action-recognition label, so that supervision does not require a model to count. Answers shared across histories that differ in event order, accumulation, or relations leave those distinctions unconstrained; we call this state under-specification. Visible-State Supervision (ViSS) addresses it by training on source-grounded probes of event identity, order, accumulation, relation change, and answer sufficiency; under the same recent-frame interface it improves OVO-Bench over a strict-matched generic temporal supervision baseline while remaining comparable on StreamingBench, with the largest gain in hallucination detection. Test-Time Causal View Search (TVS) then adapts evidence access while keeping the learned model fixed, expanding from recent frames to sparse event and compact history views on demand. The two interventions separate representation from view selection: supervision particularly benefits hallucination detection and causal reasoning, access particularly benefits event recall and forward reasoning. Together they reach the best reported accuracy among the published systems compared here on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench at a fraction of the processed frames of exhaustive selection, and strict replay shows that most of the remaining gap to a three-view oracle is a correct answer that was later replaced. Streaming accuracy depends on what supervision asks the model to keep, what evidence inference exposes, and whether the model keeps a correct answer once it has one.

AI.tldr: 提出"可见状态监督"(ViSS)与"测试时因果视图搜索"(TVS)两项干预，分别从监督信号与证据访问两方面改进流式视频的时序推理，在OVO-Bench与StreamingBench上取得最优成绩且处理帧数更少。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频动作识别/时序问答中，相同答案覆盖了事件顺序、累积、关系等不同历史，导致"状态欠定"(under-specification)；同时模型默认只看近期帧，证据访问受限。作者希望把"表征学习"与"证据视图选择"解耦并分别改进。
AI.method: ViSS：在最近帧接口下用源数据构造可验证探针（事件身份、顺序、累积、关系变化、答案充分性）进行监督训练；TVS：固定模型参数，在推理时按需从最近帧扩展到稀疏事件视图与紧凑历史视图，搜索因果视图。严格重放分析剩余差距。
AI.result: 同等接口下ViSS优于严格匹配的通用时序监督基线（OVO-Bench），StreamingBench可持平，幻觉检测增益最大；TVS显著提升事件回忆与前向推理。二者结合在两基准上达已发表系统最佳，且处理帧数远少于穷举选择；与三视图oracle的差距主要来自正确答案被后续替换。
AI.conclusion: 流式准确率取决于三件事：监督要求模型保留什么、推理暴露哪些证据、以及模型能否在得到正确答案后不丢失。监督与访问需解耦设计。

title: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
summary: Dynamic target tracking requires a mobile robot to maintain target visibility while navigating obstacles with smooth, feasible controls. Online trajectory optimization explicitly encodes these objectives but requires repeated numerical solving, whereas waypoint-based neural policies separate geometric prediction from control execution. We introduce LECO, a framework that transfers tracking optimization into offline learning of a direct-control policy. LECO predicts control sequences and maps them to trajectories through a differentiable kinematic model, allowing trajectory-level objectives to directly guide control learning. A decaying expert-guidance curriculum initializes effective tracking behavior and progressively shifts learning toward these task objectives. At deployment, a predictive safety lock checks short-horizon obstacle clearance and invokes a classical planning and control fallback when the predicted motion is unsafe or the target prediction is invalid. Across three simulated obstacle densities, LECO reduces root-mean-square linear jerk by 14.1--31.2\% relative to the best competing method for this metric and achieves the highest tracking success rate, with per-cycle computation times of 4.25--5.63\,ms. Experiments on two robot platforms further demonstrate tracking through indoor narrow passages and outdoor forest environments. These results demonstrate that learning direct control from optimization enables smooth and robust dynamic target tracking.

AI.tldr: LECO 将在线轨迹优化"蒸馏"为离线直接控制策略：策略预测控制序列，经可微运动学模型映射为轨迹，使轨迹级目标直接监督控制学习；配合衰减式专家引导课程与部署时预测安全锁（必要时回退经典规划控制）。
AI.motivation: 动态目标跟踪需在避障同时保持目标可见且控制平滑可行。在线轨迹优化需反复数值求解、实时性差；基于路点的神经策略把几何预测与控制执行解耦，难以端到端优化轨迹级目标（平滑性、可行性）。
AI.method: 1) 直接控制网络输出控制序列，用可微运动学模型前向生成预测轨迹，从而以轨迹级损失（跟踪、避障、jerk 平滑）反向传播监督控制输出；2) 衰减式专家引导课程：早期用专家（优化/规划器）数据初始化跟踪行为，逐步提高任务目标权重、退火专家项；3) 部署时预测安全锁：检测短时域障碍间隙与目标预测有效性，不安全则调用经典规划+控制回退，保证安全性。
AI.result: 三种模拟障碍密度下，相对该指标最优对比方法，均方根线性 jerk 降低 14.1–31.2%，跟踪成功率最高；单周期计算 4.25–5.63 ms。两套真实机器人平台上完成室内狭窄通道与户外森林环境跟踪实验。
AI.conclusion: 从优化中学习直接控制可兼顾平滑性与鲁棒性，获得实时、可部署的动态目标跟踪策略；可微运动学+课程+安全回退是有效的工程组合范式。

title: Fed-MAPTrack: Federated Modality-aware Prompt Tuning for RGB-X Tracking
summary: RGB-X tracking complements RGB appearance with thermal, depth, or event observations, but centralized training requires collecting multimodal videos at a single location. Federated training keeps raw videos local, but sensor heterogeneity can create a mismatch between parameter-sharing domains and the clients contributing to them. This mismatch is particularly relevant when RGB-only clients coexist with sensor-equipped clients: their RGB observations remain useful, but they provide no auxiliary measurements for learning sensor-dependent interactions. We propose Fed-MAPTrack, a modality-aware federated prompt tuning framework for RGB-X tracking. The pretrained tracking backbone and prediction head are frozen, and clients optimize and exchange only prompt-related parameters. The server aggregates RGB-shared parameters globally and maintains separate thermal, event, and depth banks for auxiliary-specific, fusion, and normalization parameters. Selective participation retains RGB-only clients' contributions to the global RGB bank while excluding their fusion and normalization updates from modality-specific aggregation. Across three matched training repetitions under a fixed client partition, Fed-MAPTrack improves the mean FedAvg scores by 2.35 AUC points on LasHeR, 3.45 SR points on VisEvent, and 2.11 F-score points on DepthTrack. Among the nine evaluated methods, it achieves the highest mean thermal AUC and depth F-score, while its mean event SR is 0.07 points below that of Independent FL. Controlled ablations show that extending the bucketing scope without a compatible participation rule can reduce performance. These results highlight the need to jointly define the sharing domain and eligible contributors for each parameter group.

AI.tldr: Fed-MAPTrack: 面向 RGB-X 跟踪的模态感知联邦提示微调框架，冻结骨干与预测头，仅交换与提示相关参数；服务器按参数类型分域聚合（全局 RGB 共享 + 热/事件/深度专属 bank），并引入选择性参与规则排除纯 RGB 客户的融合/归一化更新。
AI.motivation: 集中式多模态跟踪需在同一地点采集 RGB-X 视频；联邦学习可保数据本地化，但传感器异构导致"参数共享域"与"实际贡献客户"不匹配，尤其纯 RGB 客户存在时无法提供辅助模态交互监督。
AI.method: 以预训练跟踪骨干+预测头为冻结模块，客户仅优化提示相关参数；服务器对 RGB 共享参数做全局聚合，对热/事件/深度分别维护专属 bank（含辅助模态专属、融合与归一化参数）；选择性参与：纯 RGB 客户只更新全局 RGB bank，其融合与归一化更新被排除在模态专属聚合之外。
AI.result: 固定客户划分下的三次匹配训练重复：FedAvg 均值在 LasHeR 上提升 2.35 AUC、VisEvent 上提升 3.45 SR、DepthTrack 上提升 2.11 F-score；九种方法中取得最高平均热红外 AUC 与深度 F-score，事件 SR 仅比 Independent FL 低 0.07。消融表明在缺少兼容参与规则时扩大分桶范围会掉点。
AI.conclusion: 参数分域与可参与客户须联合定义，才能缓解模态异质下的联邦多模态跟踪性能损失。

title: DimFlow: Bidirectional Grid-Expert Learning for Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Dynamic Gaussian reconstruction requires compact scene features to support coordinated changes in geometry and appearance. A factorized grid provides efficient local queries, but accurate interpolation alone does not ensure that the resulting dynamic attributes remain compatible across space and time. We introduce DimFlow, a framework that learns these features through bidirectional interaction between a multi-resolution grid and a coordinate-based expert branch. Feature-level adversarial alignment connects their distributions, adaptive fusion transfers complementary information, and activation-masked residual feedback refines the grid during training. Four attribute experts organize deformation, rotation, opacity, and temporal information before Gaussian rendering. In the aggregate comparison across D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, and DAVIS, DimFlow achieves 39.73 dB PSNR, improving on 4D-GS by 1.92 dB while matching its reported 85 FPS rendering speed. The model occupies 18.9 MB, compared with 18.3 MB for 4D-GS. Component and attribute-expert ablations reveal complementary contributions from feature alignment, adaptive exchange, and temporal processing.

AI.tldr: DimFlow通过多分辨率网格与坐标专家分支的双向交互学习紧凑特征，实现动态高斯重建，在D-NeRF/HyperNeRF/DAVIS上达39.73 dB PSNR，比4D-GS高1.92 dB且保持85 FPS、18.9 MB。
AI.motivation: 动态高斯重建需要紧凑场景特征以协调几何与外观变化；因子化网格支持高效局部查询，但仅靠精确插值无法保证生成的动态属性在时空上兼容。作者希望引入坐标网络专家分支来弥补纯网格表示的泛化与一致性不足。
AI.method: 提出DimFlow框架：多分辨率网格与坐标（coordinate-based）专家分支进行双向交互。含三部分机制——特征级对抗对齐（对齐两分支特征分布）、自适应融合（传递互补信息）、激活掩码残差反馈（训练中对网格进行精化）。另设四个属性专家分别建模形变、旋转、不透明度与时间信息，再送入高斯渲染。
AI.result: 在D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DAVIS三数据集汇总比较中达39.73 dB PSNR，较4D-GS提升1.92 dB，渲染速度与4D-GS报告的85 FPS相当；模型体积18.9 MB（4D-GS为18.3 MB）。组件与属性专家消融显示特征对齐、自适应信息交换与时间处理各有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 混合架构（网格+坐标专家+对抗对齐）可在几乎不增加存储与几乎不牺牲速度的前提下显著提升动态高斯重建精度，为紧凑动态场景表示提供了可验证的设计路径。

title: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents built on vision-language models interact with continuously evolving interfaces, yet conventional inference repeatedly recomputes representations of largely overlapping observations and histories. This mismatch makes multi-step interaction costly, while changes in context, interface content, and action arguments prevent straightforward cache reuse. We introduce GUIFlow, a framework for full-pipeline incremental inference in multi-image GUI interaction. Our central insight is that advancing a decision need not require rebuilding all supporting representations: each interaction step can instead selectively update computational states maintained across the trajectory. To support new decisions as the context evolves, GUIFlow adapts how past computation is reused: historical KV states are position-aligned and injected into the current context; change signals guide selective updates of current-observation states in the vision encoder and language model; and earlier action responses serve as speculative drafts verified by the target model. Together, these mechanisms enable cross-step reuse throughout visual encoding, prefill, and decoding without additional training, a separate draft model, or changes to the model-visible inputs and action interface. Experiments demonstrate up to 3.39x geometric-mean speedup across offline multi-image benchmarks and up to 3.49x in online, closed-loop interaction on OSWorld, while maintaining task performance broadly comparable to the dense baseline.

AI.tldr: GUIFlow: 面向多图GUI交互的全流水线增量推理框架，通过跨步复用KV状态、视觉编码器/LM状态的选择性更新与动作投机解码，无需训练即实现约3.4倍加速。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体在多步交互中反复对高度重叠的观察与历史做全量重算，造成显著冗余开销；但上下文变化、界面内容变动与动作参数变化又阻碍了朴素缓存复用。
AI.method: 提出"推进决策无需重建全部支撑表示"的观点：历史KV状态经位置对齐注入当前上下文；变化信号引导视觉编码器与语言模型的当前观测状态选择性更新；先前动作响应作为投机草稿由目标模型验证。机制覆盖视觉编码、prefill与decoding三阶段，无需额外训练、独立草稿模型或修改模型可见输入与动作接口。
AI.result: 离线多图基准上几何平均加速最高3.39倍，OSWorld在线闭环交互中最高3.49倍，任务性能与稠密基线大体相当。
AI.conclusion: 跨步增量计算可有效消除GUI多步交互中的表示冗余，且以训练无关方式实现端到端加速，为GUI智能体的高效部署提供通用性方案。

title: Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup for Robust Camera-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-based bird's-eye view (BEV) perception methods such as Fast-BEV have demonstrated promising results with fast inference speed and competitive accuracy. However, their robustness to real-world corruptions remains insufficiently explored, posing risks for autonomous driving deployment where environmental variations are inevitable. In this paper, we propose Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup (SR-BEVS), a sparse recovery learning approach that simultaneously improves clean accuracy and corruption robustness without requiring additional data or architectural modifications. Our method identifies pruning candidates based on layer-wise weight magnitudes, applies random pruning to create diverse sparse models, and retrains each model with a randomly sampled learning rate. By averaging these diverse recovered models into a single dense model, we achieve enhanced robustness against various corruptions while introducing zero inference overhead. We further provide a mode connectivity analysis demonstrating that our pruning-based diversification preserves the connected low-loss basin necessary for stable weight averaging. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate up to 33.8% improvement in corruption robustness and a 1.8% gain in clean accuracy over the Fast-BEV baseline, with consistent improvements across sensor noise, weather distortions, and illumination changes. Our simple yet effective approach may be applicable to other BEV models.

AI.tldr: SR-BEVS：基于层权重幅值的随机剪枝+随机学习率重训生成多样稀疏模型，再权重平均成单个稠密模型，零推理开销同时提升Fast-BEV的干净精度与腐蚀鲁棒性（nuScenes上+33.8%鲁棒性、+1.8%干净精度），并给出模式连通性分析。
AI.motivation: 相机BEV感知（如Fast-BEV）推理快、精度可用，但对真实世界腐蚀（噪声、天气、光照）的鲁棒性研究不足，而自动驾驶部署中环境变化不可避免。作者希望在不增加数据、不改结构、不增推理开销的前提下同时提升干净精度与腐蚀鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1）按逐层权重大小确定剪枝候选；2）对候选施加随机剪枝，产生多个不同的稀疏模型；3）对每个稀疏模型用随机采样的学习率分别重训（稀疏恢复）；4）将这些多样化恢复模型的权重平均为一个稠密模型（model soup）。（5）用模式连通性分析说明剪枝式多样化保留了稳定权重平均所需的连接低损失盆地。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，相对Fast-BEV基线，腐蚀鲁棒性最高提升33.8%，干净精度提升1.8%；在传感器噪声、天气畸变与光照变化上均取得一致改进；推理时零额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 一种简单有效的“剪枝多样化+稀疏恢复+权重平均”方案可同时改善BEV模型的精度与腐蚀鲁棒性，且不引入推理成本，思路有望迁移到其他BEV模型。

title: Reason or Recite: Complementary Specialists with an LLM Judge for Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the AI City Challenge Workshop, ECCV 2026. 1st place in Track 3 (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning)
summary: Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per question with a training-free LLM judge. RoR ranks first on the in-domain leaderboard with mean score 0.6788.

AI.tldr: 提出双专家框架 Reason-or-Recite (RoR) 参加 2026 AI City Challenge 交通异常推理赛道：改写 CoT 标注并 LoRA 微调 9B 模型 + 4-bit 27B 模型仅学答案风格，再用免训练 LLM 裁判选题，域内榜单第一（0.6788）。
AI.motivation: 交通异常场景的实用系统不仅要检测，还要核验事件、描述场景、解释成因。作者观察到视觉语言模型的这两类能力存在张力：闭式问题奖励精确、有证据支撑的推理；开放式答案按与参考文本的相似度评分，匹配标注风格与推理正确同样重要。因此单一模型难以兼顾，需要分工。
AI.method: (1) 将官方 chain-of-thought 标注重写为结构化、带时间定位的 schema，在增强轨迹上用 LoRA 微调 9B VLM，得到"推理专家"；(2) 在答案本身上微调 4-bit 量化的 27B 模型，吸收标注风格，得到"背诵/风格专家"；(3) 采用免训练 LLM 裁判，按问题逐题在两个候选答案间选择。
AI.result: 在 AI City Challenge 2026 Traffic Anomaly Reasoning 赛道域内榜单排名第一，平均分 0.6788。
AI.conclusion: "闭式推理"与"开放风格匹配"可由两个专家模型分工、再用 LLM 裁判路由来同时满足，是一种低成本、无需额外训练的集成策略；但结论建立在单一赛道基准上，缺乏跨域泛化与消融证据。
