title: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
summary: Long-video generators increasingly retrieve past visual observations to prevent identity drift. The intuition is compelling: more access to history should make future video more consistent. But an image can be faithful to the past and wrong for the present. Does visual memory always improve the generated story? We investigate this question through VMem-Bench, a two-track diagnostic study. Track-A measures which references are selected from 92 real films (16,548 segments), before generation and without generator confounds. Track-B compares four retrieval policies with no-memory and gold-informed last-seen controls on 30 causally generated stories (2,824 segments) using a shared generator. Retrieval increases entity recall from 0.559 to 0.628-0.693 and improves similarity to past appearances, but decreases precision from 0.977 to 0.915-0.938 and forbidden-entity avoidance from 0.968 to 0.845-0.898. It can also reinforce obsolete appearances after the story changes them. Conversely, high long-gap recall can arise without memory when the prompt itself supplies the appearance; an appearance-stripping analysis exposes this confound. These results distinguish historical fidelity from current-story correctness and show why retrieval relevance or final-video consistency alone does not establish memory utility.

AI.tldr: VMem-Bench 双轨诊断研究检验"视觉记忆是否总是改善长视频生成"：检索历史帧能提升实体召回与外观相似度，但降低精度与禁用实体规避能力，并会强化已过时的外观。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成器普遍通过检索过去视觉观测来抑制身份漂移，隐含假设是"历史访问越多越一致"。但作者指出忠实于过去不等同于对当前叙事正确（图像可能忠于历史却不符合当下剧情），因此需要区分"历史保真度"与"当前故事正确性"，并检验检索相关性或最终视频一致性是否足以证明记忆有效性。
AI.method: 构建 VMem-Bench 两轨诊断：Track-A 在生成前、无生成器混淆的条件下，基于 92 部真实影片（16,548 段）测量参考帧选择策略；Track-B 在同一生成器上，于 30 条因果生成故事（2,824 段）中比较四种检索策略与"无记忆"和"gold-informed last-seen"两类对照。另设外观剥离（appearance-stripping）分析，用于揭示提示词本身提供外观时产生的高长间隔召回混淆。
AI.result: 检索将实体召回从 0.559 提升至 0.628–0.693，并提高与历史外观的相似度；但精度从 0.977 降至 0.915–0.938，禁用实体规避率从 0.968 降至 0.845–0.898。故事设定改变后，检索还会强化已过时的外观。外观剥离分析表明，无记忆条件下也能出现高长间隔召回，说明该指标存在混淆。
AI.conclusion: 视觉记忆并非无代价的增益：它偏向历史保真而非当前叙事正确。评估记忆效用不能仅依赖检索相关性或最终视频一致性，需同时度量精度、禁用实体规避与对设定变更的适应性。

title: DUET4D: Self-Corrective Coupled Guidance for Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view 4D reconstruction is highly under-constrained when only a few cameras are available. Generative priors can recover missing appearances, but video models are computationally impractical for iterative reconstruction, whereas single-view models produce temporally inconsistent pseudo-observations. Moreover, directly absorbing uncertain generative outputs into Gaussian optimization often creates redundant primitives and floating artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose DUET4D, a self-corrective coupled guidance framework for sparse-view 4D Gaussian splatting. The core of our approach is a self-corrective framework where the 4D representation guides generative prior for spatio-temporal consistent supervisions. We first construct sequential alignments from current Gaussian evidence to steer the latent restoration. Then we use Sequential Fidelity Resampling to lift generative supervisions into Gaussian space to selectively distinguish repeatedly supported primitives. The corrected representation then provides more reliable Gaussian evidence for the next restoration cycle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET4D significantly improves rendering quality and rendering efficiency.

AI.tldr: DUET4D：用自校正耦合引导框架解决稀疏视角4D高斯泼溅的重建欠约束问题，通过4D表示反向引导生成先验，并配合序列保真重采样过滤冗余基元。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角4D重建严重欠约束。视频生成先验计算量过大不适合迭代优化，单视图生成模型产生时间不一致的伪观测；且直接吸收不确定的生成结果会引入冗余高斯基元与漂浮伪影。
AI.method: DUET4D自校正耦合引导框架：(1) 从当前高斯证据构造序列对齐，引导潜空间恢复；(2) 用序列保真重采样(Sequential Fidelity Resampling)将生成监督提升到高斯空间，依据多轮重复支持度区分并筛除不可靠基元；(3) 校正后的表示再为下一轮恢复提供更可靠的证据，形成闭环迭代。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DUET4D在渲染质量和渲染效率上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将生成先验与4D高斯表示双向耦合、并显式过滤不确定生成监督，是稀疏视角动态重建的有效范式。

title: Shifted Window Temporal Transformer for YOLO-Guided Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Surgery
summary: Intelligent operating rooms require accurate awareness of surgical workflow for better intra-operative decisions, teamwork, and surgical documentation. Therefore, accurately recognizing surgical phase during surgery is crucial. However, previous artificial intelligence-based methods provide fluctuating predictions for the transitions, restricting their clinical use. To address this challenge, we propose a clinically meaningful framework that integrates a Swin Transformer and Temporal Transformer Encoder (TTE) for effective surgical phase recognition and a parallel YOLOv11s network for real-time surgical instrument localization. To avoid phase flickering and to produce stable workflow predictions, a causal temporal smoothing is applied. The proposed framework is tested on the Cholec80 dataset for the simultaneous recognition of the surgical phases and instruments. The overall phase recognition accuracy of this model was 92%, and the macro average F1-score was 0.86. This performance surpasses CNN based methods such as EndoNet (81.7%) and SV-RCNet (85.3%), as well as temporal convolutional and transformer-based approaches including TeCNO (88.6%), Trans-SVNet (90.9%), and LoViT (91.5%). Besides, the module of instrument detection achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.863. The reliability of the results is confirmed, obtaining a high recognition rate of the workflows, and a high accuracy of the localization of the instruments. The proposed framework can serve as a foundation for intelligent surgical assistance, enriching situation awareness, and potential robotic surgery applications. Code will be made publicly available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该文提出集成Swin Transformer与时间Transformer编码器(TTE)的手术阶段识别框架，并行YOLOv11s实时定位手术器械，并用因果时间平滑抑制阶段抖动；在Cholec80上阶段准确率92%、macro-F1 0.86，器械检测mAP@0.5=0.863。
AI.motivation: 智能手术室需要对手术流程的准确感知，以支持术中决策、团队协作与手术记录。既往基于AI的方法在阶段切换处预测波动明显（phase flickering），限制其临床应用，因此需要更稳定、临床可用的阶段识别方案。
AI.method: Swin Transformer骨干加时间Transformer编码器(TTE)做手术阶段识别；并行YOLOv11s分支做器械实时定位；对阶段概率序列施加因果时间平滑（causal temporal smoothing）以抑制抖动、产生稳定预测。
AI.result: Cholec80上阶段识别总体准确率92%、macro-F1 0.86，超过EndoNet(81.7%)、SV-RCNet(85.3%)、TeCNO(88.6%)、Trans-SVNet(90.9%)、LoViT(91.5%)；器械检测mAP@0.5=0.863。方法偏工程组合，增益主要来自后处理平滑与骨干替换，缺乏消融与跨中心验证细节。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可同时提供稳定的阶段识别与器械定位，作为智能手术辅助与情境感知的基础，并可扩展至机器人手术场景；但属于医学视觉领域工作，与物理AI/具身智能核心议题关联较弱。

title: JevVLA: Jev-Inspired Energy-Based Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can select among discrete candidates for pick-and-place manipulation or generate continuous action chunks for motion control. Improving both forms of decision making through a common mechanism while retaining the capabilities of a pretrained policy is an important adaptation problem. Inspired by Jev's structured, probabilistic decision interface, we propose JevVLA, a lightweight energy-based adaptation framework for VLA policies. JevVLA instantiates this inspiration by modeling the relative quality of action proposals: with the base policy frozen, it learns a differentiable scalar energy conditioned on observations, task context, and actions, using execution feedback, expert corrections, or demonstration-derived preferences. JevVLA uses this single learned action preference function in two ways: its values compare discrete candidates, while its action gradients correct continuous actions or guide their generation. Candidate selection and continuous control thus share one trainable decision core. Each benchmark uses independently trained weights and fixed input/output encodings, while retaining the same core network with approximately 80,000 trainable parameters. On the held-out test sets, JevVLA improves task success over the respective matched base-policy controls by 1.28, 2.31, 1.60, 1.52, and 1.28 percentage points on MetaWorld MT50, VIMA, LanguageTable, LIBERO Plus, and CLIPort, respectively. These results support the feasibility of a lightweight, Jev-inspired energy model for adapting both discrete action selection and continuous action guidance. The JevVLA implementation will be open-sourced at this https URL .

AI.tldr: JevVLA：冻结VLA基座，学习约8万参数的标量能量函数，用其值比较离散动作候选、用其梯度修正或引导连续动作，实现统一的轻量适配决策核心。
AI.motivation: VLA策略存在两种决策形式（离散候选选择、连续动作块生成），需在保持预训练策略能力的条件下用统一机制同时提升两者，而重训练代价高。
AI.method: 在冻结基座策略上学习以观测、任务上下文和动作为条件的可微标量能量；训练信号来自执行反馈、专家纠正或示演偏好；能量值用于离散候选排序，能量梯度用于连续动作修正/生成引导；各基准独立训练权重、固定输入输出编码，共享同一约80k参数核心网络。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上相较匹配的基座策略控制，任务成功率分别提升1.28（MetaWorld MT50）、2.31（VIMA）、1.60（LanguageTable）、1.52（LIBERO Plus）、1.28（CLIPort）个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了轻量能量模型作为通用适配接口，可同时服务离散动作选择与连续动作引导的可行性；增益幅度偏小，缺乏真机验证。

title: When Pointing Becomes Profiling: Social Bias and Refusal in Text-Steerable Visual Encoders
summary: Text-steerable visual encoders condition a frozen Vision Transformer on a natural-language prompt and point at the matching image region, producing prompt-conditioned heatmaps and features. We audit the released SteerViT model and find that its steering interface turns language-driven pointing into demographic profiling. On counterfactual face mosaics and real multi-person photographs, "the person" selects a man more often than the base rate, crime words select Black people more often than occupation words do, "the man" among four women selects the Black woman 75.6% of the time on SocialCounterfactuals, and "the monkey" selects Black people. None of them is in the backbone's unsteered saliency, and the crime association is not in the frozen text encoder; the race effects grow with steering strength and enter through the last two cross-attention layers: giving the prompt to those layers alone reproduces them. Four other grounding models, CLIPSeg, Grounding-DINO, SAM 3, and Qwen2.5-VL, show no crime routing and weaker race routing. The model cannot refuse. Its patch softmax must place its mass somewhere, and its heatmap separates a groundable request ("the police officer") from one that is absent ("the pizza") or that would require a stereotyped demographic inference ("the criminal") only at chance (AUROC 0.52). We introduce SafeSteer, which adds a learned abstention output and counterfactual-invariance training on the same 23M steering parameters. SafeSteer separates should-point from should-abstain prompts at AUROC 0.997, generalizes to held-out sensitive and absent words (0.998; at a 0.5 threshold it refuses 99.8% of trained and 62% of held-out sensitive words) with no over-refusal of visible people on the benchmark, and removes most race routing while keeping localization and retrieval within 1 point of the released model. Code, benchmarks, and the curated mosaic sets will be released.

AI.tldr: 审计发现文本可操控视觉编码器SteerViT的引导接口会把语言指向变成人口统计画像（如"the monkey"指向黑人），效应经最后两层交叉注意力进入且无法拒答；作者提出SafeSteer加入学习式弃答与反事实不变性训练，AUROC 0.997地分离"该指/不该指"提示，显著削弱种族路由且定位与检索性能损失在1点内。
AI.motivation: 文本可引导视觉编码器（prompt-conditioned heatmap与特征）被广泛用作定位接口，但其"必须把softmax质量放在某处"的机制可能导致对不存在目标或需刻板推断的提示强行指认，从而产生人口统计偏置与安全风险。作者要审计该风险并给出可拒答的修正方案。
AI.method: 对发布的SteerViT在反事实人脸拼图与真实多人物照片上进行反事实审计（基线与未引导显著性、冻结文本编码器对照、逐层消融定位效应来源）；提出SafeSteer，在同一23M引导参数上增加学习式弃答输出头与反事实不变性训练。
AI.result: "the person"选中男性高于基率；crime词比occupation词更常选中黑人；四名女性中"the man"以75.6%选中黑人女性；效应随引导强度增强并由最后两层交叉注意力引入。CLIPSeg、Grounding-DINO、SAM 3、Qwen2.5-VL无crime路由且种族路由更弱。原模型区分可定位/不可定位/需刻板推断提示仅达随机水平（AUROC 0.52）。SafeSteer达0.997（留出敏感词0.998，0.5阈值下拒绝99.8%训练、62%留出敏感词），无视人过度拒答，定位与检索差距<1点。
AI.conclusion: 语言引导的视觉定位接口存在结构性人口统计画像风险，且源于交叉注意力而非文本编码器；通过弃答与反事实不变性微调可在极小性能代价下大幅缓解，为该类接口提供了可审计、可拒答的设计范式。

title: Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Estimation for Visual Perception in Lower-Limb Prostheses
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Integrated Systems in Medical Technologies 2026
summary: Monocular depth estimation has advanced rapidly with the development of foundation models that demonstrate strong zero-shot generalisation across diverse visual domains. However, the applicability of these models to visual perception for lower-limb prosthetics remains largely unexplored. Reliable depth perception is particularly important for prosthesis users, who often experience significant challenges when navigating stairs, uneven terrain, and other complex environments. To address this gap, we introduce the Lower-Limb Prosthesis (LP) dataset, a benchmark designed to evaluate depth perception from an emulated knee-level prosthetic viewpoint. Using this dataset, we evaluate four state-of-the-art monocular depth estimation foundation models. Our results provide the first systematic benchmark of monocular depth estimation performance from a prosthetic viewpoint, while highlighting both the challenges and the potential of deploying foundation models in prosthetic perception systems. The code and dataset are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出LP数据集，用于评估膝部假肢视角下的单目深度估计，并对4个SOTA深度基础模型做首个系统性基准评测。
AI.motivation: 深度基础模型虽具备强零样本泛化，但其在下肢假肢感知（尤其楼梯、非平整地形）中的适用性尚未被探索，缺乏针对假肢视角的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建Lower-Limb Prosthesis (LP)数据集，从模拟膝部假肢视角采集/构建数据；在该基准上评估四个SOTA单目深度估计基础模型。
AI.result: 给出假肢视角下首个系统性的单目深度估计性能基准，揭示基础模型在该视角下既有挑战也有应用潜力（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可望用于假肢感知系统，但仍存在明显挑战；数据集与代码已公开。

title: Revealing Imaging Characteristics of Thermal Wakes from Underwater Vehicles Without Cooling-Water Discharge
summary: Small uncrewed underwater vehicles are proliferating and threaten maritime security, yet evade sonar and magnetic sensors built for larger submarines. Infrared thermal wakes, generated by hydrodynamic displacement that modulates the cold-skin layer, offer a non-acoustic, non-magnetic alternative even without cooling-water discharge. Existing studies, however, rely on idealized simulations that fail to capture real-world backgrounds, offering limited guidance for target-background discrimination. We establish AVP-IR-Wake, the first large-scale, real-world, physically diverse benchmark of 161,485 frames collected over three years. We show that thermal wakes are extended structures of discrete vortices, violating the compactness assumption of conventional targets. We reveal local indistinguishability: individual wake vortices are statistically identical to wind-induced background vortices in temporal, frequency, and sparse domains, sharing low-frequency information and long-range correlations. This challenges the assumptions of compact, transient, high-frequency targets in conventional detection. Yet we establish global morphological separability: although locally inseparable, the wake as a whole is organized by vehicle trajectory, whereas background clutter is organized by wind-driven thermal fronts. This explains why representative detectors fail and shows that reliable detection must shift from local feature extraction to global trajectory-constrained physical modeling. Because the cold-skin layer varies globally and seasonally, forecasting wake observability will require integrating physical oceanography and atmospheric science, linking underwater surveillance to the changing ocean surface.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AVP-IR-Wake——首个大规模真实红外热尾流基准（161,485 帧，跨三年采集），揭示热尾流由离散涡构成、局部与风生背景涡统计不可分，但整体形态可按轨迹约束区分，从而指出检测应从局部特征提取转向全局轨迹约束的物理建模。
AI.motivation: 小型无人潜航器扩散威胁海上安全，却能规避为大型潜艇设计的声呐与磁传感器。红外热尾流提供非声、非磁的替代探测途径，但现有研究依赖理想化仿真，无法反映真实背景，难以指导目标—背景判别。
AI.method: 构建 AVP-IR-Wake 真实世界红外基准（161,485 帧、三年、物理条件多样）；对尾流涡与风生背景涡在时域、频域与稀疏域进行统计分析以验证局部不可分性；通过整体形态与组织机制分析（尾流由航迹组织、背景由风驱热锋组织）建立全局可分性；据此论证全局轨迹约束物理建模的必要性。
AI.result: 热尾流是离散涡的延展结构，违背传统目标的紧凑性假设；单涡与背景涡在时间、频率与稀疏域统计上不可区分，共享低频信息与长程相关性；代表性检测器因此失效；而尾流整体形态具备全局可分离性，指示了检测范式的转变方向。
AI.conclusion: 可靠热尾流检测需从局部特征提取转向全局轨迹约束的物理建模；冷皮层的全局与季节变化意味着尾流可观测性预报需融合物理海洋学与大气科学，将水下监视与变化的海表环境相联系。

title: Context-dependent Runtime Construction of Safe Regions of Attraction from Design-Time Identification for Multi-Candidate Simplex Architectures
summary: Deploying safety-critical cyber-physical systems requires control strategies that reconcile high performance and adaptability with rigorous safety guarantees. Classical control strategies offer stability proofs but are conservative, while advanced optimization- and learning-based controllers achieve high performance but lack formal verification. Runtime Assurance (RTA) architectures bridge this gap by introducing their own (dis-)advantages. Safety filters use online optimization and introduce chattering, while Simplex permissiveness is bounded by the tightness of the certified Region of Attraction (RoA) of its High-Assurance (HA) controller. Targeting this conservatism, we present a two-stage RoA certification procedure leveraging contraction-based stability to establish a target set for Taylor-model-based reachability analysis. We then treat the closed-loop system under HA control as a switched system, enabling: (a) runtime construction of context-dependent safe RoA and (b) safe switching between HA candidates to optimize recovery and maximize the operating envelope of the uncertified High-Performance (HP) controller. We validate this framework on a robotic path-tracking task using a three-stage evaluation: Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) simulation for theoretical verification, high-fidelity Gazebo simulation under unmodeled dynamics, and experiments on physical hardware. Results show that the Simplex architecture maintains safety under fault injection and successfully shields a behavioral-cloning-trained HP controller. Crucially, the decision module introduces negligible overhead (0.028 ms average, 4.13 ms worst-case), consuming under 10 % of the control period.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段 RoA 认证流程：先用基于收缩的稳定性分析确定目标集，再用 Taylor 模型可达性分析扩展，将 HA 控制下的闭环视为切换系统，实现运行时上下文相关的安全 RoA 构造与 HA 候选间安全切换，从而最大化未认证 HP 控制器的可运行包络。
AI.motivation: 经典控制保守、优化/学习方法缺形式化验证；RTA 自身也有缺陷：安全滤波器在线优化引发抖振，Simplex 的容许性受限于 HA 控制器认证吸引域（RoA）的紧致程度。目标是缓解这一保守性。
AI.method: 两阶段 RoA 认证：收缩理论（contraction-based stability）给出目标集，Taylor 模型可达性分析做扩张验证；把 HA 闭环建模为切换系统，支持运行时构建上下文相关安全 RoA、并在多个 HA 候选间安全切换以优化恢复并扩大 HP 控制器运行包络。
AI.result: 机器人路径跟踪任务三阶段验证（ODE 仿真、含未建模动力学的 Gazebo 高保真仿真、实机实验）：Simplex 架构在故障注入下保持安全，成功屏蔽行为克隆训练的 HP 控制器；决策模块开销可忽略（平均 0.028 ms，最坏 4.13 ms，占控制周期不足 10%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过可达性与收缩结合的 RoA 认证及切换式 Simplex 设计，可在保持形式化安全保证的同时显著提升 RTA 的容许性与实用性能，且计算开销适合实时部署。

title: DriveUniTok: A Unified Multimodal Tokenizer for Driving World-Action Models
summary: World models are emerging as a fundamental component of policy learning for real-world agents, enabling agents to predict future world states and plan actions within a learned representation of the dynamic environment. Existing approaches, however, often model appearance, metric geometry represented by projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion either partially or independently, overlooking the fact that these modalities are different projections of a shared underlying world state. This separation can lead to information loss and cross-modal inconsistency, ultimately limiting downstream performance. Motivated by this unified view of the world, we propose DriveUniTok, a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes these modalities in a single decodable continuous latent. We freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model, DriveUniWAM, to predict future unified latents; the tokenizer then decodes them into future appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that our unified design achieves better future prediction and planning performance at lower downstream computational cost than separate-stream alternatives. With reinforcement learning post-training, DriveUniWAM achieves a PDMS of 91.54, reaching state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated WAM-based planners.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的驾驶世界-动作模型多模态分词器 DriveUniTok，将外观、投影 LiDAR 深度与自车运动编码进单一可解码连续潜空间，并以冻结分词器 + 预训练扩散模型 DriveUniWAM 预测未来统一潜变量，再解码为未来外观、深度与轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型往往部分独立地建模外观、度量几何（投影 LiDAR 深度）与自车运动，忽视三者是同一潜在世界状态的不同投影，导致信息损失与跨模态不一致，限制下游预测与规划性能。
AI.method: DriveUniTok：统一多模态 tokenizer，将三类模态编码为单一连续潜表示且可分别解码；冻结 tokenizer 后基于预训练扩散模型构建 DriveUniWAM 预测未来统一潜变量，解码得到未来外观、投影 LiDAR 深度与自车轨迹；下游再加强化学习后训练。
AI.result: NAVSIM 上优于独立分流方案，未来预测与规划更佳且下游计算开销更低；经 RL 后训练，PDMS 达 91.54，在所评估的 WAM 类规划器中达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 统一潜空间的多模态分词是世界-动作模型的有效设计范式，可在更低计算成本下同时提升预测与规划，验证了"多模态为共享世界状态的不同投影"这一假设。

title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
comment: code: this https URL , project page: this https URL
summary: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.

AI.tldr: VISTA is a meta-agent framework that turns post-hoc rollout reflection for embodied "harness" (the scaffolding around foundation models) into active self-exploration, maintaining a harness graph of version lineage and iteratively probing failures in-environment to refine the harness.
AI.motivation: Embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models but also on the "harness" around them; prior work treats rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates that are never autonomously tested or refined through further embodied interaction.
AI.method: A meta-agent maintains a harness graph recording the lineage of proposed harnesses, enabling retrieval of prior hypotheses and avoidance of repeated failed directions. Each iteration starts from a retained harness version plus its execution evidence; instead of committing an update directly from history, the meta-agent actively explores the environment—generating new rollouts, probing failures and recovery behavior—and iteratively modifies the harness, then re-evaluates and adds it to the graph.
AI.result: On LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin, VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, reaching higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.
AI.conclusion: Active, evidence-driven harness self-improvement with lineage tracking outperforms static post-hoc reflection for embodied agents, though the paper only reports simulated benchmarks.

title: LOCUS: Locate Once, Check Until Settled. Draft-and-Verify Visual Grounding with a Box Head and Coordinate-Token Verification
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL Models: this https URL and this https URL
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) ground a referring expression in one of two ways. They decode the box as coordinate tokens, which is precise but takes one sequential step per token, or they regress it from a hidden state with a small head, which takes one step but loses accuracy at high IoU. The two fail differently: a head usually finds the right object but places its edges loosely, while coordinate tokens place edges precisely. We therefore use the regression head as a speculative drafter for the model's own coordinate tokens. Locus writes the head's box as coordinate tokens and checks them with the same backbone by Jacobi iteration over a shared image prefix. The fixed point is the model's greedy coordinate-token answer, reached in about 5.60 sequential passes on average instead of 18.46 decoding steps; head and verifier are one set of weights, trained jointly. On the 8 RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg splits, verification raises Locus-2B's Acc@0.9 from 54.87 for its own head to 59.13, and the one-pass head is ahead at Acc@0.5 of every published model with at most 3B parameters except Florence-2-L. Against Jag, the strongest open regression-head model, at its own size and training budget, Locus ties at Acc@0.5 and, with typical acceptance, gains +4.52 points at Acc@0.9, with paired significance tests. Exact answers come 1.5x faster than vLLM greedy-decoding the same coordinate tokens with the same weights; a pure regression head remains faster still.

AI.tldr: Locus 用回归头作为自身坐标 token 的"投机草稿器"：把头部预测的框写成坐标 token，再用同一骨干网络通过 Jacobi 迭代在共享图像前缀上校验，从而在约 5.6 次串行前向（对比 18.46 步自回归解码）内达到模型的贪心坐标 token 定点答案。
AI.motivation: VLM 指代定位有两条路线且失败模式互补：坐标 token 解码边缘精确但每 token 一步、速度慢；回归头一次前向但高 IoU 下精度不足（框找对了但边界松）。作者希望兼得二者，让回归头充当自家坐标 token 的高效草稿器，用同一套权重完成校验。
AI.method: 以回归头输出作为初始化，将框转写为坐标 token；共享图像前缀下用 Jacobi（并行）迭代反复校验并更新 token，直到收敛到模型贪心坐标 token 解码的固定点；起草器与校验器共享一套权重并联合训练。实验中与 vLLM 贪心解码、Jag 等回归头模型在等规模等训练预算下对比。
AI.result: 8 个 RefCOCO/+/g split 上，校验使 Locus-2B 的 Acc@0.9 从其回归头的 54.87 提升到 59.13；单次前向（head）版本在 Acc@0.5 上超过除 Florence-2-L 外所有 ≤3B 已发表模型。与 Jag 同规模同预算下 Acc@0.5 持平，典型接受率下 Acc@0.9 提升 +4.52 点（配对显著性检验）。获得精确答案比用相同权重在 vLLM 上贪心解码同一批坐标 token 快 1.5×；纯回归头仍最快。
AI.conclusion: 将"慢但精确"的坐标 token 与"快但粗糙"的回归头统一为同一权重的投机解码框架，可在显著减少串行步数的同时提升高 IoU 精度，是 VLM 定位的一种高效折中方案。

title: 3D-Force Estimation for Dual-arm Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects via Factor Graphs
summary: Estimating forces acting on Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is challenging due to their underactuated nature. However, reliable contact estimation is crucial to precisely control them and enable safe manipulation tasks. Differently from the various approaches presented in the literature, this work adopts a probabilistic formulation where the DLO state and sensor data are related through conditional distributions. In particular, factor graphs are used to determine the magnitude, direction, and location of a 3D force acting on a DLO, while simultaneously reconstructing its shape. Since DLOs are not actuated and are typically thin, like cables and wires, strain gauges and actuation readings are usually impractical. Therefore, to overcome this issue, this work is tested using one type of sensing information only, thus developing a generic technique suited for a wider variety of tasks. Realistic tests are performed by introducing noise into the measurements while the DLO follows a prescribed path in the presence of external forces that are accurately estimated.

AI.tldr: 采用因子图概率框架，仅用单一传感信息（含噪声）即可同时估计作用于柔性线状物体(DLO)的3D接触力的大小、方向、位置并重建其形状。
AI.motivation: DLO欠驱动且细长，难以通过应变片或驱动读数获取接触信息；可靠接触力估计对精确控制与安全操作至关重要，且希望设计一种仅依赖单一传感模态、适用于更广任务的通用方法。
AI.method: 将DLO状态与传感数据通过条件分布关联，构建因子图进行概率推断，联合优化力的大小、方向、位置与DLO形状重建；仅在单一传感信息（含测量噪声）下测试，DLO沿给定轨迹运动并受外力作用。
AI.result: 在引入测量噪声的真实感仿真测试中，DLO沿规定路径运动并受外力作用，外力被准确估计，同时完成形状重建。
AI.conclusion: 因子图概率建模为DLO接触力估计提供了一种通用、仅需单一传感模态的方案，可支撑后续精确控制与安全操作任务。

title: PushAround: Collaborative Path Clearing via Physics-Informed Hybrid Search
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). 8 pages, 11 figures. Supplementary video and evaluation records are included as ancillary files. Video: this https URL
summary: Large vehicles in cluttered environments are often blocked by movable obstacles, motivating mobile robot teams to clear traversable corridors. Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches often abstract obstacle displacements while neglecting robot dimensions, obstacle mass, contact geometry and forces, yielding physically infeasible plans. PushAround is a physics-informed hybrid search that couples geometric connectivity reasoning with short-horizon simulation to construct executable clearing plans. Repeated W-clearance connectivity graph (WCCG) queries expose frontier gaps requiring widening and rank them by estimated downstream costs. The search generates direct or recursive pushing candidates, selecting obstacles, directions, contacts and forces, and admits physics-evaluated candidates. Numerical experiments validate WCCG against standard connectivity checks and demonstrate scaling to denser clutter and teams of up to four robots, with robustness to simulated execution-side physical-parameter mismatch.

AI.tldr: PushAround：结合几何连通性推理与短时域物理仿真的混合搜索，为多机器人团队生成可执行的可移动障碍清障规划。
AI.motivation: 拥挤环境中的大型车辆常被可移动障碍阻挡，需要移动机器人团队开辟可通行通道；现有NAMO方法抽象化障碍位移，忽略机器人尺寸、障碍质量、接触几何与力，导致物理不可行规划。
AI.method: 提出物理感知混合搜索：用重复的W-clearance连通图(WCCG)查询识别需拓宽的前沿缺口并按估计的下游成本排序；生成直接或递归推动候选（选择障碍、方向、接触点与力），并通过短时域仿真筛选、接纳物理可行候选。
AI.result: 数值实验验证WCCG相对标准连通性检查的有效性，展示了在更密集杂波与最多四机器人团队下的可扩展性，并对执行侧物理参数失配具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将几何推理与物理仿真耦合可弥补纯抽象NAMO规划的不可行性，为多机器人清障提供可执行方案；但证据限于仿真，缺乏真实机器人验证。

title: Kronecker-Structured Video Completion with Cross-Fitted Self-Supervised Residual Learning
summary: Tube-wise video completion reconstructs temporal trajectories at spatial locations unobserved in every frame. We propose a two-stage framework combining regularized masked Kronecker product decomposition (KPD) with cross-fitted self-supervised residual learning. First, we estimate a compact structural backbone directly from observed entries using cyclic component-wise least-squares updates, spatial and temporal factor regularization, and regularizer-optimal scale balancing. The exact updates yield a nonincreasing objective. Second, we address the mismatch between in-sample fitting errors and the prediction errors encountered at missing tubes. We partition observed tubes into folds and construct residual targets using backbone models fitted without the corresponding target tubes. A lightweight 3-D convolutional neural network then predicts corrections from the backbone, visible residual context, observation mask, and local detail features. Exact data consistency preserves observed measurements. Experiments include ablations, sensitivity analysis, grayscale and RGB video completion, and structured missing patterns. Our method achieves the highest mean PSNR and SSIM at the higher tested sampling rates on the grayscale benchmark. On eight selected DAVIS RGB sequences, it achieves the highest mean missing-region PSNR and full-frame SSIM and the lowest mean missing-tube temporal-gradient MAE at every evaluated sampling rate.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段 tube-wise 视频补全框架：先用正则化掩码 Kronecker 积分解（KPD）从观测条目拟合低秩结构骨架，再用交叉拟合的自监督残差学习（3D CNN）修正缺失 tube 的预测误差。
AI.motivation: 整条 tube（所有帧中均未观测的空间位置）无法从任何帧获得信息，纯低秩模型在样本内拟合误差与缺失 tube 的预测误差之间存在系统性错配，需同时解决结构建模与泛化偏差两个问题。
AI.method: 阶段一：以循环逐分量最小二乘更新、空间/时间因子正则与正则项最优尺度平衡，直接从观测条目估计紧凑 KPD 骨架，更新保证目标函数单调不增。阶段二：将观测 tube 划分为若干折，用不含目标 tube 的骨架构造残差目标（交叉拟合），训练轻量 3D CNN 结合可见残差上下文、观测掩码与局部细节特征预测修正量，并用精确数据一致性约束保持观测值不变。
AI.result: 在灰度视频基准的高采样率下取得最高平均 PSNR/SSIM；在 8 段 DAVIS RGB 序列上，各采样率均取得最高缺失区域 PSNR、全帧 SSIM 与最低缺失 tube 时间梯度 MAE；并给出消融与敏感性分析及结构化缺失模式实验。
AI.conclusion: 将低秩张量分解的结构先验与交叉拟合的残差学习结合，可有效缓解样本内拟合偏差，是 tube-wise 视频补全的可行范式；但实验限于离线视频基准，规模与场景多样性有限，尚未涉及动态场景三维重建或机器人感知闭环。

title: MemVLN: Streaming Episodic Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through 3D environments. Maintaining persistent episodic memory remains a challenge for VLM-based streaming agents in long-horizon navigation. We present MEMVLN, a streaming episodic memory framework that maintains a bounded bank of compressed perceptual features annotated with timesteps and action-derived relative poses, and produces compact memory tokens via cross-attention. We pair the proposed memory with a frozen pretrained geometry encoder. To learn the memory module, we design a masking-based trajectory summarization task with multi-granularity sub-trajectory decomposition, encouraging route reconstruction exclusively from episodic memory. Under navigation training restricted to the official R2R/RxR trajectories, MEMVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics on standard VLN-CE benchmarks. Long-horizon analyses further characterize when episodic memory is useful. For physical evaluation, we collect 30 instruction-conditioned episodes in one physical scene, use 24 as demonstrations for post-training, and hold out six for testing. On the held-out episodes, MEMVLN improves success over the VLM baseline from 17% to 40%, and post-training further raises it to 47%.

AI.tldr: MEMVLN: 面向VLN-CE流式智能体的有界情节记忆框架，用压缩感知特征库+跨注意力生成记忆token，配冻结几何编码器，以掩码轨迹摘要任务训练，R2R/RxR上SOTA，真实场景成功率17%→40%→47%。
AI.motivation: VLM驱动的流式智能体在长时程3D导航中难以维持持久的情节记忆；现有方法缺乏对历史观测的有界、可压缩且可学习的记忆表示，长程一致性差。
AI.method: 构建有界记忆库，存储带时间戳与动作推导相对位姿的压缩感知特征；通过跨注意力生成紧凑记忆token；搭配冻结预训练几何编码器；设计多粒度子轨迹分解的掩码式轨迹摘要预训练任务，迫使仅凭情节记忆重建路线；导航训练仅用官方R2R/RxR轨迹。
AI.result: VLN-CE标准基准上多数指标达SOTA；长时程分析刻画了情节记忆的增益边界；真实场景30条指令条件episode（24条后训练、6条测试），成功率由VLM基线17%提升至40%，后训练后达47%。
AI.conclusion: 有界学习式情节记忆可作为VLM流式导航智能体的有效外挂模块，且记忆预训练与少量真实示范后训练可叠加提升；为长时程具身导航记忆设计提供可分析范式。

title: Zero-HLM: Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation without Real Robot Data
summary: Learning generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation remains bottlenecked by costly real-world demonstrations. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but requires visually faithful, physics-ready scenes and executable whole-body motions. We present Zero-HLM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms smartphone captures and simulated source demonstrations into scalable training data for humanoid loco-manipulation. Gaussian-guided agentic real-to-sim reconstruction aligns visual and physical scenes; motion-environment co-adaptation uses rollout feedback to correct whole-body references and interaction geometry. We generate 4,800 physically validated demonstrations for zero-shot transfer across three Unitree G1 tasks. Simulation-trained GR00T N1.7 achieves 66.7% mean full-task success, versus 46.7% with real-data training. On generalized configurations, expanded simulation training raises pooled success from 23% for base-trained real-data policies to 69%, without additional real demonstrations. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: Zero-HLM：以手机拍摄+仿真源演示驱动的real-to-sim-to-real流水线，通过高斯引导的智能体重建与运动-环境协同自适应，生成4,800条物理可行全身演示，实现Unitree G1零样本迁移（平均全任务成功率66.7% vs 真实数据46.7%）。
AI.motivation: 人形loco-manipulation的泛化受限于昂贵的真机演示；仿真虽可扩展，但需要视觉真实、物理可用的场景与可执行的全身运动，二者的自动获取是瓶颈。
AI.method: (1) Gaussian-guided agentic real-to-sim重建：由智能体编排多步流程，对齐视觉与物理场景；(2) motion-environment co-adaptation：利用策略rollout反馈迭代修正全身参考轨迹与交互几何；(3) 将智能手机采集与仿真源演示扩展为规模化训练数据，训练GR00T N1.7 VLA策略。
AI.result: 三个Unitree G1任务上4,800条物理验证演示；仿真训练实现零样本迁移，平均全任务成功率66.7%（真实数据训练46.7%）；泛化配置下训练集扩展使合并成功率由23%提升至69%，且未增加真实演示。
AI.conclusion: 面向VLA的策略演示增强与智能体驱动的对象/场景重建与物理自校正闭环能有效替代真机数据，是人形全身操作可扩展数据生成的有力范式。

title: Blendshape Generation for Models with Disconnected Parts: Adding ARKit/MediaPipe Blendshapes to Anime-Style Character Models
summary: Blendshape generation for 3D models has been extensively researched, but very few works address generating blendshapes for models with multiple disconnected parts. We present a case study of generating fixed facial expression blendshapes for commercial anime-style 3D character models with up to 11 parts per face. To make sure that our system can handle models in a way that is agnostic to topology, we train neural networks to generate deformation fields around the input meshes. We employ at least one network to independently process each part, and the relative positions of their outputs are coordinated by having each network also process the geometry of an anchor part. We use two mechanisms to improve accuracy: having the networks predict whether the output displacement is zero or not, and classifying blendshapes into different size groups and dedicating a network to each group. We also introduce a method to improve blendshape quality by enhancing bilateral symmetry. Our method is simpler than recent neural-network-based works and solves a real problem of the user community of these models.

AI.tldr: 为多分离部件动漫风3D角色生成固定表情blendshape的工程案例研究，采用拓扑无关的神经变形场与多部件协同网络
AI.motivation: 现有blendshape生成研究主要针对单一连通网格，缺乏对含多个不连通部件（每个面部多达11个部件）的商业动漫风格3D角色模型的系统性方案；目标是为该用户社区解决真实痛点，并保证方法对网格拓扑不敏感。
AI.method: 训练神经网络在输入网格周围生成变形场（deformation field），从而与拓扑解耦。每个部件至少用一个独立网络处理，并通过让各网络同时处理一个锚定部件（anchor part）的几何来协调各部件输出的相对位置。两项精度增强机制：(1) 让网络预测位移是否为零（零位移分类）；(2) 按blendshape尺寸分组并为每组分配专用网络。此外提出通过增强双侧对称性来提升blendshape质量的后处理/约束方法。整体结构较近期神经网络方法更简洁。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；定性上宣称相比近期神经网络方法结构更简单，能够处理多部件、拓扑各异的商业动漫角色模型，并通过零位移预测、尺寸分组与对称性增强提升精度与质量。
AI.conclusion: 这是一项面向实际生产需求的案例研究，表明"逐部件网络+锚定部件协同+零位移预测+按尺寸分组+对称性增强"的组合足以在多分离部件网格上生成表情blendshape，无需依赖复杂管线，具有较强工程可复用性。

title: Improving VLMs on Scientific Chart Analysis via Autonomous Evolution
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Understanding and operating with scientific charts is a standard approach in data analysis, and while humans are good at interpreting such charts, open vision-language models (VLMs) are known to perform poorly when it comes to question answering based on such data types. Motivated by an initial observation that many of their errors are due to inexact answering, we raise the following natural question: how much accuracy can we recover without changing the model at all? In this paper, we study this question by searching over inference programs and the code around a "frozen" version of the model. Using ideas from autonomous evolution (famously used in AlphaEvolve), we first start from a baseline inference program, and in each round we show an LLM judge the code together with a few failures on training questions, and ask for an improving evolutionary move. As usual in autonomous evolution approaches, the candidate programs are kept in a small pool ranked by training accuracy, and the next edit is performed on top-scorers from this pool. We run this approach on three VLMs and four popular benchmarks on scientific charts, and we measure the fraction of descriptive questions whose answer exactly matches the ground truth. The accuracy improves in all experimental settings. On average, it rises from 16.6% with the starting program to 41.3% with the evolved one, and the largest single increase is 55.2 percentage points. As a side benefit, our evolved program is 3.8x faster than the starting program, because short answers are easier to grade and faster to generate. Our results demonstrate that a large part of the observed errors arise due to the inference pipeline, and that optimizing it can improve the "frozen" VLM without the need to retrain it.

AI.tldr: 用 LLM 驱动的自主进化（类 AlphaEvolve）在冻结 VLM 外围搜索推理程序与代码，显著提升科学图表问答的精确匹配率（16.6%→41.3%），并使推理速度提升 3.8 倍。
AI.motivation: 开放视觉-语言模型在科学图表问答上表现差，但初步观察表明大量错误源于"答案不精确"这一推理管线问题而非模型能力不足，因此希望在不改变模型参数的前提下，尽可能多地恢复精度。
AI.method: 将 VLM 冻结，仅优化其外层推理程序（提示/代码/后处理管线）。以基线推理程序为起点，每轮把当前代码连同若干训练题失败案例交给 LLM 评审，要求提出改进的"进化编辑"；候选程序维护在小规模池中按训练准确率排序，仅对高分者继续编辑。在 3 个 VLM × 4 个科学图表基准上评估，指标为描述性问题答案与真值完全一致的占比。
AI.result: 所有实验设置下准确率均提升，平均从 16.6% 升至 41.3%，单设置最大提升 55.2 个百分点；进化后程序比初始程序快 3.8 倍（短答案更易评分、生成更快）。
AI.conclusion: 相当大比例的错误来自推理管线而非模型本身；通过自主进化优化推理程序即可提升"冻结"VLM 的性能，无需重训练。方法本质是通用 LLM 智能体式的代码搜索/自我改进范式，可迁移到其他任务管线优化。

title: Reading the Registers of Honorius III without Manual Line Transcription: Forced-Aligned HTR, End to End, Modular or Hybrid
summary: Unlocking medieval archives at scale is bottlenecked by the cost of line-level diplomatic transcriptions and manual abbreviation expansion. Focusing on the registers of Pope Honorius III (1216-1227) over 5,000 letters surviving in full only as manuscript images - we show that existing, line-break-free expert transcriptions (edition drafts) suffice to train end-to-end hand-written text recognition (HTR) that jointly transcribes and expands heavily abbreviated Latin. Using forced alignment on 860 unaligned edition entries across 394 pages of Reg. Vat. 9, we automatically bootstrap 13,122 training lines without manual alignment of segmented lines. While the generic CATMuS baseline struggles on this domain (18.9% CER) and a modular space-free HTR + word-segmentation pipeline (cf. Camps et al. 2021) plateaus at 15.6% WER, our from-scratch hybrid Conformer - combining CTC with bidirectional subword attention decoders, iterative self-realignment and n-best LM rescoring - achieves 4.7% CER and 8.7% WER (8.4% WER with ROVER system combination), nearly halving errors on clause-final words (22.7% to 12.2% WER). These figures are measured on the test lines that align with the transcription (86% of all test lines for the best hybrid). Furthermore, we address a tension between paleographic fidelity and editorial normalization: training on targets that preserve scribal name initials reduces the WER against the manuscript text on the 31 affected test lines from 13.3% to 9.2%, at a small cost against the expanded transcription (WER +0.3 points, CER +0.4). Finally, extensive ablations show that none of an auxiliary diplomatic CTC head, a copy mechanism, a permutation decoder or masked-image pretraining improves on direct end-to-end supervision, while strict padding-mask propagation and per-line beam termination make inference batch-invariant.

AI.tldr: 利用教皇Honorius III登记册（Reg. Vat. 9）中现有的无换行专家转录，通过强制对齐自动生成13,122条行级训练数据，训练端到端混合Conformer（CTC + 双向子词注意力解码器 + 迭代自重对齐 + n-best语言模型重打分）HTR模型，同时完成转录与缩写展开，取得4.7% CER / 8.7% WER。
AI.motivation: 中世纪档案的规模化利用受限于行级外交体（diplomatic）转录与人工缩写展开的高昂成本；需要一种能直接利用已有专家版本（edition draft）而无须逐行手工对齐的端到端手写文本识别方法，在同一过程中完成拉丁文缩写展开。
AI.method: 在Reg. Vat. 9的394页、860条未对齐版本条目上做强制对齐，自动引导出13,122条训练行；从零训练混合Conformer架构，结合CTC与双向子词注意力解码器，并加入迭代自重对齐、n-best语言模型重打分及ROVER系统融合。作者还做了大量消融：辅助外交体CTC头、复制机制、置换解码器、掩码图像预训练均无提升；严格padding-mask传播与逐行beam终止保证推理的批不变性。另对比CATMuS通用基线与"无空格HTR+分词"模块化流水线。
AI.result: CATMuS基线CER 18.9%，模块化流水线WER 15.6%；本文混合模型CER 4.7%、WER 8.7%（ROVER融合8.4%），子句末词WER由22.7%降至12.2%。在与转录对齐的测试行上评估（混合模型覆盖86%测试行）。保留抄写员姓名首字母的训练目标使对原稿的WER从13.3%降至9.2%（31行），对展开转录的代价仅WER +0.3、CER +0.4。消融显示辅助CTC头、复制机制、置换解码器、掩码图像预训练均不如直接端到端监督。
AI.conclusion: 已有的无行断、未对齐专家版本足以支撑端到端HTR训练，误差近乎减半（相对模块化流水线），且可同时处理缩写展开；自动对齐+混合Conformer+LM重打分是关键。遗留问题为评估仅限能对齐到转录的行，以及抄写忠实度与编辑规范化之间的取舍。

title: Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition
summary: Test-Time Prompt Tuning (TPT) adapts large pretrained models to unseen target distribution shifts by updating only lightweight prompt tokens. Existing TPT methods are effective, but they mainly optimize each prompt update locally. Across test-time steps, prompts updated at the current step are reused for the corresponding predictions and updates, so noisy or biased unlabeled objectives can accumulate and destabilize the prompt-update trajectory. We identify two failure modes: magnitude expansion, where updates move the prompt too far, and directional drift, where consecutive updates point in inconsistent directions. To analyze and control these failures, we propose Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition ($\mathtt{TPD}$), which characterizes observed prompt-update trajectories from a dynamical-systems view and decomposes base prompt updates into magnitude and direction. $\mathtt{TPD}$ computes a spectral radius to measure update expansion and decomposes update directions into persistent, oscillatory, and residual components. Building on this decomposition, Adaptive Koopman Control ($\mathtt{AKC}$) regulates update magnitude by shrinking updates under expansive recent dynamics, while Hankel Update Router ($\mathtt{HUR}$) refines update direction by preserving persistent components and suppressing oscillatory and residual components. Together, $\mathtt{AKC}$ and $\mathtt{HUR}$ produce a stabilized prompt update. As a prompt-agnostic framework, $\mathtt{TPD}$ can be plugged into visual and text TPT methods without modifying the backbone, prompt architecture, or adaptation loss. Experiments on 15 datasets show that $\mathtt{TPD}$ consistently improves 10 baselines, with accuracy gains of $3$--$8\%$ for visual prompts and over $2\%$ for text prompts.

AI.tldr: TPD 从动力系统视角分解测试时 prompt 更新为幅度与方向，用谱半径与 Koopman/Hankel 手段抑制幅度膨胀与方向漂移，作为即插即用插件提升 10 个 TPT 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 Test-Time Prompt Tuning 逐步局部优化 prompt，无标签目标中的噪声与偏差会逐步累积，导致两类失效：(1) 幅度膨胀，更新把 prompt 推得过远；(2) 方向漂移，连续更新方向不一致，使更新轨迹不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition (TPD)：将观察到的 prompt 更新轨迹视为动力系统，分解为幅度与方向；用谱半径度量更新扩张性，并将方向分解为持续（persistent）、振荡（oscillatory）与残差分量。基于该分解，Adaptive Koopman Control (AKC) 在近期动力学呈扩张时收缩更新幅度；Hankel Update Router (HUR) 保留持续分量、抑制振荡与残差分量以修正方向。
AI.result: 在 15 个数据集上插拔到 10 个基线均稳定提升：视觉 prompt 精度增益 3–8%，文本 prompt 增益超 2%。
AI.conclusion: TPD 是 prompt 无关的通用框架，无需改动骨干、prompt 结构或适配损失即可稳定 TPT 更新轨迹；但其证据集中于视觉/文本识别类分布偏移基准，未见视觉-语言-动作、机器人或具身任务的验证。

title: Uncertainty Evaluation to Support Safety of the Intended Functionality Analysis for Determining the Applicability of Performance Targets Across Triggering Conditions in ML-Based LiDAR Object Detection
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Extended version of the VEHITS 2026 conference paper (doi: https://doi.org/10.5220/0014967200004030 ). Submitted for journal publication. Code and recorded results: this https URL
summary: For safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) analysis according to ISO 21448, a machine learning object detector for light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds can meet a performance target, a limit on the mean per-frame share of wrong detections among accepted detections, by rejecting detections above an uncertainty threshold. A threshold selected on data of one condition carries a statistical guarantee only for data distributed like its selection data, whereas SOTIF analysis covers every triggering condition. This paper presents an uncertainty evaluation in which the threshold is transferred into a triggering condition, a test decides at a stated error probability whether the target is applicable there, not applicable or not determined, and a lower bound counts the independent units an applicable outcome requires. For PointPillars ensembles on KITTI and nuScenes, counted in recorded sequences, as the dependence between frames requires, neither dataset held enough independent units for any target limit, and no transfer had a not applicable outcome. Counted in frames, the same data gave not applicable outcomes at limits fixed in advance after transfers into far distance, into rain and between two separately trained detectors, thresholds that met the target limit after a transfer rejected most correct detections, and in rain the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve did not decrease. A performance target met under one condition therefore counts as evidence under a triggering condition only after a test there, reported with its share of accepted correct detections and its number of independent recorded sequences.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种不确定度评估流程：将检测阈值转化为触发条件，通过统计检验在高错误概率下判定性能目标在触发条件下是否适用，并以独立记录序列数作为计数单位；在KITTI/nuScenes上验证发现数据独立单元不足且阈值迁移普遍失效。
AI.motivation: ISO 21448 SOTIF分析要求覆盖所有触发条件，但基于单一条件数据选出的不确定度阈值只能对该分布给出统计保证，缺乏阈值迁移到新触发条件后的有效性验证方法。
AI.method: 面向LiDAR点云检测器（PointPillars集成模型），提出不确定度评估框架：阈值迁移测试判定目标"适用/不适用/未确定"；以记录序列为独立单元计算所需样本下界；在KITTI与nuScenes上考察远距离、雨天、跨模型等迁移场景，并报告接受检测中正确检测占比与独立序列数。
AI.result: 按序列计数时两数据集均无足够独立单元达成任何目标；按帧计数时可在远距离、雨天、跨检测器迁移下得到"不适用"结论；满足目标的迁移阈值会拒绝大量正确检测；雨天AUC未下降但阈值仍失效。
AI.conclusion: 单一条件下达成的性能目标只有在触发条件下经统计检验、并同时报告接受正确检测比例与独立记录序列数后，才可作为证据。

title: The Language of Deformation: Semantic Failure Analysis as a Prerequisite for Dexterous Manipulation of Deformable Objects
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the European Robotics Forum (ERF) 2026
summary: Dexterous manipulation of rigid objects has reached a level of maturity where grasp stability, control, and planning strategies are successfully applied in industry and logistics. In contrast, manipulating deformable objects (cables, plastic pieces, cloth) remains far more challenging, as rigid-object methods do not account for their additional complexity. This paper identifies semantic failure analysis as a key step toward mature deformable-object manipulation and supports this claim with proof-of-concept experiments. Unlike rigid-object manipulation, where goals are well-defined in terms of criteria such as force balance and slippage, deformable-object manipulation involves a broader variety of failure modes arising from differences in materials, geometry, and behaviour. Typical failures include buckling, plastic deformation, pressure variations, and tearing. These diverse and often hard-to-detect events require distinct corrective strategies, making semantic failure analysis necessary. We define its key components and challenges and present experimental results supporting its potential as a research direction.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"语义失效分析"（semantic failure analysis）是柔性物体操作走向成熟的关键步骤，并给出概念验证实验支持。
AI.motivation: 刚体灵巧操作已较成熟，而电缆、塑料件、布料等柔性物体操作仍困难：刚体方法未考虑材料、几何与行为带来的额外复杂性，且目标定义（力平衡、滑移）不足以覆盖柔性物体多样的失效形式。
AI.method: 识别并归类柔性物体操作的典型失效模式（屈曲、塑性变形、压力变化、撕裂等），界定语义失效分析的关键组成与挑战，并设计概念验证实验说明其可行性与研究潜力。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化结果，仅报告概念验证性实验结果，支持语义失效分析作为研究方向的价值。
AI.conclusion: 柔性物体操作需要按失效语义进行诊断与分类，并据此匹配不同纠正策略；语义失效分析应成为该领域成熟化的核心研究议程。

title: Understanding and Repairing Cooperative Perception under Adverse Weather
summary: A cooperative 3D detector can miss a vehicle even when the LiDAR points on it remain unchanged. We study this failure under adverse weather as Weather-Induced Context Interference. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled study of how weather-related exterior changes remove cooperative benefits while preserving all points inside annotated objects. Controlled experiments on simulated and real roadside inputs show that exterior loss changes object representations before fusion and removes previously useful assistance. On real inputs, restoring object-neighborhood features recovers 30 of 31 induced failures; three equal-area exterior controls recover none. The failure condition also appears with a second fusion model. These findings motivate Adverse-Weather Cooperative Repair (AWCR), with separate implementations for the available supervision. Point Classifier filters added weather returns in simulation. On real inputs, Local Correction refines candidates and Quality Selection checks them against current measurements, without naturally paired clear/adverse-weather recordings. Candidate tracing shows that correction supplies accurate geometry for some targets that original candidates cannot localize at the evaluation threshold. On natural adverse-weather CoInfra development data, AWCR improves car bird's-eye-view (BEV) AP@0.7 by 4.66 points with V2X-ViT and 5.56 with AttFuse. On simulated V2X-R fog, it improves vehicle BEV AP@0.7 by 4.47 points at a fixed 4,096-candidate budget.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“天气诱导上下文干扰”现象：协同3D检测器在目标点云不变时仍可能漏检；并给出AWCR修复方案（仿真用Point Classifier，真实场景用Local Correction+Quality Selection），在CoInfra与V2X-R上分别提升BEV AP@0.7约4.5–5.6点。
AI.motivation: 协同（V2X）3D检测依赖车-路多视角互补，但雨雾等天气会改变目标外部的邻域上下文，导致融合前的目标表征漂移，从而丧失协同增益。作者希望首次在“保留标注目标内部全部点、仅改变外部环境”的受控条件下，系统研究这一失效机制。
AI.method: 受控实验：在仿真与真实路侧输入上，仅移除/恢复目标邻域外部特征，并设置等面积外部对照（3组全不恢复），验证是“外部邻域”而非点数或面积导致失效；再在第二个融合模型上复现该失效条件。据此提出AWCR：(1) 仿真中用Point Classifier滤除新增天气回波点；(2) 真实数据缺少自然配对的晴/恶劣天气录制的条件下，用Local Correction精修候选、Quality Selection以当前测量核验候选，并结合候选追踪分析。
AI.result: 真实输入中恢复目标邻域特征可挽回31例诱导失效中的30例，3个等面积外部对照均无挽回；失效在第二融合模型上同样出现。CoInfra自然恶劣天气开发集上，AWCR使车辆BEV AP@0.7在V2X-ViT上提升4.66点、AttFuse上提升5.56点；仿真V2X-R雾天在固定4096候选预算下提升4.47点。候选追踪显示Local Correction可为部分原候选在评估阈值下无法定位的目标提供准确几何。
AI.conclusion: 协同检测的鲁棒性瓶颈部分来自目标外部上下文而非目标自身观测，属于可诊断、可修复的融合前表征问题；AWCR提供了在无配对晴/雾数据条件下的实用修复路径，对V2X协同感知的天气鲁棒性有直接工程价值。

title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
summary: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provides important metabolic information for tumor detection and staging but remains significantly less accessible than Computed Tomography (CT) due to its high cost, infrastructure requirements, and reliance on injected radioactive tracers. CT-to-PET image translation using generative models aims to address this disparity, yet state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods are limited by the scarcity of paired training data. To overcome this, we propose a domain-adapted latent diffusion framework that transfers natural-image priors using a relatively small dataset of 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, incorporating a signed power transform to resolve extreme intensity sparsity in PET data. Compared to CPDM, a state-ofthe-art baseline for CT-to-PET image translation, our approach yields superior performance in pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity, demonstrating effective transfer of natural-image priors to the medical domain. We further provide a systematic analysis of evaluation metric reliability for sparse PET data, showing that standard full-image metrics can be misleading indicators of translated image quality, and propose background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics as more clinically meaningful alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出域适配隐扩散框架，用21,930对CT/PET切片迁移自然图像先验实现CT→PET翻译，并引入符号幂变换处理PET极端稀疏，同时指出全图指标对稀疏PET不可靠，提出背景滤波与掩膜限定指标。
AI.motivation: PET代谢信息对肿瘤检测与分期重要，但成本高、依赖放射性示踪剂，可及性远低于CT；基于扩散的CT→PET生成受限于配对数据稀缺。
AI.method: 域适配的潜空间扩散模型，将自然图像先验迁移至医学域；采用符号幂变换（signed power transform）缓解PET强度极端稀疏问题；训练数据为21,930对CT/PET切片。
AI.result: 在像素级重建与局部肿瘤保真度上优于SOTA基线CPDM；系统分析显示全图指标对稀疏PET具有误导性，背景滤波与掩膜限定指标更贴合临床意义。
AI.conclusion: 自然图像先验可有效迁移至医学跨模态翻译；稀疏目标域的评测需采用背景滤波/掩膜限定的指标。

title: Sexual dimorphism and sex-specific features of pediatric hand bone shapes via statistical shape modeling
summary: Understanding the envelope of shape variation encompassing both sexual dimorphism and growth-related changes in living tissue is a non-trivial task. In this work, we use statistical shape models (SSMs) and analyze demographic-stratified shape parameters to quantify sexual dimorphism and sex-specific shape changes. To this end, we developed a two-stage detection-segmentation framework that accurately segmented $n = 27664$ unique bone masks from a radiographic dataset of $n = 1456$ subjects with diverse ages and sexes (HD95 = $1.512 \pm 0.005$, ASSD $0.449 \pm 001$, Dice = $0.987 \pm 0.00004$, IoU = $0.975 \pm 0.0001$). Following SSM fitting, our follow-up analyses of stratified shape parameters highlighted the morphology of sexual dimorphisms for each bone and demonstrated sex-specific differences in shape development. Our results were consistent with existing literature and provided an unambiguous, data-driven methodology for characterizing tissue shape and its population-scale variation. This approach provides a potential methodological foundation for developing population-based models of anatomical variation and could be extended to investigate tissue growth and shape changes over time. Future work should evaluate the applicability of this methodology on alternative anatomical structures and imaging modalities, with the goal of validating these growth trajectories on longitudinal data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出两阶段检测-分割框架，从X光影像中自动分割27664个骨掩膜，并借助统计形状模型（SSM）按人口分层量化骨盆/骨骼的性别二态性与性别特异的生长形状变化。
AI.motivation: 活体组织的形状变异同时包含性别二态性与生长相关变化，二者的混合效应难以解耦；缺乏可靠、可复现的数据驱动方法来刻画群体尺度的组织形状变异。
AI.method: 两阶段检测-分割网络（HD95=1.512±0.005, ASSD=0.449, Dice=0.987, IoU=0.975）在1456名受试者 radiographic 数据上产出27664个骨掩膜；随后进行SSM拟合，并按年龄/性别分层的形状参数做统计分析，比较各骨骼的性别形态差异与性别特异的发育轨迹。
AI.result: 分割精度优异（Dice≈0.987）；分层SSM参数分析成功刻画每块骨的性别二态形态，并揭示性别特异的形状发育差异，结论与既有文献一致。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个无歧义、数据驱动的群体尺度组织形状变异建模方法，可作为基于人群的解剖变异模型的方法学基础，并可扩展至随时间变化的组织生长研究；后续需在纵向数据与其他解剖结构/影像模态上验证。

title: Temporal Slice Learning for AI-Generated Video Detection with 400$\times$ Fewer FLOPs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 18 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recent advances in generative video models have improved visual realism, making detection increasingly dependent on subtle temporal inconsistencies. However, these signals are weak and spatially localized, while most of the video content is redundant. This creates a fundamental mismatch: existing detectors rely on heavy backbones to model full videos, which leads to high computational cost and limited scalability. In this work, we rethink AI-generated video detection from a representation perspective. Instead of modeling entire videos, we restructure them into compact temporal slice representations that isolate informative temporal evolution. We introduce a lightweight framework using frequency-aware temporal slice consistency learning, where informative spatial rows and columns are aggregated over time to form slice-domain inputs. This reparameterization suppresses redundant appearance while preserving discriminative temporal dynamics, enabling efficient and targeted detection. By constructing slices from both high- and low-frequency regions, our method exposes complementary temporal artifacts, including unstable details and abnormal motion smoothness. We instantiate this idea in a Temporal Slice Consistency Network, which integrates task-driven slice localization, hierarchical positional encoding, and a lightweight Transformer to model cross-slice and cross-frequency dependencies. We further introduce AI-Artist, a new benchmark with artist-curated videos from recent high-fidelity generators, including Seedance and Kling. Experiments on GenVideo and AI-Artist show that our method achieves strong performance while requiring over 400$\times$ fewer model-forward FLOPs and 3.6$\times$ faster model inference than the strong video-based baseline ReStraV (2.9$\times$ faster end to end, including preprocessing), enabling scalable and practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 将视频重构为频率感知的时间切片表示，用轻量Transformer做切片一致性学习来检测AI生成视频，FLOPs降低400倍以上。
AI.motivation: 生成视频模型的视觉真实感不断提升，鉴伪线索变得微弱且空间局部化，而视频大部分内容冗余；现有检测器需用重骨干网络处理整段视频，计算开销高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 从表示层面重构检测任务：沿时间聚合有信息量的空间行/列，形成紧凑的时间切片表示，抑制冗余外观、保留判别性时间动态；分别从高频与低频区域构建切片以暴露互补伪影（细节不稳定、运动过于平滑）。实例化为Temporal Slice Consistency Network，包含任务驱动的切片定位、层级位置编码与轻量Transformer建模跨切片、跨频率依赖。同时提出AI-Artist基准（含Seedance、Kling等生成器的高保真视频）。
AI.result: 在GenVideo与AI-Artist上取得强性能，模型前向FLOPs比ReStraV少400倍以上，推理快3.6倍（含预处理端到端快2.9倍）。
AI.conclusion: 通过时间切片重参数化实现高效可扩展的生成视频鉴伪，兼顾精度与部署实用性；属生成内容取证方向，与具身智能/3D重建主线仅弱相关。

title: Complexity-guided Regularization for Generalizable Human Gaussian Splatting
comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, including appendix. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent studies on generalizable human Gaussian splatting have achieved the notable progress in synthesizing novel views of unseen human subjects from multi-view images. Despite this progress, existing methods still struggle to represent fine-grained details of human subjects, which inherently involve high geometric and textural complexity. This is because previous methods do not impose a constraint on how densely Gaussians are placed, which often leads to blurry rendering results in complex regions. To address this problem, we propose a complexity-guided regularization scheme. The key idea is to leverage a complexity prior computed via the local entropy in geometric and textural characteristics of a clothed human. This effectively prevents Gaussians from being coarsely placed in complex regions, which facilitates the faithful reconstruction of intricate structures. Furthermore, we sample local patches predominantly from complex regions according to this complexity prior, which allows the model to be sufficiently supervised by local details. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method delivers state-of-the-art performance while maintaining the real-time inference speed in generalizable human Gaussian splatting. The code and model are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度引导正则化：用服装人体的几何/纹理局部熵作为复杂度先验，惩罚复杂区域高斯过度粗糙放置，并按先验从复杂区域采局部patch监督，从而提升可泛化人体高斯泼溅的细节保真度，同时保持实时推理。
AI.motivation: 现有可泛化人体 Gaussian Splatting 方法未约束高斯放置的密度分配，在高几何与纹理复杂度区域易产生模糊渲染，细粒度细节难以表示。
AI.method: 1) 基于局部熵计算几何与纹理特征的复杂度先验；2) 用该先验设计正则项，抑制复杂区域中高斯粗糙/稀疏放置；3) 依复杂度先验从复杂区域优先采样局部 patch 进行训练监督。基于多视角图像的可泛化前馈式人体高斯重建框架。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上取得 SOTA 性能，且保持可泛化人体高斯泼溅的实时推理速度；代码与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 密度约束（复杂度自适应正则）+ 难度感知采样是提升细节保真的有效、低成本手段，可推广到其他前馈式 splatting 重建任务。

title: How Tuning, Reference Preview, Actuator Modeling, and Fallback Policies Change Quadrotor Controller Comparisons: A Reproducible Simulation Study
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Reproducible simulation study of quadrotor controller benchmarking
summary: Quadrotor controller comparisons commonly report a single tracking error, although the resulting ranking also depends on tuning effort, reference information, actuator prediction, optimizer fallback, and command timing. We quantify these effects for cascade PID, hover LQR, boundary-layer sliding-mode control (BL-SMC), linear MPC with LQR fallback (LMPC-F), a preview-enabled LMPC-F, and a geometric $SO(3)$ controller on a common nonlinear plant with rotor gyroscopic coupling, motor lag, and saturation. A primary study (556 episodes at 50~Hz) combines matched twelve-candidate tuning, 400 paired evaluation episodes, and a 48-cell MPC factorial; a confirmation study (1462 episodes) repeats the evaluation on 50 fresh realizations with tuning budgets of 12, 24, and 48 candidates. A matched twelve-candidate tuning protocol changed the mean-RMSE ordering obtained with the fixed baseline settings, moving BL-SMC from last to first; the new ordering recurred on the fresh realizations, and a 48-candidate budget left it unchanged. Reference preview substantially reduced MPC tracking error and, on the figure-eight task, removed fallback activity. On an abrupt step, the outcome depended on the interplay between fallback policy, predictor, and actuator authority. Command timing also changed the outcome: replaying measured command-call delays terminated three of four nominal MPC configurations on a desktop computer and all four on a Raspberry Pi~5, whereas capping the solver at 100 iterations removed every deadline miss in the tested nominal timing profiles. Controller rankings therefore depend not only on tracking accuracy but also on the tuning protocol, reference information, fallback behavior, and implementation timing. We propose a reporting checklist covering tracking accuracy, tuning effort, completion and failure rates, fallback activity, applied-input variation, and command timing.

AI.tldr: 该文在统一非线性四旋翼模型上，量化调参协议、参考预览、回退策略与指令时序对六种控制器排名的影响，并提出报告清单。
AI.motivation: 现有四旋翼控制器对比通常只报告单一跟踪误差，隐含了调参投入、参考信息、执行器预测、优化器回退与指令时序等混杂因素，导致排名不可复现、跨研究不可比。
AI.method: 在含转子陀螺耦合、电机滞后与饱和的共同非线性被控对象上比较级联PID、悬停LQR、边界层滑模(BL-SMC)、带LQR回退的线性MPC(LMPC-F)、带预览的LMPC-F及几何SO(3)控制器。主研究556回合(50 Hz)：匹配式十二候选调参、400配对评估回合、48单元MPC析因实验；确认研究1462回合：50组新实现下以12/24/48候选预算重复评估。
AI.result: 匹配调参改变了基线设置下的平均RMSE排序，BL-SMC由末位升至首位并在新实现上复现，48候选预算不改变该排序；参考预览显著降低MPC跟踪误差并在八字轨迹上消除回退触发；阶跃工况结果依赖回退策略、预测器与执行器权限的交互；回放实测指令延迟导致桌面端3/4、树莓派5上4/4的标称MPC配置超时终止，而将求解器限制为100次迭代可消除全部超时。
AI.conclusion: 控制器排名不仅取决于跟踪精度，还受调参协议、参考信息、回退行为与实现时序影响；作者提出覆盖跟踪精度、调参投入、完成/失败率、回退活动、输入变化量与指令时序的报告清单。

title: RetroNav: Scene-Grounded Retrospection and Retry for Self-Evolving Lifelong Navigation
summary: Existing robot navigation methods primarily focus on isolated tasks, overlooking the need to accumulate knowledge and experience across repeated navigation episodes. Although recent lifelong navigation methods have explored cross-task knowledge accumulation, they mainly focus on scene knowledge while neglecting historical navigation experience and its connection to scene evidence, limiting the ability to reflect on past mistakes and improve future decisions. To address this limitation, this paper presents RetroNav, a training-free self-evolving navigation framework that integrates navigation, memory accumulation, and failure reflection. Specifically, we develop a unified memory system that connects geometric and semantic scene knowledge with historical navigation experience, distinguishing objective observations from task-dependent interpretations. After each navigation attempt, an independent evaluator determines whether a retry is necessary. If so, a Retrospection Agent revisits historical decisions using accumulated scene knowledge and navigation records, generating an evidence-grounded retry brief to guide the next attempt. RetroNav achieves state-of-the-art performance across five navigation benchmarks. Our method will be open-sourced at this https URL .

AI.tldr: RetroNav：免训练、自演进的导航框架，统一记忆系统融合几何/语义场景知识与历史导航经验，并引入回顾代理在失败后基于证据生成重试简报，在五个导航基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人导航方法多聚焦孤立任务，缺乏跨回合的知识与经验积累；已有终身导航方法侧重场景知识，忽视历史导航经验及其与场景证据的关联，难以反思过往错误并改进决策。
AI.method: 构建训练-free的自演进框架：1）统一记忆系统，将几何与语义场景知识与历史导航经验关联，并区分客观观测与任务相关解释；2）每次导航后由独立评估器判断是否需重试；3）若需重试，Retrospection Agent 利用累积的场景知识与导航记录回溯历史决策，生成有证据支撑的重试简报（retry brief）以指导下一回合。
AI.result: 在五个导航基准上达到SOTA性能。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: 将导航、记忆积累与失败反思显式整合，为终身/自演进具身导航提供了一种无需训练、可解释且可复用的范式。

title: OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations
summary: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony-based approaches. Unlike current models, OrthoRF also recovers occluded object parts, indicating stronger grouping under occlusion. Overall, orthogonality emerges as a simple, effective inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF)，通过内积损失强制 RF 取向空间正交，显著提升相位对齐与无监督物体发现的解耦表征质量，并可恢复遮挡部件、免去后处理聚类。
AI.motivation: 神经同步（synchrony）假说认为大脑通过相位绑定组织多物体场景；Rotating Features 以复数/向量激活的取向编码物体归属，但其取向空间缺乏约束，导致相位对齐松散、分组可靠性不足，且许多同步类方法仍需事后聚类。作者希望用简单归纳偏置改进这一表征。
AI.method: 在 Rotating Features 的取向空间上施加内积（正交性）损失，并配合架构修改（如归一化/归一化的取向更新），使不同物体的相位表征趋于正交，从而获得更锐利的相位对齐与更可靠的绑定；无需事后聚类即可直接读出物体掩码。
AI.result: 在无监督物体发现评测中（含重叠物体、噪声、分布外测试），OrthoRF 匹配或超越现有模型，表征更可解释，且无需后处理聚类；与现有模型不同，还能恢复被遮挡物体的部件，说明遮挡下分组能力更强。
AI.conclusion: 正交性可作为一种简单而有效的归纳偏置，用于基于同步的物体中心学习，并为遮挡下的解耦表征提供新思路。

title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
summary: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that method outperforms the strongest single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0x less token overhead on HallusionBench and this http URL analysis demonstrates that relay collaboration enables heterogeneous agents to progressively integrate complementary insights, combining heterogeneous capabilities across reasoning stages. Our source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MACR提出“接力式思考”多智能体协作拓扑：通过置信度触发推理权转移，并用竞价机制选择下一个智能体，使异质智能体在演化中的推理轨迹上逐步精炼互补。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体协作多为“群体思考”拓扑——各智能体独立生成解再聚合，难以继承与迭代彼此推理过程。作者想探索接力式拓扑，实现推理所有权的动态转移。
AI.method: 提出MACR框架：1）置信度引导的接力触发，判断何时应移交推理；2）竞标机制，依据各候选智能体的置信度选择下一个接管者；使后续智能体继承并精炼不断演化的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 四个基准上优于最强单模型策略，MathVista +3.3%、MMStar +3.9%；HallusionBench上与多智能体策略相当但token开销减少6.0倍。分析表明接力协作使异质智能体逐步整合互补洞见。
AI.conclusion: 接力式多智能体拓扑是群体思考的有效替代，可在更低开销下获得互补能力组合，但整体属通用多模态智能体推理方法，未涉及物理AI/3D/机器人任务。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出优化感知双域框架 O2D-MedNet：DDI 融合傅里叶/小波域特征抑退化，CGF 跨 CNN-视觉状态空间骨干进行轮廓引导融合，GCO 依据损失趋势与梯度统计稳定训练。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割受复合退化与多尺度几何变化影响，损害病灶-背景可分性、结构一致性与优化稳定性；单流框架混淆异构线索，混合流框架多为通用/静态融合，缺乏跨域协同且忽视优化不稳定性。
AI.method: 三部分：1) 退化感知双域交互(DDI)模块整合傅里叶域与小波域特征；2) 跨骨干轮廓引导融合(CGF)模块实现 CNN 局部细节与视觉状态空间全局结构的选择性交互；3) 梯度上下文优化(GCO)策略基于损失趋势与梯度统计自适应调整学习动态。
AI.result: 在六个基准、多成像模态上相较 SOTA 医学分割方法取得一致提升；消融分析证实敏感性、结构一致性与优化稳定性增强。
AI.conclusion: O2D-MedNet 在异构条件下实现稳健医学图像分割，双域交互、轮廓引导跨骨干融合与优化感知训练的协同是关键。

title: GaussianSpline: Adaptive Bézier Splines for Highly Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: We present GaussianSpline, a dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting method that models per-Gaussian motion using adaptive, non-uniform piecewise cubic Bézier splines. Unlike approaches based on global deformations, fixed-order polynomials, or uniformly parameterized splines, GaussianSpline jointly learns the Bézier control points and the temporal partition of each Gaussian's trajectory. This adaptive representation allocates greater temporal capacity to highly dynamic regions while maintaining compact trajectories for near-static regions, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction of complex and rapidly changing motion. To jointly achieve globally smooth motion and local adaptivity, we enforce $G^1$ continuity between consecutive Bézier segments using a reflection-based constraint on their control points. This produces smooth, fully differentiable trajectories while preserving the flexibility of non-uniform temporal parameterization. Experiments on the Neural 3D Video benchmark, the Google Immersive dataset, as well as on synthetic scenes demonstrate that GaussianSpline substantially improves reconstruction quality in scenes with highly non-uniform and challenging dynamics, while maintaining competitive performance on general dynamic scenes compared with state-of-the-art 4D Gaussian Splatting methods.

AI.tldr: GaussianSpline 提出一种 4D 高斯泼溅动态重建方法，为每个高斯用自适应非均匀分段三次 Bézier 样条建模运动，联合学习控制点与时间分段，并以基于反射的 G¹ 连续性约束保证轨迹平滑可微。
AI.motivation: 现有 4D 高斯泼溅方法或依赖全局形变场、或使用固定阶多项式、或采用均匀参数化样条，难以在时间维度上为高动态区域分配足够表示能力，导致快速、非均匀运动的重建质量受限。
AI.method: 逐高斯采用自适应非均匀分段三次 Bézier 样条表示轨迹，将 Bézier 控制点与每条轨迹的时间划分作为可学习参数联合优化；通过在相邻 Bézier 段控制点上施加反射式约束实现 G¹ 连续，从而在保持非均匀时间参数化灵活性的同时获得全局平滑且完全可微的运动。
AI.result: 在 Neural 3D Video 基准、Google Immersive 数据集及合成场景上，于高度非均匀、运动剧烈的场景中显著提升重建质量，同时在一般动态场景上与当前最先进 4D 高斯泼溅方法保持有竞争力表现。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、非均匀的分段样条参数化是提升动态 4D 重建保真度的有效途径；G¹ 连续性约束可在不牺牲局部自适应性的前提下保证轨迹平滑，为动态场景表示提供简洁可微的设计范式。

title: Joint Latent Reasoning and Observation for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. Observation reconstruction and reasoning-distribution alignment provide auxiliary supervision from textual teacher trajectories. Across five video-understanding benchmarks, LARVA achieves strong performance with 4B and 7B backbones. On VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench, the 7B model outperforms a textual CoT student trained on the same teacher trajectories by 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of jointly learning how agents represent evidence and act on it when distilling video-understanding capabilities.

AI.tldr: LARVA通过联合学习潜在推理与视觉观测来蒸馏多轮视频智能体：观察器将视觉输入编码为紧凑连续表示而非文本描述并传给推理器，后者据此选择下一步采集动作或给出答案；动作与答案监督信号经该接口回传，使观察器学会传递对下游决策有用的信息。
AI.motivation: 视频智能体需要学会"下一步看哪里"，但蒸馏到小模型困难：每次视觉观测既用于支撑答案，又用于引导后续证据搜索；文本描述虽能刻画当前可见内容，却常丢失后续采集所需线索。
AI.method: Observer–reasoner 双模块架构，以连续潜在表示替代caption作为通信接口；动作与答案监督通过该接口反向传播训练observer；并引入观测重构（observation reconstruction）与推理分布对齐（reasoning-distribution alignment）作为来自文本教师轨迹的辅助监督；在4B/7B骨干上训练。
AI.result: 在5个视频理解基准上取得强性能；7B模型在VideoHolmes、Video-MME、LVBench上分别比同样教师轨迹训练的文本CoT学生高5.1、2.5、3.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式文本CoT并非最优蒸馏媒介，联合学习"如何表示证据"与"如何基于证据行动"对视频理解智能体蒸馏更有效。

title: Thermal-Headroom Routing for Efficient Robot Perception in Extreme Heat
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code and experimental outputs: this https URL {Submitted IEEE Big Data}
summary: Adaptive robot perception systems must balance detector accuracy, inference latency, and energy consumption, particularly when high ambient temperatures cause processors to thermally throttle. We propose Thermal-Headroom Routing (THR), a lightweight model-selection policy that forecasts processor temperature using a closed-form RC thermal model and excludes detector configurations predicted to cross a throttling threshold. We evaluate THR with four YOLO11 configurations across seven real-world perception traces, eight ambient temperatures, and 20 randomized seeds, comparing it with latency-aware routing, fixed-threshold thermostats, duty caps, and a matched-compute-budget control. At ambient temperatures of 45-55 degrees C and a tight inference deadline, THR eliminates throttling in simulation, reduces deadline misses by 3.9-7.5 percentage points, and reduces energy per on-time frame by approximately 12-13% relative to a latency-belief router. A separate experiment using deadline-paced, nonoverlapping frame execution yields miss-rate reductions of 6.2-9.5 percentage points. A tuned thermostat or duty cap can match THR at a fixed operating point; predictive routing is most useful when ambient conditions or calibrated thermal parameters differ from those used to tune static policies. Measurements on an Apple M5 support the single-node heating approximation but do not validate hardware throttling. The results characterize the conditions under which thermal forecasting improves the efficiency and timeliness of resource-constrained robot perception.

AI.tldr: 提出Thermal-Headroom Routing (THR)，基于闭式RC热模型预测处理器温度，动态排除将触发热降频的目标检测器配置，在高温环境下减少截止期错过与单帧能耗。
AI.motivation: 机器人在高温环境（45-55°C）下运行时处理器会热降频，导致检测器延迟抖动、错过推理截止期并浪费能耗；现有延迟感知路由和静态温度阈值/占空比策略无法预见热累积趋势。
AI.method: 用闭式RC热模型在线预测芯片温度，构建轻量级模型选择策略，过滤掉预测会越过降频阈值的YOLO11配置；在7条真实感知trace、8个环境温度、20个随机种子下与延迟感知路由、固定阈值温控、占空比上限及等算力预算对照组对比；另做deadline-paced非重叠帧执行实验，并在Apple M5上验证单节点热模型。
AI.result: 仿真中THR完全消除热降频；相比延迟信念路由器，截止期错失率降低3.9-7.5个百分点，准时帧单帧能耗降低约12-13%；非重叠执行实验中错失率降低6.2-9.5个百分点；调优后的静态温控或占空比可在固定工作点达到同等效果；M5实测支持单节点加热近似但未验证硬件降频。
AI.conclusion: 热预测路由的价值主要体现在环境温度或标定热参数偏离静态策略调优工作点时；该工作刻画了热预测何时能提升资源受限机器人感知的效率与时序可靠性。

title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
summary: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.

AI.tldr: An end-to-end framework combining vision-based layout segmentation, multi-script OCR, and an agentic RAG loop to retrieve information from degraded historical Indian parliamentary archives (200k-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha corpus).
AI.motivation: Historical public archives exist only as degraded, multi-column scans with mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise; OCR failure blocks downstream information retrieval.
AI.method: Vision-based layout segmentation + multi-script OCR, coupled with an iterative agentic RAG loop that navigates OCR noise and layout ambiguity before answer generation; analyzes how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into extraction errors.
AI.result: Evaluated on a 200,000-page archive; robust to historical document degradation and outperforms text-only RAG baselines.
AI.conclusion: Vision-aware OCR plus agentic retrieval is an effective pipeline for degraded document archives; no code or quantitative breakdown disclosed.

title: Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks
summary: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation.
