This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出 Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG)，用图结构建模艺术作品中色彩、笔触、构图、光影、线条质量及视觉实体节点与情绪标签的关联，并可选地加入层级化 valence-arousal 辅助模块，在 EmoArt-5k 上优于 Qwen3-VL / InternVL3.5 直接推理。
AI.motivation: 艺术图像的情绪识别具有主观性、隐含性，且依赖视觉形式与语义联想之间的关系。直接使用视觉语言模型做 image-to-emotion 预测，容易忽略形式、语义与情感线索之间可解释的显式关系。
AI.method: 将所有画像表示为可解释特征节点（颜色、笔触、构图、光影、线条质量、抽取的视觉实体）构成异构图，学习特征—情绪关联用于主导情绪分类；另设可选的层级 valence-arousal 辅助情感模块，以粗到细的效价—唤醒层级结构进行联合建模；比较 VSAG、VSAG-TopK 与 Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5 直接推理。
AI.result: 直接 VLM 推理基线有效但偏弱；图模型提升主导情绪预测。层级 valence-arousal 版本表现最佳，accuracy、macro-F1、weighted-F1 均超过直接 VLM 推理与仅情绪的 VSAG 基线。逐类结果显示图模型与 VLM 捕捉部分互补信号；valence-arousal 结构以层级方式融入比后处理校正更有效。
AI.conclusion: 显式的视觉—语义结构既能提升艺术作品情绪识别的预测性能，也增强了结果的可解释性；情感维度结构宜作为粗到细的层级辅助任务，而非事后修正。

title: Labference: Benchmarking the Reasoning-Action Connection in Robotic Laboratories
summary: Realizing Embodied AI for Science requires robots to translate experimental goals into reliable physical procedures, reducing hazardous and repetitive human work while generating evidence for scientific discovery. Although language-based planning and learned manipulation provide complementary capabilities, their integration requires robots to adapt subsequent operations to actual execution outcomes. For example, an unsuccessful placement changes what must be done next, even when the experimental goal remains unchanged. Existing benchmarks assess planning, manipulation, and laboratory workflows through task completion and reasoning or execution metrics; however, aggregate performance leaves the connection between outcome-dependent choices and physical execution unresolved. To address this evaluation gap, we introduce Labference, a benchmark for evaluating how observed physical outcomes guide subsequent choices and how those choices translate into robotic laboratory actions. Its evaluation protocol is designed to test outcome-dependent behavioral adaptation through controlled evidence variations, while independently measuring operation selection, physical execution, and task completion. Matched Oracle-assisted continuations from shared checkpoints then assess which forms of support improve subsequent choices and task completion. Initial weighing evaluations reveal target-selection errors in the tested VLA policies despite successful object transfers, whereas GPT-driven control achieves correct selection but encounters execution failures and substantial computation costs. Together, these findings highlight the need to connect task-appropriate reasoning with reliable, timely action. By making this connection measurable and diagnosable, Labference supports targeted improvements toward autonomous experimentation for Embodied AI for Science.

AI.tldr: 提出 Labference 基准，用于评估具身科学实验中"物理执行结果如何驱动后续决策"的闭环能力，并独立测量操作选择、物理执行与任务完成度。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只考核任务完成率或推理/执行单项指标，聚合分数掩盖了"结果依赖型决策"与物理执行之间的联系，难以诊断语言规划与操作能力整合时的失效环节。
AI.method: 构建面向机器人实验室流程的基准：通过受控证据变体测试结果依赖的行为适应；对操作选择、物理执行、任务完成分别独立度量；从共享检查点出发用 Oracle 辅助的匹配续写，比较不同支持形式对后续决策与任务完成的影响。
AI.result: 初始称量评测显示，被测 VLA 策略虽能成功搬运物体，但出现目标选择错误；GPT 驱动的控制能正确选择目标，却存在执行失败且计算开销大。
AI.conclusion: Labference 将"任务适配的推理"与"可靠及时的动作"之间的连接变为可度量、可诊断的对象，为自主科学实验的针对性改进提供评测基础。

title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
summary: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于低秩MERA张量网络的3D OCT体数据表示，联合实现压缩、去噪与特征提取，无需训练，并在视网膜疾病小样本分类上具竞争力。
AI.motivation: OCT体积存在散斑噪声，且大视场高分辨率数据存储与传输负担重；深度学习方案依赖大量标注、可解释性差，且每例需独立处理以避免跨样本泄漏。
AI.method: 将3D OCT体建模为MERA张量网络：顶层核心张量编码全局特征，多个相互作用的低秩正交/半正交因子刻画B-scan间与B-scan内相关性，通过张量收缩表示整体体积；提取MERA特征后用Grassmann流形最近子空间分类器（仅子空间维度一个超参数）。
AI.result: 在两个不同扫描仪采集的OCT体积上，视觉质量提升、视网膜层分割误差降低；两个临床数据集分类精度具竞争力，小样本下优于受限的深度学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知、模型驱动的表示学习可在有限监督下兼顾泛化与可解释性，适合高维医学影像。

title: Reward-Guided RRT* for Budgeted Task and Motion Planning
summary: Robotic missions involving spatially distributed tasks often require jointly selecting rewarding locations and planning feasible motions under limited travel budgets. This paper proposes Reward-Guided RRT*, a new sampling-based framework that constructs a budget-feasible mission through a sequence of locally joint task-selection-and-motion-planning stages, evaluated directly in the continuous state space, without requiring a precomputed task-transition graph. The method incrementally builds a mission using reward-guided RRT* searches, while a return-feasibility procedure ensures that each selected task can be visited without violating the mission budget. Experiments with increasing obstacle complexity and number of tasks show solutions comparable to VNS-PRM* while requiring substantially fewer sampled states. We also extend the framework to Dubins steering and evaluate it in CoppeliaSim with a scaled car-like robotic platform, demonstrating its ability to incorporate vehicle kinematic constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reward-Guided RRT*：在连续状态空间中以局部"任务选择+运动规划"联合采样迭代构建满足旅行预算的机器人任务序列，无需预计算任务转移图；返回可行性检验保证每个选中任务可在预算内完成。
AI.motivation: 空间分布式任务的机器人作业需在有限旅行预算下同时决定访问哪些奖励点并规划可行路径；现有方法（如 VNS-PRM*）依赖预计算任务转移图与密集采样，代价高且难以直接推广到带运动学约束的连续空间。
AI.method: 以奖励引导的 RRT* 采样搜索增量构造任务序列：每个阶段在连续状态空间内做局部联合任务选择与运动规划，奖励引导采样树扩展方向；引入 return-feasibility 过程检查候选任务是否能在不超预算的前提下被访问并可返回；扩展至 Dubins 转向以处理车辆运动学约束。
AI.result: 在障碍复杂度和任务数递增的实验中，解质量与 VNS-PRM* 相当，但采样状态数显著减少；Dubins 版本在 CoppeliaSim 中于缩放车式平台上验证，展示了纳入车辆运动学约束的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将任务选择与运动规划在连续空间中紧耦合、并以预算可行性剪枝的采样框架，可在不构建任务转移图的情况下高效求解预算约束下的奖励型任务规划，并可自然扩展至带运动学约束平台。

title: OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation
summary: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: OVM-Occ提出以语言嵌入高斯作为中间表示的开词汇单目室内占据预测框架，配合实例级视觉-语言教师与几何感知解耦语义蒸馏，并构建OpenOcc-ScanNet/OpenOcc-Replica基准。
AI.motivation: 现有单目室内占据预测受限于闭集预定义类别，难以泛化到室内场景中高度多样、细粒度的未见类别，因此需要研究开放词汇占据预测。
AI.method: 以Language-Embedded Gaussians为中间场景表示；提出几何感知可变形注意力模块精炼高斯语义特征；构建实例级视觉-语言嵌入提供可靠语义监督；引入几何感知解耦语义蒸馏以缓解几何学习与语义学习之间的干扰；并扩展出OpenOcc-ScanNet与OpenOcc-Replica两个更细粒度类别的基准。
AI.result: 在开放词汇单目室内占据预测上达到SOTA，相较此前最优方法在Occ-ScanNet上提升12.2 mIoU与0.6 IoU，并在新的开放词汇评测协议下取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 将高斯表示与视觉-语言教师蒸馏结合，可有效实现开放词汇的室内单目占据预测，并具备向未见类别泛化的能力。

title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
summary: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图像配准传播子区域 + ResNet50 的回归方法，从 UK Biobank 颈-膝水脂 MRI 中估计肾脏体积、心脏体积与年龄，并给出组级显著性图。
AI.motivation: UK Biobank 计划采集 10 万例 MRI，需自动化方法扩展图像衍生表型；直接对全身高分辨率 3D 扫描做深度回归计算与显存代价过高，且无关组织引入噪声。
AI.method: 先由参考扫描手动定义解剖子区域，通过图像配准将其传播到 3 万+ 扫描；对每个目标子区域采样多层切片组成 2D 多通道 collage（保持高分辨率但紧凑），输入 ResNet50 风格网络做数值回归；再通过组级显著性分析定位网络依赖的解剖区域。
AI.result: 肾脏体积、心脏体积、年龄三项回归任务 R² 在 0.731–0.984 之间；组级显著性图落在医学上合理的解剖区域，验证了方法的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 配准引导的目标子区域采样可标准化并约束深度回归流水线的输入，提升信息密度，降低计算开销，为后续医学推断研究提供通用框架。

title: VisGeo-PipeTrack: A Visual Geometric Servo Control Framework with MPC-RCAPID Control for UAV-Based Dynamic Pipes Tracking
comment: Submit to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems IEEE TITS
summary: While unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for pipeline inspection, prevailing research predominantly assumes static pipes. In real-world industrial environments, pipes often exhibit dynamic movements, such as vibrations. This imposes more stringent requirements on UAVs' adaptive control and computational efficiency than in static scenarios. Therefore, this paper proposes a servo control framework named VisGeo-PipeTrack, which utilizes geometric constraints to enable UAV tracking of dynamic pipes. To achieve efficient UAV positioning, YOLOv5 is employed to detect labels on the pipe. The positions are derived from visual geometric constraints based on these detected labels to enable precise localization. To address tracking control challenges, a model predictive control based real-time corrected adaptive PID (MPC-RCAPID) controller is proposed. This controller employs the Recursive Least Squares method for real-time model estimation and integrates rolling horizon optimization to dynamically adjust PID parameters. Experiments conducted on both the AirSim simulator and the Tello UAV platform validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Simulation comparisons with standard PID, fractional-order PID, adaptive PID, and fuzzy PID demonstrate that MPC-RCAPID achieves the shortest settling time (3.26 s) and the lowest average tracking error (3.52%). In physical experiments on the Tello platform, compared with standard PID control, MPC-RCAPID reduces the average tracking error by 55.52%, 26.72%, and 26.52% across the three test dimensions. These results demonstrate that VisGeo-PipeTrack facilitates efficient autonomous tracking in dynamic pipe environments.

AI.tldr: VisGeo-PipeTrack：用管道标签+视觉几何约束定位，配合MPC实时校正的自适应PID（MPC-RCAPID）实现无人机对振动管道的动态跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机管道巡检研究多假设管道静止，而真实工业场景中管道存在振动等动态位移，对自适应控制与计算效率要求更高。
AI.method: YOLOv5检测管道标签，基于检测标签的视觉几何约束解算无人机相对位姿实现精确定位；控制端提出MPC-RCAPID控制器，用递推最小二乘（RLS）在线辨识模型，结合滚动时域优化动态整定PID参数。
AI.result: AirSim仿真中相比标准PID、分数阶PID、自适应PID、模糊PID，稳定时间最短（3.26 s）、平均跟踪误差最低（3.52%）；Tello实机三个测试维度上平均跟踪误差较标准PID分别降低55.52%、26.72%、26.52%。
AI.conclusion: 该视觉几何+自适应控制框架可在动态管道环境下实现高效自主跟踪，具备工程可行性。

title: CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
summary: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: CVTSplat 用自适应重心Voronoi剖分（CVT）做多视图表面重建，单元尺寸由演化中的SDF调制，配合GPU最近邻/近似Voronoi构建与专用光栅化，训练约2.5分钟单卡达到与最优高斯泼溅表面方法相当的几何精度。
AI.motivation: Voronoi剖分作为自适应空间划分已被用于多视图形状与外观重建，但不规则单元导致优化中反复重建剖分开销大；标准CVT单元规则但尺寸均匀，无法在表面附近加密。
AI.method: 提出自适应CVT：以演化中的符号距离场调制单元尺寸，在零水平集附近聚集站点，同时保持单元近似重心性、形状良好；据此专门化整条流水线——GPU最近邻查询、近似Voronoi构建（该场景下比通用方案快5–10倍）、面向小而近各向同性单元的光栅化器。
AI.result: 在DTU与BlendedMVS上几何精度与最佳高斯泼溅表面方法相当；单张GPU训练约2.5分钟；Voronoi构建速度提升5–10倍。
AI.conclusion: 用几何规则性约束换取计算效率是Voronoi类表面重建的可行路线，可在保持精度的同时大幅降低优化与查询开销。

title: Evidence-Guided Selection of Retinal Vessel Segmentation Pipelines: A Cross-Dataset Benchmark of Performance, Structure, Failure Modes, and Reproducibility
summary: Retinal vessel segmentation is widely used in retinal image analysis, yet model selection based only on aggregate overlap scores can overlook structural fidelity, cross-dataset robustness, and application-specific error costs. We evaluated five executable binary vessel-segmentation pipelines (FSG-Net, SA-UNetv2, DCP-1024, GAVE, and FR-UNet) on 244 images from six public datasets using pixel-level agreement, cross-dataset stability, thin-vessel retention, structural metrics, error composition, and available computational evidence. Results were aggregated with equal weighting across datasets. No pipeline was optimal in every setting. FSG-Net achieved the highest equal-dataset mean Macro-F1 (0.77), IoU (0.63), clDice (0.83), and Skeleton F1 (0.78), whereas SA-UNetv2 achieved the highest mean sensitivity (0.85) and Thin-Vessel Sensitivity (0.63). Differences across datasets were often larger than those among the leading pipelines, and errors shared by all five methods were concentrated near annotated vessel boundaries and faint peripheral vessels. In an ancillary analysis on 45 HRF images, segmentation masks were converted into 11 ring-wise vascular features for leave-one-out classification. Controlled perturbations showed that local mask errors can be amplified in downstream features, while targeted stabilization reduced sensitivity for five features. The results support task-conditioned, benchmark-relative pipeline selection rather than a single universal ranking and highlight the need to validate the selected pipeline on the intended target domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了五个开源视网膜血管分割流程（FSG-Net、SA-UNetv2、DCP-1024、GAVE、FR-UNet）在六个公开数据集244张图像上的多维度表现，提出应基于任务条件进行"相对基准"的流程选择，而非追求单一通用排名。
AI.motivation: 现有血管分割研究常仅以聚合重叠指标（如整体Dice/IoU）选模型，这可能掩盖结构保真度、跨数据集鲁棒性、细血管保留以及应用特定的误差代价差异，缺少对可执行流程的综合评估框架。
AI.method: 在6个公开数据集共244张图像上评测5个可执行二值血管分割流程；采用像素级一致性、跨数据集稳定性、细血管保留（Thin-Vessel Sensitivity）、结构指标（clDice、Skeleton F1）、误差成分分析及算力证据，并按数据集等权聚合。另在45张HRF图像上做辅助分析：将掩膜转为11个环状血管特征，进行留一法分类，并通过受控扰动考察局部掩膜误差在下游特征中的放大效应。
AI.result: 无任何流程在所有设置下最优。FSG-Net在等数据集平均Macro-F1(0.77)、IoU(0.63)、clDice(0.83)、Skeleton F1(0.78)上最高；SA-UNetv2灵敏度(0.85)与细血管灵敏度(0.63)最高。数据集间差异常大于领先流程间差异；五种方法共有的误差集中在标注血管边界附近与微弱周边血管。扰动实验显示局部掩膜误差会在下游特征中被放大，针对性稳定化可降低其中5个特征的敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应任务条件化、基准相对化，而非单一通用排名；选定流程后需在目标域上重新验证。指标选择与下游特征鲁棒性应纳入流程评估流程。

title: SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.

AI.tldr: SG-Splat：姿态无关的前馈3DGS框架，通过双分支解耦+粗到精姿态/几何修正+双路径训练策略提升对残余姿态误差的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有姿态无关前馈3DGS对残余姿态误差敏感，姿态扰动会破坏canonical空间的Gaussian变换，从而给几何与属性学习引入噪声监督。
AI.method: 将几何估计与Gaussian属性预测解耦为两个独立分支以降低误差耦合；引入粗到精精炼流程：Flow-Guided Pose Refinement（FGPR）用光流相关特征+可微BA精化相机位姿，Residual-Guided Geometry Correction（RGC）用FGPR得到的深度残差修正初始点图以得到更可靠的Gaussian中心；训练时采用GT与预测位姿混合的双路径canonical变换策略，为属性提供干净监督。
AI.result: 在DL3DV与RealEstate10K上，新视角合成与位姿估计均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 解耦架构+显式姿态/几何精炼+混合位姿监督可有效提升无位姿前馈3DGS的稳定性与精度，为实用化部署提供更鲁棒的重建方案。

title: Resilient Decentralized Radar-LiDAR-Inertial Odometry in Challenging Subterranean Environments
summary: Accurate localization in GPS-denied and visually degraded environments affected by smoke, dust, or fog remains a critical challenge for autonomous systems. While LiDAR provides high-resolution spatial perception, its performance deteriorates under particulate occlusion. In contrast, frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar offers robustness under such conditions but suffers from sparse measurements and outliers. This article presents a resilient decentralized LiDAR Radar Inertial Odometry (LRIO) framework that fuses the complementary strengths of LiDAR, radar, and inertial sensing to achieve robust pose estimation in challenging subterranean environments. At the core of the framework is an Adaptive Residual Thresholding (ART) mechanism that autonomously detects temporal sensor degradation and selectively adjusts the fusion process to minimize unreliable measurements. Building on this, a Robust Error-Tolerant Optimal Information Filter (RETOIF) is employed within a decentralized fusion architecture to integrate LiDAR-inertial and multiple radar-inertial odometry estimates in a fault-aware manner, enhancing resilience to environmental disturbances and intermittent sensor failures. The proposed framework is evaluated using real-world sensor data collected in GPS-denied subterranean tunnels under smoke-free and smoke-degraded conditions. In the smoke-free experiment, the proposed RETOIF framework achieves a root mean square localization error (RMSE) of 2.1733, compared with 2.9929 for the conventional centralized LRIO approach, corresponding to a 27.4\% reduction in RMSE. Experimental results further demonstrate the framework's ability to maintain pose estimation under smoke-induced sensor degradation, highlighting its potential for resilient autonomous navigation and mapping in challenging subterranean environments.

AI.tldr: 提出分散式 LiDAR-Radar-惯性里程计 (LRIO) 框架，用自适应残差阈值 (ART) 检测传感器退化，并用容错最优信息滤波 (RETOIF) 做故障感知融合，在无 GPS 烟雾退化地下隧道中实现鲁棒定位。
AI.motivation: GPS 拒止且受烟雾/粉尘/雾遮挡的退化环境中定位困难：LiDAR 在高分辨率空间感知上强但受颗粒遮挡影响，FMCW 雷达鲁棒但稀疏且有离群点，单一模态均不可靠，需互补融合并处理传感器间歇性失效。
AI.method: 多模态分散式融合框架：以 LiDAR-惯性与多路雷达-惯性里程计作为子估计器；核心为 Adaptive Residual Thresholding (ART)，基于残差时间变化自主检测传感器退化并选择性调整融合；再用 Robust Error-Tolerant Optimal Information Filter (RETOIF) 在分散式架构下以故障感知方式融合各子估计（信息滤波形式便于容错加权）。
AI.result: 在真实地下隧道数据上验证：无烟场景 RETOIF 的定位 RMSE 为 2.1733，对比集中式 LRIO 的 2.9929，降低 27.4%；烟雾退化场景下仍能维持位姿估计。
AI.conclusion: ART+RETOIF 的分散式故障感知融合可提升多模态里程计在退化环境中的精度与韧性，具备地下自主导航与建图的潜力；但实验规模有限，需更多场景与开源验证。

title: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
summary: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DiffTR：基于坐标条件扩散的无监督张量恢复统一框架，用共享因子+紧凑score网络同时支持补全、混合噪声去噪与高光谱超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 张量数据跨越表格、图像、视频、高光谱等异构模态与观测过程，现有方法多为任务专用，缺乏可跨模态、跨任务复用的统一表示与恢复范式。
AI.method: 以张量坐标索引的共享因子条件化紧凑score网络；通过score matching从已知观测中联合学习因子与隐式张量表示。输出支持标量（单元素）与向量（整条tube）以统一表格张量/图像/视频。将表示学习与任务观测模型解耦：反向扩散补全缺失值；Tweedie公式+软阈值+可选空间一致性做混合噪声去噪；测量引导采样把低分辨率高光谱先验迁移到高分辨率重建，后接数据一致性与光谱子空间正则的后采样精化。
AI.result: 多模态张量、多恢复任务实验显示竞争性重建质量，并验证统一条件生成表示在容纳不同退化模型与任务约束上的灵活性；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 以条件扩散为核心的表示—观测解耦设计可作为通用张量恢复骨架，但缺少面向真实物理场景与下游具身任务的验证。

title: GIFT: Representation Geometry Matters for Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection
summary: Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) aims to generalize from a single source domain to unseen domains under distribution shifts. Existing efforts mainly focus on simulating unseen domains or suppressing domain-specific factors. However, they largely overlook the intrinsic generalization capability embedded in Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). In this work, we show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, which encodes domain-invariant semantics. Motivated by this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a geometric-aware fine-tuning method for VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a series of learnable Householder reflections to the pre-trained weights to encourage geometry-consistent adaptation under domain shift. In addition, we propose a lightweight channel-wise scaling to facilitate effective task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on two S-DGOD benchmarks. Notably, by introducing fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters into the frozen backbone, the proposed method achieves improvements of +7.9% and +2.9% in mPC over the previous SOTA on the Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather Dataset, respectively. This finding highlights that preserving representation geometry is crucial for robust cross-domain generalization, establishing GIFT as a principled and efficient solution to domain shift.

AI.tldr: GIFT：通过在预训练权重上引入可学习 Householder 反射保持表征几何结构，并加轻量通道缩放做任务适配，实现单源域泛化目标检测。
AI.motivation: 现有单源域泛化目标检测（S-DGOD）方法主要靠模拟未见域或抑制域特有因子，忽略了视觉基础模型（VFM）自身的内在泛化能力；作者发现无约束微调会破坏预训练表征中编码域不变语义的几何结构。
AI.method: 提出 Geometry-Invariance Fine-Tuning（GIFT）：在冻结骨干的预训练权重上叠加一组可学习 Householder 反射，使适配在域偏移下保持几何一致；另加轻量通道级缩放实现任务特定适配，额外可训练参数不足 1%。
AI.result: 在两个 S-DGOD 基准上稳定超越 SOTA；Cityscapes-C 上 mPC 提升 +7.9%，Diverse Weather Dataset 上 +2.9%。
AI.conclusion: 保持表征几何结构对鲁棒跨域泛化至关重要，GIFT 是一种有原则且参数高效的域偏移解决方案。

title: ACSAN: All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network Integrating Convolutional Operations with Vision Transformer
summary: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. We defined spatial self-attention and channel self-attention to generate attention features respectively. The two attention features are finally merged as the output of the DCSA module. Based on DCSA, we then construct the basic ACSAN block. Comparing with ViT, we use DCSA to replace the regular self-attention operations, and use convolution layers to replace MLPs. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we train ACSAN on three widely-used image classification databases, i.e. CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, from scratch. Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent classification accuracy comparing with standard ViT with comparable or fewer parameters, as well as other state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify that each component contributes positively to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 该文提出全卷积自注意力网络ACSAN，用多尺度空洞卷积生成Q/K/V并替代ViT中的矩阵乘自注意力，同时用卷积层替代MLP，以降低参数量和数据依赖。
AI.motivation: ViT参数量大、强依赖大规模训练数据，学习效率低，难以用于资源受限场景；作者希望通过卷积化改造提升参数效率与数据效率。
AI.method: 设计动态卷积自注意力DCSA模块：用多尺度空洞卷积生成Query、Key、Value，分别构建空间自注意力与通道自注意力并融合输出；以此构建ACSAN基本块，替代标准ViT的自注意力与MLP。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k上从头训练，分类精度优于参数量相当或更少的标准ViT及多个SOTA方法；消融实验显示各组件均有正向贡献。
AI.conclusion: 卷积化的自注意力与MLP替代方案能在更少或相当参数下取得更优分类性能，验证了ACSAN在参数与数据效率上的有效性。

title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
comment: Technical report. 19 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Embodied agents are expected to accomplish real-world goals by deciding for themselves how and when to interact with their surroundings. For many such goals, changing the physical state of the world is the means rather than the end: the agent changes the state of a system through interaction, observes the feedback, and explores until it either achieves the goal itself (e.g., discovering physical laws) or learns what the goal requires; it acts to know. Manipulation benchmarks stop at acting to change, with the target state given; scientific discovery benchmarks evaluate knowing but replace physical experimentation with symbolic actions or numerical queries. We introduce EmbodiedLab, a benchmark in which a robot must act to know. Quantitative science experiments make this setting controllable: the parameters of the system are resampled for every instance, so the result cannot be known in advance, yet it can be scored exactly. Across 30 experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms, the agent receives an objective and the apparatus, chooses its own procedure, and operates a physics-based simulated laboratory, reading the instruments through its cameras. Evaluation checks what the agent came to know, grounded in readings recorded during the episode, as well as the physical state the task requires; every experiment is verified to be solvable. We evaluate six frontier models in their developers' coding agents with native observation and control, with added perception and motion planning, and with manipulation skills distilled from the strongest agents. With native control, even the strongest agent succeeds less than half the time; for every agent, most failures arise in interacting with the apparatus, and manipulation skills help weaker agents more than perception and planning. The benchmark and its evaluation code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 EmbodiedLab 基准：机器人在物理仿真实验室中"以行动求知"，自主设计定量科学实验、操作仪器、通过相机读表，并依据episode内记录的真实读数评估其"学到了什么"与最终物理状态；30个实验、5学科、14类装置，6个前沿模型在原生控制下成功率不足50%，失败多源于装置交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基准存在割裂：操作类基准止步于"以行动改变状态"且目标状态已给定；科学发现类基准评估"求知"却用符号动作或数值查询替代真实物理实验。缺少一个统一"以行动求知"（act to know）的评测场景。
AI.method: 构建 EmbodiedLab：每个实例重采样系统物理参数，使结果无法预先获知但可精确打分；覆盖5学科30个实验、14种装置平台，物理仿真实验室，智能体仅获目标与装置，自定流程、通过相机读仪器；评测基于episode中记录的真实读数判定其知识获取与所需物理状态，并验证每个实验可解。评测6个前沿模型在三种设定下（原生观测+控制、加感知与运动规划、加从最强智能体蒸馏的操作技能）的表现。
AI.result: 原生控制下最强智能体成功率<50%；所有智能体的多数失败发生在与装置交互环节；蒸馏出的操作技能对较弱智能体提升大于感知与运动规划。
AI.conclusion: 操作能力而非高层推理/感知是当前具身智能体做真实实验的主要瓶颈；感知-规划与技能蒸馏的收益不对称，说明低层交互技能应是重点。基准与评测代码已开源。

title: Toward Clinical Translation of Deep Learning-Based Intracranial Super-Resolution 4D Flow MRI Using Multi-Cohort Transfer Learning
comment: 28 pages, 6 main figures, 4 main tables; supplementary material includes 6 sections, 2 figures, and 1 table
summary: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

AI.tldr: 该研究将合成数据预训练与多队列迁移学习结合，用于颅内4D Flow MRI的深度学习超分辨率重建，跨健康、烟雾病、多发性硬化三队列评估。
AI.motivation: 4D Flow MRI高分辨率扫描耗时且信噪比低，低分辨率成像牺牲血管细节与血流动力学精度；同时不同神经系统疾病队列间数据异质性使单一模型泛化受限，需验证合成预训练与多队列迁移策略的跨队列有效性。
AI.method: 混合前瞻-回顾研究，18名被试（12健康、3烟雾病、3多发性硬化）配对获取1.2 mm与0.6 mm 4D Flow MRI。以合成脑血管数据预训练的CNN为骨干，分别用队列特异数据或汇总多队列在体数据进行微调；高分辨率下采样输入用于体素级评价，原生标准分辨率扫描用于血管造影与血流动力学分析。
AI.result: 合成预训练较插值降低动脉平均速度归一化RMSE（0.147 vs 0.166）；多队列汇总迁移学习取得最低vNRMSE（0.119，队列特异0.127，合成预训练0.147），且95%一致性界限宽度更窄（0.109–0.222 vs 0.154–0.278 m/s）；超分辨相位对比血管造影在所有队列中PR-AUC均高于原生标准分辨率（0.848–0.896 vs 0.486–0.805）。
AI.conclusion: 多队列汇总迁移学习可提升跨队列重建一致性，超分辨率能改善血管显示，为脑血管影像的多中心验证提供初步支持；但样本量小（n=18），仍需更大规模多中心验证。

title: NeSySpec: Neuro-Symbolic Technical Intelligence for Auditing Engineering Specifications with an Application to Aircraft
summary: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite imagery and on synthetic errors: generated corruptions, edits labeled from the edit alone and deliberate falsifications. NeSySpec combines all the assessed audit outputs in one pipeline, which no learned, rule-based, solver-based, neuro-symbolic or language-model comparator does; on the test aircraft none is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of its constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error, and it is competitive in record and image-pair detection. Its diagnosis names the violated constraint in 94.2% of corrupted test records, against 79.5% for classical Fellegi-Holt diagnosis, and on edits labeled from the edit alone, without retraining, abduction finds the altered field in 59.3% of records, against 30.6% for minimum-cardinality localization with random tie- breaking. Only the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data are specific to the domain.

AI.tldr: NeSySpec 是基于 Logic Tensor Networks 的可解释神经符号审计框架，用可微分级谓词编码领域物理约束、从真实记录学习容差，在同一流水线内完成约束合规判定、违反约束诊断、通过溯因定位被篡改字段、给出最小改动修正建议，并将图像证据与所描述部件对齐、缺失证据时弃答。
AI.motivation: 工程师审计工程系统的声明规格时，需要知道它遵守/违反了哪些物理约束、哪个字段被改动以及如何修正，而现有学习型、规则型、求解器型、神经符号或语言模型方法都无法在同一条流水线中同时给出全部审计输出。
AI.method: 以 Logic Tensor Networks 为底座，将物理关系写成可微分级谓词公理，容差由一批真实记录学习得到；由同一组隶属度派生：违反约束诊断、溯因定位被改动字段、最小改动修正提议、图像证据与部件绑定及证据缺失时的精确弃答；最后汇成单一验证报告。
AI.result: 在 107 种机型（16 架测试机、9 个族留出）及配套地面照片与卫星影像、合成错误（生成式破坏、仅依据编辑标注的改动、蓄意伪造）上评估：无任何对比方法能在同一流水线中组合全部审计输出；测试机上其约束判定 macro-F1、违反约束与被改字段命名、修正误差均不落后，记录与图像对检测具竞争力；破坏记录中违反约束命名准确率 94.2%（对比经典 Fellegi-Holt 的 79.5%），在无重训条件下仅凭编辑标注的样本上溯因定位被改字段达 59.3%（对比最小基数定位+随机打破平局的 30.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号分级谓词+可学习容差可作为规格审计的统一、可解释范式，显著优于经典 Fellegi-Holt 诊断与最小基数定位；知识库、视觉谓词、破坏生成器与数据是唯一领域相关部分，框架其余组件具备可迁移性。

title: Unveil the Mask: Jointly-Optimized Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Appearance-Agnostic Operator Verification
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026 Workshop on Who Is Behind the Avatar? (WBA)
summary: Photorealistic avatar videos decouple the appearance of a rendered face from the person who operates it, which makes conventional face recognition unsuitable for identifying the operator. Verifying the operator therefore requires representations of how a face moves that are insensitive to what the avatar looks like. We propose a verification framework built without any external pretrained model. It uses two complementary modalities provided for each sample: facial landmark sequences and video frames. From the landmark modality, it learns motion representations by diffusion masked pretraining over grouped landmarks, guided by lightweight auxiliary tasks that predict behavioral cues such as motion intensity and eye openness, and turns them into operator embeddings with a contrastive linear probe. To generalize to unseen avatar generators, the pretraining input is randomly transformed to simulate how a generator may alter the operator's motion. From the video modality, it captures fine facial motion through differences between consecutive frames. The embeddings of the two modalities are combined into one. Our approach reaches an overall AUC of 0.769 on the WBA2026 benchmark. Linear probing shows that the video embedding retains little information about the avatar's identity, whereas the landmark embedding retains some, and fusing the two modalities improves verification in particular across speaking and listening modes.

AI.tldr: 提出无需外部预训练模型的“操作者验证”框架：用面部关键点序列通过扩散掩码预训练+辅助行为线索任务学习运动表征，并结合相邻帧差分的视频模态，融合两模态嵌入以识别驱动虚拟化身的人，WBA2026 AUC 0.769。
AI.motivation: 逼真化身视频把“渲染面孔的外观”与“实际操作者”解耦，传统人脸识别无法识别操作者；需要一种对外观不敏感、只刻画面部运动方式的表征来完成操作者验证。
AI.method: 完全从零训练，不依赖任何外部预训练模型。①关键点模态：对分组面部关键点做扩散式掩码预训练学习运动表征，配合轻量辅助任务（预测运动强度、眼睛开合等行为线索），再用对比式线性探针得到操作者嵌入；训练时对输入做随机变换以模拟不同生成器对运动的改动，从而泛化到未见生成器。②视频模态：用相邻帧差分捕捉细微面部运动。③两模态嵌入拼接融合。
AI.result: 在WBA2026基准上整体AUC为0.769。线性探针分析显示：视频嵌入几乎不保留化身身份信息，关键点嵌入则保留一部分；模态融合在说话与聆听两种模式下带来明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 运动中心的多模态（关键点+帧差分）表征可在不自监督外部模型的前提下实现跨生成器泛化的人身（操作者）验证，且两模态在身份信息泄露与验证性能上互补。

title: MATE-BT: A Behavior-Tree-Based Framework for Hierarchically Decentralized Mission Autonomy in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Teams
summary: Multi-robot teams executing predefined missions must adapt to runtime changes and sustain mission management despite robot failures. This paper proposes MATE-BT (Mission, Allocation, and Task Execution with Behavior Trees), a hierarchically decentralized framework that separates mission execution, allocation, and task execution. An active onboard leader manages mission progression and team-level task assignment, with authority transferable to another leader-capable robot after failure. Interchangeable decentralized methods resolve target assignments, while each robot adapts its local behavior through planning and acting with behavior trees. Webots simulations and real-robot experiments demonstrate mission continuity despite new targets and robot failures, including active-leader failure. In the physical experiments, all MATE-BT computation runs onboard. Hardware-in-the-loop resource measurements further support onboard execution on Jetson Orin Nano and Raspberry Pi 5. By updating only the affected layers without full-plan regeneration, MATE-BT maintained a response time of approximately 130 ms with 30 robots and 120 targets. Comparisons of four target-assignment plugins reveal scenario-dependent trade-offs between mission completion time and total travel distance.

AI.tldr: MATE-BT: 分层去中心化多机器人任务框架，分离任务执行、分配与任务执行三层，采用行为树+可转移领导者，支持故障与目标变更下的任务连续性，全部计算在机器人端运行。
AI.motivation: 多机器人团队执行预设任务时需应对运行时变化与机器人失效，需要可维持任务管理连续性的架构。
AI.method: 分层去中心化框架：机载主动领导者负责任务推进与团队级任务分配，失效后可移交权限给其他具备领导能力的机器人；目标分配由可互换的去中心化方法插件完成；各机器人用行为树进行本地规划与执行；仅更新受影响层，避免全局重规划。
AI.result: Webots仿真与真机实验验证了新目标与机器人故障（含领导者失效）下的任务连续性；真机实验全部机载计算；硬件在环资源测量支持Jetson Orin Nano与Raspberry Pi 5；30机器人120目标时响应时间约130 ms；四种分配插件在任务完成时间与总行程间呈现场景相关折衷。
AI.conclusion: 分层去中心化+行为树的组合可在资源受限平台上实现鲁棒、低延迟的多机器人任务管理，分配策略需按场景选择。

title: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
summary: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) \textbf{Timely tool invocation remains unreliable}: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) \textbf{Query-free reminders remain poorly covered}: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) \textbf{End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited}: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 Omni-InteractScope 基准，含 1,479 条人工标注、交叉复核的交互与 1,790 个时间目标，覆盖流式音视频下的定时工具调用、无查询主动提醒与序列化引导，揭示现有 Omni-LLM 在及时性、主动性与全序列覆盖上的三大缺陷。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM 被期望在连续音视频流中实时辅助用户，但现有评测无法刻画模型能否可靠地把流内证据与用户需求连接起来，并给出及时、持续、主动的干预。
AI.method: 构建 Omni-InteractScope 基准：1,479 条经人工标注与交叉复核的交互样本、1,790 个时间目标、8 类任务组，将输入模态、事件触发点、干预类型与用户需求显式关联；涵盖事件定时的工具调用、无查询辅助，以及通知、警告、状态跟踪与连续响应；并对 12 个模型做评测，另设针对性控制实验（事件定位、响应历史与频率）以消融诊断。
AI.result: （1）12 个模型中工具调用首次响应准时率最高不超过 40%，时序与工具联合正确率最高 32.0%；（2）无查询提醒的及时目标召回不超过 23.0%，且普遍低于显式提问场景；（3）26 条引导序列中 9 个模型零完整覆盖，其余 3 个各仅覆盖 1–3 条；控制实验表明工具调用分数不能代表事件接地能力，提醒覆盖率依赖响应历史与频率。
AI.conclusion: 现有 Omni-LLM 在流式场景的及时行动、无查询主动性与全序列覆盖三方面均存在系统性不足，需要面向流式助手重新设计与评测；该基准为后续研究提供了可诊断、细粒度的评测框架。

title: Model-Aware Generation of Safety-Critical Scenes for Robust End-to-End Driving via Distilled Planner Surrogates
summary: End-to-end driving models perform well on standard benchmarks but collide frequently in safety-critical scenarios. We present a failure-mode analysis on NeuroNCAP which shows that 95.9% of DiffusionDrive's collisions are planning failures despite reliable detection, pinpointing the bottleneck in planning rather than perception. We attribute this to a fundamental data imbalance, as safety-critical interactions are rare in real driving logs, so planners are hardly ever trained on them. We close this gap with a novel model-aware framework that generates safety-critical training scenes against a specific planner. Each planner is attacked at the bird's-eye-view (BEV) level through a differentiable surrogate distilled from its own planning head. This keeps the expensive video renderer out of the attack loop. We extract 50 scenes per planner, each pairing an attack with a safe escape trajectory that serves as the fine-tuning label. A fully automated quality-diversity search generates both the attacks and the escapes, so that their variety is not specified by hand. Only these scenes are rendered to fine-tune the planner, which reduces the computational cost significantly. Fine-tuning on these scenes roughly halves the closed-loop collision rate of two planners on NeuroNCAP (SparseDrive 28.0% to 12.2%, DiffusionDrive 37.5% to 19.2%) while largely preserving normal driving. A cross-planner transfer experiment shows that the gain comes from targeting the specific planner. Each planner improves most on the scenes generated against itself, and DiffusionDrive fine-tuned on SparseDrive's scenes retains only 6.7 of its 18.3-point collision-rate reduction.

AI.tldr: 针对端到端自动驾驶规划器的模型感知安全关键场景生成框架：在BEV层面用可微代理对特定规划器发动攻击并自动搜索配套安全逃逸轨迹，仅渲染50个场景用于微调，使NeuroNCAP闭环碰撞率减半
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶模型在标准基准表现良好但在安全关键场景频繁碰撞；作者在NeuroNCAP上做失败模式分析，发现DiffusionDrive 95.9%的碰撞源于规划失败而非感知，根因是真实驾驶日志中安全关键交互极稀缺导致的数据不平衡——规划器几乎从未被训练在危险场景中应对。
AI.method: 模型感知框架：从规划器自身规划头蒸馏出可微BEV级代理模型，在BEV表示空间对规划器定向攻击（避免视频渲染器进入攻击循环，大幅降低开销）；用全自动质量-多样性（QD）搜索同时生成攻击场景与安全逃逸轨迹，作为对比式微调标签；每个规划器提取50个场景，仅渲染这批场景做微调。
AI.result: NeuroNCAP闭环碰撞率近似减半：SparseDrive 28.0%→12.2%，DiffusionDrive 37.5%→19.2%，同时基本保持正常驾驶性能；跨规划器迁移实验显示收益来自定向性——各规划器在针对自身的场景上提升最大，DiffusionDrive用SparseDrive场景微调仅保留18.3点降幅中的6.7点。
AI.conclusion: 安全关键场景的稀有性是可闭环修复的规划瓶颈；对特定规划器定制的BEV级对抗式场景生成+QD搜索逃逸标签是一种计算高效、可迁移性弱但针对性强的失败驱动微调范式，可为闭环驾驶策略鲁棒性提供数据侧补充。

title: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
comment: Published in Remote Sensing 18(20), 3535 (2026). Code and checkpoints: this https URL and this https URL
summary: Referring expression grounding in overhead imagery requires oriented bounding boxes rather than horizontal ones, since aerial objects appear at arbitrary orientations. Most grounding models emit box coordinates sequentially; Parallel Box Decoding (PBD) instead predicts all geometry slots in one forward pass, but only for four-coordinate horizontal boxes. We extend this block-aligned interface to a six-slot oriented representation using a double-angle parameterization. Rather than assuming correctness from a decreasing loss curve, we verify the extension with image/prompt-shuffle controls and visibility/leakage probes, which show that the corrected model depends on both the image and the prompt rather than on prompt statistics alone. On the aerial vehicle visual grounding (AVVG) benchmark, whose targets are genuinely oriented, the extended model improves rotated intersection over union (rotIoU) from 0.1253 for the zero-shot baseline to 0.303 +/- 0.012 (mean +/- standard deviation over three training seeds) across the complete 6139-record test split spanning all 120 images. Learning oriented boxes rather than their axis-aligned envelopes adds 0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU beyond a matched control (per-seed 95% confidence intervals all excluding zero), whereas block expansion alone yields no rotIoU gain distinguishable from zero.

AI.tldr: 将并行框解码(PBD)的四槽水平框接口扩展为六槽旋转框(双角度参数化)，用于俯视影像指代表达定位，并用图像/提示打乱与可见性探针验证模型确实依赖图像与提示；AVVG 上 rotIoU 由 0.1253 提升至 0.303。
AI.motivation: 俯视影像中目标朝向任意，需要定向框而非水平框；但现有并行框解码器只支持四坐标水平框，逐坐标回归的定位模型效率受限。
AI.method: 把 PBD 的块对齐接口从四槽扩展到六槽，采用双角度(double-angle)角度参数化以避免角度回归的不连续性；不依赖损失下降判断有效性，而用图像/提示打乱对照与可见性、泄漏探针做因果性验证，并设置"水平包络框"与"仅扩块"两类匹配对照。
AI.result: 在 AVVG 基准完整 6139 条测试记录(120 张图像)上，rotIoU 从零样本基线 0.1253 提升到 0.303±0.012(三个随机种子)；学习定向框相较匹配的水平包络对照额外带来 0.055±0.008 rotIoU(各种子 95% CI 均不含零)，而单纯块扩展无显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 简单的槽位扩展需配合正确的角度参数化与严格的对照/探针验证才产生真实收益；该工作为俯视影像指代定位提供了可复现的旋转框并行解码方案。

title: RoKON: Efficient and Adaptive Data-Enabled Predictive Control for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Data-enabled predictive control has recently emerged as a promising control paradigm, enabling a transparent optimal-control formulation without the need to learn an explicit dynamics model. This paper presents a number of extensions paving the path towards its use in real-time robotics tasks. Following recent work, we utilize a nonlinear predictor based on Gaussian kernels to represent the relationship between input and output data. We propose a damped Gauss-Newton method that enables real-time control by efficiently exploiting the least-squares structure of the control problem. In addition, we introduce a hybrid buffer management strategy that incorporates informative online data while retaining relevant offline data, allowing the predictor to account for changes in the dynamics. We demonstrate the tracking performance and computational suitability of the proposed method in MuJoCo using a Franka Research 3 arm pushing a block across surface, without prior knowledge of its changing friction values.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了数据驱动预测控制（DeePC），采用基于高斯核的非线性预测器，提出阻尼高斯-牛顿法实时求解并利用最小二乘结构，同时引入混合缓冲区管理在线/离线数据以适应动力学变化，在MuJoCo中完成Franka机械臂推动变摩擦滑块的跟踪任务。
AI.motivation: 无模型预测控制（DeePC）无需显式学习动力学模型即可给出透明的最优控制形式，但要用于真实机器人实时任务仍缺少高效求解手段与在线适应机制。
AI.method: 1）以高斯核构造输入-输出数据的非线性预测器（非线性DeePC）；2）针对控制的非线性最小二乘结构设计阻尼高斯-牛顿法，实现实时求解；3）混合缓冲区管理：在线注入信息量大的新数据同时保留相关离线数据，使预测器可跟踪动力学变化。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo仿真中用Franka Research 3机械臂推动平台上的滑块，在摩擦系数变化且无先验知识条件下实现跟踪，并验证了计算实时性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非线性数据驱动预测控制走向实时机器人应用提供了求解效率与在线适应两方面的可行路径，但验证仍限于仿真环境，未见真机实验。

title: DEX-PHD: A Dexterous Portable Handheld Device for Multimodal Data Collection
summary: Existing manipulation data collection methods typically offer either accurate robot-state acquisition through kinematic-chain-based teleoperation or convenient, portable operation through vision-based approaches. We present DEX-PHD, a portable handheld device that combines these advantages for dexterous manipulation by integrating a dexterous robot hand, continuous per-finger control, and multimodal logging. The system records proprioceptive information, fingertip contact data, and wrist-camera video, while the operator directly controls the robot hand through joint-level mapping. Its untethered design enables data collection across diverse environments. We demonstrate DEX-PHD on contact-rich tasks requiring coordinated multi-finger manipulation and deploy the collected demonstrations through open-loop replay on a physical humanoid robot. The results show that open-loop replay preserves the main temporal patterns of finger motion and task-relevant contact. Therefore, DEX-PHD provides a practical platform for portable, multimodal dexterous manipulation data collection.

AI.tldr: DEX-PHD：一种便携式无缆手持设备，集灵巧机械手、逐指连续控制和多模态记录于一体，用于采集接触丰富的灵巧操作示范数据。
AI.motivation: 现有操作数据采集方案存在权衡：基于运动链的遥操作能获得精确机器人状态，但便携性差；基于视觉的方案便携但难以获得准确本体状态。作者希望兼顾两者，实现便携、多模态、低成本且可跨环境部署的灵巧操作数据采集。
AI.method: 硬件上把手持设备与灵巧机器人手结合，操作者通过关节级映射直接控制机器人手，实现逐指连续控制；系统同步记录本体感知信息、指尖接触数据和腕部相机视频，并采用无缆设计以支持多种环境采集。在需要多指协同的接触丰富任务上演示该系统，并将采集的示范以开环回放方式部署到实体人形机器人上，分析手指运动的时间模式与任务相关接触是否得以保留。
AI.result: 开环回放能保留手指运动的主要时间模式以及任务相关的接触特征，说明关节级映射采集的数据在跨具身迁移（人手尺度设备→人形机器人）时仍具可用性。摘要未给出定量指标、任务成功率或与基线方法的对比。
AI.conclusion: DEX-PHD提供了一个实用、便携、多模态的灵巧操作数据采集平台，适合作为灵巧操作/人形机器人数据管线的工具性工作；但缺乏定量评估、闭环策略学习与规模验证，尚不足以证明其在VLA等下游任务上的增益。

title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
summary: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Culture-MMT 诊断基准（498 条去标识化社交媒体 UGC，跨 20 领域），按所需证据类型分为 Symbol/Visual/Hybrid 三类，并构建与人类对齐的领域专用评估器 Judger 及受控证据变量评测框架，量化视觉证据与文化语用适配对多模态机器翻译的独立贡献。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体跨语言传播中，UGC 语义分散于文本、图像与文化知识之中；现有评测通常把图像视为可选、假设文本信息充分，从而无法区分翻译错误究竟源自视觉证据缺失还是文化适配不足。
AI.method: 构建 Culture-MMT 诊断基准，按证据依赖类型（Symbol/Visual/Hybrid）分层；开发领域专用、与人类判断对齐的自动评测器 Judger；设计受控评测框架，系统改变翻译模型可用证据（真实图像、随机图像、人工撰写的图像描述等）；在 17 种模型配置上开展对比实验。
AI.result: 真实图像带来 Visual 类 +0.280、Hybrid 类 +0.197 的提升，但对 Symbol 类仅 +0.050；随机图像无类似增益，说明增益来源于语义对齐而非单纯多模态输入。人工描述实验显示，即便视觉事实已显式给出，联合依赖型样本仍更难处理。
AI.conclusion: 将文化有效的社交媒体翻译刻画为“分布式证据下的语义重构”；视觉 grounding 与文化语用适配是两类彼此独立的模型瓶颈。

title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
summary: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出TP-JSCC：面向云边协同LVLM 3D-VQA的混合token剪枝（LGS-HTP）＋轻量token联合信源信道编码（T-JSCC），实现约180倍数据量压缩与90%计算开销节省，且CIDEr损失<1%。
AI.motivation: 在带宽受限、噪声信道上把LVLM部署到资源受限具身智能体做3D视觉问答，需云边协同；直接上传海量视觉数据带来严重时延与传输失真。
AI.method: LGS-HTP：解耦前景/背景token，联合局部与全局语义进行混合冗余剪枝，保留推理关键token；T-JSCC：级联轻量线性层压缩已剪枝token，并加入SNR自适应机制适配波动信道，计算开销极小。在ScanQA与SQA3D上验证。
AI.result: ScanQA验证集上LGS-HTP达90%剪枝率而CIDEr损失<1%；T-JSCC进一步18倍压缩，总体数据量降低180倍，LVLM部署计算复杂度节省90%。
AI.conclusion: 将token剪枝与联合信源信道编码结合，可在云边协同下实现6D/3D-VQA的高效鲁棒传输，为具身智能体侧LVLM部署提供可行路径。

title: S$^2$-RL: Sample-Set Dual Reinforcement Learning for Generative Semantic Segmentation Dataset Distillation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: this https URL
summary: While dataset distillation has witnessed significant advances in image classification, its extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation is plagued by two core bottlenecks: bi-level optimization-based approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs stemming from pixel-wise gradient unrolling, whereas proxy-based generative methods merely infuse visual textures into fixed semantic masks derived from real data, thus failing to condense rich semantic knowledge into a compact set of informative, novel scene generations. To address both bottlenecks simultaneously, we propose a novel Sample-Set Reinforcement Learning (S$^2$-RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD). Specifically, S$^2$-RL formulates SSDD as a diffusion model based text-to-image generation paradigm, enabling flexible generation of images with informative, novel semantic distributions via a concise text prompt. Furthermore, we fine-tune a diffusion policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), leveraging a sample-set dual reward paradigm: for individual samples, it enforces semantic alignment with input text prompts and intra-class feature diversity; for sample sets, it maximizes inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem. These design choices enable S$^2$-RL to distill large-scale semantic segmentation datasets into a compact set of generated samples that encapsulate diverse, informative semantic knowledge without the need of pixel-wise gradient unrolling. Extensive experiments on the ADE20K and COCO datasets demonstrate that S$^2$-RL achieves substantial and consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a new benchmark for SSDD.

AI.tldr: 提出S²-RL框架，将生成式语义分割数据集蒸馏表述为基于扩散模型的文生图范式，并用GRPO微调扩散策略，结合样本级与样本集级双重奖励（样本级语义对齐与类内多样性，集合级以上下文多臂老虎机最大化样本间语义分布多样性），避免像素级梯度展开，将大规模分割数据集压缩为少量高信息量生成样本。
AI.motivation: 语义分割等稠密预测任务的数据集蒸馏存在两大瓶颈：基于双层优化的方法需像素级梯度展开，计算代价过高；基于代理的生成方法仅将视觉纹理贴到真实数据衍生的固定语义掩码上，无法将丰富语义知识凝练为紧凑、新颖的场景生成。
AI.method: 1) 以混合共轭梯度使混合二次型可分离，实现精确原始-对偶近端梯度更新；2) 在稀疏图上以近似间隙参数在α-β-割表示的多胞形内优化α-β-图的割函数；3) 用原始-对偶和顶点交换原语求解超梯度上升，得到局部α-β-图最优割。
AI.result: 在ADE20K与COCO上相对SOTA基线取得显著且一致的提升，建立了SSDD新基准；训练全程无需像素级梯度展开，大幅降低计算开销，生成样本兼具语义对齐、类内特征多样性与集合级语义分布多样性。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散文生图与GRPO强化学习结合、以双重奖励驱动采样，是可扩展且有效的生成式分割数据集蒸馏路径，为稠密预测任务的数据压缩提供了新范式。

title: Enhancing Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Motion Planning via Task Decomposition
summary: Training robotic manipulation policies in simulation is widely adopted due to safety and cost efficiency; however, tasks involving obstacles remain under-performing and often converge slowly under Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). To address this challenge, we propose a task decomposition framework for DRL that integrates Transfer Learning (TL) with Reward Redesign (RR) to improve learning efficiency and robustness in obstacle environments. The TL strategy selectively transfers only the first-layer critic parameters across structurally related tasks, since that layer captures general state--action representations while deeper layers encode reward- and obstacle-specific value geometry; RR decomposes tasks into staged sub-objectives to provide denser optimization signals. Experiments on the PyBullet Panda platform show consistent gains in obstacle settings. On Push with obstacle, our method achieves $0.83 \pm 0.05$, outperforming the strongest baseline (Truncated Quantile Critics (TQC), $0.77 \pm 0.06$) by approximately $7.8\%$. On Slide with obstacle, performance reaches $0.95 \pm 0.02$, exceeding Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) ($0.84 \pm 0.06$) by about $11\%$ success rates. In addition to higher final performance, forward transfer reduces convergence time by up to $70\%$ in obstacle tasks, and RR shortens sparse-reward Pick-and-Place training from roughly $0.75$M to $0.20$M steps ($\approx73\%$ reduction). The best policy is deployed on a real Franka Emika FR3 robot as a qualitative feasibility demonstration.

AI.tldr: 提出结合迁移学习(TL)与奖励重设计(RR)的DRL任务分解框架，仅迁移首层critic参数并分阶段重塑奖励，在障碍物操作任务上提升成功率与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 仿真中训练机械臂操作策略虽安全省成本，但含障碍物任务在DRL下性能差、收敛慢，需要提升学习效率与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 任务分解框架：TL仅跨结构相关任务迁移第一层critic参数（该层刻画通用状态-动作表征，深层编码奖励/障碍特定价值几何）；RR将任务拆为分阶段子目标以提供更稠密优化信号。PyBullet Panda平台评测，最佳策略部署于真实Franka Emika FR3做定性验证。
AI.result: 有障碍Push达0.83±0.05，较最强基线TQC(0.77±0.06)高约7.8%；有障碍Slide达0.95±0.02，较SAC(0.84±0.06)高约11%。前向迁移使收敛时间最多缩短70%；RR将稀疏奖励Pick-and-Place训练从约0.75M步降至0.20M步(约73%)。
AI.conclusion: 选择性浅层critic迁移与奖励分阶段重塑可显著提升障碍操作任务的样本效率与最终成功率；真机FR3仅作定性可行性演示，缺少定量真机证据。

title: Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 (Highlight). Project page: this https URL
summary: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.

AI.tldr: 将位姿图优化（PGO）与不确定性感知加权融入 ACE-Zero，从预测场景坐标中提取相对位姿约束来精化相机位姿并抑制错误优化。
AI.motivation: ACE-Zero 等学习式 SfM 虽无需 GT 监督即可从无序图像估计位姿与场景坐标，但缺乏全局与多视图一致性约束，在复杂/歧义场景中易出现位姿漂移与错位。
AI.method: 从 ACE-Zero 输出的场景坐标反解相对位姿约束并构建位姿图；结合对极约束与光流一致性等几何先验估计边的不确定性置信度，在 PGO 中做加权优化，从而抑制错误约束与过度精化。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅定性表明位姿估计的鲁棒性与精度得到提升，验证全局几何推理可有效补充学习式推理。
AI.conclusion: 学习式前馈位姿推断与经典全局几何优化（加权 PGO）互补的混合框架是提升无监督 SfM 稳定性的可行路径。

title: HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space
summary: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出HiFiPix，一个像素空间Real-ISR框架，通过跨尺度小波判别器(CWSD)、Mixup对比自蒸馏(MixCSD)抑制patch边界伪影，并用选择性LoRA剪枝(LoRA-SP)平衡生成能力与保真度。
AI.motivation: 基于VAE潜空间的扩散Real-ISR因潜在压缩导致信息损失，重建保真度受限；像素空间扩散模型可避免压缩，但直接迁移存在patch边界伪影与生成能力退化问题。
AI.method: 像素空间扩散Real-ISR框架：CWSD在图像级惩罚不真实的高频周期成分以抑制patch边界伪影；MixCSD对中间表示做对比自蒸馏正则；发现LoRA上存在异构的生成-保真权衡，据此提出LoRA-SP自适应剪枝LoRA层。
AI.result: 大量实验表明HiFiPix在恢复精度与感知质量上均大幅优于现有SOTA潜空间方法。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间扩散可作为高保真Real-ISR的有效方案，配合伪影抑制与LoRA选择性剪枝可兼顾保真与生成能力；代码与模型将开源。

title: Learning High-Quality Pseudo-Labels for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出由先验引导初始化(PGI)与共识引导精化(CGR)组成的伪标签框架,用于点监督时序动作定位(PTAL),在THUMOS14上取得68.5%平均mAP。
AI.motivation: 现有PTAL伪标签方法存在两点不足:(1)基于置信度的初始化会忽略定位良好但置信度不高的候选proposal;(2)伪标签在检测器训练中或保持固定、或虽被更新但未充分利用原始候选池中的边界证据,导致监督质量受限、检测性能受阻。
AI.method: 框架包含两个模块。PGI:将proposal置信度与由点标注导出的先验结合,为每个实例建立可靠性度量,用于初始伪标签筛选与候选保留。CGR:在训练过程中持续利用被保留的原始候选构造边界目标,将其共识与检测器不断演化的预测结合,以迭代精化伪标签。
AI.result: 在四个基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能;THUMOS14上tIoU 0.1–0.7平均mAP达68.5%,较PseR提升3.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以先验引导初始化+共识引导精化的联合策略可显著提升点监督时序动作定位的伪标签质量与检测精度,代码已开源。

title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: GenSfM 用多模态扩散 Transformer 联合去噪形状潜变量与各视图位姿潜变量（共享自注意力），并结合 3D-native UV-volume 分词与位姿感知精化，实现少视图无标定下的重建+生成统一框架。
AI.motivation: 经典 SfM 只能恢复与输入一致的部分几何、无法补全不可见区域；原生 3D 生成得到合理但不忠于输入的物体；简单串联两者会误差级联。目标是同时满足分布先验与输入一致性。
AI.method: 基于多模态扩散 Transformer 的联合去噪：在共享自注意力下同时建模形状潜变量与逐视图位姿潜变量，用物体级先验推断不可见区域、以观测视图 grounding 几何；采用紧凑的 3D-native UV-volume tokenization 控制随视图数增长的自注意力序列长度；后接位姿感知阶段在恢复的相机位姿上采样逐体素图像特征，精化几何与纹理。
AI.result: 在 Toys4k 与 GSO 上、4 张无标定视图条件下，相比强原生 3D 生成基线，新视角 PSNR 提升 3.2–4.5 dB，中位 Chamfer 距离降低 2.8–3.8 倍；输入视图位姿恢复 Acc@5° 超过 96%，且无需外部位姿估计骨干、后处理优化或已知内参。
AI.conclusion: 将图像 3D 重建与原生 3D 扩散生成在单一联合去噪框架内耦合，可避免两阶段误差级联，同时兼顾输入一致性与不可见区域的先验补全，并实现无标定位姿的端到端恢复。

title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
summary: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

AI.tldr: WorldPager：面向交互式世界模型，将历史 KV 记忆按 int4 存储于 GPU/DRAM/NVMe 层级，利用相机位姿的先验可预测性做零阻塞预取与后台写回，在单卡 4090 上连续生成 37.5 分钟视频且无停顿。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需保留历史 chunk 的 KV 作为检索记忆以维持重访场景一致性，但在消费级单机上受两重瓶颈限制：容量（Matrix-Game 2.0 的 KV 在 bf16 下 45 秒、int4 下 2.8 分钟即耗尽 32GiB 主机内存）与模型位置编码的 4.3 分钟视界。
AI.method: 指出该记忆是容量受限而非带宽受限，且因相机位姿是输入，访问集在计算前已知。据此建立分析模型预测溢出点（误差在一个 chunk 内）并判定零/非零 stall。WorldPager 用该模型指导：int4 KV 分级存放于 GPU/DRAM/NVMe（而非重算），按外推位姿预取下一 chunk 记忆，never-wait 的 miss 处理，后台写回；并采用免训练的位置处理扩展位置视界。
AI.result: 分析模型在留出配置上准确预测溢出点与 stall 分类；系统连续生成 37.5 分钟视频、零停顿、主机内存恒定，约 9.5 FPS；密封测试集上 int4 存储无可测质量损失，长间隔重访时 MUSIQ 约下降 1 分。
AI.conclusion: 首个将交互式世界模型 KV 记忆下沉到 NVMe 层并实现零停顿预取的方案，证明以位姿可预测性驱动的分层存储可突破消费级硬件上的长时交互生成瓶颈，代价仅为重访场景的轻微画质退化。

title: EARS: Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and Motion for Budgeted Video Reasoning
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Uniform frame sampling can miss brief evidence in sparse-event videos when the VLM sees only K frames. We propose EARS (Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and motion), a training-free, query-free front-end that ranks frames using optical-flow motion and audio energy, then applies temporal non-maximum suppression for diversity. The evidence score alone has frame-level AP 0.39; used only to select frames for the VLM, EARS with temporal diversity reaches localization AP 0.94, compared with 0.88 under Uniform sampling. In the updated matched study, at K = 1 EARS reaches XD-subset F1 0.660 versus 0.614 for centered Uniform (the paired interval includes zero); earlier backbone studies use separate protocols. On mostly-silent UCF-Crime, however, EARS slightly trails Uniform. A single configuration is used across both benchmarks; the new controls do not repeat the original held-out search. EARS therefore targets low-budget videos whose salient evidence aligns with motion or audio; on dense narratives or stealthy events, uniform or semantic selection remains preferable, and cheap modality statistics cannot reliably route between them. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: EARS：无需训练、无需查询的帧选择前端，用光流运动能量与音频能量打分并做时间非极大值抑制，为低预算VLM选取稀疏事件证据帧。
AI.motivation: 均匀采样帧数有限（K帧）时，稀疏事件视频中的短暂证据容易被漏掉，导致VLM定位失败。
AI.method: 训练自由、查询无关的前端：以光流运动幅度与音频能量构造帧级证据分数，再做时间维非极大值抑制以保证选取帧的多样性，仅用于选择送入VLM的K帧。
AI.result: 证据分数本身帧级AP 0.39；经时间多样性选择后定位AP达0.94（Uniform为0.88）。匹配研究中K=1时XD子集F1 0.660 vs 中心均匀采样0.614（配对区间含零）；纯静音为主的UCF-Crime上略逊于Uniform；两基准共用单一配置，新对照未重跑原始留出搜索。
AI.conclusion: EARS适用于低预算、显著证据与运动或音频对齐的视频；密集叙事或隐蔽事件场景下均匀或语义选择更优，且廉价模态统计难以可靠地在两者间路由。属相邻工具性贡献，非VLA/3D核心方法。

title: Metric Scale for Insta360 Structure-from-Motion from the Camera's Embedded IMU
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Dataset: this https URL
summary: Structure-from-motion (SfM) from the dual-fisheye video of a consumer 360-degree camera recovers geometry only up to a similarity transform; in the pipeline considered here, metric scale is obtained from smartphone ARKit or ARCore poses captured alongside the camera. This paper evaluates a self-contained alternative: the IMU embedded in the Insta360 X5 and X6, recorded at 1 kHz. The sensor is characterised (noise density, camera-IMU synchronisation, accelerometer scale factor, bias stability), the camera-IMU rotation and frame timing are estimated from the data, and the scale is recovered by a linear visual-inertial alignment over the SfM poses of a whole survey. The standard formulation, with gravity and accelerometer bias shared across the survey, overestimates the scale by 3.4% on average; estimating each contiguous segment independently and averaging removes the bias. On nine surveys with a co-mounted LiDAR scanner the inertial scale deviates from the LiDAR by 0.74% in mean absolute error, against 1.94% for the smartphone scale; on printed fiducial markers both agree within the 1% uncertainty of the target. On the reference trajectories of thirty sequences of a public benchmark, brought to scales of 1/40, 1 and 40, the estimator recovers the metric scale with a mean error of -0.07% and a standard deviation of 1.28%. On fifty production surveys where the smartphone is the only reference, the two scales agree to a standard deviation of 2.6%, the inertial scale being 0.9% lower on average; the difference does not depend on window construction, grows with the extent of the smartphone anchor, and cannot be attributed to either reference. An ablation over window construction and a comparison with monocular metric-depth networks complete the study.

AI.tldr: 利用Insta360 X5/X6内置1kHz IMU，通过线性视觉-惯性对齐恢复360相机SfM的度量尺度，并分段估计消除系统偏差。
AI.motivation: 消费级360相机SfM只能恢复相似变换，现有度量尺度依赖手机ARKit/ARCore位姿，本文希望用相机自身IMU实现自包含的尺度恢复。
AI.method: 对IMU做噪声密度、同步、加速度计尺度因子与偏置稳定性标定；估计相机-IMU旋转与帧时序；在整段巡测的SfM位姿上做线性视觉-惯性对齐求尺度，并改为逐连续片段独立估计后平均。
AI.result: 标准全局公式高估尺度约3.4%，分段平均消除偏差；9组与LiDAR同机扫描对比，惯性尺度MAE 0.74%，手机尺度1.94%；标定板精度在1%内；公开基准30序列多尺度下误差均值-0.07%、标准差1.28%；50组生产数据两尺度标准差2.6%，惯性尺度平均低0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 消费级360相机内置IMU可作为智能手机位姿的独立度量尺度来源，精度优于手机AR位姿，但两种参考在生产数据上存在无法归因的0.9%系统性差异。

title: High-resolution tactile observation makes hidden racket-control mechanisms learnable
comment: 58 pages, including 14 pages of main text and 44 pages of supplementary information. 5 main figures and 19 supplementary figures
summary: Experts can master fine hand-object manipulation skills, yet limited conscious perception of rapid tactile interactions hinders their ability to articulate the underlying control mechanisms. Badminton racket control requires rapid, fine hand-force coordination, providing a demanding testbed for uncovering these mechanisms. An 864-node tactile-inertial glove with synchronized 100-Hz acquisition recorded over 14,000 strokes from more than 70 participants across five skills. Inspired by sensorimotor control, our mechanics-grounded two-layer framework inferred object-driving and grip-stabilizing control from tactile history, while resolving their spatiotemporal force realization. We found that higher proficiency was associated with selective rather than extensive control: greater skill specificity, anticipatory regulation, focal distal modulation and lower geometric torque cancellation, while spatiotemporal coordination showed a non-monotonic acquire-refine pattern. We translated these mechanisms into personalized guidance targeting force control and force-motion coordination. In a randomized cohort, mechanism-guided learners gained 0.72 expert-rated skill levels versus 0.05 with level-only feedback, making control mechanisms actionable.

AI.tldr: 用864节点触觉-惯性手套采集70余人5个水平、超14000次羽毛球挥拍数据，提出力学驱动的两层框架从触觉历史推断物体驱动与握持稳定两类控制并解析其时空力实现，揭示高水平对应“选择性而非广泛”控制，并以机制引导的个性化反馈在随机队列中将技能提升0.72级（对照0.05级）。
AI.motivation: 专家级手-物精细操作的控制机制因快速触觉交互的自觉感知有限而难以言说；羽毛球拍控制需要快速精细的手部力协调，可作为揭示该类机制的严苛测试平台。
AI.method: 自研864节点触觉-惯性手套，100 Hz同步采集，覆盖70余名受试者、5种技能水平、逾14000次挥拍；受感觉运动控制启发构建力学落地的两层框架，从触觉历史中推断“物体驱动控制”与“握持稳定控制”，并解析二者的时空力实现；据此生成针对力控制与力-运动协调的个性化指导，并在随机对照队列中验证。
AI.result: 高熟练度与“选择性而非广泛”的控制相关：技能特异性更强、前馈/预期性调节、远端聚焦调制、更低的几何力矩抵消；时空协调呈非单调的“习得-精炼”模式。随机队列中机制引导组提升0.72个专家评定技能等级，仅水平反馈组为0.05。
AI.conclusion: 将难以言说的专家触觉控制机制显式化、可计算化，并证明其可作为可执行的个性化训练反馈，显著优于单纯的绩效水平反馈。

title: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
summary: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image.
