But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Copying-as-Defense (CaD)，通过在DiT编辑器的早期Transformer块中最大化目标token对参考图像的注意力质量，使模型"复制"而非"编辑"输入图像，从而实现主动防御。
AI.motivation: 基于DiT的上下文图像编辑器（如Flux Kontext）可被滥用于有害或未经同意的图像篡改。现有主动防御通过削弱输出对受保护参考图的注意力，但这反而让模型仅凭文本和已生成token继续完成编辑，产生弱接地的新图像，防御失效。
AI.method: 反其道而行：通过受控注意力干预发现，仅在前若干早期块中将目标token注意力集中于参考图即可崩溃编辑行为。据此提出CaD，将早期块中逐token的target-to-reference注意力质量最大化；由于注意力行归一化，提升参考注意力会自然压低文本与生成画布的注意力。目标仅限早期块，可截断反向传播路径，降低优化开销。
AI.result: 在多个编辑器与基准上，平均编辑成功率从无保护图像的81.4%降至24.0%（相对降低70.6%），相对最强基线DeContext（43.0%）再降44.3%。每步优化速度约为同类方法的1.8–2.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 对DiT上下文编辑器的主动防御应引导模型复制参考图而非忽视它；早期块注意力集中即可有效崩溃编辑，且计算高效。

title: Preemptive Instruction Following with Resumption
summary: Long-horizon embodied navigation may be interrupted by a higher-priority instruction before the current task sequence is complete. The agent must finish its current atomic task, execute the inserted task, and resume the remaining sequence from the updated environment state, where its viewpoint and available navigation candidates may have changed. To evaluate this capability, we introduce PIFR benchmark, a novel task for runtime task preemption and resumption in embodied navigation. PIFR includes single, repeated, and nested interruption settings,with stage-specific metrics for inserted-task completion, resumption of the original task, and completion of the full sequence. Evaluations show that recovery performance varies across interruption conditions, while aggregate success can obscure differences in interruption handling and resumption. We further propose a lightweight candidate-ranking baseline to improve target re-grounding after interruption. Together, PIFR and the baseline provide a systematic framework for studying interruption handling and task recovery in long-horizon embodied navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出PIFR基准，评估长时程具身导航中运行时任务抢占与恢复能力，含单次、重复、嵌套中断设置及分阶段指标，并提出轻量候选排序基线以改善中断后的目标重定位。
AI.motivation: 长时程具身导航常被更高优先级指令打断，智能体需完成当前原子任务、执行插入任务并从状态变化后的环境恢复剩余序列；现有评测缺乏对此类抢占-恢复能力的系统性衡量，且聚合成功率会掩盖中断处理的差异。
AI.method: 构建PIFR基准任务，设计单次、重复与嵌套三种中断条件，并定义分阶段指标分别度量插入任务完成、原任务恢复与整序列完成；同时提出一个轻量的候选排序（candidate-ranking）基线，用于中断后重新定位目标。
AI.result: 实验显示不同中断条件下的恢复表现差异明显，聚合层面的成功率会掩盖中断处理与恢复环节的差异；候选排序基线可提升中断后的目标重定位效果。
AI.conclusion: PIFR与基线共同构成研究长时程具身导航中中断处理与任务恢复的系统性框架，强调需采用分阶段指标而非单一聚合成功率进行评测。

title: Hyperspectral Unmixing using a Structured Linear Mixing Model with Additive Spectral Variability
summary: Linear hyperspectral unmixing aims at retrieving pure material spectra present in an observed scene and their associated abundance fractions in each pixel. In most practical situations, hyperspectral images are affected by spectral variability (SV) also known as intra-class variability, which is caused by different physical phenomena including atmospheric effects, intrinsic variability of the pure materials and illumination or topographic changes. Nevertheless, the standard hyperspectral unmixing methods that rely on the Linear Mixing Model (LMM) do not consider these phenomena. Thus, neglecting them will spread errors throughout the linear hyperspectral unmixing process. To avoid this problem, this paper proposes two hyperspectral unmixing algorithms dedicated to a parametric model called Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM). This mixing model handles SV in an additive manner by incorporating two terms into the standard LMM. Moreover, the designed algorithms are based on Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and optimize a cost function which integrates additional penalization accounting for SV. Furthermore, a novel improved initialization scheme, which takes SV into account, is proposed. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for linearly unmixing hyperspectral images with SV compared to the tested state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出两种面向Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM)的高光谱解混算法，基于NMF并在代价函数中加入光谱变异惩罚项，同时给出考虑光谱变异的改进初始化方案。
AI.motivation: 标准线性混合模型(LMM)解混忽略光谱变异(大气效应、材料本征差异、光照/地形变化)，导致误差在整个解混流程中传播；需在参数化模型中显式建模类内变异以提升解混精度。
AI.method: 采用SAV-LMM：在标准LMM上以加性方式引入两个变异项；据此设计两个基于NMF的解混算法，最小化含光谱变异附加惩罚的代价函数，并提出考虑SV的改进初始化策略。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实高光谱数据集上，所提算法相较对比的当前最优方法在存在SV的线性解混中表现更有效。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模光谱变异的NMF型解混算法与配套初始化可有效缓解LMM在SV情形下的误差，验证了SAV-LMM参数化框架的实用性。

title: Distributed Predictive Flocking for a Swarm of Miniature Vibration-Driven Robots in a Confined Arena
comment: Submitted to Robotics and Autonomous Systems
summary: Coordinating many miniature robots in a confined arena, with no leader, central planner, or global map, is a core challenge for swarm robotics. As the swarm grows denser, collision avoidance becomes the limiting factor, and the number of safely coexisting robots depends on the formulation of the inter-robot safety constraint. We present a distributed predictive flocking controller in which each robot solves its own nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) problem, optimizing swarm cohesion and alignment costs, inter-robot and obstacle safety, and a task objective, while exchanging only predicted trajectories with local neighbors. Within this generalized controller architecture, solved in real time, we compare six barrier and control-barrier-function (CBF) safety formulations on a digital twin of an open-source vibration-driven bristlebot in a $0.64\,\mathrm{m^2}$ arena. A look-ahead discrete-time CBF performs best overall, with the fewest collisions and the widest inter-robot margins across nearly every swarm size tested. We deploy it on phototaxis, phototactic orbiting, and cohesion without a stimulus tasks, using swarm sizes starting from ten robots and up to the geometric packing limit. The swarm holds well: collisions stay low in small swarms, rising steeply as the packing limit approaches, while coordination and cohesion degrade gently rather than collapsing. The swarm is found not to trade safety for order, keeping both across the confined arena, with local alignment high at every swarm size.

AI.tldr: 分布式NMPC集群控制器，每个机器人仅与邻居交换预测轨迹，在数字孪生bristlebot上比较六种避障安全约束，发现look-ahead离散时间CBF最优，并在10台至几何堆积极限规模下实机验证光趋性等任务。
AI.motivation: 受限场地内无中心规划、无全局地图的集群机器人协同是核心难题；随着集群密度上升，避障成为限制因素，而安全共存机器人数量取决于机器人间安全约束的具体形式，需要系统比较。
AI.method: 构建分布式预测式flocking控制器：每个机器人求解自己的NMPC，优化群体凝聚/对齐代价、机器人间与障碍物安全、任务目标，仅与局部邻居交换预测轨迹。在该通用架构下于0.64 m²场地的一款开源振动驱动bristlebot数字孪生上，比较六种barrier与CBF安全约束形式。
AI.result: look-ahead离散时间CBF整体表现最佳：几乎在所有测试规模下碰撞最少、机器人间裕度最大。实机部署光趋性、光趋环绕、无刺激凝聚三类任务，规模从10台至几何堆积极限：小规模碰撞率低，接近堆积极限时碰撞陡升，但协调性与凝聚性仅平缓退化而非崩溃；局部对齐在各规模下都保持较高。
AI.conclusion: 集群不会用安全性换取有序性，在受限场地内两者兼得；安全约束的形式选择是决定安全共存规模的关键设计变量。

title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 Self Flow Forcing (SF²)，在 DMD 蒸馏框架中额外引入预测式表征损失，通过给学生与 EMA 教师不同噪声水平制造信息不对称，迫使学生从更退化的输入预测教师内部表征，从而在不改动输出目标的前提下融合自监督表征对齐，显著改善少步视频扩散模型的空间保真度与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏（few-step distillation）对视频扩散模型部署至关重要；DMD 虽在输出空间保真度上表现优异且无需对抗训练，但其目标仅约束输出空间，缺少对内部表征的显式正则。当蒸馏步数极度压缩时，纯输出监督不足，导致学生模型在细粒度空间结构与连贯时间动态上同时退化。
AI.method: 在 DMD 的原有输出目标之外增加一个预测式表征损失：对学生输入施加更高噪声、对 EMA 教师输入施加较低噪声，形成信息不对称（information asymmetry），要求学生从更被破坏的输入回归教师的中间层表征，等价于将其自监督表征对齐嵌入分布匹配流程；机制与架构无关，无需外部特征提取器，额外算力开销极小，同时兼容双向与因果视频模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 SF² 能有效抑制时间闪烁（temporal flickering），并在空间保真度与运动质量上取得一致提升；对双向与因果两类架构均可无缝迁移，且计算开销增加很小。
AI.conclusion: 将表征层级的自监督对齐补充进输出空间的分布匹配，是缓解激进少步蒸馏下质量退化的有效且通用手段，提供了一种轻量、架构无关的少步视频扩散蒸馏增强方案。

title: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
summary: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.

AI.tldr: RoboDoctor：免训练的执行期适应框架，将诊断、接地动作与持久经验记录（记录决策理由、尝试方法、结果与复用条件）串联，在策略与语言代理间分配控制，并在54条RoboDojo-Sim任务上取得五维均分57.10、原生成功率49.44%。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略与语言模型代理能力互补，但任务完成还需依据物理交互后果调整其用法；作者关注把"执行"本身当作适应发生的场所——反馈既指导当前动作，也在权重固定条件下为修订后续决策提供证据。
AI.method: 提出免训练的RoboDoctor框架，围绕三个修订目标组织：harness（在策略与代理之间分配控制权）、intervention（决定何时介入以保留有效策略行为）、operation（依据观测到的效果精修物理操作方法）；并用关联经验记录保存决策原因、所尝试方法、结果与复用条件。
AI.result: 在自建的54条RoboDojo-Sim任务条目档案上，五维平均分57.10，原生成功率49.44%；记录到的交互体现了策略切换、选择性纠错与抓取方式修订等行为。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了所评估系统中的执行期适应能力；但缺乏受控实验，尚不能分离跨回合经验本身的贡献，需后续对照试验验证。权重固定、无训练、仅仿真且自建评测集，证据强度有限。

title: Context-Aware Generation and Modulation of Expressive Motion Behavior using Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Expressive robot motion positively impacts human-robot interaction by improving user engagement, likability, or task performance. We present a novel approach to automatically generate and modulate complex, expressive full-body gesture sequences from a multimodal (text, audio, video) context description. Based on a unified mathematical implementation of the Principles of Animation using Dynamic Movement Primitives, we use multimodal foundation models to generate such sequences along with parametric motion variations that are highly context-aware. This method extends the state of the art in terms of flexibility and generality by being interpretable, composable, and working across different robot morphologies. Moreover, we integrate the system into a continuous control framework and leverage knowledge distillation to learn a much smaller model, significantly improving token efficiency and system latency. Results from a user study with a human-like platform indicate that participants judged our system's motions to be better aligned with the interaction context than motions produced under a non-modulated or API-level condition. We also demonstrate how the system generates expressive motion for robots with different kinematics, showcasing its versatility. Paper webpage: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 基于动态运动基元(DMP)统一实现动画十二原则，用多模态基础模型从文本/音频/视频上下文生成可参数化调制的全身表达性手势序列，并集成到连续控制框架，通过知识蒸馏压缩模型以提升token效率与降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 表达性机器人运动能提升用户参与度、好感度与任务表现，但自动生成并调制复杂、上下文感知的全身手势序列仍缺乏灵活、可解释、可跨形态通用的方法。
AI.method: 将Disney动画原则以DMP的数学形式统一实现，用多模态基础模型生成手势序列及其参数化运动变体；方法具备可解释性与可组合性，跨机器人形态适用；系统封装进连续控制框架，并用知识蒸馏训练小模型以降低延迟。
AI.result: 用户研究（类人平台）表明，相较无调制条件与API级基线，被试认为该系统的运动与交互上下文更契合；并演示了对不同运动学结构机器人的表达性动作生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 动画原则+DMP+多模态基础模型的组合可生成可解释、可组合、跨形态的表达性手势，配合蒸馏实现低延迟部署，具备通用性。

title: Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction
comment: 34 pages, including 5 pages of Supplementary Methods; 10 main-text figures and 1 supplementary figure
summary: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于开源工具包LumenMorph生成的合成可变形管状场景基准（5,580张RGB图），交叉三类表面运动条件与动/静态相机，提供相机位姿、深度、形变场、持久材质对应与有限元记录，用于评估可变形3D重建。
AI.motivation: 可变形3D重建评估缺乏同时关联相机运动、表面形变、材质对应与图像外观的真值数据，现有资源难以区分配准覆盖度与几何精度。
AI.method: 用LumenMorph配置化生成管状场景，构建三类表面运动×动/静相机的基线，附外观匹配变体；公开文档化接口给出位姿、几何、深度、形变场与持久三角面身份材质权重；另以独立实现的几何与力学检查验证标注自洽性；开展SfM、光流与几何驱动的位移插值实验。
AI.result: 实验表明该资源可区分配准覆盖与几何精度、揭示相机与表面运动的影响，并暴露力学先验的收益与失配；数据完整性、固定环境可重复性和预测得分回放各有独立验证范围。
AI.conclusion: 提供一个受控合成参考基准，不宣称解剖或临床真实性，可通过公开读取器、评估契约与可配置生成器支持复用扩展。

title: Robot-Aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Precise Reaching with Wrist-Camera VLA Policies
summary: Efficient robotic data collection remains a major bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) policy learning, especially for tasks requiring accurate end-effector positioning and camera-action alignment. This challenge is particularly severe in electronic-waste disassembly, where robots operate in cluttered assemblies of densely packed, visually similar components. Full digital-twin simulation is difficult because many parts are thin, reflective, or mechanically complex, making accurate object-level meshes and contact models difficult to obtain. In this work, we focus on pre-contact reaching and propose a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based data generation pipeline for wrist-camera VLA adaptation. Our method reconstructs the real workspace with 3DGS and renders diverse wrist-camera observations from robot-aligned poses. These observations are paired with smooth, structured reaching trajectories to provide robot-aligned visual-action supervision for VLA fine-tuning. We further augment the VLA policy with an instruction-conditioned reach verifier that estimates target proximity and provides reliable termination before physical interaction. Experiments in motherboard disassembly demonstrate precise VLA-based reaching using wrist-camera observations alone, without an external side-view camera. With $\pi$0.5, 1,500 generated trajectories achieve 80.0\% precise-reaching success across three targets, compared with 58.7\% using 150 teleoperated demonstrations, while requiring less than 10 minutes of active human capture. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 用3DGS重建真实拆解工作台并按机器人对齐位姿渲染虚拟腕部相机观测，配套平滑结构化接近轨迹，为VLA微调提供视觉-动作监督，并加一个指令条件化的接近验证器决定终止时机；主板拆解任务上1500条生成轨迹达80.0%精确接近成功率，优于150条遥操作的58.7%。
AI.motivation: VLA策略学习受限于高效机器人数据采集，尤其需要末端精确定位与相机-动作对齐的任务；电子废弃物拆解场景中部件密集、外观相似、薄壁反光，难以建立精确物体级网格与接触模型的数字孪生仿真，因此需要低成本、机器人对齐的数据生成途径。
AI.method: 聚焦接触前的接近阶段：(1) 用3DGS重建真实工作空间；(2) 从机器人对齐位姿渲染多样化腕部相机观测，与平滑结构化接近轨迹配对，形成机器人对齐的视觉-动作监督用于VLA微调；(3) 为VLA策略增加指令条件化的reach验证器，估计目标邻近度并在物理交互前给出可靠终止。仅依赖腕部相机，不需要外部侧视相机。
AI.result: 在主板拆解实验中使用π0.5，三个目标上1500条生成轨迹实现80.0%精确接近成功率，对比150条遥操作示范的58.7%；主动人工采集时间不足10分钟。
AI.conclusion: 以3DGS渲染替代数字孪生仿真，可低成本放大机器人对齐的VLA示范数据，并配合邻近验证器实现纯腕部相机的精确接近；该管线可推广到其他细碎、反光、难以几何建模的工业拆解场景。

title: From Language to Drives: A Multimodal Framework for Aligning Autonomous Robots with Human Purposes
summary: This work explores a multimodal approach to the alignment of the behavior of open-ended learning autonomous robots with human purposes through the use of large language models as cultural enablers. While autonomous robots can generate their own skills and goals through interaction with the environment, they often lack mechanisms to ensure that these remain relevant and aligned to those of human users. The proposed approach makes use of the general and cultural knowledge contained in LLMs and VLMs to establish a multimodal interactive alignment process in which human purposes, expressed in natural language, are transformed into motivational components of a robot architecture in the form of robot missions and drives that guide the behavior of the robot. The system is structured into three layers for semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling. This design enables a bidirectional interaction loop: human inputs define high-level purposes, robots expand them into executable missions making use of multimodal information relayed by LLMs and VLMs, and feedback maintains alignment with human intent. Experiments in simulation and with a physical robot demonstrate that the process produces valid missions and behaviors, supporting effective human-agent alignment in interactive scenarios with autonomous robots.

AI.tldr: 用LLM/VLM作为"文化赋能器"，将自然语言表达的人类目的转化为机器人架构中的任务(mission)与驱力(drive)，实现开放式学习机器人的多模态交互式价值对齐。
AI.motivation: 开放式自主机器人能自主生成技能与目标，但缺乏保证这些目标与人类意图相关的对齐机制。
AI.method: 三层架构：语义对齐层、任务生成层、驱力建模层；利用LLM/VLM的通用与文化知识构建双向交互循环，人类输入高层目的，机器人展开为可执行任务，反馈维持对齐。
AI.result: 仿真与实体机器人实验表明可生成有效任务与行为，支持有效的人-智能体对齐。
AI.conclusion: LLM/VLM可作为文化中介，将人类目的落地为机器人动机组件，形成可行的交互式对齐流程。

title: Revisiting Direct Control: A Field Evaluation of Sensor Fusion Efficacy in Teleoperating Full-Scale Autonomous Vehicles via Bird's Eye View
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: In autonomous driving, robot teleoperation serves as a critical safety fallback mechanism, requiring operators to assume direct control in the event of system failure. While recent research has pivoted toward high-level supervisory control or simulation-based studies, these approaches often fail to capture the physical dynamics and sensory demands of driving a full-scale vehicle. To address this gap, we evaluated the impact of spatial data representation on operator performance using a real car-sized vehicle in a field experiment with $N = 18$ participants. We compared three visualization interfaces: (i) a standard camera feed baseline, with two bird's-eye views (BEV) from (ii) a raw LiDAR point cloud, and (iii) a sensor fusion of LiDAR and camera data streams. Contrary to prior passive observation studies suggesting that sensor-fusion BEV may hinder awareness, our active-control results demonstrate that such representation significantly outperforms the standard LiDAR BEV in perceived usability ($p \leq 0.0001$) and cognitive task load ($p = 0.01$, NASA-TLX score: 34.58/100) while also being significantly better than the Camera-only view ($p = 0.043$). The fused interface also led to statistically significant reductions in task completion time ($p = 0.0461$) and superior usability (SUS: 77.9/100) compared to those of the Camera-only and LiDAR-only views. By synthesizing objective performance data with comprehensive subjective assessments, we demonstrate that BEV fusion maximizes safety margins while minimizing the operator's mental demand. These findings challenge existing teleoperation conventions and provide an empirically validated approach for designing robust remote piloting systems.

AI.tldr: 在真实车体尺度的车辆上开展实地实验（N=18），比较三种遥操作可视化界面：原始相机视角、LiDAR点云鸟瞰图（BEV）、以及LiDAR+相机的传感器融合BEV。结果显示融合BEV在可用性、认知负荷（NASA-TLX 34.58）、任务完成时间和SUS（77.9）上均优于单模态方案，与以往被动观察研究结论相反。
AI.motivation: 遥操作是自动驾驶失效时的安全兜底机制，但近期研究多转向高层监督式控制或仿真实验，难以还原真实全尺寸车辆的物理动力学与多感官负荷；同时，此前基于被动观察的研究提示传感器融合BEV可能损害态势感知，需在主动控制场景下重新验证空间数据表征对操作员绩效的影响。
AI.method: 真实车体尺度车辆上的被试内实地实验（N=18），对比三类可视化界面：（i）标准相机馈送基线；（ii）原始LiDAR点云BEV；（iii）LiDAR与相机数据流传感器融合BEV。采用客观任务完成时间指标与主观量表（NASA-TLX认知负荷、SUS可用性、感知可用性）相结合的混合评估方法，并进行统计显著性检验。
AI.result: 融合BEV在感知可用性上显著优于LiDAR-only BEV（p≤0.0001）与Camera-only视角（p=0.043）；认知负荷显著更低（p=0.01，NASA-TLX 34.58/100）；任务完成时间显著缩短（p=0.0461）；SUS达77.9/100，优于两种单模态界面。而LiDAR-only BEV相对基线未表现出优势。
AI.conclusion: 在主动遥操作控制条件下，LiDAR-相机融合BEV能最大化安全裕度并最小化操作员心理负荷，纠正了基于被动观察的既有结论，为鲁棒的远程驾驶系统界面设计提供了经实证验证的方案。局限在于样本量较小、单一场景与单一车辆平台，且未涉及学习型感知或端到端策略。

title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Pretrain to Adapt
summary: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpTTA：世界模型测试时自适应目标中加入规划器的 goal-reaching cost 项，使模型对"达成目标"乐观，替代纯预测目标，平均提升规划成功率约13.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型离线预训练后冻结使用，部署时分布漂移导致规划退化。规划场景下的 TTA 是闭环的：规划器用模型 rollout 选动作，产生的转移又驱动下一次更新。仅用预测损失时模型只拟合自身动作的结果，对"能到达目标"的动作仍可能判断错误，低预测误差不等于更优规划。
AI.method: 借鉴自适应控制中的 reward-biased maximum likelihood，构造双项目标：观测转移上的预测损失 + 规划器在其候选 rollout 上的 goal-reaching 代价，二者对模型参数联合最小化；无需额外环境交互。可仅适应 predictor，也可同时适应 encoder；在三种 JEPA 世界模型、CEM 与梯度规划器上验证。
AI.result: 视觉与环境漂移下（操作、到达、导航任务）：仅适应 predictor 时相对冻结模型最终成功率平均 +13.5 点，AdaJEPA（仅预测目标）为 +6.9；同时适应 encoder 时为 +13.5 与 +7.5。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型用于规划时，测试时自适应应在预测损失之外引入乐观的、任务感知的项；目标空间偏差是 TTA 有效性的关键。

title: SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion
summary: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出生成式配准-融合框架 SeeRF：先用微分同胚静止速度场形变生成+视觉基础模型特征+由粗到细渐进配准实现跨模态流估计与有效视场掩码生成，再将配准与扩散生成模块紧耦合，通过跨模态控制编码与控制残差特征编解码实现非重叠视场区域的补全与自然融合。
AI.motivation: 多模态传感器存在视角差异与视场不匹配，现有融合方法难以突破视场限制实现场景级信息整合，融合结果常残留模态专属区域与伪影，削弱场景结构与语义表达的完整性。
AI.method: 基于微分同胚静止速度场的形变生成策略；视觉基础模型引导的特征提取；由粗到细的渐进式多模态配准模块，输出跨模态流与有效视场掩码；配准模块与扩散生成模块紧耦合的 generative registration-fusion 框架，含跨模态控制编码模块与控制残差特征编码器-解码器，用扩散先验完成视场外区域补全与融合。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集与真实场景上的大量实验表明，该方法性能优于对比方法，验证了有效性、优越性与鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 将跨模态配准与生成式扩散先验联合建模，可突破共享视场假设，实现非重叠视场区域的自然补全与融合，为场景级多模态信息整合提供可行范式；后续代码将开源。

title: VPR-Space: A Benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in Space Analog Domains
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE). Under this GT we require a VPR method to identify exactly those image pairs for which a subsequently applied RPE is expected to provide a valuable pose estimate in a SLAM context. (3) We evaluated nine state-of-the-art VPR approaches. The results show considerable room for improvement and indicate directions for future research. We provide a pre-release version of the dataset on github: $\texttt{ this https URL }$

AI.tldr: 提出 VPR-Space 基准，基于月球/火星类比域（SAD）构建16个VPR库-查询数据集，并提出以下游SLAM效用为依据、由相对位姿估计器（RPE）集成性能生成的GT矩阵，评测9种SOTA VPR方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VPR与视觉SLAM在城市场景和特征丰富的自然环境中表现良好，但月球、火星等地外表面广阔且纹理稀疏，对现有方法构成严峻挑战；同时传统VPR基准中以固定位姿阈值定义"同一地点"的标注方式具有病态性（ill-posed），与下游SLAM实际需求脱节。
AI.method: 1) 基于Space Analog Domains收集16组VPR库-查询数据集，涵盖环境、视角变化与光照条件多样性；2) 摒弃固定位置与视角阈值，改以"匹配是否对下游SLAM有价值"定义GT，通过对SOTA相对位姿估计器集成（ensemble）的实测性能生成GT矩阵，从而避免在环评估SLAM的开销与限制；3) 评测9种SOTA VPR方法。
AI.result: 9种SOTA VPR方法在该基准上表现仍有明显提升空间，结果揭示了未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 地外表面特征稀疏场景下的VPR现有方法尚不成熟；以SLAM任务效用驱动的GT构造方式为VPR基准提供了更合理的评价范式，数据集已开源预发布版本。

title: Environment Edits as a Corrective Signal for Reward Learning
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 Workshop on Learning from Corrections
summary: Robot corrections allow people to adjust a robot's behavior, but a single correction changes many features. Also, preferences about object attributes and relationships between objects cannot be expressed by moving the robot. We propose environment edits as a complementary form of feedback. The robot's motion is held constant as the human edits the scene, so the only explanation for the edit is the moved object. We introduce Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces (FERRET), which learns preferences from both robot and environment corrections. We show that environment edits are able to disambiguate features and learn preferences that robot corrections alone cannot.

AI.tldr: 提出“环境编辑”作为一种补充反馈形式：机器人运动保持不变，人通过移动/编辑场景物体来表达偏好；由此提出 FERRET，从机器人修正与环境编辑轨迹中联合学习特征与偏好，可消歧特征并学到仅靠机器人修正无法获得的偏好。
AI.motivation: 机器人修正（如拖动机械臂）一次改动会同时改变多个特征，存在特征纠缠与歧义；且物体属性偏好、物体间关系偏好无法通过移动机器人来表达，因而需要更清晰、可表达关系约束的反馈通道。
AI.method: 以“机器人运动不变、仅场景发生变化”为约束，使环境编辑的唯一解释为被移动的物体，从而提供低歧义的偏好信号；构建 FERRET 框架，从机器人修正与环境—机器人关系编辑轨迹（edit traces）中共同学习特征表示与偏好模型。
AI.result: 实验表明环境编辑能够消歧特征，并学习到机器人修正单独无法学到的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 环境编辑与机器人修正互补，是一种有效的偏好学习反馈形式，可扩展机器人可从人类反馈中获取的偏好类型。

title: Continuous-Time Safe Planning and Control for Agile Quadrupeds
summary: Agile quadruped navigation in dynamic environments demands trajectories that are both dynamically feasible and provably collision-free. Most real-time planners achieve tractability through a convex reduction that requires simplified kinematic models, discarding motion that the robot can readily execute, and certify safety only at discretization points, leaving open possible inter-sample collisions with moving obstacles. We present a real-time motion planning framework that retains the fully-actuated $SE(2)$ model of a quadruped, with its anisotropic, heading-coupled velocity bounds, and accepts the resulting nonconvexity. By parameterizing trajectories as composite Bernstein polynomials, we exploit the convex hull property to certify collision avoidance and the input bounds over the entirety of each planning horizon. Solved at online replanning rates, the optimization runs in closed loop, commanding body velocities to the locomotion controller. We validate the approach in simulation against ablations and external baselines, and in hardware experiments on a quadruped navigating among unknown moving obstacles, recovering both lateral and heading-coupled motion that simplified models exclude.

AI.tldr: 提出实时运动规划框架，保留四足机器人完全驱动的 SE(2) 模型与各向异性、航向耦合速度约束，用复合 Bernstein 多项式参数化轨迹，借助凸包性质在每个规划时域整体（而非离散点）证明无碰撞与输入可行，闭环在线重规划输出机身速度给运动控制器。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的四足敏捷导航需要既动力学可行又可证明无碰撞的轨迹；现有实时规划器依赖凸简化与简化运动学模型，丢弃了机器人本可执行的运动，且仅在离散化点做安全检查，存在与运动障碍物在采样点之间碰撞的风险。
AI.method: 以复合 Bernstein 多项式参数化轨迹，利用其凸包性质在整个规划时域上认证碰撞规避与输入边界；保留完整 SE(2) 各向异性、航向耦合速度模型并直接处理由此产生的非凸性；优化在闭环中以在线重规划频率求解，向运动控制器下发机身速度指令。
AI.result: 仿真中与消融变体和外部基线对比验证；硬件实验中四足机器人在未知运动障碍物间导航，恢复了简化模型所排除的横向运动与航向耦合运动。
AI.conclusion: 连续时间可证明安全的非凸运动规划在真实四足平台上可行且实时，说明放弃简化运动学模型并未牺牲实时性，反而释放了更多可执行机动。

title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
summary: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: CounterFlow 提出基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的视觉反事实解释框架，在原始像素空间用目标类别条件的向量场直接把源图"引导"到指定目标类，生成真实感更强的语义修改。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉反事实解释多依赖 GAN 或扩散模型，生成质量不稳定且计算开销大，难以实际部署；作者希望用更轻量、更直接的生成机制在像素空间实现目标类定向修改。
AI.method: 以条件流匹配学习目标类别条件的向量场，将源图像沿该向量场积分/传输至目标类样本，无需 GAN 判别器或扩散采样链；直接在 raw pixel space 操作，避免编码器-解码器或潜空间映射带来的失真。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，CounterFlow 在视觉真实感与目标类别切换成功率两项指标上均达到 SOTA，且计算开销显著低于 GAN/扩散类方案。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配可作为高效视觉反事实生成的有效替代范式，像素空间直接操作更利于真实场景部署；但抽象未给出具体数据集、量化指标与用户研究，也未涉及机器人、3D 重建或 VLA 场景。

title: Printed and Scanned: Exposing the Fragility of Single-Image Morphing Attack Detectors under Print-Scan Degradation
summary: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了 SYN-MAD22 的打印-扫描版本（300/600 DPI，两台扫描仪），用于评测数字域训练的 8 个 S-MAD 模型，发现数字域接近 SOTA 的检测器在打印-扫描退化下平均 EER 上升三倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸变形攻击检测（S-MAD）基准几乎只覆盖数字域，而部分国家证件签发流程要求打印申请人照片再扫描回数字化，该环节引入半色调、重采样、色彩空间变化与传感器噪声，可能掩盖 S-MAD 依赖的高频伪影，导致数字基准性能与真实部署鲁棒性之间存在未被充分报告的落差。
AI.method: 将 SYN-MAD22 中全部真实与变形图像按 300 DPI 和 600 DPI 打印并重新扫描，构建打印-扫描版本数据集；用该数据集评测八个仅在数字数据上训练的先进 S-MAD 模型；并使用第二台扫描仪重复采集以评估跨设备鲁棒性。
AI.result: 数字域接近 SOTA 的检测器在打印-扫描条件下平均等错误率（EER）上升超过三倍；两台扫描设备上呈现一致的定性退化趋势。
AI.conclusion: 打印-扫描退化是 S-MAD 部署中的关键薄弱环节，数字域基准性能不能代表真实证件签发流程下的鲁棒性；需在含打印-扫描环节的数据上训练/评估 MAD 模型。

title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: this http URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniShowcase，包含自动化数据合成管线与基于转台表面法向图的几何条件方法，用于多参考视图的主体到视频（S2V）生成，并构建 Showcase-4K 数据集与 ShowcaseBench 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 单参考图 S2V 在相机揭示输入中不可见表面时需推测外观与几何；多视图方法虽提供更多信息，但未显式建模连接这些观测的 3D 结构，且现有训练数据不能保证视角变化下保持同一 3D 主体。
AI.method: (1) 全自动数据合成管线：由底层主体几何驱动，沿多样相机轨迹（可达 360° 环绕）生成训练视频；(2) 几何条件方法：从参考视图重建表面法向图并构成转台序列作为条件输入，无需与生成帧做时间对齐。构建 Showcase-4K（基于 3D 资产的 12 种相机运动、88 种轨迹配置）与带源网格和相机参数的 ShowcaseBench。
AI.result: 实验显示在主体身份一致性与 3D 一致性上达到当前最优，同时视频质量与运动表现保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以重建表面法向作为显式 3D 几何条件并结合几何一致性可控的数据合成，可有效提升多视图 S2V 的 3D 一致性与身份保持。

title: FISRF: Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework for Robotics Task Planning with Large Language Model
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely adopted for reflective error correction in task planning; however, existing approaches primarily rely on autonomous exploration, rendering them prone to accumulating erroneous experiences during early interactions with new environments. To address this limitation, we propose the Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework (FISRF), an agent--mentor architecture that estimates the robot's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) in task planning and adaptively selects reflection strategies and mentor guidance, thereby facilitating the accumulation of effective error-correction experience. Experiments in ALFWorld and on real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that FISRF reduces the average number of error-correction rounds by 37% and redundant reasoning by 25.1%, while improving the overall task success rate by 8%. Project webpage : this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FISRF，一种agent–mentor架构，通过估计机器人在任务规划中的最近发展区（ZPD）来动态选择反思策略与导师指导，从而减少无效反思经验的积累。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的任务规划反思纠错主要依赖自主探索，机器人在新环境交互早期容易累积错误经验，导致纠错效率低、冗余推理多。
AI.method: 借鉴教育心理学的最近发展区（ZPD）概念，构建agent–mentor双角色架构：mentor估计机器人当前能力边界（ZPD），并据此自适应选择反思策略与指导强度，引导agent积累有效的纠错经验。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与真实机器人平台上验证，平均纠错轮次减少37%，冗余推理减少25.1%，整体任务成功率提升8%。
AI.conclusion: 引入能力评估驱动的自适应脚手架式指导，可显著提升LLM规划agent的反思纠错效率，并具备真实机器人平台的可迁移性。

title: TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains
comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Biomimetics (ROBIO)
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.

AI.tldr: TrySee: 模块化闭环机器人任务规划流水线，将通用VLM推理与领域专用感知模块、运动规划组件结合，实现无需微调的可替换式在线 grounding。
AI.motivation: 通用VLM在机器人高层推理与任务规划上表现良好，但在专业化领域（如拆解）的图像理解与grounding能力不足；而领域专用训练数据稀缺，难以对VLM进行微调或端到端示教。
AI.method: 提出反应式循环规划流水线：VLM负责高层推理，前置领域专用模块化视觉预处理以提供在线grounding，并引入动态预处理选择机制以提升可扩展性；感知模块与运动规划器均可替换，无需VLM微调或端到端演示。
AI.result: 在5个差异显著的领域任务上评估，包含真实机器人拆解任务的现场测试；在brownfield环境中验证了将VLM规划集成进专用机器人系统的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 模块化闭环设计使通用VLM可低成本迁移到专用机器人领域，是VLM任务规划落地的一种务实路径；但感知仍依赖手工设计的领域模块，缺乏学习驱动的通用3D/接触级表征。

title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.

AI.tldr: Triage：面向视频扩散 Transformer 的无训练三档注意力近似方法，按块赋予“跳过/NVFP4 略读/NVFP4 残差精修”层级，用轻量 router 控制误差-算力权衡，并融合为单 pass kernel。
AI.motivation: 视频 DiT 中数万 visual token 的注意力是推理瓶颈；现有稀疏化/低精度方法对所有保留 tile 使用单一精度，忽略了不同 tile 近似误差差异极大的事实。
AI.method: 训练无关：基于块统计预测每个 tile 在三种近似层级的输出误差（块均值替换跳过、NVFP4 skimming、NVFP4 残差修正），仅当误差下降收益大于额外算力时升级层级，单一价格参数调节权衡；在 RTX Blackwell FP4 张量核上实现单次遍历的融合 kernel。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo、LTX-2.5 上端到端加速最高 2.32x（相对 dense FlashAttention）；5 个设置中均快于所有基线，且 PSNR 比最高 PSNR 基线高 0.3–3.0 dB。
AI.conclusion: 按 tile 自适应分配近似精度优于统一稀疏/低精度策略，可在不训练、不损失画质的前提下显著加速视频扩散推理。

title: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
summary: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.

AI.tldr: MatAnyone-E: 高效高分辨率视频抠图方法，先低分辨率传播定位不确定区域，仅对不确定区域进行高分辨率记忆匹配，并用贴合运行时瓶颈的轻量解码器替代原解码器，实现约7.4倍加速、4K下峰值显存降至7.6%，单张H200上1080p 73.07 FPS、4K 28.62 FPS。
AI.motivation: 基于记忆的视频抠图（如 MatAnyone 2）质量好，但随分辨率增长，全图高分辨率特征与跨帧记忆匹配的计算和显存开销急剧上升，难以实用化。
AI.method: (1) 先做低分辨率传播，识别需要精细处理的不确定区域及其最相关的记忆候选；(2) 仅对这些区域用所选记忆做高分辨率匹配，其余位置复用低分辨率匹配结果，同时减少匹配位置数与记忆检索量；(3) 依据实测运行时瓶颈设计轻量高分辨率解码器，并通过蒸馏拟合原解码器的表征以保持质量。
AI.result: 抠图质量与 MatAnyone 2 相当；估计推理加速约7.4倍，4K下峰值GPU显存约为 MatAnyone 2 的7.6%；编译推理下单张 NVIDIA H200 达 1080p 73.07 FPS、4K 28.62 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏化（区域+记忆）高分辨率匹配加瓶颈驱动的解码器蒸馏，可在几乎不损质量的前提下大幅降低高分辨率视频抠图的算力与显存成本，为高分辨率记忆式视频抠图提供可行工程路径。

title: A Category-Selective Encryption Framework for Privacy Protection of UAV Images
summary: Imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems increasingly raises privacy concerns, as UAV aerial surveillance routinely captures sensitive objects such as pedestrians and vehicles alongside ordinary scene content. Existing privacy-preserving approaches typically employ class-agnostic saliency detection to indiscriminately obfuscate all visually salient regions, leading to unnecessary information loss and hindering downstream scene analysis. This paper proposes a category-selective encryption framework for privacy-preserving UAV surveillance. The core advance over prior class-agnostic approaches is semantic-level selectivity: the system first recognizes what is present in the scene via an 80-class detector, then encrypts only user-specified sensitive categories while leaving non-sensitive objects and background intact for downstream analytics. The framework supports two complementary encryption schemes: Thumbnail-Preserving Encryption (TPE), which applies adaptive pixelation with a learnable blend parameter and recovers content through a jointly trained Enhanced U-Net, and XOR stream cipher encryption, which offers parameter-free, mathematically exact reversibility. The architectural design, composite loss formulation, and joint training methodology are presented in detail, establishing a foundation for practical privacy-preserving UAV surveillance that balances protection strength and scene utility.

AI.tldr: 提出面向UAV航拍的类别选择性加密框架：先用80类检测器识别场景，仅加密用户指定的敏感类别（TPE自适应像素化+增强U-Net恢复，或XOR流密码精确可逆），保留非敏感内容供下游分析。
AI.motivation: UAV航拍常拍到行人和车辆等敏感对象，而现有隐私保护方法依赖类别无关的显著性检测，对所有显著区域一律模糊，造成不必要的信息损失并阻碍下游场景分析。
AI.method: 语义级选择性加密流水线：80类目标检测器→按用户指定敏感类别做掩膜→两种互补加密方案：①Thumbnail-Preserving Encryption（TPE），采用带可学习混合参数的自适应像素化，并用联合训练的Enhanced U-Net恢复内容；②XOR流密码加密，无参数、数学上精确可逆。文中详述网络架构、复合损失与联合训练策略。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验数据；声称实现敏感类别加密与非敏感区域可用性的平衡，XOR方案保证精确保密可逆，TPE方案通过联合训练网络近似恢复内容，为下游分析保留场景效用。
AI.conclusion: 语义级类别选择性加密为UAV隐私保护提供了兼顾保护强度与场景可用性的可行框架，是迈向实用化UAV隐私保护监控的基础。

title: SPECOLA: A Tool for Specification Driven Robot Evaluation
summary: Simulation benchmarks are a useful way to measure progress in robotics; typically they provide success rate as the dominant measure of performance. However, success rate reports only whether a rollout completed the task, hiding by what margin it succeeded, how sensitive the success is to goal parameter changes, requirements it may have violated, and whether success persisted. Signal Temporal Logic (STL) provides a formal language for capturing specifications; it can be used to define requirements, and measure how close a robot behavior is to satisfying or violating them. Using STL monitors in a simulator, however, requires exposing simulator state and mapping it to specification-relevant signals. We present Specola, a tool for evaluating robot behaviors in simulation with respect to STL specifications. Specola provides an interface for writing specifications over simulator signals, and creates and manages the relevant monitors while a policy executes. We provide a Python API and command-line interface for integrating monitoring into existing policy execution loops. We provide an adapter interface for connecting new simulators, and provide adapters for nine simulation environments and benchmarks, including LIBERO, RoboCasa, Isaac Lab, and RoboDojo. We provide case studies that illustrate the nuanced evaluation that Specola enables. Code and adapters are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Specola：一个基于STL（信号时序逻辑）的机器人仿真行为评估工具，提供跨9个仿真环境的适配器与Python/CLI接口。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真基准主要以成功率作为主导性能指标，无法揭示成功的余量、对目标参数变化的敏感度、违规约束以及成功是否持续等问题。而STL可形式化表达规格并度量行为接近/违反规格的程度，但在仿真器中部署STL监视器需暴露仿真器状态并映射为规格相关信号，工具支持缺失。
AI.method: 提出Specola工具：提供在仿真器信号上编写规格的接口，在策略执行时自动创建与管理相应STL监视器；提供Python API与命令行接口以嵌入既有策略执行回路；提供仿真器适配器接口，并实现LIBERO、RoboCasa、Isaac Lab、RoboDojo等9个仿真环境/基准的适配器。
AI.result: 实现对多仿真环境的STL监控集成，并通过案例研究展示了Specola所能提供的细化评估能力（成功余量、参数敏感性、约束违规、持续性等），代码与适配器开源。
AI.conclusion: Specola补充了成功率之外的细粒度、形式化行为评估维度，为机器人仿真基准评测提供了可复用的基础设施工具。

title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
comment: 30 pages. To appear at NeurIPS 2026 (extended version)
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“目标冲突系数”量化多目标冲突程度并给出近最优遗憾界，进而设计路由式集成策略学习（routed ensemble）与核代理轨迹归因（kernel surrogate trajectory attribution）两种缓解冲突的方法。
AI.motivation: 多目标强化学习中，最优策略随目标权重组合急剧变化，变化幅度取决于目标间冲突程度，导致逐偏好单独学习策略样本效率低下，需要量化冲突并设计高效算法。
AI.method: (1) 提出目标冲突系数并推导在线设置下的近最优遗憾界；(2) 路由式集成策略学习：维护一小基策略集合，将轨迹动态路由至潜在奖励最高的策略；(3) 基于核的轨迹归因：用核函数估计一组轨迹的反馈信号对其他轨迹策略学习的影响，可捕获协同与拮抗等非线性交互，并用于轨迹选择。
AI.result: Meta-World 与 MO-Gymnasium 在线环境中路由集成平均性能较基线提升4.3%；核代理归因与留一分析相关性较现有基线提升50%；用于轨迹选择时奖励提升27%。
AI.conclusion: 目标冲突是决定多目标学习效率的关键可量化因素；路由集成与核归因轨迹选择是缓解冲突、提升样本效率的有效手段。

title: VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion
summary: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

AI.tldr: VidEdit3D将3D场景编辑重构为轨迹视频编辑任务，利用视频扩散模型的时空先验实现多视图一致的文本引导3DGS编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS文本编辑方法在"多视图一致性"与"允许结构修改"之间存在取舍，且图像编辑器在非常规视角下难以施加目标编辑。
AI.method: 提出三部分：Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) 沿相机轨迹选取关键帧并构建平滑视频片段以适配VDM输入；Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE) 为免训练框架，含Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG)，在共享隐状态上对比源/编辑图像条件并用调度式源图增强提升对参考编辑的遵循；Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) 将几何与外观更新严格限制在目标primitive，抑制背景属性泄漏。
AI.result: 实验显示指令对齐度与多视图一致性均优于基线方法，但摘要未给出定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 将静态3D场景编辑类比为视频时序编辑，借助VDM时空先验可有效缓解一致性与结构编辑的矛盾；免训练编辑+区域约束精修是可行路线。

title: Improving Signals, Declining Encoder: A Known-Answer Test of Label-Free Monitoring in Self-Supervised Learning
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: this https URL . Checkpoints: this https URL
summary: Self-supervised training is monitored without labels, through the loss and statistics of the learned features. We report a case where we know the encoders lost part of what they had learned, so we can check whether these signals noticed. We trained LeJEPA encoders on synthetic images with known generating factors. In nine of ten seeds, the readability of those factors fell abruptly and stayed down, nearly always along the same direction in factor space. Meanwhile the loss kept falling, and most of the eleven label-free signals we tracked kept improving and rated the declining runs better than runs that did not decline. Standard change-point detection rarely flagged the decline near its onset, and selecting checkpoints by these signals mostly chose ones after it.

AI.tldr: 在已知生成因子的合成图像上训练LeJEPA编码器时，10个随机种子中有9个出现表征因子的可读性骤降并持续降低，而损失继续下降，11个无标签监测信号中多数反而给出改善评价，且标准变点检测与检查点选择方法均未能及时识别或规避该退化。
AI.motivation: 自监督训练缺乏标签，通常依赖损失与特征统计等无标签信号来监测训练质量。作者希望检验这些信号能否察觉编码器"遗忘/丢失已学到信息"的隐性退化。
AI.method: 在生成因子已知的合成图像上训练LeJEPA编码器，追踪损失与11种无标签信号（特征统计、可读性代理指标等），并以生成因子的线性/探测可读性作为真实退化判据；对比退化运行与未退化运行，并应用标准变点检测与基于信号的检查点选择。
AI.result: 10个种子中9个出现因子可读性突降并持续下降，且退化方向在因子空间中高度一致；训练损失持续下降，多数无标签信号持续改善并更偏好退化运行；变点检测极少能在起始附近报警，基于信号的检查点选择大多落在退化之后。
AI.conclusion: 常用的无标签监测（损失、特征统计）不可靠，甚至系统性反向指示表征质量退化；需引入更有效的表征健康度诊断与检查点选取机制。但实验局限于合成数据上的单一方法（LeJEPA），外部有效性有待验证。

title: Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $\pi^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

AI.tldr: 冻结的 VGGT 前馈位姿回归器虽不输出位姿不确定性，但其中间融合层特征线性可探出"位姿是否错误"，HardMatch 上 ROC-AUC 93.5%，可让下游系统对不可信样本弃权并跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: VGGT 类单次前向的相机与几何回归模型对预测位姿不给任何不确定性，错误相对位姿与正确定位姿在输出上无法区分，缺乏可用的失效检测/弃权信号。
AI.method: 构建 HardMatch 基准（1000 对刻意困难图像对，VGGT 失败率 35%）；在冻结 VGGT 特征上加线性探针做位姿失败二分类；与 VGGT 自带 point-map 置信度和"全输出分类器"对比；做跨类别留出评估、弃权式下游实验、零重训迁移到 PhotoTourism 与 ScanNet-1500 的旋转失败，并控制共视度；通过逐层探测定位信息来源（两视图融合层中途），在第二个模型 π³ 上复现。
AI.result: 线性探针在留出类别上 ROC-AUC 93.5%，优于 point-map 置信度 79.7% 与全输出分类器 77.7%；能捕捉 VGGT 自信却失败的情形，支持下游弃权，并免重训迁移到两个数据集且超出共视可解释部分；该知识不在单图像编码器中，而由跨视图融合层计算，π³ 同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 前馈 3D 重建模型内部隐含了关于自身位姿失效的自知信号，只是未在输出中报告；提出轻量探针即可提取并用于弃权与泛化迁移。

title: Multimodal Concert Video Editing: System Design and Exploratory Evaluation
summary: Editing multi-camera concerts requires coordinated decisions about musical relevance, visual quality and cut timing. We present a modular framework that combines instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments and image sharpness with beat-based timing and probabilistic camera selection. An interpretable scoring model links these components to the choice of views over complete shot intervals. Component tests and an exploratory expert study on a four-camera concert yield mixed assessments across the editing variants. The findings motivate extending local audiovisual relevance with contextual and sequence-level criteria. The architecture provides a basis for testing these extensions and studying how component behaviour affects the quality of complete edits.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化多机位音乐会自动剪辑框架：融合多轨音频的乐器活动、可见乐器与图像清晰度，用节拍驱动的时间与概率化机位选择，并以可解释评分模型在完整镜头区间上进行选镜；组件测试与四机位专家初探研究结果喜忧参半。
AI.motivation: 多机位音乐会剪辑需在音乐相关性、视觉质量与切换时机之间协同决策，现有方法缺乏可解释的、模块化可检验的组件化方案。
AI.method: 模块化框架：从多轨音频提取乐器活动，结合可见乐器检测与图像清晰度构成局部视听相关性；以节拍为基础确定切换时机；采用概率化机位选择，并通过可解释评分模型在完整镜头区间层面做视图选择。
AI.result: 对各组件进行单元测试，并在四机位音乐会数据上开展探索性专家研究；不同剪辑变体评价不一，说明仅靠局部视听相关性不足以决定成片质量。
AI.conclusion: 需将局部视听相关性扩展到上下文与序列级准则；该架构为测试此类扩展、研究组件行为对完整剪辑质量的影响提供了基础。

title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
summary: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

AI.tldr: ZAP：用小型开源VLM（27B）加简单工具调用框架控制机器人，先以大模型自举世界理解与推理，再用模拟任务做SFT+GRPO教其运动，无真实机器人数据即在真机达96.7%成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略需同时具备"理解任务与场景"和"控制机器人运动"两种能力；VLA端到端训练昂贵且需大量真机数据，而通用大模型API昂贵、速度慢。
AI.method: 以预训练27B VLM为起点，通过tool harness（工具调用接口）输出机器人动作；用强模型引导（bootstrapping）建立世界理解与推理能力，再在简单仿真任务上用监督微调与GRPO强化学习教其操作技能，全程不使用真实机器人数据。
AI.result: 真机任务成功率96.7%，与GPT-6 Astra持平，远超MolmoAct2 VLA（33.3%），速度快3倍、成本低17倍；能泛化到新物体/目标/策略/语言（试管入架并换孔、双臂空中交接、井字棋画X、下棋）；迁移到未见过的单臂Franka本体，RoboLab-120上达55.9%，领先最强VLA/WAM基线4.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以小型开源VLM+工具调用+仿真RL的"智能体式策略"可在零真机数据下达到甚至超越大模型与专用VLA的水平，并具备强泛化与跨本体迁移能力。

title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
summary: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MiniWeb（65 站点、369 人工标注任务、37 个可复用交互原语/7 类技能族）用于技能级诊断，并用 MiniWebGen 自动生成技能中心训练数据微调 Qwen3.5-4B，再以规划器（MiniWebAgent）组合技能完成长任务，在 MiniWeb 未见解及 WebArena-Lite/Online-Mind2Web/WebVoyager 上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器智能体评测只看任务成败，无法定位失败技能；训练数据也缺乏针对性的技能覆盖，导致智能体"练得多但练不到点上"。
AI.method: 构建 15 个域、65 个互联站点的 MiniWeb 测试环境，标注 369 个日常流程任务与 37 个交互原语（7 个技能族）；基准测试 10 个开源权重智能体；提出 MiniWebGen 从该环境自动生成并验证技能级轨迹（3.1K 条）微调执行器；再构建 MiniWebAgent，由规划器将完整任务分解为已学技能步骤、交由执行器完成。
AI.result: 拖拽/手势为最弱技能族，无智能体成功率超过 24%；微调后单原语成功率在 13 个未见网站上提升 24.9pp 且全技能族均有增益；MiniWebAgent 在未见解 MiniWeb 站点提升任务成功率 19.4pp，零训练迁移至 WebArena-Lite +9.3pp、Online-Mind2Web +16.1pp、WebVoyager +20.0pp。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑浏览器智能体的可行路线是"直接练可复用技能，再组合技能解决陌生任务"；技能级评测与生成式数据构成闭环，短程技能训练需配合显式规划才能转化为长程任务成功率。

title: Seeing Through Distractions: Context-Stable Attribution via the Least Core
summary: Shapley-value-based explanations are widely used for feature attribution in machine learning. However, in computer vision, a feature may reduce the target-class score when added to the complete genuine image, even when the predicted label remains unchanged. We formalize such features as contextual distractors and investigate their attributions under semivalues and the least core. Under a weak average marginal monotonicity assumption, we derive quantitative semivalue--least-core gap bounds and sufficient conditions based on the probability of sampling smaller contexts. We further show that shifting semivalue weights toward larger contexts decreases the signed gap. Finally, controlled image-classification experiments and evaluations on Salient ImageNet provide strong empirical support for our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"加入真实图像后反而降低目标类别分数、但不改变预测标签"的特征形式化为语境干扰项，分析其在半值（semivalues）与最小核心（least core）下的归因差异，给出差值界与充分条件。
AI.motivation: Shapley值类特征归因在视觉任务中存在反常现象：某些特征在完整真实图像中加入后反而降低目标类得分，但预测标签不变。作者希望理解此类"语境干扰项"在不同合作博弈解（半值 vs. 最小核心）下的归因行为差异，从而为归因方法的稳定性提供理论解释。
AI.method: 形式化定义语境干扰项；在弱平均边际单调性假设下推导半值与最小核心归因差值的定量界，给出基于"采样到更小语境"概率的充分条件；并证明将半值权重向更大语境转移可减小有符号差值。
AI.result: 给出半值—最小核心差值界与充分条件，理论上表明权重偏向大语境时差值收窄；受控图像分类实验与Salient ImageNet评测对理论结论提供实证支持。
AI.conclusion: 为Shapley类归因在视觉模型中的反常现象提供理论刻画，说明半值与最小核心解在语境干扰项上的系统性差异，并可指导归因权重设计。

title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 系统评测前沿MLLM（GPT-6-Astra）在EBench上以agent方式控制机器人，对比直接控制与"harness+后训练VLA/WAM策略"两种配置与后训练策略的能力边界。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态大模型可零样本控制机器人，但其与后训练VLA、WAM策略在不同操作需求下的能力比较与互补关系缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 在统一视觉与本体感知观测协议下，将GPT-6-Astra作为agent通过agent harness控制机器人：配置一为直接生成航点指令；配置二为额外调用后训练VLA/WAM策略执行动作，并按任务维度分析性能。
AI.result: 直接控制下整体性能与后训练策略相当，短时域任务领先且跨泛化维度波动最小；长时域、桌面操作与高精度接触丰富任务落后。harness+策略组合可提升总体成功率至最强对比策略水平并显著降低token开销，但受策略调用次优、固定指令无子目标、恢复控制时抓取中断影响，仍未达各组件单任务上界。
AI.conclusion: 刻画了前沿MLLM agent的能力边界，指出harness设计改进方向（策略调用决策、子目标分解、控制权交接）。

title: MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer
summary: Multimodal medical AI requires a common visual interface for encoding heterogeneous imaging evidence for patient condition modeling. However, existing medical visual tokenizers are often tied to a specific dimension and imaging modality, forcing multimodal systems to rely on fragmented and poorly reusable representations. We introduce MedVTok, a general-purpose visual tokenizer that maps 2D images and 3D volumes from diverse imaging modalities into a unified token space. Building such a tokenizer poses two key challenges: preserving anatomical structure across dimensions and capturing clinical semantics across modalities. To this end, MedVTok introduces (i) slice differential regularization, which explicitly models inter-slice anatomical coherence missing in previous per-pixel/per-voxel supervision, and (ii) multi-expert representation alignment, which integrates knowledge from multiple medical expert encoders while retaining modality-specific complementary knowledge. Trained on 28M images and 70K volumes across 9 imaging modalities, MedVTok supports classification, retrieval, segmentation, synthesis, visual question answering, and medical report generation through a single tokenizer. Across 24 benchmarks, MedVTok achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating a scalable token interface that unifies medical image dimension, modality, and task usage.

AI.tldr: MedVTok：通用医学视觉分词器，将跨模态 2D 图像与 3D 体数据映射到统一 token 空间，支持分类、检索、分割、合成、VQA 与报告生成等多任务。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉分词器绑定特定维度与模态，导致多模态系统表示碎片化、复用性差，缺乏统一的视觉接口。
AI.method: 提出两个关键机制：(i) 切片差分正则化，显式建模层间解剖连贯性，弥补逐像素/逐体素监督的缺失；(ii) 多专家表示对齐，融合多个医学专家编码器知识并保留模态特异性互补信息。训练数据为 9 种模态、2800 万图像与 7 万体数据。
AI.result: 24 个基准上达到 SOTA，单一分词器覆盖 6 类下游任务（分类、检索、分割、合成、VQA、报告生成）。
AI.conclusion: MedVTok 提供了可扩展的医学视觉 token 接口，统一了图像维度、模态与任务使用方式；但评测限于医学领域基准，未涉及物理 AI、机器人或 3D 重建等核心方向。

title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
summary: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: OSWAM用"imagination tokens"初始化扩散过程并将扩散步数压缩至单步，实现直接策略式世界动作模型(World Action Model)的实时动作生成。
AI.motivation: 直接策略式WAM虽避免了显式未来视觉预测，但仍需数十步去噪，延迟高难以实时部署；简单减少步数会使多步非线性去噪轨迹退化为粗糙更新，动作质量显著下降。作者认为根因在于随机噪声初始化缺乏结构化动作先验。
AI.method: 构造imagination tokens作为扩散初始状态，提供物理先验与动作条件表征；引入带未来条件的特权信息蒸馏(privileged information distillation)增强未来感知的动作生成，从而支持单步扩散生成高质量动作。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶与具身控制任务上取得与需数十步的直接策略WAM及Joint-WAM相当甚至更优的性能；相对直接策略WAM基线约3倍加速；编译后推理延迟低至40ms（NVIDIA RTX 5090）。
AI.conclusion: 以结构化先验替代随机初始化是实现单步高质量动作生成的关键，使世界动作模型具备实时部署能力。

title: Nonprehensile Robotic Catching Using Virtual Constraints
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures; an abridged version of this article has been submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: The problem of nonprehensile robotic catching is addressed using virtual nonholonomic constraints (VNHCs); the motion of the robot end-effector is designed and controlled directly in terms of the states of the object before it is caught on the surface of the end-effector. In contrast to contemporary approaches, our approach avoids the need for object trajectory prediction, and consequent time-varying robot trajectory generation. With a focus on the planar case, we demonstrate that our VNHC approach can be used to catch an object on an end-effector at a desired height, with minimal relative normal velocity at the contact instant. Moreover, the VNHC function depends only on the desired catching height, and the same VNHC can be used for a range of initial conditions. We use model predictive control (MPC) to bring the object and end-effector to rest at a desired location after contact is made. The approach is validated in simulation.

AI.tldr: 用虚拟非完整约束(VNHC)直接在物体状态空间设计末端执行器运动来实现非抓取式接球,无需物体轨迹预测,配合MPC完成接触后减速停止。
AI.motivation: 传统非抓取接球依赖物体轨迹预测和时变机器人轨迹生成,计算与实时性负担大;希望直接在末端执行器上"塑造"物体的运动状态,避免预测环节。
AI.method: 以平面情形为对象,构造仅依赖目标接球高度的虚拟非完整约束(VNHC)函数,使物体在接触瞬间于指定高度具有极小相对法向速度;末端执行器运动直接由物体状态变量参数化并闭环控制;接触后使用模型预测控制(MPC)将物体与末端共同静止于目标位置。
AI.result: 仿真验证:可在期望高度接住物体并实现接近零的相对法向接触速度,同一VNHC对不同初始条件具有通用性;接触后MPC实现协同停稳。
AI.conclusion: VNHC框架为无预测的非抓取接球提供了简洁的约束化设计范式,但仅在平面仿真中验证,缺少三维、真实机器人与复杂动力学(摩擦、冲击)的实证。

title: Differentiable Contact Dynamics for Legged Locomotion: Policy Learning and Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization
summary: This paper proposes a smooth analytic gradient for frictional contact and applies it to policy learning and contact-implicit trajectory optimization for legged locomotion. The exact contact sensitivity is available in closed form but describes changes within the current contact mode, providing no first-order information toward neighboring contact modes. The proposed gradient replaces this sensitivity only in the backward pass, leaving the hard-contact forward solve unchanged and the realized rollout feasible. A central-path relaxation of the de Saxcé-corrected second-order-cone complementarity problem for Coulomb friction smooths the conditions defining the separating, clamping, and sliding modes. The relaxed sensitivity is evaluated at a point on the central path obtained by a Newton iteration initialized from the hard-contact solution. The sensitivity remains continuous through contact-mode transitions and converges to the exact sensitivity as the relaxation vanishes. Using 100,000 samples and less than 2 min of training on a desktop PC, policy learning with the proposed gradient produces a policy that transfers to hardware without fine-tuning. On hardware, the robot under a trotting policy withstands pushes and traverses debris and slippery ground. In trajectory optimization, the proposed gradient reaches contact-rich solutions missed by exact and Signorini-relaxed gradients. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出摩擦接触的平滑解析梯度：仅在反向传播中用以中心路径松弛的敏感性替换精确敏感性，前向仍保持硬接触求解，从而在接触模式切换处保持连续可导，并成功用于腿足机器人策略学习与接触隐式轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 接触隐式优化中，精确接触敏感性在闭式下可得，但只描述当前接触模式内的变化，对相邻接触模式无一阶信息，导致梯度在模式切换（分离/夹紧/滑动）处不连续，阻碍策略学习与轨迹优化的收敛。
AI.method: 对de Saxcé修正的库仑摩擦二阶锥互补问题做中心路径松弛，平滑分离、夹紧、滑动三种模式的定义条件；松弛后的敏感性在由硬接触解初始化、经Newton迭代得到的中心路径点上求值；该梯度仅替换反向传播，前向硬接触求解不变，rollout仍严格可行；松弛趋于零时收敛到精确敏感性。
AI.result: 策略学习仅用10万样本、桌面PC上不到2分钟训练，所得策略零微调迁移到实机；实机上trot策略可抵御推力、穿越碎石与湿滑地面。在轨迹优化中，该方法找到精确梯度与Signorini松弛梯度均遗漏的富接触解。
AI.conclusion: 通过只在反向通道施加中心路径松弛敏感性，可在保持前向可行性同时获得跨接触模式的连续梯度，是腿足locomotion中兼顾物理正确性与可优化性的实用方案。

title: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
comment: Project page and code are available at this https URL
summary: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.

AI.tldr: FL4N是首个前馈式隐式4D新视角合成模型，用统一的时空潜在表示替代显式4D高斯，仅以图像合成目标训练即可实时渲染并达到SOTA，且能泛化到真实视频。
AI.motivation: 单目前馈4D NVS中显式4D高斯表示易产生时序不一致与明显渲染伪影；同时动态训练数据稀缺，难以直接学习完整4D先验。
AI.method: 将4D场景先验编码为跨时空的统一隐式表示；核心思想是在预训练静态隐式先验上以残差方式学习时序动态。引入轻量动态编码器，利用静态场景特征将物体运动与相机视差解耦，仅用图像合成损失训练。
AI.result: 实现SOTA的4D NVS质量并支持实时渲染；所学隐式表示可泛化到真实世界视频，并能将视角与时间解耦。
AI.conclusion: 以隐式残差式4D先验替代显式4D图元，是低数据下高效建模动态场景的可行路线，兼具质量、速度与泛化性。

title: Do vision models know that three is three?
summary: Do vision models encode the transition $2{\to}3$ the same way whether it appears in handwritten digits or in hand gestures, and do they "understand" that clean${\to}$dirty is the same transformation regardless of whether it is applied to a kitchen or a carpet? The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) answers this for language models: concept changes correspond to directions in (language) embedding space. In vision, the same concept can manifest in visually unrelated "regimes" that rarely co-occur: images of digits and hands do not share much in common in pixel space. To understand whether vision models still encode the underlying abstract concepts, we study 46 vision encoders across architectures, training objectives, and scales, on 10 concept families including numerosity, age, object identity, and MIT-States attributes. Within each regime, we find statistically significant concept directions near-universally across our tested models. However, two distinct regimes do not always share the same concept direction. Several models learn multiple linear structures for the same concept transition, split across regimes.
