We call this phenomenon "fragmented linearity": strong local linearity coexisting with near-absent global linearity. Fragmentation is, however, not fixed: models with stronger local linearity progressively escape it (local-global linearity correlated with $\tau \in [0.38, 0.89]$ across all concepts), and where global linearity does emerge, concept directions can transfer as linear probes across regimes.

AI.tldr: 研究46个视觉编码器在10类概念族上的线性表征，发现“片段化线性”（fragmented linearity）：各视觉"域"内局部概念方向几乎普遍显著，但跨域不一致；局部线性越强越能逐步摆脱片段化，并实现概念方向跨域的线性探针迁移。
AI.motivation: 线性表征假设（LRH）在语言模型中成立，但视觉中同一抽象概念常出现在像素空间毫不相关的"域"（如手写数字 vs 手势），视觉模型是否编码跨域的抽象概念转变方向尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在10个概念族（数值量、年龄、物体身份、MIT-States属性等）上，系统评测46个不同架构、训练目标与规模的视觉编码器，逐域检测概念方向的统计显著性，并比较同一概念转变在不同域间方向的共享程度与探针迁移性。
AI.result: 各域内概念方向几乎普遍统计显著；但两个域并不总共享同一方向，部分模型为同一概念转变学出多套线性结构，即强局部线性与近乎缺失的全局线性并存（"片段化线性"）。局部线性与全局线性呈相关（τ∈[0.38, 0.89]），全局线性出现时可跨域迁移线性探针。
AI.conclusion: 视觉编码器的抽象概念表征是片段化的线性结构，而非统一全局线性；该现象可随局部线性增强而缓解，为跨域概念可迁移性提供了解释与评估框架。

title: Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Therefore, we present FLORE, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. We collect robot-free demonstrations using two force-sensing UMI-style handheld grippers for hand motion and contact wrenches, and wearable trackers for body motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and remain compliant along the others. In simulation, the controller tracks per-hand force commands of varied magnitude and direction, with little loss in whole-body motion accuracy. Across three contact-rich tasks on the robot, the force-reactive policy succeeds in 80% of rollouts, compared with 26.7% for a position-only policy trained on the same demonstrations and executed by the same controller. For more details, please visit our website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: FLORE：用人手持UMI式力感夹爪采集无机器人示教，训练力反应扩散策略输出动作与双手力指令，配合混合柔顺全身控制器实现人形接触力协调。
AI.motivation: 日常任务既需控运动也需控接触力，人形上力需双手与全身协调，仅靠运动学轨迹无法指定力。
AI.method: 用两个带力感知的UMI式手持夹爪+可穿戴追踪器采集无机器人示教（手运动、接触力旋量、身体运动）；力反应扩散策略输入视觉、本体感知与测得力旋量，输出动作与每手力指令；混合柔顺全身控制器以真实F/T传感器的力误差积分实现指令方向精确跟踪、其他方向柔顺，同时保持平衡。
AI.result: 仿真中控制器可跟踪不同幅值与方向的双手力指令且全身运动精度损失小；真机三个接触丰富任务，力反应策略成功率80%，同控制器下纯位置策略仅26.7%。
AI.conclusion: 显式力指令+力跟踪控制对人形接触丰富任务至关重要，力反应策略显著优于位置-only基线。

title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

AI.tldr: VibeVideoBench：面向“代码驱动视频生成”多模态智能体的基准，239 个中英文任务、12 类，沙箱内原生长程自主产出带音轨 MP4；采用交付规格程序检查、约13k任务级 rubric 与 VLM 评审团+盲测人类偏好分层评估；9 个前沿系统 2151 次 rollout 均未解决。
AI.motivation: 扩散视频模型无法可靠渲染精确公式、正确图表、规则一致的游戏或与画面事件同步的解说，缺乏可验证的精确性与长程一致性；而“智能体写代码渲染每一帧并合成音频”是替代路线，但缺少统一的、以证据为基础的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 239 个自包含任务（英/中双语，12 类：数据故事、音乐驱动、课堂讲授、论文解读等），智能体在其原生 harness 中于沙箱内限时 1 小时产出带声 MP4。评估分三层：交付规格的程序化检查；约 13k 条任务专属 rubric 检查并溯源到对应需求；五个质量维度、按任务锚定的人评标准，由三个 VLM 评审团打分，并用盲测人类偏好验证。
AI.result: 对 9 个前沿智能体系统、2151 次计分 rollout：GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 明显领先，但最佳系统仍有约 1/4 任务未满足核心要求；视频是否最终交付与质量同等重要，丢失视频中约 3/4 源于最终渲染启动过晚、运行过慢或从未启动；评审团在系统排序上与人类一致，但在单条视频上仅中等一致。
AI.conclusion: 代码驱动视频生成基准远未饱和，瓶颈既在质量也在长程执行与时限管理；提出的分层、rubric 溯源与 VLM+人类联合验证协议可作为该方向的可复现评测范式。
